'Look at the shape of each one — the curve tells you what it heals and the point tells you where.' I studied them until the difference became clear, and the right word rose in my mind like a warm light.
guess:1.cnHint: 师妹叮嘱我不要____，要仔细看每颗字种的形状，才能辨别它们的效用。
guess:1.hook: One seed had no curve and no point — it had neither shape at all.
guess:1.line: 'If you *guess* instead of reading, the herb will answer the wrong question.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread five small word-seeds on the flat rock between us and looked at me with calm eyes.
sentences.cn: 小杏在我们之间的平石上铺开五粒小字种，用平静的眼睛看我。

sentences.en: 'Do not *guess*,' she said quietly.
'Look at the shape of each one — the curve tells you what it heals and the point tells you where.'
sentences.cn: 看每一粒的形状——曲线告诉你它治愈什么，尖端告诉你在哪里。

sentences.en: I studied them until the difference became clear, and the right word rose in my mind like a warm light.
sentences.cn: 我研究它们直到差别变得清晰，一个温暖的光芒像字一样在我脑海中升起。

protection:1.en: A sudden wind crossed the open market ledge of the floating town, scattering herb-papers and word-scrolls across the stone floor. Shen Wujiu moved quickly, drawing a single character in the air with two fingers. A thin shell of light settled over our pile of word-seeds, and the wind passed around it. 'That,' he said, 'is *protection*.'
protection:1.cnHint: 大风吹过浮空集市，师兄在空中画字，为我们的字种提供了____。
protection:1.hook: The wind did not stop — it circled the ledge and came back harder.
protection:1.line: '*Protection* is a word you must know before you leave this mountain.'

sentences.en: A sudden wind crossed the open market ledge of the floating town, scattering herb-papers and word-scrolls across the stone floor.
sentences.cn: 一阵突风掠过浮城的开放市坡，吹散了草纸和字卷撒满石地。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu moved quickly, drawing a single character in the air with two fingers.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎迅速移动，用两根手指在空中画了一个字。

sentences.en: A thin shell of light settled over our pile of word-seeds, and the wind passed around it.
sentences.cn: 一层薄薄的光膜落在我们的字种堆上，风从周围吹过。

sentences.en: 'That,' he said, 'is *protection*.'

resident:1.en: The floating town of Yunbu sat on a wide stone shelf halfway up the tallest peak. Every *resident* there was either a word-trader or a retired disciple who had chosen the high air over the valley below. An old woman at her doorway nodded as I passed. She held a small glowing character in her open palm, turning it slowly like a piece of fruit.
resident:1.cnHint: 浮空小镇云埠的每位____不是字商就是退隐弟子，一位老妇在门口翻转着一个发光的字符。
resident:1.hook: The character in her palm suddenly went dark when she saw my face.
resident:1.line: 'Every *resident* here once stood where you are standing now, young one.'

sentences.en: The floating town of Yunbu sat on a wide stone shelf halfway up the tallest peak.
sentences.cn: 云布浮城坐在最高峰中途的宽阔石架上。

sentences.en: Every *resident* there was either a word-trader or a retired disciple who had chosen the high air over the valley below.
An old woman at her doorway nodded as I passed.
sentences.cn: 我经过时，门口的一位老妇人点了点头。

sentences.en: She held a small glowing character in her open palm, turning it slowly like a piece of fruit.
sentences.cn: 她的手心握着一个小小的闪耀字符，像转动一块水果一样慢慢转动。

willing:1.en: At the edge of the cloud-market, Master Qingwu asked each of us in turn whether we were *willing* to carry a word-herb across the open bridge alone, in full wind, with no senior disciple beside us. One by one the others nodded. When my turn came, I felt the wind pull at my sleeves, and I nodded too. She wrote something small in her record-book.
willing:1.cnHint: 师尊逐一询问弟子是否____独自携带字草穿越风中的天桥，轮到我时我点了头。
willing:1.hook: She did not write anything after the disciple who answered last.
willing:1.line: 'Only the *willing* hand can carry a word-herb without waking it too soon.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the cloud-market, Master Qingwu asked each of us in turn whether we were *willing* to carry a word-herb across the open bridge alone, in full wind, with no senior disciple beside us.
One by one the others nodded.
sentences.cn: 一个接一个其他人点了头。

sentences.en: When my turn came, I felt the wind pull at my sleeves, and I nodded too.
sentences.cn: 轮到我时，我感觉风拉扯着我的衣袖，我也点了头。

sentences.en: She wrote something small in her record-book.
sentences.cn: 她在记录册上写了点什么。

admit:1.en: At the base of Verdant Peak, a crowd of young disciples waited in silence. Master Qingwu stood at the gate, studying each face with calm eyes. One by one she turned people away. At last she reached me, paused, and spoke the words that changed everything. She chose to *admit* me into the Cloud Sea Sect.
admit:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在云海宗门口审视每一位求入者，终于____了我。
admit:1.hook: But the gate creaked shut, and something watched from above.
admit:1.line: 'I will *admit* only those whose hearts are still,' she said.

sentences.en: At the base of Verdant Peak, a crowd of young disciples waited in silence.
sentences.cn: 在翠峰的山脚，一群年轻弟子无声地等待。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the gate, studying each face with calm eyes.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在门前，用平静的眼睛研究每一张脸。

sentences.en: One by one she turned people away.
sentences.cn: 一个接一个她拒绝了人们。

sentences.en: At last she reached me, paused, and spoke the words that changed everything.
sentences.cn: 最后她走到我面前，停顿了，说出改变一切的话。

sentences.en: She chose to *admit* me into the Cloud Sea Sect.

association:1.en: On the outer steps of the sect hall, Shen Wujiu showed me a carved stone tablet listing every inner circle. 'Each group trains apart,' he said. 'But this one is different.' He pointed to a name near the top. Their *association* of cloud-walking disciples had not accepted anyone new for thirty years.
association:1.cnHint: 师兄向我介绍宗内各个____，其中一个云行弟子的团体已三十年未纳新人。
association:1.hook: The carved name on the tablet slowly began to glow.
association:1.line: 'The *association* has watched you since you arrived,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: On the outer steps of the sect hall, Shen Wujiu showed me a carved stone tablet listing every inner circle.
sentences.cn: 在宗殿的外台阶上，沈无咎给我看一块刻着每个内圈的石板。

sentences.en: 'Each group trains apart,' he said.
sentences.cn: 他说，每个团队都单独训练。

sentences.en: 'But this one is different.'
sentences.cn: 但这一个不同。

sentences.en: He pointed to a name near the top.
sentences.cn: 他指向靠近顶部的一个名字。

sentences.en: Their *association* of cloud-walking disciples had not accepted anyone new for thirty years.

brand:1.en: Xiaoxing knelt beside a low flame at the courtyard's edge, pressing a warm seal onto a strip of spirit-bark. 'Every herb we gather must carry this mark,' she told me softly. The *brand* of the Cloud Sea Sect — two mountains above a wave — meant the herb had been blessed and was safe to use.
brand:1.cnHint: 小星用宗门印记给药草打____，以示这些药草已经过祝福可以安全使用。
brand:1.hook: One strip of bark, already marked, began to tremble on its own.
brand:1.line: 'This *brand* tells the world where our power comes from,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing knelt beside a low flame at the courtyard's edge, pressing a warm seal onto a strip of spirit-bark.
sentences.cn: 小杏跪在院子边的低火焰旁，把一个温暖的印章按在一条灵树皮上。

sentences.en: 'Every herb we gather must carry this mark,' she told me softly.
sentences.cn: 她轻声告诉我，我们采集的每一株草都必须带着这个标记。

sentences.en: The *brand* of the Cloud Sea Sect — two mountains above a wave — meant the herb had been blessed and was safe to use.

deep:1.en: Master Qingwu led me to the eastern cliff and told me to breathe. Far below the floating mountain, the sea of clouds shifted and rolled. 'Do not fear the height,' she said. 'Fear only a shallow mind.' I looked *deep* into the white silence beneath my feet and felt something ancient stir.
deep:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊带我到东崖，让我凝视脚下____处的云海，感受其中沉睡的力量。
deep:1.hook: A shape moved far below, too large and too slow to be wind.
deep:1.line: 'Look *deep*, and the clouds will show you what you are,' she said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led me to the eastern cliff and told me to breathe.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊带我来到东边的悬崖，让我调整呼吸。

sentences.en: Far below the floating mountain, the sea of clouds shifted and rolled.
sentences.cn: 浮山之下，云海翻滚涌动。

sentences.en: 'Do not fear the height,' she said.
sentences.cn: "不要害怕高度，"她说。

sentences.en: 'Fear only a shallow mind.'
sentences.cn: "只要害怕心浅。"

sentences.en: I looked *deep* into the white silence beneath my feet and felt something ancient stir.

discover:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade slip and told me to walk the outer herb garden alone. 'Say nothing until you find it,' he said. Near the northern wall, half hidden under broad silver leaves, I bent down to *discover* a single violet stalk glowing faintly — a spirit herb no map had ever marked.
discover:1.cnHint: 师兄让我独自漫步药草园，我在北墙边____了一株任何地图上都未曾标注的发光灵草。
discover:1.hook: The violet glow pulsed once, as though it had been waiting.
discover:1.line: 'Those who truly *discover* a herb must also name it,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade slip and told me to walk the outer herb garden alone.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一块小玉简，让我独自走外面的药园。

sentences.en: 'Say nothing until you find it,' he said.
sentences.cn: "找到它之前别说话，"他说。

sentences.en: Near the northern wall, half hidden under broad silver leaves, I bent down to *discover* a single violet stalk glowing faintly — a spirit herb no map had ever marked.

essential:1.en: Before the morning bell, Xiaoxing and I swept the stone path that wound around the peak. She stopped and pointed to a small hollow in the rock face where water collected. 'This pool is *essential*,' she said quietly. 'Without it the oldest spirit tree cannot drink, and without that tree, our sect has no roots.'
essential:1.cnHint: 小星指着岩壁上的一处积水坑，说它是古灵树乃至整个宗门存续的____所在。
essential:1.hook: The pool's surface rippled though the morning air was perfectly still.
essential:1.line: 'Rest is *essential*; a tired hand drops the rarest herb,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Before the morning bell, Xiaoxing and I swept the stone path that wound around the peak.
sentences.cn: 晨钟敲响前，我和小杏扫过绕着山峰蜿蜒的石径。

sentences.en: She stopped and pointed to a small hollow in the rock face where water collected.
sentences.cn: 她停下来，指向岩壁上一个积水的浅凹处。

sentences.en: 'This pool is *essential*,' she said quietly.
'Without it the oldest spirit tree cannot drink, and without that tree, our sect has no roots.'
sentences.cn: "没有那棵树，我们宗派就没有根基。"

fine:1.en: The path along the outer ridge was narrow but the air was clear. Shen Wujiu walked ahead without looking down. He asked how I felt after my first night on the floating mountain. I told him I was *fine*, though my legs still trembled from the height and my ears still rang with wind.
fine:1.cnHint: 在浮山外脊的小路上，师兄问我第一夜的感受，我说我____，但身体其实还未完全适应。
fine:1.hook: He smiled, then stopped — the path ahead had simply ended.
fine:1.line: 'You say you are *fine*, but your shadow leans toward the edge,' he said.

sentences.en: The path along the outer ridge was narrow but the air was clear.
sentences.cn: 外脊的路很窄，但空气清冷透亮。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu walked ahead without looking down.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎走在前面，眼睛从不往下看。

sentences.en: He asked how I felt after my first night on the floating mountain.
sentences.cn: 他问我在浮山的第一夜感觉如何。

sentences.en: I told him I was *fine*, though my legs still trembled from the height and my ears still rang with wind.

largely:1.en: At the wide terrace below the main hall, older disciples gathered to trade spirit herbs before noon. Xiaoxing whispered that the daily market was *largely* run by the herb-keeper elders, but the best rare finds always came from young disciples who wandered too far and stumbled onto something they could not name.
largely:1.cnHint: 在宗门主殿下的露台集市上，小星告诉我这里____由掌药长老主导，但最珍稀的药材往往来自误入深处的年轻弟子。
largely:1.hook: One young disciple held out a herb, and every elder went silent.
largely:1.line: 'Our strength is *largely* drawn from what grows where no one looks,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: At the wide terrace below the main hall, older disciples gathered to trade spirit herbs before noon.
sentences.cn: 大殿下的宽阔平台上，年长的弟子在正午前聚集交易灵草。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing whispered that the daily market was *largely* run by the herb-keeper elders, but the best rare finds always came from young disciples who wandered too far and stumbled onto something they could not name.

machine:1.en: The outer courtyard held a strange *machine* — brass rings turning inside larger rings, each carved with a single word. Shen Wujiu explained that the sect used it to measure a disciple's breath against the living formulas. I pressed my palm to the cold metal and felt the rings shudder, then spin faster than wind.
machine:1.cnHint: 外院有一台奇异的____，用来测量弟子与灵文之间的共鸣。
machine:1.hook: One ring kept spinning long after all the others had stopped.
machine:1.line: 'This *machine* has not moved that fast in forty years,' said Shen Wujiu, his voice very quiet.

sentences.en: The outer courtyard held a strange *machine* — brass rings turning inside larger rings, each carved with a single word.
Shen Wujiu explained that the sect used it to measure a disciple's breath against the living formulas.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎解释说宗派用它来校验弟子的呼吸是否符合生活的法则。

sentences.en: I pressed my palm to the cold metal and felt the rings shudder, then spin faster than wind.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌贴在冰冷的金属上，感觉到齿轮颤动，然后旋转得比风还快。

observe:1.en: On the first morning of the Cloud Sea Sect, we gathered at the cliff edge to *observe* the ancient rite of Mist Greeting. Master Qingwu lit a single word-leaf and let the smoke rise into the sky. Every disciple bowed as the clouds below us turned a deep, slow gold.
observe:1.cnHint: 清晨，全体弟子聚集在悬崖边____古老的迎雾仪式。
observe:1.hook: The gold faded too soon — by half a breath, the elders said nothing, but their eyes were troubled.
observe:1.line: 'We *observe* this rite so the clouds remember we are still here,' Master Qingwu said softly.

sentences.en: On the first morning of the Cloud Sea Sect, we gathered at the cliff edge to *observe* the ancient rite of Mist Greeting.
Master Qingwu lit a single word-leaf and let the smoke rise into the sky.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊点燃一片词叶，让烟雾升向天空。

sentences.en: Every disciple bowed as the clouds below us turned a deep, slow gold.
sentences.cn: 每个弟子都鞠躬，我们下方的云海变成了深沉、缓慢的金色。

fat:1.en: Xiaoxing pointed at the word-herb called Golden Marrow, its leaves thick with stored light. 'It looks almost like *fat*,' she said, laughing. I pressed one leaf between my fingers and felt warmth move up my arm, rich and slow, the way a deep river moves under ice.
fat:1.cnHint: 小星指着一株储满灵光的词草，说它的叶片像____一样厚实。
fat:1.hook: The warmth reached my shoulder and stopped, as if blocked by something I could not see.
fat:1.line: 'A leaf this full of *fat* light can mend a cracked spirit bone,' Xiaoxing said, eyes bright.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pointed at the word-herb called Golden Marrow, its leaves thick with stored light.
sentences.cn: 小杏指向那种叫金髓的词草，叶片厚实、闪闪发光。

sentences.en: 'It looks almost like *fat*,' she said, laughing.
I pressed one leaf between my fingers and felt warmth move up my arm, rich and slow, the way a deep river moves under ice.
sentences.cn: 我在指尖按压一片叶子，感受到暖意沿着手臂上升，浓郁而缓慢，就像深河在冰下的流动。

helpful:1.en: I had learned three words but could hold none of them steady in the wind. Shen Wujiu knelt beside me on the stone path and showed me how to anchor each word at the base of my breath. It was the most *helpful* lesson I had yet received, and yet when I stood up, my shadow fell the wrong way.
helpful:1.cnHint: 沈无咎教了我一个极____的稳字之法，但站起身后，我的影子朝着错误的方向倒去。
helpful:1.hook: My shadow pointed east — and the morning sun stood firmly in the south.
helpful:1.line: 'The most *helpful* thing I can teach you is to trust the word before you trust your hand,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: I had learned three words but could hold none of them steady in the wind.
sentences.cn: 我学会了三个词，却没办法在风中保持它们的稳定。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu knelt beside me on the stone path and showed me how to anchor each word at the base of my breath.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在石径上跪下身子，教我如何在呼吸的根部固定每个词。

sentences.en: It was the most *helpful* lesson I had yet received, and yet when I stood up, my shadow fell the wrong way.

position:1.en: Master Qingwu moved me to a new *position* on the training terrace — three steps closer to the edge, where the wind carried live word-seeds up from the cloud sea below. I could feel each seed brush my skin like a whispered question. The drop beyond my toes was longer than silence.
position:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊将我调至演武台上一个新的____，那里风中漂浮着来自云海的活灵字种。
position:1.hook: A word-seed landed on my lip and, for one breath, I understood a formula I had never been taught.
position:1.line: 'Your *position* here is not a reward — it is a test,' Master Qingwu said, eyes forward.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu moved me to a new *position* on the training terrace — three steps closer to the edge, where the wind carried live word-seeds up from the cloud sea below.
I could feel each seed brush my skin like a whispered question.
sentences.cn: 我能感觉到每粒词种像低声的问题一样拂过我的皮肤。

sentences.en: The drop beyond my toes was longer than silence.
sentences.cn: 我脚尖外的悬空比沉默还深。

threat:1.en: A grey fog rolled in from the northern peaks, carrying the smell of burned words — a sign that a rival sect had tried to harvest our cloud-herbs without permission. Shen Wujiu stood at the gate, calm but watchful. 'This is not the first *threat*,' he told me, 'but it feels different today.'
threat:1.cnHint: 北峰飘来一片灰雾，带着焦灼灵文的气息，像是某种____正在逼近。
threat:1.hook: The fog stopped at our gate — then, slowly, it began to spell something.
threat:1.line: 'A *threat* that arrives in silence is harder to answer than one that shouts,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: A grey fog rolled in from the northern peaks, carrying the smell of burned words — a sign that a rival sect had tried to harvest our cloud-herbs without permission.
sentences.cn: 灰雾从北峰卷来，带着烧焦的词的味道——这是敌对宗派在试图未经允许就采摘我们的云草的信号。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the gate, calm but watchful.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在门边，平静但警惕。

sentences.en: 'This is not the first *threat*,' he told me, 'but it feels different today.'

trend:1.en: Among the younger disciples, there was a clear *trend*: everyone wanted the flying words, the bright ones that lifted your feet off stone. Xiaoxing shook her head and kept practicing the quiet healing formulas instead. By evening her hands glowed like paper lanterns, and the rest of us looked at our empty palms.
trend:1.cnHint: 年轻弟子中出现了一种____，人人都追捧御风飞行的灵字，唯独小星专心修习治愈术。
trend:1.hook: When the night bell rang, only Xiaoxing's lantern-hands could be seen through the mountain fog.
trend:1.line: 'If everyone follows a *trend*, who will be left to do the quiet work?' Xiaoxing asked, not unkindly.

sentences.en: Among the younger disciples, there was a clear *trend*: everyone wanted the flying words, the bright ones that lifted your feet off stone.
Xiaoxing shook her head and kept practicing the quiet healing formulas instead.
sentences.cn: 小杏摇摇头，反而继续练习那些安静的治愈法咒。

sentences.en: By evening her hands glowed like paper lanterns, and the rest of us looked at our empty palms.
sentences.cn: 到了傍晚，她的双手闪闪发光，像纸灯笼一样，而我们其他人只能看着自己空荡荡的手掌。

ultimately:1.en: I spent the afternoon trying every path across the Word Bridge — stone arches inscribed with living formulas that shifted if you mispronounced them. I fell twice, caught myself once, and *ultimately* crossed on a single held breath, speaking the bridge's true name in a voice barely above a whisper.
ultimately:1.cnHint: 我在灵字桥上尝试了每一条路，____以一口屏住的气息和轻声念出的真名走到了对岸。
ultimately:1.hook: The bridge went silent behind me, as though it would never let anyone cross again.
ultimately:1.line: 'You *ultimately* succeed not when the bridge trusts you, but when you trust the word,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: I spent the afternoon trying every path across the Word Bridge — stone arches inscribed with living formulas that shifted if you mispronounced them.
sentences.cn: 我整个下午都在试着穿过言语桥——那些石拱上刻满了活的公式，一旦你念错了，它们就会改变。

sentences.en: I fell twice, caught myself once, and *ultimately* crossed on a single held breath, speaking the bridge's true name in a voice barely above a whisper.

australia:1.en: Master Qingwu spread an old scroll across the stone table outside the Gate of First Clouds. 'Every sect has its own sky,' she said. 'Even the distant land called *Australia* holds words we have never heard — words that could heal wounds our herbs cannot touch.' I traced the strange syllables, feeling heat rise from the page.
australia:1.cnHint: 师尊在山门外展开古卷，提到远方有一片土地，那里藏有我们从未听闻的____灵词。
australia:1.hook: The scroll's edge began to smoke, though no flame was near.
australia:1.line: 'Even *Australia* holds words that our mountain has never tasted.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu spread an old scroll across the stone table outside the Gate of First Clouds.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在第一朵云门外的石桌上铺开了一幅古老的卷轴。

sentences.en: 'Every sect has its own sky,' she said.
sentences.cn: "每个宗派都有自己的天空，"她说。

sentences.en: 'Even the distant land called *Australia* holds words we have never heard — words that could heal wounds our herbs cannot touch.'
I traced the strange syllables, feeling heat rise from the page.
sentences.cn: 我追踪着那些奇怪的音节，感觉热度从纸页上升起。

authority:1.en: Outside the Hall of Clouds, Shen Wujiu stood before a crowd of new disciples, arms folded. He spoke with quiet *authority*, and every student fell still. 'A word spoken without understanding,' he said, 'is a stone thrown into deep water — it sinks, and you never know what it stirs.' I held my breath.
authority:1.cnHint: 师兄站在殿外，用他的____向新弟子讲述轻率使用灵词的危险。
authority:1.hook: Then a crack split the stone step behind him, clean as a blade.
authority:1.line: 'Speak with *authority*, or the word will turn against you.'

sentences.en: Outside the Hall of Clouds, Shen Wujiu stood before a crowd of new disciples, arms folded.
sentences.cn: 在云殿外，沈无咎站在一群新弟子面前，双臂交叠。

sentences.en: He spoke with quiet *authority*, and every student fell still.
'A word spoken without understanding,' he said, 'is a stone thrown into deep water — it sinks, and you never know what it stirs.'
sentences.cn: "一句不理解的话，"他说，"就像往深水里扔的石子——它会沉下去，你永远不知道它搅动了什么。"

sentences.en: I held my breath.
sentences.cn: 我屏住了呼吸。

confident:1.en: The morning test was held on the outer terrace, open sky above and cloud sea below. I stepped to the edge, more *confident* than I had any right to be, and released the word for 'rise.' For one breath, my feet left the stone. The other disciples went silent. Xiaoxing smiled from across the terrace.
confident:1.cnHint: 我在露台上参加晨试，____地使出"升"字灵词，双脚短暂地离开了地面。
confident:1.hook: A second later, a cold wind rose from below, carrying a smell of rain and iron.
confident:1.line: 'Be *confident*, but remember — the sky does not forgive a careless word.'

sentences.en: The morning test was held on the outer terrace, open sky above and cloud sea below.
sentences.cn: 早晨的试炼在外平台举行，头上是开阔的天空，脚下是云海。

sentences.en: I stepped to the edge, more *confident* than I had any right to be, and released the word for 'rise.'
For one breath, my feet left the stone.
sentences.cn: 有一瞬间，我的双脚离开了石头。

sentences.en: The other disciples went silent.
sentences.cn: 其他弟子都沉默了。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing smiled from across the terrace.
sentences.cn: 小杏从平台那头笑了。

crowd:1.en: On the market path between the outer peaks, a *crowd* of disciples gathered around a senior who was writing words in the air with a burning brush. Each word floated for a moment, then dissolved into light. I pushed to the front, desperate to see. Master Qingwu watched from a high step, saying nothing.
crowd:1.cnHint: 在两峰之间的市道上，弟子们____在一位师长周围，观看他以烈笔书写悬空灵词。
crowd:1.hook: The last word did not dissolve — it turned dark and held its shape.
crowd:1.line: 'Do not let the *crowd* pull you forward before you are ready.'

sentences.en: On the market path between the outer peaks, a *crowd* of disciples gathered around a senior who was writing words in the air with a burning brush.
Each word floated for a moment, then dissolved into light.
sentences.cn: 每个字浮现一瞬，然后消散成光。

sentences.en: I pushed to the front, desperate to see.
sentences.cn: 我推向前去，拼命想要看清。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched from a high step, saying nothing.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从高处的台阶上看着，什么也没说。

highly:1.en: Shen Wujiu spoke to me near the low bridge at the edge of the sect grounds, voice unhurried. 'Master Qingwu thinks *highly* of your ear for sound,' he said. 'She believes you will hear what others miss.' I did not know what to say. The clouds below the bridge shifted, and for a moment I thought I saw a shape moving through them.
highly:1.cnHint: 师兄在山门边的小桥旁告诉我，师尊对我有着很高的____评价，认为我能听到旁人错过的东西。
highly:1.hook: The shape in the clouds rose closer, slow and deliberate.
highly:1.line: 'Master Qingwu thinks *highly* of you — do not waste that gift.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spoke to me near the low bridge at the edge of the sect grounds, voice unhurried.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在宗派边界的低桥附近对我说话，声音不急不躁。

sentences.en: 'Master Qingwu thinks *highly* of your ear for sound,' he said.
'She believes you will hear what others miss.'
sentences.cn: "她相信你会听到别人听不到的东西。"

sentences.en: I did not know what to say.
sentences.cn: 我不知道该说什么。

sentences.en: The clouds below the bridge shifted, and for a moment I thought I saw a shape moving through them.
sentences.cn: 桥下的云海移动了，有一瞬间我以为看到了什么东西在云的深处移动。

occur:1.en: Xiaoxing and I sat on the outer steps after evening study, watching the sky change colour. 'Does it ever *occur* to you,' she said softly, 'that every word we learn is also learning us?' I had no answer. Below, the cloud sea turned from gold to grey, and somewhere in its depth, a light pulsed once, then went out.
occur:1.cnHint: 小星和我在台阶上望着暮色，她问我有没有____过一个念头：每个我们学习的灵词也在反过来认识我们。
occur:1.hook: The light in the clouds pulsed again — twice this time.
occur:1.line: 'Did it ever *occur* to you that the words choose us, not the other way?'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing and I sat on the outer steps after evening study, watching the sky change colour.
sentences.cn: 小杏和我在晚间功课后坐在外面的台阶上，看着天空变色。

sentences.en: 'Does it ever *occur* to you,' she said softly, 'that every word we learn is also learning us?'
I had no answer.
sentences.cn: 我没有答案。

sentences.en: Below, the cloud sea turned from gold to grey, and somewhere in its depth, a light pulsed once, then went out.
sentences.cn: 下面，云海从金黄色变成灰色，在它的深处某处，一盏灯闪烁了一下，然后熄灭了。

regularly:1.en: Each dawn, Master Qingwu walked the outer path alone, speaking words *regularly* into the air — one every ten steps, steady as a heartbeat. I watched from the gate, counting. Shen Wujiu appeared beside me. 'She is feeding the mountain,' he said. 'If she stopped, the stone would forget how to hold the air.' I did not sleep well after that.
regularly:1.cnHint: 师尊每天清晨都会____地在山间小径上行走念词，师兄说她是在"喂养"这座山。
regularly:1.hook: That night, the outer path cracked in three places no one had walked.
regularly:1.line: 'Walk this path *regularly*, or the mountain will forget your weight.'

sentences.en: Each dawn, Master Qingwu walked the outer path alone, speaking words *regularly* into the air — one every ten steps, steady as a heartbeat.
I watched from the gate, counting.
sentences.cn: 我从门口看着，数着。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu appeared beside me.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎出现在我身旁。

sentences.en: 'She is feeding the mountain,' he said.
sentences.cn: "她在喂养这座山，"他说。

sentences.en: 'If she stopped, the stone would forget how to hold the air.'
sentences.cn: "如果她停下来，石头就会忘记怎样托住空气。"

sentences.en: I did not sleep well after that.
sentences.cn: 那之后我睡得不太好。

responsible:1.en: After a younger disciple mispronounced a word and cracked a stone wall near the east gate, Master Qingwu gathered us outside in the cool morning air. 'You are each *responsible* for the words you release,' she said, her voice level and without anger. 'A word that leaves your mouth is a stone that leaves your hand.' She turned and walked away. The cracked wall began to bleed thin smoke.
responsible:1.cnHint: 一名弟子念错灵词导致石墙开裂后，师尊召集众人，告知我们每人都要对自己____的灵词负责。
responsible:1.hook: The smoke from the wall curled upward and shaped itself into a single unknown character.
responsible:1.line: 'You are *responsible* for every word the moment it leaves your lips.'

sentences.en: After a younger disciple mispronounced a word and cracked a stone wall near the east gate, Master Qingwu gathered us outside in the cool morning air.
sentences.cn: 一个年轻的弟子在东门附近念错了一个字，裂开了一面石墙，青梧师尊把我们都聚集在凉爽的清晨空气中。

sentences.en: 'You are each *responsible* for the words you release,' she said, her voice level and without anger.
'A word that leaves your mouth is a stone that leaves your hand.'
sentences.cn: "一个从你嘴里说出去的字就是一块从你手里扔出去的石头。"

sentences.en: She turned and walked away.
sentences.cn: 她转身走开了。

sentences.en: The cracked wall began to bleed thin smoke.
sentences.cn: 裂开的墙开始渗出薄薄的烟。

slightly:1.en: The stone path outside the sect gate curved *slightly* to the left, as if bowing toward the sea of clouds below. I had walked it a hundred times, yet today it felt different beneath my feet. Xiaoxing stood at the edge, her white robe catching the wind. 'The path shifts,' she said quietly, 'when the mountain listens.'
slightly:1.cnHint: 山门外的石路今日感觉有些异样，师妹说山在____偏转时会聆听。
slightly:1.hook: Beneath our feet, the stone let out one soft, low sound.
slightly:1.line: 'The flame in your palm bends *slightly* — the word is almost yours.'

sentences.en: The stone path outside the sect gate curved *slightly* to the left, as if bowing toward the sea of clouds below.
I had walked it a hundred times, yet today it felt different beneath my feet.
sentences.cn: 我走过它一百次了，但今天它在我脚下感觉不同。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stood at the edge, her white robe catching the wind.
sentences.cn: 小杏站在边缘，她的白袍被风吹起。

sentences.en: 'The path shifts,' she said quietly, 'when the mountain listens.'
sentences.cn: "当山在听的时候，路就会变，"她轻声说。

vital:1.en: Master Qingwu laid three leaf-scrolls on the open air platform above the clouds. 'One word among these three,' she said, 'is *vital* — without it, the healing formula collapses like mist.' I studied each scroll in turn, my breath slow, my mind sharp. The wind held still, as though it too was waiting for my answer.
vital:1.cnHint: 师尊说三片叶卷中有一个字____，少了它治愈法诀便会瓦解。
vital:1.hook: One scroll began to glow at its edges, then stopped.
vital:1.line: 'Breath is *vital* — let it go and the word dies with it.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu laid three leaf-scrolls on the open air platform above the clouds.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在云上的开放平台上铺开了三卷叶简。

sentences.en: 'One word among these three,' she said, 'is *vital* — without it, the healing formula collapses like mist.'
I studied each scroll in turn, my breath slow, my mind sharp.
sentences.cn: 我逐一研究每张简，我的呼吸缓慢，我的心思敏锐。

sentences.en: The wind held still, as though it too was waiting for my answer.
sentences.cn: 风停止了，好像它也在等待我的答案。

mention:1.en: Shen Wujiu passed me on the cloud bridge without a glance, but at the last step he paused. 'There is one word,' he said, 'that Master Qingwu has never taught in class.' He did not make any further *mention* of it. He simply walked on, leaving only the sound of wind through the rope rails and a cold feeling at the back of my neck.
mention:1.cnHint: 师兄提到师尊课上有一个字从未被____，然后转身离去。
mention:1.hook: That evening, I found the word written in ash on my doorstep.
mention:1.line: 'No *mention* of this outside the inner hall — not to anyone.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu passed me on the cloud bridge without a glance, but at the last step he paused.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在云桥上经过我身边时没有看我，但在最后一步他停了下来。

sentences.en: 'There is one word,' he said, 'that Master Qingwu has never taught in class.'
sentences.cn: "有一个字，"他说，"是青梧师尊从来没有在课堂上教过的。"

sentences.en: He did not make any further *mention* of it.
He simply walked on, leaving only the sound of wind through the rope rails and a cold feeling at the back of my neck.
sentences.cn: 他只是走开了，只留下风吹过绳栏的声音和我后颈处的一阵寒意。

rare:1.en: High on the outer cliff, where the air grew thin and *rare*, a single silver herb clung to the rock face. Xiaoxing pointed up at it, her voice barely above a whisper. 'That plant holds a word no one has spoken in a generation,' she said. I pressed my palm to the cold stone and began to climb, one careful hold at a time.
rare:1.cnHint: 悬崖高处空气____而稀薄，一株银草上藏着一个久未有人说出的字。
rare:1.hook: Halfway up, something above us shifted and went still.
rare:1.line: 'Words grow in *rare* air — that is why so few disciples reach them.'

sentences.en: High on the outer cliff, where the air grew thin and *rare*, a single silver herb clung to the rock face.
Xiaoxing pointed up at it, her voice barely above a whisper.
sentences.cn: 小杏指向上方，声音几乎听不见。

sentences.en: 'That plant holds a word no one has spoken in a generation,' she said.
sentences.cn: 那株植物承载着一个整整一代人都没有说出过的字，她说。

sentences.en: I pressed my palm to the cold stone and began to climb, one careful hold at a time.
sentences.cn: 我把掌心贴在冰冷的石头上，开始往上爬，一次一个落脚点。

useful:1.en: I spent the morning arranging word-herbs on a flat cloud stone, sorting them by color and weight. Shen Wujiu watched from the doorway and shook his head. 'Only three of those are truly *useful* for what you plan to do,' he said. He pointed without touching them. I looked again and realized I had been grouping by beauty, not by purpose.
useful:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我摆放的字草中只有三株对我的目标真正____。
useful:1.hook: The three herbs he had chosen began to hum together at dusk.
useful:1.line: 'A word is only *useful* if you can hold it without fear.'

sentences.en: I spent the morning arranging word-herbs on a flat cloud stone, sorting them by color and weight.
sentences.cn: 我整个上午都在云石板上摆放字草，按颜色和分量分类。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu watched from the doorway and shook his head.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从门口看着，摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'Only three of those are truly *useful* for what you plan to do,' he said.
He pointed without touching them.
sentences.cn: 他指了指，没有碰它们。

sentences.en: I looked again and realized I had been grouping by beauty, not by purpose.
sentences.cn: 我又看了一遍，才明白自己一直是按美观程度分组，而不是按用处。

blood:1.en: The old gate record showed every disciple who had ever opened it, each name pressed into the wood in *blood*-red ink made from the crimson root herb. I found my own name there, already written, though I had only arrived that morning. Shen Wujiu said nothing when I showed him. He simply looked at the sky.
blood:1.cnHint: 门册上用____红草汁记录着每位弟子之名，而我的名字已在其中。
blood:1.hook: My name on the wood was still faintly warm to the touch.
blood:1.line: 'The sect traces its line through *blood* — the herbs remember every name.'

sentences.en: The old gate record showed every disciple who had ever opened it, each name pressed into the wood in *blood*-red ink made from the crimson root herb.
I found my own name there, already written, though I had only arrived that morning.
sentences.cn: 我在上面找到了自己的名字，虽然我才到这儿一个上午，名字却已经写在了上面。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said nothing when I showed him.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎看到的时候什么都没说。

sentences.en: He simply looked at the sky.
sentences.cn: 他只是看着天空。

fund:1.en: The inner library held one hundred word-scrolls, each one costly to preserve. Master Qingwu told us the sect used its entire spiritual *fund* each season just to keep them from fading. 'Read carefully,' she said, 'and waste nothing.' I opened the nearest scroll and felt the words rise off the page like warm breath meeting cold air.
fund:1.cnHint: 师尊说宗门每季要用尽全部____才能维持百卷字轴不褪色。
fund:1.hook: One scroll at the far end of the shelf had already gone blank.
fund:1.line: 'We *fund* the words so the words may one day carry you.'

sentences.en: The inner library held one hundred word-scrolls, each one costly to preserve.
sentences.cn: 内库里有一百卷字轴，每一卷的保存成本都很高。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told us the sect used its entire spiritual *fund* each season just to keep them from fading.
'Read carefully,' she said, 'and waste nothing.'
sentences.cn: 仔细读，别浪费，她说。

sentences.en: I opened the nearest scroll and felt the words rise off the page like warm breath meeting cold air.
sentences.cn: 我打开最近的一卷字轴，感觉字迹从纸面上升起来，像温热的呼吸遇上冷空气。

anxiety:1.en: Standing at the edge of the flight platform, I felt a sharp *anxiety* rise in my chest — not fear exactly, but a tightness, like a word held too long without being spoken. Below was only cloud. Xiaoxing stood beside me and said nothing for a long time. Then, gently, she pressed a small leaf into my hand. It smelled of pine and steady wind.
anxiety:1.cnHint: 站在飞升台边缘，我心中涌起一阵____，师妹将一片叶子悄悄放入我手中。
anxiety:1.hook: Far below the clouds, something large and dark moved once, then was gone.
anxiety:1.line: '*Anxiety* before the first flight is just the word asking to be freed.'

sentences.en: Standing at the edge of the flight platform, I felt a sharp *anxiety* rise in my chest — not fear exactly, but a tightness, like a word held too long without being spoken.
Below was only cloud.
sentences.cn: 下面只有云。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stood beside me and said nothing for a long time.
sentences.cn: 小杏站在我身边，沉默了很久。

sentences.en: Then, gently, she pressed a small leaf into my hand.
sentences.cn: 然后，她轻轻地把一片小叶子放在我手里。

sentences.en: It smelled of pine and steady wind.
sentences.cn: 闻起来像松树和稳定的风。

digital:1.en: At the sect's outer gate, a stone board displayed the rankings of all disciples. Each name was carved not in ink but in light — every score a *digital* mark that shifted when your cultivation rose or fell. I found my own name near the bottom, glowing faintly. Shen Wujiu stood beside me, arms folded, saying nothing.
digital:1.cnHint: 弟子们的修炼积分以光点形式显示在石榜上，我的____排名靠后。
digital:1.hook: Then my name flickered once — and vanished.
digital:1.line: 'Every *digital* mark on that board is a measure of your will,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: At the sect's outer gate, a stone board displayed the rankings of all disciples.
sentences.cn: 派系外门有块石板，上面显示着所有弟子的排名。

sentences.en: Each name was carved not in ink but in light — every score a *digital* mark that shifted when your cultivation rose or fell.
I found my own name near the bottom, glowing faintly.
sentences.cn: 我找到了自己的名字，在最底部附近，微微发光。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood beside me, arms folded, saying nothing.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在我身边，双臂交叉，什么都没说。

sale:1.en: Near the mountain's lower terrace, older disciples spread their spare herbs on flat stones each morning — a quiet *sale* of words too common for senior cultivators but precious to newcomers like me. I traded my only copper token for a pale leaf said to sharpen the mind. Xiaoxing warned me to check the colour first.
sale:1.cnHint: 弟子们在山脚摆摊____灵草，我用仅有的铜牌换了一片叶子。
sale:1.hook: The leaf was the wrong shade of pale — almost white.
sale:1.line: 'This *sale* ends at sunrise,' the older disciple said, folding the cloth away.

sentences.en: Near the mountain's lower terrace, older disciples spread their spare herbs on flat stones each morning — a quiet *sale* of words too common for senior cultivators but precious to newcomers like me.
I traded my only copper token for a pale leaf said to sharpen the mind.
sentences.cn: 我用仅有的一枚铜币换了一片苍白的叶子，据说能增强心智。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing warned me to check the colour first.
sentences.cn: 小杏警告我先检查颜色。

contact:1.en: Master Qingwu taught us that a word-herb must never *contact* bare skin before it is sealed in breath — the raw formula would dissolve into the body without control, scattering one's focus for days. I had forgotten. My palm tingled where the herb had rested, and the clouds below the mountain began to rise faster than usual.
contact:1.cnHint: 灵草在封印前不能____皮肤，我忘记了这一点，手掌开始发麻。
contact:1.hook: Above us, the sky turned the colour of a bruise.
contact:1.line: 'Do not let it *contact* your skin before you are ready,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu taught us that a word-herb must never *contact* bare skin before it is sealed in breath — the raw formula would dissolve into the body without control, scattering one's focus for days.
I had forgotten.
sentences.cn: 我忘了。

sentences.en: My palm tingled where the herb had rested, and the clouds below the mountain began to rise faster than usual.
sentences.cn: 草叶接触过的掌心发痒，山下的云开始比平时上升得快。

failure:1.en: The sect posted results from the first recitation trial on the gate pillar at dawn. My name carried a single word beside it: *failure*. Shen Wujiu read it without flinching and pressed a small herb into my hand — one that tasted of bitter root and, after a moment, of something almost sweet.
failure:1.cnHint: 第一次背诵考核的成绩张贴出来，我的名字旁边写着____。
failure:1.hook: Somewhere above, a bell rang that was not meant to ring until graduation.
failure:1.line: 'A *failure* to recite once does not close the path,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: The sect posted results from the first recitation trial on the gate pillar at dawn.
sentences.cn: 派系在天亮时在门柱上贴出了第一次吟诵试炼的成绩。

sentences.en: My name carried a single word beside it: *failure*.
Shen Wujiu read it without flinching and pressed a small herb into my hand — one that tasted of bitter root and, after a moment, of something almost sweet.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎读过结果没有皱眉，然后把一株小草递给了我——尝起来先是苦涩的根，之后有点甜味。

bird:1.en: A single white *bird* landed on the railing of the outer terrace as I practiced the word for wind. The sect elders called this kind of creature a messenger of the high peaks — it only appeared when a disciple's voice had reached the right pitch. It tilted its head, then lifted away into the cloud sea below without a sound.
bird:1.cnHint: 我练习风字诀时，一只白____落在栏杆上，据说只有声调准确时它才会出现。
bird:1.hook: It left behind one small feather that hummed faintly against the stone.
bird:1.line: 'When a *bird* like that lands near you, do not stop your practice,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: A single white *bird* landed on the railing of the outer terrace as I practiced the word for wind.
The sect elders called this kind of creature a messenger of the high peaks — it only appeared when a disciple's voice had reached the right pitch.
sentences.cn: 派系的长老们说这种生物是高峰的信使——只有当弟子的声音达到恰当的音调时，它才会出现。

sentences.en: It tilted its head, then lifted away into the cloud sea below without a sound.
sentences.cn: 它歪了歪头，然后无声地飞向下方的云海。

official:1.en: An *official* messenger from the sect's inner court arrived at midday, wearing a robe stitched with silver cloud patterns. He carried a sealed scroll and read aloud the names of three disciples chosen for the mountain trial. My name was not among them — but Xiaoxing's was, and her face went very still.
official:1.cnHint: 内院的____使者宣读了入选山岳试炼的三名弟子名单，小星在列。
official:1.hook: The silver seal on the empty scroll began to glow on its own.
official:1.line: 'The *official* list is final,' the messenger said, and rolled the scroll shut.

sentences.en: An *official* messenger from the sect's inner court arrived at midday, wearing a robe stitched with silver cloud patterns.
He carried a sealed scroll and read aloud the names of three disciples chosen for the mountain trial.
sentences.cn: 他拿着一卷密封的字轴，大声念出了三个被选中进行山试的弟子的名字。

sentences.en: My name was not among them — but Xiaoxing's was, and her face went very still.
sentences.cn: 我的名字不在其中——但小杏的名字在，她的脸变得很僵硬。

confidence:1.en: Before the recitation gate, each disciple had to speak a word-herb aloud with enough *confidence* to make the stone arch hum. Doubt, the elders said, was a crack in the vessel — the formula would leak out and dissolve. I stepped forward, breathed slowly, and spoke. The arch gave a low, clear note, like a bowl struck at a feast.
confidence:1.cnHint: 在背诵石门前，弟子需要以足够的____大声念出灵字，使石拱嗡鸣。
confidence:1.hook: But a second sound followed — deeper, and from underground.
confidence:1.line: '*Confidence* is not loudness,' Master Qingwu said. 'It is a still flame.'

sentences.en: Before the recitation gate, each disciple had to speak a word-herb aloud with enough *confidence* to make the stone arch hum.
Doubt, the elders said, was a crack in the vessel — the formula would leak out and dissolve.
sentences.cn: 长老们说怀疑是容器上的裂痕——公式会漏出来溶解。

sentences.en: I stepped forward, breathed slowly, and spoke.
sentences.cn: 我走上前，慢慢呼吸，开口说了那个字。

sentences.en: The arch gave a low, clear note, like a bowl struck at a feast.
sentences.cn: 拱门发出一声低沉、清晰的声音，像宴席上被敲响的碗。

display:1.en: Xiaoxing had a habit of climbing the outer wall each evening to *display* her newest herb-characters on a broad flat stone — she would trace each word in light so passing disciples could study them. Tonight her characters looked different: the strokes bent at the ends like hooks, reaching toward the cloud sea as if asking a question.
display:1.cnHint: 小星每晚都在石面上____她新学的灵字，今晚字形的笔画弯曲如钩。
display:1.hook: One character stayed lit long after the others faded.
display:1.line: 'I *display* them here so we can all find the mistakes together,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had a habit of climbing the outer wall each evening to *display* her newest herb-characters on a broad flat stone — she would trace each word in light so passing disciples could study them.
Tonight her characters looked different: the strokes bent at the ends like hooks, reaching toward the cloud sea as if asking a question.
sentences.cn: 今晚她的字迹看起来不一样了：笔画末端弯成钩子，朝向云海，就像在问一个问题。

experiment:1.en: On the outer terrace, where wind carries seeds of sound across the clouds, I began my first *experiment*: placing the word 'rise' on my tongue and breathing it toward a fallen leaf. The leaf trembled, lifted an inch, then dropped. Shen Wujiu watched without blinking. Even a failed attempt leaves a mark on the air.
experiment:1.cnHint: 我在露台上进行了一次____，试图用语词之力让落叶升起。
experiment:1.hook: The leaf had moved — but so had something else, far below the clouds.
experiment:1.line: 'Every *experiment* teaches the word what it wants to become,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: On the outer terrace, where wind carries seeds of sound across the clouds, I began my first *experiment*: placing the word 'rise' on my tongue and breathing it toward a fallen leaf.
The leaf trembled, lifted an inch, then dropped.
sentences.cn: 叶子颤动了，浮起一寸，然后落了下来。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu watched without blinking.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎目不转睛地看着。

sentences.en: Even a failed attempt leaves a mark on the air.
sentences.cn: 即使一次失败的尝试也会在空气中留下痕迹。

nature:1.en: Master Qingwu led us to the cliff edge at dawn, where the sea of clouds rolled like slow breath. 'Observe,' she said. I watched until I understood: the *nature* of every word here is like water — it takes the shape of whoever holds it. Xiaoxing pressed her palms together and whispered something I could not hear.
nature:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉我们，语词的____如同流水，随持有者的心意而变形。
nature:1.hook: Then the clouds parted, and a shape rose from beneath that had no name.
nature:1.line: 'Know the *nature* of a word before you dare to speak it,' Master Qingwu said softly.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us to the cliff edge at dawn, where the sea of clouds rolled like slow breath.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在黎明时分带我们来到悬崖边，云海在那里像缓慢的呼吸一样翻滚。

sentences.en: 'Observe,' she said.
sentences.cn: "看着，"她说。

sentences.en: I watched until I understood: the *nature* of every word here is like water — it takes the shape of whoever holds it.
Xiaoxing pressed her palms together and whispered something I could not hear.
sentences.cn: 小杏把手掌并在一起，低声说了些我听不清的话。

status:1.en: Outside the Hall of Records, a stone board listed every disciple's *status*: seed, sprout, branch, or crown. My name sat at the very bottom, marked only as seed. Xiaoxing stood beside me, her name one row higher. She did not gloat. She simply said, 'The board updates at midnight.' Somewhere above us, wind chimes rang without wind.
status:1.cnHint: 宗门石板上记录着每位弟子的____，我的名字挂在最末一行。
status:1.hook: At midnight, one name on the board was gone entirely.
status:1.line: 'Your *status* is a starting point, not a sentence,' Xiaoxing told me.

sentences.en: Outside the Hall of Records, a stone board listed every disciple's *status*: seed, sprout, branch, or crown.
My name sat at the very bottom, marked only as seed.
sentences.cn: 我的名字坐在最底部，只标记为"种子"。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stood beside me, her name one row higher.
sentences.cn: 小杏站在我身边，她的名字高出一行。

sentences.en: She did not gloat.
sentences.cn: 她没有幸灾乐祸。

sentences.en: She simply said, 'The board updates at midnight.'
sentences.cn: 她只是说，"公告板在午夜更新。"

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, wind chimes rang without wind.
sentences.cn: 我们上方的某处，风铃在没有风的时候响了起来。

accident:1.en: It was no *accident* that the word 'hold' cracked the stone basin in the courtyard. I had spoken it too sharply, too hungry for a result. Master Qingwu knelt beside the broken edge and traced the split with one finger. 'Intention makes the wound,' she said. 'But longing deepens it.' A thin mist rose from the crack like a held breath released.
accident:1.cnHint: 石盆碎裂并非____，而是我急于求成、吐字过猛所致。
accident:1.hook: The mist from the crack drifted upward and did not dissolve.
accident:1.line: 'An *accident* in words can cut deeper than a blade,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: It was no *accident* that the word 'hold' cracked the stone basin in the courtyard.
I had spoken it too sharply, too hungry for a result.
sentences.cn: 我说得太急了，太渴望看到结果。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu knelt beside the broken edge and traced the split with one finger.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊跪在破裂的边缘旁，用一根手指描绘那条裂纹。

sentences.en: 'Intention makes the wound,' she said.
sentences.cn: "意图造成了伤口，"她说。

sentences.en: 'But longing deepens it.'
sentences.cn: "但渴望加深了它。"

sentences.en: A thin mist rose from the crack like a held breath released.
sentences.cn: 一缕薄雾从裂缝中升起，像一口被释放的呼吸。

active:1.en: Shen Wujiu moved through the courtyard before sunrise, his lips *active* with the day's first formulas — soft, rhythmic, relentless. I counted twelve passes before he stopped. 'The words grow cold if you leave them still,' he told me, tossing a warm ember-bright seed my way. I caught it. It hummed against my palm like a living thing.
active:1.cnHint: 师兄在清晨不断练习，让语词保持____，免得它们失去灵气。
active:1.hook: When I opened my hand, the seed had already taken root.
active:1.line: 'Stay *active* with your words, or they will forget your voice,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu moved through the courtyard before sunrise, his lips *active* with the day's first formulas — soft, rhythmic, relentless.
I counted twelve passes before he stopped.
sentences.cn: 我数了他停下来前的十二遍。

sentences.en: 'The words grow cold if you leave them still,' he told me, tossing a warm ember-bright seed my way.
sentences.cn: "如果你让这些词静止不动，它们就会变冷，"他告诉我，向我扔了一颗温热的、闪烁着火焰光芒的种子。

sentences.en: I caught it.
sentences.cn: 我接住了。

sentences.en: It hummed against my palm like a living thing.
sentences.cn: 它在我的手掌中嗡嗡作响，就像一个活物。

feed:1.en: At the edge of the eastern path, where cloud wisps curl like sleeping cats, Xiaoxing showed me how to *feed* the listening stones — smoothing each word over their surface the way one smooths water over dry earth. The stones softened under her touch, glowing faint amber. She handed me one to try. It was heavier than it looked, and warm.
feed:1.cnHint: 小星教我如何用语词____聆听石，让它们吸收灵气发光。
feed:1.hook: The last stone I touched turned cold, and whispered a word back at me.
feed:1.line: '*Feed* the stone slowly — it remembers every word you rush,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: At the edge of the eastern path, where cloud wisps curl like sleeping cats, Xiaoxing showed me how to *feed* the listening stones — smoothing each word over their surface the way one smooths water over dry earth.
The stones softened under her touch, glowing faint amber.
sentences.cn: 在她的触摸下，这些石头软化了，闪着淡淡的琥珀色光芒。

sentences.en: She handed me one to try.
sentences.cn: 她递给我一块让我试试。

sentences.en: It was heavier than it looked, and warm.
sentences.cn: 它比看起来要沉，而且很温暖。

principle:1.en: On the step outside the archive hall, I asked Shen Wujiu why some words heal and others cut. He sat down and looked at the sky for a long moment. 'The first *principle* is this: a word does what your heart does while you say it.' He said nothing more. A single crane passed overhead, white against the grey cloud, unhurried and certain.
principle:1.cnHint: 师兄在档案堂外向我讲述了语词运用的第一条____。
principle:1.hook: That night I dreamed every word I knew had grown teeth.
principle:1.line: 'That is the founding *principle* of this sect,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: On the step outside the archive hall, I asked Shen Wujiu why some words heal and others cut.
sentences.cn: 在档案厅外的台阶上，我问沈无咎为什么有些词会治愈，而有些则会伤害。

sentences.en: He sat down and looked at the sky for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 他坐了下来，看了很久的天空。

sentences.en: 'The first *principle* is this: a word does what your heart does while you say it.'
He said nothing more.
sentences.cn: 他没有再说什么。

sentences.en: A single crane passed overhead, white against the grey cloud, unhurried and certain.
sentences.cn: 一只白鹤从头顶飞过，在灰色的云层中是白色的，不急不躁，确定无疑。

article:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a narrow scroll on the outer wall board — a single *article* listing the three words forbidden before the ceremony of ascent. I read it twice. The words themselves were not written; only their shapes were drawn, like silhouettes of birds. Xiaoxing leaned close and whispered, 'They say reading the shapes is already enough to hear them.' The lantern above us flickered once.
article:1.cnHint: 师尊在布告栏上张贴了一篇____，列出了飞升前禁止使用的三个词语。
article:1.hook: The lantern did not flicker again — but its shadow moved on its own.
article:1.line: 'Read this *article* carefully before the ceremony begins,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a narrow scroll on the outer wall board — a single *article* listing the three words forbidden before the ceremony of ascent.
I read it twice.
sentences.cn: 我读了两遍。

sentences.en: The words themselves were not written; only their shapes were drawn, like silhouettes of birds.
sentences.cn: 这些词本身没有被写出来；只有它们的形状被画出来了，像鸟的轮廓。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing leaned close and whispered, 'They say reading the shapes is already enough to hear them.'
sentences.cn: 小杏凑近我，低声说，"他们说，仅仅读这些形状就足以听到它们了。"

sentences.en: The lantern above us flickered once.
sentences.cn: 我们上方的灯笼闪烁了一次。

awareness:1.en: The outer courtyard of Cloud Sea Sect opened onto a stone path where morning mist curled like sleeping dragons. Master Qingwu walked ahead, silent. I followed, carrying my first herb-scroll, when a slow *awareness* crept over me: every pebble underfoot held a faint glow, as if the mountain itself were listening. I stopped. The path had been watching us all along.
awareness:1.cnHint: 在山门石径上，我逐渐产生了一种奇异的____，感觉脚下每块石头都在发光。
awareness:1.hook: The glow beneath my feet pulsed once, then went dark.
awareness:1.line: 'Let your *awareness* spread like water, and the path will answer you,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The outer courtyard of Cloud Sea Sect opened onto a stone path where morning mist curled like sleeping dragons.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的外围庭院通向一条石径，晨雾在那里蜷曲得像睡梦中的龙。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu walked ahead, silent.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊走在前面，沉默不语。

sentences.en: I followed, carrying my first herb-scroll, when a slow *awareness* crept over me: every pebble underfoot held a faint glow, as if the mountain itself were listening.
I stopped.
sentences.cn: 我停了下来。

sentences.en: The path had been watching us all along.
sentences.cn: 这条路一直在看着我们。

introduce:1.en: At the Cloud Gate, where wind carries spoken words across the mountains, Shen Wujiu stepped forward to *introduce* me to the elder disciples gathered on the stone terrace. Each name they returned was not just a greeting but a small formula, humming in the air like a plucked string. When the last elder spoke mine back to me, the clouds below the terrace rippled. Something had changed.
introduce:1.cnHint: 在云门石台上，师兄向众位师兄姐____了我，每个回应的名字都像公式一样嗡嗡作响。
introduce:1.hook: The last elder's eyes lingered on me one breath too long.
introduce:1.line: 'Allow me to *introduce* our newest disciple — the mountain has already taken note,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: At the Cloud Gate, where wind carries spoken words across the mountains, Shen Wujiu stepped forward to *introduce* me to the elder disciples gathered on the stone terrace.
Each name they returned was not just a greeting but a small formula, humming in the air like a plucked string.
sentences.cn: 他们每一个回复的名字都不仅仅是一个问候，而是一个小小的公式，在空气中嗡嗡作响，就像一根拨动的弦。

sentences.en: When the last elder spoke mine back to me, the clouds below the terrace rippled.
sentences.cn: 当最后一位长老向我说出我的名字时，庭院下方的云层泛起了涟漪。

sentences.en: Something had changed.
sentences.cn: 有些东西改变了。

expense:1.en: Near the sect's open herb market, rows of word-vessels glowed on low tables. Xiaoxing warned me that mastering the flight formula came at great *expense*: three months of gathered morning dew, traded for a single syllable. I reached for the smallest vessel. The vendor, an old woman with cloud-white hair, shook her head slowly and pointed at the sky instead.
expense:1.cnHint: 在门派草药集市上，小星提醒我，修炼飞行口诀要付出很大的____。
expense:1.hook: Above us, a vessel cracked open on its own with a sound like distant thunder.
expense:1.line: 'The *expense* of that word is higher than it looks — pay with care,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: Near the sect's open herb market, rows of word-vessels glowed on low tables.
sentences.cn: 在宗派的开放草药市场附近，一排排词汇容器在低矮的桌子上闪闪发光。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing warned me that mastering the flight formula came at great *expense*: three months of gathered morning dew, traded for a single syllable.
I reached for the smallest vessel.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去拿最小的容器。

sentences.en: The vendor, an old woman with cloud-white hair, shook her head slowly and pointed at the sky instead.
sentences.cn: 那个老妇人，一头云白的头发，缓缓摇了摇头，指向了天空。

toward:1.en: On the wide landing terrace where disciples practice step-forms, I watched the morning wind push a torn page *toward* the cliff edge. The characters on it were still glowing. I ran, bare feet slapping cold stone, and caught it just before it fell into the white sea below. The words on the page rearranged themselves the moment my fingers closed around it.
toward:1.cnHint: 在练功露台上，一张写满发光字符的残页随风飘____悬崖边缘，我奋力追上。
toward:1.hook: The rearranged words spelled a name I did not yet know.
toward:1.line: 'Move *toward* the wind, not against it, and the words will come to you,' called Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: On the wide landing terrace where disciples practice step-forms, I watched the morning wind push a torn page *toward* the cliff edge.
The characters on it were still glowing.
sentences.cn: 我赤脚踏过冰冷的石板，在它飘落悬崖之前一把抓住了它。

sentences.en: I ran, bare feet slapping cold stone, and caught it just before it fell into the white sea below.
sentences.cn: 页面上的字迹在我手指合拢的瞬间重新排列了。

sentences.en: The words on the page rearranged themselves the moment my fingers closed around it.
sentences.cn: 我赤脚踏过冰冷的石板，在它飘落悬崖之前一把抓住了它。

track:1.en: A narrow *track* wound between the outer herb gardens, used by senior disciples to collect rare dawn-blossoms. Shen Wujiu showed me the route, pointing out where the soil glowed faintest — signs that a powerful word had passed through. I pressed my palm to the earth and felt a faint pulse, steady as a heartbeat. Something ahead was still moving along this path.
track:1.cnHint: 在草药园间的小____上，师兄让我感受土地的微光，那是强大字符曾经经过的痕迹。
track:1.hook: At the path's next bend, a bloom had been freshly crushed.
track:1.line: 'Follow this *track* only at dawn — after that, it belongs to something else,' Shen Wujiu warned.

sentences.en: A narrow *track* wound between the outer herb gardens, used by senior disciples to collect rare dawn-blossoms.
Shen Wujiu showed me the route, pointing out where the soil glowed faintest — signs that a powerful word had passed through.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎给我指了路，指出土壤发光最微弱的地方——那是强大的字句经过的痕迹。

sentences.en: I pressed my palm to the earth and felt a faint pulse, steady as a heartbeat.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌贴在地上，感受到一阵微弱的脉搏，稳定得像心跳。

sentences.en: Something ahead was still moving along this path.
sentences.cn: 前面有东西还在沿着这条路移动。

afford:1.en: By the public stone board where disciples post requests for word-trades, I found a notice for a healing syllable I urgently needed. But the listed price was ten dawn-crystals — far more than I could *afford* with a newcomer's weekly share. I turned to leave. The notice fluttered, and a second line appeared below the price, written in fresher ink, offering a different kind of payment.
afford:1.cnHint: 在石板告示处，我发现自己____不起一个急需的治愈字符，却发现告示上多出了新的一行字。
afford:1.hook: The fresher ink was still wet, though no one stood near the board.
afford:1.line: 'I cannot *afford* it yet, but I will find a way before the next moon,' I said quietly.

sentences.en: By the public stone board where disciples post requests for word-trades, I found a notice for a healing syllable I urgently needed.
sentences.cn: 在弟子们发布词语交易请求的公告石板前，我发现了一张寻求我急需的治愈音节的启事。

sentences.en: But the listed price was ten dawn-crystals — far more than I could *afford* with a newcomer's weekly share.
I turned to leave.
sentences.cn: 我转身要离开。

sentences.en: The notice fluttered, and a second line appeared below the price, written in fresher ink, offering a different kind of payment.
sentences.cn: 公告纸飘动了一下，新的墨迹在价格下方显现，提出了另一种付款方式。

feature:1.en: Master Qingwu gathered us on the viewing terrace above the cloud sea to explain the sect's training ground. Its most striking *feature* was a ring of seven stones, each carved with a different root-word, arranged around a hollow at the center that hummed in all weathers. She said that ring had not been silent in three hundred years. Today, as she finished speaking, it was.
feature:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在观云台上介绍修炼场时，说那七块刻字石围成的圆圈是最重要的____，然而话音刚落，它却沉默了。
feature:1.hook: Three hundred years of hum — gone in a single held breath.
feature:1.line: 'The most important *feature* of this ground is the silence it refuses to make,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu gathered us on the viewing terrace above the cloud sea to explain the sect's training ground.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把我们召聚到云海上的观景台，讲述宗派的修炼场地。

sentences.en: Its most striking *feature* was a ring of seven stones, each carved with a different root-word, arranged around a hollow at the center that hummed in all weathers.
She said that ring had not been silent in three hundred years.
sentences.cn: 她说那个石环三百年来从未沉默过。

sentences.en: Today, as she finished speaking, it was.
sentences.cn: 今天，她说完话的时候，它无声了。

innovative:1.en: In the courtyard where disciples share newly discovered formulas, Xiaoxing unrolled a small scroll she called her most *innovative* work yet: a word-pattern that let the speaker walk on cloud without losing altitude. The other disciples leaned in, impressed. She demonstrated one careful step off the stone ledge, and it held her — until a second, unplanned word slipped from her lips and the cloud bloomed bright gold beneath her foot.
innovative:1.cnHint: 在共享心法的院子里，小星展示了她最____的成果——一种能在云上行走的字符阵，却意外触发了意料之外的效果。
innovative:1.hook: The gold faded, but the cloud beneath her foot refused to let go.
innovative:1.line: 'This is my most *innovative* pattern yet — though I admit I do not know how it ends,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: In the courtyard where disciples share newly discovered formulas, Xiaoxing unrolled a small scroll she called her most *innovative* work yet: a word-pattern that let the speaker walk on cloud without losing altitude.
The other disciples leaned in, impressed.
sentences.cn: 其他弟子们探身靠近，印象深刻。

sentences.en: She demonstrated one careful step off the stone ledge, and it held her — until a second, unplanned word slipped from her lips and the cloud bloomed bright gold beneath her foot.
sentences.cn: 她谨慎地从石板边缘迈出一步，云托住了她——直到第二个意外逸出的字句从她唇间滑落，云在她的脚下绽放出耀眼的金色。

operation:1.en: On the wide training terrace carved into the cliff face, Master Qingwu drew a circle of light in the air. 'Every *operation* of a formula,' she said, 'is like pressing a finger to a pulse — one wrong step and the flow breaks.' I pressed my fingertips together and tried again.
operation:1.cnHint: 师尊在露台上讲解每一步____的要领，我努力模仿她的手势。
operation:1.hook: A crack split the stone beneath my feet.
operation:1.line: 'Each *operation* must be as clean as a single breath, no more.'

sentences.en: On the wide training terrace carved into the cliff face, Master Qingwu drew a circle of light in the air.
sentences.cn: 在悬崖上凿出的宽阔修炼台，青梧师尊在空中画了一个光圈。

sentences.en: 'Every *operation* of a formula,' she said, 'is like pressing a finger to a pulse — one wrong step and the flow breaks.'
I pressed my fingertips together and tried again.
sentences.cn: 我把指尖并在一起，再试一遍。

population:1.en: The outer courtyard hummed with voices. Shen Wujiu told me that the Cloud Sea Sect's *population* had grown three times over since the eastern peaks stabilised, drawing farmers, healers, and wanderers alike. I watched them stream through the gate like clouds filling a valley.
population:1.cnHint: 师兄说门派的____近年大增，形形色色的人涌入外院。
population:1.hook: Among the crowd, one face did not move at all.
population:1.line: 'A sect with such a *population* must keep its roots or it will drift.'

sentences.en: The outer courtyard hummed with voices.
sentences.cn: 外院传来嗡嗡的人声。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me that the Cloud Sea Sect's *population* had grown three times over since the eastern peaks stabilised, drawing farmers, healers, and wanderers alike.
I watched them stream through the gate like clouds filling a valley.
sentences.cn: 我看着他们像云填满山谷一样涌过大门。

quick:1.en: Xiaoxing sprinted across the bridge of hanging stones, her robe snapping like a white flag. She was *quick* — quicker than the wind that tried to pull her off the edge. I watched from below, heart loud in my chest, as she reached the far pillar and pressed her palm to the seal.
quick:1.cnHint: 师妹身手____，飞速冲过悬石桥，将手印按在石柱上。
quick:1.hook: The seal glowed red, not gold.
quick:1.line: 'Be *quick* — the mist rises faster than you think.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing sprinted across the bridge of hanging stones, her robe snapping like a white flag.
sentences.cn: 小杏在悬石桥上冲刺，她的衣袍像白旗一样飘动。

sentences.en: She was *quick* — quicker than the wind that tried to pull her off the edge.
I watched from below, heart loud in my chest, as she reached the far pillar and pressed her palm to the seal.
sentences.cn: 我在下方观看，心在胸口怦怦跳着，看她跑到对面的柱子，把手掌按在封印上。

scale:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a map on the flat boulder. The *scale* marked on its edge showed one finger-width for every hundred li of cloud-sea sky. I traced the tiny dot that meant our sect, then looked up at the real peaks stretching beyond the morning fog, vast and silent.
scale:1.cnHint: 师尊展开地图，我从图上的____看出门派在云海中渺小如尘。
scale:1.hook: A mountain not on the map rose from the mist.
scale:1.line: 'At this *scale*, even a small error means a journey of days.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a map on the flat boulder.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在平坦的石头上铺开一幅地图。

sentences.en: The *scale* marked on its edge showed one finger-width for every hundred li of cloud-sea sky.
I traced the tiny dot that meant our sect, then looked up at the real peaks stretching beyond the morning fog, vast and silent.
sentences.cn: 我描了描那个表示宗派的小点，抬起头看向晨雾外真实的山峰，广阔而无声。

basic:1.en: 'You have not yet learned the *basics*,' Shen Wujiu said, not unkindly, as I failed to hold the simplest herb-glyph above my palm for more than three breaths. Around us, petals from the courtyard tree drifted down, each one outlasting my spell. I bowed my head and tried once more.
basic:1.cnHint: 师兄提醒我，____尚未掌握，就不应急于追求高阶法术。
basic:1.hook: One petal caught fire before it touched the ground.
basic:1.line: 'Master the *basics* first — every tall peak begins at the foot.'

sentences.en: 'You have not yet learned the *basics*,' Shen Wujiu said, not unkindly, as I failed to hold the simplest herb-glyph above my palm for more than three breaths.
Around us, petals from the courtyard tree drifted down, each one outlasting my spell.
sentences.cn: 我们周围，庭院树上的花瓣飘落而下，每一片都比我的咒文持续得更久。

sentences.en: I bowed my head and tried once more.
sentences.cn: 我低下头，又试了一次。

constantly:1.en: The wind on the outer terrace was *constantly* shifting, carrying the scent of pine one moment and cold iron the next. Xiaoxing said the mountain itself breathed — inhaling calm and exhaling warning. I stood still, trying to read each change the way Master Qingwu had taught us to read silence.
constantly:1.cnHint: 外台的风____变换方向，师妹说这是山在呼吸，暗藏信号。
constantly:1.hook: Then every breath of wind stopped at once.
constantly:1.line: 'The air *constantly* changes — learn to listen and you will not be lost.'

sentences.en: The wind on the outer terrace was *constantly* shifting, carrying the scent of pine one moment and cold iron the next.
Xiaoxing said the mountain itself breathed — inhaling calm and exhaling warning.
sentences.cn: 小杏说山呼吸着——吸入平静，呼出警告。

sentences.en: I stood still, trying to read each change the way Master Qingwu had taught us to read silence.
sentences.cn: 我静静站着，试图用青梧师尊教过我们的方式来理解每一个变化，如同读懂沉默。

favor:1.en: Of all the herbs growing in the cliff-garden, Master Qingwu seemed to *favor* the pale nightbloom that opened only in morning mist. She would pause beside it each time we passed, never touching it, only watching as if she were reading a letter written long ago. I began to watch it too.
favor:1.cnHint: 师尊似乎特别____那株崖边的晨雾花，每次经过都会驻足凝视。
favor:1.hook: Today the nightbloom had turned completely black.
favor:1.line: 'I *favor* patience in a disciple above all other gifts.'

sentences.en: Of all the herbs growing in the cliff-garden, Master Qingwu seemed to *favor* the pale nightbloom that opened only in morning mist.
She would pause beside it each time we passed, never touching it, only watching as if she were reading a letter written long ago.
sentences.cn: 她经过时总会在它旁边停留，从不触碰它，只是看着，仿佛在读一封很久以前写下的信。

sentences.en: I began to watch it too.
sentences.cn: 我也开始看它了。

absence:1.en: Shen Wujiu's place at the morning formation was empty. No one said his name. Master Qingwu's gaze passed over the gap as if she had long expected it, and her *absence* of surprise chilled me more than any explanation could. I kept my eyes forward and breathed as slowly as I was able.
absence:1.cnHint: 晨练时师兄不在队列中，师尊对这个____毫无惊讶之色，令我心寒。
absence:1.hook: His stone lantern at the gate still burned.
absence:1.line: 'The *absence* of a word can sometimes speak louder than the word itself.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu's place at the morning formation was empty.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在晨操中的位置空着。

sentences.en: No one said his name.
sentences.cn: 没有人念出他的名字。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu's gaze passed over the gap as if she had long expected it, and her *absence* of surprise chilled me more than any explanation could.
I kept my eyes forward and breathed as slowly as I was able.
sentences.cn: 我目光直视前方，尽力放缓呼吸。

institution:1.en: The Cloud Sea Sect is more than a school — it is an *institution* older than the oldest peak, its roots sunk deep into the living rock of the sky. Master Qingwu led me through the outer gate and named each carved pillar as we passed. Every stone held a word, and every word held a law.
institution:1.cnHint: 师尊带我穿过宗门外门，讲解这个古老____的规矩与传承。
institution:1.hook: One pillar had no carving — only a shadow shaped like a hand.
institution:1.line: 'This *institution* has stood since before your grandmother's grandmother drew her first breath,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The Cloud Sea Sect is more than a school — it is an *institution* older than the oldest peak, its roots sunk deep into the living rock of the sky.
Master Qingwu led me through the outer gate and named each carved pillar as we passed.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊领我穿过外门，一一指点沿途的每根石柱。

sentences.en: Every stone held a word, and every word held a law.
sentences.cn: 每块石头都刻着一个字，每个字都承载着一条法则。

outcome:1.en: Shen Wujiu and I practiced the wind-word on the stone platform at dawn, each attempt lifting us a little higher above the cloud floor. Neither of us knew what the right *outcome* should feel like — only that the air would tell us when we had it right. On my seventh try, my feet left the stone and did not return.
outcome:1.cnHint: 我和师兄在石台上练习风字诀，努力寻找每次修炼该有的____。
outcome:1.hook: Then the wind stopped, and the silence was the loudest thing I had ever heard.
outcome:1.line: 'The only *outcome* that matters is whether you land on your feet,' said Shen Wujiu, brushing dust from his sleeve.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu and I practiced the wind-word on the stone platform at dawn, each attempt lifting us a little higher above the cloud floor.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎和我在清晨的石台上练习风字，每一次尝试都让我们在云层上升得更高一些。

sentences.en: Neither of us knew what the right *outcome* should feel like — only that the air would tell us when we had it right.
On my seventh try, my feet left the stone and did not return.
sentences.cn: 第七次尝试时，我的脚离开了石台，再也没有落下。

recognize:1.en: Among the hundred new disciples gathered on the entrance terrace, Master Qingwu walked slowly, pausing before each face. She could *recognize* a word-gift by the faint glow behind the eyes, she said — a light no lamp could make. She stopped before me for a long breath, and said nothing at all.
recognize:1.cnHint: 师尊在新弟子中巡视，凭眼神中的光芒____每个人天赋的高低。
recognize:1.hook: Her silence was not peace — it was a door left open in a storm.
recognize:1.line: 'I can *recognize* your gift, but whether it will save you is another matter,' she said softly.

sentences.en: Among the hundred new disciples gathered on the entrance terrace, Master Qingwu walked slowly, pausing before each face.
sentences.cn: 在汇聚在山门平台上的百名新弟子中，青梧师尊缓缓走过，在每张脸前停留。

sentences.en: She could *recognize* a word-gift by the faint glow behind the eyes, she said — a light no lamp could make.
She stopped before me for a long breath, and said nothing at all.
sentences.cn: 她在我面前停了许久，什么也没有说。

safety:1.en: The rope bridge between the second and third peaks swayed hard in the morning gust. Xiaoxing crossed first, arms out, each step placed with care. I followed, reciting the anchor-word under my breath — not for power, but for *safety*, the way a candle is lit not to see far but to keep the dark honest.
safety:1.cnHint: 我和师妹过悬索桥时，我默念护身咒语以求____，而非追求力量。
safety:1.hook: Halfway across, one rope frayed and let out a sound like a question.
safety:1.line: '*Safety* first — a disciple who falls cannot learn anything,' Xiaoxing called back over her shoulder.

sentences.en: The rope bridge between the second and third peaks swayed hard in the morning gust.
sentences.cn: 第二和第三座峰顶间的绳桥在晨风中摇晃得很厉害。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing crossed first, arms out, each step placed with care.
sentences.cn: 小杏先过，双臂张开，每一步都小心翼翼地踩下。

sentences.en: I followed, reciting the anchor-word under my breath — not for power, but for *safety*, the way a candle is lit not to see far but to keep the dark honest.

collect:1.en: Each morning before the mist lifted, we were sent to the herb-word garden to *collect* the dew that gathered on the carved stones. The drops tasted of old ink and pine. Master Qingwu said whoever gathered enough could speak a single word that the mountain would obey.
collect:1.cnHint: 每天清晨，我们去字草园____石刻上的露水，据说积够了便能使山听命。
collect:1.hook: That morning, my jar held one drop that glowed like a trapped star.
collect:1.line: '*Collect* every drop before the sun touches the third stone or the power is lost,' Master Qingwu warned.

sentences.en: Each morning before the mist lifted, we were sent to the herb-word garden to *collect* the dew that gathered on the carved stones.
The drops tasted of old ink and pine.
sentences.cn: 露珠尝起来像陈年的墨水和松香。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said whoever gathered enough could speak a single word that the mountain would obey.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说，谁能集够露水，就能说出一个字让山听命。

door:1.en: At the far end of the sect's outer path stood a small *door* cut from black stone, sealed with a word none of us could read. Shen Wujiu said it had not opened in sixty years. The characters around the frame still breathed — you could see the faint rise and fall if you watched long enough.
door:1.cnHint: 宗门外路尽头有一扇黑石____，封印其上的字迹至今无人能读。
door:1.hook: That evening, a thin line of light appeared along the bottom edge.
door:1.line: 'Every *door* in this sect is also a test — never touch one you have not been taught to read,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: At the far end of the sect's outer path stood a small *door* cut from black stone, sealed with a word none of us could read.
Shen Wujiu said it had not opened in sixty years.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说那扇门已经六十年没有打开过了。

sentences.en: The characters around the frame still breathed — you could see the faint rise and fall if you watched long enough.
sentences.cn: 门框周围的字迹依然在呼吸——只要盯着看够久，就能看到细微的起伏。

eventually:1.en: Learning the fire-word was slow work. I burned my own notes three times and made Xiaoxing laugh each time. Master Qingwu said patience was itself a word, and that anyone who practiced long enough would *eventually* hear the flame agree to move. On the fourteenth morning, mine did.
eventually:1.cnHint: 我苦练火字诀，师尊说只要坚持，____会听见火焰应声而动。
eventually:1.hook: But the flame moved in a shape that no lesson had named.
eventually:1.line: 'You will *eventually* understand,' said Master Qingwu, 'when the word trusts you as much as you trust it.'

sentences.en: Learning the fire-word was slow work.
sentences.cn: 学习火字是件缓慢的功夫。

sentences.en: I burned my own notes three times and made Xiaoxing laugh each time.
sentences.cn: 我烧毁了自己的笔记三次，每次都逗得小杏发笑。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said patience was itself a word, and that anyone who practiced long enough would *eventually* hear the flame agree to move.
On the fourteenth morning, mine did.
sentences.cn: 到第十四个清晨，我的火字动了。

match:1.en: The sect held a word-recitation *match* on the cloud terrace every new moon — not a fight, but a test of memory and breath control. Xiaoxing stepped up first and spoke twelve words without pause. The crowd went quiet. I was called next, and the air between us went tight as a drawn string.
match:1.cnHint: 宗门在云台举行字诀____，师妹率先出场，连诵十二字，令全场屏息。
match:1.hook: Before I could speak, the clouds below the terrace rose without wind.
match:1.line: 'A *match* is not about winning — it is about showing what you have grown into,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The sect held a word-recitation *match* on the cloud terrace every new moon — not a fight, but a test of memory and breath control.
Xiaoxing stepped up first and spoke twelve words without pause.
sentences.cn: 小杏上前，一口气念出十二个字，没有停顿。

sentences.en: The crowd went quiet.
sentences.cn: 人群安静了下来。

sentences.en: I was called next, and the air between us went tight as a drawn string.
sentences.cn: 接下来叫到我，我们之间的气息绷得紧紧的，像一根拨动的弦。

advice:1.en: At the edge of the outer courtyard, where stone steps dissolved into open sky, Master Qingwu handed me a small scroll. 'Read this before you speak the Wind Word,' she said. The *advice* written inside was simple: breathe out fear before breathing in power. I tucked it against my chest, where it hummed faintly, as if the words were already alive.
advice:1.cnHint: 师尊在云端石阶旁给了我一张小卷轴，上面写着关于修炼风语的____。
advice:1.hook: Then the scroll grew warm, and the sky above cracked with silent light.
advice:1.line: 'My *advice* to you: speak the word only when the clouds are still.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the outer courtyard, where stone steps dissolved into open sky, Master Qingwu handed me a small scroll.
sentences.cn: 在外院的边缘，石阶消融于开阔的天空处，青梧师尊递给我一张小卷轴。

sentences.en: 'Read this before you speak the Wind Word,' she said.
sentences.cn: "念风字之前先读这个，"她说。

sentences.en: The *advice* written inside was simple: breathe out fear before breathing in power.
I tucked it against my chest, where it hummed faintly, as if the words were already alive.
sentences.cn: 我把它贴着胸口揣进去，它发出微弱的嗡鸣，仿佛那些字已经活了过来。

attempt:1.en: On the wide training terrace carved into the mountainside, I stood before the Lift Stone and drew a slow breath. Every disciple must *attempt* the first flight word alone, without aid. My voice trembled as I shaped the syllable. The stone shivered. Then it rose — one finger's width above the ground — and held there, trembling like a held note.
attempt:1.cnHint: 在山腰的训练台上，我独自____念出第一个飞升字诀，磐石微微离地。
attempt:1.hook: A cold wind rose from nowhere, carrying a whisper that was not mine.
attempt:1.line: 'You must *attempt* the word yourself — no one else can speak it for you.'

sentences.en: On the wide training terrace carved into the mountainside, I stood before the Lift Stone and drew a slow breath.
sentences.cn: 我站在镌刻在山腰上的宽阔训练台前，面对着那块升石，缓缓吸了口气。

sentences.en: Every disciple must *attempt* the first flight word alone, without aid.
My voice trembled as I shaped the syllable.
sentences.cn: 我的声音在塑形音节时有些颤抖。

sentences.en: The stone shivered.
sentences.cn: 石头震颤了。
