sentences.en: Then it rose — one finger's width above the ground — and held there, trembling like a held note.
sentences.cn: 然后它升了起来——只有一根手指那么高——悬停在那里，像一个被按住的音符在微微摇晃。

draw:1.en: Shen Wujiu challenged me to a word-match on the open bridge between two peaks. We each cast our best formula and the forces met in the air above the drop, neither breaking. The contest ended in a *draw*, and we both laughed, breathless, leaning on the rope railing while clouds swirled far below our feet.
draw:1.cnHint: 在两山之间的空中桥上，我和师兄的字诀对撞，最终以____收场。
draw:1.hook: In the mist below, something large and silent began to rise.
draw:1.line: 'A *draw* today, but tomorrow the clouds will choose a winner.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu challenged me to a word-match on the open bridge between two peaks.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在两座峰顶间的开放桥上向我挑战了一场字诀对决。

sentences.en: We each cast our best formula and the forces met in the air above the drop, neither breaking.
sentences.cn: 我们各施出最强的法诀，两股力量在悬崖上方的空气中相遇，谁也没有压过谁。

sentences.en: The contest ended in a *draw*, and we both laughed, breathless, leaning on the rope railing while clouds swirled far below our feet.

facility:1.en: Master Qingwu led the new disciples through the Herb Terrace, a wide open platform near the summit where every healing word was practiced. 'This *facility* is older than the sect itself,' she said, touching a stone basin still warm from morning sun. Rows of carved channels caught wind and light, turning weather into medicine.
facility:1.cnHint: 在山顶附近，师尊带我们参观了一处古老的修炼____，那里专门用于学习治愈字诀。
facility:1.hook: One basin, however, was cracked — and inside it, a black feather lay perfectly still.
facility:1.line: 'Every *facility* on this mountain was shaped by words, not tools.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led the new disciples through the Herb Terrace, a wide open platform near the summit where every healing word was practiced.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊带着新入门的弟子穿过药台，那是山巅附近的宽阔平台，每一句疗愈之言都在这里习练。

sentences.en: 'This *facility* is older than the sect itself,' she said, touching a stone basin still warm from morning sun.
Rows of carved channels caught wind and light, turning weather into medicine.
sentences.cn: 雕刻成沟槽的石渠捕捉风和光，把天气化作药物。

firm:1.en: On the summit path, the wind pushed against me so hard I nearly stepped off the edge. Xiaoxing caught my sleeve and set her feet wide apart, her grip *firm* against the gale. She did not shout a word of power; she simply held on, and the wind seemed to respect that quiet strength and eased a little.
firm:1.cnHint: 在山顶的小路上，狂风袭来，师妹用____的力道抓住我的袖子，令我稳住身形。
firm:1.hook: When the wind died, every stone on the path had flipped to its dark side.
firm:1.line: 'Keep your feet *firm* and your voice low — the mountain is listening.'

sentences.en: On the summit path, the wind pushed against me so hard I nearly stepped off the edge.
sentences.cn: 在通往山顶的小径上，风硬生生推我，我差点踩空。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing caught my sleeve and set her feet wide apart, her grip *firm* against the gale.
She did not shout a word of power; she simply held on, and the wind seemed to respect that quiet strength and eased a little.
sentences.cn: 她没有喊出任何力量之言，只是紧紧抓住，风仿佛尊重了这份无言的力量，便温和了些许。

innovation:1.en: At the open market terrace where traveling scholars traded rare words for coin, one elder displayed a new formula no one had seen. He called it an *innovation* in the art of wind-walking, a single syllable that combined lift and direction at once. Disciples crowded around him, and even the vendor banners stirred without any breeze.
innovation:1.cnHint: 在山间集市台上，一位游历学者展示了飞行字诀的一项____，令众弟子围观惊叹。
innovation:1.hook: When he demonstrated it, his shadow rose from the ground before he did.
innovation:1.line: 'This *innovation* took me thirty years and one very bad fall to discover.'

sentences.en: At the open market terrace where traveling scholars traded rare words for coin, one elder displayed a new formula no one had seen.
sentences.cn: 在旅行学者交易珍稀之言换取钱币的开阔市集台，一位长者展示了一个前所未有的新公式。

sentences.en: He called it an *innovation* in the art of wind-walking, a single syllable that combined lift and direction at once.
Disciples crowded around him, and even the vendor banners stirred without any breeze.
sentences.cn: 弟子们围在他身边，连商贩的旗帜都在无风中飘动。

multiple:1.en: Outside the archive hall, stone pillars each bore a single carved word, and Shen Wujiu told me that the greatest masters could hold *multiple* words in mind at once, weaving them together like threads. I tried to recall just two and felt the pressure behind my eyes like twin stones pressing inward. The clouds below us darkened without warning.
multiple:1.cnHint: 在藏经楼外，师兄告诉我，最强的修士能够同时掌握____个字诀，融为一道。
multiple:1.hook: The darkening clouds formed a shape — unmistakably the outline of an open hand.
multiple:1.line: '*Multiple* words spoken in one breath — that is the threshold of true flight.'

sentences.en: Outside the archive hall, stone pillars each bore a single carved word, and Shen Wujiu told me that the greatest masters could hold *multiple* words in mind at once, weaving them together like threads.
I tried to recall just two and felt the pressure behind my eyes like twin stones pressing inward.
sentences.cn: 我试着回忆仅仅两个字，感觉脑后像两块石头向内压迫。

sentences.en: The clouds below us darkened without warning.
sentences.cn: 我们下方的云层忽然黑了下去。

path:1.en: A stone *path* ran along the mountain's outer rim, so narrow that disciples walked it single file with the sea of clouds on one side and the cliff face on the other. Master Qingwu said that walking it at dawn, in silence, was itself a kind of word — one spoken by the body instead of the mouth. I placed each foot with care.
path:1.cnHint: 山脊外沿有一条窄窄的石____，师尊说清晨在上面静走，本身就是一种无声的字诀修行。
path:1.hook: Halfway along, a single white feather stood upright in a crack, as if planted there on purpose.
path:1.line: 'The *path* teaches patience — the word you seek cannot be rushed.'

sentences.en: A stone *path* ran along the mountain's outer rim, so narrow that disciples walked it single file with the sea of clouds on one side and the cliff face on the other.
Master Qingwu said that walking it at dawn, in silence, was itself a kind of word — one spoken by the body instead of the mouth.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说在晨曦时沿着这条路行走，沉默无言，那本身就是一种字——由身体而非嘴巴说出的话。

sentences.en: I placed each foot with care.
sentences.cn: 我每一步都踩得很谨慎。

character:1.en: Master Qingwu pressed a single herb into my palm and said nothing. Its shape told me everything: five curved leaves, each one a different shade of green. Shen Wujiu had warned me that every herb carries a *character* as distinct as a person's — bitter pride, gentle patience, wild hunger. I began to read it like a face.
character:1.cnHint: 师尊给了我一株草药，师兄说每株药材都有自己独特的____。
character:1.hook: Beneath my fingers, the herb pulsed once — then went cold.
character:1.line: 'Every herb has a *character*; read it before you speak its name.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu pressed a single herb into my palm and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把一株草药按进我的掌心，什么也没说。

sentences.en: Its shape told me everything: five curved leaves, each one a different shade of green.
sentences.cn: 它的形状告诉了我一切：五片弯曲的叶子，每一片都是不同的绿色。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu had warned me that every herb carries a *character* as distinct as a person's — bitter pride, gentle patience, wild hunger.
I began to read it like a face.
sentences.cn: 我开始像读一张脸一样去读它。

clean:1.en: Before dawn, Xiaoxing handed me a worn brush and pointed at the stone steps leading to the Hall of Words. 'A disciple who cannot *clean* the path cannot clear the mind,' she said softly. I swept until the mist itself seemed to thin, until each step shone pale as a new page. Then I saw the mark — scratched into the lowest stone overnight.
clean:1.cnHint: 小星让我____石阶，说心境清明才能修炼词法。
clean:1.hook: The scratch formed a word I had never been taught.
clean:1.line: '*Clean* the steps each morning — the path and the mind are one.'

sentences.en: Before dawn, Xiaoxing handed me a worn brush and pointed at the stone steps leading to the Hall of Words.
sentences.cn: 天亮前，小杏把一把磨损的毛笔递给我，指向通往言语殿堂的石阶。

sentences.en: 'A disciple who cannot *clean* the path cannot clear the mind,' she said softly.
I swept until the mist itself seemed to thin, until each step shone pale as a new page.
sentences.cn: 我一直扫，直到雾气本身似乎都消散了，直到每一级台阶都闪闪发光，苍白如同新的书页。

sentences.en: Then I saw the mark — scratched into the lowest stone overnight.
sentences.cn: 然后我看到了那个痕迹——在最低的石头上，连夜被划出来的痕迹。

convey:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the cliff's edge and released a single spoken word into the wind. It drifted outward like a seed. 'Distance means nothing,' he told me. 'A true formula can *convey* meaning across ten mountains without losing a syllable.' I tried to repeat it. My word fell straight down into the cloud sea below.
convey:1.cnHint: 师兄演示如何用词法跨越远山____信息，而我的尝试却失败了。
convey:1.hook: From somewhere deep in the clouds, something answered.
convey:1.line: 'Learn to *convey* one word cleanly before you attempt a sentence.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the cliff's edge and released a single spoken word into the wind.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在悬崖边，释放出一个单独的字到风里。

sentences.en: It drifted outward like a seed.
sentences.cn: 它像种子一样飘向远方。

sentences.en: 'Distance means nothing,' he told me.
sentences.cn: "距离什么都不是，"他告诉我。

sentences.en: 'A true formula can *convey* meaning across ten mountains without losing a syllable.'
I tried to repeat it.
sentences.cn: 我试着重复它。

sentences.en: My word fell straight down into the cloud sea below.
sentences.cn: 我的字直直落入了下方的云海里。

distraction:1.en: The courtyard exam was simple: hold the word for 'still' in your mind for one full breath. Xiaoxing passed without effort. When my turn came, a white bird landed on the wall and tilted its head at me. That small *distraction* was enough — the word slipped, the air around me shivered, and Master Qingwu wrote something in her ledger.
distraction:1.cnHint: 考验中，一只鸟成了我的____，导致我失去了对词法的专注。
distraction:1.hook: Master Qingwu's brush did not stop moving after she noted my name.
distraction:1.line: 'One moment of *distraction* can undo a month of practice — remember that.'

sentences.en: The courtyard exam was simple: hold the word for 'still' in your mind for one full breath.
sentences.cn: 院子里的考核很简单：在脑海里持守"静"这个字一整个呼吸的时间。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing passed without effort.
sentences.cn: 小杏毫不费力地通过了。

sentences.en: When my turn came, a white bird landed on the wall and tilted its head at me.
sentences.cn: 轮到我时，一只白鸟落在了墙上，歪着头看我。

sentences.en: That small *distraction* was enough — the word slipped, the air around me shivered, and Master Qingwu wrote something in her ledger.

fight:1.en: The old texts said that words of healing and words of harm share the same root. Master Qingwu made us stand in the morning wind and choose one word each — one that gave us *fight*, a will to keep going when the cold pressed in. Mine came slowly, then all at once, rising from somewhere below my ribs like a warm coal.
fight:1.cnHint: 师尊要我们找到一个能给自己带来____与意志的词。
fight:1.hook: The wind shifted direction the moment I said mine aloud.
fight:1.line: 'Find the word that gives you *fight* — that one will never leave you.'

sentences.en: The old texts said that words of healing and words of harm share the same root.
sentences.cn: 古籍记载，疗愈之言和伤害之言有共同的根源。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu made us stand in the morning wind and choose one word each — one that gave us *fight*, a will to keep going when the cold pressed in.
Mine came slowly, then all at once, rising from somewhere below my ribs like a warm coal.
sentences.cn: 我的字来得很慢，然后突然一下子，像一块温热的炭从我的肋间下升起。

finish:1.en: Shen Wujiu laid seven herb-words in a row on the flat rock, each one linked to the next by a thread of breath. 'A formula has a *finish*,' he said, 'a final shape as clean as the edge of a good blade. Anything less and it trails off — and trailing words attract the wrong kind of attention.' He swept them away before I could memorize the last two.
finish:1.cnHint: 师兄讲解词法需要有完整的____，残缺的词诀会招来麻烦。
finish:1.hook: In the silence after, the flat rock bore a faint scorch mark.
finish:1.line: 'The *finish* of a formula matters as much as how it begins.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu laid seven herb-words in a row on the flat rock, each one linked to the next by a thread of breath.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在平坦的岩石上排出七个草药之字，每一个都用一缕呼吸和下一个相连。

sentences.en: 'A formula has a *finish*,' he said, 'a final shape as clean as the edge of a good blade.
Anything less and it trails off — and trailing words attract the wrong kind of attention.'
sentences.cn: 任何少于这个的都会尾音不全——而尾音不全的字会吸引错误的东西。

sentences.en: He swept them away before I could memorize the last two.
sentences.cn: 他在我能记住最后两个字之前就把它们扫掉了。

frequently:1.en: Xiaoxing told me she visited the outer ledge *frequently* — sometimes three times before the afternoon bell — just to watch the cloud sea shift. 'The clouds teach patience,' she said, hugging her knees to her chest. 'They never rush and they never stop.' Below us, the white surface moved like slow breath, and something dark turned beneath it.
frequently:1.cnHint: 小星____来到悬崖边观云，说云海能教人学会耐心。
frequently:1.hook: Whatever moved beneath the clouds was rising.
frequently:1.line: 'I come here *frequently*; the clouds remind me why we study.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing told me she visited the outer ledge *frequently* — sometimes three times before the afternoon bell — just to watch the cloud sea shift.
'The clouds teach patience,' she said, hugging her knees to her chest.
sentences.cn: "云教会耐心，"她说，把膝盖抱到胸口。

sentences.en: 'They never rush and they never stop.'
sentences.cn: "它们从不匆忙，也从不停止。"

sentences.en: Below us, the white surface moved like slow breath, and something dark turned beneath it.
sentences.cn: 我们下方，白色的表面像缓慢的呼吸一样移动，什么黑色的东西在它下面转动。

invest:1.en: Master Qingwu told us that every word we learned was a seed, and that a seed grows only when you *invest* real attention in it — not hours of tired repetition, but a few minutes of honest, focused care each day. I had been spending long nights forcing the same words. I had been doing it wrong. The mountain under me hummed, low and patient, as if it agreed.
invest:1.cnHint: 师尊说真正的修炼需要____真诚的专注，而非疲惫的重复。
invest:1.hook: That night, my practice word glowed faintly in the dark air and did not fade.
invest:1.line: '*Invest* true attention in each word — effort without focus is just noise.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told us that every word we learned was a seed, and that a seed grows only when you *invest* real attention in it — not hours of tired repetition, but a few minutes of honest, focused care each day.
I had been spending long nights forcing the same words.
sentences.cn: 我一直在长夜里强行重复同样的词汇。

sentences.en: I had been doing it wrong.
sentences.cn: 我做错了。

sentences.en: The mountain under me hummed, low and patient, as if it agreed.
sentences.cn: 山在我身下低鸣，耐心而温柔，仿佛在认同我的觉悟。

safe:1.en: At the base of the Cloud Sea Sect's oldest pine, a hollow in the rock served as our communal *safe* — not iron or lock, but packed earth sealed with the word 'guard,' carved by Master Qingwu herself. Every disciple placed one learned herb-name inside each season. I knelt and added mine: 'breath.'
safe:1.cnHint: 山门古松下的石洞是弟子们存放习得草药名的____，我将今季所学放入其中。
safe:1.hook: But the word 'guard' had begun to crack.
safe:1.line: 'Place your word in the *safe* before the next bell,' Master Qingwu said softly.

sentences.en: At the base of the Cloud Sea Sect's oldest pine, a hollow in the rock served as our communal *safe* — not iron or lock, but packed earth sealed with the word 'guard,' carved by Master Qingwu herself.
Every disciple placed one learned herb-name inside each season.
sentences.cn: 每个弟子都会在每个季节往里放一个学会的草药名。

sentences.en: I knelt and added mine: 'breath.'
sentences.cn: 我跪下，放进了我的：「息」。

speed:1.en: Shen Wujiu crossed the outer courtyard in three steps where I needed nine. His *speed* was not muscle but mastery — he carried the word 'wind' under his tongue and released it with each stride. I watched, counting syllables under my breath, trying to borrow even one beat of his rhythm.
speed:1.cnHint: 师兄穿越庭院的____令人叹服，源于他对'风'字诀的精熟掌握。
speed:1.hook: Then his shadow stopped, though his feet had not.
speed:1.line: '*Speed* is just a word you have learned to trust,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu crossed the outer courtyard in three steps where I needed nine.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎三步就穿过了外院，我得走九步。

sentences.en: His *speed* was not muscle but mastery — he carried the word 'wind' under his tongue and released it with each stride.
I watched, counting syllables under my breath, trying to borrow even one beat of his rhythm.
sentences.cn: 我看着他，在呼吸间数着音节，想从他的节奏里借来哪怕一拍。

burden:1.en: The scroll Master Qingwu gave me held forty herb-names in neat columns. I had expected a gift; instead it felt like a *burden* — forty promises pressed against my ribs. Xiaoxing passed by, carrying her own scroll lightly, as if the words inside had learned to weigh nothing at all.
burden:1.cnHint: 师尊交付的卷轴满载草药名，对我而言是沉重的____，对师妹却似乎轻如鸿毛。
burden:1.hook: At the bottom of the scroll, one name had been left blank.
burden:1.line: 'Do not let the scroll become a *burden* heavier than the mountain,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: The scroll Master Qingwu gave me held forty herb-names in neat columns.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊给我的卷轴上整整齐齐地列着四十个草药名。

sentences.en: I had expected a gift; instead it felt like a *burden* — forty promises pressed against my ribs.
Xiaoxing passed by, carrying her own scroll lightly, as if the words inside had learned to weigh nothing at all.
sentences.cn: 小杏从身边经过，轻飘飘地拿着她的卷轴，仿佛里面的词已经学会了如何变得毫无分量。

former:1.en: Two paths split at the cloud-bridge: the *former* led downward to the herb gardens below, the latter climbed toward the sword-peak above. Shen Wujiu said a new disciple must walk the lower road first, tending roots before reaching for sky. I chose it without argument, pressing damp soil between my palms.
former:1.cnHint: 云桥分岔处，前者通向草药园，后者直抵剑峰，师兄说新弟子应先走____。
former:1.hook: Something on the lower path had already moved.
former:1.line: 'The *former* road is not the lesser road,' Shen Wujiu told me firmly.

sentences.en: Two paths split at the cloud-bridge: the *former* led downward to the herb gardens below, the latter climbed toward the sword-peak above.
Shen Wujiu said a new disciple must walk the lower road first, tending roots before reaching for sky.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说新弟子必须先走下面的路，在伸向苍穹之前先要照料根茎。

sentences.en: I chose it without argument, pressing damp soil between my palms.
sentences.cn: 我毫无异议地选了它，在掌心按压着潮湿的土壤。

oppose:1.en: When I spoke the word 'still' facing the morning wind, the wind did not stop. Master Qingwu explained that a word does not *oppose* nature — it converses with it. I had been shouting. I tried again, quieter, and felt the air pause, just for one breath, as if listening.
oppose:1.cnHint: 师尊说，字诀不是要____自然，而是与之对话，我初学时误以为需要强行压制。
oppose:1.hook: On the third attempt, the wind turned and spoke back.
oppose:1.line: 'We do not *oppose* the cloud; we ask it to move,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: When I spoke the word 'still' facing the morning wind, the wind did not stop.
sentences.cn: 我面对晨风说出「静」这个字，风并没有停止。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu explained that a word does not *oppose* nature — it converses with it.
I had been shouting.
sentences.cn: 我一直在喊。

sentences.en: I tried again, quieter, and felt the air pause, just for one breath, as if listening.
sentences.cn: 我试了一次，声音更轻，感到空气停顿了，只有一个呼吸的瞬间，仿佛在聆听。

unable:1.en: At morning practice, I stood before the small flame we kept on the courtyard stone and spoke the word 'cool.' Nothing changed. I was *unable* to shift even the heat at its edge, though Xiaoxing had done it easily the day before. I closed my eyes and tried to remember not the sound but the feeling of the word.
unable:1.cnHint: 晨练时我对着火焰念'凉'字却毫无效果，____改变哪怕一丝热气，令我深感沮丧。
unable:1.hook: When I opened my eyes, the flame had turned pale blue.
unable:1.line: 'Being *unable* today is just the shape of tomorrow's learning,' Xiaoxing said gently.

sentences.en: At morning practice, I stood before the small flame we kept on the courtyard stone and spoke the word 'cool.'
sentences.cn: 清晨练习时，我站在院子石板上的小火焰前，说出「凉」这个字。

sentences.en: Nothing changed.
sentences.cn: 什么都没有改变。

sentences.en: I was *unable* to shift even the heat at its edge, though Xiaoxing had done it easily the day before.
I closed my eyes and tried to remember not the sound but the feeling of the word.
sentences.cn: 我闭上眼睛，试着记起的不是字的声音，而是这个词的感觉。

unusual:1.en: The herb Xiaoxing found growing between two cloud-stones was *unusual* — its leaves formed the shape of a written character none of us could name. Master Qingwu crouched beside it for a long moment, then covered it with her sleeve as if shielding a secret from the sky above.
unusual:1.cnHint: 师妹在云石间发现了一株____的草药，叶片形如某个无人识得的字符。
unusual:1.hook: Master Qingwu's sleeve was shaking when she stood.
unusual:1.line: 'This is *unusual* — do not speak of it outside this circle,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

sentences.en: The herb Xiaoxing found growing between two cloud-stones was *unusual* — its leaves formed the shape of a written character none of us could name.
Master Qingwu crouched beside it for a long moment, then covered it with her sleeve as if shielding a secret from the sky above.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在它旁边蹲了很久，然后用袖子盖住了它，仿佛在守护一个不想被天空看见的秘密。

apart:1.en: The four peaks of the Cloud Sea Sect stood *apart* from one another, each wrapped in its own thin mist, each holding a different kind of word-knowledge. I could see all four from the rope bridge where I stood, and I understood for the first time that mastering one peak was only one quarter of a breath.
apart:1.cnHint: 云海宗四峰彼此____而立，各藏一类字诀，我在绳桥上望见它们时才明白自己路途有多长。
apart:1.hook: Then the rope bridge began to hum under my feet.
apart:1.line: 'Great strength is not one word — it is many, *apart* and then joined,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: The four peaks of the Cloud Sea Sect stood *apart* from one another, each wrapped in its own thin mist, each holding a different kind of word-knowledge.
I could see all four from the rope bridge where I stood, and I understood for the first time that mastering one peak was only one quarter of a breath.
sentences.cn: 我能从站着的绳桥上看到四座山峰，我第一次明白，掌握其中一座山峰只是一个呼吸的四分之一。

announce:1.en: On the wide stone terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, Master Qingwu stepped forward at dawn. Her voice carried across the cold air as she *announced* the name of the disciple chosen to attempt the Ascension Trial. Every heart stopped. My own name rose like smoke from her lips and drifted into the pale sky.
announce:1.cnHint: 清晨，青雾师尊在石台上____了参加飞升试炼的弟子名单。
announce:1.hook: But why was my name the only one called?
announce:1.line: 'I *announce* your name today, and the sky will judge tomorrow.'

sentences.en: On the wide stone terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, Master Qingwu stepped forward at dawn.
sentences.cn: 晨曦中，青梧师尊在云海宗宽阔的石台上踏出一步。

sentences.en: Her voice carried across the cold air as she *announced* the name of the disciple chosen to attempt the Ascension Trial.
Every heart stopped.
sentences.cn: 每个人的心都停止了跳动。

sentences.en: My own name rose like smoke from her lips and drifted into the pale sky.
sentences.cn: 我的名字从她的唇间升起，如烟雾般飘散在苍白的天空里。

appropriate:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade case before the trial. 'Wear these,' he said quietly. The silver-threaded robes inside shimmered like cloud-light. He reminded me that *appropriate* clothing could help channel spiritual energy, just as the right herb must be picked in the right season or its power would be wasted.
appropriate:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，穿____的服装有助于在飞升试炼中引导灵气。
appropriate:1.hook: Still, the robe felt cold against my skin.
appropriate:1.line: 'The *appropriate* robe is not pride — it is preparation.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade case before the trial.
sentences.cn: 考验前，沈无咎递给我一个小小的玉匣。

sentences.en: 'Wear these,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: 「穿上这个，」他低声说。

sentences.en: The silver-threaded robes inside shimmered like cloud-light.
sentences.cn: 里面的银丝衣袍闪烁着云光。

sentences.en: He reminded me that *appropriate* clothing could help channel spiritual energy, just as the right herb must be picked in the right season or its power would be wasted.

chief:1.en: A carved wooden board outside the Ascension Hall listed the rules of the trial. At the very top, written in deep ink, was the name of the examiner: Elder Mosswind. Shen Wujiu whispered that the elder's *chief* duty was not to test our strength, but to measure whether our hearts held any trace of fear.
chief:1.cnHint: 石板上写着这次飞升考核的____监察者姓名。
chief:1.hook: Elder Mosswind had failed every disciple for three years.
chief:1.line: 'His *chief* concern is your heart, not your hand.'

sentences.en: A carved wooden board outside the Ascension Hall listed the rules of the trial.
sentences.cn: 飞升殿外有一块刻着字的木板，列出了考验的规则。

sentences.en: At the very top, written in deep ink, was the name of the examiner: Elder Mosswind.
sentences.cn: 最上面用深色墨迹写着主考官的名字：苔风长老。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu whispered that the elder's *chief* duty was not to test our strength, but to measure whether our hearts held any trace of fear.

clearly:1.en: Xiaoxing drew the trial path in the dirt with a stick, her small hand steady and sure. The route curved between three wind-pillars before reaching the summit cloud. She spoke *clearly*, marking each dangerous turn so I would not confuse them in the mist. Her voice was calm, but her eyes were not.
clearly:1.cnHint: 师妹____地为我讲解了飞升路径上的危险转折点。
clearly:1.hook: One pillar on her map had no marking at all.
clearly:1.line: 'Listen *clearly* — the third turn is where disciples vanish.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing drew the trial path in the dirt with a stick, her small hand steady and sure.
sentences.cn: 小杏用木棍在土里画出试炼路线，小手稳稳当当。

sentences.en: The route curved between three wind-pillars before reaching the summit cloud.
sentences.cn: 路线在三根风柱间蜿蜒，最后通向山顶的云层。

sentences.en: She spoke *clearly*, marking each dangerous turn so I would not confuse them in the mist.
Her voice was calm, but her eyes were not.
sentences.cn: 她的声音很平静，但眼神却不是。

communicate:1.en: The floating mountains carry no echo. Shen Wujiu taught me a hand signal before I set out: three slow fingers meant danger ahead; a closed fist meant turn back. 'In the high clouds, you cannot *communicate* with words,' he said. 'Let your hands speak instead.' I practiced the signs until my fingers ached.
communicate:1.cnHint: 师兄教我用手势在云雾中____信息，因为高山上声音无法传递。
communicate:1.hook: He showed me one signal but would not name its meaning.
communicate:1.line: 'When words fail, *communicate* with your hands alone.'

sentences.en: The floating mountains carry no echo.
sentences.cn: 浮山上没有回声。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu taught me a hand signal before I set out: three slow fingers meant danger ahead; a closed fist meant turn back.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在我出发前教过我一个手势：三根缓缓抬起的手指表示前方有危险；握拳表示掉头。

sentences.en: 'In the high clouds, you cannot *communicate* with words,' he said.
'Let your hands speak instead.'
sentences.cn: 让你的手替你说话吧。

sentences.en: I practiced the signs until my fingers ached.
sentences.cn: 我练习这些手势，直到手指酸痛。

emphasis:1.en: Master Qingwu gathered us at the foot of the Ascension Path and spoke only a few sentences. Her *emphasis* fell on a single warning: do not stop moving once you enter the cloud layer, for the clouds remember stillness and will hold you there. I repeated the warning to myself three times as she turned away.
emphasis:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊的叮嘱中，____落在了进入云层后绝不能停步这一点上。
emphasis:1.hook: She had never warned any disciple about this before.
emphasis:1.line: 'My *emphasis* today is one rule only: do not stop.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu gathered us at the foot of the Ascension Path and spoke only a few sentences.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把我们集合在升仙路脚下，只说了几句话。

sentences.en: Her *emphasis* fell on a single warning: do not stop moving once you enter the cloud layer, for the clouds remember stillness and will hold you there.
I repeated the warning to myself three times as she turned away.
sentences.cn: 她转身离开时，我在心里把这个警告重复了三遍。

emphasize:1.en: At the stone gate, a senior disciple read the trial code aloud. She paused at the final line and lifted her eyes to *emphasize* it: 'Return before the cloud-bell rings, or the path will close.' The words settled over us like snow. Even Shen Wujiu, who rarely showed worry, pressed his lips together.
emphasize:1.cnHint: 宣读规则的弟子特别____了飞升路径关闭的时限。
emphasize:1.hook: The cloud-bell, I realised, had already begun to hum.
emphasize:1.line: 'I *emphasize* this line because it has ended disciples before.'

sentences.en: At the stone gate, a senior disciple read the trial code aloud.
sentences.cn: 在石门前，一位师姐大声念出了试炼的暗语。

sentences.en: She paused at the final line and lifted her eyes to *emphasize* it: 'Return before the cloud-bell rings, or the path will close.'
The words settled over us like snow.
sentences.cn: 那些话像雪一样落在我们身上。

sentences.en: Even Shen Wujiu, who rarely showed worry, pressed his lips together.
sentences.cn: 连很少显露担忧的沈无咎，也抿紧了嘴角。

england:1.en: Old texts in the sect library sometimes held words from distant lands across the sea of clouds. Xiaoxing once showed me a faded map where a small island nation called *England* was marked. Master Qingwu told us those far places carried their own spirit-wisdom, and that a wide heart could find meaning even in a foreign word.
england:1.cnHint: 师妹在古籍地图上向我指出了一个名叫____的遥远岛国。
england:1.hook: The map had a second mark that no one could explain.
england:1.line: '*England* is far, yet its words carry spirit too.'

sentences.en: Old texts in the sect library sometimes held words from distant lands across the sea of clouds.
sentences.cn: 宗门藏书阁里的古籍有时会收录来自云海另一端远方的词汇。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing once showed me a faded map where a small island nation called *England* was marked.
Master Qingwu told us those far places carried their own spirit-wisdom, and that a wide heart could find meaning even in a foreign word.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊告诉我们那些遥远的地方各有各的灵性智慧，宽广的心可以在异国的词汇里找到意义。

male:1.en: On the outer terrace, two disciples argued over a rare silver crane. The *male* bird had chosen to land on my shoulder, not theirs. Master Qingwu watched from the stone path, silent. A chosen bird, the elders say, sees something the eye cannot.
male:1.cnHint: 一只雄性银鹤停在弟子肩上，师尊在石径旁静静注视。
male:1.hook: The crane whispered one word into my ear.
male:1.line: 'Every *male* crane that lands unbidden has already read your fate,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: On the outer terrace, two disciples argued over a rare silver crane.
sentences.cn: 在外廊，两个弟子为了一只罕见的银鹤争执不下。

sentences.en: The *male* bird had chosen to land on my shoulder, not theirs.
Master Qingwu watched from the stone path, silent.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从石路上看着，沉默不语。

sentences.en: A chosen bird, the elders say, sees something the eye cannot.
sentences.cn: 长辈们说，被选中的鸟能看到眼睛看不到的东西。

fish:1.en: Shen Wujiu knelt at the cloud-pool's edge and lifted a bowl of pale *fish* carved from glacier ice. Each piece held a sleeping formula inside its flesh. To eat one was to wake a word in your blood, but the wrong word could silence you forever.
fish:1.cnHint: 师兄从云池边取出一碗冰雕的____，每块鱼肉中都封印着一个功法。
fish:1.hook: One piece glowed red — a color no one had ever seen before.
fish:1.line: 'Do not touch the red *fish*,' Shen Wujiu said softly, 'not yet.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu knelt at the cloud-pool's edge and lifted a bowl of pale *fish* carved from glacier ice.
Each piece held a sleeping formula inside its flesh.
sentences.cn: 每一块冰雕的鱼肉里都藏着一个沉睡的咒语。

sentences.en: To eat one was to wake a word in your blood, but the wrong word could silence you forever.
sentences.cn: 吃下一块会在你的血液里唤醒一个词，但吃错了可能会让你永远沉默。

fashion:1.en: High on the wind terrace, Xiaoxing arranged spirit-herbs in a careful *fashion*, each one placed according to the pull of the clouds. She said the order was older than the Sect itself. I copied her pattern on a spare stone, wondering if I was learning a language or making a prayer.
fashion:1.cnHint: 师妹以一种古老的____在风台上排列灵草，我悄悄照样学着。
fashion:1.hook: The herbs began to rise, one by one, without any wind.
fashion:1.line: 'Arrange them in this *fashion*, and the mountain will answer,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: High on the wind terrace, Xiaoxing arranged spirit-herbs in a careful *fashion*, each one placed according to the pull of the clouds.
She said the order was older than the Sect itself.
sentences.cn: 她说这个顺序比宗门本身还要古老。

sentences.en: I copied her pattern on a spare stone, wondering if I was learning a language or making a prayer.
sentences.cn: 我在一块闲石上复制了她的图案，想知道自己是在学一门语言还是在做一次祈祷。

weather:1.en: The outer courtyard smelled of rain before any cloud had arrived. Master Qingwu said a true disciple learns to read the *weather* of the spirit world, not only the sky. Pressure, silence, the tilt of a leaf — all were words in a language the body knew first.
weather:1.cnHint: 师尊说，真正的弟子要学会读懂灵界的____，而不仅仅是天空的变化。
weather:1.hook: Then the courtyard went utterly still, and something vast drew near.
weather:1.line: 'The *weather* here obeys intention, not season,' Master Qingwu warned quietly.

sentences.en: The outer courtyard smelled of rain before any cloud had arrived.
sentences.cn: 外院的空气闻起来像雨，但没有一片云飘来。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said a true disciple learns to read the *weather* of the spirit world, not only the sky.
Pressure, silence, the tilt of a leaf — all were words in a language the body knew first.
sentences.cn: 压力、寂静、一片叶子的倾斜——这一切都是身体最先知道的语言里的词汇。

device:1.en: Near the east gate, a bronze *device* no larger than a hand sat on a flat stone. Shen Wujiu said it was used to measure the density of floating words in the air. Today it spun without stopping. Whatever was rising from below the clouds, it was rising fast.
device:1.cnHint: 东门旁有一件小巧的青铜____，师兄说它能测量空气中灵字的浓度。
device:1.hook: The needle snapped clean off — far beyond any reading ever recorded.
device:1.line: 'This *device* has never spun this fast in a hundred years,' Shen Wujiu murmured.

sentences.en: Near the east gate, a bronze *device* no larger than a hand sat on a flat stone.
Shen Wujiu said it was used to measure the density of floating words in the air.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说那是用来测量空气中悬浮词密度的。

sentences.en: Today it spun without stopping.
sentences.cn: 今天它一刻不停地转动。

sentences.en: Whatever was rising from below the clouds, it was rising fast.
sentences.cn: 不管什么东西从云层下方上升，它上升得很快。

farm:1.en: Below the lowest floating mountain, the old disciples kept a spirit *farm* on a narrow ledge of cloud-earth. Rows of glowing seedlings held half-formed words inside their stems. I was sent to water them at dawn. The moment I touched the first row, all the words turned gold.
farm:1.cnHint: 最低的浮山上，弟子们在云土台地上种着一片灵草____，我被派去清晨浇水。
farm:1.hook: Every seedling turned to face me, all at once.
farm:1.line: 'No one has made the *farm* glow on their first visit,' Xiaoxing said, eyes wide.

sentences.en: Below the lowest floating mountain, the old disciples kept a spirit *farm* on a narrow ledge of cloud-earth.
Rows of glowing seedlings held half-formed words inside their stems.
sentences.cn: 一排排发光的幼苗茎里藏着半成形的词汇。

sentences.en: I was sent to water them at dawn.
sentences.cn: 我被派去在黎明时浇灌它们。

sentences.en: The moment I touched the first row, all the words turned gold.
sentences.cn: 我触到第一排的时候，所有的词都变成了金色。

drug:1.en: On the high stone shelf outside the medicine hall, sealed jars held every known spirit *drug* in the Sect's collection. One jar was always warm to the touch, no matter the season. Master Qingwu told me not to open it. That, of course, was the one I could not stop thinking about.
drug:1.cnHint: 药殿外的石架上排列着各种封印的灵____，其中一个瓶子四季常温。
drug:1.hook: Tonight the warm jar was glowing, and humming my name.
drug:1.line: 'That *drug* is not sealed to keep it in,' Master Qingwu said, 'but to keep something out.'

sentences.en: On the high stone shelf outside the medicine hall, sealed jars held every known spirit *drug* in the Sect's collection.
One jar was always warm to the touch, no matter the season.
sentences.cn: 有一个罐子无论季节如何始终是温热的。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told me not to open it.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊告诉我不要打开它。

sentences.en: That, of course, was the one I could not stop thinking about.
sentences.cn: 当然，那正是我无法停止想开的那个。

heat:1.en: At noon the training ground shimmered with *heat* rising from the cloud-stone floor. Xiaoxing said the warmth was not from the sun but from ten thousand unspoken words pressing upward from the sea below. I felt them against my feet — restless, urgent, as if they had been waiting for someone to arrive.
heat:1.cnHint: 正午时分，云石地面散发出阵阵____，师妹说那是来自云海深处无数未言之字的力量。
heat:1.hook: A single crack split the stone directly beneath where I stood.
heat:1.line: 'Feel that *heat*,' Xiaoxing said softly, 'it means the words have chosen you.'

sentences.en: At noon the training ground shimmered with *heat* rising from the cloud-stone floor.
Xiaoxing said the warmth was not from the sun but from ten thousand unspoken words pressing upward from the sea below.
sentences.cn: 小杏说那温暖不是来自太阳，而是来自下方海洋中万千未诉说的言语向上压来。

sentences.en: I felt them against my feet — restless, urgent, as if they had been waiting for someone to arrive.
sentences.cn: 我能感觉到它们贴着我的脚——躁动不安，急迫万分，仿佛在等待某个人的到来。

moment:1.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, I stood watching the morning mist rise from below. Master Qingwu lifted one hand, and the whole world seemed to hold its breath. In that *moment*, every floating mountain above us shivered, and a single golden leaf fell upward instead of down.
moment:1.cnHint: 在云海宗的露台上，师尊抬手，四周忽然静止，一片金叶向上飘落，预示着____的到来。
moment:1.hook: The leaf hung still, pointing at me.
moment:1.line: 'This *moment* will not come twice,' said Master Qingwu, her eyes fixed on the sky.

sentences.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, I stood watching the morning mist rise from below.
sentences.cn: 在云海宗的外露台上，我站着看下方的晨雾升起。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu lifted one hand, and the whole world seemed to hold its breath.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊抬起一只手，整个世界仿佛都屏住了呼吸。

sentences.en: In that *moment*, every floating mountain above us shivered, and a single golden leaf fell upward instead of down.

nice:1.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled the formula scroll on the stone path outside the herb garden. His brush strokes were so *nice* in their balance — each line exactly as wide as it needed to be, each curve measured to the last breath — that even the air around the scroll seemed to sharpen and hold still.
nice:1.cnHint: 师兄在药园外展开功法卷轴，笔法____而精准，连四周的空气都随之凝神屏息。
nice:1.hook: Then one stroke began to bleed ink upward.
nice:1.line: 'The spacing must be *nice* or the formula will misread the wind,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled the formula scroll on the stone path outside the herb garden.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在药园外的石径上铺开了符箓卷轴。

sentences.en: His brush strokes were so *nice* in their balance — each line exactly as wide as it needed to be, each curve measured to the last breath — that even the air around the scroll seemed to sharpen and hold still.

peer:1.en: At the mountain gate, Xiaoxing pressed close to the carved stone arch and tried to *peer* through the white curtain of cloud below. She said she had heard footsteps rising from the cloud sea — steady, slow, and far too heavy to belong to any bird or wandering wind.
peer:1.cnHint: 晓星在山门处努力向云幕下方____，她说她听到了从云海中传来的沉重脚步声。
peer:1.hook: Something below answered her gaze with a low hum.

sentences.en: At the mountain gate, Xiaoxing pressed close to the carved stone arch and tried to *peer* through the white curtain of cloud below.
She said she had heard footsteps rising from the cloud sea — steady, slow, and far too heavy to belong to any bird or wandering wind.
sentences.cn: 她说她听到了从云海升上来的脚步声——稳定、缓慢，而且重得不可能属于任何鸟儿或游荡的风。

recommendation:1.en: Before I could enter the sect's outer training ground, I had to present a *recommendation* from a senior disciple. Shen Wujiu handed me a folded paper marked with his seal. When I opened it on the stone steps, the characters rose off the page and floated in a calm ring around my head.
recommendation:1.cnHint: 进入外门演武场前，我需要持有师兄的____信；打开信时，文字竟从纸上浮起，在我头顶绕成一圈。
recommendation:1.hook: The floating characters slowly rearranged into a warning I had not asked for.
recommendation:1.line: 'My *recommendation* will open the gate, but what you do inside is yours alone,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Before I could enter the sect's outer training ground, I had to present a *recommendation* from a senior disciple.
Shen Wujiu handed me a folded paper marked with his seal.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一张折好的纸，上面印着他的封印。

sentences.en: When I opened it on the stone steps, the characters rose off the page and floated in a calm ring around my head.
sentences.cn: 当我在石阶上打开它时，字符从纸上浮起，在我头顶周围静静地盘旋。

strange:1.en: The cliff walk east of the sect was a familiar path, yet this morning it felt *strange* under my feet — the stones slightly warm, the carved markers along the edge turned to face inward rather than outward, as though the mountain itself had shifted during the night without asking anyone's permission.
strange:1.cnHint: 宗门以东的崖道平日熟悉，今晨却感到____——石面微热，路边的刻石全都转向内侧，像是山体独自挪动过。
strange:1.hook: The last marker had no carving left at all.
strange:1.line: 'It is *strange* that the mountain moves but makes no sound,' I said, and Xiaoxing nodded slowly.

sentences.en: The cliff walk east of the sect was a familiar path, yet this morning it felt *strange* under my feet — the stones slightly warm, the carved markers along the edge turned to face inward rather than outward, as though the mountain itself had shifted during the night without asking anyone's permission.

widespread:1.en: News of the golden leaf falling upward had become *widespread* among the outer disciples by midday. Groups gathered on every terrace and open path, pointing at the sky and trading guesses in low voices. Master Qingwu walked through them all without stopping, her sleeves folded, her face giving nothing away.
widespread:1.cnHint: 金叶倒飞的消息在外门弟子间迅速____，各处聚集议论，唯有师尊神色平静地穿行其间。
widespread:1.hook: She paused once, looked directly at me, and walked on.
widespread:1.line: 'When a sign is *widespread*, it means heaven is speaking loudly,' Shen Wujiu said, eyes lifted.

sentences.en: News of the golden leaf falling upward had become *widespread* among the outer disciples by midday.
Groups gathered on every terrace and open path, pointing at the sky and trading guesses in low voices.
sentences.cn: 人群聚集在每个露台和开阔的小径上，指向天空，用低沉的嗓音交换猜测。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu walked through them all without stopping, her sleeves folded, her face giving nothing away.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊穿过他们所有人却没有停下，袖子折叠着，脸上毫无表情。

wonderful:1.en: From the highest open ledge of Cloud Sea Sect, the view at dusk was *wonderful* in a way that ached — gold and violet light folding over distant peaks, the cloud sea below burning soft and slow. I had climbed here to be alone, but the sky itself felt crowded with something waiting to happen.
wonderful:1.cnHint: 在宗门最高的岩台上，暮色中的云海景象____而令人心悸，我独自登顶，却感到天空中有什么东西正在等待。
wonderful:1.hook: One peak on the far horizon was no longer where it had been yesterday.
wonderful:1.line: 'How *wonderful* and how heavy it is,' said Xiaoxing, 'to stand above the clouds and feel small.'

sentences.en: From the highest open ledge of Cloud Sea Sect, the view at dusk was *wonderful* in a way that ached — gold and violet light folding over distant peaks, the cloud sea below burning soft and slow.
I had climbed here to be alone, but the sky itself felt crowded with something waiting to happen.
sentences.cn: 我爬到这里是想独处，但天空本身似乎被什么等待中的东西挤满了。

immediately:1.en: The morning bell rang across the stone courtyard, and I *immediately* dropped my ink brush and ran to the outer gate. Shen Wujiu stood there, holding a torn scroll that still glowed at the edges. 'The wind carried this from the upper peak,' he said quietly. Around us, every lantern flame bent toward the east at once.
immediately:1.cnHint: 清晨钟声一响，我____冲向外门，师兄手持一卷残破发光的卷轴。
immediately:1.hook: Every flame in the courtyard pointed east, toward the forbidden peak.
immediately:1.line: 'Come *immediately* — the scroll will stop glowing before the next breath.'

sentences.en: The morning bell rang across the stone courtyard, and I *immediately* dropped my ink brush and ran to the outer gate.
Shen Wujiu stood there, holding a torn scroll that still glowed at the edges.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在那里，手中拿着一卷仍在边缘处发光的残破卷轴。

sentences.en: 'The wind carried this from the upper peak,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "风从上峰吹来了这个，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: Around us, every lantern flame bent toward the east at once.
sentences.cn: 我们周围，每一盏灯笼的火焰同时向东弯去。

improvement:1.en: Xiaoxing spread her herb scrolls across the flat stone near the cliff edge, comparing my writing to hers in the afternoon light. 'There is *improvement*,' she said, tracing a word I had shaped three times that week. 'Your strokes no longer tremble.' Far below, the cloud sea churned without wind.
improvement:1.cnHint: 小星在悬崖边对比我们的卷轴，说我的书写有了____，但云海无风自涌。
improvement:1.hook: The cloud sea churned below, though the air above was perfectly still.
improvement:1.line: 'I see real *improvement* — but something in the clouds worries me.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread her herb scrolls across the flat stone near the cliff edge, comparing my writing to hers in the afternoon light.
sentences.cn: 小杏把她的药草卷轴铺在靠近悬崖边的平坦石头上，在下午的光线中对比我的笔迹和她的。

sentences.en: 'There is *improvement*,' she said, tracing a word I had shaped three times that week.
'Your strokes no longer tremble.'
sentences.cn: "你的笔画不再发抖了。"

sentences.en: Far below, the cloud sea churned without wind.
sentences.cn: 远下方，云海在无风中翻腾。

afternoon:1.en: We gathered healing words by the east ledge every *afternoon*, pressing glowing syllables between stone boards to dry them like herbs. Master Qingwu watched from above without speaking. On this day, the syllables dried black instead of gold, and their warmth was gone.
afternoon:1.cnHint: 我们每天____在东崖采集灵字，但今天字迹晒干后变成了黑色。
afternoon:1.hook: The syllables turned black as they dried — every single one.
afternoon:1.line: 'Each *afternoon* we gather words here, but today the words are sick.'

sentences.en: We gathered healing words by the east ledge every *afternoon*, pressing glowing syllables between stone boards to dry them like herbs.
Master Qingwu watched from above without speaking.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从上方看着，一言不发。

sentences.en: On this day, the syllables dried black instead of gold, and their warmth was gone.
sentences.cn: 在这一天，这些音节干燥后变成了黑色而不是金色，它们的温暖也消失了。

expand:1.en: Shen Wujiu placed one bright word-seed on the open ground and told me to breathe a slow, steady breath upon it. I watched the glow *expand* like a ripple on still water until it reached the stone wall and stopped. He nodded once. Then a crack split the wall where the glow had touched.
expand:1.cnHint: 师兄让我对一枚灵字种子吹气，光芒____开来，随即石壁出现了裂缝。
expand:1.hook: A crack split the stone wall exactly where the light had touched it.
expand:1.line: 'Watch it *expand* — and do not step back, whatever you feel.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu placed one bright word-seed on the open ground and told me to breathe a slow, steady breath upon it.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在开阔的地面上放了一枚明亮的字种，让我对着它缓缓、稳稳地吹一口气。

sentences.en: I watched the glow *expand* like a ripple on still water until it reached the stone wall and stopped.
He nodded once.
sentences.cn: 他点了一下头。

sentences.en: Then a crack split the wall where the glow had touched.
sentences.cn: 然后一道裂缝从那光触及的地方沿着石墙裂开了。

regardless:1.en: The outer path wound along a narrow ledge above the cloud sea. Xiaoxing walked it *regardless* of the height, her herb satchel swinging lightly. I gripped the rope guide with both hands. She paused at the far end, knelt down, and pressed her palm flat against the stone. 'Something is pushing up,' she said.
regardless:1.cnHint: 小星____高度多远，都走在悬空石道上，在尽头处她感觉到石头在往上顶。
regardless:1.hook: She pressed her palm to the path and said something was pushing up.
regardless:1.line: 'I walk this ledge *regardless* — the words out here are the freshest.'

sentences.en: The outer path wound along a narrow ledge above the cloud sea.
sentences.cn: 外侧山径沿着云海上方的狭窄崖边蜿蜒而上。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing walked it *regardless* of the height, her herb satchel swinging lightly.
I gripped the rope guide with both hands.
sentences.cn: 我用双手紧紧握住绳索的指引。

sentences.en: She paused at the far end, knelt down, and pressed her palm flat against the stone.
sentences.cn: 她在远端停下，跪了下去，把掌心贴在石头上。

sentences.en: 'Something is pushing up,' she said.
sentences.cn: "有什么东西在往上推，"她说。

rid:1.en: I spent the long morning copying the purifying word that is said to *rid* a scroll of false meanings. My hand ached by the third hour. Master Qingwu passed without looking at my work, then stopped, stepped back, and stared. 'You wrote it correctly,' she said, which was not quite a compliment.
rid:1.cnHint: 我抄写能____卷轴中虚假含义的净化灵字，师尊看后说我写对了，语气意味深长。
rid:1.hook: Master Qingwu said I wrote it correctly, and her voice held no warmth.
rid:1.line: 'This word can *rid* a scroll of lies — copy it until your hand knows it.'

sentences.en: I spent the long morning copying the purifying word that is said to *rid* a scroll of false meanings.
My hand ached by the third hour.
sentences.cn: 到第三个时辰时，我的手开始酸疼。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu passed without looking at my work, then stopped, stepped back, and stared.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊经过时没看我的功课，然后停了下来，退了一步，盯着看。

sentences.en: 'You wrote it correctly,' she said, which was not quite a compliment.
sentences.cn: "你写对了，"她说，这不太算是夸奖。

dog:1.en: A small *dog* followed Shen Wujiu through the lower courtyard gate, its fur the color of old clouds. No one had seen it before. It sat beside the word-drying rack and barked once at a single scroll, then went still. Shen Wujiu unrolled that scroll and found the center word had already vanished.
dog:1.cnHint: 一只毛色如云的____跟着师兄进了庭院，冲着晾字架上的某卷轴叫了一声，那卷轴中心的字已消失。
dog:1.hook: The center word of that scroll had vanished without a trace.
dog:1.line: 'This little *dog* barked at the scroll before any of us noticed the missing word.'

sentences.en: A small *dog* followed Shen Wujiu through the lower courtyard gate, its fur the color of old clouds.
No one had seen it before.
sentences.cn: 谁都没见过它。

sentences.en: It sat beside the word-drying rack and barked once at a single scroll, then went still.
sentences.cn: 它坐在晒字架旁边，对着一卷经文叫了一声，然后就没动了。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled that scroll and found the center word had already vanished.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎打开那卷经文，发现中心的字已经消散了。

busy:1.en: The lower market ledge was *busy* with disciples trading word-cuttings and dried syllables before sunset. I pushed through carefully, holding my new scroll flat. Xiaoxing found me near the edge stall. 'Master Qingwu called for you an hour ago,' she said. Above the crowd, a single dark cloud hung without moving.
busy:1.cnHint: 日落前的下层市集____极了，小星找到我说师尊一小时前就叫我了，头顶一片乌云纹丝不动。
busy:1.hook: One dark cloud hung above the busy ledge and had not moved for an hour.
busy:1.line: 'The market is *busy* today — which means someone is selling something they should not be.'

sentences.en: The lower market ledge was *busy* with disciples trading word-cuttings and dried syllables before sunset.
I pushed through carefully, holding my new scroll flat.
sentences.cn: 我小心地挤过人群，把新的经文卷平放着。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found me near the edge stall.
sentences.cn: 小杏在靠近边缘的摊位找到了我。

sentences.en: 'Master Qingwu called for you an hour ago,' she said.
sentences.cn: "青梧师尊一小时前召你，"她说。

sentences.en: Above the crowd, a single dark cloud hung without moving.
sentences.cn: 人群上方悬着一朵乌黑的云，一动不动。

extreme:1.en: On the outer platform of the sect, the morning wind carried a sharp cold that cut through my robe. Master Qingwu stood at the edge, eyes closed. She had warned us that *extreme* conditions on the high peaks would test not our strength but our stillness. I breathed. The clouds below stirred.
extreme:1.cnHint: 师尊告诫弟子，高峰上____的环境将考验内心的平静。
extreme:1.hook: Then the platform began, slowly, to crack.
extreme:1.line: '*Extreme* cold is not your enemy — your own fear is.'

sentences.en: On the outer platform of the sect, the morning wind carried a sharp cold that cut through my robe.
sentences.cn: 在派系的外侧平台上，晨风吹来刺骨的寒冷，直穿过我的衣衫。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the edge, eyes closed.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在边缘，闭着眼睛。

sentences.en: She had warned us that *extreme* conditions on the high peaks would test not our strength but our stillness.
I breathed.
sentences.cn: 我呼吸。

sentences.en: The clouds below stirred.
sentences.cn: 下方的云海动了起来。

style:1.en: Shen Wujiu crossed the open courtyard with a ease I could not copy. Every step held a particular *style*, unhurried and exact, as though the mountain path itself had been arranged for him alone. Master Qingwu watched from above without a word. I tried to match his walk and nearly fell.
style:1.cnHint: 师兄走路的____令人印象深刻，小星暗暗模仿却险些跌倒。
style:1.hook: A single feather drifted down and landed at my feet.
style:1.line: 'Your *style* of walking tells me everything about your inner wind.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu crossed the open courtyard with a ease I could not copy.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎穿过空旷的庭院，用了一种我模仿不来的从容。

sentences.en: Every step held a particular *style*, unhurried and exact, as though the mountain path itself had been arranged for him alone.
Master Qingwu watched from above without a word.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从上面看着，一言不发。

sentences.en: I tried to match his walk and nearly fell.
sentences.cn: 我试着模仿他的步态，几乎摔倒了。

color:1.en: We gathered at the sky terrace before dawn. The clouds below shifted from grey to a deep rose, and then to a shade I had never seen. Xiaoxing pointed and said the rare *color* meant a spiritual tide was rising from the sea below. My chest tightened with quiet excitement.
color:1.cnHint: 小星指着云海异常的____，说明一股灵潮正在涌起。
color:1.hook: The color deepened, and something enormous moved beneath the clouds.
color:1.line: 'That *color* appears only when the sea of clouds is about to speak.'

sentences.en: We gathered at the sky terrace before dawn.
sentences.cn: 我们在天台集合，天色未明。

sentences.en: The clouds below shifted from grey to a deep rose, and then to a shade I had never seen.
sentences.cn: 下方的云从灰色变成了深玫瑰色，接着变成了我从未见过的颜色。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pointed and said the rare *color* meant a spiritual tide was rising from the sea below.
My chest tightened with quiet excitement.
sentences.cn: 我的胸口因为安静的兴奋而绷紧了。

meeting:1.en: A notice was posted at the stone gate: all outer disciples were to attend a *meeting* at the Windsong Pavilion at midday. No reason was given. Shen Wujiu folded his arms and studied the seal on the notice. I had been a disciple for only three days. My hands would not stop shaking.
meeting:1.cnHint: 石门处贴出告示，所有外门弟子须参加一场____，原因未明。
meeting:1.hook: The seal on the notice was one no living master had used in years.
meeting:1.line: 'This *meeting* was called by someone even Master Qingwu must answer to.'

sentences.en: A notice was posted at the stone gate: all outer disciples were to attend a *meeting* at the Windsong Pavilion at midday.
No reason was given.
sentences.cn: 没有给出理由。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu folded his arms and studied the seal on the notice.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎交叉着双臂，研究着通知上的印章。

sentences.en: I had been a disciple for only three days.
sentences.cn: 我做弟子还不到三天。

sentences.en: My hands would not stop shaking.
sentences.cn: 我的手停不下来地发抖。

volunteer:1.en: Master Qingwu asked who would carry the new spirit-herb map to the eastern ridge before the storm arrived. Silence filled the open ground. I raised my hand slowly. She looked at me for a long moment. 'A *volunteer*,' she said, almost to herself, 'is worth ten who are ordered.' My feet felt light.
volunteer:1.cnHint: 师尊询问谁愿主动送图，小叙述者举起了手，师尊低声称赞____的价值。
volunteer:1.hook: Behind her, the eastern clouds turned the color of iron.
volunteer:1.line: 'A *volunteer* carries something an ordered disciple never can — true will.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu asked who would carry the new spirit-herb map to the eastern ridge before the storm arrived.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊问谁愿意在暴风雨来临前把新的灵草地图送到东岭。

sentences.en: Silence filled the open ground.
sentences.cn: 空地上一片沉默。

sentences.en: I raised my hand slowly.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢地举起了手。

sentences.en: She looked at me for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 她看了我许久。

sentences.en: 'A *volunteer*,' she said, almost to herself, 'is worth ten who are ordered.'
My feet felt light.
sentences.cn: 我的脚轻飘飘的。

deliver:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood before the assembly on the cliff path and began to *deliver* his report on the broken wind-seals with a calm, steady voice. Each word landed like a stone set firmly in place. I stood at the edge of the crowd, watching his stillness, and understood what mastery of speech truly meant.
deliver:1.cnHint: 师兄在悬崖上____报告，字字稳健，令人感受到语言的力量。
deliver:1.hook: When he finished, Master Qingwu closed her eyes and said nothing.
deliver:1.line: 'I will *deliver* the full account, however long it takes to speak.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood before the assembly on the cliff path and began to *deliver* his report on the broken wind-seals with a calm, steady voice.
Each word landed like a stone set firmly in place.
sentences.cn: 每一个字都像一块石子，稳稳地落在了位置上。

sentences.en: I stood at the edge of the crowd, watching his stillness, and understood what mastery of speech truly meant.
sentences.cn: 我站在人群的边缘，看着他的沉着，明白了什么叫真正的言语之道。

engineering:1.en: The old aqueduct that fed the herb terraces was failing. Xiaoxing spread a torn map on the flat rock and traced the broken channels with her finger. She said this was not a spiritual problem but a problem of *engineering* — of water, weight, and careful design. I had never thought of the mountain as something built.
engineering:1.cnHint: 小星展开地图，说明水道失修是____问题而非灵力问题。
engineering:1.hook: Beneath the largest crack, water dripped onto something that glowed faintly.
engineering:1.line: 'Good *engineering* and good cultivation share one root — patient attention.'

sentences.en: The old aqueduct that fed the herb terraces was failing.
sentences.cn: 供给草药梯田的古老渡槽在损坏。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread a torn map on the flat rock and traced the broken channels with her finger.
sentences.cn: 小杏在平石上摊开一张破损的地图，用手指描过断裂的水道。

sentences.en: She said this was not a spiritual problem but a problem of *engineering* — of water, weight, and careful design.
I had never thought of the mountain as something built.
sentences.cn: 我从未想过这座山是被建造出来的。

tiny:1.en: Xiaoxing held out her palm. In the center sat a *tiny* seed, no larger than a grain of rice, giving off a faint silver light. She said Master Qingwu had grown it over thirty years. One such seed, planted at the right peak, could open a passage through the clouds. I was afraid to breathe.
tiny:1.cnHint: 小星手心托着一粒____的种子，师尊培育了它整整三十年。
tiny:1.hook: The seed pulsed once, as though it had heard my heartbeat.
tiny:1.line: 'Do not let its *tiny* size deceive you — it holds a mountain inside.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing held out her palm.
sentences.cn: 小杏伸出了她的掌心。

sentences.en: In the center sat a *tiny* seed, no larger than a grain of rice, giving off a faint silver light.
She said Master Qingwu had grown it over thirty years.
sentences.cn: 她说青梧师尊花了三十年培养了它。

sentences.en: One such seed, planted at the right peak, could open a passage through the clouds.
sentences.cn: 这样一粒种子，种在正确的山峰上，就能打开穿过云海的通道。

sentences.en: I was afraid to breathe.
sentences.cn: 我害怕连呼吸都不敢。

intelligence:1.en: Master Qingwu led us to the outer cliff path, where wind-carved stones held old sect maps. 'Read the land,' she said. 'A disciple's *intelligence* is not measured by how many formulas they memorise, but by how clearly they see what is hidden in plain sight.' I studied every stone.
intelligence:1.cnHint: 师尊在峭壁小路上考验弟子，看谁能凭____读懂隐藏在山石中的地图。
intelligence:1.hook: One stone glowed faintly — and it was not on any map.
intelligence:1.line: 'True *intelligence* sees what the eye alone will miss.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us to the outer cliff path, where wind-carved stones held old sect maps.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊带我们走上外崖的小径，风蚀的石头上刻着古老的宗门地图。

sentences.en: 'Read the land,' she said.
sentences.cn: "读懂这片地，"她说。

sentences.en: 'A disciple's *intelligence* is not measured by how many formulas they memorise, but by how clearly they see what is hidden in plain sight.'
I studied every stone.
sentences.cn: 我研究了每一块石头。

uk:1.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a yellowed scroll beside the mountain gate. 'This symbol,' he said, pointing to a mark shaped like two crossed keys, 'is the old sect shorthand for the upper kingdom — our elders wrote *uk* in the border notes to mean the high realm above the clouds.' I copied it carefully.
uk:1.cnHint: 师兄在山门旁展示古卷，解释卷边批注中____的含义。
uk:1.hook: Below the mark, a second hand had added three words no one could read.
uk:1.line: 'The elders used *uk* to name the realm above our sky.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a yellowed scroll beside the mountain gate.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在山门边展开一卷泛黄的卷轴。

sentences.en: 'This symbol,' he said, pointing to a mark shaped like two crossed keys, 'is the old sect shorthand for the upper kingdom — our elders wrote *uk* in the border notes to mean the high realm above the clouds.'
I copied it carefully.
sentences.cn: 我小心地抄写下来。

user:1.en: At the outer training terrace, a stone basin held a shared spirit spring. A wooden board above it read: every *user* of this water must offer one word of thanks to the mountain before drinking. I spoke my thanks aloud, and the water rose an inch on its own.
user:1.cnHint: 在露天练功台，山泉旁的木牌要求每位____取水前向山致谢。
user:1.hook: The water stilled — then showed a face that was not mine.
user:1.line: 'Every *user* of the spring must give the mountain its due.'

sentences.en: At the outer training terrace, a stone basin held a shared spirit spring.
sentences.cn: 在外训练平台，一个石盆里装着共用的灵泉。

sentences.en: A wooden board above it read: every *user* of this water must offer one word of thanks to the mountain before drinking.
I spoke my thanks aloud, and the water rose an inch on its own.
sentences.cn: 我大声说出感谢的话，水自己往上涨了一寸。

park:1.en: Beyond the sect's eastern gate lay a wide, flat expanse of pale stone where senior disciples would *park* their wind-boards after long flights above the cloud sea. I watched Shen Wujiu land his board in perfect silence and walk away without a backward glance, as if the sky were nothing.
park:1.cnHint: 在宗门东门外的空地，师兄们习惯将飞行木板____在那里后步入山门。
park:1.hook: One board stood alone, still warm, with no owner in sight.
park:1.line: 'You may *park* your board here only after you have earned your wings.'

sentences.en: Beyond the sect's eastern gate lay a wide, flat expanse of pale stone where senior disciples would *park* their wind-boards after long flights above the cloud sea.
I watched Shen Wujiu land his board in perfect silence and walk away without a backward glance, as if the sky were nothing.
sentences.cn: 我看着沈无咎的风板无声地落地，他转身离开时头也不回，仿佛天空对他什么都不是。

reward:1.en: Xiaoxing had spent three dawn shifts gathering frost-herbs on the open ledge. Master Qingwu placed a small jade vial in her palm. 'This is your *reward*,' she said quietly. 'Not for the herbs, but for returning each morning when the wind told you to turn back.' Xiaoxing bowed without a word.
reward:1.cnHint: 小星在露台连续采药三日，师尊以玉瓶作为____赠予她。
reward:1.hook: The vial hummed once, then fell completely silent in her hand.
reward:1.line: 'This vial is your *reward* — the mountain remembers who stays.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had spent three dawn shifts gathering frost-herbs on the open ledge.
sentences.cn: 小杏花了三个清晨在开阔的崖边采集霜草。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a small jade vial in her palm.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把一个小玉瓶放在她掌心。

sentences.en: 'This is your *reward*,' she said quietly.
'Not for the herbs, but for returning each morning when the wind told you to turn back.'
sentences.cn: "不是为了这些草，而是因为每个早晨风都在劝你回头，你还是来了。"

sentences.en: Xiaoxing bowed without a word.
sentences.cn: 小杏无言地鞠了一躬。

credit:1.en: After our group recitation on the wind-swept square, Master Qingwu looked at Shen Wujiu. 'The younger disciples chanted well today. Give the *credit* to those who rose before dawn to practise.' He nodded, turned to us, and spoke our names one by one into the open air above the cliff.
credit:1.cnHint: 在广场集体诵诀后，师尊要师兄将____归于清晨苦练的弟子们。
credit:1.hook: When the last name left his lips, a cloud rose from below unbidden.
credit:1.line: 'The *credit* belongs to those who practised under the cold stars.'

sentences.en: After our group recitation on the wind-swept square, Master Qingwu looked at Shen Wujiu.
sentences.cn: 在风吹的广场上集体诵读之后，青梧师尊看向沈无咎。

sentences.en: 'The younger disciples chanted well today.
sentences.cn: "今天小弟子们诵得不错。

sentences.en: Give the *credit* to those who rose before dawn to practise.'
He nodded, turned to us, and spoke our names one by one into the open air above the cliff.
sentences.cn: 他点点头，转向我们，把我们的名字一个一个念进了悬崖上方的空气里。

progress:1.en: Each week, Master Qingwu walked the cliff-side practice ground to watch her disciples work. She stopped beside me and said nothing for a long moment. 'You *progress* slowly,' she said at last, 'but every step you take is rooted. Slow roots hold against storms that fast growth never survives.' I breathed.
progress:1.cnHint: 师尊在峭壁练习场巡视时，点评弟子虽____缓慢但根基扎实。
progress:1.hook: Above us, a storm cloud appeared from a completely clear sky.
progress:1.line: 'You *progress* slowly — yet I see no crack in your foundation.'

sentences.en: Each week, Master Qingwu walked the cliff-side practice ground to watch her disciples work.
sentences.cn: 每周，青梧师尊都会走过崖边的练功场看弟子们修行。

sentences.en: She stopped beside me and said nothing for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 她在我身边停下，沉默了很久。

sentences.en: 'You *progress* slowly,' she said at last, 'but every step you take is rooted.
Slow roots hold against storms that fast growth never survives.'
sentences.cn: 慢根能挡住快速生长永远活不过的暴风雨。"

sentences.en: I breathed.
sentences.cn: 我呼吸了。

snack:1.en: Between the morning and afternoon lessons, disciples gathered on the open stone steps to rest. Xiaoxing passed me a small paper packet — a pressed seed cake, a common *snack* among the outer disciples. 'Eat,' she said warmly. 'The afternoon formula is long, and hunger makes the words blur.' I ate.
snack:1.cnHint: 课间休息时，小星在石阶上将一块常见的____分给我，叮嘱我补充体力。
snack:1.hook: The last seed dissolved on my tongue and left a taste of lightning.
snack:1.line: 'Take this *snack* — you will need clear eyes for what comes next.'

sentences.en: Between the morning and afternoon lessons, disciples gathered on the open stone steps to rest.
sentences.cn: 上午和下午功课之间，弟子们聚在开阔的石阶上休息。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing passed me a small paper packet — a pressed seed cake, a common *snack* among the outer disciples.
'Eat,' she said warmly.
sentences.cn: "吃，"她温暖地说。

sentences.en: 'The afternoon formula is long, and hunger makes the words blur.'
sentences.cn: "下午的法诀很长，饿肚子会让字都模糊。"

sentences.en: I ate.
sentences.cn: 我吃了。

retire:1.en: The stone path through the outer court grew quiet as senior disciples began to *retire* for the night, their lanterns fading one by one into the mist. I alone stayed beside the Word-Stone, tracing the carved formula with one finger, afraid to stop. Above me, a single star blinked out without warning.
retire:1.cnHint: 夜深了，师兄们陆续____就寝，而我仍独自守在刻字石旁。
retire:1.hook: The star that guides new disciples should never go dark.
retire:1.line: 'Disciples who do not *retire* before the third bell lose the dawn's first breath of spirit.'

sentences.en: The stone path through the outer court grew quiet as senior disciples began to *retire* for the night, their lanterns fading one by one into the mist.
I alone stayed beside the Word-Stone, tracing the carved formula with one finger, afraid to stop.
sentences.cn: 只有我还守在文字石旁，用一根手指描着刻下的法诀，不敢停下。

sentences.en: Above me, a single star blinked out without warning.
sentences.cn: 我头顶上，一颗星星毫无预警地熄灭了。

sea:1.en: Master Qingwu led me to the cliff edge at sunrise and pointed down. Below our floating mountain, the *sea* of clouds rolled in slow, silent waves, and somewhere beneath it lay the world I had left behind. I felt the pull of that white emptiness like a held breath, vast and without floor.
sea:1.cnHint: 师尊带我站在悬崖边，俯瞰脚下那片云____，令我心生敬畏。
sea:1.hook: Something dark moved just below the cloud surface, slow and deliberate.
sea:1.line: 'The *sea* below remembers every word ever spoken into it,' Master Qingwu said softly.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led me to the cliff edge at sunrise and pointed down.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在日出时把我领到崖边，指向下方。

sentences.en: Below our floating mountain, the *sea* of clouds rolled in slow, silent waves, and somewhere beneath it lay the world I had left behind.
I felt the pull of that white emptiness like a held breath, vast and without floor.
sentences.cn: 我感受到那片白茫茫的虚空像一口被憋住的气，辽阔而无底。

town:1.en: Before joining the sect I had lived in a small *town* at the base of the mountains, where healers sold herb-words painted on paper strips. Now, looking down from the floating peak, that whole settlement was no larger than a single character in my practice book, its roof tiles glinting like ink drops.
town:1.cnHint: 我曾在山脚下的一个小____长大，如今从山巅俯望，它渺小如豆。
town:1.hook: A thin column of smoke rose from that tiny town, the color of a warning sign.
town:1.line: 'Every disciple here once stood in some *town* below, staring up and wondering,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Before joining the sect I had lived in a small *town* at the base of the mountains, where healers sold herb-words painted on paper strips.
Now, looking down from the floating peak, that whole settlement was no larger than a single character in my practice book, its roof tiles glinting like ink drops.
sentences.cn: 如今从浮空的峰顶往下看，整个镇子还没有我练功书里一个字大，屋顶瓦片像墨滴一样闪闪发光。

gap:1.en: Shen Wujiu set two Word-Stones side by side on the practice terrace. 'Do you see the *gap* between these two formulas?' he asked. I stared: one stone glowed steady gold, the other flickered pale silver. The space between them hummed with unfinished meaning, like a sentence missing its heart.
gap:1.cnHint: 师兄指着两块刻字石，让我看它们之间的____，要我理解其中未竟的含义。
gap:1.hook: When I reached toward the gap, the hum sharpened into something close to a voice.
gap:1.line: 'Bridge the *gap* between those two words and you will have your first true formula,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu set two Word-Stones side by side on the practice terrace.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在练功平台上并排放了两块文字石。

sentences.en: 'Do you see the *gap* between these two formulas?' he asked.
I stared: one stone glowed steady gold, the other flickered pale silver.
sentences.cn: 我盯着看：一块石头闪着稳定的金光，另一块闪烁着苍白的银光。

sentences.en: The space between them hummed with unfinished meaning, like a sentence missing its heart.
sentences.cn: 两块石头之间的空隙发出嗡鸣声，像一句话丢了心脏。

generation:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long scroll listing every disciple the Cloud Sea Sect had accepted since its founding. 'Each *generation* adds three words to the living language,' she said quietly. I counted the columns: forty rows of names, forty pulses of meaning grown across centuries, and the next blank row waited at the bottom.
generation:1.cnHint: 师尊展开宗门典籍，讲述每一____弟子如何为活字典增添新词。
generation:1.hook: The ink in that last blank row was still faintly wet.
generation:1.line: 'Our *generation* must add its words before the season of clouds ends,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long scroll listing every disciple the Cloud Sea Sect had accepted since its founding.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊铺开一卷长长的纸轴，上面列着云海宗建立以来收纳的每一位弟子的名字。

sentences.en: 'Each *generation* adds three words to the living language,' she said quietly.
I counted the columns: forty rows of names, forty pulses of meaning grown across centuries, and the next blank row waited at the bottom.
sentences.cn: 我数了数纵列：四十行名字，四十股跨越世纪生长的含义，最下面还空着一行，在等待。

guide:1.en: Xiaoxing handed me a small wooden tablet carved with three root-words. 'Think of it as a *guide* for when the formulas blur together,' she said with a gentle smile. I held it tightly as the evening fog swallowed the path ahead, grateful for even three steady words to lean on.
guide:1.cnHint: 师妹递给我一块刻有根本字的木牌，作为迷失时的____。
guide:1.hook: The fog that swallowed the path was moving against the wind.
guide:1.line: 'Keep this *guide* close — the mountain paths look different after the first rain,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me a small wooden tablet carved with three root-words.
sentences.cn: 小杏递给我一块小木牌，上面刻着三个根字。

sentences.en: 'Think of it as a *guide* for when the formulas blur together,' she said with a gentle smile.
I held it tightly as the evening fog swallowed the path ahead, grateful for even three steady words to lean on.
sentences.cn: 我紧紧握着它，当夜雾吞没了前面的小路，我为能靠着这三个稳稳的字而感到庆幸。

household:1.en: Each *household* in the outer court of the sect had its own Word-Hearth, a small stone basin where daily practice words were burned at dawn. I lit mine alone that first morning, watching the smoke rise in careful spirals, and felt for the first time that I might truly belong somewhere above the clouds.
household:1.cnHint: 宗门外院每个____都有自己的字炉，用于每日晨起修炼。
household:1.hook: The smoke from my Word-Hearth twisted east, toward the sealed peak.
household:1.line: 'A *household* that tends its Word-Hearth each dawn will never lose its place on the mountain,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Each *household* in the outer court of the sect had its own Word-Hearth, a small stone basin where daily practice words were burned at dawn.
I lit mine alone that first morning, watching the smoke rise in careful spirals, and felt for the first time that I might truly belong somewhere above the clouds.
sentences.cn: 第一个清晨我独自点燃了我的字炉，看着烟雾升起，盘旋着，我第一次真切地感到自己或许真的能属于云之上的某个地方。

luxury:1.en: Shen Wujiu laughed when he saw me copying the same formula for the fifth time. 'Doubt is a *luxury* for disciples who have not yet stood at the cloud edge,' he said, not unkindly. I set down my brush, looked at the horizon where sky and cloud met in silence, and copied the formula a sixth time, without doubt.
luxury:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，犹豫不决是一种我们负担不起的____。
luxury:1.hook: At the cloud edge, the horizon cracked open like a page being turned.
luxury:1.line: 'Hesitation is a *luxury* we cannot carry when the words begin to move on their own,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu laughed when he saw me copying the same formula for the fifth time.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎看到我第五次誊写同一个符咒时笑了。

sentences.en: 'Doubt is a *luxury* for disciples who have not yet stood at the cloud edge,' he said, not unkindly.
I set down my brush, looked at the horizon where sky and cloud met in silence, and copied the formula a sixth time, without doubt.
sentences.cn: 我放下毛笔，望向天空与云交汇的地平线，沉默地誊写了第六遍符咒，没有半分疑虑。

analysis:1.en: At the edge of the outer courtyard, where wind carried the scent of cloud-moss, I spread my notes across a flat stone. Master Qingwu had taught us that every word-herb held a hidden structure. My *analysis* of the word 'rise' showed three root strokes — each one a step toward flight. Shen Wujiu watched in silence, then nodded once.
analysis:1.cnHint: 我在庭院边对一个词语进行____，发现了它隐藏的飞升之力。
analysis:1.hook: But the third stroke had begun to glow on its own.
analysis:1.line: 'Your *analysis* of that word is more complete than mine was at your stage,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

sentences.en: At the edge of the outer courtyard, where wind carried the scent of cloud-moss, I spread my notes across a flat stone.
sentences.cn: 在外院边缘，风吹来云苔的香气，我把笔记铺在一块平石上。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had taught us that every word-herb held a hidden structure.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊教过我们，每一株字草都藏着隐秘的结构。

sentences.en: My *analysis* of the word 'rise' showed three root strokes — each one a step toward flight.
Shen Wujiu watched in silence, then nodded once.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎无声地看着，然后点了一次头。

application:1.en: The sect's notice board stood at the mountain gate, its wooden surface worn smooth by a thousand hands. I pressed my *application* — a single paper folded around a sprig of cloud-moss — into the waiting slot. It was a request to study the advanced word 'ascend.' Xiaoxing stood beside me, her own paper already gone.
application:1.cnHint: 我在山门布告栏提交了一份学习高阶词语的____。
application:1.hook: A thin line of gold light sealed the slot shut the moment my paper entered.
application:1.line: 'An *application* without a spiritual herb inside will not be read,' Xiaoxing warned me gently.

sentences.en: The sect's notice board stood at the mountain gate, its wooden surface worn smooth by a thousand hands.
sentences.cn: 宗派的告示板立在山门口，木面被千万只手摩得光滑。

sentences.en: I pressed my *application* — a single paper folded around a sprig of cloud-moss — into the waiting slot.
It was a request to study the advanced word 'ascend.'
sentences.cn: 这是一份关于学习高阶字"升"的申请。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stood beside me, her own paper already gone.
sentences.cn: 小杏站在我身旁，她自己的纸已经递出去了。

living:1.en: Master Qingwu led us along the outer ridge path at dawn. Below, the sea of clouds rolled like slow breath. She said that every *living* thing on these mountains — moss, bird, disciple — drew its strength from words spoken at the right moment. I wrote the word 'breathe' on my palm and felt a faint warmth rise.
living:1.cnHint: 师尊说，山上每一个有____的事物都从正确的词语中汲取力量。
living:1.hook: Then the clouds below us stopped moving entirely.
living:1.line: 'Every *living* creature on this peak has already mastered one word without knowing it,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us along the outer ridge path at dawn.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在黎明时分领我们沿着外院的山脊小路走去。

sentences.en: Below, the sea of clouds rolled like slow breath.
sentences.cn: 下方，云海翻滚着，如缓缓的呼吸。

sentences.en: She said that every *living* thing on these mountains — moss, bird, disciple — drew its strength from words spoken at the right moment.
I wrote the word 'breathe' on my palm and felt a faint warmth rise.
sentences.cn: 我在手心写下"呼吸"二字，感到一阵微弱的温热升起。

proposal:1.en: By the stone table near the lower path, the four outer disciples gathered to plan the word-harvest. Shen Wujiu unrolled a small map and outlined his *proposal*: we would each collect one rare word-herb from a different ridge before the evening bell. The idea was clean and fair. Everyone agreed — almost everyone.
proposal:1.cnHint: 师兄在石桌旁提出了一个关于采集词草的____，大家几乎都同意了。
proposal:1.hook: I noticed one name missing from the ridge assignments on the map.
proposal:1.line: 'My *proposal* keeps us separated, which means each of us faces the ridge alone,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: By the stone table near the lower path, the four outer disciples gathered to plan the word-harvest.
sentences.cn: 在下路边的石桌旁，四位外院弟子聚在一起筹划字草的采集。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a small map and outlined his *proposal*: we would each collect one rare word-herb from a different ridge before the evening bell.
The idea was clean and fair.
sentences.cn: 这个办法简洁而公平。

sentences.en: Everyone agreed — almost everyone.
sentences.cn: 几乎所有人都同意了。

relevant:1.en: The outer library wall was covered in carved word-lists, but not all of them applied to a first-year disciple. Xiaoxing ran her finger along the rows and circled only what was *relevant* to our current lesson — words of wind and lift, not yet fire or depth. Her choices were careful and right. I copied her circles into my own notes.
relevant:1.cnHint: 师妹只圈出了与我们当前功课____的词语，没有浪费时间在其他内容上。
relevant:1.hook: One word she had skipped was circled in faint red by an unknown hand.
relevant:1.line: 'Copy only what is *relevant* to the lesson — the rest will mislead you,' Xiaoxing said firmly.

sentences.en: The outer library wall was covered in carved word-lists, but not all of them applied to a first-year disciple.
sentences.cn: 外院图书室的墙上刻满了字表，但不是所有的都适用于一年级弟子。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing ran her finger along the rows and circled only what was *relevant* to our current lesson — words of wind and lift, not yet fire or depth.
Her choices were careful and right.
sentences.cn: 她的选择谨慎而得当。

sentences.en: I copied her circles into my own notes.
sentences.cn: 我把她圈出的字都抄进了我自己的笔记里。

senior:1.en: On the stone steps outside the main hall, I met a disciple I did not recognise. His robe was a deeper blue than mine. Shen Wujiu appeared beside me and bowed slightly, explaining in a low voice that every *senior* of the sect had earned that deeper colour through three completed word-trials. I straightened without thinking.
