seemingly:1.line: 'The mountain is *seemingly* still, but its roots have not stopped moving,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从殿里走了出来，抬头看了一眼，什么也没有说。

therefore:1.en: The outer courtyard of Cloud Sea Sect lay open to the sky, its stone paths swept clean by morning wind. Master Qingwu traced a word-formula in the air above the practice ground. sentences.en: Xiaoxing had failed the breathing trial three mornings in a row.
sentences.cn: 小杏连续三个早晨都没通过呼吸试炼。

sentences.en: On the fourth, she stood at the cliff's edge and watched a cloud slowly take the shape of a word she did not yet know.
sentences.cn: 第四天，她站在悬崖边，看着一朵云慢慢变成她还不认识的词形。

sentences.en: Something about its quiet movement seemed to *inspire* her, and she drew a clean breath at last.
The word dissolved before she could name it.
sentences.cn: 词在她能说出名字前就消散了。

narrow:1.en: The trial path behind the waterfall was barely wide enough for one person. I pressed against the wet stone wall, each step careful. Shen Wujiu had warned me that the *narrow* passage would test not my body but my focus — and he was right. Three words lit up in the rock as I passed.
narrow:1.cnHint: 瀑布后面的小径十分____，师兄说它考验的不是身体，而是专注力。
narrow:1.hook: The third word on the stone wall pulsed once and then went dark.
narrow:1.line: 'A *narrow* path asks more of your mind than your feet — remember that.'

sentences.en: The trial path behind the waterfall was barely wide enough for one person.
sentences.cn: 瀑布后的试炼路几乎只能容一个人通过。

sentences.en: I pressed against the wet stone wall, each step careful.
sentences.cn: 我紧贴着湿润的石墙，每一步都很小心。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu had warned me that the *narrow* passage would test not my body but my focus — and he was right.
Three words lit up in the rock as I passed.
sentences.cn: 我经过时，岩石里亮起了三个词。

quantity:1.en: Master Qingwu laid out the morning lesson in the open courtyard under pale sky. 'Do not be fooled,' she said, placing one small herb beside a great pile of lesser ones. 'The *quantity* of words you hold means nothing without the depth to use them.' Xiaoxing nodded. A cold wind moved through the pile and scattered it.
quantity:1.cnHint: 师尊告诫弟子们，掌握字草的____多少并不重要，关键在于运用的深度。
quantity:1.hook: One herb remained in place after all the others had blown away.
quantity:1.line: 'A great *quantity* of weak words will not carry you one step into the sky.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu laid out the morning lesson in the open courtyard under pale sky.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在淡色天空下的开放院子里铺开了上午的课程。

sentences.en: 'Do not be fooled,' she said, placing one small herb beside a great pile of lesser ones.
sentences.cn: "别被骗了，"她说，在一大堆次等词根旁放下一个小小的词根。

sentences.en: 'The *quantity* of words you hold means nothing without the depth to use them.'
Xiaoxing nodded.
sentences.cn: 小杏点了点头。

sentences.en: A cold wind moved through the pile and scattered it.
sentences.cn: 一阵冷风吹过那堆词根，把它们吹散了。

sustainable:1.en: The old disciple had consumed fifty rare word-herbs in a single week and risen fast. But Shen Wujiu shook his head as we watched from the outer path. 'Fast growth fed by too much is never *sustainable*,' he said. 'The roots have to hold.' Three days later, the disciple could not speak a single word.
sustainable:1.cnHint: 一位弟子短期内消耗大量字草后迅速提升，但师兄说这种方式是不____的。
sustainable:1.hook: At dusk, the disciple's hand reached for a herb and found only air.
sustainable:1.line: 'Only growth with strong roots is *sustainable* — speed alone will hollow you out.'

sentences.en: The old disciple had consumed fifty rare word-herbs in a single week and risen fast.
sentences.cn: 那个老弟子在一周内吸收了五十个稀有词根，进步很快。

sentences.en: But Shen Wujiu shook his head as we watched from the outer path.
sentences.cn: 但我们从外道看着时，沈无咎摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'Fast growth fed by too much is never *sustainable*,' he said.
'The roots have to hold.'
sentences.cn: "根须得扎住才行。"

sentences.en: Three days later, the disciple could not speak a single word.
sentences.cn: 三天后，那个弟子说不出一个字了。

delay:1.en: The ascension trial was set for dawn. I reached the outer gate just as the bell struck, and Xiaoxing was already there, calm, prepared. 'Do not *delay* even by a breath,' she said softly, eyes on the sky. 'The word-wind opens once and will not wait.' We stepped forward together. The gate began to close behind us.
delay:1.cnHint: 升仙试炼在黎明开始，师妹提醒我不要____哪怕一息，字风只开放一次。
delay:1.hook: The gate closed fully before the echo of the bell had faded.
delay:1.line: 'Do not *delay* — the word-wind opens once and will not return for us.'

sentences.en: The ascension trial was set for dawn.
sentences.cn: 升仙试炼定在黎明时分。

sentences.en: I reached the outer gate just as the bell struck, and Xiaoxing was already there, calm, prepared.
sentences.cn: 钟声敲响时我刚好赶到外门，小杏已经在那里了，镇定自若，准备就绪。

sentences.en: 'Do not *delay* even by a breath,' she said softly, eyes on the sky.
'The word-wind opens once and will not wait.'
sentences.cn: "词风只开一次，不会等人。"

sentences.en: We stepped forward together.
sentences.cn: 我们一起向前走去。

sentences.en: The gate began to close behind us.
sentences.cn: 身后的门开始关闭。

store:1.en: At the base of the outer peak, a small *store* sold bundles of dried spirit-grass and ink sticks carved with living words. I spent my last copper coin on a single stalk of Breath-Easing Herb, hoping it would steady my qi before the entrance trial. The old keeper wrapped it in reed paper without a word, then stared at the sky a beat too long.
store:1.cnHint: 我在山脚的____买了一株稳气草，准备应对入门考验。
store:1.hook: Behind me, the keeper whispered a word I did not yet know.
store:1.line: 'This *store* holds herbs that have waited a hundred years for the right hand.'

sentences.en: At the base of the outer peak, a small *store* sold bundles of dried spirit-grass and ink sticks carved with living words.
I spent my last copper coin on a single stalk of Breath-Easing Herb, hoping it would steady my qi before the entrance trial.
sentences.cn: 我用最后一枚铜币买了一根安气草，希望它能在入门试炼前稳定我的气。

sentences.en: The old keeper wrapped it in reed paper without a word, then stared at the sky a beat too long.
sentences.cn: 那个老店主用芦苇纸无言地包好了它，然后盯着天空看了太长一拍。

budget:1.en: Shen Wujiu spread a worn scroll across the stone table and traced each column with one finger. 'Every disciple receives a monthly *budget* of spirit points,' he said, 'enough for two lessons or one mid-grade herb, never both.' I counted my own allotment and felt the weight of each choice settle on my shoulders like a second robe.
budget:1.cnHint: 师兄向我解释，每位弟子每月的____只够选择两件事情之一。
budget:1.hook: At the bottom of the scroll, one name had been crossed out in red ink.
budget:1.line: 'Guard your *budget* well — spirit points spent in haste leave the mind hollow.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread a worn scroll across the stone table and traced each column with one finger.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在石桌上铺开一张破旧的卷轴，用一根手指描过每一栏。

sentences.en: 'Every disciple receives a monthly *budget* of spirit points,' he said, 'enough for two lessons or one mid-grade herb, never both.'
I counted my own allotment and felt the weight of each choice settle on my shoulders like a second robe.
sentences.cn: 我算了算自己的配额，感觉每个选择都像第二件袍子一样压在我肩上。

grant:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the cliff's edge and held out a small jade slip. 'I *grant* you the right to enter the Word Garden for one hour,' she said, her voice as level as still water. Inside that garden, every petal was a syllable; every root, a rule of grammar. I took the slip with both hands, feeling it hum against my palms.
grant:1.cnHint: 师尊把进入词语园的权限____给了我，那里的每朵花都是一个音节。
grant:1.hook: The slip grew warm the moment the garden gate swung open.
grant:1.line: 'I *grant* this to you once — prove the hour was not wasted.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the cliff's edge and held out a small jade slip.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在悬崖边缘，递出一块小玉简。

sentences.en: 'I *grant* you the right to enter the Word Garden for one hour,' she said, her voice as level as still water.
Inside that garden, every petal was a syllable; every root, a rule of grammar.
sentences.cn: 在那个花园里，每一片花瓣都是一个音节；每一条根须，都是语法的规则。

sentences.en: I took the slip with both hands, feeling it hum against my palms.
sentences.cn: 我用双手接过玉简，感觉它在我掌心嗡鸣。

hospital:1.en: Near the market terrace of Cloud Foot Town, a low building bore a sign that read Hall of Mending Words. Xiaoxing called it the sect's *hospital*, a place where healers pressed written formulas onto wounds and read diagnoses aloud until the body listened. I paused at its open door and heard soft chanting drift out like smoke on a windless day.
hospital:1.cnHint: 小星告诉我，云脚镇的那栋低矮建筑是宗门的____，医者用书写符文来治伤。
hospital:1.hook: One of the chants cut off mid-syllable, and silence rushed in to fill the gap.
hospital:1.line: 'The *hospital* never turns away a disciple who carries an unfinished word.'

sentences.en: Near the market terrace of Cloud Foot Town, a low building bore a sign that read Hall of Mending Words.
sentences.cn: 在云脚镇的市集台附近，一座低矮的建筑挂着"补字堂"的招牌。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing called it the sect's *hospital*, a place where healers pressed written formulas onto wounds and read diagnoses aloud until the body listened.
I paused at its open door and heard soft chanting drift out like smoke on a windless day.
sentences.cn: 我在敞开的门前停下，听见柔和的诵经声像无风之日的烟雾一样飘出来。

island:1.en: From the outer terrace I could see a lone floating peak drifting far from the main range, wreathed in white mist. Shen Wujiu called it the Ink *Island*, a platform of black rock where advanced disciples went alone to write their final thesis word in full view of the open sky. No bridge connected it; you reached it only by flight.
island:1.cnHint: 师兄指着远处孤悬的山峰，说那座____是高阶弟子独自前往书写毕业符文的地方。
island:1.hook: Even as we watched, the Ink Island began, very slowly, to rise.
island:1.line: 'No one returns from that *island* the same person who left.'

sentences.en: From the outer terrace I could see a lone floating peak drifting far from the main range, wreathed in white mist.
sentences.cn: 从外层台看，我能看见一座孤立的浮峰远离主山脉而去，缠绕在白色的雾气里。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu called it the Ink *Island*, a platform of black rock where advanced disciples went alone to write their final thesis word in full view of the open sky.
No bridge connected it; you reached it only by flight.
sentences.cn: 没有桥连接它；你只能通过飞行才能到达。

native:1.en: Master Qingwu asked each of us to speak one word in our *native* tongue before learning its written form. She said the sound a word makes at home carries the first breath of its meaning, and without that breath the formula remains a dead shell. When my turn came, I spoke a single syllable from my village dialect and felt the air around me shiver.
native:1.cnHint: 师尊让我们用____语言说出一个词，她说母语中的发音藏着词语意义的第一口气息。
native:1.hook: My syllable hung in the air longer than anyone else's had.
native:1.line: 'Your *native* tongue is the root; every other word you learn is a branch.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu asked each of us to speak one word in our *native* tongue before learning its written form.
She said the sound a word makes at home carries the first breath of its meaning, and without that breath the formula remains a dead shell.
sentences.cn: 她说一个词在家乡发出的声音承载着它意义的第一口气息，没有这口气的咒语就成了死壳。

sentences.en: When my turn came, I spoke a single syllable from my village dialect and felt the air around me shiver.
sentences.cn: 轮到我时，我用村里的方言说了一个单音，感觉周围的空气颤动了。

tradition:1.en: The Cloud Sea Sect had one unbroken *tradition*: on the first morning of each season, every disciple — from newest to eldest — wrote the same foundational word together on the open plaza. The brushstrokes rose as pale smoke and joined above the rooftops into a single column that pointed, always, toward the highest peak.
tradition:1.cnHint: 云海宗有一个世代相传的____：每季第一天，所有弟子在广场上共同书写同一个基础符文。
tradition:1.hook: This season, the smoke column bent west for the first time in living memory.
tradition:1.line: '*Tradition* is not habit — it is a promise the sect makes to the sky each season.'

sentences.en: The Cloud Sea Sect had one unbroken *tradition*: on the first morning of each season, every disciple — from newest to eldest — wrote the same foundational word together on the open plaza.
The brushstrokes rose as pale smoke and joined above the rooftops into a single column that pointed, always, toward the highest peak.
sentences.cn: 笔画升起如淡烟，汇聚在屋顶上方，形成一根始终指向最高峰顶的单独烟柱。

africa:1.en: A travelling scholar had crossed half the world from a place she called *Africa*, where spiritual words grew in red soil and were sung rather than written. She set up a stall on the outer plaza, offering one lesson in exchange for a local herb. I traded my last sprig of Cloud Mint and learned that the same word for 'wind' existed in her tongue and mine, shaped differently but meaning the same sky.
africa:1.cnHint: 一位从____远道而来的学者在广场摆摊，用一堂课换取本地草药，我因此发现两种语言里"风"字意思相同。
africa:1.hook: As she packed her stall, a gust lifted every paper on the plaza at once.
africa:1.line: 'In *Africa*, we sing a word until the sky agrees to carry it.'

sentences.en: A travelling scholar had crossed half the world from a place she called *Africa*, where spiritual words grew in red soil and were sung rather than written.
She set up a stall on the outer plaza, offering one lesson in exchange for a local herb.
sentences.cn: 她在外广场摆了一个摊位，用一堂课换取当地的草药。

sentences.en: I traded my last sprig of Cloud Mint and learned that the same word for 'wind' existed in her tongue and mine, shaped differently but meaning the same sky.
sentences.cn: 我用最后一枝云薄荷换来了这个知识：在她的舌头和我的舌头里，同一个"风"字存在着，形状不同但指向同一片天空。

teenager:1.en: On the lower platform of White Crane Peak, a *teenager* no older than sixteen stood before the Sect gate, a worn herb-sack on his back. Master Qingwu studied the boy with quiet eyes. 'The mountains choose the willing,' she said softly. A single white feather drifted down and landed in the boy's open palm.
teenager:1.cnHint: 一个少年站在宗门外，师尊静静地打量他，一根白羽无风而落。
teenager:1.line: 'A *teenager* with such roots — the clouds themselves leaned in to look.'

sentences.en: On the lower platform of White Crane Peak, a *teenager* no older than sixteen stood before the Sect gate, a worn herb-sack on his back.
Master Qingwu studied the boy with quiet eyes.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用沉静的眼神打量那男孩。

sentences.en: 'The mountains choose the willing,' she said softly.
sentences.cn: "山峰选择愿意者，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: A single white feather drifted down and landed in the boy's open palm.
sentences.cn: 一根白羽毛飘落下来，落在男孩张开的掌心。

patient:1.en: Shen Wujiu sat beneath the Stone Breath Pine for the third morning in a row, cross-legged and still. 'You must be *patient*,' Master Qingwu had told him — each breath a seed, each silence a root. Far below, the sea of clouds shifted. Something large was rising through it.
patient:1.cnHint: 师兄在松树下静坐三日，师尊叮嘱他要____，而云海之下似有巨物正在升起。
patient:1.hook: The pine needles all turned toward the east at once.
patient:1.line: 'Be *patient*, or the word-herb will close before you can name it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu sat beneath the Stone Breath Pine for the third morning in a row, cross-legged and still.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎第三个清晨坐在石息松下，双腿盘起，纹丝不动。

sentences.en: 'You must be *patient*,' Master Qingwu had told him — each breath a seed, each silence a root.
Far below, the sea of clouds shifted.
sentences.cn: 远下方，云海翻涌。

sentences.en: Something large was rising through it.
sentences.cn: 什么庞大的东西正从云里升起。

classroom:1.en: The outer disciples called the flat stone terrace the open *classroom*, for Master Qingwu taught there whenever the wind was right. Xiaoxing knelt at its edge, copying a healing formula onto bark paper. The ink shone green, then faded. Somewhere above, thunder rolled across a sky without a single cloud.
classroom:1.cnHint: 师妹在露天____里抄写治愈法诀，墨迹泛绿后消失，无云的天空却传来雷声。
classroom:1.hook: The bark paper crumbled to fine silver ash.
classroom:1.line: 'This *classroom* has no walls — the wind grades every word you write.'

sentences.en: The outer disciples called the flat stone terrace the open *classroom*, for Master Qingwu taught there whenever the wind was right.
Xiaoxing knelt at its edge, copying a healing formula onto bark paper.
sentences.cn: 小杏跪在它的边缘，在树皮纸上抄写一个治愈咒语。

sentences.en: The ink shone green, then faded.
sentences.cn: 墨水闪闪发绿，然后褪去。

sentences.en: Somewhere above, thunder rolled across a sky without a single cloud.
sentences.cn: 某处上方，一声雷鸣滚过无云的天空。

vehicle:1.en: The flying lotus-disk was the Sect's oldest *vehicle*, wide enough for four disciples and carved with words that kept it aloft. Shen Wujiu steered it low over the outer mountains, searching for a missing herb. Xiaoxing gripped the rim. Below, a valley they had never seen before blinked into view.
vehicle:1.cnHint: 师兄驾驶宗门最古老的飞行____在外山搜寻药草，师妹握紧边沿，一个从未见过的山谷骤然出现。
vehicle:1.hook: The carved words on the disk had rearranged themselves.
vehicle:1.line: 'This *vehicle* only flies where the clouds are willing to be parted.'

sentences.en: The flying lotus-disk was the Sect's oldest *vehicle*, wide enough for four disciples and carved with words that kept it aloft.
Shen Wujiu steered it low over the outer mountains, searching for a missing herb.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎驾驶飞行莲盘低掠过外山，搜寻一株失踪的草药。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing gripped the rim.
sentences.cn: 小杏紧紧握住边缘。

sentences.en: Below, a valley they had never seen before blinked into view.
sentences.cn: 下方，一个他们从未见过的山谷在视野里闪现。

remote:1.en: The assignment was simple: gather frost-moss from a *remote* ridge three peaks to the north, where no disciple had climbed in a generation. I set out at dawn, the air thinning with every step. By midday the path vanished. By afternoon, I heard breathing that was not my own.
remote:1.cnHint: 我独自前往北边____的山脊采集霜苔，路途渐失，午后却听见不属于自己的呼吸声。
remote:1.hook: Two pale lights rose slowly above the nearest boulder.
remote:1.line: 'The most *remote* places keep the oldest words — and the oldest hungers.'

sentences.en: The assignment was simple: gather frost-moss from a *remote* ridge three peaks to the north, where no disciple had climbed in a generation.
I set out at dawn, the air thinning with every step.
sentences.cn: 我在黎明时出发，每走一步空气就变得稀薄。

sentences.en: By midday the path vanished.
sentences.cn: 到了中午，小路消失了。

sentences.en: By afternoon, I heard breathing that was not my own.
sentences.cn: 到了下午，我听到了不是我自己的呼吸声。

zoo:1.en: Disciples sometimes joked that the Sect's beast-garden was a *zoo* with clouds for fences. I did not laugh today. One of the spirit-cranes was gone — collar left behind, gate still locked. Master Qingwu knelt and pressed two fingers to the empty perch, her expression unreadable.
zoo:1.cnHint: 宗门兽苑被弟子们戏称为____，然而今日一只灵鹤失踪，师尊神情难辨。
zoo:1.hook: The collar was cold, but the perch beneath it was scorched.
zoo:1.line: 'A *zoo* built on clouds has doors that open from the inside, too.'

sentences.en: Disciples sometimes joked that the Sect's beast-garden was a *zoo* with clouds for fences.
I did not laugh today.
sentences.cn: 今天我没有笑。

sentences.en: One of the spirit-cranes was gone — collar left behind, gate still locked.
sentences.cn: 其中一只灵鹤消失了——项圈留下，大门仍然上锁。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu knelt and pressed two fingers to the empty perch, her expression unreadable.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊跪下，把两根手指压在空荡荡的栖木上，表情莫测。

card:1.en: Each disciple received a pale jade *card* at the start of the season, engraved with their spirit-name. Mine had begun to grow warm at strange hours. Shen Wujiu glanced at it and said nothing, but his jaw tightened. Near the gate, Xiaoxing's card had already cracked clean in two.
card:1.cnHint: 每位弟子都持有刻着灵名的玉____，小星的那块已然断裂，我的却开始在奇异时刻发热。
card:1.hook: A thin line of smoke rose from Xiaoxing's broken pieces.
card:1.line: 'When a *card* cracks before the season ends, the mountain is sending a warning.'

sentences.en: Each disciple received a pale jade *card* at the start of the season, engraved with their spirit-name.
Mine had begun to grow warm at strange hours.
sentences.cn: 我的那张开始在奇怪的时刻变得炙热。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu glanced at it and said nothing, but his jaw tightened.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎瞥了一眼，什么都没说，但他的下颌绷紧了。

sentences.en: Near the gate, Xiaoxing's card had already cracked clean in two.
sentences.cn: 靠近大门的地方，小杏的玉牌已经干干净净地裂成两截。

gene:1.en: Master Qingwu said that the gift for word-herbs was not luck — it lived in the blood, a *gene* passed down like the shape of a nose or the colour of an eye. I had inherited mine from a grandmother I never met. On the cliff wall, her name was still faintly carved.
gene:1.cnHint: 师尊说操控词草的天赋如同____一般流传于血脉之中，我从未谋面的祖母将它留给了我。
gene:1.hook: Her carved name began to glow the moment I touched it.
gene:1.line: 'A *gene* for the clouds does not sleep — it waits for the right mountain.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said that the gift for word-herbs was not luck — it lived in the blood, a *gene* passed down like the shape of a nose or the colour of an eye.
I had inherited mine from a grandmother I never met.
sentences.cn: 我从一个素未谋面的祖母那里继承了我的天赋。

sentences.en: On the cliff wall, her name was still faintly carved.
sentences.cn: 在悬崖壁上，她的名字仍然隐约刻着。

artificial:1.en: On the outer terrace, rows of stone lanterns glowed with a cold blue light. Shen Wujiu frowned. 'These flames feed on spirit stones, not the sky,' he said. The light was *artificial*, made by human hands, and it could not guide a true ascension. Above us, real stars waited in silence.
artificial:1.cnHint: 石灯台上的蓝色火焰是____的，无法指引真正的飞升之路。
artificial:1.hook: Then one lantern went dark, and something moved behind it.
artificial:1.line: 'This *artificial* light will fool no spirit that watches from above.'

sentences.en: On the outer terrace, rows of stone lanterns glowed with a cold blue light.
sentences.cn: 外露台上，一排石灯笼闪烁着冰冷的蓝光。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu frowned.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎皱起眉头。

sentences.en: 'These flames feed on spirit stones, not the sky,' he said.
sentences.cn: "这些火焰以灵石为食，不是天空，"他说。

sentences.en: The light was *artificial*, made by human hands, and it could not guide a true ascension.
Above us, real stars waited in silence.
sentences.cn: 在我们上方，真正的星辰在沉默中等待。

confirm:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a scroll on the open courtyard stone and pressed her seal upon it. 'I must *confirm* your name before the mountain gate opens,' she said. The characters on the scroll shimmered, then turned gold. Around us, wind rose from the valley far below, carrying the cold smell of cloud.
confirm:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在卷轴上盖印，____我们的名字，山门方能开启。
confirm:1.hook: The last name on the scroll had already been crossed out.
confirm:1.line: 'Step forward so I can *confirm* your spirit root before dawn.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a scroll on the open courtyard stone and pressed her seal upon it.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在露天石台上展开一卷文书，按下了她的印章。

sentences.en: 'I must *confirm* your name before the mountain gate opens,' she said.
The characters on the scroll shimmered, then turned gold.
sentences.cn: 纸上的字迹闪烁了一下，然后转成了金色。

sentences.en: Around us, wind rose from the valley far below, carrying the cold smell of cloud.
sentences.cn: 四周，下方谷地吹起一阵风，带来云的冰冷气息。

context:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a fragment of ancient text, but the words made no sense alone. 'Read it in *context*,' he said, pointing to the stone wall behind the gate, where older lines were carved in rows. Only together did they form the formula for flight. The full mountain seemed to breathe.
context:1.cnHint: 石壁上的古文需要联系____才能读懂飞升的法诀。
context:1.hook: One carved line had been chiselled away, and no one knew when.
context:1.line: 'Without *context*, that formula is just noise on old stone.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a fragment of ancient text, but the words made no sense alone.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一段古籍残片，但那些字单独看没有任何意义。

sentences.en: 'Read it in *context*,' he said, pointing to the stone wall behind the gate, where older lines were carved in rows.
Only together did they form the formula for flight.
sentences.cn: 只有把它们放在一起，才能组成飞行的公式。

sentences.en: The full mountain seemed to breathe.
sentences.cn: 整座山仿佛都在呼吸。

date:1.en: Carved into the arch of the outer gate was a single *date*: the seventh day of the ninth month. Xiaoxing traced the numbers with one finger. 'Every disciple who ascended left on this day,' she whispered. The clouds below the mountain were unusually still, as if the sky itself remembered.
date:1.cnHint: 山门拱石上刻着一个____，记录着每位飞升弟子离去的时日。
date:1.hook: Today was the seventh day of the ninth month.
date:1.line: 'Mark the *date* well — the mountain does not give a second chance.'

sentences.en: Carved into the arch of the outer gate was a single *date*: the seventh day of the ninth month.
Xiaoxing traced the numbers with one finger.
sentences.cn: 小杏用一根手指描过那些数字。

sentences.en: 'Every disciple who ascended left on this day,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "每个飞升的弟子都在这天离开，"她低声说。

sentences.en: The clouds below the mountain were unusually still, as if the sky itself remembered.
sentences.cn: 山下的云层异常静谧，仿佛天空本身都记得。

flexible:1.en: The bridge between the two outer peaks was made of woven cloud-root, thin and pale. Xiaoxing stepped onto it without fear. 'It holds because it is *flexible*,' she said, and indeed it bent gently with each gust, never breaking. I followed, watching the sea of clouds churn far below my feet.
flexible:1.cnHint: 两峰之间的云根桥因____而不断弯曲，却从不折断。
flexible:1.hook: A sound like tearing silk rose from somewhere underneath the bridge.
flexible:1.line: 'Stay calm — a *flexible* path bends, but a steady heart does not.'

sentences.en: The bridge between the two outer peaks was made of woven cloud-root, thin and pale.
sentences.cn: 两座外峰之间的桥由编织的云根组成，纤细而苍白。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stepped onto it without fear.
sentences.cn: 小杏毫不畏惧地踏上了它。

sentences.en: 'It holds because it is *flexible*,' she said, and indeed it bent gently with each gust, never breaking.
I followed, watching the sea of clouds churn far below my feet.
sentences.cn: 我跟在后面，看着遥远脚下的云海翻腾。

fly:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the cliff's edge and released a single seed into the open air. We watched it *fly* on the wind, rising rather than falling, carried up by a current no one could see. 'That current is your road,' she said quietly. The seed vanished into brightness above the clouds.
fly:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊放出一粒种子，看它____入云端，为弟子指示飞升之路。
fly:1.hook: The current shifted, and the seed turned back toward the mountain.
fly:1.line: 'Watch how it *flies* — the wind reveals the path words cannot name.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the cliff's edge and released a single seed into the open air.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在悬崖边，释放了一粒种子进入开阔的空中。

sentences.en: We watched it *fly* on the wind, rising rather than falling, carried up by a current no one could see.
'That current is your road,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "那股气流就是你的路，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: The seed vanished into brightness above the clouds.
sentences.cn: 种子消失在云上的光亮中。

judge:1.en: At the outer examination stone, three elders sat in silence. Their task was to *judge* each disciple's readiness to attempt ascension. Shen Wujiu stood before them with calm eyes. I waited behind him, hearing only wind and the distant cry of some bird circling the highest peak. No one spoke.
judge:1.cnHint: 三位长老坐在考验石前，____每位弟子是否已有资格飞升。
judge:1.hook: The eldest elder closed her eyes and slowly shook her head.
judge:1.line: 'We do not *judge* your courage here — only whether the sky will accept you.'

sentences.en: At the outer examination stone, three elders sat in silence.
sentences.cn: 在外考石前，三位长老无言地坐着。

sentences.en: Their task was to *judge* each disciple's readiness to attempt ascension.
Shen Wujiu stood before them with calm eyes.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在他们面前，眼神平静。

sentences.en: I waited behind him, hearing only wind and the distant cry of some bird circling the highest peak.
sentences.cn: 我在他身后等待，只听得见风和远处某只鸟在最高峰盘旋的叫声。

sentences.en: No one spoke.
sentences.cn: 没有人说话。

oil:1.en: Before the ascension rite, Xiaoxing knelt and rubbed a few drops of golden *oil* into the cracks of the stone altar. 'It is pressed from cloud-lotus seeds,' she said softly. The altar began to warm under our hands. A thin mist rose from the mountain path below, curling upward like a question.
oil:1.cnHint: 小星将云莲种榨成的____涂抹在石坛裂缝中，祭坛随之散发温热。
oil:1.hook: The mist formed a shape, then the shape opened its eyes.
oil:1.line: 'A single drop of this *oil* can wake a stone that has slept for a century.'

sentences.en: Before the ascension rite, Xiaoxing knelt and rubbed a few drops of golden *oil* into the cracks of the stone altar.
'It is pressed from cloud-lotus seeds,' she said softly.
sentences.cn: "这是用云莲子压榨的，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: The altar began to warm under our hands.
sentences.cn: 祭坛在我们手掌下开始温热。

sentences.en: A thin mist rose from the mountain path below, curling upward like a question.
sentences.cn: 一缕细雾从下方山路升起，像一个疑问般蜷缩地向上卷。

passion:1.en: The outer courtyard of Cloud Sea Sect stretched wide under a pale sky. Disciples lined up to carve their first word-herb into stone tablets. My hand shook, but the *passion* I felt for each carved stroke steadied it. Master Qingwu walked the row, silent, pausing one breath too long at my tablet.
passion:1.cnHint: 弟子们在石碑上刻下第一个字草，我对每一笔的____让手不再颤抖。
passion:1.hook: Master Qingwu's sleeve caught the wind — and the carved word began to glow.
passion:1.line: 'Let your *passion* guide the chisel, or the stone will remember nothing.'

sentences.en: The outer courtyard of Cloud Sea Sect stretched wide under a pale sky.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的外院在苍白的天空下宽阔地伸展。

sentences.en: Disciples lined up to carve their first word-herb into stone tablets.
sentences.cn: 弟子们排队在石板上刻下他们的第一个词草。

sentences.en: My hand shook, but the *passion* I felt for each carved stroke steadied it.
Master Qingwu walked the row, silent, pausing one breath too long at my tablet.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊沿着队伍走过，无言，在我的石板前停顿得太久了一息。

temperature:1.en: Xiaoxing crouched beside the herb-flame brazier at the mountain gate, adjusting its feed of word-ash. 'The *temperature* must stay level,' she said, 'or the formula turns bitter and pulls cloud instead of parting it.' I held my hand above the flame and finally felt the difference.
temperature:1.cnHint: 小星在山门旁调节药焰，说____必须平稳，否则云诀会变得苦涩。
temperature:1.hook: A sudden cold gust swept the mountain — and the flame bent the wrong way.
temperature:1.line: 'If the *temperature* drops now, the whole morning's work is ash.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing crouched beside the herb-flame brazier at the mountain gate, adjusting its feed of word-ash.
sentences.cn: 小杏蹲在山门的词火炭盆旁，调整它的词灰进料。

sentences.en: 'The *temperature* must stay level,' she said, 'or the formula turns bitter and pulls cloud instead of parting it.'
I held my hand above the flame and finally felt the difference.
sentences.cn: 我把手放在火焰上方，终于感受到了那差异。

board:1.en: At the trailhead where the floating path began, a long cedar *board* bore the sect's first word-formula, burned deep into the grain by founders long gone. Shen Wujiu pressed his palm to it each morning as he passed. Today he stepped aside and gestured for me to do the same.
board:1.cnHint: 登山路口立着一块长木____，上面刻有云海宗开派时的第一道字诀。
board:1.hook: The moment my palm touched the wood, the grain lines rearranged themselves.
board:1.line: 'Every disciple must touch this *board* before they step onto the sky-path.'

sentences.en: At the trailhead where the floating path began, a long cedar *board* bore the sect's first word-formula, burned deep into the grain by founders long gone.
Shen Wujiu pressed his palm to it each morning as he passed.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎每天经过时都会把手掌按在上面。

sentences.en: Today he stepped aside and gestured for me to do the same.
sentences.cn: 今天他向一旁让开，示意我也这样做。

handle:1.en: The word-blade Master Qingwu placed before me looked plain — worn leather wrap, no ornament. But the *handle* held a single character pressed into the stitching: the root-word for flight. My fingers closed around it and the air thinned, as though the sky leaned in to listen.
handle:1.cnHint: 师尊放在我面前的字刃看起来朴素，但____处藏着"飞"的字根。
handle:1.hook: The character in the stitching began to warm against my palm.
handle:1.line: 'Keep your grip on the *handle* loose — the word inside needs room to breathe.'

sentences.en: The word-blade Master Qingwu placed before me looked plain — worn leather wrap, no ornament.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊摆在我面前的词刀看起来很普通——磨损的皮革缠绕，没有装饰。

sentences.en: But the *handle* held a single character pressed into the stitching: the root-word for flight.
My fingers closed around it and the air thinned, as though the sky leaned in to listen.
sentences.cn: 我的手指合拢在它上面，空气变薄了，仿佛天空俯身来倾听。

ideal:1.en: Shen Wujiu drew the ascent diagram on the courtyard stone with a stick of white chalk: seven steps, clean arcs, no wasted movement. 'This is the *ideal* path,' he said, 'drawn by those who rose before us.' I studied each arc until I could close my eyes and still see them.
ideal:1.cnHint: 沈无咎用白粉笔画出飞升图，说这是前辈留下的____路径。
ideal:1.hook: One of the chalk arcs smudged on its own, shifting toward a longer, harder line.
ideal:1.line: 'The *ideal* path is drawn in chalk — reality writes it in something harder.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu drew the ascent diagram on the courtyard stone with a stick of white chalk: seven steps, clean arcs, no wasted movement.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎用白粉笔在院子的石头上画出上升图：七个步骤，干净的弧线，没有浪费的动作。

sentences.en: 'This is the *ideal* path,' he said, 'drawn by those who rose before us.'
I studied each arc until I could close my eyes and still see them.
sentences.cn: 我研究了每一道弧线，直到闭上眼睛还能看见它们。

ride:1.en: The cloud-skiff at the sect's lower dock was barely wide enough for two. Shen Wujiu steadied it with one word spoken softly, then offered a hand. The *ride* from the lower dock to the mid-peak took less than a breath, yet I arrived feeling the whole sky had passed through me.
ride:1.cnHint: 云舟停在宗门下码头，从那里到中峰的____只有一息之遥，却让人感觉穿越了整片天空。
ride:1.hook: At the mid-peak landing, a single white feather drifted up — not down.
ride:1.line: 'Your first *ride* above the cloud-line will change the way you hear words.'

sentences.en: The cloud-skiff at the sect's lower dock was barely wide enough for two.
sentences.cn: 宗门下码头的云舟窄得只能勉强容下两个人。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu steadied it with one word spoken softly, then offered a hand.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎轻声说了一个字稳住它，然后伸出手。

sentences.en: The *ride* from the lower dock to the mid-peak took less than a breath, yet I arrived feeling the whole sky had passed through me.

adjust:1.en: Master Qingwu watched me attempt the lift-word for the third time. My footing was wrong, she said nothing, only drew a line in the air with one finger. I understood: I had to *adjust* my stance so the word could travel from my feet upward rather than scattering at the knee.
adjust:1.cnHint: 师尊用一根手指在空中画了一条线，提示我需要____站姿，让字诀从脚底向上贯通。
adjust:1.hook: When I shifted my heel by one inch, the courtyard flagstones hummed.
adjust:1.line: '*Adjust* your weight before you speak the word, or the sky will not catch you.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched me attempt the lift-word for the third time.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊看我第三次尝试那个提升词。

sentences.en: My footing was wrong, she said nothing, only drew a line in the air with one finger.
sentences.cn: 我的站位不对，她什么都没说，只用一根手指在空中划了一条线。

sentences.en: I understood: I had to *adjust* my stance so the word could travel from my feet upward rather than scattering at the knee.

basis:1.en: On the stone pillar at the mountain gate, the founding rule was carved in letters worn smooth by rain: master the root-words first. Shen Wujiu read it aloud as we passed. 'That line,' he said, 'is the *basis* of every formula this sect has ever raised into the air.'
basis:1.cnHint: 山门石柱上刻着建派戒律，沈无咎说那句话是宗门一切字诀的____。
basis:1.hook: Below the carved rule, a crack had opened overnight — spelling a word no one recognized.
basis:1.line: 'Root-words are the *basis* — skip them and your formulas are beautiful lies.'

sentences.en: On the stone pillar at the mountain gate, the founding rule was carved in letters worn smooth by rain: master the root-words first.
sentences.cn: 山门的石柱上刻着创派规则，被雨水磨得光滑：先掌握根词。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu read it aloud as we passed.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎经过时把它念了出来。

sentences.en: 'That line,' he said, 'is the *basis* of every formula this sect has ever raised into the air.'

relative:1.en: The mountain path split into two at the stone gate. Shen Wujiu studied both routes in silence. 'The danger of each road is *relative*,' he said at last, 'depending on which words you have already learned to carry.' I chose the left path, where pale mist curled like waiting breath.
relative:1.cnHint: 在石门前，师兄告诉我两条路的危险程度是____的，取决于你掌握了哪些灵字。
relative:1.hook: Behind me, the stone gate groaned and began to close.
relative:1.line: 'The danger of each road is *relative* to the words you already carry.'

sentences.en: The mountain path split into two at the stone gate.
sentences.cn: 山路在石门处分成了两条。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu studied both routes in silence.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎静静地看了看两条路。

sentences.en: 'The danger of each road is *relative*,' he said at last, 'depending on which words you have already learned to carry.'
I chose the left path, where pale mist curled like waiting breath.
sentences.cn: 我选了左边的路，那里淡雾缠绕得像在屏息等待。

rent:1.en: At the base of Cloud Peak, a row of wooden stalls offered lodging to wandering disciples. The *rent* for one night was a single spoken herb-word, breathed into the landlord's clay jar. I had only three words left. Xiaoxing counted her own jar and smiled without speaking.
rent:1.cnHint: 在云峰脚下，住一晚的____是向掌柜念一个灵草字，我只剩三个字了。
rent:1.hook: The landlord's jar glowed faint red — someone had spoken a forbidden word into it.
rent:1.line: 'The *rent* here is one herb-word spoken clearly into the jar.'

sentences.en: At the base of Cloud Peak, a row of wooden stalls offered lodging to wandering disciples.
sentences.cn: 云峰脚下有一排木头客栈，给游历的弟子们提供住宿。

sentences.en: The *rent* for one night was a single spoken herb-word, breathed into the landlord's clay jar.
I had only three words left.
sentences.cn: 我只剩下三个字了。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing counted her own jar and smiled without speaking.
sentences.cn: 小杏数了数自己罐子里的，没出声地笑了。

round:1.en: Each dawn, Master Qingwu led us through a *round* of spoken drills on the open terrace — one word for wind, one for stone, one for cloud — circling back until our voices no longer shook. On the seventh morning, frost formed in the shapes of the words we had just spoken. No one could explain it.
round:1.cnHint: 每天清晨，师尊带我们在露台上进行一____口诵练习，第七天清晨出现了奇异的霜迹。
round:1.hook: The frost words were not the ones we had practiced that morning.
round:1.line: 'Begin the next *round* — your voice must not shake this time.'

sentences.en: Each dawn, Master Qingwu led us through a *round* of spoken drills on the open terrace — one word for wind, one for stone, one for cloud — circling back until our voices no longer shook.
On the seventh morning, frost formed in the shapes of the words we had just spoken.
sentences.cn: 第七个早上，frost formed in the shapes of the words we had just spoken。

sentences.en: No one could explain it.
sentences.cn: 没有人能解释这是怎么回事。

structure:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a chart of the sect's core formula on the courtyard wall. 'Study the *structure* first,' she said, tracing each line with two fingers. 'A word spoken without understanding its bones will shatter before it heals.' A crack appeared along the wall the moment she stepped away.
structure:1.cnHint: 师尊展开图卷，让我们先研究核心法诀的____，说不理解其骨架的字会在愈合前破碎。
structure:1.hook: The crack on the wall spelled a word none of us had been taught.
structure:1.line: 'Study the *structure* first — a word without bones will shatter.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a chart of the sect's core formula on the courtyard wall.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在院子的墙上展开了宗门核心公式的图表。

sentences.en: 'Study the *structure* first,' she said, tracing each line with two fingers.
'A word spoken without understanding its bones will shatter before it heals.'
sentences.cn: 一个没有理解其骨骼的词说出来会在治愈前就崩裂。

sentences.en: A crack appeared along the wall the moment she stepped away.
sentences.cn: 她转身离开的一刻，墙上出现了一道裂纹。

typical:1.en: A *typical* morning at the sect began with silence: no words spoken, no formulas breathed, only the sound of the mountain settling into itself. Shen Wujiu said this stillness was the root of all the words to come. Today the silence lasted three times as long, and no one asked why.
typical:1.cnHint: 在门派，____的早晨从沉默开始，不念任何字诀，今天的沉默持续了平时的三倍。
typical:1.hook: When the silence finally broke, the voice that spoke was not any of ours.
typical:1.line: 'A *typical* morning here begins in silence — learn to listen first.'

sentences.en: A *typical* morning at the sect began with silence: no words spoken, no formulas breathed, only the sound of the mountain settling into itself.
Shen Wujiu said this stillness was the root of all the words to come.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说这份寂静是所有即将到来的词的根源。

sentences.en: Today the silence lasted three times as long, and no one asked why.
sentences.cn: 今天这份沉默持续了三倍之久，没有人问为什么。

vacation:1.en: The elder council granted a three-day *vacation* after the spring trials — no drills, no word-recitation, only rest on whatever ledge of sky you preferred. Xiaoxing chose a mossy shelf near the waterfall. I sat beside her, and for a while the clouds below us were perfectly still.
vacation:1.cnHint: 春季考核后长老会批了三天____，我和师妹坐在瀑布旁的苔石上，云海出奇地平静。
vacation:1.hook: On the third day, a red bird landed between us carrying a sealed message.
vacation:1.line: 'Enjoy the *vacation* — when it ends, the real trials begin.'

sentences.en: The elder council granted a three-day *vacation* after the spring trials — no drills, no word-recitation, only rest on whatever ledge of sky you preferred.
Xiaoxing chose a mossy shelf near the waterfall.
sentences.cn: 小杏选了瀑布边一个长满苔藓的平台。

sentences.en: I sat beside her, and for a while the clouds below us were perfectly still.
sentences.cn: 我坐在她身边，有一会儿我们下方的云彩完全静止了。

acquire:1.en: Shen Wujiu warned me that it takes months to *acquire* even one stable herb-word — the tone must match the season, the breath must carry no fear. I practiced mine in the dark each night until it lit a small blue glow on my palm. On the ninth night, the glow turned gold without warning.
acquire:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，____哪怕一个稳定的灵草字也需要数月，第九晚我掌心的蓝光突然变成了金色。
acquire:1.hook: Master Qingwu appeared at my door before I could call out to anyone.
acquire:1.line: 'It takes months to *acquire* one stable word — do not rush the season.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu warned me that it takes months to *acquire* even one stable herb-word — the tone must match the season, the breath must carry no fear.
I practiced mine in the dark each night until it lit a small blue glow on my palm.
sentences.cn: 我每晚在黑暗里练习我的词，直到它在我手心发出一道蓝色的微光。

sentences.en: On the ninth night, the glow turned gold without warning.
sentences.cn: 第九晚，那光突然变成了金色。

adequate:1.en: Before the gate examination, Master Qingwu reviewed each disciple's word-store. She paused at mine the longest. 'Your range is *adequate*,' she said quietly, 'but adequate has a ceiling, and the clouds above this peak have none.' She marked my scroll and moved on without another word.
adequate:1.cnHint: 登门考核前，师尊查看我的字库，说我的储量____，但____是有上限的，而山峰上方的云没有。
adequate:1.hook: At the bottom of my scroll, in ink I did not recognize, a single new word had appeared.
adequate:1.line: 'Your range is *adequate* — but adequate has a ceiling, and the sky does not.'

sentences.en: Before the gate examination, Master Qingwu reviewed each disciple's word-store.
sentences.cn: 在通关考试前，青梧师尊逐个审查每个弟子的词库。

sentences.en: She paused at mine the longest.
sentences.cn: 她在我的这里停留得最久。

sentences.en: 'Your range is *adequate*,' she said quietly, 'but adequate has a ceiling, and the clouds above this peak have none.'
She marked my scroll and moved on without another word.
sentences.cn: 她在我的卷轴上做了标记，没再说什么就走了。

comfortable:1.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect lay open to the sky, where morning mist curled between stone lanterns. Shen Wujiu spread a worn mat on the steps and handed me a thick robe. 'Rest here,' he said. 'No disciple should begin a hard day without something *comfortable* beneath them.' The robe smelled of cedar and old ink.
comfortable:1.cnHint: 师兄递给我一件厚袍，让我在台阶上____地坐下，准备迎接艰难的修炼。
comfortable:1.hook: But beneath the mat, a single black feather lay perfectly still.
comfortable:1.line: 'No disciple should begin a hard day without something *comfortable* beneath them.'

sentences.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect lay open to the sky, where morning mist curled between stone lanterns.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的外院向天空敞开，晨雾在石灯笼间缭绕。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread a worn mat on the steps and handed me a thick robe.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在台阶上铺开一张旧垫子，递给我一件厚袍子。

sentences.en: 'Rest here,' he said.
sentences.cn: 他说，就在这儿休息。

sentences.en: 'No disciple should begin a hard day without something *comfortable* beneath them.'
The robe smelled of cedar and old ink.
sentences.cn: 那件袍子闻起来有杉木和陈墨的味道。

conclusion:1.en: We stood on the wide terrace above the cloud line, watching word-sparks drift from Master Qingwu's brush. Each spark landed on stone and faded. Xiaoxing counted them under her breath, then turned to me. 'My *conclusion* is that the mountain chooses disciples the way fire chooses wood — not by size, but by what is dry inside.' I had no answer for that.
conclusion:1.cnHint: 小星观察完师尊的试炼火花后，得出了一个关于山峰如何____弟子的判断。
conclusion:1.hook: Above us, the summit stone cracked along a line no one had seen before.
conclusion:1.line: 'My *conclusion* is that the mountain chooses disciples the way fire chooses wood.'

sentences.en: We stood on the wide terrace above the cloud line, watching word-sparks drift from Master Qingwu's brush.
sentences.cn: 我们站在云线上方的宽阔露台上，看着青梧师尊毛笔中飘散的字火。

sentences.en: Each spark landed on stone and faded.
sentences.cn: 每一点火星落在石头上便消散了。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing counted them under her breath, then turned to me.
sentences.cn: 小杏在喉咙里数着它们，然后转向我。

sentences.en: 'My *conclusion* is that the mountain chooses disciples the way fire chooses wood — not by size, but by what is dry inside.'
I had no answer for that.
sentences.cn: 我无言以对。

formal:1.en: The admission rite took place on the open sky-bridge at sunrise. Master Qingwu wore a robe stitched with silver cloud patterns — the only *formal* garment I had ever seen on a cultivator — and her voice carried across the wind without effort. I pressed my hands together and bowed until the bridge trembled faintly under my knees.
formal:1.cnHint: 在天桥上举行的入门仪式是一场____典礼，师尊身着绣云长袍主持。
formal:1.hook: The trembling did not stop when I rose.
formal:1.line: 'This robe marks the only *formal* moment a master and disciple will ever share — remember it.'

sentences.en: The admission rite took place on the open sky-bridge at sunrise.
sentences.cn: 收徒仪式在开放的天桥上日出时举行。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu wore a robe stitched with silver cloud patterns — the only *formal* garment I had ever seen on a cultivator — and her voice carried across the wind without effort.
I pressed my hands together and bowed until the bridge trembled faintly under my knees.
sentences.cn: 我把双手合十，鞠躬到桥在我膝下微微震颤。

happiness:1.en: Outside the herb pavilion, small word-seeds were pinned to a board for new disciples to study. Xiaoxing stopped before the seed for the word 'bloom' and touched it lightly. '*Happiness*,' she said quietly, not to me but to the seed itself, as if greeting an old friend. The seed glowed for a half-breath, then went still.
happiness:1.cnHint: 小星在药草阁外看到一粒文字种子，轻声说出了她的____，种子随之微微发光。
happiness:1.hook: When she lifted her finger, the glow had moved to her palm.
happiness:1.line: '*Happiness* is what a word feels when someone finally understands it.'

sentences.en: Outside the herb pavilion, small word-seeds were pinned to a board for new disciples to study.
sentences.cn: 药草楼外，小小的字种被钉在一块木板上供新弟子学习。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stopped before the seed for the word 'bloom' and touched it lightly. '*Happiness*,' she said quietly, not to me but to the seed itself, as if greeting an old friend.
The seed glowed for a half-breath, then went still.
sentences.cn: 那粒种子闪了半口气的光，然后归于寂静。

intelligent:1.en: Master Qingwu set three word-riddles on a flat rock in the courtyard and walked away without speaking. Shen Wujiu solved two before the incense burned down. The third defeated him. He looked at me with a calm smile. 'An *intelligent* mind,' he said, 'knows which problems to leave for the mountain to answer.' The incense went out in windless air.
intelligent:1.cnHint: 师兄解开了两道文字谜题后坦言，____的心智懂得哪些问题该留给山来回答。
intelligent:1.hook: The third riddle's characters rearranged themselves while no one was looking.
intelligent:1.line: 'An *intelligent* mind knows which problems to leave for the mountain to answer.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set three word-riddles on a flat rock in the courtyard and walked away without speaking.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在院子里的平石上设了三道字谜，然后无言而去。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu solved two before the incense burned down.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在香烧完前解开了两道。

sentences.en: The third defeated him.
sentences.cn: 第三道难住了他。

sentences.en: He looked at me with a calm smile.
sentences.cn: 他用平静的微笑看向我。

sentences.en: 'An *intelligent* mind,' he said, 'knows which problems to leave for the mountain to answer.'
The incense went out in windless air.
sentences.cn: 香在无风的空气中熄灭了。

novel:1.en: On the broad landing where disciples gathered before dawn practice, I found a word I did not recognize carved into the railing. Shen Wujiu said it was an old formula for lifting fog. 'The feeling you have right now — that small shock of the unknown — that is what the sect calls *novel* energy,' he said. 'Feed it. It runs out faster than you think.'
novel:1.cnHint: 师兄在晨练台的栏杆上指出一个陌生字符，说我此刻感受到的正是修炼中____的力量。
novel:1.hook: The fog below the railing thickened the moment he named it.
novel:1.line: 'That small shock of the unknown — that is what the sect calls *novel* energy.'

sentences.en: On the broad landing where disciples gathered before dawn practice, I found a word I did not recognize carved into the railing.
sentences.cn: 在弟子们天亮前集合的宽阔平台上，我发现了栏杆上刻着一个我不认识的字。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said it was an old formula for lifting fog.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说那是一个古老的驱雾咒。

sentences.en: 'The feeling you have right now — that small shock of the unknown — that is what the sect calls *novel* energy,' he said.
'Feed it.
sentences.cn: 快把它喂饱。

sentences.en: It runs out faster than you think.'
sentences.cn: 它消耗得比你想象的快。

political:1.en: The grand stairway between the outer and inner peaks was neutral ground — no elder's rule held there, by old agreement. Shen Wujiu called it a *political* space, shaped more by the history of old disputes than by any spiritual law. He said it quietly, watching the steps as if they might hear. A cold wind rose from below without warning.
political:1.cnHint: 师兄说，连接内外峰的大阶梯是一个____空间，由古老的争议而非灵法塑造。
political:1.hook: Something under the stairs answered the wind with a low sound.
political:1.line: 'This stairway is a *political* space — history carved it, not spirit law.'

sentences.en: The grand stairway between the outer and inner peaks was neutral ground — no elder's rule held there, by old agreement.
sentences.cn: 连接外峰和内峰的大阶梯是中立地带——根据古老的协议，没有长老的规则在那里生效。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu called it a *political* space, shaped more by the history of old disputes than by any spiritual law.
He said it quietly, watching the steps as if they might hear.
sentences.cn: 他轻声说着，目光扫过台阶，仿佛它们可能会听见。

sentences.en: A cold wind rose from below without warning.
sentences.cn: 一阵冷风没有预警地从下方升起。

property:1.en: At the edge of the outer terrace stood a row of small locked boxes, each marked with a disciple's seal. Master Qingwu told us that the words we mastered were the only *property* a cultivator could truly keep — mountains could fall, boxes could be taken, but a word learned in the bone stayed forever. She paused, then added: 'Guard the first one well.'
property:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉弟子们，真正掌握的文字是修炼者唯一无法被夺走的____。
property:1.hook: One of the sealed boxes bore no name at all.
property:1.line: 'Words learned in the bone are the only *property* a cultivator truly keeps.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the outer terrace stood a row of small locked boxes, each marked with a disciple's seal.
sentences.cn: 外露台的边缘排列着一排小小的上锁木盒，每个都标着一个弟子的印记。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told us that the words we mastered were the only *property* a cultivator could truly keep — mountains could fall, boxes could be taken, but a word learned in the bone stayed forever.
She paused, then added: 'Guard the first one well.'
sentences.cn: 她停了一下，然后补充道："第一个要好好守护。"

conventional:1.en: At the base of Ascension Peak, disciples gathered to receive their first herb pouches. Master Qingwu handed mine over without a word. Inside was nothing *conventional* — no dried roots or pressed leaves, but a single living seed that hummed like a struck bell and cast faint gold light on my palm.
conventional:1.cnHint: 在飞升峰山脚，师尊交给我一个不____的草药包。
conventional:1.hook: The seed pulsed once, then went silent.
conventional:1.line: 'Nothing *conventional* grows on the peak above the clouds,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: At the base of Ascension Peak, disciples gathered to receive their first herb pouches.
sentences.cn: 在飞升峰的山脚，弟子们聚集起来领取他们的第一个草药袋。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed mine over without a word.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊没有一句话地把我的递了过来。

sentences.en: Inside was nothing *conventional* — no dried roots or pressed leaves, but a single living seed that hummed like a struck bell and cast faint gold light on my palm.

disappear:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me through the outer terrace at dawn, pointing out the herbs carved above each gate. Then he stopped walking. I turned, and he had simply ceased to be there — it is common on this mountain, he had warned me, for a person to *disappear* into the mist between one step and the next.
disappear:1.cnHint: 在晨雾中，师兄突然在我眼前____了。
disappear:1.hook: His footprints in the dew ended without reason.
disappear:1.line: 'On foggy mornings, even your own shadow can *disappear*,' Shen Wujiu warned.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me through the outer terrace at dawn, pointing out the herbs carved above each gate.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在天亮时领我穿过外露台，指给我看每扇门上雕刻的草药。

sentences.en: Then he stopped walking.
sentences.cn: 然后他停止了行走。

sentences.en: I turned, and he had simply ceased to be there — it is common on this mountain, he had warned me, for a person to *disappear* into the mist between one step and the next.

district:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a map of the mountain range across a flat stone. Each floating peak belonged to a different *district* of the Cloud Sea Sect, she explained — one for healing, one for combat, one for flight. I had been assigned to the smallest, the one whose name no elder spoke aloud.
district:1.cnHint: 师尊展开地图，向我介绍宗门各个____的用途。
district:1.hook: The smallest district had no label at all.
district:1.line: 'Every *district* carries its own law, and its own silence,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a map of the mountain range across a flat stone.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在一块平石上展开了山脉的地图。

sentences.en: Each floating peak belonged to a different *district* of the Cloud Sea Sect, she explained — one for healing, one for combat, one for flight.
I had been assigned to the smallest, the one whose name no elder spoke aloud.
sentences.cn: 我被分配到最小的那一个，那个没有长老敢出声念的名字的山峰。

greatly:1.en: I attempted the Rising Breath formula for the third time at the cliff edge. The air around me shifted, and I rose — only a hand's width, but Xiaoxing clapped once from the path. She said the light in the formula had *greatly* improved, brighter and steadier than yesterday, like a lantern finally given oil.
greatly:1.cnHint: 小星告诉我，今天我施展法诀的灵光____比昨日进步了。
greatly:1.hook: Below the cliff, the sea of clouds began to stir.
greatly:1.line: 'Your breath has *greatly* changed since last week,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: I attempted the Rising Breath formula for the third time at the cliff edge.
sentences.cn: 我在悬崖边第三次尝试了升气心法。

sentences.en: The air around me shifted, and I rose — only a hand's width, but Xiaoxing clapped once from the path.
sentences.cn: 我周围的空气移动了，我升起来——只有一掌宽，但小杏从小路上拍了一下手。

sentences.en: She said the light in the formula had *greatly* improved, brighter and steadier than yesterday, like a lantern finally given oil.

imitate:1.en: Xiaoxing pressed her hands together and shaped a small cloud above her fingers. She smiled and told me not to *imitate* the shape — the form was only a shell, she said, and the real work was in the breath behind it. I closed my eyes and tried to feel rather than copy.
imitate:1.cnHint: 小星叮嘱我不要____她的手势，而要感受气息本身。
imitate:1.hook: When I opened my eyes, my cloud had a different, stranger shape.
imitate:1.line: 'Do not *imitate* the gesture alone — breathe the meaning into it,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed her hands together and shaped a small cloud above her fingers.
sentences.cn: 小杏合起双手，在指尖上塑出了一朵小云。

sentences.en: She smiled and told me not to *imitate* the shape — the form was only a shell, she said, and the real work was in the breath behind it.
I closed my eyes and tried to feel rather than copy.
sentences.cn: 我闭上眼睛，试着去感受而不是模仿。

implement:1.en: Shen Wujiu carried a worn leather roll tied with a blue cord. He opened it on the stone railing, and inside lay each *implement* of the first trial — a bone needle, a small blade of pressed cloud-iron, and a hollow reed no longer than my thumb. Each one, he said, corresponded to a word.
implement:1.cnHint: 师兄向我展示初试所用的每一件____，并说明它们各自对应一个字诀。
implement:1.hook: One implement was wrapped separately, and he did not name it.
implement:1.line: 'Each *implement* in this roll has ended at least one trial early,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu carried a worn leather roll tied with a blue cord.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎怀里揣着一卷陈旧的皮筒，用蓝色的绳子系得紧紧的。

sentences.en: He opened it on the stone railing, and inside lay each *implement* of the first trial — a bone needle, a small blade of pressed cloud-iron, and a hollow reed no longer than my thumb.
Each one, he said, corresponded to a word.
sentences.cn: 他说，每一件都对应一个字。

mood:1.en: The outer terrace was quiet at noon, the mist low and silver. I sat with my herb scroll but could not read. Master Qingwu passed behind me and paused. She said the mountain reads a disciple's *mood* the way water reads wind — it ripples before the gust even arrives, and it remembers long after.
mood:1.cnHint: 师尊说，这座山能感应弟子的____，就像水感应风一样。
mood:1.hook: A tremor moved through the stone beneath me, slow and deliberate.
mood:1.line: 'The mountain mirrors your *mood* — do not let it learn fear,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The outer terrace was quiet at noon, the mist low and silver.
sentences.cn: 外阳台在正午时分很安静，雾气低低地压着，银色的。

sentences.en: I sat with my herb scroll but could not read.
sentences.cn: 我坐在药草卷轴前，却看不进去。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu passed behind me and paused.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从我身后走过，停了下来。

sentences.en: She said the mountain reads a disciple's *mood* the way water reads wind — it ripples before the gust even arrives, and it remembers long after.

motivation:1.en: Shen Wujiu asked me why I had climbed to the sect on foot instead of taking the cloud-ferry like the others. I told him I had no good reason. He shook his head and said that was exactly the right answer — that pure *motivation*, without weight or want, is the only kind the peak will accept.
motivation:1.cnHint: 师兄问我徒步上山的____是什么，说只有纯粹的动机才能被山峰接受。
motivation:1.hook: Above us, the gate at the summit opened one finger's width.
motivation:1.line: 'Tell me your *motivation*, and the peak will already know if you lied,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu asked me why I had climbed to the sect on foot instead of taking the cloud-ferry like the others.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎问我为什么要步行上山，而不像其他人一样乘坐云渡。

sentences.en: I told him I had no good reason.
sentences.cn: 我告诉他我没有什么好理由。

sentences.en: He shook his head and said that was exactly the right answer — that pure *motivation*, without weight or want, is the only kind the peak will accept.

attribute:1.en: At the stone gate of the outer court, Master Qingwu held up a pale seed — a word-herb so rare that even senior disciples had never seen one. 'Every healer must learn to *attribute* a patient's weakness to the right cause,' she said, 'or the cure becomes the poison.' I wrote the lesson on my palm with trembling fingers. Above the gate, a crack split the stone in perfect silence.
attribute:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在石门前告诫弟子，治愈者必须懂得将病人的虚弱____于正确的根源。
attribute:1.hook: The crack in the gate widened one breath later, then stopped.
attribute:1.line: 'You must *attribute* every symptom to its true root, or your formula will fail.'

sentences.en: At the stone gate of the outer court, Master Qingwu held up a pale seed — a word-herb so rare that even senior disciples had never seen one.
sentences.cn: 在外院石门前，青梧师尊举起一粒淡色的种子——一种字草，稀罕得连资深弟子都没见过。

sentences.en: 'Every healer must learn to *attribute* a patient's weakness to the right cause,' she said, 'or the cure becomes the poison.'
I wrote the lesson on my palm with trembling fingers.
sentences.cn: 我用发抖的手指在掌心写下这个教诲。

sentences.en: Above the gate, a crack split the stone in perfect silence.
sentences.cn: 门上方，石头裂开了，声音完全无声。

badly:1.en: The market bridge was packed with outer disciples trading word-seeds in the open air. I had spent all morning searching for a single herb that could steady a shaking voice. I *badly* needed it before the afternoon trial, where Master Qingwu would test us on spoken formulas. Shen Wujiu pressed a small pouch into my hand without a word. At sunset, every lantern on the bridge went dark at once.
badly:1.cnHint: 我____需要一株能稳定声音的草药，才能通过今天下午的考验。
badly:1.hook: Every lantern on the bridge went dark at once.
badly:1.line: 'I *badly* need that herb — the trial begins in one hour.'

sentences.en: The market bridge was packed with outer disciples trading word-seeds in the open air.
sentences.cn: 集市桥上挤满了外门弟子，在露天交易字种。

sentences.en: I had spent all morning searching for a single herb that could steady a shaking voice.
sentences.cn: 我整个上午都在寻找一种能稳定颤抖嗓音的草药。

sentences.en: I *badly* needed it before the afternoon trial, where Master Qingwu would test us on spoken formulas.
Shen Wujiu pressed a small pouch into my hand without a word.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎没说话，直接把一个小布袋塞进我的手里。

sentences.en: At sunset, every lantern on the bridge went dark at once.
sentences.cn: 日落时，桥上所有的灯笼一下子全灭了。

bridge:1.en: The sect's oldest *bridge* stretched between two floating peaks, its stones carved with ten thousand words too faded to read. Each morning, disciples crossed it in silence, breathing in whatever meaning drifted up from the clouds below. Today I stopped at the center and listened. A low hum rose from the carvings, as if one forgotten word was trying to wake up again. The hum did not stop when I walked away.
bridge:1.cnHint: 宗门最古老的____连接着两座浮峰，石面上刻满了万千模糊的文字。
bridge:1.hook: The hum followed me all the way to the inner court.
bridge:1.line: 'Never stop on this *bridge* at night — some words here still have teeth.'

sentences.en: The sect's oldest *bridge* stretched between two floating peaks, its stones carved with ten thousand words too faded to read.
Each morning, disciples crossed it in silence, breathing in whatever meaning drifted up from the clouds below.
sentences.cn: 每天早上，弟子们无声地穿过它，呼吸着从云层下飘上来的某种意义。

sentences.en: Today I stopped at the center and listened.
sentences.cn: 今天我在中点停了下来，静静听着。

sentences.en: A low hum rose from the carvings, as if one forgotten word was trying to wake up again.
sentences.cn: 一声低沉的嗡鸣从雕刻里升起，仿佛有一个被遗忘的字想要再次苏醒。

sentences.en: The hum did not stop when I walked away.
sentences.cn: 我走开了，嗡鸣声依然没有停止。

casual:1.en: Outside the herb pavilion, Xiaoxing sat on a low wall with a *casual* ease that made the elder disciples nervous. She was sorting word-seeds by color, humming to herself, as if the coming storm trial meant nothing at all. I asked how she could be so calm. She smiled and held up a seed that glowed faint gold. The sky above her head turned the same shade of gold, then faded.
casual:1.cnHint: 小星以一种____的从容坐在矮墙上，整理着她的文字种子，仿佛即将到来的风暴考验毫不在意。
casual:1.hook: The sky above her head turned gold, then faded fast.
casual:1.line: 'My *casual* look is itself a formula — it keeps rivals from guessing my strength.'

sentences.en: Outside the herb pavilion, Xiaoxing sat on a low wall with a *casual* ease that made the elder disciples nervous.
She was sorting word-seeds by color, humming to herself, as if the coming storm trial meant nothing at all.
sentences.cn: 她正在按颜色整理字种，哼着歌，仿佛即将到来的风暴试炼对她毫无意义。

sentences.en: I asked how she could be so calm.
sentences.cn: 我问她怎么能这么淡定。

sentences.en: She smiled and held up a seed that glowed faint gold.
sentences.cn: 她笑着举起一粒闪着淡金光的种子。

sentences.en: The sky above her head turned the same shade of gold, then faded.
sentences.cn: 她头顶的天空变成了同样的金色，然后褪去。

closely:1.en: In the open square before the inner hall, I watched Master Qingwu write a healing word in the air with one finger. The strokes vanished, but their warmth stayed. She told us to study the shape *closely*, because the curve of each line held the meaning the way a valley holds rain. I copied the motion three times. On the third try, the air smelled briefly of pine and distant rain.
closely:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊要求我们____观察她在空中写下的治愈文字，每一笔的弧度都承载着意义。
closely:1.hook: On the third copy, the air smelled of pine and rain.
closely:1.line: 'Watch *closely* — the curve of this stroke is where the healing lives.'

sentences.en: In the open square before the inner hall, I watched Master Qingwu write a healing word in the air with one finger.
sentences.cn: 在内殿前的开阔广场上，我看着青梧师尊用一根手指在空中写下一个治愈的字。

sentences.en: The strokes vanished, but their warmth stayed.
sentences.cn: 笔画消散了，但它们的温度留了下来。

sentences.en: She told us to study the shape *closely*, because the curve of each line held the meaning the way a valley holds rain.
I copied the motion three times.
sentences.cn: 我反复做了三次这个动作。

sentences.en: On the third try, the air smelled briefly of pine and distant rain.
sentences.cn: 第三次时，空气里短暂地飘来了松木和远处雨水的气息。

commit:1.en: At the edge of the practice yard, Shen Wujiu told me that mastering a word-formula was not about memory. 'You have to *commit* fully,' he said, 'half belief breaks the spell.' He demonstrated with a wind-word, and the dust rose in a perfect spiral before settling back in exactly the same pattern. I tried to do the same. The dust rose, then stopped, frozen mid-spiral, waiting for something.
commit:1.cnHint: 沈无咎告诉我，要掌握文字法诀，就必须____全力以赴，半信半疑会破坏咒文。
commit:1.hook: The dust froze mid-spiral and would not fall.
commit:1.line: 'You must *commit* with your whole will, or the word will refuse you.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the practice yard, Shen Wujiu told me that mastering a word-formula was not about memory.
sentences.cn: 在练功场的边缘，沈无咎告诉我掌握字诀并不是关于记忆。

sentences.en: 'You have to *commit* fully,' he said, 'half belief breaks the spell.'
He demonstrated with a wind-word, and the dust rose in a perfect spiral before settling back in exactly the same pattern.
sentences.cn: 他用一个风字做了示范，尘埃升起，形成了一个完美的螺旋，然后以完全相同的方式落回原处。

sentences.en: I tried to do the same.
sentences.cn: 我试着做同样的事。

sentences.en: The dust rose, then stopped, frozen mid-spiral, waiting for something.
sentences.cn: 尘埃升起，然后停住了，冻结在螺旋的中间，等待着什么。

concentrate:1.en: The trial ground was a wide stone terrace open to the sky. Wind came from all four directions, carrying distracting sounds and scents of strange herbs. Master Qingwu told us to *concentrate* on a single word-seed and feel its meaning expand inside the mind. I closed my eyes. For a moment the noise vanished and I heard only one clear tone. When I opened my eyes, the other disciples were staring at my hands.
concentrate:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊让我们在嘈杂的试炼台上____于单一的文字种子，感受它的意义在心中扩展。
concentrate:1.hook: Every disciple was staring at my hands when I opened my eyes.
concentrate:1.line: '*Concentrate* on one word only — scatter your mind and the seed will scatter too.'

sentences.en: The trial ground was a wide stone terrace open to the sky.
sentences.cn: 试炼地是一个宽阔的石台，完全暴露在天空下。

sentences.en: Wind came from all four directions, carrying distracting sounds and scents of strange herbs.
sentences.cn: 风从四面八方吹来，带着令人分心的声音和陌生草药的香气。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told us to *concentrate* on a single word-seed and feel its meaning expand inside the mind.
I closed my eyes.
sentences.cn: 我闭上了眼睛。

sentences.en: For a moment the noise vanished and I heard only one clear tone.
sentences.cn: 那一刻噪音消失了，我只听到了一个清晰的音调。

sentences.en: When I opened my eyes, the other disciples were staring at my hands.
sentences.cn: 当我睁开眼睛时，其他弟子都盯着我的手。

conscious:1.en: After the morning trial, I sat by the outer gate and tried to recall every step I had taken. Shen Wujiu said that a true disciple must be *conscious* of each breath during a formula, aware of the moment meaning passes from mind to air. I had not been aware at all — I had simply acted. Yet the word-seed had bloomed. A single white petal drifted up from the sea of clouds below and landed on my knee.
conscious:1.cnHint: 沈无咎说，真正的弟子在施展法诀时必须对每一次呼吸保持____，清醒地感受意义从心中流向空气。
conscious:1.hook: A white petal rose from the clouds and landed on my knee.
conscious:1.line: 'Be *conscious* of each breath — that awareness is half the formula.'

sentences.en: After the morning trial, I sat by the outer gate and tried to recall every step I had taken.
sentences.cn: 晨间试炼后，我坐在外门旁，试图回想我走过的每一步。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said that a true disciple must be *conscious* of each breath during a formula, aware of the moment meaning passes from mind to air.
I had not been aware at all — I had simply acted.
sentences.cn: 我根本没有意识到——我只是在行动。

sentences.en: Yet the word-seed had bloomed.
sentences.cn: 可是字种开花了。

sentences.en: A single white petal drifted up from the sea of clouds below and landed on my knee.
sentences.cn: 一片白色的花瓣从下面的云海里飘起，落在我的膝盖上。

obvious:1.en: The trial ground stretched across the open sky-bridge between two peaks. Every disciple stood still, reading the stone tablets carved with spirit words. To me, the correct path was *obvious* — the word for wind glowed faintly at the base, pointing left. I stepped forward. No one else moved.
obvious:1.cnHint: 在天桥试炼中，石碑上的答案对我来说____，我率先迈步。
obvious:1.hook: Behind me, the bridge began to crack.
obvious:1.line: 'The answer is *obvious* — look at where the light falls.'

sentences.en: The trial ground stretched across the open sky-bridge between two peaks.
sentences.cn: 试炼地横跨两座山峰之间的开阔天桥。

sentences.en: Every disciple stood still, reading the stone tablets carved with spirit words.
sentences.cn: 每个弟子都站在那儿，读着刻在石板上的灵字。

sentences.en: To me, the correct path was *obvious* — the word for wind glowed faintly at the base, pointing left.
I stepped forward.
sentences.cn: 我向前迈步。

sentences.en: No one else moved.
sentences.cn: 没有人动。

ordinary:1.en: The sky-market on the eastern ledge sold spirit words pressed into paper strips. Most stalls offered *ordinary* words — light, stone, wind — things any first-year disciple already knew. But one old seller at the far corner held a strip that shimmered with a color I had never seen.
ordinary:1.cnHint: 东崖集市上大多数摊位只售卖____的灵字，唯有角落一位老人手中的字条与众不同。
ordinary:1.hook: The old seller looked at me and quietly folded the strip away.
ordinary:1.line: 'These are just *ordinary* words — nothing here will surprise a careful student.'

sentences.en: The sky-market on the eastern ledge sold spirit words pressed into paper strips.
sentences.cn: 东崖的集市里卖的是压在纸条上的灵言。

sentences.en: Most stalls offered *ordinary* words — light, stone, wind — things any first-year disciple already knew.
But one old seller at the far corner held a strip that shimmered with a color I had never seen.
sentences.cn: 但远角有个老摊主手里拿着一张纸条，闪烁着一种我从未见过的颜色。

pace:1.en: Before the morning bell, I watched Shen Wujiu *pace* along the outer ledge, his lips moving in silence. He was rehearsing the flight formula — each step matched a syllable, each turn a breath. The clouds below swirled as if listening. I counted twelve full rounds before he stopped.
pace:1.cnHint: 清晨，我看见师兄在崖边____，默默演练飞升咒文。
pace:1.hook: On the thirteenth step, his feet left the stone entirely.
pace:1.line: 'I *pace* like this every dawn — the words only settle when the body moves.'

sentences.en: Before the morning bell, I watched Shen Wujiu *pace* along the outer ledge, his lips moving in silence.
He was rehearsing the flight formula — each step matched a syllable, each turn a breath.
sentences.cn: 他在排练飞行诀——每一步对应一个音节，每一转对应一次呼吸。

sentences.en: The clouds below swirled as if listening.
sentences.cn: 下方的云雾仿佛在倾听。

sentences.en: I counted twelve full rounds before he stopped.
sentences.cn: 我数了十二个完整的圈才见他停下。

participate:1.en: Master Qingwu announced that any disciple who wished to *participate* in the Sky Ascent rite must first carve their chosen word into the summit stone before sunrise. I had spent three nights deciding. Xiaoxing had already chosen hers. I pressed my blade to the cold rock and began.
participate:1.cnHint: 师尊宣布，想要____飞升仪式的弟子必须在日出前将灵字刻入顶石。
participate:1.hook: My blade slipped, and the stone lit up with a color no one had chosen before.
participate:1.line: 'Only those who *participate* with a whole heart will feel the mountain respond.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu announced that any disciple who wished to *participate* in the Sky Ascent rite must first carve their chosen word into the summit stone before sunrise.
I had spent three nights deciding.
sentences.cn: 我花了三个晚上才决定下来。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had already chosen hers.
sentences.cn: 小杏已经选好了。

sentences.en: I pressed my blade to the cold rock and began.
sentences.cn: 我把刀刃按在冰冷的石头上，开始刻起来。

pilot:1.en: High above the outer ring, a lone figure glided on a narrow cloud-board without any visible word-seal beneath their feet. Shen Wujiu leaned close and said that the elder was the sect's oldest *pilot*, someone who had long since merged the flight word into his very breath. I watched until the figure vanished into white.
pilot:1.cnHint: 一位老者无需字印便能驾云而行，师兄告诉我他是门派最资深的____。
pilot:1.hook: Then the elder reappeared — directly behind me.
pilot:1.line: 'A true *pilot* does not read the word — they become it.'

sentences.en: High above the outer ring, a lone figure glided on a narrow cloud-board without any visible word-seal beneath their feet.
sentences.cn: 外环的上方，有个身影踩着一块狭窄的云板滑行，脚下却看不见任何灵言的印记。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu leaned close and said that the elder was the sect's oldest *pilot*, someone who had long since merged the flight word into his very breath.
I watched until the figure vanished into white.
sentences.cn: 我看到那身影消失在白雾里才罢了。

primary:1.en: Xiaoxing spread her study notes across the flat rock near the cliff edge. She tapped the first page and said the *primary* rule of spirit-word craft was breath control — without steady breath, even the simplest healing word would scatter like smoke. I copied the rule down three times as a cold wind crossed the ledge.
primary:1.cnHint: 师妹说，掌握灵字的____原则是调息，我在笔记上一连抄写了三遍。
primary:1.hook: The cold wind carried a sound — someone else's breath, close and unsteady.
primary:1.line: 'Our *primary* task this season is to hold the word long enough to feel it pull.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread her study notes across the flat rock near the cliff edge.
sentences.cn: 小杏把她的笔记摊开在悬崖边的平石上。

sentences.en: She tapped the first page and said the *primary* rule of spirit-word craft was breath control — without steady breath, even the simplest healing word would scatter like smoke.
I copied the rule down three times as a cold wind crossed the ledge.
sentences.cn: 我把这条写下来三遍，冷风掠过崖边。

priority:1.en: The morning roster listed twelve tasks for the outer disciples. Shen Wujiu crossed out ten with a single stroke. He said the sky-trial was two days away, and our only *priority* was the ascent word — everything else could wait. Master Qingwu passed by without a word, but she nodded once.
priority:1.cnHint: 师兄划去了名册上的大多数任务，说飞升试炼在即，我们唯一的____是掌握升天灵字。
priority:1.hook: That night, the ascent word appeared on the wall of my room — unwritten, in pale light.
priority:1.line: 'Let the chores wait — your *priority* is the one word that opens the sky.'

sentences.en: The morning roster listed twelve tasks for the outer disciples.
sentences.cn: 早晨的名单上列着外门弟子的十二项任务。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu crossed out ten with a single stroke.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎一笔划掉了十个。

sentences.en: He said the sky-trial was two days away, and our only *priority* was the ascent word — everything else could wait.
Master Qingwu passed by without a word, but she nodded once.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊走过时没有说话，但点了一下头。

throughout:1.en: *Throughout* the long afternoon, the outer disciples practiced on the wind-terrace, calling words into the open air. Some words rose cleanly; others broke apart and drifted down into the clouds. I kept my stance low and my voice even, as Xiaoxing had shown me. By dusk, my word held for three full breaths.
throughout:1.cnHint: 整个下午，弟子们在风台____练习，我的灵字到黄昏时终于能维持三息。
throughout:1.hook: At the final bell, the clouds below the terrace turned a deep, unnatural red.
throughout:1.line: '*Throughout* every trial I have seen, it is patience that carries the word farthest.'

sentences.en: *Throughout* the long afternoon, the outer disciples practiced on the wind-terrace, calling words into the open air.
Some words rose cleanly; others broke apart and drifted down into the clouds.
sentences.cn: 有些灵言飘得很干净；有些则散开了，飘进云层里。

sentences.en: I kept my stance low and my voice even, as Xiaoxing had shown me.
sentences.cn: 我像小杏教我的那样保持低姿态，声音平稳。

sentences.en: By dusk, my word held for three full breaths.
sentences.cn: 到天黑时，我的灵言能坚持三个完整的呼吸了。

dinner:1.en: On the broad stone terrace where the sect gathers before flight trials, Master Qingwu has prepared a *dinner* of rare cloud-herb broth and river-grain cakes. Every disciple sits cross-legged on woven mats. Shen Wujiu passes me a warm bowl, and the whole mountain breathes in slow, golden silence.
dinner:1.cnHint: 飞升考验前夕，师尊在露台上为弟子们摆下____，饭香随云气飘散。
dinner:1.hook: One empty mat at the table belongs to no living disciple.
dinner:1.line: 'This *dinner* is not a reward — it is a farewell offering to the sky.'

sentences.en: On the broad stone terrace where the sect gathers before flight trials, Master Qingwu has prepared a *dinner* of rare cloud-herb broth and river-grain cakes.
Every disciple sits cross-legged on woven mats.
sentences.cn: 每个弟子都盘腿坐在编织垫上。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu passes me a warm bowl, and the whole mountain breathes in slow, golden silence.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一碗热汤，整座山在缓缓的金色寂静中呼吸。

embrace:1.en: On the wide landing path carved into the cliff face, Xiaoxing spreads her arms wide as the morning wind rushes up from the sea of clouds below. She says the wind is teaching her to *embrace* everything she fears — the height, the cold, the long fall. I watch and feel my own heart open a little.
embrace:1.cnHint: 在悬崖栈道上，小星张开双臂，学着用____来面对心中的恐惧。
embrace:1.hook: Then the wind stopped, and the silence was louder than any storm.
embrace:1.line: 'To *embrace* the cold air is the first step toward flying through it.'

sentences.en: On the wide landing path carved into the cliff face, Xiaoxing spreads her arms wide as the morning wind rushes up from the sea of clouds below.
sentences.cn: 在崖壁上凿出的宽阔降落通道上，小杏张开双臂，迎向从下方云海涌上来的晨风。

sentences.en: She says the wind is teaching her to *embrace* everything she fears — the height, the cold, the long fall.
I watch and feel my own heart open a little.
sentences.cn: 我看着，感觉自己的心也开放了一点。

explanation:1.en: Beneath the great signal bell hung between two floating peaks, I find Shen Wujiu standing alone, staring at a crack running through the ancient stone pillar. He offers no *explanation* for why he is here before dawn, only presses one finger against the crack and whispers a word-formula I do not recognise.
explanation:1.cnHint: 清晨，我在信号钟下发现师兄独自凝视裂柱，他没有给出任何____。
explanation:1.hook: The crack in the pillar spread another inch as he walked away.
explanation:1.line: 'I owe no *explanation* to anyone — only to the stone itself.'

sentences.en: Beneath the great signal bell hung between two floating peaks, I find Shen Wujiu standing alone, staring at a crack running through the ancient stone pillar.
sentences.cn: 在悬在两座浮峰之间的大信号钟下方，我发现沈无咎独自站着，盯着古老石柱上的一条裂纹。

sentences.en: He offers no *explanation* for why he is here before dawn, only presses one finger against the crack and whispers a word-formula I do not recognise.
