jam:1.line: 'This *jam* of feet and fear will cost us the first light.'

sentences.en: Halfway up the stone path to the trial gate, all twelve disciples stopped.
sentences.cn: 沿着石径往试炼门走到一半，十二个弟子都停下了。

sentences.en: The narrow pass was a *jam* of nervous bodies and heavy supply sacks, no one willing to step forward first.
The clouds below swirled impatiently.
sentences.cn: 脚下的云海焦躁地翻滚着。

sentences.en: Somewhere ahead, a low bell struck once and did not strike again.
sentences.cn: 前面某处，一口低沉的钟声敲了一下，就没有再敲。

supermarket:1.en: A visiting merchant had built a row of open stalls along the base-mountain road, selling spirit-roots and rare soils. Xiaoxing laughed and called it a *supermarket* of the sky, everything labelled and priced and stacked in neat rows. Master Qingwu did not laugh, and the merchant did not meet her eyes.
supermarket:1.cnHint: 山脚下商贩摆开的货摊被小星戏称为天上的____，但师尊的神色却十分凝重。
supermarket:1.hook: One labelled jar held something that moved.
supermarket:1.line: 'Even a *supermarket* of rare herbs means nothing without a pure heart.'

sentences.en: A visiting merchant had built a row of open stalls along the base-mountain road, selling spirit-roots and rare soils.
sentences.cn: 一个外来商人在山脚的路边开了一排摊铺，卖灵根和稀有的土壤。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing laughed and called it a *supermarket* of the sky, everything labelled and priced and stacked in neat rows.
Master Qingwu did not laugh, and the merchant did not meet her eyes.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊没有笑，商人也没有抬眼看她。

debate:1.en: At the cloud-ferry landing, Shen Wujiu and Xiaoxing stood on opposite sides of a carved post, voices low and steady. They were deep in *debate* about whether the eastern path or the western ridge would carry us closer to the gate before the trial fog rose. I looked up and saw the fog was already rising.
debate:1.cnHint: 在云渡口，沈无咎与小星就路线选择展开____，而他们争论的那团雾已悄然升起。
debate:1.hook: The fog chose the path for them.
debate:1.line: 'We can *debate* the route, but the mountain will not wait for us.'

sentences.en: At the cloud-ferry landing, Shen Wujiu and Xiaoxing stood on opposite sides of a carved post, voices low and steady.
sentences.cn: 在云渡码头，沈无咎和小杏站在一根雕花柱子的两侧，声音低沉而平稳。

sentences.en: They were deep in *debate* about whether the eastern path or the western ridge would carry us closer to the gate before the trial fog rose.
I looked up and saw the fog was already rising.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头，看到雾气已经开始升起了。

housing:1.en: At the base of the Ascending Path, rows of small stone rooms clung to the cliff face like swallows' nests. Shen Wujiu swept his arm wide. 'New disciples share *housing* here until their first word-herb blooms,' he said. Each door bore a carved character that glowed faintly at dusk, as though the mountain itself was reading us.
housing:1.cnHint: 云海宗山壁上的石屋是新弟子的____，每扇门上的字符在黄昏时微微发光。
housing:1.hook: Behind the last door, one character had already turned black.
housing:1.line: 'New disciples share *housing* here until their first word-herb blooms.'

sentences.en: At the base of the Ascending Path, rows of small stone rooms clung to the cliff face like swallows' nests.
sentences.cn: 在登仙路的山脚，一排小石室紧贴悬崖面，像燕窝一样层叠着。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu swept his arm wide.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎挥了挥手臂。

sentences.en: 'New disciples share *housing* here until their first word-herb blooms,' he said.
Each door bore a carved character that glowed faintly at dusk, as though the mountain itself was reading us.
sentences.cn: 每扇门上都雕着一个字，在暮色时微微发光，像是山在读我们。

behaviour:1.en: Master Qingwu circled us slowly on the open terrace above the clouds. 'Every word you speak becomes a seed,' she said. 'The sect judges not your talent but your *behaviour* — how you carry each formula, how you set it down.' I straightened my back and held my breath, feeling the mist taste my intentions.
behaviour:1.cnHint: 师尊在云端平台上告诫弟子们，修炼的关键在于____，而非天赋。
behaviour:1.hook: A seed of light drifted from her sleeve and settled on the one who had lied.
behaviour:1.line: 'The sect judges not your talent but your *behaviour*.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu circled us slowly on the open terrace above the clouds.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在云海之上的露台上缓缓绕着我们转圈。

sentences.en: 'Every word you speak becomes a seed,' she said.
sentences.cn: "你说出的每一个字都会成为一粒种子，"她说。

sentences.en: 'The sect judges not your talent but your *behaviour* — how you carry each formula, how you set it down.'
I straightened my back and held my breath, feeling the mist taste my intentions.
sentences.cn: 我挺直了脊背，屏住呼吸，感受到雾气在品尝我的意图。

husband:1.en: An old woman sat outside the market gate selling dried cloud-moss. She pressed a small bundle into my hands and refused payment. 'My *husband* once learned the healing word here,' she said softly, eyes distant. 'He is gone now, but the word still grows in our garden.' The moss smelled of pine and old sorrow.
husband:1.cnHint: 集市门口一位老妇人提起她的____曾在此学过治愈之词，令人动容。
husband:1.hook: When I looked back, the woman and her basket had both vanished.
husband:1.line: 'My *husband* once learned the healing word here.'

sentences.en: An old woman sat outside the market gate selling dried cloud-moss.
sentences.cn: 一个老妇人坐在市集门口卖干的云苔。

sentences.en: She pressed a small bundle into my hands and refused payment.
sentences.cn: 她把一小束塞进我手里，拒绝了我的付款。

sentences.en: 'My *husband* once learned the healing word here,' she said softly, eyes distant.
'He is gone now, but the word still grows in our garden.'
sentences.cn: "他现在已经走了，但那个字还在我们的花园里生长。"

sentences.en: The moss smelled of pine and old sorrow.
sentences.cn: 苔藓闻起来有松树和陈旧哀伤的味道。

tourist:1.en: A visitor in bright robes drifted through the outer market, pausing at every herb-stall with wide, delighted eyes. 'Even a *tourist* can feel the words humming,' Xiaoxing murmured beside me, watching him lift a jar of sky-salt and frown at the price. Then the humming stopped, and every herb on the nearest stall wilted at once.
tourist:1.cnHint: 一位____在外市闲逛，感受到字词的震动——直到所有草药突然枯萎。
tourist:1.hook: The visitor's bright robe had no sect mark anywhere on it.
tourist:1.line: 'Even a *tourist* can feel the words humming in this place.'

sentences.en: A visitor in bright robes drifted through the outer market, pausing at every herb-stall with wide, delighted eyes.
sentences.cn: 一个穿着亮色长袍的访客飘过外市集，在每个草药摊前都停下来，眼睛睁得很大，满是欣喜。

sentences.en: 'Even a *tourist* can feel the words humming,' Xiaoxing murmured beside me, watching him lift a jar of sky-salt and frown at the price.
Then the humming stopped, and every herb on the nearest stall wilted at once.
sentences.cn: 然后嗡鸣声停止了，最近的草药摊上每一株草都一下子枯萎了。

agent:1.en: Shen Wujiu pulled me aside near the cloud-dye stalls. 'That man in grey is an *agent* for the lowland merchants,' he said quietly. 'He trades silver for stolen word-seeds.' I watched the man pass a folded paper beneath a bolt of blue cloth. Above us, a patrol crane circled lower and lower without landing.
agent:1.cnHint: 师兄警告我，那个灰衣人是低地商人的____，专门收购被盗的字词种子。
agent:1.hook: The folded paper began to smoke at the edges in the cold air.
agent:1.line: 'That man in grey is an *agent* for the lowland merchants.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pulled me aside near the cloud-dye stalls.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在云料染坊旁把我拉到一边。

sentences.en: 'That man in grey is an *agent* for the lowland merchants,' he said quietly.
'He trades silver for stolen word-seeds.'
sentences.cn: "他用银子换被盗的字种。"

sentences.en: I watched the man pass a folded paper beneath a bolt of blue cloth.
sentences.cn: 我看着那个男人在一匹蓝布下面塞进一张折叠的纸。

sentences.en: Above us, a patrol crane circled lower and lower without landing.
sentences.cn: 我们上方，一只巡逻鹤盘旋得越来越低，但没有降落。

cash:1.en: The seed-market opened at first light, and every stall demanded immediate payment. 'No credit above the clouds,' the elder vendor said flatly. 'Only *cash* — copper rounds or sky-glass chips.' I counted my last three chips into her palm. She held each one up to the sun, and the third one cast a shadow shaped like a warning sign.
cash:1.cnHint: 云端集市只收____，我数出最后三枚天玻璃币，第三枚投下了奇怪的影子。
cash:1.hook: The shadow-shape matched the seal on Master Qingwu's forbidden scroll.
cash:1.line: 'Only *cash* — copper rounds or sky-glass chips, nothing else.'

sentences.en: The seed-market opened at first light, and every stall demanded immediate payment.
sentences.cn: 字种市集在破晓时开门，每个摊位都要求立即付款。

sentences.en: 'No credit above the clouds,' the elder vendor said flatly.
sentences.cn: "云上没有赊账，"年长的商贩生硬地说。

sentences.en: 'Only *cash* — copper rounds or sky-glass chips.'
I counted my last three chips into her palm.
sentences.cn: 我把最后三枚晶片数进她的掌心。

sentences.en: She held each one up to the sun, and the third one cast a shadow shaped like a warning sign.
sentences.cn: 她把每一枚都举向太阳，第三枚投出的影子形成了一个警告的符号。

competition:1.en: Once a season the outer disciples gathered at the Sky-Split Bridge for the Word-Sprint — a *competition* to see who could light the bridge stones fastest by speaking the fire formula aloud. I placed third. But Xiaoxing, who placed last, whispered her word so gently that the final stone glowed warmest of all, long after the others had cooled.
competition:1.cnHint: 每季一次的字词____中，小星得了最后一名，她的石头却燃得最久。
competition:1.hook: A crack split the bridge's oldest stone the moment the scores were read.
competition:1.line: 'This *competition* reveals more than speed — it reveals your heart.'

sentences.en: Once a season the outer disciples gathered at the Sky-Split Bridge for the Word-Sprint — a *competition* to see who could light the bridge stones fastest by speaking the fire formula aloud.
I placed third.
sentences.cn: 我排名第三。

sentences.en: But Xiaoxing, who placed last, whispered her word so gently that the final stone glowed warmest of all, long after the others had cooled.
sentences.cn: 但排名最后的小杏，她说那个字时声音那么温柔，最后一块石头闪得最亮，远比其他的冷却得都晚。

farmer:1.en: On the lower terrace where herbs were grown in rows of cloud-soil, an old man knelt pressing seeds into the earth one by one. Shen Wujiu bowed low. 'He was a *farmer* before he joined the sect,' he told me. 'Master Qingwu says his hands know patience better than any formula.' The old man did not look up, but the seeds began to glow.
farmer:1.cnHint: 低台菜地里，曾是____的老人一粒一粒播种，他的双手比任何咒语都更懂得耐心。
farmer:1.hook: Every seed he had just planted spelled out a single, unreadable word.
farmer:1.line: 'He was a *farmer* before he ever touched a single word-herb.'

sentences.en: On the lower terrace where herbs were grown in rows of cloud-soil, an old man knelt pressing seeds into the earth one by one.
sentences.cn: 在下露台上，草药在一行行云土中生长，一个老人跪着一个一个地把种子按进土里。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu bowed low.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎深深鞠躬。

sentences.en: 'He was a *farmer* before he joined the sect,' he told me.
'Master Qingwu says his hands know patience better than any formula.'
sentences.cn: "青梧师尊说他的手比任何秘诀都更懂得耐心。"

sentences.en: The old man did not look up, but the seeds began to glow.
sentences.cn: 老人没有抬起头，但种子开始发光了。

collection:1.en: At the foot of the Sky-Root Cliff, Master Qingwu spread her *collection* of dried spirit-herbs across a wide stone table. Each root and petal had been gathered from a different floating peak. I knelt beside her, studying their colours, trying to learn which could cure and which could kill.
collection:1.cnHint: 师尊在悬崖石桌上展示她多年积累的____，我跪在一旁细心学习。
collection:1.hook: One herb, I noticed, had begun to glow.
collection:1.line: 'This *collection* took thirty years and three lives to complete,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: At the foot of the Sky-Root Cliff, Master Qingwu spread her *collection* of dried spirit-herbs across a wide stone table.
Each root and petal had been gathered from a different floating peak.
sentences.cn: 每一根根茎和花瓣都是从不同的浮动山峰上采集来的。

sentences.en: I knelt beside her, studying their colours, trying to learn which could cure and which could kill.
sentences.cn: 我跪在她身边，研究它们的颜色，试图学会哪些能治愈，哪些能杀死。

depression:1.en: Shen Wujiu found me sitting alone in a shallow *depression* in the mountain path, head low, eyes fixed on the clouds below. I had failed the morning recitation for the third time. He sat beside me without a word, and handed me a warm cup of pine-needle tea.
depression:1.cnHint: 师兄在山路的____处发现了垂头丧气的我，默默递来一杯热茶。
depression:1.hook: The tea tasted of something I could not yet name.
depression:1.line: 'A *depression* in stone still holds rainwater,' said Shen Wujiu softly.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu found me sitting alone in a shallow *depression* in the mountain path, head low, eyes fixed on the clouds below.
I had failed the morning recitation for the third time.
sentences.cn: 我第三次晨诵失败了。

sentences.en: He sat beside me without a word, and handed me a warm cup of pine-needle tea.
sentences.cn: 他在我身边坐下，没有说一个字，递给我一杯温热的松针茶。

foot:1.en: I stood at the *foot* of the Grand Stair, five hundred steps of white stone rising into low cloud. Every new disciple climbs it on the first dawn. Master Qingwu watched from above, still as a heron. I took one breath, lifted my heel, and began.
foot:1.cnHint: 我站在大台阶的____，准备踏上每位新弟子都必须攀登的五百级石阶。
foot:1.hook: At the hundredth step, the stone beneath me hummed.
foot:1.line: 'At the *foot* of this stair, many have already turned back,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: I stood at the *foot* of the Grand Stair, five hundred steps of white stone rising into low cloud.
Every new disciple climbs it on the first dawn.
sentences.cn: 每一个新弟子都要在第一个清晨爬上这五百阶白石。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched from above, still as a heron.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从上面看着，像一只苍鹭一样静止不动。

sentences.en: I took one breath, lifted my heel, and began.
sentences.cn: 我深吸一口气，抬起脚跟，开始往上爬。

graduate:1.en: Xiaoxing showed me the honour board near the outer gate, where the name of every *graduate* of the Cloud Sea Sect was carved in pale jade. She traced one name with her finger and smiled. 'My elder sister,' she said. The carving caught the morning light and shone briefly gold.
graduate:1.cnHint: 小星在荣誉碑上指给我看，每一位____的名字都刻在淡玉之上。
graduate:1.hook: One name near the top was still warm to the touch.
graduate:1.line: 'Every *graduate* carved here once stood exactly where you stand,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me the honour board near the outer gate, where the name of every *graduate* of the Cloud Sea Sect was carved in pale jade.
She traced one name with her finger and smiled.
sentences.cn: 她用手指描过一个名字，笑了。

sentences.en: 'My elder sister,' she said.
sentences.cn: "我的姐姐，"她说。

sentences.en: The carving caught the morning light and shone briefly gold.
sentences.cn: 那个刻字在晨光中闪烁，短暂地泛起金色。

intake:1.en: Master Qingwu watched my breathing during the dawn exercise and shook her head. 'Your *intake* is too sharp,' she said. 'You pull the cloud-qi in like a fist, not like an open hand.' Around us the morning mist moved gently between the pine trees, waiting to be invited, not seized.
intake:1.cnHint: 晨练时，师尊指出我气息的____方式过于急促，需要柔和如掌而非紧握如拳。
intake:1.hook: When I breathed correctly at last, the mist leaned toward me.
intake:1.line: 'Slow your *intake*, or the cloud-qi will scatter,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched my breathing during the dawn exercise and shook her head.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在晨练时看着我的呼吸，摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'Your *intake* is too sharp,' she said.
'You pull the cloud-qi in like a fist, not like an open hand.'
sentences.cn: "你像握拳一样吸入云气，而不是张开手掌去迎接。"

sentences.en: Around us the morning mist moved gently between the pine trees, waiting to be invited, not seized.
sentences.cn: 我们周围的晨雾在松树间温柔地流动，等待被邀请，而不是被强取。

screen:1.en: A bamboo *screen* stood at the entrance to the outer courtyard, painted with cranes and mist. Shen Wujiu told me it was not decoration. Words of warding were hidden inside the brushstrokes. Any disciple who could read them all was permitted to pass beyond it without an elder's company.
screen:1.cnHint: 外院入口处立着一扇竹制____，其笔画中藏着只有能读懂的弟子才能独自通过的护符文字。
screen:1.hook: I could almost read the third stroke — almost.
screen:1.line: 'The *screen* has turned away stronger disciples than you,' said Shen Wujiu, not unkindly.

sentences.en: A bamboo *screen* stood at the entrance to the outer courtyard, painted with cranes and mist.
Shen Wujiu told me it was not decoration.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎告诉我那不是装饰。

sentences.en: Words of warding were hidden inside the brushstrokes.
sentences.cn: 护咒的字被隐藏在笔画里面。

sentences.en: Any disciple who could read them all was permitted to pass beyond it without an elder's company.
sentences.cn: 任何能把它们全部读出来的弟子都可以不用长老陪同就穿过去。

chair:1.en: An empty *chair* sat at the centre of the debating ground, carved from cloud-iron wood and worn smooth by generations of use. Xiaoxing whispered that only the sect's chosen speaker may sit there during the great sky-forum. Today it was empty. Tomorrow, one disciple's name would be called.
chair:1.cnHint: 辩论场中央摆着一把____，小星悄声告诉我明天将有一名弟子被选中坐上它。
chair:1.hook: A single white feather rested on the seat.
chair:1.line: 'Whoever earns that *chair* speaks for all of us,' whispered Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: An empty *chair* sat at the centre of the debating ground, carved from cloud-iron wood and worn smooth by generations of use.
Xiaoxing whispered that only the sect's chosen speaker may sit there during the great sky-forum.
sentences.cn: 小杏低声说只有宗派选中的辩手才能在大论云坛时坐在那里。

sentences.en: Today it was empty.
sentences.cn: 今天椅子是空的。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, one disciple's name would be called.
sentences.cn: 明天就会有一个弟子的名字被念出来。

court:1.en: We crossed the stone *court* behind the Hall of First Words just as evening light turned the paving orange. Master Qingwu paused and looked up. A second moon, faint and bluish, hung beside the real one. She said nothing, but her sleeve tightened around her wrist as she walked on.
court:1.cnHint: 我们穿过初言堂后的石____时，师尊抬头看见了天上异常的第二轮月影。
court:1.hook: No record in the sect's history mentioned two moons.
court:1.line: 'Do not linger in this *court* after dark,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: We crossed the stone *court* behind the Hall of First Words just as evening light turned the paving orange.
Master Qingwu paused and looked up.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊停下来抬起头。

sentences.en: A second moon, faint and bluish, hung beside the real one.
sentences.cn: 一轮淡蓝色的月亮挂在真月旁边。

sentences.en: She said nothing, but her sleeve tightened around her wrist as she walked on.
sentences.cn: 她什么都没说，只是走的时候袖子在腕上紧了紧。

female:1.en: On the stone path below the Outer Gate, a small *female* crane stood apart from the flock, her feathers pale as morning cloud. Master Qingwu watched her without a word. Shen Wujiu leaned close and whispered that such birds only appeared before a great ascension. The crane turned one bright eye toward me.
female:1.cnHint: 外门石道上，师尊凝视着一只落单的____仙鹤，同门师兄低声说这预示着飞升将至。
female:1.hook: The crane opened her beak, and no sound came out.
female:1.line: 'That *female* crane has not moved since dawn,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: On the stone path below the Outer Gate, a small *female* crane stood apart from the flock, her feathers pale as morning cloud.
Master Qingwu watched her without a word.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊无言地看着她。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu leaned close and whispered that such birds only appeared before a great ascension.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎靠过来低声说这样的鸟只会在大飞升前出现。

sentences.en: The crane turned one bright eye toward me.
sentences.cn: 那只鹤转过一只明亮的眼睛看向我。

holiday:1.en: The Lantern Cloud *holiday* filled every terrace of the sect with soft gold light. Disciples hung herb-bundles from the rail posts and sang old formulas like folk songs. Xiaoxing pressed a small warm lantern into my hands, her eyes bright. Somewhere above us, a bell rang once, out of turn.
holiday:1.cnHint: 云灯____节，小星将一盏灯递给我，节日气氛中一声错时的钟声骤然响起。
holiday:1.hook: One lantern rose higher than all the rest, then vanished.
holiday:1.line: 'On this *holiday*, even the sky listens more closely,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: The Lantern Cloud *holiday* filled every terrace of the sect with soft gold light.
Disciples hung herb-bundles from the rail posts and sang old formulas like folk songs.
sentences.cn: 弟子们在栏杆柱子上挂起草药束，像唱民谣一样唱起古老的咒语。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small warm lantern into my hands, her eyes bright.
sentences.cn: 小杏把一盏温暖的小灯笼塞进我手里，眼睛闪闪发亮。

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, a bell rang once, out of turn.
sentences.cn: 我们上方某处，一口钟不合时宜地响了一下。

pain:1.en: I knelt on the cold summit terrace and pressed my palm to the cracked spirit-stone. The *pain* climbed my arm like a slow fire, yet Master Qingwu had said to hold on until the stone accepted me. Shen Wujiu stood at the edge, counting my breaths aloud to keep me steady.
pain:1.cnHint: 我跪在寒冷的山顶石台上，忍着____将手掌压在破裂的灵石上，师兄为我数着呼吸。
pain:1.hook: At the ninth breath, the crack in the stone began to glow.
pain:1.line: 'Bear the *pain* a little longer; the stone is almost warm,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: I knelt on the cold summit terrace and pressed my palm to the cracked spirit-stone.
sentences.cn: 我跪在冰冷的山顶平台上，把手掌按在裂开的灵石上。

sentences.en: The *pain* climbed my arm like a slow fire, yet Master Qingwu had said to hold on until the stone accepted me.
Shen Wujiu stood at the edge, counting my breaths aloud to keep me steady.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在边缘，大声数着我的呼吸，好让我保持平稳。

player:1.en: Near the sect's lower market, a traveling *player* tossed painted tiles into the air and caught them in patterns said to mirror the sixty-four cloud formations. A crowd gathered. Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve and pointed: one tile hung in the air a breath too long before it fell.
player:1.cnHint: 在宗门下市，一位卖艺____将彩砖抛入空中，小星拉住我，指着那枚在空中多停了一息的砖。
player:1.hook: The tile landed face-down, and the crowd went silent.
player:1.line: 'That *player* knows more than he shows,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: Near the sect's lower market, a traveling *player* tossed painted tiles into the air and caught them in patterns said to mirror the sixty-four cloud formations.
A crowd gathered.
sentences.cn: 围观的人越来越多。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve and pointed: one tile hung in the air a breath too long before it fell.
sentences.cn: 小杏扯着我的袖子指过去：一块瓷砖在空中停留了比平时长的一瞬才掉下来。

production:1.en: The sect's outer courtyard was busy with the morning *production* of cloud-ink, a thick silver liquid used to write ascension formulas on silk. Workers poured, stirred, and sealed clay jars in careful order. Shen Wujiu told me one dropped jar could erase a disciple's name from the sect record entirely.
production:1.cnHint: 宗门外院正忙着云墨的____，师兄告诉我，一罐云墨打碎便可抹去一名弟子的所有记录。
production:1.hook: One jar near the edge rocked, then stilled, then rocked again.
production:1.line: 'The *production* of cloud-ink must never be rushed,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: The sect's outer courtyard was busy with the morning *production* of cloud-ink, a thick silver liquid used to write ascension formulas on silk.
Workers poured, stirred, and sealed clay jars in careful order.
sentences.cn: 工人们小心有序地倒、搅、封装着陶罐。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me one dropped jar could erase a disciple's name from the sect record entirely.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎告诉我哪怕掉一个罐子都能把一个弟子的名字从宗派记录里彻底抹掉。

secure:1.en: Before the trial path opened, Master Qingwu walked the rope bridge herself and checked every knot. Only when she nodded did she call it *secure*. The bridge crossed nothing but open air and white cloud far below. I counted the knots as I stepped onto the first plank and lost count at seven.
secure:1.cnHint: 师尊亲自检查绳桥每个结，确认____后才示意我踏上去，桥下是无边的云海。
secure:1.hook: Halfway across, the bridge gave one long, slow shiver.
secure:1.line: 'The bridge is *secure*; walk without fear,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Before the trial path opened, Master Qingwu walked the rope bridge herself and checked every knot.
sentences.cn: 在试炼路开启之前，青梧师尊自己走过了绳桥，检查了每一个结。

sentences.en: Only when she nodded did she call it *secure*.
The bridge crossed nothing but open air and white cloud far below.
sentences.cn: 这座桥跨越的只有开阔的天空和远下方的白云。

sentences.en: I counted the knots as I stepped onto the first plank and lost count at seven.
sentences.cn: 我数着踏上第一块木板时的绳结，数到七就数不下去了。

audience:1.en: At dawn, Master Qingwu granted a formal *audience* on the outer cliff terrace, where the wind carried words away before they could be written down. I stood before her as mist moved between us. She asked only one question, and the answer I gave made her look past me, toward the rising sun.
audience:1.cnHint: 黎明时分，师尊在崖台上正式____我，她只问了一个问题，我的回答令她望向了初升的太阳。
audience:1.hook: She did not tell me whether my answer was right.
audience:1.line: 'This *audience* will shape your path more than any test,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: At dawn, Master Qingwu granted a formal *audience* on the outer cliff terrace, where the wind carried words away before they could be written down.
I stood before her as mist moved between us.
sentences.cn: 我站在她面前，雾气在我们之间流动。

sentences.en: She asked only one question, and the answer I gave made her look past me, toward the rising sun.
sentences.cn: 她只问了一个问题，我给出的答案让她的目光越过我，看向升起的太阳。

borrow:1.en: Xiaoxing caught me at the herb steps and asked if she could *borrow* my wind-formula tablet for the afternoon trial. She said her own had cracked in the frost. I handed it over without thinking, and only later noticed she had left her own cracked tablet in my bag as quiet thanks.
borrow:1.cnHint: 小星在药草台阶拦住我，请求____我的风诀玉简，还给我时我才发现她悄悄留下了她自己的碎玉简。
borrow:1.hook: The cracked tablet in my bag began to hum softly.
borrow:1.line: 'May I *borrow* your tablet, just until sunset?' Xiaoxing asked.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing caught me at the herb steps and asked if she could *borrow* my wind-formula tablet for the afternoon trial.
She said her own had cracked in the frost.
sentences.cn: 她说自己的在霜冻里裂了。

sentences.en: I handed it over without thinking, and only later noticed she had left her own cracked tablet in my bag as quiet thanks.
sentences.cn: 我没想就交给她了，后来才发现她把自己裂了的平板静悄悄地留在了我的包里作为感谢。

mile:1.en: The trial path wound across the open sky-platform, stretching a full *mile* between the starting stone and the Gate of Ascension. Master Qingwu stood at the far end, still as cloud. Each step I took felt heavier than the last, as though the air itself was testing my will to rise.
mile:1.cnHint: 弟子在天台上走完漫长的____，才能抵达飞升之门。
mile:1.hook: At the halfway mark, the Gate began to close.
mile:1.line: 'One *mile* of sky — walk it without fear, and the Gate will know you.'

sentences.en: The trial path wound across the open sky-platform, stretching a full *mile* between the starting stone and the Gate of Ascension.
Master Qingwu stood at the far end, still as cloud.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在远处，静得像云。

sentences.en: Each step I took felt heavier than the last, as though the air itself was testing my will to rise.
sentences.cn: 我迈出的每一步都比上一步更沉重，好像空气本身在考验我上升的意志。

movement:1.en: Before dawn, Master Qingwu gathered us on the outer terrace. 'Watch,' she said, and drew one slow arc with her sleeve. Every *movement* she made left a faint silver trail in the cold air, each trail a word of the Ascension Formula. I tried to copy her, but my trails faded before they could form.
movement:1.cnHint: 师尊在露台上演示飞升法诀，每一个____都在空中留下银色痕迹。
movement:1.hook: Mine faded — then one trace, at last, held.
movement:1.line: 'Each *movement* of your hand must carry intent, not just shape.'

sentences.en: Before dawn, Master Qingwu gathered us on the outer terrace.
sentences.cn: 天亮前，青梧师尊把我们聚在了外阳台上。

sentences.en: 'Watch,' she said, and drew one slow arc with her sleeve.
sentences.cn: "看，"她说，袖子轻轻划出一道弧线。

sentences.en: Every *movement* she made left a faint silver trail in the cold air, each trail a word of the Ascension Formula.
I tried to copy her, but my trails faded before they could form.
sentences.cn: 我试着模仿她，但我留下的轨迹还没成形就淡了。

party:1.en: A *party* of outer disciples arrived at the Cloud Gate just as the morning bell rang. Shen Wujiu counted them quietly — seven, all carrying sealed herb-cases. Master Qingwu frowned. 'They come from the South Peak,' she murmured. 'That sect does not share its formulas freely. Something has changed.'
party:1.cnHint: 一____弟子带着封印的药匣抵达云门，师尊神色凝重。
party:1.hook: Their herb-cases all bore the same broken seal.
party:1.line: 'The *party* from South Peak never travels without a reason — watch them.'

sentences.en: A *party* of outer disciples arrived at the Cloud Gate just as the morning bell rang.
Shen Wujiu counted them quietly — seven, all carrying sealed herb-cases.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎安静地数了数——七个，都提着密封的药盒。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu frowned.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊皱起眉头。

sentences.en: 'They come from the South Peak,' she murmured.
sentences.cn: "他们来自南峰，"她低声说。

sentences.en: 'That sect does not share its formulas freely.
sentences.cn: "那个宗派不会轻易分享功法。

sentences.en: Something has changed.'
sentences.cn: 有什么变了。"

rescue:1.en: High above the lower terraces, Xiaoxing had climbed too far chasing a rare wind-herb and now clung to a narrow ledge. Shen Wujiu leapt without a word. His sleeve caught her wrist at the last breath of a moment. The *rescue* was over in seconds, but my heart did not slow for a long time.
rescue:1.cnHint: 小星攀高台时险些坠落，师兄及时____了她。
rescue:1.hook: The wind-herb, freed, drifted upward — still unclaimed.
rescue:1.line: 'A *rescue* means nothing if you climb reckless again, little sister.'

sentences.en: High above the lower terraces, Xiaoxing had climbed too far chasing a rare wind-herb and now clung to a narrow ledge.
sentences.cn: 小杏为了采摘罕见的风草爬得太高，现在贴着一处窄窄的石壁。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu leapt without a word.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎没有多想，一跃而起。

sentences.en: His sleeve caught her wrist at the last breath of a moment.
sentences.cn: 他的袖子在最后一刻抓住了她的手腕。

sentences.en: The *rescue* was over in seconds, but my heart did not slow for a long time.

writing:1.en: Carved into the base of the Ascension Pillar was ancient *writing* I had never seen in any scroll. The characters curved like rising smoke. Master Qingwu knelt and touched one line gently. 'These are the original words of our founders,' she said. 'They still hold power. Read carefully — some lines are warnings.'
writing:1.cnHint: 飞升柱底部刻有上古____，师尊说其中藏有警示。
writing:1.hook: One carved line glowed faint red under her fingers.
writing:1.line: 'The *writing* on this pillar has not changed in three hundred years — until today.'

sentences.en: Carved into the base of the Ascension Pillar was ancient *writing* I had never seen in any scroll.
The characters curved like rising smoke.
sentences.cn: 那些字弯曲得像升起的烟。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu knelt and touched one line gently.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊跪下，轻轻触摸了其中一行。

sentences.en: 'These are the original words of our founders,' she said.
sentences.cn: "这些是我们祖师的原始言语，"她说。

sentences.en: 'They still hold power.
sentences.cn: "它们仍有力量。

sentences.en: Read carefully — some lines are warnings.'
sentences.cn: 仔细读——有些行是警告。"

bite:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small cloud-plum before the final trial. 'Eat,' he said simply. I took one *bite* and felt warmth spread from my chest to my fingertips. The sour-sweet taste sharpened my focus like a clear bell. Xiaoxing watched with wide eyes. Even a small thing, I realised, could shift one's whole bearing.
bite:1.cnHint: 师兄递来云梅，弟子____了一口，感到精神一振。
bite:1.hook: The warmth reached my palms just as the trial bell rang.
bite:1.line: 'One *bite* before a trial — it is a small kindness, but it counts.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small cloud-plum before the final trial.
sentences.cn: 最后的试炼前，沈无咎递给我一颗小小的云梅。

sentences.en: 'Eat,' he said simply.
sentences.cn: "吃，"他简单地说。

sentences.en: I took one *bite* and felt warmth spread from my chest to my fingertips.
The sour-sweet taste sharpened my focus like a clear bell.
sentences.cn: 那酸甜的滋味像清脆的钟声一样，让我的思绪变得清晰。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing watched with wide eyes.
sentences.cn: 小杏睁大了眼睛看着我。

sentences.en: Even a small thing, I realised, could shift one's whole bearing.
sentences.cn: 我才明白，再小的东西也能改变一个人的气质。

capture:1.en: Master Qingwu set a sphere of pure wind-light spinning above the platform. 'Your task,' she said, 'is to *capture* it with a single formula word before it rises beyond reach.' Shen Wujiu had done it in one breath. I raised my hand, shaped the word, and released — the sphere stilled for one perfect moment.
capture:1.cnHint: 师尊命弟子用法诀____旋转的风光球。
capture:1.hook: Then it shattered — and left a map in the air.
capture:1.line: 'To *capture* the light, you must first be as still as the light itself.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set a sphere of pure wind-light spinning above the platform.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在平台上方转动起一颗纯粹的风光之球。

sentences.en: 'Your task,' she said, 'is to *capture* it with a single formula word before it rises beyond reach.'
Shen Wujiu had done it in one breath.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎只用了一口气就做到了。

sentences.en: I raised my hand, shaped the word, and released — the sphere stilled for one perfect moment.
sentences.cn: 我抬起手，凝聚出那个字，释放开去——那颗球在完美的一刻停住了。

cope:1.en: The ascension winds hit without warning, spinning the outer walkway until I could not tell sky from cloud. Xiaoxing pressed her back against the pillar, eyes shut. I reached for her hand. Neither of us spoke. We had to *cope* with the storm together, step by careful step, until Master Qingwu's lamp appeared ahead.
cope:1.cnHint: 飞升风暴突然袭来，弟子与小星相互扶持，努力____。
cope:1.hook: Master Qingwu's lamp burned steady — but she was not holding it.
cope:1.line: 'We *cope* not by standing firm alone, but by holding the same ground together.'

sentences.en: The ascension winds hit without warning, spinning the outer walkway until I could not tell sky from cloud.
sentences.cn: 上升的风毫无预警地袭来，旋转着外走廊，让我分不清天和云。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed her back against the pillar, eyes shut.
sentences.cn: 小杏把背紧贴着柱子，眼睛紧闭。

sentences.en: I reached for her hand.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去握她的手。

sentences.en: Neither of us spoke.
sentences.cn: 我们都没有说话。

sentences.en: We had to *cope* with the storm together, step by careful step, until Master Qingwu's lamp appeared ahead.

salary:1.en: On the Grand Market terrace, floating stalls sold bottled starlight and dried cloud-moss. Master Qingwu examined each price tag with calm eyes. 'A disciple's *salary* of merit points,' she said, 'is earned breath by breath, not spent in a single morning.' I tucked my coin-pouch away, ashamed.
salary:1.cnHint: 师尊在云市告诫我，____要一点一滴地挣，不能一早上就花光。
salary:1.hook: But one stall held a price no merit points could ever cover.
salary:1.line: 'Your *salary* of merit points must be earned, not squandered.'

sentences.en: On the Grand Market terrace, floating stalls sold bottled starlight and dried cloud-moss.
sentences.cn: 在大市集的阳台上，浮空的摊位卖着装在瓶子里的星光和晒干的云苔。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu examined each price tag with calm eyes.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊镇定地审视着每一个价签。

sentences.en: 'A disciple's *salary* of merit points,' she said, 'is earned breath by breath, not spent in a single morning.'
I tucked my coin-pouch away, ashamed.
sentences.cn: 我尴尬地把钱袋收了起来。

shopping:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me through the Cloudbridge Bazaar, where herb-sellers called out from hovering baskets. He moved with ease, nodding at familiar faces. '*Shopping* here sharpens the eye,' he said, lifting a frost-root to the light. 'You learn which words heal and which merely look beautiful.' I watched and said nothing.
shopping:1.cnHint: 师兄带我在云桥集市____，说这能磨练辨别真伪的眼力。
shopping:1.hook: Then a vendor pressed a black herb into my hand and vanished.
shopping:1.line: '*Shopping* here will teach you more than any scroll can.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me through the Cloudbridge Bazaar, where herb-sellers called out from hovering baskets.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我穿过云桥集市，草药商人从悬浮的篮子里喊着叫卖。

sentences.en: He moved with ease, nodding at familiar faces. '*Shopping* here sharpens the eye,' he said, lifting a frost-root to the light.
'You learn which words heal and which merely look beautiful.'
sentences.cn: 你学会了哪些词能治愈，哪些只是看起来漂亮。

sentences.en: I watched and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 我看着，什么也没说。

tendency:1.en: We stood on the Sky-Root Bridge as morning mist rose from the cloud sea below. Master Qingwu traced the wind with one finger. 'You have a *tendency* to reach for power before you understand it,' she said quietly. The bridge hummed underfoot. Far below, something vast moved in the white folds of cloud.
tendency:1.cnHint: 师尊在天根桥上指出，我有一种在理解之前就抢先动手的____。
tendency:1.hook: The humming grew louder, as though the bridge itself disagreed.
tendency:1.line: 'Your *tendency* to rush will one day cost you something dear.'

sentences.en: We stood on the Sky-Root Bridge as morning mist rose from the cloud sea below.
sentences.cn: 我们站在天根桥上，晨雾从下方的云海升起。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu traced the wind with one finger.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用一根手指划过风。

sentences.en: 'You have a *tendency* to reach for power before you understand it,' she said quietly.
The bridge hummed underfoot.
sentences.cn: 桥在脚下嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: Far below, something vast moved in the white folds of cloud.
sentences.cn: 远下方，什么巨大的东西在白色的云褶里蠕动。

tough:1.en: The Path of Ascending Stones was a *tough* climb even for senior disciples, each slab tilting under wind that smelled of ozone and old lightning. Xiaoxing kept pace beside me, her breath steady. 'Do not look down,' she advised. Above us, the sect gate floated like a paper lantern against the pale sky.
tough:1.cnHint: 飞升石阶的攀爬十分____，连师兄们都走得艰难，师妹却气息平稳。
tough:1.hook: One stone tilted too far, and my foot found only sky.
tough:1.line: 'The road is *tough*, but the gate is already waiting for us.'

sentences.en: The Path of Ascending Stones was a *tough* climb even for senior disciples, each slab tilting under wind that smelled of ozone and old lightning.
Xiaoxing kept pace beside me, her breath steady.
sentences.cn: 小杏在我身边保持着步调，呼吸稳定。

sentences.en: 'Do not look down,' she advised.
sentences.cn: "不要往下看，"她劝我。

sentences.en: Above us, the sect gate floated like a paper lantern against the pale sky.
sentences.cn: 我们上方，宗派的门像纸灯笼一样漂浮在苍白的天空下。

tour:1.en: Every new disciple takes a *tour* of the outer peaks before their first lesson. Shen Wujiu walked ahead, naming each mountain in a low voice. The clouds shifted and revealed a peak I had not seen on any map. It floated apart from the others, wrapped in a silence that felt deliberate and cold.
tour:1.cnHint: 每位新弟子都要____外峰，师兄逐一报名，却有一座山不在地图上。
tour:1.hook: Shen Wujiu paused at that peak and did not say its name.
tour:1.line: 'Every disciple must *tour* the peaks before the trials begin.'

sentences.en: Every new disciple takes a *tour* of the outer peaks before their first lesson.
Shen Wujiu walked ahead, naming each mountain in a low voice.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎走在前面，用低沉的声音逐一说出每座山的名字。

sentences.en: The clouds shifted and revealed a peak I had not seen on any map.
sentences.cn: 云雾散开，露出了一座我从未在任何地图上看过的山峰。

sentences.en: It floated apart from the others, wrapped in a silence that felt deliberate and cold.
sentences.cn: 它飘离其他山峰，笼罩在一种刻意冷漠的寂静中。

wake:1.en: We gathered on the Dawn Platform as the sect's oldest word-tree was removed. Master Qingwu stood at its stump in silence. It was a quiet *wake* for something that had given shade and meaning for three hundred years. Petals drifted down through the cloud layer and did not return. Xiaoxing held her sleeve over her face.
wake:1.cnHint: 全门在晨台为一棵三百年的字树举行____，花瓣飘落后再未升回。
wake:1.hook: The stump began to glow, as though the tree refused to end.
wake:1.line: 'We hold this *wake* so the tree knows it is not forgotten.'

sentences.en: We gathered on the Dawn Platform as the sect's oldest word-tree was removed.
sentences.cn: 我们聚集在晨曦台，宗门最古老的字树被移走了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at its stump in silence.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在树桩旁，沉默无言。

sentences.en: It was a quiet *wake* for something that had given shade and meaning for three hundred years.
Petals drifted down through the cloud layer and did not return.
sentences.cn: 花瓣飘落穿过云层，再也没有回来。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing held her sleeve over her face.
sentences.cn: 小杏把袖子拉过脸去。

annual:1.en: The *annual* Sky-Herb Census drew every disciple to the outer terraces at first light. We counted blooms, recorded colours, and pressed samples into jade books. Xiaoxing found a herb that had no entry in any record. She looked up at me, brush still wet. Above us a cloud folded open like a slow eye.
annual:1.cnHint: 一年一度的____云草普查中，师妹发现了一株没有任何记录的草药。
annual:1.hook: The unrecorded herb pulsed once, then matched her heartbeat exactly.
annual:1.line: 'The *annual* census has never once turned up a herb like this.'

sentences.en: The *annual* Sky-Herb Census drew every disciple to the outer terraces at first light.
We counted blooms, recorded colours, and pressed samples into jade books.
sentences.cn: 我们数着花朵，记录颜色，把样本压进玉册里。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found a herb that had no entry in any record.
sentences.cn: 小杏找到了一种没有任何记录中的草药。

sentences.en: She looked up at me, brush still wet.
sentences.cn: 她抬头看我，笔还沾着湿润的墨。

sentences.en: Above us a cloud folded open like a slow eye.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶的云朵缓缓展开，如同睁开的眼睛。

charity:1.en: At the Cloud-Gate steps, a line of wandering cultivators waited for morning rations. Shen Wujiu handed out packets of spirit-grain without a word. 'This is not *charity*,' Master Qingwu said beside me, 'it is memory — we were all without a gate once.' A child at the end of the line held up an empty bowl and smiled.
charity:1.cnHint: 师尊说，在云门台阶发放灵粮不叫____，而是一种共同的记忆。
charity:1.hook: The child's empty bowl held a single word none of us could read.
charity:1.line: 'We do not call this *charity*; we call it memory returned.'

sentences.en: At the Cloud-Gate steps, a line of wandering cultivators waited for morning rations.
sentences.cn: 在云门的石阶上，一队流浪修士等待晨间的口粮。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed out packets of spirit-grain without a word.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎默默地分发灵谷包裹。

sentences.en: 'This is not *charity*,' Master Qingwu said beside me, 'it is memory — we were all without a gate once.'
A child at the end of the line held up an empty bowl and smiled.
sentences.cn: 队伍末尾的一个孩子举起空碗，绽开笑容。

burn:1.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, I watched Shen Wujiu press a glowing herb seal against his own wrist. The mark left a *burn* across his skin — not from carelessness, but as a bond of proof, showing the sect he had mastered the fire formula.
burn:1.cnHint: 师兄将一枚发光的草印按在自己手腕上，留下一道____，以此证明他已掌握火诀。
burn:1.hook: The sealed mark began to glow a second time.
burn:1.line: 'A *burn* like this means the formula has accepted you,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, I watched Shen Wujiu press a glowing herb seal against his own wrist.
sentences.cn: 在云海宗的外阳台上，我看着沈无咎将一枚发光的草药印章贴在自己的手腕上。

sentences.en: The mark left a *burn* across his skin — not from carelessness, but as a bond of proof, showing the sect he had mastered the fire formula.

cook:1.en: Below the east cliff, where morning mist rolled in from the sea of clouds, Xiaoxing knelt by a small stone stove. She began to *cook* three rare spirit herbs together, following a formula carved on a bamboo strip. The rising steam smelled of distant mountains.
cook:1.cnHint: 小星在悬崖下用石炉将三株灵草____在一起，蒸气带着远山的气息升起。
cook:1.hook: The bamboo strip cracked down the middle without warning.
cook:1.line: 'I will *cook* the herbs slowly — rushing breaks their spirit,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Below the east cliff, where morning mist rolled in from the sea of clouds, Xiaoxing knelt by a small stone stove.
sentences.cn: 在东崖下，清晨的雾气从云海翻涌而来，小杏跪在一个小石炉旁。

sentences.en: She began to *cook* three rare spirit herbs together, following a formula carved on a bamboo strip.
The rising steam smelled of distant mountains.
sentences.cn: 升起的蒸汽闻起来像远方的群山。

corporate:1.en: At the wide stone gate where new disciples gathered, Master Qingwu announced that the sect would seal a *corporate* oath with three allied mountain clans. Every disciple would share both the power and the duty. I felt the weight of it settle on my shoulders like fog.
corporate:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊宣布，本门将与三个山族订立____誓约，每位弟子都将共担其力与其责。
corporate:1.hook: One clan elder turned away before the oath was finished.
corporate:1.line: 'This *corporate* vow binds every one of us,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: At the wide stone gate where new disciples gathered, Master Qingwu announced that the sect would seal a *corporate* oath with three allied mountain clans.
Every disciple would share both the power and the duty.
sentences.cn: 每个弟子都要分担这份力量和责任。

sentences.en: I felt the weight of it settle on my shoulders like fog.
sentences.cn: 我感受到它如雾气般沉沉地落在我的肩膀上。

dangerous:1.en: The stone path to the upper terrace narrowed until it was barely a foot wide. Shen Wujiu walked it without looking down, but he told me clearly that the crossing was *dangerous* — the wind off the cloud sea could pull a disciple off the edge before they had time to call a formula.
dangerous:1.cnHint: 通往高台的石路极为____，云海来风可以在弟子念出法诀之前将其卷落。
dangerous:1.hook: A second gust came, stronger than the first.
dangerous:1.line: 'Do not linger here — this path is *dangerous* after noon,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The stone path to the upper terrace narrowed until it was barely a foot wide.
sentences.cn: 通向上阳台的石径越来越窄，最后只有一尺宽。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu walked it without looking down, but he told me clearly that the crossing was *dangerous* — the wind off the cloud sea could pull a disciple off the edge before they had time to call a formula.

debt:1.en: Outside the medicine hall, I found Xiaoxing standing very still, staring at a list carved into the stone wall. Each name on the list carried a number — a *debt* of spirit stones owed to the sect for herbs borrowed in hard seasons. Her own name was near the top.
debt:1.cnHint: 小星盯着石壁上的名单，那是弟子们向门派借取灵草所欠下的____记录，她的名字列在最前。
debt:1.hook: Someone had drawn a small mark beside her name overnight.
debt:1.line: 'I will clear every last *debt* before the next full moon,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Outside the medicine hall, I found Xiaoxing standing very still, staring at a list carved into the stone wall.
sentences.cn: 在药殿外，我发现小杏站得笔直，盯着刻在石墙上的一份名单。

sentences.en: Each name on the list carried a number — a *debt* of spirit stones owed to the sect for herbs borrowed in hard seasons.
Her own name was near the top.
sentences.cn: 她的名字靠近顶部。

discipline:1.en: On the open training ground swept by cool wind, Master Qingwu stood before the new disciples and spoke of *discipline* — not as punishment, but as the daily practice that lets a formula take root in the body the way a seed takes root in soil. We stood straighter without being told.
discipline:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在训练场上讲述____的意义：它不是惩罚，而是让法诀在体内生根的日常修行。
discipline:1.hook: At the edge of the ground, a dead herb suddenly put out one green leaf.
discipline:1.line: '*Discipline* is the soil in which your power grows,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: On the open training ground swept by cool wind, Master Qingwu stood before the new disciples and spoke of *discipline* — not as punishment, but as the daily practice that lets a formula take root in the body the way a seed takes root in soil.
We stood straighter without being told.
sentences.cn: 我们挺直了身子，没人说什么。

error:1.en: At the foot of the great observation pillar, I recited the wind-lift formula aloud for Shen Wujiu to judge. He stopped me at the third line. One small *error* in the middle phrase — a breath too short — would send a disciple rising too fast and scatter their spirit force across the sky.
error:1.cnHint: 师兄在我诵读风升诀时将我叫停，指出中间一处____：呼吸太短，会让灵力在半空中溃散。
error:1.hook: He asked me to recite it again from the very beginning.
error:1.line: 'Correct that one *error* now, before it becomes a habit,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: At the foot of the great observation pillar, I recited the wind-lift formula aloud for Shen Wujiu to judge.
sentences.cn: 在大观塔的塔脚下，我为沈无咎大声背诵风升诀。

sentences.en: He stopped me at the third line.
sentences.cn: 他在第三行停止了我。

sentences.en: One small *error* in the middle phrase — a breath too short — would send a disciple rising too fast and scatter their spirit force across the sky.

gym:1.en: Near the inner courtyard stood a low hall the older disciples called the *gym* of the cloud path — a training space where the body was shaped before the spirit could fly. Wooden posts, balance beams, and hanging stones waited in the early light. No formula could save a weak frame.
gym:1.cnHint: 内院附近有一座被称为云道____的修炼堂，弟子们在这里磨炼体魄，因为再强的法诀也撑不起一副弱骨。
gym:1.hook: The hall door stood open, and a faint mist drifted out.
gym:1.line: 'Meet me at the *gym* before sunrise — the body trains while the mind is still quiet,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Near the inner courtyard stood a low hall the older disciples called the *gym* of the cloud path — a training space where the body was shaped before the spirit could fly.
Wooden posts, balance beams, and hanging stones waited in the early light.
sentences.cn: 木桩、平衡木和悬挂的石头在晨光中等待着。

sentences.en: No formula could save a weak frame.
sentences.cn: 没有诀法能拯救虚弱的身躯。

couple:1.en: On the open sky-bridge between two floating peaks, I paused to watch a *couple* of elder disciples release paper lanterns together. Their quiet joy made the clouds below glow amber. Master Qingwu stood apart, watching them with an expression I could not read.
couple:1.cnHint: 在两座浮峰之间的天桥上，我看到一____弟子放灯，师尊默默注视着他们。
couple:1.hook: The lanterns stopped rising and began to fall.
couple:1.line: 'A *couple* of lanterns fell — that is no accident,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: On the open sky-bridge between two floating peaks, I paused to watch a *couple* of elder disciples release paper lanterns together.
Their quiet joy made the clouds below glow amber.
sentences.cn: 他们安静的喜悦让下方的云朵泛起琥珀色的光。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood apart, watching them with an expression I could not read.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在一旁，用一种我读不懂的表情看着他们。

definition:1.en: Shen Wujiu carved the herb's name into the stone wall beside the mountain gate. 'The *definition* of a healing word is not its sound,' he told me, 'but what it mends.' His brush paused, and a thin crack opened in the stone below the final stroke.
definition:1.cnHint: 师兄在山门旁石壁上刻写药草之名，解释____的真正含义，石壁却悄然裂开。
definition:1.hook: The crack spread upward, slow as a question.
definition:1.line: 'The *definition* you memorise is only the shell,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu carved the herb's name into the stone wall beside the mountain gate.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在山门旁的石墙上刻下了这株草的名字。

sentences.en: 'The *definition* of a healing word is not its sound,' he told me, 'but what it mends.'
His brush paused, and a thin crack opened in the stone below the final stroke.
sentences.cn: 他的笔停了，最后一笔下方的石头裂开了一道细缝。

imagination:1.en: I sat at the cliff's edge where young disciples sketched clouds to train their minds. Master Qingwu said that *imagination* is the first wind beneath any ascent — without it, even perfect technique is a bird with clipped wings. The clouds below us suddenly darkened.
imagination:1.cnHint: 师尊在崖边告诉弟子们，____是飞升的第一阵风，云海随即骤然变暗。
imagination:1.hook: Something vast moved beneath the clouds.
imagination:1.line: 'Your *imagination* must reach the peak before your feet do,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: I sat at the cliff's edge where young disciples sketched clouds to train their minds.
sentences.cn: 我坐在悬崖边上，年轻的弟子们在这里画云来修行。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said that *imagination* is the first wind beneath any ascent — without it, even perfect technique is a bird with clipped wings.
The clouds below us suddenly darkened.
sentences.cn: 我们下方的云突然暗了下来。

journey:1.en: The outer gate of Cloud Sea Sect opened only once each season. I watched three new disciples begin their *journey* up the nine-hundred steps, their robes snapping in cold wind. Xiaoxing stood beside me, counting each step under her breath as if memorising a formula.
journey:1.cnHint: 云海宗外门每季仅开一次，我看着三位新弟子踏上____，小星在身旁默默数着台阶。
journey:1.hook: At step four hundred, all three stopped at once.
journey:1.line: 'Every *journey* up these steps leaves something behind,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: The outer gate of Cloud Sea Sect opened only once each season.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的外门每个季节只打开一次。

sentences.en: I watched three new disciples begin their *journey* up the nine-hundred steps, their robes snapping in cold wind.
Xiaoxing stood beside me, counting each step under her breath as if memorising a formula.
sentences.cn: 小杏站在我身边，用低沉的嗓音数着每一级台阶，仿佛在背诵一个公式。

nearby:1.en: A strange herb grew *nearby*, rooted in a crack of the sky-bridge's railing, far above any soil. Shen Wujiu knelt to study it without touching it. Its leaves spelled a character none of us recognised, and the air around it tasted faintly of lightning.
nearby:1.cnHint: 天桥栏杆缝隙中，____长出一株奇异药草，师兄俯身查看，空气中隐隐有雷电之味。
nearby:1.hook: The character on its leaves slowly changed.
nearby:1.line: 'Something *nearby* is drawing power from below,' Shen Wujiu warned.

sentences.en: A strange herb grew *nearby*, rooted in a crack of the sky-bridge's railing, far above any soil.
Shen Wujiu knelt to study it without touching it.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎跪下研究它，但没有去碰它。

sentences.en: Its leaves spelled a character none of us recognised, and the air around it tasted faintly of lightning.
sentences.cn: 它的叶子拼出了我们都不认识的一个字，周围的空气闻起来隐隐有闪电的味道。

perspective:1.en: From the peak's narrow ledge, the entire valley of floating mountains spread below like scattered jade. Master Qingwu said that *perspective* is itself a kind of power — to see where others stand is to understand their weakness and their strength alike. A distant bell rang twice.
perspective:1.cnHint: 师尊在险峰窄台上说，____本身就是一种力量，远处随即传来两声钟鸣。
perspective:1.hook: The second bell had no echo.
perspective:1.line: 'From this *perspective*, even the strongest peak looks small,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: From the peak's narrow ledge, the entire valley of floating mountains spread below like scattered jade.
sentences.cn: 从峰顶的窄平台往下看，整个浮山谷像散落的翡翠一样展开。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said that *perspective* is itself a kind of power — to see where others stand is to understand their weakness and their strength alike.
A distant bell rang twice.
sentences.cn: 远处的钟敲响了两次。

requirement:1.en: Before any disciple could attempt ascension, there was one *requirement* beyond skill: you had to name the wind. I stood at the trial stone outside the hall, lips dry, while Xiaoxing whispered encouragement from the path behind me. The wind itself seemed to lean in and listen.
requirement:1.cnHint: 飞升考验有一项____超越技艺本身：你必须为风命名，小星在身后低声为我鼓劲。
requirement:1.hook: The wind stopped the moment I opened my mouth.
requirement:1.line: 'The only *requirement* is that you speak it true,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Before any disciple could attempt ascension, there was one *requirement* beyond skill: you had to name the wind.
I stood at the trial stone outside the hall, lips dry, while Xiaoxing whispered encouragement from the path behind me.
sentences.cn: 我站在大厅外的试炼石旁，嘴唇干涩，小杏在身后的小路上低声给我鼓劲。

sentences.en: The wind itself seemed to lean in and listen.
sentences.cn: 风本身似乎俯身倾听。

signal:1.en: A column of white smoke rose from the sect's outer watch-post, thin and perfectly straight. Shen Wujiu grabbed my sleeve. 'That smoke does not *signal* a visitor,' he said, his voice flat and careful. Across the sky-bridge, the gate lanterns flickered and went dark one by one.
signal:1.cnHint: 瞭望台升起一柱白烟，师兄拉住我的袖子说那烟____的并非来客，长廊灯笼随即相继熄灭。
signal:1.hook: The last lantern took the longest to die.
signal:1.line: 'Three puffs *signal* danger; this one has not stopped,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: A column of white smoke rose from the sect's outer watch-post, thin and perfectly straight.
sentences.cn: 一道白烟从宗派的外哨所升起，细长笔直。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu grabbed my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎抓住了我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'That smoke does not *signal* a visitor,' he said, his voice flat and careful.
Across the sky-bridge, the gate lanterns flickered and went dark one by one.
sentences.cn: 天桥对面，门灯逐盏熄灭了。

strength:1.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, Shen Wujiu handed me a pale green herb and said it held a single word: *strength*. 'Crush it between your palms,' he said. I did. Warmth moved up my arms and the heavy stone at my feet rose slowly into the bright air.
strength:1.cnHint: 师兄递给我一株草药，它蕴含着____的字诀，我将它握碎后感到一股力量涌遍全身。
strength:1.hook: Then the stone cracked down the middle, and something inside it began to glow.
strength:1.line: 'This herb carries the word *strength* — handle it with respect, or it will handle you.'

sentences.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, Shen Wujiu handed me a pale green herb and said it held a single word: *strength*.
'Crush it between your palms,' he said.
sentences.cn: "把它在你的掌心碾碎，"他说。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.cn: 我照做了。

sentences.en: Warmth moved up my arms and the heavy stone at my feet rose slowly into the bright air.
sentences.cn: 温暖沿着我的手臂向上蔓延，脚下沉重的石头慢慢升入明亮的空中。

survive:1.en: Xiaoxing led me to the edge of the floating mountain where the wind cut sharp and cold. She pointed to a small herb clinging to bare rock. 'Only those who hold the word *survive* can grow in a place like this,' she said quietly. I wrote the word on my palm and felt the cold become bearable.
survive:1.cnHint: 师妹指着悬崖边顽强生长的草药，说懂得____字诀的人才能在险境中坚持下去。
survive:1.hook: Far below, something large moved beneath the sea of clouds.
survive:1.line: 'To *survive* here, you must become as stubborn as the rock itself.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing led me to the edge of the floating mountain where the wind cut sharp and cold.
sentences.cn: 小杏带我走到浮山的边缘，那里的风锋利而刺骨。

sentences.en: She pointed to a small herb clinging to bare rock.
sentences.cn: 她指向紧贴裸岩的一株小草。

sentences.en: 'Only those who hold the word *survive* can grow in a place like this,' she said quietly.
I wrote the word on my palm and felt the cold become bearable.
sentences.cn: 我在掌心写下这个字，寒冷变得可以承受了。

touch:1.en: Master Qingwu stood before the word-stone in the morning mist. 'Do not reach for a formula you have not earned,' she said. I stepped forward anyway, and the lightest *touch* of my finger on the carved word sent a pulse of warm light through my whole body, then silence.
touch:1.cnHint: 师尊警告我不要轻易____那块字石，但我还是伸出了手指。
touch:1.hook: The carved word had changed shape by the time the light faded.
touch:1.line: 'A single *touch* of an unlearned word can undo a year of practice.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood before the word-stone in the morning mist.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在晨雾中的字石前。

sentences.en: 'Do not reach for a formula you have not earned,' she said.
sentences.cn: "不要去触碰你还没有赚取的公式，"她说。

sentences.en: I stepped forward anyway, and the lightest *touch* of my finger on the carved word sent a pulse of warm light through my whole body, then silence.

trap:1.en: Shen Wujiu warned me about the lower cloud paths before dawn. 'Old sects sometimes plant a false formula in the mist — a word that looks like healing but pulls your spirit down.' I stopped walking. The glowing character drifting toward me was beautiful, and I understood at last what a *trap* could look like.
trap:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我云雾中漂浮的那个发光字符是个____，看起来像治愈的字诀，实则会伤人。
trap:1.hook: The character drifted closer, still smiling with soft light.
trap:1.line: 'That glowing word is a *trap* — do not speak it, do not even breathe near it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu warned me about the lower cloud paths before dawn.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在黎明前警告我下层的云路。

sentences.en: 'Old sects sometimes plant a false formula in the mist — a word that looks like healing but pulls your spirit down.'
sentences.cn: "老派系有时会在雾中埋下假公式——看似治愈的字，却会把你的灵魂往下拉。"

sentences.en: I stopped walking.
sentences.cn: 我停下了脚步。

sentences.en: The glowing character drifting toward me was beautiful, and I understood at last what a *trap* could look like.

tv:1.en: A merchant from the lower towns had carried a small glowing box onto the mountain path, calling it a *tv*. He said it showed moving pictures of the outside world. Xiaoxing looked at it with calm eyes. 'Down there, people learn from images,' she said. 'Up here, we learn from living words.' The box flickered once, then went dark.
tv:1.cnHint: 一个商人带来了一台____，师妹平静地说山上的人用活字诀学习，不靠图像。
tv:1.hook: In the sudden dark, a single glowing character rose from the dead screen.
tv:1.line: 'A *tv* shows the world as a picture — a living word lets you step inside it.'

sentences.en: A merchant from the lower towns had carried a small glowing box onto the mountain path, calling it a *tv*.
He said it showed moving pictures of the outside world.
sentences.cn: 他说这是一个显示外面世界动态画面的东西。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing looked at it with calm eyes.
sentences.cn: 小杏用平静的眼神看着它。

sentences.en: 'Down there, people learn from images,' she said.
sentences.cn: "下面那些地方，人们从画面里学习，"她说。

sentences.en: 'Up here, we learn from living words.'
sentences.cn: "这里，我们从活的字里学习。"

sentences.en: The box flickered once, then went dark.
sentences.cn: 盒子闪了一下，然后熄灭了。

victim:1.en: Master Qingwu gathered us at the mountain gate at dusk. She spoke of a young disciple from long ago who had swallowed three formulas at once without a teacher's guidance. 'He became a *victim* of his own hurry,' she said, her voice steady. 'The words fought inside him until there was quiet.' She did not say what kind of quiet.
victim:1.cnHint: 师尊讲述了一个因贪快而成为自己急于求成的____的弟子的故事。
victim:1.hook: A cold wind rose, and the gate lantern bent sideways without going out.
victim:1.line: 'Do not become a *victim* of your own impatience on this mountain.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu gathered us at the mountain gate at dusk.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在暮色中把我们聚集在山门前。

sentences.en: She spoke of a young disciple from long ago who had swallowed three formulas at once without a teacher's guidance.
sentences.cn: 她讲起很久以前一个年轻弟子，没有师父指引就一口吞了三道法诀。

sentences.en: 'He became a *victim* of his own hurry,' she said, her voice steady.
'The words fought inside him until there was quiet.'
sentences.cn: 那些字在他身体里相互争执，直到一切归于寂静。

sentences.en: She did not say what kind of quiet.
sentences.cn: 她没有说那是什么样的寂静。

zone:1.en: Shen Wujiu drew a circle in the air above the east courtyard. 'This is the silent *zone*,' he said, 'where unspoken words take shape on their own.' I stepped inside. Every sound fell away. Somewhere near the centre, a pale character I had never studied before rose slowly from the ground and waited.
zone:1.cnHint: 师兄指出东院有一片特殊的____，在那里未曾出口的字诀会自己成形。
zone:1.hook: The character did not disappear when I stepped back across the line.
zone:1.line: 'Inside this *zone*, even a thought you have not finished can become a formula.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu drew a circle in the air above the east courtyard.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在东院上空画了一个圆。

sentences.en: 'This is the silent *zone*,' he said, 'where unspoken words take shape on their own.'
I stepped inside.
sentences.cn: 我走了进去。

sentences.en: Every sound fell away.
sentences.cn: 每一丝声音都消散了。

sentences.en: Somewhere near the centre, a pale character I had never studied before rose slowly from the ground and waited.
sentences.cn: 靠近中心的某处，一个我从未学过的苍白字影缓缓从地上升起，在那儿等待。

afraid:1.en: Before my first public recitation, Xiaoxing stood beside me on the open platform high above the clouds. My voice would not come. 'I know you are *afraid*,' she said, not unkindly. 'But the words can feel that too, and they go quiet when you do.' I breathed. I spoke. The first formula rose from my lips like smoke finding open sky.
afraid:1.cnHint: 师妹察觉我在公开诵咒前很____，温和地提醒我字诀会感受到我的情绪。
afraid:1.hook: Below us, the sea of clouds parted in a ring, as if something had been listening.
afraid:1.line: 'Being *afraid* is allowed — but let the word out before the fear closes your throat.'

sentences.en: Before my first public recitation, Xiaoxing stood beside me on the open platform high above the clouds.
sentences.cn: 在我第一次公开诵咒之前，小杏站在高高悬于云上的露台边陪我。

sentences.en: My voice would not come.
sentences.cn: 我的声音怎么都发不出来。

sentences.en: 'I know you are *afraid*,' she said, not unkindly.
'But the words can feel that too, and they go quiet when you do.'
sentences.cn: 但那些字也能感受到你的害怕，你一害怕它们就会沉默。

sentences.en: I breathed.
sentences.cn: 我深吸一口气。

sentences.en: I spoke.
sentences.cn: 我开口了。

sentences.en: The first formula rose from my lips like smoke finding open sky.
sentences.cn: 第一道法诀从我唇间升起，像烟雾找到了开阔的天空。

persuade:1.en: On the outer terrace of the sect, morning mist curled between stone pillars. Shen Wujiu stood at the edge, staring down at the clouds far below. I tried every reason I knew to *persuade* him to step back from the rim before the wind shifted.
persuade:1.cnHint: 我在悬台边努力____师兄离开危险的边缘。
persuade:1.hook: His foot moved — but not away from the edge.
persuade:1.line: 'Nothing you say will *persuade* me to leave this spot,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: On the outer terrace of the sect, morning mist curled between stone pillars.
sentences.cn: 在派系的外台上，晨雾在石柱之间缠绕。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the edge, staring down at the clouds far below.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在边缘，凝视着下方远处的云海。

sentences.en: I tried every reason I knew to *persuade* him to step back from the rim before the wind shifted.

preference:1.en: Master Qingwu laid three spiritual herbs on the flat stone before us. Each path of study demanded a different one. Xiaoxing reached at once for the silver root, but Master Qingwu said our *preference* mattered less than what the herb chose for us.
preference:1.cnHint: 师尊说，比起我们的____，灵草自有其选择。
preference:1.hook: The silver root rolled away from every hand that reached for it.
preference:1.line: 'Your *preference* is noted, child, but the herb has its own opinion,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu laid three spiritual herbs on the flat stone before us.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我们面前的平石上放了三种灵草。

sentences.en: Each path of study demanded a different one.
sentences.cn: 每一条修行之路都需要不同的一种。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing reached at once for the silver root, but Master Qingwu said our *preference* mattered less than what the herb chose for us.

reliable:1.en: The stone path down the mountain had crumbled in three places after the night wind. Shen Wujiu tested each step before waving me forward. He was the most *reliable* guide the sect had, and still he paused at the last broken stone, frowning.
reliable:1.cnHint: 师兄是公认最____的向导，却在碎石前皱起了眉头。
reliable:1.hook: Beyond the last stone, the path had simply disappeared.
reliable:1.line: 'I am told I am *reliable*, yet today the mountain disagrees,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The stone path down the mountain had crumbled in three places after the night wind.
sentences.cn: 夜风过后，山下的石板路有三处崩塌了。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu tested each step before waving me forward.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎逐步试探，然后招手让我跟上。

sentences.en: He was the most *reliable* guide the sect had, and still he paused at the last broken stone, frowning.

suspect:1.en: A faint smell of burnt bark rose from the herb garden near the outer gate. No fire was visible, yet the grey soil was warm under my palm. I began to *suspect* that someone had passed through before dawn, drawing energy from the roots without permission.
suspect:1.cnHint: 药园泥土仍带余温，我开始____有人趁夜盗取灵气。
suspect:1.hook: A single footprint in the ash pointed toward the inner hall.
suspect:1.line: 'I *suspect* this garden has had an uninvited visitor,' said Master Qingwu softly.

sentences.en: A faint smell of burnt bark rose from the herb garden near the outer gate.
sentences.cn: 外门附近的草药园飘来一阵烧焦树皮的淡淡气味。

sentences.en: No fire was visible, yet the grey soil was warm under my palm.
sentences.cn: 看不见火，但灰色的土壤在我掌心是温热的。

sentences.en: I began to *suspect* that someone had passed through before dawn, drawing energy from the roots without permission.

yield:1.en: The climb to the upper terrace was steep, and my legs burned with every step. Shen Wujiu moved ahead without slowing. I refused to let my body *yield* to the pain, placing one foot above the other until the white peak came into view at last.
yield:1.cnHint: 我拒绝向疲惫____，一步一步攀上了白色山顶。
yield:1.hook: At the summit, a door stood open that had been sealed for a century.
yield:1.line: 'Do not *yield* to the mountain,' called Xiaoxing from below. 'It is watching you.'

sentences.en: The climb to the upper terrace was steep, and my legs burned with every step.
sentences.cn: 爬上上层露台的路很陡，每一步我的腿都在灼烧。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu moved ahead without slowing.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在前面走着，步伐没有放缓。

sentences.en: I refused to let my body *yield* to the pain, placing one foot above the other until the white peak came into view at last.

abandon:1.en: The old pavilion at the edge of the cloud terrace had been empty for many seasons. Vines covered the pillars and the roof sagged. Master Qingwu told us that a disciple had chosen to *abandon* all study and walk into the clouds alone, long before our time.
abandon:1.cnHint: 师尊说，曾有弟子____修行，独自走入云海消失不见。
abandon:1.hook: Inside the pavilion, a single candle was still warm.
abandon:1.line: 'To *abandon* one's path here,' said Master Qingwu, 'is to become the wind.'

sentences.en: The old pavilion at the edge of the cloud terrace had been empty for many seasons.
sentences.cn: 云台边缘的老亭子已经空置了很多季节。

sentences.en: Vines covered the pillars and the roof sagged.
sentences.cn: 藤蔓覆盖了柱子，屋顶也塌陷了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told us that a disciple had chosen to *abandon* all study and walk into the clouds alone, long before our time.

anxious:1.en: The morning bell rang twice, which meant an assessment was near. I stood in the outer courtyard, turning my herb pouch over and over in my hands. Xiaoxing noticed and smiled. She said being *anxious* before a trial meant you still cared, and caring was the first lesson.
anxious:1.cnHint: 小星说，考验前感到____，正说明你心中仍有所求。
anxious:1.hook: Then the bell rang a third time, which no one had ever heard before.
anxious:1.line: 'You look *anxious*,' said Xiaoxing. 'Good. That means you are ready.'

sentences.en: The morning bell rang twice, which meant an assessment was near.
sentences.cn: 晨钟敲了两声，说明考验即将到来。

sentences.en: I stood in the outer courtyard, turning my herb pouch over and over in my hands.
sentences.cn: 我站在外院里，一遍遍翻转手中的草药袋。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing noticed and smiled.
sentences.cn: 小杏注意到了，笑了。

sentences.en: She said being *anxious* before a trial meant you still cared, and caring was the first lesson.

assess:1.en: Master Qingwu walked slowly around the circle of disciples gathered on the open platform above the clouds. She paused before each one, saying nothing. To *assess* a student here meant reading the colour of their breath in the cold air, not the words on any scroll.
assess:1.cnHint: 师尊在云台上逐一____每位弟子，看的是寒气中呼吸的颜色。
assess:1.hook: She stopped before me the longest, and her eyes grew still.
assess:1.line: 'I *assess* you not by your words,' said Master Qingwu, 'but by your silence.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu walked slowly around the circle of disciples gathered on the open platform above the clouds.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊缓缓走过聚集在云上露台的弟子们围成的圆圈。

sentences.en: She paused before each one, saying nothing.
sentences.cn: 她在每个人面前停下，什么都不说。

sentences.en: To *assess* a student here meant reading the colour of their breath in the cold air, not the words on any scroll.

behave:1.en: On the outer terrace where disciples gathered each morning, Master Qingwu watched us recite the Wind-Step formula. Shen Wujiu stood perfectly still, breath even, eyes forward. I tried to copy him. 'A word-herb only blooms for those who *behave* with full attention,' Master Qingwu said, her voice soft as cloud-mist.
behave:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊观察弟子们在露台上诵读风步诀，提醒大家要____得当。
behave:1.hook: Then the wind stopped, and every herb on the terrace wilted at once.
behave:1.line: '*Behave* with full attention, or the formula will never open for you.'

sentences.en: On the outer terrace where disciples gathered each morning, Master Qingwu watched us recite the Wind-Step formula.
sentences.cn: 在弟子们每天早上聚集的外台上，青梧师尊看着我们诵咒御风步。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood perfectly still, breath even, eyes forward.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站得笔直，呼吸平稳，目光向前。

sentences.en: I tried to copy him.
sentences.cn: 我试着模仿他。

sentences.en: 'A word-herb only blooms for those who *behave* with full attention,' Master Qingwu said, her voice soft as cloud-mist.

cent:1.en: At the mountain-gate market, travelling merchants spread their wares on low wooden tables. Xiaoxing lifted a tiny seed that glowed faint amber. The merchant shook his head. 'Not a *cent* less than ten silver pieces — that seed holds the Breath-Root word, the rarest syllable on any floating peak,' he said firmly.
cent:1.cnHint: 在山门集市上，小星想购买一粒珍贵的种子，商人坚持价格不让一____。
cent:1.hook: The seed pulsed once, then cracked open on Xiaoxing's palm.
cent:1.line: 'I will not take a *cent* less — this syllable feeds the whole mountain.'

sentences.en: At the mountain-gate market, travelling merchants spread their wares on low wooden tables.
sentences.cn: 山门集市上，行商们把货物铺在矮木桌上。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing lifted a tiny seed that glowed faint amber.
sentences.cn: 小杏拿起一粒泛着淡琥珀色光芒的细小种子。

sentences.en: The merchant shook his head.
sentences.cn: 商人摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'Not a *cent* less than ten silver pieces — that seed holds the Breath-Root word, the rarest syllable on any floating peak,' he said firmly.

commercial:1.en: Below our peak, a wide stone bridge connected two trading summits. Shen Wujiu called it the most *commercial* path in the Cloud Sea Sect, where cultivators exchanged word-scrolls for spirit stones every dawn. I had never seen so many voices bargaining at once, each traded syllable hanging in the air like coloured smoke.
commercial:1.cnHint: 云海宗有一条繁忙的____通道，修士们在此以字卷换灵石。
commercial:1.hook: One bargained syllable drifted loose and began to change colour.
commercial:1.line: 'This is the most *commercial* bridge in the sect — stay close and guard your scrolls.'

sentences.en: Below our peak, a wide stone bridge connected two trading summits.
sentences.cn: 我们山峰下方，一座宽阔的石桥连接了两个贸易峰。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu called it the most *commercial* path in the Cloud Sea Sect, where cultivators exchanged word-scrolls for spirit stones every dawn.
I had never seen so many voices bargaining at once, each traded syllable hanging in the air like coloured smoke.
sentences.cn: 我从未见过这么多的声音同时讨价还价，每一个被交易的音节都像彩烟一样悬浮在空气中。

death:1.en: Outside the eastern gate, a stone pillar listed the names of disciples lost to the Trial of Hollow Winds. I counted twelve names. Master Qingwu placed one hand on the pillar. 'Each name here chose a word beyond their strength,' she said quietly. 'The *death* of a disciple is the silence left where a voice should be.'
death:1.cnHint: 东门石碑记录着在空风试炼中牺牲的弟子名字，师尊讲述了____的含义。
death:1.hook: My own name seemed to shimmer at the very bottom of the stone.
death:1.line: 'The *death* of a voice leaves a silence no formula can fill.'

sentences.en: Outside the eastern gate, a stone pillar listed the names of disciples lost to the Trial of Hollow Winds.
sentences.cn: 东门外，一块石碑上刻着那些在空心之风试炼中丧生的弟子名字。

sentences.en: I counted twelve names.
sentences.cn: 我数了数，共有十二个名字。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed one hand on the pillar.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把一只手放在石碑上。

sentences.en: 'Each name here chose a word beyond their strength,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "这里的每一个名字都选了超出自己力量的字音，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: 'The *death* of a disciple is the silence left where a voice should be.'

escape:1.en: A sudden storm of wild word-fragments swept the open courtyard near the cliff's edge. Disciples ran for the covered walkways. I pressed against a stone pillar, watching the bright shards cut the air. There was no *escape* through the main path; the fragments circled like hunting birds, blocking every stone step down.
escape:1.cnHint: 野生字符碎片突然席卷露天庭院，弟子们无路____。
escape:1.hook: One shard stopped in mid-air and slowly turned to face me.
escape:1.line: 'There is no *escape* that way — follow me under the stone arch!'

sentences.en: A sudden storm of wild word-fragments swept the open courtyard near the cliff's edge.
sentences.cn: 突然，一阵野生的字音碎片风暴扫过悬崖边的空地。

sentences.en: Disciples ran for the covered walkways.
sentences.cn: 弟子们向廊下跑去。

sentences.en: I pressed against a stone pillar, watching the bright shards cut the air.
sentences.cn: 我贴着一根石柱，看着明亮的碎片切割空气。

sentences.en: There was no *escape* through the main path; the fragments circled like hunting birds, blocking every stone step down.

expose:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a ridge where the morning light was strongest. 'Stand here and *expose* your word-core to the sun,' he said. 'Hidden flaws in a formula show as dark lines when the light passes through.' I opened my palm and held the syllable up. Three thin shadows crossed it like cracks in old jade.
expose:1.cnHint: 师兄让我在山脊上将字核____在晨光中，以检验其中的暗纹裂缝。
expose:1.hook: The third shadow moved on its own, sliding toward my wrist.
expose:1.line: '*Expose* your word-core to full light — hidden flaws cannot hide from the sun.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a ridge where the morning light was strongest.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我来到一处晨光最强的山脊。

sentences.en: 'Stand here and *expose* your word-core to the sun,' he said.
'Hidden flaws in a formula show as dark lines when the light passes through.'
sentences.cn: "字式中隐藏的缺陷在光线穿过时会显示为暗线，"他说。

sentences.en: I opened my palm and held the syllable up.
sentences.cn: 我张开掌心，把那个音节举向阳光。

sentences.en: Three thin shadows crossed it like cracks in old jade.
sentences.cn: 三条细细的影子像老玉上的裂纹一样穿过它。

floor:1.en: The sect's great library was carved into the cliff face, seven levels high. Master Qingwu brought our group to the third *floor*, where the shelves held living scrolls that murmured softly in the dark. The syllables inside them drifted against the paper like moths. I reached toward one and felt warmth against my fingers.
floor:1.cnHint: 师尊带弟子们前往藏书楼第三____，那里存放着会低语的活体字卷。
floor:1.hook: Every scroll on that shelf turned to face me at the same moment.
floor:1.line: 'On this *floor* the scrolls choose their readers — do not reach first.'

sentences.en: The sect's great library was carved into the cliff face, seven levels high.
sentences.cn: 宗派的大图书馆是在悬崖面上开凿出来的，有七层高。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu brought our group to the third *floor*, where the shelves held living scrolls that murmured softly in the dark.
The syllables inside them drifted against the paper like moths.
sentences.cn: 里面的音节像飞蛾一样贴着纸张飘动。

sentences.en: I reached toward one and felt warmth against my fingers.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去触碰其中一个，感到指尖传来温热。

foundation:1.en: On the wide practice ground at the base of the mountain, Xiaoxing traced a large circle in the stone dust. 'This circle is the *foundation* of the Ascending-Cloud step,' she explained, 'without it, no other movement holds.' She walked its edge once, and the dust rose around her in a perfect spiral, steady and bright.
foundation:1.cnHint: 小星在山脚修炼场向我讲解，这个圆形图案是飞升步法的____。
foundation:1.hook: When the dust settled, her footprints had risen three inches above the ground.
foundation:1.line: 'Without this circle as your *foundation*, the step will scatter like morning mist.'

sentences.en: On the wide practice ground at the base of the mountain, Xiaoxing traced a large circle in the stone dust.
sentences.cn: 在山脚的宽阔练功场上，小杏在石土里画了一个大圆。

sentences.en: 'This circle is the *foundation* of the Ascending-Cloud step,' she explained, 'without it, no other movement holds.'
She walked its edge once, and the dust rose around her in a perfect spiral, steady and bright.
sentences.cn: 她沿着圆边行走一遍，尘土在她周围升起，形成完美而明亮的螺旋。

employment:1.en: Outside the sect gate, merchants lined the stone path, each offering *employment* to new disciples — carry this herb, guard that cart, copy these scrolls. Shen Wujiu walked past them all without slowing. 'The only work worth taking,' he said quietly, 'grows inside you.' A cold wind rose from the cloud sea below, scattering petals no tree had shed.
employment:1.cnHint: 在宗门外，有人向新弟子提供____，但师兄却头也不回地走过。
employment:1.hook: The petals spelled a character none of us could read.
employment:1.line: 'True *employment* of your gift begins the moment you stop looking outward.'

sentences.en: Outside the sect gate, merchants lined the stone path, each offering *employment* to new disciples — carry this herb, guard that cart, copy these scrolls.
Shen Wujiu walked past them all without slowing.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从他们身边走过，没有放慢脚步。

sentences.en: 'The only work worth taking,' he said quietly, 'grows inside you.'
sentences.cn: "唯一值得去做的工作，"他轻声说，"是在你心里生长的那种。"

sentences.en: A cold wind rose from the cloud sea below, scattering petals no tree had shed.
sentences.cn: 云海下方吹起一阵冷风，吹散了没有任何树木飘落的花瓣。

entire:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a narrow scroll on the open-air terrace. The *entire* mountain range — seven peaks, forty-two valleys, one forbidden ridge — was drawn in a single breath of ink.
