'Learn every name here,' she said, 'before the first snow.' Far below, something large moved beneath the cloud sea, bending the mist into slow circles.
entire:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊将____山脉的地图展开，要求弟子在初雪前记住所有地名。
entire:1.hook: The forbidden ridge had no name written on it — only a smudge.
entire:1.line: 'The *entire* map must live in your mind before you speak a single word aloud.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a narrow scroll on the open-air terrace.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在露天平台上展开了一卷狭长的卷轴。

sentences.en: The *entire* mountain range — seven peaks, forty-two valleys, one forbidden ridge — was drawn in a single breath of ink.
'Learn every name here,' she said, 'before the first snow.'
sentences.cn: "学会这里的每一个名字，"她说，"在第一场雪降临之前。"

sentences.en: Far below, something large moved beneath the cloud sea, bending the mist into slow circles.
sentences.cn: 远方的云海下，有什么巨大的东西在移动，把雾气弯曲成缓慢的圆圈。

gift:1.en: Xiaoxing placed a small clay jar in my hands at the morning gate. 'A *gift* for your first full week,' she said, smiling. Inside was a pressed herb that smelled of pine and old rain — a word-herb, she explained, one that steadied the breath before recitation. I looked up to thank her, but she had already disappeared into the cloud below the bridge.
gift:1.cnHint: 小星在晨门送给我一份____，是一株能让呼吸平稳的词草。
gift:1.hook: The jar was warm, though no fire had touched it.
gift:1.line: 'Every *gift* on this mountain carries a small debt — remember that.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing placed a small clay jar in my hands at the morning gate.
sentences.cn: 小杏在晨门口把一个小陶罐放进我的手里。

sentences.en: 'A *gift* for your first full week,' she said, smiling.
Inside was a pressed herb that smelled of pine and old rain — a word-herb, she explained, one that steadied the breath before recitation.
sentences.cn: 里面是一株被压干的草药，闻起来有松木和陈雨的气息——她解释说，这是一种字药，能在诵念前稳定呼吸。

sentences.en: I looked up to thank her, but she had already disappeared into the cloud below the bridge.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头想向她道谢，可她已经消失在桥下的云海中了。

kitchen:1.en: Behind the Hall of Echoing Words stood the sect *kitchen*, where herbs were sorted by sound rather than smell. Shen Wujiu showed me the long shelves: words for heat on the left, words for cold on the right. 'Taste none without asking,' he warned. Through the open window, the cloud sea glowed a deep amber, though the sun had already set.
kitchen:1.cnHint: 在回音堂后面的____里，草药按声音而非气味分类排列。
kitchen:1.hook: One jar on the highest shelf hummed faintly without being touched.
kitchen:1.line: 'In this *kitchen*, the wrong word in your mouth can boil your blood.'

sentences.en: Behind the Hall of Echoing Words stood the sect *kitchen*, where herbs were sorted by sound rather than smell.
Shen Wujiu showed me the long shelves: words for heat on the left, words for cold on the right.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎指给我看那些长长的架子：散发热感的字音在左边，散发冷感的字音在右边。

sentences.en: 'Taste none without asking,' he warned.
sentences.cn: "没有询问就别尝任何东西，"他警告说。

sentences.en: Through the open window, the cloud sea glowed a deep amber, though the sun had already set.
sentences.cn: 透过开着的窗户，云海泛着深琥珀色的光芒，虽然太阳早已落下。

mystery:1.en: The old notice board near the east gate held one line that no disciple could explain: 'The first word is also the last.' Xiaoxing called it a *mystery* left by a founder whose name the sect no longer spoke aloud. I copied the line into my journal three times. That night, the ink dried in a shape that was not what I had written.
mystery:1.cnHint: 东门告示牌上有一句谁也解不开的____，而我抄录后墨迹竟变了形。
mystery:1.hook: By morning, the notice board itself was blank.
mystery:1.line: 'The deepest *mystery* is not a question — it is a word waiting for the right speaker.'

sentences.en: The old notice board near the east gate held one line that no disciple could explain: 'The first word is also the last.'
sentences.cn: 东门附近的旧公告板上有一行没有任何弟子能解释的文字："第一个字音也是最后一个。"

sentences.en: Xiaoxing called it a *mystery* left by a founder whose name the sect no longer spoke aloud.
I copied the line into my journal three times.
sentences.cn: 我在日志里把这句话抄了三遍。

sentences.en: That night, the ink dried in a shape that was not what I had written.
sentences.cn: 那晚，墨迹干透时呈现出的形状不是我写的样子。

opposite:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood me at the wide overlook and pointed to the peak *opposite* ours, a pale spire half-hidden in cloud. 'That is where words go when disciples forget them,' he said. I almost laughed, until I saw a faint light moving in the spire's windows — a light that moved like someone reading. No bridge connected the two peaks.
opposite:1.cnHint: 师兄指着对面____山峰说，弟子遗忘的词语都会去那里。
opposite:1.hook: The light in the far spire paused, then turned to face us.
opposite:1.line: 'The peak *opposite* us remembers everything we choose to lose.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood me at the wide overlook and pointed to the peak *opposite* ours, a pale spire half-hidden in cloud.
'That is where words go when disciples forget them,' he said.
sentences.cn: '那是弟子遗忘的词语去的地方，'他说。

sentences.en: I almost laughed, until I saw a faint light moving in the spire's windows — a light that moved like someone reading.
sentences.cn: 我几乎笑出声，直到看见那塔楼窗口有微弱的光在移动——像是有人在读书的光。

sentences.en: No bridge connected the two peaks.
sentences.cn: 两座山峰之间没有桥连接。

permanent:1.en: Master Qingwu pressed one finger to the stone railing of the outdoor corridor, and a single character appeared, carved deep and clean. 'Nothing here is *permanent*,' she said, 'except the mark a truly spoken word leaves in the air.' The carving faded within ten breaths — but I could still feel it, like a warm coal, long after the stone was smooth again.
permanent:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在石栏上刻下一个字，说明这里没有什么是____的，除了真言留下的印记。
permanent:1.hook: My own palm itched where I had touched the railing the day before.
permanent:1.line: 'Only a word spoken without fear becomes *permanent* in the cloud sea's memory.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu pressed one finger to the stone railing of the outdoor corridor, and a single character appeared, carved deep and clean.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用一根手指按在户外走廊的石栏杆上，一个字迹出现了，雕刻得深而清晰。

sentences.en: 'Nothing here is *permanent*,' she said, 'except the mark a truly spoken word leaves in the air.'
The carving faded within ten breaths — but I could still feel it, like a warm coal, long after the stone was smooth again.
sentences.cn: 石头上的刻痕在十个呼吸内褪去了——但我能感到它，像一块温热的炭火，远在石头再次光滑后很久。

plenty:1.en: The market terrace above the main gate had *plenty* of stalls on arrival day — jars of stored sound, bundles of written breath, small vials of names no one used anymore. I had no coins, so I only looked. A merchant met my eyes and slid one tiny vial across the counter without a word. I walked away quickly, not sure if it was kindness or a test.
plenty:1.cnHint: 宗门入口的集市上____各类词草摊位，一位商人无声地递给我一只小瓶。
plenty:1.hook: The vial grew heavier with every step I took away from the stall.
plenty:1.line: 'There is *plenty* here for those who know how to listen before they buy.'

sentences.en: The market terrace above the main gate had *plenty* of stalls on arrival day — jars of stored sound, bundles of written breath, small vials of names no one used anymore.
I had no coins, so I only looked.
sentences.cn: 我没有硬币，所以我只能看。

sentences.en: A merchant met my eyes and slid one tiny vial across the counter without a word.
sentences.cn: 一个商人与我对视，无言地把一个小玻璃瓶推过柜台。

sentences.en: I walked away quickly, not sure if it was kindness or a test.
sentences.cn: 我匆忙走开，不确定这是善意还是一场考验。

strike:1.en: The disciples gathered on the outer terrace as dawn broke over the cloud sea. Master Qingwu raised one hand, and silence fell like dew. 'A word spoken with full spirit can *strike* through stone,' she said, 'but only if the speaker believes it first.' I pressed my palm against the cold railing and felt something stir in my chest.
strike:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉弟子们，一个充满灵力的词语可以____穿石头。
strike:1.hook: Then a crack split the railing beneath my hand.
strike:1.line: 'A word spoken with full spirit can *strike* through stone.'

sentences.en: The disciples gathered on the outer terrace as dawn broke over the cloud sea.
sentences.cn: 弟子们聚集在外露台上，天色破晓照亮云海。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu raised one hand, and silence fell like dew.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊抬起一只手，寂静像露水一样降临。

sentences.en: 'A word spoken with full spirit can *strike* through stone,' she said, 'but only if the speaker believes it first.'
I pressed my palm against the cold railing and felt something stir in my chest.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌贴在冰冷的栏杆上，感到胸中有什么东西开始蠢动。

television:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the Sect's archive hall, where smooth spirit-mirrors lined every wall. Each mirror showed a distant mountain in real time — peaks burning with dawn light, mist rivers flowing below. 'We call this wall our *television*,' he said with a quiet smile, 'because it tells and it shows, all at once.' One mirror flickered dark.
television:1.cnHint: 同门师兄把灵镜墙称为____，因为它既能传递信息又能展示画面。
television:1.hook: The darkened mirror began to show something moving inside it.
television:1.line: 'We call this wall our *television* — it tells and it shows, all at once.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the Sect's archive hall, where smooth spirit-mirrors lined every wall.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎领我去了宗派的档案厅，那里光滑的灵镜排满了每一面墙。

sentences.en: Each mirror showed a distant mountain in real time — peaks burning with dawn light, mist rivers flowing below.
sentences.cn: 每面镜子都实时显示一座远处的山峰——山峰燃烧着晨光，雾河在下方流动。

sentences.en: 'We call this wall our *television*,' he said with a quiet smile, 'because it tells and it shows, all at once.'
One mirror flickered dark.
sentences.cn: 一面镜子闪烁着黑暗。

youth:1.en: I sat beside Xiaoxing on the stone steps at the mountain's edge, both of us watching clouds drift past like slow breath. She said that Master Qingwu had once told her every disciple carries the energy of *youth* like a lamp — bright but quick to burn. I looked at my hands and wondered how much flame I had left.
youth:1.cnHint: 小星说师尊曾提到，每位弟子都像一盏灯，带着____的光芒。
youth:1.hook: Far below, a lamp appeared in the clouds where no lamp should be.
youth:1.line: 'Master Qingwu says every disciple carries the energy of *youth* like a lamp.'

sentences.en: I sat beside Xiaoxing on the stone steps at the mountain's edge, both of us watching clouds drift past like slow breath.
sentences.cn: 我和小杏并肩坐在山边的石阶上，两人看着云像缓慢的呼吸一样漂流而过。

sentences.en: She said that Master Qingwu had once told her every disciple carries the energy of *youth* like a lamp — bright but quick to burn.
I looked at my hands and wondered how much flame I had left.
sentences.cn: 我看着自己的双手，想知道还剩多少火焰。

alter:1.en: On the flat practice ground between two pine trees, Master Qingwu asked me to speak the word for wind. I said it three times, each time louder, but the air stayed still. 'You must *alter* your breath before the word,' she said calmly, 'or the sky simply will not listen.' I breathed out slowly, changed my tone — and a single leaf lifted.
alter:1.cnHint: 师尊教导我，在说出词语之前，必须先____自己的气息。
alter:1.hook: The leaf rose higher than any wind could carry it.
alter:1.line: 'You must *alter* your breath before the word, or the sky will not listen.'

sentences.en: On the flat practice ground between two pine trees, Master Qingwu asked me to speak the word for wind.
sentences.cn: 在两棵松树之间的平坦练功场上，青梧师尊让我说风这个字。

sentences.en: I said it three times, each time louder, but the air stayed still.
sentences.cn: 我说了三遍，每次都更大声，但空气始终没有动静。

sentences.en: 'You must *alter* your breath before the word,' she said calmly, 'or the sky simply will not listen.'
I breathed out slowly, changed my tone — and a single leaf lifted.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓呼出气，改变了音调——一片树叶飘起来了。

approximately:1.en: Shen Wujiu paced the outer path, counting his steps aloud. He told me the Cloud Sea Sect mountain was *approximately* three hundred paces wide at its base, and that a disciple who could speak the full circle in one breath might, in theory, lift the whole peak. He stopped pacing. He looked at me. Neither of us spoke.
approximately:1.cnHint: 同门师兄告诉我，山脚____有三百步宽，而能一口气念完一圈的弟子也许能举起整座山峰。
approximately:1.hook: Beneath our feet, the stone gave one slow, low hum.
approximately:1.line: 'The mountain is *approximately* three hundred paces wide at its base.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu paced the outer path, counting his steps aloud.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在外面的小路上踱步，大声数着他的脚步。

sentences.en: He told me the Cloud Sea Sect mountain was *approximately* three hundred paces wide at its base, and that a disciple who could speak the full circle in one breath might, in theory, lift the whole peak.
He stopped pacing.
sentences.cn: 他停止踱步。

sentences.en: He looked at me.
sentences.cn: 他看着我。

sentences.en: Neither of us spoke.
sentences.cn: 我们都没有说话。

attractive:1.en: Xiaoxing showed me a spirit herb she had gathered that morning — its petals a pale gold that shifted in the light. 'It is *attractive*, yes,' she said, 'but the words that grow from it bite back if you mispronounce them.' She placed it gently in her bag and tied it shut. A sweet scent drifted past, then vanished too quickly.
attractive:1.cnHint: 小星提醒我，那株灵草看起来____，但如果念错从它生长出的词语，词语会反噬修炼者。
attractive:1.hook: The sweet scent returned — from a direction where nothing grew.
attractive:1.line: 'It is *attractive*, yes, but the words that grow from it bite back if you mispronounce them.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me a spirit herb she had gathered that morning — its petals a pale gold that shifted in the light.
sentences.cn: 小杏给我看了她那天早上采集的灵草——花瓣是在光线中闪闪发光的淡金色。

sentences.en: 'It is *attractive*, yes,' she said, 'but the words that grow from it bite back if you mispronounce them.'
She placed it gently in her bag and tied it shut.
sentences.cn: 她轻轻地把它放进袋子，系上了口。

sentences.en: A sweet scent drifted past, then vanished too quickly.
sentences.cn: 一阵甜蜜的香气飘过，然后消散得太快了。

bag:1.en: Master Qingwu set a worn cloth *bag* on the courtyard stone and told us to name what was inside before opening it. Shen Wujiu said 'seed.' Xiaoxing said 'ash.' I said 'a word not yet spoken.' Master Qingwu looked at me for a long moment, then opened the bag and showed us three folded slips of paper, each blank.
bag:1.cnHint: 师尊让弟子们猜____里装的是什么，我的回答让师尊沉默了片刻。
bag:1.hook: The blank slips of paper began, very slowly, to fill with characters.
bag:1.line: 'Name what is inside this *bag* before you open it — that is today's lesson.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set a worn cloth *bag* on the courtyard stone and told us to name what was inside before opening it.
Shen Wujiu said 'seed.'
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说'种子'。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing said 'ash.'
sentences.cn: 小杏说'灰烬'。

sentences.en: I said 'a word not yet spoken.'
sentences.cn: 我说'一个还没被说过的词'。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu looked at me for a long moment, then opened the bag and showed us three folded slips of paper, each blank.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊看了我很久，然后打开袋子，给我们看三张折叠的纸片，每张都是空白的。

beat:1.en: At the morning drill, Master Qingwu struck a small stone drum, and each *beat* marked the moment a disciple had to release one spoken word into the air. Miss the beat, lose the word. I missed my third mark and felt the half-formed syllable dissolve on my tongue like cold fog. Shen Wujiu caught my eye and gave the smallest nod.
beat:1.cnHint: 晨练时，每一声鼓____都是弟子必须说出一个词语的时刻，错过节拍词语就会消散。
beat:1.hook: On the seventh beat, the drum cracked clean in two.
beat:1.line: 'Each *beat* is your only chance — let the word go or it is gone forever.'

sentences.en: At the morning drill, Master Qingwu struck a small stone drum, and each *beat* marked the moment a disciple had to release one spoken word into the air.
Miss the beat, lose the word.
sentences.cn: 错过节拍，词语就丢了。

sentences.en: I missed my third mark and felt the half-formed syllable dissolve on my tongue like cold fog.
sentences.cn: 我错过了第三次标记，感到半成形的音节像冷雾一样在舌尖消散。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu caught my eye and gave the smallest nod.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎捕捉到我的目光，给了最细微的点头。

preserve:1.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect sat open to the sky, jars of spirit-words lined along a stone shelf. Master Qingwu moved slowly between them, pressing fresh wax over each lid. 'We must *preserve* these words,' she said, 'or the frost will drain their power before the new disciples can learn them.' I counted the jars. One was already cracked.
preserve:1.cnHint: 师尊在露天石台上封存灵字药罐，叮嘱弟子要____它们，我却发现其中一只已经裂开。
preserve:1.hook: A thin, silver mist crept up from the cracked jar and would not stop.
preserve:1.line: 'We must *preserve* these words, or the frost will take them before dawn.'

sentences.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect sat open to the sky, jars of spirit-words lined along a stone shelf.
sentences.cn: 云海宗派的外院坐落在开放的天空下，灵词的坛子沿着一块石板排成一行。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu moved slowly between them, pressing fresh wax over each lid.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在它们之间缓缓移动，在每个盖子上压新的蜡。

sentences.en: 'We must *preserve* these words,' she said, 'or the frost will drain their power before the new disciples can learn them.'
I counted the jars.
sentences.cn: 我数了数坛子的个数。

sentences.en: One was already cracked.
sentences.cn: 有一个已经裂了。

procedure:1.en: Outside the Gate of Rising Winds, Shen Wujiu walked me through each step of the morning rite. 'There is a strict *procedure*,' he said, drawing each motion in the air with his finger. 'Miss one step and the word-formula collapses back into silence.' I followed carefully. On my third attempt, the air shimmered — then went still far too quickly.
procedure:1.cnHint: 师兄在山门外教我晨课仪式的____，我按步骤练习，第三次时灵气忽然凝聚又迅速消散。
procedure:1.hook: The silence that followed felt less like calm and more like a held breath.
procedure:1.line: 'Follow the *procedure* exactly — one skipped step and the formula dies.'

sentences.en: Outside the Gate of Rising Winds, Shen Wujiu walked me through each step of the morning rite.
sentences.cn: 在升风门外，沈无咎一步步教我进行晨间仪式。

sentences.en: 'There is a strict *procedure*,' he said, drawing each motion in the air with his finger.
'Miss one step and the word-formula collapses back into silence.'
sentences.cn: 漏掉一个步骤，咒语就会崩塌回沉默。

sentences.en: I followed carefully.
sentences.cn: 我小心地跟着做。

sentences.en: On my third attempt, the air shimmered — then went still far too quickly.
sentences.cn: 第三次尝试时，空气闪烁了一下——然后停滞得太快了。

reasonable:1.en: Xiaoxing and I sat on the courtyard steps, sorting dried word-petals into small pouches. She argued that three petals of 'calm' were enough for one dose. I said five. 'Three is *reasonable*,' she insisted, holding the pouch up to the pale morning light. 'Five would dull the edge entirely.' The wind shifted, carrying a low hum from the mountain above us.
reasonable:1.cnHint: 师妹在院子里与我争论每剂灵字花瓣的用量，她认为三瓣已经____，山上随即传来低沉的嗡鸣声。
reasonable:1.hook: The hum grew, and the petals in her palm began to tremble.
reasonable:1.line: 'Three petals is *reasonable* — any more and the word loses its edge.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing and I sat on the courtyard steps, sorting dried word-petals into small pouches.
sentences.cn: 小杏和我坐在院子的台阶上，把干燥的字花分装进小袋子里。

sentences.en: She argued that three petals of 'calm' were enough for one dose.
sentences.cn: 她辩称一份剂量用三片"宁静"就足够了。

sentences.en: I said five.
sentences.cn: 我说要五片。

sentences.en: 'Three is *reasonable*,' she insisted, holding the pouch up to the pale morning light.
'Five would dull the edge entirely.'
sentences.cn: 五片会把效果完全钝化。

sentences.en: The wind shifted, carrying a low hum from the mountain above us.
sentences.cn: 风向转了，山上传来一阵低沉的嗡鸣。

reduction:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the open cliff edge, facing the sea of clouds below. She explained that carving a word too deep into stone causes a *reduction* in its living force — the meaning becomes fixed, unable to breathe. I pressed my palm to the carved pillar beside me and felt it: cold, flat, emptied. Somewhere behind us, a bell rang once without being struck.
reduction:1.cnHint: 师尊在悬崖边讲解将灵字深刻入石会造成其灵力的____，我触摸石柱时真切感受到了那份空洞，身后铜钟无故响了一声。
reduction:1.hook: The bell's echo faded upward, not outward, as though the sky had swallowed it.
reduction:1.line: 'Cutting too deep causes a *reduction* in the word's living force — it forgets how to breathe.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the open cliff edge, facing the sea of clouds below.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在敞开的崖边，面朝下方的云海。

sentences.en: She explained that carving a word too deep into stone causes a *reduction* in its living force — the meaning becomes fixed, unable to breathe.
I pressed my palm to the carved pillar beside me and felt it: cold, flat, emptied.
sentences.cn: 我按住身边刻在柱子上的字，感受到了——冰冷、平板、被掏空了。

sentences.en: Somewhere behind us, a bell rang once without being struck.
sentences.cn: 我们身后某处，一口钟无人敲击却自鸣了一声。

season:1.en: It was the high *season* of cloud-bloom, when the sea of mist below the mountains swells and rises toward the stone paths. Shen Wujiu said word-formulas learned during this time take root more deeply, fed by the damp spiritual air. I practiced the lifting word at the edge of the lower path until my feet left the stone by three finger-widths. Then the cloud swelled higher than it should.
season:1.cnHint: 云海花开的____里，师兄说此时习得的灵字根基最深，我在小径边练习腾升术，云层却忽然异常地涌高。
season:1.hook: The cloud did not stop rising, and within it something moved with clear intent.
season:1.line: 'This *season* of cloud-bloom feeds the words — practice now and they will stay with you.'

sentences.en: It was the high *season* of cloud-bloom, when the sea of mist below the mountains swells and rises toward the stone paths.
Shen Wujiu said word-formulas learned during this time take root more deeply, fed by the damp spiritual air.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说在这个时期学的咒语会扎根更深，被潮湿的灵气滋养。

sentences.en: I practiced the lifting word at the edge of the lower path until my feet left the stone by three finger-widths.
sentences.cn: 我在下方小路的边缘练习升浮咒，直到脚离开石头有三指宽。

sentences.en: Then the cloud swelled higher than it should.
sentences.cn: 然后云海涨得比它应该涨的还高。

sector:1.en: The Cloud Sea Sect's mountain was divided by old boundary stones. Master Qingwu pointed to the eastern *sector*, where the stones glowed faintly amber. 'That area holds the oldest word-seeds,' she said. 'No disciple enters without escort.' I looked toward it from the main path. One of the boundary stones had tipped slightly, leaning inward as if something from inside had pushed it.
sector:1.cnHint: 师尊指出山上东侧____存有最古老的灵字种，禁止弟子单独进入，而我看见一块界石已向内倾斜。
sector:1.hook: The amber glow on that stone pulsed once, then shifted to a cold, pale green.
sector:1.line: 'The eastern *sector* holds the oldest seeds — no one enters it alone.'

sentences.en: The Cloud Sea Sect's mountain was divided by old boundary stones.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的山被古老的界石分割开了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu pointed to the eastern *sector*, where the stones glowed faintly amber.
'That area holds the oldest word-seeds,' she said.
sentences.cn: 那片区域存放着最古老的字种。

sentences.en: 'No disciple enters without escort.'
sentences.cn: 没有弟子可以独自进去。

sentences.en: I looked toward it from the main path.
sentences.cn: 我从主路向那边看去。

sentences.en: One of the boundary stones had tipped slightly, leaning inward as if something from inside had pushed it.
sentences.cn: 其中一块界石轻微地倾斜了，向内倾倒，仿佛里面有什么东西推过它。

setting:1.en: Xiaoxing chose a flat rock near the outer stream as her study place. 'The *setting* matters,' she told me, arranging three word-stones in a triangle at her feet. 'A restless place gives you restless words.' The stream here was calm and the light even. I settled beside her and opened my practice scroll. The words on it rearranged themselves into an order I had not written.
setting:1.cnHint: 师妹说修习灵字要注重____，在溪边将三枚字石摆成三角，我打开练习卷轴，字迹却自行排列成了我从未写过的顺序。
setting:1.hook: The new order spelled a warning none of us had been taught to read.
setting:1.line: 'The *setting* matters — a restless place will give you restless words.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing chose a flat rock near the outer stream as her study place.
sentences.cn: 小杏在外溪边选了块平坦的石头作为她的学习地点。

sentences.en: 'The *setting* matters,' she told me, arranging three word-stones in a triangle at her feet.
'A restless place gives you restless words.'
sentences.cn: 一个不安的地方会给你不安的字。

sentences.en: The stream here was calm and the light even.
sentences.cn: 这里的溪水很平静，光线也很均匀。

sentences.en: I settled beside her and opened my practice scroll.
sentences.cn: 我在她身边坐下，打开了我的练习卷。

sentences.en: The words on it rearranged themselves into an order I had not written.
sentences.cn: 上面的字重新排列成了我没有写过的顺序。

shrink:1.en: We stood in the outer plaza as Master Qingwu demonstrated the word for stillness. As she spoke it, the flame in the stone lantern began to *shrink* — not go out, but pull inward, tight and bright, smaller than a seed. 'When a word is fully held,' she said, 'it gathers rather than spreads.' The flame held its tiny shape for a long breath. Then, all at once, every other lantern in the plaza went dark.
shrink:1.cnHint: 师尊在广场上演示静止灵字，石灯中的火焰开始____并凝聚成极小的亮点，话音未落，广场上其余所有灯笼同时熄灭。
shrink:1.hook: In the sudden dark, the single bright seed of flame cast no shadow at all.
shrink:1.line: 'Watch how the flame will *shrink* and gather — that is a word being fully held.'

sentences.en: We stood in the outer plaza as Master Qingwu demonstrated the word for stillness.
sentences.cn: 我们站在外广场上，青梧师尊演示了"寂静"这个字。

sentences.en: As she spoke it, the flame in the stone lantern began to *shrink* — not go out, but pull inward, tight and bright, smaller than a seed.
'When a word is fully held,' she said, 'it gathers rather than spreads.'
sentences.cn: 当一个字被完全掌握时，它会汇聚而非扩散。

sentences.en: The flame held its tiny shape for a long breath.
sentences.cn: 火焰保持了这个微小的形状好几个呼吸。

sentences.en: Then, all at once, every other lantern in the plaza went dark.
sentences.cn: 然后，瞬间，广场里所有其他的灯笼都熄灭了。

frame:1.en: At the gate of the Cloud Sea Sect, a great stone arch rose against the morning sky. Master Qingwu called it the *frame* of our world — every word-herb we would ever learn must first pass through it, carried on breath and intention. I stood beneath it, small and trembling, and felt the stone hum.
frame:1.cnHint: 弟子站在门派石拱门下，师尊说这是整个修炼世界的____。
frame:1.hook: Behind me, the gate sealed shut with a sound like a drawn sword.
frame:1.line: 'This *frame* holds every word you will ever need,' said Master Qingwu, touching the carved stone.

sentences.en: At the gate of the Cloud Sea Sect, a great stone arch rose against the morning sky.
sentences.cn: 在云海宗的门前，一座巨大的石拱门矗立在晨曦中。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu called it the *frame* of our world — every word-herb we would ever learn must first pass through it, carried on breath and intention.
I stood beneath it, small and trembling, and felt the stone hum.
sentences.cn: 我站在它下面，瘦小而颤抖，感受到石头发出嗡鸣。

friday:1.en: On *Friday*, the market path along the cloud-bridge filled with wandering herb-traders, each calling out word-formulas like merchants selling silk. Shen Wujiu pulled me through the crowd, naming every chant we passed. By evening my mind was full and buzzing, the way a hive feels before it swarms.
friday:1.cnHint: ____这天，云桥市集热闹非凡，师兄带我穿过叫卖咒语的人群。
friday:1.hook: One trader met my eyes and said nothing — and that silence was louder than all the rest.
friday:1.line: 'Every *Friday* the rarest word-herbs arrive at this bridge,' Shen Wujiu told me, eyes bright.

sentences.en: On *Friday*, the market path along the cloud-bridge filled with wandering herb-traders, each calling out word-formulas like merchants selling silk.
Shen Wujiu pulled me through the crowd, naming every chant we passed.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎拉着我穿过人群，说出我们经过的每一个咒语。

sentences.en: By evening my mind was full and buzzing, the way a hive feels before it swarms.
sentences.cn: 到了傍晚我的脑子满满的、嗡嗡作响，像一个蜂巢在准备分群。

grain:1.en: Xiaoxing crouched at the edge of the platform and poured a handful of golden dust into the open air. Each tiny *grain* was a seed-word, she said — plant one in still water and it would grow into a healing chant by dawn. The grains caught the light and fell, slow as snow, into the clouds below.
grain:1.cnHint: 师妹将每一粒金色尘埃——每一____字种——撒入云海之中。
grain:1.hook: Not one grain came back up, but something else, faintly, did.
grain:1.line: 'Each *grain* holds one word of the healing formula,' Xiaoxing said softly, opening her palm.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing crouched at the edge of the platform and poured a handful of golden dust into the open air.
sentences.cn: 小杏蹲在平台边缘，把一把金色的粉末倒进开阔的空气中。

sentences.en: Each tiny *grain* was a seed-word, she said — plant one in still water and it would grow into a healing chant by dawn.
The grains caught the light and fell, slow as snow, into the clouds below.
sentences.cn: 粉粒捕捉着光线下落，缓缓如雪，落入下方的云雾中。

implication:1.en: Master Qingwu wrote a single word on the stone floor and asked what it meant. I named its surface sense, proud and quick. She shook her head. 'You miss the *implication*,' she said — the hidden pull beneath the word, the way it tied the speaker to the sky. I looked again and felt the ground tilt.
implication:1.cnHint: 师尊写下一个字，我只读出字面，却错过了它深藏的____。
implication:1.hook: The word on the stone began, very slowly, to glow.
implication:1.line: 'The *implication* of that word is what gives it power,' Master Qingwu said, voice low.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu wrote a single word on the stone floor and asked what it meant.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石地板上写了一个字，问我是什么意思。

sentences.en: I named its surface sense, proud and quick.
sentences.cn: 我很快地说出了它的表面意思，很得意。

sentences.en: She shook her head.
sentences.cn: 她摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'You miss the *implication*,' she said — the hidden pull beneath the word, the way it tied the speaker to the sky.
I looked again and felt the ground tilt.
sentences.cn: 我再看一遍，感到地面倾斜了。

incredible:1.en: From the outer terrace I watched Shen Wujiu release a spoken formula into the wind. What followed was *incredible* — the cloud below shaped itself into a bridge, solid enough to walk on, lasting exactly ten breaths before dissolving back to mist. He turned and shrugged as if it were nothing. It was not nothing.
incredible:1.cnHint: 师兄念出咒语后，云彩竟化为桥梁，那一幕真是令人____。
incredible:1.hook: On the eleventh breath, the shape of the bridge remained — as a shadow on the water far below.
incredible:1.line: 'Is it not *incredible* what a single word can build?' Shen Wujiu asked, turning to me.

sentences.en: From the outer terrace I watched Shen Wujiu release a spoken formula into the wind.
sentences.cn: 从外露台我看着沈无咎把一句咒语释放到风中。

sentences.en: What followed was *incredible* — the cloud below shaped itself into a bridge, solid enough to walk on, lasting exactly ten breaths before dissolving back to mist.
He turned and shrugged as if it were nothing.
sentences.cn: 他转身一耸肩，仿佛那什么都不是。

sentences.en: It was not nothing.
sentences.cn: 可那不是什么都不是。

net:1.en: The old word-catcher at the mountain pass spread a *net* of knotted silk between two pine trees. Each knot held a trapped syllable, he said, collected over forty years of listening to the wind. He offered to sell me three knots for a week of carrying water. Shen Wujiu whispered that I should accept.
net:1.cnHint: 山口的老人张开一张丝____，每个结上都缠着从风中捕来的音节。
net:1.hook: As I reached for the knots, one of them untied itself.
net:1.line: 'This *net* has caught words that no living master can still speak,' the old man said proudly.

sentences.en: The old word-catcher at the mountain pass spread a *net* of knotted silk between two pine trees.
Each knot held a trapped syllable, he said, collected over forty years of listening to the wind.
sentences.cn: 他说每个结子里都困着一个字，这是他四十年来听风的成果。

sentences.en: He offered to sell me three knots for a week of carrying water.
sentences.cn: 他要我给他背水一周，作为交换买他三个结子的代价。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu whispered that I should accept.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎低声劝我答应。

obtain:1.en: To *obtain* the right to climb the inner peak, each disciple must speak a word-formula before the dawn bell without error. I had heard Xiaoxing practice all night, her voice a thin thread in the dark. When the bell rang, she stepped forward first — steady, clear, unhesitating — and the gate opened only for her.
obtain:1.cnHint: 想要____进入内峰的资格，每位弟子必须在晨钟前无误地念出咒语。
obtain:1.hook: The gate left a mark of light on my palm, though I had not touched it.
obtain:1.line: 'You can only *obtain* the inner path through your own voice,' Master Qingwu said, not unkindly.

sentences.en: To *obtain* the right to climb the inner peak, each disciple must speak a word-formula before the dawn bell without error.
I had heard Xiaoxing practice all night, her voice a thin thread in the dark.
sentences.cn: 我听过小杏整夜练习，她的声音在黑暗里就像一根细细的丝。

sentences.en: When the bell rang, she stepped forward first — steady, clear, unhesitating — and the gate opened only for her.
sentences.cn: 钟声响起时，她率先走上前去——稳定、清晰、毫不犹豫——大门只为她打开了。

pair:1.en: Master Qingwu handed me a *pair* of smooth river stones, one dark, one pale. She said every word-formula has two halves — one that calls, one that answers — and neither works alone. I held a stone in each hand and tried to feel the difference. One was warm. One was cold. Both were trembling.
pair:1.cnHint: 师尊给了我一____石头，说每个咒语都由呼唤与回应两半组成。
pair:1.hook: When I pressed the two stones together, they rang like a distant bell.
pair:1.line: 'A *pair* of words spoken in the right order can open the sky,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed me a *pair* of smooth river stones, one dark, one pale.
She said every word-formula has two halves — one that calls, one that answers — and neither works alone.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说每个字诀都有两个半——一个呼唤，一个应答——少了哪一个都不行。

sentences.en: I held a stone in each hand and tried to feel the difference.
sentences.cn: 我在两只手里各握一块石头，试图感受它们的区别。

sentences.en: One was warm.
sentences.cn: 一块是热的。

sentences.en: One was cold.
sentences.cn: 一块是冷的。

sentences.en: Both were trembling.
sentences.cn: 但两块都在颤抖。

beautiful:1.en: At the edge of the outer courtyard, I swept fallen petals from the stone path. Master Qingwu paused beside the great pine and looked up at the floating peaks catching the morning light. 'A *beautiful* sight calms the spirit,' she said softly, 'but beauty that moves you is also beauty that binds you.'
beautiful:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊在庭院外看着远处的浮峰，提醒我____的景色既能静心，也能迷心。
beautiful:1.hook: A single petal rose upward, against the wind.
beautiful:1.line: 'A *beautiful* sight calms the spirit, but beauty that binds you is a chain.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the outer courtyard, I swept fallen petals from the stone path.
sentences.cn: 在外院的边缘，我从石板路上扫去落下的花瓣。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu paused beside the great pine and looked up at the floating peaks catching the morning light.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在那棵大松树边停下，抬头看着晨光下飘浮的峰峦。

sentences.en: 'A *beautiful* sight calms the spirit,' she said softly, 'but beauty that moves you is also beauty that binds you.'

combine:1.en: Shen Wujiu spread two glowing herb-scrolls across the courtyard stone. He showed me how the sect's elders would *combine* the breath formula with the root-word of water, weaving them into one living sigil. Alone, each scroll did little. Together, they hummed like a living thing waking up.
combine:1.cnHint: 师兄在院中展示如何将两道功法____在一起，形成一个有力的符文。
combine:1.hook: The sigil trembled, then split clean down the middle.
combine:1.line: 'You must *combine* the two scrolls before the morning bell fades.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread two glowing herb-scrolls across the courtyard stone.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在院子的石板上铺开两卷发光的草药符。

sentences.en: He showed me how the sect's elders would *combine* the breath formula with the root-word of water, weaving them into one living sigil.
Alone, each scroll did little.
sentences.cn: 单独看，每卷的作用都很小。

sentences.en: Together, they hummed like a living thing waking up.
sentences.cn: 合在一起，它们嗡嗡作响，像一个活着的东西在苏醒。

complicated:1.en: Xiaoxing handed me the sect's entry chart, a web of paths, gates, and spirit-nodes sprawling across thin paper. 'The layout looks *complicated*,' she admitted, tracing a finger along a looping line, 'but every path leads back to the Cloud Root Stone if your intention is honest.' I was not sure mine was.
complicated:1.cnHint: 小星把门派的路线图交给我，说图看起来很____，但只要心意真诚就不会迷路。
complicated:1.hook: My finger stopped at a gate marked with no name.
complicated:1.line: 'The layout is *complicated*, but an honest heart finds the way.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me the sect's entry chart, a web of paths, gates, and spirit-nodes sprawling across thin paper.
sentences.cn: 小杏把宗派的入山图递给了我，那是布满在薄纸上的路径、门关和灵窍的网络。

sentences.en: 'The layout looks *complicated*,' she admitted, tracing a finger along a looping line, 'but every path leads back to the Cloud Root Stone if your intention is honest.'
I was not sure mine was.
sentences.cn: 我不确定自己的意图是否真诚。

crash:1.en: High above the outer square, two senior disciples raced on wind-boards in a training run. Without warning came a sharp *crash*, and one board struck the stone pillar at the gate, sending sparks of blue light across the courtyard. Everyone froze. Then the dust settled, and the disciple stood, shaken but whole.
crash:1.cnHint: 两位师兄在广场上空练习飞行时，其中一人的飞板撞上石柱，发出巨大的____声。
crash:1.hook: The pillar bore a crack shaped exactly like a flying crane.
crash:1.line: 'That *crash* shook the spirit-seal on the gate — someone must report it.'

sentences.en: High above the outer square, two senior disciples raced on wind-boards in a training run.
sentences.cn: 在外广场的高处，两个高阶弟子在风板上训练竞速。

sentences.en: Without warning came a sharp *crash*, and one board struck the stone pillar at the gate, sending sparks of blue light across the courtyard.
Everyone froze.
sentences.cn: 所有人都僵住了。

sentences.en: Then the dust settled, and the disciple stood, shaken but whole.
sentences.cn: 尘埃散去，那个弟子站起身来，虽然受了惊吓但完好无损。

creature:1.en: I was crossing the lower courtyard at dusk when a small, silver-furred *creature* slipped from behind the well. It had wide pale eyes and left no prints on the stone. Xiaoxing caught my sleeve before I could follow it. 'Some things that appear at dusk,' she whispered, 'are not lost — they are waiting.'
creature:1.cnHint: 黄昏时分，一只银毛的小____从井边溜出，小星拦住了想跟上去的我。
creature:1.hook: The well behind us filled, slowly, with soft silver light.
creature:1.line: 'That *creature* leaves no prints — do not follow it past the gate.'

sentences.en: I was crossing the lower courtyard at dusk when a small, silver-furred *creature* slipped from behind the well.
It had wide pale eyes and left no prints on the stone.
sentences.cn: 它有宽大的苍白眼睛，在石板上没有留下任何足迹。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing caught my sleeve before I could follow it.
sentences.cn: 小杏抓住我的袖子，阻止我跟上去。

sentences.en: 'Some things that appear at dusk,' she whispered, 'are not lost — they are waiting.'
sentences.cn: 她低声说，"在黄昏出现的一些东西不是迷路了，它们是在等待。"

crime:1.en: An old notice board stood at the sect's south entrance. Shen Wujiu read the top posting aloud: stealing a peer's spirit-herb was listed as a *crime* equal to breaking a sworn oath. 'Harsh,' I said. He shook his head. 'A stolen word can poison a formula and kill the one who speaks it.'
crime:1.cnHint: 师兄在告示板前念出规定：偷取同门的灵草是与违背誓言同等的____。
crime:1.hook: Below the notice, someone had pressed a single torn leaf.
crime:1.line: 'Stealing a spirit-herb is a *crime* that the sect does not pardon lightly.'

sentences.en: An old notice board stood at the sect's south entrance.
sentences.cn: 一块旧的告示板立在宗派的南入口。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu read the top posting aloud: stealing a peer's spirit-herb was listed as a *crime* equal to breaking a sworn oath.
'Harsh,' I said.
sentences.cn: "很严厉，"我说。

sentences.en: He shook his head.
sentences.cn: 他摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'A stolen word can poison a formula and kill the one who speaks it.'
sentences.cn: "被盗的字可以污染一个字诀，杀死说出它的人。"

deeply:1.en: After the morning recitation, Master Qingwu stood alone at the cliff-edge path, eyes closed. Shen Wujiu leaned close and told me she had been *deeply* moved by a disciple's words at last night's trial — words none of us had heard. Whatever was said, it had changed the stillness around her into something heavy.
deeply:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，清雾师尊被昨夜考核中某位弟子的话____打动，神情从此不同了。
deeply:1.hook: She opened her eyes and looked directly at me.
deeply:1.line: 'Those words touched her *deeply* — she has not spoken of them to anyone.'

sentences.en: After the morning recitation, Master Qingwu stood alone at the cliff-edge path, eyes closed.
sentences.cn: 晨诵后，青梧师尊独自站在悬崖边的小路上，闭着眼睛。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu leaned close and told me she had been *deeply* moved by a disciple's words at last night's trial — words none of us had heard.
Whatever was said, it had changed the stillness around her into something heavy.
sentences.cn: 不管说了什么，都把她周围的寂静变成了沉重的东西。

demonstrate:1.en: In the open training yard, Shen Wujiu asked me to *demonstrate* the three-step breath form in front of the morning assembly. My hands shook at the first step. But by the third, the air around my palms thinned and brightened, and someone in the back row drew a quiet breath of surprise.
demonstrate:1.cnHint: 师兄要我在晨会上当众____三步吐纳功法，我从颤抖到成功，让人群发出了惊讶声。
demonstrate:1.hook: A cold wind rose, carrying the scent of something blooming out of season.
demonstrate:1.line: 'Now *demonstrate* the third step — let everyone see if the form holds.'

sentences.en: In the open training yard, Shen Wujiu asked me to *demonstrate* the three-step breath form in front of the morning assembly.
My hands shook at the first step.
sentences.cn: 我在第一步时双手发抖。

sentences.en: But by the third, the air around my palms thinned and brightened, and someone in the back row drew a quiet breath of surprise.
sentences.cn: 但到了第三步，我掌心周围的空气变得稀薄而明亮，后排的某个人发出了一声轻轻的惊呼。

bottom:1.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect spread wide beneath the morning mist. Master Qingwu lined us up and pointed to a stone tablet carved with a thousand words. 'Read from the *bottom*,' she said. The lowest word on the stone glowed faint gold — a single character meaning 'root.' I traced it with one finger and felt the ground tremble.
bottom:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊命弟子从石碑最低处开始诵读，那里刻着"根"字，触碰后地面震动。
bottom:1.hook: Beneath my feet, something vast and ancient began to wake.
bottom:1.line: 'Start at the *bottom* — roots hold everything above them.'

sentences.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect spread wide beneath the morning mist.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的外院在晨雾下铺展开来。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu lined us up and pointed to a stone tablet carved with a thousand words.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊排好我们的队伍，指向一块刻满千字的石碑。

sentences.en: 'Read from the *bottom*,' she said.
The lowest word on the stone glowed faint gold — a single character meaning 'root.'
sentences.cn: 石头上最低的那个字闪烁着淡淡的金光——单独一个字，意思是"根"。

sentences.en: I traced it with one finger and felt the ground tremble.
sentences.cn: 我用一根手指描着它，感觉地面在颤抖。

breed:1.en: In the seed garden on the eastern terrace, Xiaoxing knelt among rows of tiny glowing pods. 'Each word is a different *breed*,' she explained, lifting one that pulsed soft blue. 'This one heals. That red one over there — it fights.' I reached for the red pod without thinking, and a sharp warmth shot up my arm.
breed:1.cnHint: 小星在东台的种子园中向我介绍不同____的灵词种子，我不慎触碰了红色的那颗。
breed:1.hook: The red warmth spread past my elbow and would not stop.
breed:1.line: 'Every *breed* of word-seed carries a different kind of power.'

sentences.en: In the seed garden on the eastern terrace, Xiaoxing knelt among rows of tiny glowing pods.
sentences.cn: 在东台阶的种子园里，小杏跪在一排排微微发光的豆荚中间。

sentences.en: 'Each word is a different *breed*,' she explained, lifting one that pulsed soft blue.
'This one heals.
sentences.cn: 这一个能治愈。

sentences.en: That red one over there — it fights.'
sentences.cn: 那边那个红色的——它能战斗。

sentences.en: I reached for the red pod without thinking, and a sharp warmth shot up my arm.
sentences.cn: 我没有多想就伸手去拿红色的豆荚，一股尖锐的温热瞬间沿着我的手臂冲了上来。

classify:1.en: Shen Wujiu spread fifty glowing leaves across the courtyard stone and handed me a slim brush. 'Your first task is to *classify* them,' he said calmly, 'by the feeling they leave on your palm.' I pressed my hand to the first leaf. It burned cold, like winter river water — and somewhere far below the clouds, a bell rang once.
classify:1.cnHint: 师兄让我按照灵叶触碰手掌时的感觉将它们____，远处云层下传来一声钟响。
classify:1.hook: The bell rang once more, though no bell tower stood on this mountain.
classify:1.line: '*Classify* them by feeling — your hand knows before your mind does.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread fifty glowing leaves across the courtyard stone and handed me a slim brush.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把五十片发光的叶子铺在院子的石头上，递给我一根细细的笔。

sentences.en: 'Your first task is to *classify* them,' he said calmly, 'by the feeling they leave on your palm.'
I pressed my hand to the first leaf.
sentences.cn: 我把手按在第一片叶子上。

sentences.en: It burned cold, like winter river water — and somewhere far below the clouds, a bell rang once.
sentences.cn: 它烧得冷冰冰的，像冬天的河水——远远在云下某处，一口钟敲响了一次。

comment:1.en: After I recited the morning formula aloud, Master Qingwu stood still for a long moment. Her only *comment* was three quiet words: 'Again. With breath.' I did not understand, yet I breathed in before each syllable this time. The words rose from my mouth as pale mist and drifted upward rather than fading. A distant peak flickered in response.
comment:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊对我诵读晨课的____只有三个字，再念一次后，词语化作白雾向上飘去，远峰随之闪动。
comment:1.hook: The distant peak flickered a second time, as if answering a question I had not asked.
comment:1.line: 'My only *comment* is this — breathe before every word you speak.'

sentences.en: After I recited the morning formula aloud, Master Qingwu stood still for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 我大声诵完早课的心诀后，青梧师尊静静地站了很久。

sentences.en: Her only *comment* was three quiet words: 'Again.
With breath.'
sentences.cn: 带着呼吸。

sentences.en: I did not understand, yet I breathed in before each syllable this time.
sentences.cn: 我没有理解，但这一次我在每个音节之前都吸了口气。

sentences.en: The words rose from my mouth as pale mist and drifted upward rather than fading.
sentences.cn: 这些词从我嘴里升起，成了淡淡的雾气，向上飘散而不是消失。

sentences.en: A distant peak flickered in response.
sentences.cn: 远处的一座山峰闪烁起来作为回应。

component:1.en: On the wide practice platform, Shen Wujiu broke a healing formula into parts, chalk lines dividing the air. 'Tone is one *component*,' he said, marking the first line. 'Intention is another. Leave either out and the word dies before it lands.' I tried the full formula once, properly joined. A small wound on my wrist closed without a scar — and the sky above darkened by one shade.
component:1.cnHint: 师兄讲解疗愈咒语的各个____，我按要求完整念出后，手腕上的伤口愈合，天色却莫名暗了一分。
component:1.hook: The sky had no reason to darken — and yet it did.
component:1.line: 'Tone is one *component* of any true word — never drop it.'

sentences.en: On the wide practice platform, Shen Wujiu broke a healing formula into parts, chalk lines dividing the air.
sentences.cn: 在宽阔的练功台上，沈无咎把一个治愈咒语分成几部分，粉笔线在空气中划分。

sentences.en: 'Tone is one *component*,' he said, marking the first line.
'Intention is another.
sentences.cn: 意图是另一个。

sentences.en: Leave either out and the word dies before it lands.'
sentences.cn: 少了任何一个，词语就会在到达之前死去。

sentences.en: I tried the full formula once, properly joined.
sentences.cn: 我试着完整地念了一遍咒语，正确地连接。

sentences.en: A small wound on my wrist closed without a scar — and the sky above darkened by one shade.
sentences.cn: 我手腕上的一个小伤口闭合了，没有留下疤痕——头顶的天空暗了一个色度。

contrary:1.en: All new disciples were told the mountain air sharpens focus. My experience was *contrary*: the higher I climbed toward the outer peak, the louder the humming in my ears grew, full of half-formed syllables I did not know. Xiaoxing caught my arm before I stepped off the path. Below us, a section of stone path crumbled silently into the cloud sea.
contrary:1.cnHint: 其他弟子说山上空气令人清醒，而我的感受____，爬得越高耳中杂音越响，小星及时拉住了我。
contrary:1.hook: The crumbled stones made no sound as they fell — as if the clouds swallowed them whole.
contrary:1.line: 'Your result is *contrary* to mine — the height should calm, not confuse.'

sentences.en: All new disciples were told the mountain air sharpens focus.
sentences.cn: 所有新弟子都被告知山里的空气能增强专注力。

sentences.en: My experience was *contrary*: the higher I climbed toward the outer peak, the louder the humming in my ears grew, full of half-formed syllables I did not know.
Xiaoxing caught my arm before I stepped off the path.
sentences.cn: 小杏在我踏离小径前抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: Below us, a section of stone path crumbled silently into the cloud sea.
sentences.cn: 在我们下方，一段石头小径无声地崩塌进云海里。

deny:1.en: At the gate record hall, the sect keeper asked me to sign my name beside my word-gift. I tried to *deny* that I had any gift at all, saying I had only traced one root word on a stone. He turned the ledger toward me. My name was already written there in ink that glowed — filled in by a hand that was not mine. Outside, a cold wind moved against the slope.
deny:1.cnHint: 掌籍者要我登记灵根天赋，我想____，却发现册子上我的名字已被神秘地填好，发着光。
deny:1.hook: The wind outside climbed uphill — wind never climbs uphill on its own.
deny:1.line: 'Do not *deny* what the ledger has already written in your name.'

sentences.en: At the gate record hall, the sect keeper asked me to sign my name beside my word-gift.
sentences.cn: 在门房记录厅，宗派的记录员让我在我的字礼旁边签名。

sentences.en: I tried to *deny* that I had any gift at all, saying I had only traced one root word on a stone.
He turned the ledger toward me.
sentences.cn: 他把账本转向我。

sentences.en: My name was already written there in ink that glowed — filled in by a hand that was not mine.
sentences.cn: 我的名字已经用发光的墨水写在那里了——用不是我的手填进去的。

sentences.en: Outside, a cold wind moved against the slope.
sentences.cn: 外面，冷风吹拂着山坡。

depth:1.en: The well at the courtyard center held no water. Shen Wujiu dropped a single word-stone into it and we listened. The echo came back changed — richer, slower, heavier with meaning. 'That is *depth*,' he said softly. 'A word spoken on the surface skims. A word spoken from here' — he touched his chest — 'reaches.' That night I dreamed of the cloud sea below, pulling gently, patient as tides.
depth:1.cnHint: 师兄将灵词石投入无水古井，回声变得深沉厚重，他说这就是____；当夜我梦见云海在下方静静涌动。
depth:1.hook: By morning the well held a single drop of silver water — where none had been before.
depth:1.line: '*Depth* in a word is the distance between your mouth and your true feeling.'

sentences.en: The well at the courtyard center held no water.
sentences.cn: 院子中心的井里没有水。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu dropped a single word-stone into it and we listened.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把一块字石扔进去，我们听着。

sentences.en: The echo came back changed — richer, slower, heavier with meaning.
sentences.cn: 回声回来时改变了——更丰富、更缓慢、更沉重地承载着意义。

sentences.en: 'That is *depth*,' he said softly.
'A word spoken on the surface skims.
sentences.cn: 一个在表面说的词语会掠过。

sentences.en: A word spoken from here' — he touched his chest — 'reaches.'
sentences.cn: 一个从这里说的词语——他用手指着自己的胸膛——能到达。

sentences.en: That night I dreamed of the cloud sea below, pulling gently, patient as tides.
sentences.cn: 那晚我梦到了下面的云海，轻轻地拉扯，耐心得像潮汐。

distinguish:1.en: The market on the lower terrace was loud with traders calling out the names of rare herbs. Shen Wujiu stopped before a row of silver-leafed plants and said I must learn to *distinguish* the healing word from the harmful one, or every formula I speak could turn against me. The leaves trembled, though the air was still.
distinguish:1.cnHint: 师兄在草药摊前告诉我，必须能____真正的治愈之词与有害之词。
distinguish:1.hook: A single wrong leaf lay hidden among the rest.
distinguish:1.line: 'You must *distinguish* the true herb from its shadow, or pay dearly.'

sentences.en: The market on the lower terrace was loud with traders calling out the names of rare herbs.
sentences.cn: 下台阶上的集市里，商人们叫卖着稀有草药的名字声音很大。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stopped before a row of silver-leafed plants and said I must learn to *distinguish* the healing word from the harmful one, or every formula I speak could turn against me.
The leaves trembled, though the air was still.
sentences.cn: 叶子颤抖了，尽管空气很静。

document:1.en: Master Qingwu handed me a folded paper at the sect gate and said every disciple must carry this *document* when crossing the cloud bridges between peaks, for the bridge spirits will not let a nameless person pass. I held it with both hands. The ink seemed to breathe.
document:1.cnHint: 师尊在门口交给我一份____，说过云桥时必须出示。
document:1.hook: One corner of the paper had already begun to fade.
document:1.line: 'Keep this *document* close — without it, the bridge will not open for you.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed me a folded paper at the sect gate and said every disciple must carry this *document* when crossing the cloud bridges between peaks, for the bridge spirits will not let a nameless person pass.
I held it with both hands.
sentences.cn: 我双手拿着它。

sentences.en: The ink seemed to breathe.
sentences.cn: 墨水似乎在呼吸。

dozen:1.en: Xiaoxing led me through the outer courtyard where a *dozen* stone jars stood in a circle, each sealed with a different word-formula. She said only one jar holds the word for flight, and choosing the wrong one would bind my feet to the ground for a full season. The clouds below the mountain shifted uneasily.
dozen:1.cnHint: 小星带我看院子里的____个石罐，其中只有一个藏着飞行的词。
dozen:1.hook: One jar bore a crack I had not noticed before.
dozen:1.line: 'A *dozen* disciples tried before you — none chose correctly on the first attempt.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing led me through the outer courtyard where a *dozen* stone jars stood in a circle, each sealed with a different word-formula.
She said only one jar holds the word for flight, and choosing the wrong one would bind my feet to the ground for a full season.
sentences.cn: 她说只有一个罐子里装着飞行的词语，选错了就会把我的脚绑在地上整整一个季节。

sentences.en: The clouds below the mountain shifted uneasily.
sentences.cn: 山下的云层不安地移动。

dull:1.en: The ceremonial blade used to inscribe new words onto a disciple's practice scroll must always be sharp. Shen Wujiu warned me that a *dull* blade produces a weak character, and a weak character produces a weak formula that breaks apart mid-air. He pressed a whetstone into my hand without another word.
dull:1.cnHint: 师兄警告我，____的刀刻出的字符会让法术在半空中碎裂。
dull:1.hook: My own blade had not been sharpened since the day I arrived.
dull:1.line: 'A *dull* blade is how disciples fall from the sky.'

sentences.en: The ceremonial blade used to inscribe new words onto a disciple's practice scroll must always be sharp.
sentences.cn: 用来在弟子的练功卷轴上刻画新词语的仪式刀必须始终保持锋利。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu warned me that a *dull* blade produces a weak character, and a weak character produces a weak formula that breaks apart mid-air.
He pressed a whetstone into my hand without another word.
sentences.cn: 他没说别的，只是把磨石按进我的手里。

fortune:1.en: The old herb-seller at the mountain gate smiled as I paid for my first bundle of cloud-root and said that a new disciple's *fortune* is written in the first word they master, not in the family they were born to. I thanked her and walked on. Behind me I heard the gate bell ring once, though no wind had touched it.
fortune:1.cnHint: 山门的草药老人说，弟子的____写在他们掌握的第一个词里。
fortune:1.hook: The bell only rings when something important is about to change.
fortune:1.line: 'Your *fortune* begins the moment you speak your first true word.'

sentences.en: The old herb-seller at the mountain gate smiled as I paid for my first bundle of cloud-root and said that a new disciple's *fortune* is written in the first word they master, not in the family they were born to.
I thanked her and walked on.
sentences.cn: 我感谢她走了出去。

sentences.en: Behind me I heard the gate bell ring once, though no wind had touched it.
sentences.cn: 身后我听到门铃响了一次，尽管没有风吹到它。

fulfil:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the edge of the highest terrace and told the gathered disciples that a word-formula is not decoration — it is a promise, and we must *fulfil* every promise a formula makes or the word itself will hollow out and lose its power forever. The sea of clouds below went perfectly flat and still.
fulfil:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉弟子们，必须____每一个法术词所许下的承诺，否则词语会失去力量。
fulfil:1.hook: Somewhere below the clouds, a hollow word was already drifting loose.
fulfil:1.line: 'Those who do not *fulfil* their formulas will find their words go silent.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the edge of the highest terrace and told the gathered disciples that a word-formula is not decoration — it is a promise, and we must *fulfil* every promise a formula makes or the word itself will hollow out and lose its power forever.
The sea of clouds below went perfectly flat and still.
sentences.cn: 下方的云海平静无波。

gradually:1.en: Each morning I practised the word for stillness on the outer walkway. Xiaoxing told me that spiritual words do not open all at once — their meaning *gradually* rises like water filling a stone basin, and patience is the only tool that works. By afternoon my hand had stopped shaking when I wrote.
gradually:1.cnHint: 小星告诉我，灵词的含义会____显现，就像水慢慢注满石盆。
gradually:1.hook: But that evening the word on my scroll had shifted one stroke to the left.
gradually:1.line: 'The deepest words *gradually* reveal themselves — force will only seal them shut.'

sentences.en: Each morning I practised the word for stillness on the outer walkway.
sentences.cn: 每个清晨我都在外廊练习寂静之言。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing told me that spiritual words do not open all at once — their meaning *gradually* rises like water filling a stone basin, and patience is the only tool that works.
By afternoon my hand had stopped shaking when I wrote.
sentences.cn: 到了午后，我写字时的手已经不再颤抖。

incentive:1.en: The sect posts the names of the top ten disciples on a board beside the cloud-bridge each month. Shen Wujiu told me the board is not meant to cause envy but to give every student an *incentive* to push one word further than they managed the week before. My name was not on it yet. The board creaked in the wind like a question.
incentive:1.cnHint: 师兄说，排行榜的目的是给每位弟子____，让他们比上周多掌握一个词。
incentive:1.hook: Tonight someone had turned the board so it faced the cliff edge, not the path.
incentive:1.line: 'The board is your *incentive* — let it pull you forward, not weigh you down.'

sentences.en: The sect posts the names of the top ten disciples on a board beside the cloud-bridge each month.
sentences.cn: 宗门每月在云桥旁的木板上张贴十大弟子的名单。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me the board is not meant to cause envy but to give every student an *incentive* to push one word further than they managed the week before.
My name was not on it yet.
sentences.cn: 我的名字还没有上去。

sentences.en: The board creaked in the wind like a question.
sentences.cn: 木板在风中吱呀吱呀地响，像是在问一个问题。

relax:1.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, I watched the morning mist drift between the floating peaks. Master Qingwu told me to *relax* my shoulders and breathe slowly, letting the mountain air fill my spirit root. The tension I had carried since the entrance trial finally began to soften.
relax:1.cnHint: 师尊在露台上教我____，让山中灵气自然流入灵根。
relax:1.hook: Then the mist parted, and something vast moved beneath it.
relax:1.line: '*Relax* your grip on the formula — let it flow, not fight,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, I watched the morning mist drift between the floating peaks.
sentences.cn: 在云海宗的外露台上，我看着晨雾在浮动的山峰间飘散。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told me to *relax* my shoulders and breathe slowly, letting the mountain air fill my spirit root.
The tension I had carried since the entrance trial finally began to soften.
sentences.cn: 我自入门考试以来一直承载的紧张感终于开始松软。

release:1.en: In the training yard below the east cliff, Shen Wujiu demonstrated the Wind Gather herb. He pressed it between his palms, then chose to *release* his breath all at once. A ring of pale light shot outward across the stone path, lifting loose leaves into a brief, silent spiral above our heads.
release:1.cnHint: 师兄在演武场____灵气时，一道光环扫过了石径。
release:1.hook: One leaf did not fall back down.
release:1.line: 'You must *release* the stored breath at the exact moment of stillness,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: In the training yard below the east cliff, Shen Wujiu demonstrated the Wind Gather herb.
sentences.cn: 在东崖下的训练场里，沈无咎展示了风聚草。

sentences.en: He pressed it between his palms, then chose to *release* his breath all at once.
A ring of pale light shot outward across the stone path, lifting loose leaves into a brief, silent spiral above our heads.
sentences.cn: 一圈苍白的光向外射出，掠过石板路，把散落的树叶卷入头顶上一个短暂、无声的旋涡。

route:1.en: Master Qingwu spread a jade map across the flat rock outside the sect gate. She traced the *route* from our mountain to the Valley of Echoing Roots with one slow finger, naming every herb shrine along the way. I copied each turn carefully into my training scroll, but one marking had no name beside it.
route:1.cnHint: 师尊在山门外为我指出前往回响根谷的____，其中一处标记却没有名字。
route:1.hook: The nameless mark was shaped like an open eye.
route:1.line: 'This *route* will test your reading of wind and root alike,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu spread a jade map across the flat rock outside the sect gate.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在宗门山门外的平石上铺开了一张玉质地图。

sentences.en: She traced the *route* from our mountain to the Valley of Echoing Roots with one slow finger, naming every herb shrine along the way.
I copied each turn carefully into my training scroll, but one marking had no name beside it.
sentences.cn: 我小心翼翼地把每一个转向都抄进我的修行卷轴里，但其中有一个标记旁边没有名字。

sight:1.en: We reached the upper ridge at dawn, where the sea of clouds lay far below like still water. The *sight* stopped me where I stood — peak after peak rose through that white sea, each one glowing faintly with the light of the herbs growing on its face. I had read of this view, but reading had not prepared me.
sight:1.cnHint: 站在山脊上，那片云海的____让我愣在原地，久久无法移步。
sight:1.hook: Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve and pointed upward, not down.
sight:1.line: 'Hold the *sight* in your spirit root — it will steady you later,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: We reached the upper ridge at dawn, where the sea of clouds lay far below like still water.
sentences.cn: 我们在黎明时分到达了上脊，云海远远地铺在下方，像是静止的水面。

sentences.en: The *sight* stopped me where I stood — peak after peak rose through that white sea, each one glowing faintly with the light of the herbs growing on its face.
I had read of this view, but reading had not prepared me.
sentences.cn: 我读过这个景象的描述，但读过和亲眼所见是两码事。

speaker:1.en: A sect elder stood on the broad stone platform near the outer gate, addressing a ring of new disciples. As the main *speaker* of the morning ceremony, she recited the names of the five great herb families in a voice that seemed to hum against the cliff face behind her. We all felt it in our teeth.
speaker:1.cnHint: 晨礼上，作为主要____的长老吟诵五大草药家族之名，声音震动崖壁。
speaker:1.hook: When she finished, the cliff behind her cracked along one old seam.
speaker:1.line: 'As your *speaker* today, I name the herbs that once sealed this mountain,' said the elder.

sentences.en: A sect elder stood on the broad stone platform near the outer gate, addressing a ring of new disciples.
sentences.cn: 一位宗门长老站在山门外的宽阔石台上，对着一圈新弟子讲话。

sentences.en: As the main *speaker* of the morning ceremony, she recited the names of the five great herb families in a voice that seemed to hum against the cliff face behind her.
We all felt it in our teeth.
sentences.cn: 我们都在牙齿里感受到了那股震颤。

species:1.en: Xiaoxing knelt by a shallow pool just beyond the sect's lower wall, pointing at two plants that looked nearly the same. She explained that only one *species* carried the silver thread in its stem that could open the breath meridian. I leaned close, and still could not tell them apart.
species:1.cnHint: 小星在水池边指出，两株外形相似的草药只有一个____茎中有银丝。
species:1.hook: She reached for the one on the left, then stopped.
species:1.line: 'This *species* looks gentle, but it remembers every wrong hand,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing knelt by a shallow pool just beyond the sect's lower wall, pointing at two plants that looked nearly the same.
sentences.cn: 小杏跪在宗门下墙外的浅池边，指着两株看起来几乎一样的植物。

sentences.en: She explained that only one *species* carried the silver thread in its stem that could open the breath meridian.
I leaned close, and still could not tell them apart.
sentences.cn: 我凑近看去，还是分不出哪个是哪个。

specifically:1.en: Shen Wujiu walked me along the mountain path outside the herb storage hall, stopping at a fork. He said Master Qingwu had *specifically* chosen this path for my first solo errand, because the moss here responds to untrained spirit roots in a way no practice room can teach. I looked down at the moss and it looked back.
specifically:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，师尊____选择这条山路作为我第一次独自历练的路线。
specifically:1.hook: The moss had already begun to glow beneath my left foot.
specifically:1.line: 'She *specifically* said you must walk this section alone,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu walked me along the mountain path outside the herb storage hall, stopping at a fork.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎陪我沿着药材库房外的山路走，在一个岔口停了下来。

sentences.en: He said Master Qingwu had *specifically* chosen this path for my first solo errand, because the moss here responds to untrained spirit roots in a way no practice room can teach.
I looked down at the moss and it looked back.
sentences.cn: 我低头看那些苔藓，它们也在看我。

unfortunately:1.en: I arrived at the mountain gate archive at first light to collect my assigned herb scroll. *Unfortunately*, the scroll I needed had been signed out by another disciple only moments before, and the shelf held nothing but an empty lacquered case. The archivist shook her head slowly and said one word I did not want to hear.
unfortunately:1.cnHint: 我赶到山门档案室取草药卷轴，____那份卷轴刚被人借走，只剩空盒。
unfortunately:1.hook: Written inside the empty case was my own name.
unfortunately:1.line: '*Unfortunately*, the path it describes cannot wait for another scroll,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: I arrived at the mountain gate archive at first light to collect my assigned herb scroll.
sentences.cn: 我在天明时分赶到了山门档案库去领取我分配的药卷。

sentences.en: *Unfortunately*, the scroll I needed had been signed out by another disciple only moments before, and the shelf held nothing but an empty lacquered case.
The archivist shook her head slowly and said one word I did not want to hear.
sentences.cn: 档案员缓缓摇了摇头，说了一个我不想听到的词。

lower:1.en: The Trial of Ascent had begun. I stood at the base of the great stone stair that climbed toward the summit altar. Master Qingwu warned us that disciples who walked the *lower* steps with doubt in their hearts would feel the mountain push back, and so I slowed my breath and cleared my mind before lifting my foot.
lower:1.cnHint: 弟子们踏上通往山顶祭坛的石阶，师尊提醒我们，踩在____台阶时心若有疑，山会相拒。
lower:1.hook: A cold wind rose from below, and the first step cracked.
lower:1.line: 'The *lower* steps test your heart, not your legs,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The Trial of Ascent had begun.
sentences.cn: 飞升试炼开始了。

sentences.en: I stood at the base of the great stone stair that climbed toward the summit altar.
sentences.cn: 我站在那条通往峰顶祭坛的巨大石阶的底部。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu warned us that disciples who walked the *lower* steps with doubt in their hearts would feel the mountain push back, and so I slowed my breath and cleared my mind before lifting my foot.

naturally:1.en: Xiaoxing had never studied the Wind Formula, yet when the morning gust swept across the outer terrace she raised one hand and the sleeve of her robe moved *naturally* with the current, as though sky and girl had always spoken the same language. The other disciples fell silent and watched.
naturally:1.cnHint: 小星从未学过风诀，却在晨风中____地以袖应风，令同门默然。
naturally:1.hook: Master Qingwu set down his tea and turned to look at her.
naturally:1.line: 'It came *naturally*,' Xiaoxing said softly, 'I did not try at all.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had never studied the Wind Formula, yet when the morning gust swept across the outer terrace she raised one hand and the sleeve of her robe moved *naturally* with the current, as though sky and girl had always spoken the same language.
The other disciples fell silent and watched.
sentences.cn: 其他弟子都沉默了，看着她。

passionate:1.en: Shen Wujiu spoke of the Cloud Sea Sect with a voice full of fire. Every word he chose landed like a herb placed on hot stone, releasing its scent at once. The new disciples gathered around him on the wide outer terrace, drawn by how *passionate* he was about a path most of them had only just set foot on.
passionate:1.cnHint: 申无咎在外台上____地讲述云海宗，新弟子们纷纷围拢聆听。
passionate:1.hook: Then his eyes went to the sky, and his voice stopped mid-sentence.
passionate:1.line: Shen Wujiu said, 'I am *passionate* about every word this sect has ever named.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spoke of the Cloud Sea Sect with a voice full of fire.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎谈起云海宗，声音里满是火焰。

sentences.en: Every word he chose landed like a herb placed on hot stone, releasing its scent at once.
sentences.cn: 他说的每个字都像是放在热石上的草药，立刻释放出香气。

sentences.en: The new disciples gathered around him on the wide outer terrace, drawn by how *passionate* he was about a path most of them had only just set foot on.

pop:1.en: We were crossing the Bridge of First Names when a sealed spirit-bottle at Xiaoxing's belt gave a sharp sound and its cork began to rise. 'Do not let it *pop*,' Master Qingwu said, stepping forward, but the cork flew off, and a small bright light shot straight up into the clouds above the mountain.
pop:1.cnHint: 过初名桥时，小星腰间的灵瓶突然作响，瓶塞眼看要____出来。
pop:1.hook: The light did not return, and the bridge began to sway.
pop:1.line: Master Qingwu said, 'If that cork does *pop*, every herb inside is lost.'

sentences.en: We were crossing the Bridge of First Names when a sealed spirit-bottle at Xiaoxing's belt gave a sharp sound and its cork began to rise.
sentences.cn: 我们正过名字桥的时候，小杏腰上一个封好的灵瓶发出尖锐的声响，软塞开始往上翘。

sentences.en: 'Do not let it *pop*,' Master Qingwu said, stepping forward, but the cork flew off, and a small bright light shot straight up into the clouds above the mountain.

possibly:1.en: The outer gate had been sealed by a formula none of us recognised. Shen Wujiu studied the lines carved into the stone for a long moment, then said that whoever had written it was skilled beyond our year. I could not *possibly* read more than three of the characters, yet something about the fourth made my hand go cold.
possibly:1.cnHint: 外门被陌生符文封住，我____认不出其中超过三个字，却对第四个字感到手心发凉。
possibly:1.hook: The fourth character had my name inside it.
possibly:1.line: Shen Wujiu said, 'Could you *possibly* have seen this formula before?'

sentences.en: The outer gate had been sealed by a formula none of us recognised.
sentences.cn: 外门被一道我们都不认识的法阵封住了。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu studied the lines carved into the stone for a long moment, then said that whoever had written it was skilled beyond our year.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎盯着刻在石头上的符纹看了很久，然后说写这个的人手艺比我们高出好几年。

sentences.en: I could not *possibly* read more than three of the characters, yet something about the fourth made my hand go cold.

previously:1.en: The summit path was open to senior disciples only, yet today the gate stood wide. Master Qingwu told us it had been sealed for thirty years. I noticed that the stone on either side was still marked where a chain had *previously* held it shut, the metal having cut deep grooves before someone — or something — pulled it free.
previously:1.cnHint: 山顶小路的铁门大开，师尊说此门____已封锁三十年，门柱上还留有铁链的深痕。
previously:1.hook: Fresh footprints led upward through the morning frost.
previously:1.line: 'This door,' said Master Qingwu, 'was *previously* sealed by my own hand.'

sentences.en: The summit path was open to senior disciples only, yet today the gate stood wide.
sentences.cn: 山顶的路只开放给高年级弟子，可今天山门却敞开了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told us it had been sealed for thirty years.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊告诉我们它已经被封了三十年。

sentences.en: I noticed that the stone on either side was still marked where a chain had *previously* held it shut, the metal having cut deep grooves before someone — or something — pulled it free.

profession:1.en: At the Naming Stone, each new disciple carved one word to declare their chosen path. Healing, shielding, reading the sky — every *profession* of the sect had its own character. When my turn came I stood with chisel raised and realised I did not yet know which word was mine, while the mountain waited and the clouds below stirred.
profession:1.cnHint: 在命名石前，每位新弟子刻字宣告自己的____，轮到我时却迟迟无法落凿。
profession:1.hook: The chisel moved on its own and carved a word I did not choose.
profession:1.line: Xiaoxing asked, 'Have you decided your *profession*, or does the stone decide for you?'

sentences.en: At the Naming Stone, each new disciple carved one word to declare their chosen path.
sentences.cn: 在命名石前，每个新弟子都要刻下一个字来宣示自己选择的道路。

sentences.en: Healing, shielding, reading the sky — every *profession* of the sect had its own character.
When my turn came I stood with chisel raised and realised I did not yet know which word was mine, while the mountain waited and the clouds below stirred.
sentences.cn: 轮到我的时候我站着举起凿子，才意识到自己还不知道哪个字是属于我的，山在等，云在下面翻滚。

readily:1.en: Most disciples struggled for a week before the Gate Herb would open its leaves to them. Xiaoxing, however, found that the small silver plant *readily* unfolded the moment she held out her palm, as if it had been waiting. The herb-keeper looked from the plant to her and wrote something careful in the sect record.
readily:1.cnHint: 门草对大多数弟子紧闭，却____地向小星展开，药师将此事记入宗门册中。
readily:1.hook: The herb-keeper's brush paused, and she added a second line below.
readily:1.line: Shen Wujiu said, 'It opens *readily* for you — I have not seen that in ten years.'

sentences.en: Most disciples struggled for a week before the Gate Herb would open its leaves to them.
sentences.cn: 大多数弟子要花一周时间才能让启灵草为他们舒展叶子。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing, however, found that the small silver plant *readily* unfolded the moment she held out her palm, as if it had been waiting.
The herb-keeper looked from the plant to her and wrote something careful in the sect record.
sentences.cn: 药师从植物看向她，在宗门记录里认真地写下了什么。

consultant:1.en: On the outer terrace of the Cloud Sea Sect, a robed elder examined the spirit-herb garden with quiet care. Master Qingwu introduced him as a *consultant* from a distant mountain, brought to judge which herbs held true healing power. Every disciple stood still, hoping their planted words would pass his eye.
consultant:1.cnHint: 一位来自远山的____来到宗门露台，评判药草园中灵草的品质。
consultant:1.hook: He paused longest before the one herb no disciple had dared to touch.
consultant:1.line: 'A *consultant* sees what the keeper of the garden cannot,' the elder said softly.

sentences.en: On the outer terrace of the Cloud Sea Sect, a robed elder examined the spirit-herb garden with quiet care.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的外台上，一位穿着道袍的长者仔细地查看着灵草园。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu introduced him as a *consultant* from a distant mountain, brought to judge which herbs held true healing power.
Every disciple stood still, hoping their planted words would pass his eye.
sentences.cn: 每个弟子都静静地站着，希望自己种下的字能入得了他的眼。

direct:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me along the mountain path at dawn, but he took no winding road. His steps were *direct*, cutting straight from the outer gate to the high ridge where the wind carried the scent of rare spirit-herbs. He said nothing, yet each step felt like a lesson in purpose.
direct:1.cnHint: 师兄走的是一条____的山路，从外门径直通向高岭。
direct:1.hook: At the ridge, a shadow passed overhead that had no bird to cast it.
direct:1.line: 'A *direct* path costs more effort but wastes no time,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me along the mountain path at dawn, but he took no winding road.
sentences.cn: 天亮时沈无咎领我沿着山路走，但他没走任何弯路。

sentences.en: His steps were *direct*, cutting straight from the outer gate to the high ridge where the wind carried the scent of rare spirit-herbs.
He said nothing, yet each step felt like a lesson in purpose.
sentences.cn: 他什么都没说，可每一步都像是在教我什么叫目的。

discourage:1.en: Rain fell hard on the training ground. Master Qingwu watched as I stumbled over the same formula three times. She did not scold, but she did not lie either. 'I will not *discourage* you,' she said, 'yet the clouds ahead are heavier than this rain.' I bowed and tried again.
discourage:1.cnHint: 大雨中，师尊没有____弟子，却提到前路的云比眼前的雨更重。
discourage:1.hook: Behind her, the weather vane on the sect tower spun without any wind.
discourage:1.line: 'I will not *discourage* you, but truth must be spoken,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Rain fell hard on the training ground.
sentences.cn: 雨在训练场上哗啦啦地下。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched as I stumbled over the same formula three times.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊看着我第三次在同一个法诀上摔跤。

sentences.en: She did not scold, but she did not lie either.
sentences.cn: 她没有责骂，但也没有哄我。

sentences.en: 'I will not *discourage* you,' she said, 'yet the clouds ahead are heavier than this rain.'
I bowed and tried again.
sentences.cn: 我低眉顺眼又试了一遍。

essentially:1.en: Xiaoxing spread the dried herbs on a flat stone and named each one aloud for me. 'This art is *essentially* listening,' she said. 'The herb tells you what it can heal if you are quiet enough.' Above us, a hawk circled once and landed on the tallest pine, watching.
essentially:1.cnHint: 师妹说，采药之道____上是一种倾听，安静时草药自会告诉你它的用处。
essentially:1.hook: The hawk had not been there a moment before, and it had no shadow.
essentially:1.line: 'Cultivation is *essentially* learning to be still,' said Xiaoxing with a small smile.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread the dried herbs on a flat stone and named each one aloud for me.
sentences.cn: 小杏把干草药摊在平石上，一样样给我念名字。

sentences.en: 'This art is *essentially* listening,' she said.
'The herb tells you what it can heal if you are quiet enough.'
sentences.cn: 「草药会告诉你它能治什么，只要你足够安静。」

sentences.en: Above us, a hawk circled once and landed on the tallest pine, watching.
sentences.cn: 我们上方一只鹰盘旋了一圈，落在最高的松树上，看着我们。

extent:1.en: Standing at the cliff's edge, I finally saw the *extent* of the Cloud Sea below — a white ocean stretching in every direction, swallowing the lower peaks whole. Shen Wujiu stood beside me and said nothing for a long time. The silence felt wider than the clouds themselves.
extent:1.cnHint: 站在悬崖边，弟子终于见识到云海____的宽广，白雾将低处山峰完全淹没。
extent:1.hook: Then one peak, far out in the white, slowly began to rise.
extent:1.line: 'The *extent* of your power is still unknown, even to you,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Standing at the cliff's edge, I finally saw the *extent* of the Cloud Sea below — a white ocean stretching in every direction, swallowing the lower peaks whole.
Shen Wujiu stood beside me and said nothing for a long time.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在我身边，很长时间什么都没说。

sentences.en: The silence felt wider than the clouds themselves.
sentences.cn: 这份沉默比云海本身还要辽阔。

finance:1.en: At the sect's open market, elders debated how to *finance* a new bridge of stones that would connect two floating peaks. Xiaoxing stood nearby, listening with bright eyes. 'Words are the true coin here,' she whispered to me, pressing a rare herb-scroll into my hand before the crowd grew loud.
finance:1.cnHint: 宗门集市上，长老们讨论如何____一座连接两座浮峰的新石桥。
finance:1.hook: The scroll in my hand grew warm the moment the argument ended.
finance:1.line: 'We must *finance* the bridge with the herbs we harvest this season,' said the elder.

sentences.en: At the sect's open market, elders debated how to *finance* a new bridge of stones that would connect two floating peaks.
Xiaoxing stood nearby, listening with bright eyes.
sentences.cn: 小杏站在附近，眼睛亮晶晶地听着。

sentences.en: 'Words are the true coin here,' she whispered to me, pressing a rare herb-scroll into my hand before the crowd grew loud.
sentences.cn: "这里啊，词才是真正的货币，"她悄声对我说，把一卷难得的草药卷轴塞进我手里，在人群喧闹前。

freedom:1.en: The morning after I passed my first spirit-herb trial, Master Qingwu led me to the open sky terrace. 'Today you may walk any path on this mountain,' she said. The *freedom* felt vast and strange, like a wind with no walls around it. Xiaoxing was already waiting at the far end.
freedom:1.cnHint: 通过第一次灵草考验后，师尊赋予弟子在山中自由行走的____。
freedom:1.hook: Xiaoxing pointed downward, where the clouds below had parted in a perfect circle.
freedom:1.line: '*Freedom* on this mountain is earned one true word at a time,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The morning after I passed my first spirit-herb trial, Master Qingwu led me to the open sky terrace.
sentences.cn: 通过了第一场灵草试炼的第二天早晨，青梧师尊带我来到了露天的平台。

sentences.en: 'Today you may walk any path on this mountain,' she said.
sentences.cn: "从今天起，这座山上的每条路你都可以走，"她说。

sentences.en: The *freedom* felt vast and strange, like a wind with no walls around it.
Xiaoxing was already waiting at the far end.
sentences.cn: 小杏早就在远处等我了。
