highlight:1.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled the sect's seasonal record on the stone table outside. He moved his finger down the list slowly, then stopped. 'Let me *highlight* this entry,' he said, pressing a dried petal onto one line. It was my name, marked beside a herb that had not bloomed in twenty years.
highlight:1.cnHint: 师兄在宗门季度记录中____了一条记录——弟子的名字旁写着一株二十年未曾开花的灵草。
highlight:1.hook: The petal he pressed onto the page was still faintly breathing.
highlight:1.line: 'I want to *highlight* this — no disciple has done it before,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled the sect's seasonal record on the stone table outside.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在外面的石桌上摊开了宗派的季节记录。

sentences.en: He moved his finger down the list slowly, then stopped.
sentences.cn: 他的手指沿着名单慢慢往下扫，然后停了下来。

sentences.en: 'Let me *highlight* this entry,' he said, pressing a dried petal onto one line.
It was my name, marked beside a herb that had not bloomed in twenty years.
sentences.cn: 那是我的名字，标在一种二十年没开过花的灵草旁边。

somewhat:1.en: The mountain path wound upward through cold morning air. I had expected the first trial to be a grand test of spirit, but the gate before me was *somewhat* smaller than I had imagined — barely taller than Shen Wujiu's shoulder. Yet every disciple who passed through it emerged changed, their eyes carrying a deeper light. I stepped forward.
somewhat:1.cnHint: 我原本以为第一道试炼会很宏大，但眼前的石门____比想象中要小——穿越它的弟子却都脱胎换骨。
somewhat:1.hook: Behind the gate, the clouds began to rise.
somewhat:1.line: 'The door is *somewhat* narrow,' said Shen Wujiu, 'but what waits beyond is not.'

sentences.en: The mountain path wound upward through cold morning air.
sentences.cn: 山路蜿蜒向上，穿过冷飕飕的晨风。

sentences.en: I had expected the first trial to be a grand test of spirit, but the gate before me was *somewhat* smaller than I had imagined — barely taller than Shen Wujiu's shoulder.
Yet every disciple who passed through it emerged changed, their eyes carrying a deeper light.
sentences.cn: 每个通过它的弟子都会改变，眼睛里多了一种更深的光。

sentences.en: I stepped forward.
sentences.cn: 我向前迈进去。

stable:1.en: At the edge of the outer courtyard stood a low stone building the older disciples called the Herb *Stable* — a place where living words were kept like sleeping animals, breathing slowly in clay pots. Xiaoxing pressed her ear to one pot and smiled. I pressed my ear to another and heard nothing but wind. Then, very faintly, a pulse.
stable:1.cnHint: 庭院边有座存放活字草药的石屋，被称作____，小星把耳朵贴近陶罐，我也照做，起初只听见风声。
stable:1.hook: The pulse quickened, as if it had heard my name.
stable:1.line: 'Keep your breath *stable*,' Xiaoxing whispered, 'or the word inside will not trust you.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the outer courtyard stood a low stone building the older disciples called the Herb *Stable* — a place where living words were kept like sleeping animals, breathing slowly in clay pots.
Xiaoxing pressed her ear to one pot and smiled.
sentences.cn: 小杏把耳朵贴到一个陶罐上，笑了。

sentences.en: I pressed my ear to another and heard nothing but wind.
sentences.cn: 我贴着另一个罐子听，什么都没听到，只有风。

sentences.en: Then, very faintly, a pulse.
sentences.cn: 然后，很微弱地，有个脉搏。

vigorous:1.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect lay open to the morning sky, where new disciples practiced their first spoken formulas. My voice was still thin, but Shen Wujiu moved beside me with *vigorous* steps, each word he chanted sending small sparks of light across the stone floor. I watched and steadied my breath. Above us, a single white crane circled once, then vanished into the clouds.
vigorous:1.cnHint: 在宗门外院，师兄以____的步伐示范吟诀，令我暗下决心。
vigorous:1.hook: The crane had not been seen near the sect in seven years.
vigorous:1.line: 'Keep a *vigorous* pace — the words will follow your feet.'

sentences.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect lay open to the morning sky, where new disciples practiced their first spoken formulas.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的外院在晨光下敞开，新弟子们在练习他们的第一批口诀。

sentences.en: My voice was still thin, but Shen Wujiu moved beside me with *vigorous* steps, each word he chanted sending small sparks of light across the stone floor.
I watched and steadied my breath.
sentences.cn: 我看着，稳定了呼吸。

sentences.en: Above us, a single white crane circled once, then vanished into the clouds.
sentences.cn: 上方，一只白鹤转了一圈，然后没入云里。

wide:1.en: Master Qingwu led us to the edge of the Sky-Root Terrace, where the floating mountain dropped away into open air. The view was *wide* beyond any measure — range after range of cloud-peaks stretching to the horizon, each one holding a sect we had only read about in old texts. I felt small and full at the same time. Then a low bell rang from somewhere below the clouds.
wide:1.cnHint: 站在山崖边，师尊带我们眺望____无垠的云海，远处传来不明钟声。
wide:1.hook: No bell tower was known to exist beneath the Cloud Sea.
wide:1.line: 'The world is *wide*, and every word you learn opens more of it.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us to the edge of the Sky-Root Terrace, where the floating mountain dropped away into open air.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把我们带到了天根台的边缘，那儿浮山从悬崖直直掉进空气里。

sentences.en: The view was *wide* beyond any measure — range after range of cloud-peaks stretching to the horizon, each one holding a sect we had only read about in old texts.
I felt small and full at the same time.
sentences.cn: 我感到既渺小又充盈。

sentences.en: Then a low bell rang from somewhere below the clouds.
sentences.cn: 然后云下传来一声低钟声。

agriculture:1.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the terraced spirit-fields cut into the mountainside, where glowing herbs grew in careful rows. 'In the old days,' she said, 'the sect treated *agriculture* like any other discipline — each plant was a living word, and farmers were considered healers.' I knelt to touch the soil, and it hummed faintly against my palm. That night, one row of herbs bloomed out of season.
agriculture:1.cnHint: 师妹介绍宗门药田时提到，____在古时被视为与修行同等重要的学问。
agriculture:1.hook: Out-of-season blooms were said to warn of a coming shift in the spirit tides.
agriculture:1.line: '*Agriculture* here is not farming — it is listening to what the earth remembers.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the terraced spirit-fields cut into the mountainside, where glowing herbs grew in careful rows.
sentences.cn: 小杏指向山腰上开垦出来的灵地，那儿发光的草药排成整齐的行。

sentences.en: 'In the old days,' she said, 'the sect treated *agriculture* like any other discipline — each plant was a living word, and farmers were considered healers.'
I knelt to touch the soil, and it hummed faintly against my palm.
sentences.cn: 我跪下去摸土地，它在我掌心轻轻地嗡鸣。

sentences.en: That night, one row of herbs bloomed out of season.
sentences.cn: 那天晚上，其中一行草药反时节地绽开了。

assign:1.en: On the third morning, Master Qingwu gathered the new disciples on the open practice ground and began to *assign* each of us a seed-word — a single term drawn from the Sect's oldest formula scrolls. Mine was written on a slip of jade that felt warm the moment I closed my fingers around it. Shen Wujiu caught my eye and gave a small nod. Somewhere overhead, the wind changed direction without warning.
assign:1.cnHint: 第三天清晨，师尊在演武场上为每位新弟子____了一个种字。
assign:1.hook: The wind shifting meant a seal somewhere on the mountain had just been broken.
assign:1.line: 'I will *assign* each of you one word — guard it the way you guard your breath.'

sentences.en: On the third morning, Master Qingwu gathered the new disciples on the open practice ground and began to *assign* each of us a seed-word — a single term drawn from the Sect's oldest formula scrolls.
Mine was written on a slip of jade that felt warm the moment I closed my fingers around it.
sentences.cn: 我的是写在一片玉片上的，一握住它的时候就暖了。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu caught my eye and gave a small nod.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎和我对上了眼，给了个小小的点头。

sentences.en: Somewhere overhead, the wind changed direction without warning.
sentences.cn: 头顶什么地方，风突然改了方向。

broad:1.en: The main path of the Cloud Sea Sect was *broad* enough for ten disciples to walk side by side, its stones worn smooth by centuries of passing feet. Xiaoxing told me that the width was deliberate — a narrow road, the founders believed, made the mind narrow too. I walked it slowly, feeling the stone beneath me, until I noticed fresh cracks running across the path from edge to edge.
broad:1.cnHint: 宗门正道____而平，师妹说这是为了让弟子心胸开阔，但我发现路面出现了新的裂缝。
broad:1.hook: The cracks ran perfectly straight, as if drawn by an unseen hand.
broad:1.line: 'A *broad* road is the first lesson — the sect does not reward small thinking.'

sentences.en: The main path of the Cloud Sea Sect was *broad* enough for ten disciples to walk side by side, its stones worn smooth by centuries of passing feet.
Xiaoxing told me that the width was deliberate — a narrow road, the founders believed, made the mind narrow too.
sentences.cn: 小杏告诉我这个宽度是故意的——创派的人相信，道路窄了，心就也窄了。

sentences.en: I walked it slowly, feeling the stone beneath me, until I noticed fresh cracks running across the path from edge to edge.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓地走，感受着石头在脚下，直到我注意到新的裂纹从头到尾横贯在路上。

careful:1.en: Shen Wujiu set a row of small spirit-stones along the courtyard railing and asked me to read the formula aloud. 'Be *careful* with the third syllable,' he said quietly. 'It carries more weight than it looks.' I steadied my voice and read. The stones lit in order — all except the last, which cracked down the middle and let out a single thin note like a distant cry.
careful:1.cnHint: 师兄嘱咐我吟诵咒文时要对第三个音节____，但最后一块灵石还是裂开了。
careful:1.hook: That note was the same pitch the warning bells used at the sect's founding.
careful:1.line: 'Be *careful* — the third syllable has ended more than one disciple's training.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu set a row of small spirit-stones along the courtyard railing and asked me to read the formula aloud.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎沿着院子的栏杆排成一行小灵石，要我大声念出法诀。

sentences.en: 'Be *careful* with the third syllable,' he said quietly.
'It carries more weight than it looks.'
sentences.cn: "它承载的重量比看起来要多。"

sentences.en: I steadied my voice and read.
sentences.cn: 我稳定了声音并念诵。

sentences.en: The stones lit in order — all except the last, which cracked down the middle and let out a single thin note like a distant cry.
sentences.cn: 石头按顺序亮了起来——除了最后一块，它从中间裂开，发出一声细长的、像遥远哭声的单独音符。

combination:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an ancient scroll on the open-air lecture stone and explained that no single word held full power — it was always the *combination* of two or more that produced a true effect. She demonstrated with 'still' and 'rise,' and the air above the stone shimmered into a column of pale light. We copied the pair into our notebooks. Before she rolled the scroll again, I saw a third word hidden in the margin that she had not read aloud.
combination:1.cnHint: 师尊讲解道，唯有词语的____才能产生真正的法力，我却在卷轴边缘发现了她未曾诵出的第三个字。
combination:1.hook: A word left unspoken in a scroll is a word still waiting to be released.
combination:1.line: 'Any single word is just a seed — the *combination* is where the flower grows.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an ancient scroll on the open-air lecture stone and explained that no single word held full power — it was always the *combination* of two or more that produced a true effect.
She demonstrated with 'still' and 'rise,' and the air above the stone shimmered into a column of pale light.
sentences.cn: 她用"静"和"起"做了示范，石头上方的空气闪烁成了一根淡光的柱子。

sentences.en: We copied the pair into our notebooks.
sentences.cn: 我们把这对词抄进了笔记本。

sentences.en: Before she rolled the scroll again, I saw a third word hidden in the margin that she had not read aloud.
sentences.cn: 她再卷起卷轴前，我看到了边栏里藏着的第三个词，她没有念出来。

constant:1.en: Xiaoxing and I sat on the outer steps at dusk, watching the sea of clouds shift below the mountain. She said that the one thing every master agreed on was *constant* practice — not long, dramatic sessions, but a few careful words repeated each day until they became part of your breathing. I repeated my seed-word softly to myself three times. On the third, a pale line of light appeared briefly along the mountain's edge and then went dark.
constant:1.cnHint: 黄昏时分，师妹告诉我修行的秘诀在于____的练习，而非一时的刻苦。
constant:1.hook: A light at the mountain's edge meant something on the lower peaks had just woken up.
constant:1.line: '*Constant* practice is the only formula that has never failed anyone here.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing and I sat on the outer steps at dusk, watching the sea of clouds shift below the mountain.
sentences.cn: 黄昏时，小杏和我坐在外殿的石阶上，看着山下的云海翻滚。

sentences.en: She said that the one thing every master agreed on was *constant* practice — not long, dramatic sessions, but a few careful words repeated each day until they became part of your breathing.
I repeated my seed-word softly to myself three times.
sentences.cn: 我轻声对自己重复了三遍种子字。

sentences.en: On the third, a pale line of light appeared briefly along the mountain's edge and then went dark.
sentences.cn: 第三遍时，山边出现了一道苍白的光线，转瞬即暗。

himself:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the edge of the outer terrace, eyes closed, speaking the Word of Wind entirely to *himself*. No scroll, no student, no witness — only the mountain and the breath moving through his lips. The clouds below parted in a slow, perfect circle. We watched from the archway, not daring to step closer.
himself:1.cnHint: 师尊独自在台边默念风咒，云海随之分开，弟子们在门廊处屏息旁观。
himself:1.hook: Then the circle in the clouds began, slowly, to close again.
himself:1.line: 'He spoke the Word *himself*, and the sky answered,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the edge of the outer terrace, eyes closed, speaking the Word of Wind entirely to *himself*.
No scroll, no student, no witness — only the mountain and the breath moving through his lips.
sentences.cn: 没有卷轴，没有学生，没有旁观者——只有山和经过他唇间的呼吸。

sentences.en: The clouds below parted in a slow, perfect circle.
sentences.cn: 下面的云以缓慢、完美的圆形散开。

sentences.en: We watched from the archway, not daring to step closer.
sentences.cn: 我们从拱门处看着，不敢靠近。

landscape:1.en: From the upper bridge I saw it for the first time — the full *landscape* of Cloud Sea Sect: seven peaks rising like ink strokes above a white ocean of mist, each one linked by threads of pale light. Xiaoxing said every thread was a Word, held taut between the mountains. I counted them and felt small.
landscape:1.cnHint: 在高桥上，弟子第一次俯瞰云海宗全景，小星说那些光线都是字咒。
landscape:1.hook: One thread, the thinnest, was flickering.
landscape:1.line: 'This *landscape* holds more words than any scroll,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: From the upper bridge I saw it for the first time — the full *landscape* of Cloud Sea Sect: seven peaks rising like ink strokes above a white ocean of mist, each one linked by threads of pale light.
Xiaoxing said every thread was a Word, held taut between the mountains.
sentences.cn: 小杏说每条光线都是一个字，在山峰间紧绷。

sentences.en: I counted them and felt small.
sentences.cn: 我数了数，感到自己很渺小。

mentally:1.en: Before the dawn recitation, Shen Wujiu told me to walk the stone path and *mentally* trace every Word I had learned, without moving my lips. 'The herb must take root in thought before it flowers in sound,' he said. I walked three slow rounds. On the fourth, I felt something warm stir behind my ribs.
mentally:1.cnHint: 师兄要求弟子在心里默默回想所学字咒，不出声地走完石径。
mentally:1.hook: On the fifth round, my shadow moved a breath before I did.
mentally:1.line: 'Trace each Word *mentally* first,' Shen Wujiu said, 'then let your voice follow.'

sentences.en: Before the dawn recitation, Shen Wujiu told me to walk the stone path and *mentally* trace every Word I had learned, without moving my lips.
'The herb must take root in thought before it flowers in sound,' he said.
sentences.cn: '草药必须先在思想里生根，才能在声音中开花，'他说。

sentences.en: I walked three slow rounds.
sentences.cn: 我缓步走了三圈。

sentences.en: On the fourth, I felt something warm stir behind my ribs.
sentences.cn: 第四圈时，我感到肋骨后有什么温暖的东西在翻动。

neither:1.en: Master Qingwu set two sealed jars before us — one said to hold the Word of Stillness, one the Word of Speed. She asked which we would open first. I looked at Xiaoxing; Xiaoxing looked at me. *Neither* of us reached forward. The silence stretched like silk pulled thin. Master Qingwu smiled for the first time all morning.
neither:1.cnHint: 师尊摆出两个封印罐，弟子们面面相觑，两人都没有伸手。
neither:1.hook: Both jars began to hum at exactly the same pitch.
neither:1.line: '*Neither* path is wrong,' Master Qingwu said, 'but only one is yours.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set two sealed jars before us — one said to hold the Word of Stillness, one the Word of Speed.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我们面前放了两个密封的罐子——一个据说装着静止之字，一个装着速度之字。

sentences.en: She asked which we would open first.
sentences.cn: 她问我们会先打开哪一个。

sentences.en: I looked at Xiaoxing; Xiaoxing looked at me.
sentences.cn: 我看向小杏，小杏看向我。

sentences.en: *Neither* of us reached forward.
The silence stretched like silk pulled thin.
sentences.cn: 沉默如丝般拉薄。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu smiled for the first time all morning.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊整个上午第一次笑了。

onto:1.en: Shen Wujiu pressed his palm flat *onto* the pale stone tablet at the mountain gate, and the carved words rose like smoke into his skin. He stepped back, breathing slowly, eyes distant. 'That is how the old disciples received their first Word,' Xiaoxing told me. The tablet was blank now, and waiting.
onto:1.cnHint: 师兄将手按在石碑上，字咒如烟升入掌中，石碑随即变空白。
onto:1.hook: When I looked again, one new character had appeared on the blank stone.
onto:1.line: 'Place your hand *onto* the tablet and hold still,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed his palm flat *onto* the pale stone tablet at the mountain gate, and the carved words rose like smoke into his skin.
He stepped back, breathing slowly, eyes distant.
sentences.cn: 他缓缓后退，呼吸平缓，眼神远方。

sentences.en: 'That is how the old disciples received their first Word,' Xiaoxing told me.
sentences.cn: 小杏告诉我，这就是老一代弟子接收他们第一个"字"的方式。

sentences.en: The tablet was blank now, and waiting.
sentences.cn: 石碑现在是空白的，在等待。

plus:1.en: The task seemed simple: speak the Word of Leaf *plus* the Word of Rain in a single breath to call soft mist from the valley. Xiaoxing managed it on her third try. I managed it on my ninth. Master Qingwu only said: 'Two Words together is not double the work — it is double the listening.' I wrote that down.
plus:1.cnHint: 练习同时吟诵两个字咒，小星第三次就成功，弟子用了九次才完成。
plus:1.hook: At the edge of the terrace, a third Word seemed to whisper itself.
plus:1.line: 'Leaf *plus* Rain,' Xiaoxing said, 'and the mountain breathes with you.'

sentences.en: The task seemed simple: speak the Word of Leaf *plus* the Word of Rain in a single breath to call soft mist from the valley.
Xiaoxing managed it on her third try.
sentences.cn: 小杏在第三次尝试时成功了。

sentences.en: I managed it on my ninth.
sentences.cn: 我在第九次时成功了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu only said: 'Two Words together is not double the work — it is double the listening.'
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊只说：'两个字合在一起不是双倍的工作——是双倍的倾听。'

sentences.en: I wrote that down.
sentences.cn: 我把那句话记了下来。

root:1.en: Shen Wujiu crouched beside the stone gutter at the base of the oldest pine and pointed to where its *root* broke through the rock. 'Every Word has one of these,' he said, 'a place where it first broke through. Find that place and the whole tree is yours.' I pressed my fingers to the root. It was warmer than I expected.
root:1.cnHint: 师兄指着古松破石而出的根，说每个字咒也有这样一个起点。
root:1.hook: The pine groaned once, deep and slow, as if something beneath it had turned over.
root:1.line: 'Find the *root* of a Word,' Shen Wujiu said, 'and it will never leave you.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu crouched beside the stone gutter at the base of the oldest pine and pointed to where its *root* broke through the rock.
'Every Word has one of these,' he said, 'a place where it first broke through.
sentences.cn: '每个字都有这么一个地方，'他说，'一个它第一次突破的地方。

sentences.en: Find that place and the whole tree is yours.'
sentences.cn: 找到那个地方，整棵树就是你的了。'

sentences.en: I pressed my fingers to the root.
sentences.cn: 我把手指按在树根上。

sentences.en: It was warmer than I expected.
sentences.cn: 它比我预期的要温暖。

satisfy:1.en: After the noon trial, Master Qingwu reviewed our recitations one by one. She paused longest at mine — not to correct, but to listen again. 'It does not yet *satisfy* the mountain,' she said at last, 'but it no longer troubles it.' Outside, a thin line of cloud drifted upward against the wind, which was, I decided, enough for today.
satisfy:1.cnHint: 午后考核，师尊说弟子的吟诵还不能____山岳，但已不再令其不安。
satisfy:1.hook: Then a second cloud line rose, curling toward the highest peak.
satisfy:1.line: 'Let the Word *satisfy* the air around it,' Master Qingwu said, 'not just the ear.'

sentences.en: After the noon trial, Master Qingwu reviewed our recitations one by one.
sentences.cn: 午时的考试后，青梧师尊逐一审视了我们的诵读。

sentences.en: She paused longest at mine — not to correct, but to listen again.
sentences.cn: 她在我的地方停留最久——不是为了纠正，而是再次倾听。

sentences.en: 'It does not yet *satisfy* the mountain,' she said at last, 'but it no longer troubles it.'
Outside, a thin line of cloud drifted upward against the wind, which was, I decided, enough for today.
sentences.cn: 外面，一缕薄云逆风飘起，我决定，这对今天来说已经足够了。

invite:2.en: A sealed scroll arrived at my door before dawn, its ribbon tied in the Cloud Sea Sect's blue knot. Inside, three words glowed like morning frost: Master Qingwu wished to *invite* me to the Peak of Written Wind for a private lesson. No reason was given. No refusal was possible.
invite:2.cnHint: 一封神秘的封印卷轴出现在门前，师尊____我去听私课。
invite:2.hook: The scroll's ink still moved, tracing a shape I could not name.
invite:2.line: 'I *invite* you alone — tell no one else you are coming.'

sentences.en: A sealed scroll arrived at my door before dawn, its ribbon tied in the Cloud Sea Sect's blue knot.
sentences.cn: 天亮前，一卷密封的卷轴送到了我的门前，用云海派的蓝色结打好了丝带。

sentences.en: Inside, three words glowed like morning frost: Master Qingwu wished to *invite* me to the Peak of Written Wind for a private lesson.
No reason was given.
sentences.cn: 没有给出原因。

sentences.en: No refusal was possible.
sentences.cn: 没有拒绝的余地。

million:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the Archive Cliff, where carved characters covered every surface from base to sky. 'A *million* words sleep in this stone,' he said quietly, 'and only a handful have ever been woken.' I pressed my palm to the rock and felt something breathe.
million:2.cnHint: 在档案崖，师兄说石壁中沉睡着____个文字。
million:2.hook: Beneath my hand, one character began, very slowly, to warm.
million:2.line: 'A *million* words wait here, but only one will choose you.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the Archive Cliff, where carved characters covered every surface from base to sky.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我来到了档案悬崖，每个表面从底部到天空都覆满了刻制的字符。

sentences.en: 'A *million* words sleep in this stone,' he said quietly, 'and only a handful have ever been woken.'
I pressed my palm to the rock and felt something breathe.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌按在石头上，感受到了什么在呼吸。

represent:2.en: Master Qingwu placed five stones on the table, each carved with a different mark. 'Every stone,' she said, 'can *represent* a healing word, a sword word, or a storm word — the stone does not decide. You do.' I reached for the smallest one. My fingers trembled.
represent:2.cnHint: 师尊用五块刻字石解释，每块石头能____不同的灵字。
represent:2.hook: The stone I chose began to hum at a pitch no one else seemed to hear.
represent:2.line: 'What a word can *represent* depends entirely on the heart behind it.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed five stones on the table, each carved with a different mark.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在桌上放了五块石头，每块上刻着不同的记号。

sentences.en: 'Every stone,' she said, 'can *represent* a healing word, a sword word, or a storm word — the stone does not decide.
You do.'
sentences.cn: 你来决定。'

sentences.en: I reached for the smallest one.
sentences.cn: 我伸向最小的那块。

sentences.en: My fingers trembled.
sentences.cn: 我的手指在颤抖。

surprise:2.en: I found Xiaoxing sitting cross-legged on the bridge of mist, eyes closed. To my *surprise*, the air around her was full of slow-spinning characters, none of which I had ever seen in any lesson scroll. She opened one eye. 'You are late,' she said, as if this were perfectly ordinary.
surprise:2.cnHint: 看到师妹周围漂浮着陌生灵字，我感到非常____。
surprise:2.hook: One of the spinning characters drifted toward me and dissolved against my cheek like snow.
surprise:2.line: 'Your *surprise* tells me you still believe words only live in scrolls.'

sentences.en: I found Xiaoxing sitting cross-legged on the bridge of mist, eyes closed.
sentences.cn: 小杏盘腿坐在雾桥上,眼睛闭着,我发现了她。

sentences.en: To my *surprise*, the air around her was full of slow-spinning characters, none of which I had ever seen in any lesson scroll.
She opened one eye.
sentences.cn: 她睁开了一只眼睛。

sentences.en: 'You are late,' she said, as if this were perfectly ordinary.
sentences.cn: "你迟到了，"她说，仿佛这是再平常不过的事。

topic:2.en: At the evening gathering, Master Qingwu announced the *topic* of next month's trials: words that could carry weight across distance, from one floating mountain to another. The hall fell silent. Shen Wujiu tapped my shoulder once. Outside, a cloud formation shaped like an open hand drifted past the window.
topic:2.cnHint: 师尊宣布了下月考核的____，是关于能跨山传递的灵字。
topic:2.hook: The cloud hand slowly closed into a fist and was gone.
topic:2.line: 'The *topic* sounds simple — trust me, it has ended stronger disciples than you.'

sentences.en: At the evening gathering, Master Qingwu announced the *topic* of next month's trials: words that could carry weight across distance, from one floating mountain to another.
The hall fell silent.
sentences.cn: 大厅陷入了沉寂。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu tapped my shoulder once.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在我肩上轻轻敲了一下。

sentences.en: Outside, a cloud formation shaped like an open hand drifted past the window.
sentences.cn: 窗外,一团云朵飘过,形状像一只张开的手掌。

meat:2.en: Shen Wujiu set a bowl before me: plain rice, two vegetables, no *meat*. 'Disciples on the cloud-fast do not eat heavy food,' he explained. 'Heavy food weighs the breath, and a heavy breath cannot carry words upward.' I ate in silence, already feeling strangely light.
meat:2.cnHint: 师兄解释了为何修炼期间不能吃____，以免影响灵息上行。
meat:2.hook: By the time the bowl was empty, the floor beneath me seemed only barely solid.
meat:2.line: 'Leave the *meat* aside tonight — your breath needs to be clean by morning.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu set a bowl before me: plain rice, two vegetables, no *meat*.
'Disciples on the cloud-fast do not eat heavy food,' he explained.
sentences.cn: "禁食的弟子不吃油腻的东西,"他解释道。

sentences.en: 'Heavy food weighs the breath, and a heavy breath cannot carry words upward.'
sentences.cn: "油腻的食物压低呼吸,而沉重的呼吸无法把言语向上传送。"

sentences.en: I ate in silence, already feeling strangely light.
sentences.cn: 我默默地吃着,已经感到奇异的轻盈。

drink:2.en: After the long recitation trial, Xiaoxing pressed a small cup into my hands. The liquid was pale green, warm, and faintly sweet. 'Just *drink* it slowly,' she said. 'It is a recovery word dissolved in water.' I felt the syllables move down through my chest like sunlight through thin paper.
drink:2.cnHint: 师妹递来一杯溶有恢复灵字的水，让我慢慢____。
drink:2.hook: When I set the empty cup down, it rang like a bell for three full seconds.
drink:2.line: '*Drink* before you speak again — your voice channel is still open and cold.'

sentences.en: After the long recitation trial, Xiaoxing pressed a small cup into my hands.
sentences.cn: 长长的诵经试炼之后,小杏把一个小杯子塞进我手里。

sentences.en: The liquid was pale green, warm, and faintly sweet.
sentences.cn: 液体是淡绿色的,温热的,略有甜味。

sentences.en: 'Just *drink* it slowly,' she said.
'It is a recovery word dissolved in water.'
sentences.cn: "这是溶解在水里的恢复言语。"

sentences.en: I felt the syllables move down through my chest like sunlight through thin paper.
sentences.cn: 我感到音节像阳光穿过薄纸一样在我胸口流动。

sleep:2.en: I could not *sleep*. The word Master Qingwu had given me that morning sat behind my eyes, pulsing soft gold, refusing to settle. I rose and went to the window. Every floating mountain in the distance glowed with the same color, as if they, too, were keeping watch through the dark.
sleep:2.cnHint: 因为脑海中师尊所授灵字不停闪光，我无法____。
sleep:2.hook: Then, one by one, the mountains' lights went out — all except the one directly above.
sleep:2.line: 'If a word will not let you *sleep*, it means the word has chosen to teach you tonight.'

sentences.en: I could not *sleep*.
The word Master Qingwu had given me that morning sat behind my eyes, pulsing soft gold, refusing to settle.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊那个清晨给我的字眼在我眼后生了根，柔软的金光脉动着，怎么也安定不下来。

sentences.en: I rose and went to the window.
sentences.cn: 我起身走向窗边。

sentences.en: Every floating mountain in the distance glowed with the same color, as if they, too, were keeping watch through the dark.
sentences.cn: 远处每一座浮山都泛着同样的光色，仿佛它们也在暗夜里守着什么。

shop:2.en: Beneath the Outer Hall, where disciples traded sealed jars and pouches of dried essence, stood a quiet *shop* carved into the mountain itself. I paused at its stone counter. An old keeper slid a small scroll toward me without a word, as though he had been expecting my arrival all along.
shop:2.cnHint: 弟子在山壁间的____里，收到了掌柜无声递来的一卷神秘卷轴。
shop:2.hook: The scroll bore my name, written in ink that still glowed.
shop:2.line: 'This *shop* keeps no records, yet it knew you were coming.'

sentences.en: Beneath the Outer Hall, where disciples traded sealed jars and pouches of dried essence, stood a quiet *shop* carved into the mountain itself.
I paused at its stone counter.
sentences.cn: 我在它的石柜台前停了下来。

sentences.en: An old keeper slid a small scroll toward me without a word, as though he had been expecting my arrival all along.
sentences.cn: 一位苍老的店主无言地朝我推过一个小卷轴,似乎他一直在等我的到来。

electronic:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a formation plate etched with fine copper lines that hummed softly. 'In the lower world they call such things *electronic*,' she said, 'but here the current is not electricity — it is will, flowing through metal like water through jade.' I touched it and felt my own breath quicken.
electronic:2.cnHint: 师尊向弟子展示一块铜纹法盘，说明界外将这类事物称为____。
electronic:2.hook: Where my finger pressed, a single character burned itself into the copper.
electronic:2.line: 'They call it *electronic* below; we call it the will-current above.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a formation plate etched with fine copper lines that hummed softly.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊展开了一块蚀刻着细铜线的阵盘,它柔声嗡鸣。

sentences.en: 'In the lower world they call such things *electronic*,' she said, 'but here the current is not electricity — it is will, flowing through metal like water through jade.'
I touched it and felt my own breath quicken.
sentences.cn: 我触摸了它,感到自己的呼吸加快了。

wild:2.en: Beyond the sect's eastern boundary the herbs grew without order, *wild* and fierce, their roots cracking the floating stone like impatient hands. Shen Wujiu warned me never to harvest alone out there. I nodded. But I had already seen a silver stalk swaying where no wind moved.
wild:2.cnHint: 山门以东，草药____生长，师兄叮嘱弟子不可独自前往。
wild:2.hook: The silver stalk swayed again, leaning unmistakably toward me.
wild:2.line: 'Every *wild* herb out there has already chosen its own master.'

sentences.en: Beyond the sect's eastern boundary the herbs grew without order, *wild* and fierce, their roots cracking the floating stone like impatient hands.
Shen Wujiu warned me never to harvest alone out there.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎警告我永远不要独自在那儿采集。

sentences.en: I nodded.
sentences.cn: 我点了点头。

sentences.en: But I had already seen a silver stalk swaying where no wind moved.
sentences.cn: 但我已经看到一根银色的茎在无风之处摇曳。

rich:2.en: The soil on the seventh terrace was *rich* and dark, layered with centuries of fallen cloud and dissolved starlight. Master Qingwu pressed a handful of it between her palms and the whole terrace shimmered. Even the air tasted different — thick with possibility, heavy as a promise not yet spoken.
rich:2.cnHint: 第七台地的土壤____而深沉，师尊轻握一把便令整片台地泛起光晕。
rich:2.hook: Beneath that shimmering soil, something round and hard shifted.
rich:2.line: 'Soil this *rich* does not form on its own — something feeds it.'

sentences.en: The soil on the seventh terrace was *rich* and dark, layered with centuries of fallen cloud and dissolved starlight.
Master Qingwu pressed a handful of it between her palms and the whole terrace shimmered.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把一把它握在掌心,整个露台闪闪发光。

sentences.en: Even the air tasted different — thick with possibility, heavy as a promise not yet spoken.
sentences.cn: 连空气的味道也不同了——厚重的可能性,沉重如一个未曾言说的承诺。

special:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small pouch into my hands before dawn, her expression unusually serious. 'These seeds are *special*,' she whispered. 'They only open for someone whose intent is completely pure. Master Qingwu gave me three; I am giving you one.' The pouch was warm, as though the seed inside was already breathing.
special:2.cnHint: 师妹黎明前将一枚____的种子交给弟子，叮嘱心意必须纯净。
special:2.hook: The pouch grew warmer the moment doubt entered my mind.
special:2.line: 'Guard it well — a *special* seed reads the heart before it roots.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small pouch into my hands before dawn, her expression unusually serious.
sentences.cn: 小杏在黎明前把一个小布袋塞进我手里,她的表情异常严肃。

sentences.en: 'These seeds are *special*,' she whispered.
'They only open for someone whose intent is completely pure.
sentences.cn: "它们只对意图完全纯净的人打开。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu gave me three; I am giving you one.'
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊给了我三粒;我给你一粒。"

sentences.en: The pouch was warm, as though the seed inside was already breathing.
sentences.cn: 布袋是温热的,仿佛里面的种子已经在呼吸。

text:2.en: The old archive chamber held one wall covered entirely in carved stone *text*, each character no larger than a grain of rice. I had been sent to copy three lines. When I raised my brush to the first line, however, every other character on the wall faded, leaving only a message meant for me.
text:2.cnHint: 弟子奉命抄录石壁上的____，然而整面墙字迹骤然隐去，只留下专属于他的话语。
text:2.hook: The remaining characters formed a name — my name from a past life.
text:2.line: 'The *text* on that wall has been waiting three hundred years for you.'

sentences.en: The old archive chamber held one wall covered entirely in carved stone *text*, each character no larger than a grain of rice.
I had been sent to copy three lines.
sentences.cn: 我被派去抄三行。

sentences.en: When I raised my brush to the first line, however, every other character on the wall faded, leaving only a message meant for me.
sentences.cn: 然而当我举起笔对着第一行时,墙上的所有其他字都褪去了,留下一条只为我而写的信息。

front:2.en: I stood at the *front* of the long stone bridge, looking out where the clouds broke apart to reveal a second sky below — pale and vast, a mirror of the one above. Shen Wujiu came to stand beside me in silence. Neither of us moved. The bridge hummed once beneath our feet.
front:2.cnHint: 弟子立于长桥____，俯视云层破开处显现的第二片天空，石桥随即轻鸣一声。
front:2.hook: The hum rose in pitch, as though the bridge recognized a weight it remembered.
front:2.line: 'Standing at the *front* here, you can hear the two skies breathing.'

sentences.en: I stood at the *front* of the long stone bridge, looking out where the clouds broke apart to reveal a second sky below — pale and vast, a mirror of the one above.
Shen Wujiu came to stand beside me in silence.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎无声地走来站在我身边。

sentences.en: Neither of us moved.
sentences.cn: 我们都没有动。

sentences.en: The bridge hummed once beneath our feet.
sentences.cn: 石桥在我们脚下哼了一声。

law:2.en: Master Qingwu spoke quietly but without softness: 'There is one *law* above all others in this sect — never take a word-herb that has not offered itself.' I had already reached toward a bright root before she finished. The root withdrew into the stone. My hand was left cold and empty in the open air.
law:2.cnHint: 师尊告诫弟子本门最重要的____，而弟子已在她话音未落时伸出了手。
law:2.hook: The hollow in the stone sealed over, smooth as if nothing had ever grown there.
law:2.line: 'Break that *law* once and the mountain remembers your name forever.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu spoke quietly but without softness: 'There is one *law* above all others in this sect — never take a word-herb that has not offered itself.'
I had already reached toward a bright root before she finished.
sentences.cn: 她还没说完，我就已经伸手去摘那根闪闪发亮的根茎。

sentences.en: The root withdrew into the stone.
sentences.cn: 根茎缩回了石头里。

sentences.en: My hand was left cold and empty in the open air.
sentences.cn: 我的手在空气中被冻得冷冰冰、空荡荡的。

meaning:2.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found a scroll sealed with jade thread. No disciple had touched it in a hundred years. As I unrolled it, the characters began to glow, each one carrying a *meaning* beyond its common use — not just 'wind,' but the memory of every gale that had ever lifted a cultivator into the sky.
meaning:2.cnHint: 我在藏经窟发现一卷古老封印的竹简，其中文字散发微光，似乎隐藏着超乎寻常的____。
meaning:2.hook: The last character on the scroll was still wet with ink.
meaning:2.line: 'Every word holds a *meaning* that can shake the clouds,' Master Qingwu said softly.

sentences.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found a scroll sealed with jade thread.
sentences.cn: 在藏书阁的深处，我找到了一卷用玉线封起来的竹简。

sentences.en: No disciple had touched it in a hundred years.
sentences.cn: 一百年来没有弟子碰过它。

sentences.en: As I unrolled it, the characters began to glow, each one carrying a *meaning* beyond its common use — not just 'wind,' but the memory of every gale that had ever lifted a cultivator into the sky.

strengthen:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the Stone Terrace at dawn, where wind from the lower clouds swept up in cold sheets. 'Breathe against it,' he said. Each breath pushed back the gust, and I felt my spirit root *strengthen*, growing deeper into my body like a tree finding new earth after rain.
strengthen:2.cnHint: 在石台之上，我随师兄迎风吐纳，感到自己的灵根正在____。
strengthen:2.hook: Below the terrace, the clouds parted to reveal a second, darker sky.
strengthen:2.line: 'Only resistance will *strengthen* the root within you,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the Stone Terrace at dawn, where wind from the lower clouds swept up in cold sheets.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在黎明时分领我来到了石台，寒风从下方的云层中卷起，铺天盖地地扑来。

sentences.en: 'Breathe against it,' he said.
sentences.cn: "迎风呼吸，"他说。

sentences.en: Each breath pushed back the gust, and I felt my spirit root *strengthen*, growing deeper into my body like a tree finding new earth after rain.

competitive:2.en: The Sect held its autumn ranking before the first frost. Xiaoxing warned me the trial was more *competitive* than it appeared — disciples who seemed calm were already counting one another's weak steps, reading the air like hawks above an open field, each one measuring the distance to the highest peak.
competitive:2.cnHint: 在秋季排名大考前，师妹提醒我这场试炼远比看上去更具____。
competitive:2.hook: A name had been erased from last year's stone tablet.
competitive:2.line: 'Do not be fooled — this trial is deeply *competitive*,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: The Sect held its autumn ranking before the first frost.
sentences.cn: 宗门在初霜之前举办了秋季排名大会。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing warned me the trial was more *competitive* than it appeared — disciples who seemed calm were already counting one another's weak steps, reading the air like hawks above an open field, each one measuring the distance to the highest peak.

recently:2.en: Master Qingwu examined my practice board without a word for a long time. Then she said that the high passages above Cloud Gate had *recently* been sealed by an unknown force, and that three senior disciples sent to investigate had come back unable to speak, their scrolls blank as new snow.
recently:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，云关之上的高空通道____被一股神秘力量封堵，数名师兄归来后哑口无言。
recently:2.hook: She handed me a travel pack before I could ask why.
recently:2.line: 'The upper paths have *recently* begun to change,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu examined my practice board without a word for a long time.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊长久地注视着我的修行简，一言不发。

sentences.en: Then she said that the high passages above Cloud Gate had *recently* been sealed by an unknown force, and that three senior disciples sent to investigate had come back unable to speak, their scrolls blank as new snow.

nation:2.en: In the Hall of Origins, stone carvings covered every wall — a record of the Cloud Sea Sect across ten thousand years. Xiaoxing traced one scene with her finger: a *nation* of cultivators rising together on a single wind, lifting a continent free of sorrow for one bright season before the clouds returned.
nation:2.cnHint: 在起源殿，师妹指着石壁上一幅古画，画中一个修炼者的____乘风齐飞，共渡苦难。
nation:2.hook: The last carving on the wall was unfinished, its chisel still embedded in stone.
nation:2.line: 'A whole *nation* once flew from this very peak,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: In the Hall of Origins, stone carvings covered every wall — a record of the Cloud Sea Sect across ten thousand years.
sentences.cn: 起源殿的四面八方都刻满了石雕——这是云海宗万年来的记录。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing traced one scene with her finger: a *nation* of cultivators rising together on a single wind, lifting a continent free of sorrow for one bright season before the clouds returned.

perceive:2.en: I stood at the Mist Gate for the first time, staring into a white wall of cloud that hid the path ahead. Master Qingwu told me to close my eyes. Only then could I *perceive* the faint warmth threading through the cold — a living current, the breath of the mountain itself, pointing the way forward.
perceive:2.cnHint: 站在雾关前，师尊要我闭上眼睛，只有这样才能____那条隐藏在寒气中的温热通道。
perceive:2.hook: When I opened my eyes, the mist had taken the shape of a hand.
perceive:2.line: 'Close your eyes — only then will you *perceive* the true path,' she said.

sentences.en: I stood at the Mist Gate for the first time, staring into a white wall of cloud that hid the path ahead.
sentences.cn: 我第一次站在雾门前，凝视着那堵隐没了前路的白色云墙。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told me to close my eyes.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊告诉我闭上眼睛。

sentences.en: Only then could I *perceive* the faint warmth threading through the cold — a living current, the breath of the mountain itself, pointing the way forward.

pound:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me the Medicine Terrace, where she ground sun-dried spirit herbs with a heavy stone. She let the pestle fall with each breath, and every *pound* sent a fine dust into the air that smelled of high altitude and old rain. She said the grinding was itself a kind of language the herbs understood.
pound:2.cnHint: 师妹在药台用石杵研磨灵草，每一____都带起一缕药香，她说这节奏本身就是一种灵草能听懂的语言。
pound:2.hook: One crushed leaf began to glow a pale, steady gold.
pound:2.line: 'Each *pound* of the pestle wakes the spirit inside,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me the Medicine Terrace, where she ground sun-dried spirit herbs with a heavy stone.
sentences.cn: 小杏带我来到了药台，她用一块沉重的石头碾磨着晒干的灵草。

sentences.en: She let the pestle fall with each breath, and every *pound* sent a fine dust into the air that smelled of high altitude and old rain.
She said the grinding was itself a kind of language the herbs understood.
sentences.cn: 她说这碾磨本身是灵草能听懂的一种语言。

purpose:2.en: I found Shen Wujiu sitting alone at the edge of the East Cliff, holding a plain iron token with no markings. He said Master Qingwu had given it to him years ago without explanation. He had carried it every day since, waiting to understand its *purpose*, trusting that the right moment would make it clear.
purpose:2.cnHint: 我发现师兄独坐东崖，手持一枚师尊多年前赠予的无字铁牌，至今仍不明白它的____。
purpose:2.hook: As I sat beside him, the token grew warm in his hand.
purpose:2.line: 'I still do not know its *purpose*, but I carry it still,' he said.

sentences.en: I found Shen Wujiu sitting alone at the edge of the East Cliff, holding a plain iron token with no markings.
sentences.cn: 我找到沈无咎时，他正独自坐在东崖边缘，手里握着一枚没有纹样的素铁令牌。

sentences.en: He said Master Qingwu had given it to him years ago without explanation.
sentences.cn: 他说这是青梧师尊许多年前给他的，没有解释。

sentences.en: He had carried it every day since, waiting to understand its *purpose*, trusting that the right moment would make it clear.

thinking:2.en: I found the old record in the sect library and sat with it all morning. My *thinking* slowly cleared, like mist lifting from the mountain edge: the five ascending words were not a sequence but a circle. Each one fed the next. I copied the pattern onto my palm and felt a faint warmth rise through my wrist.
thinking:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现了一份古老记录，经过长时间的____，终于看出五个飞升字诀其实构成一个循环。
thinking:2.hook: But the final word in the circle had been deliberately scratched out.
thinking:2.line: 'My *thinking* tells me this circle was meant to be hidden,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

sentences.en: I found the old record in the sect library and sat with it all morning.
sentences.cn: 我在宗门藏书阁里找到了那份古老的记录，整个上午都在研习它。

sentences.en: My *thinking* slowly cleared, like mist lifting from the mountain edge: the five ascending words were not a sequence but a circle.
Each one fed the next.
sentences.cn: 每一个相互衔接。

sentences.en: I copied the pattern onto my palm and felt a faint warmth rise through my wrist.
sentences.cn: 我把这个图案抄在掌心，感到一股微弱的温热从手腕升起。

cover:2.en: A thin sheet of jade lay over the altar stone, used as a *cover* to keep dust from the inscription beneath. I lifted it carefully. The words carved into the stone glowed faint gold the moment open air touched them, then faded, as if embarrassed to be seen.
cover:2.cnHint: 祭坛石刻上有一块玉片作为____，我将其掀开后，石上字迹瞬间发出淡金色光芒。
cover:2.hook: The glow left a single word burned onto the back of my hand.
cover:2.line: 'Remove the *cover* gently,' Master Qingwu said, 'or the inscription will seal itself.'

sentences.en: A thin sheet of jade lay over the altar stone, used as a *cover* to keep dust from the inscription beneath.
I lifted it carefully.
sentences.cn: 我小心地把它揭起来。

sentences.en: The words carved into the stone glowed faint gold the moment open air touched them, then faded, as if embarrassed to be seen.
sentences.cn: 当清新的空气接触到石头时，刻在上面的字闪起淡金色的光，随即褪去，仿佛羞于被人看见。

earth:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small handful of dark soil into my palm. She had carried it all the way from the valley floor, far below the clouds. 'Words written in mountain *earth* hold longer,' she said. I traced the first ascending formula in the soil and it stayed bright for three full breaths.
earth:2.cnHint: 小星从云层下方的山谷带来一把深色泥土，用山中____书写的字诀能保持更久的光芒。
earth:2.hook: On the fourth breath, the soil in my palm turned to ash and floated upward.
earth:2.line: 'Mountain *earth* from below the clouds remembers the sky,' Xiaoxing said quietly.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small handful of dark soil into my palm.
sentences.cn: 小杏在我的掌心塞了一小把深色的泥土。

sentences.en: She had carried it all the way from the valley floor, far below the clouds.
sentences.cn: 她把它一路从远下方的山谷底部运上来，那里还在云层之下。

sentences.en: 'Words written in mountain *earth* hold longer,' she said.
I traced the first ascending formula in the soil and it stayed bright for three full breaths.
sentences.cn: 我用泥土描绘出第一道上升的法诀，它闪亮了整整三个呼吸的时间。

paper:2.en: The message was folded into the shape of a crane and left on my windowsill. I opened it to find a single line written on pale *paper* in Master Qingwu's hand: the word for ascent, followed by a question mark. No explanation. The ink smelled faintly of pine and altitude.
paper:2.cnHint: 窗台上有一只纸鹤，展开后是写在____上的一行字——大师亲笔写下飞升之字，后面跟着一个问号。
paper:2.hook: When I looked up, the crane shape had refolded itself and flown from the sill.
paper:2.line: 'This *paper* carries a question only you can answer,' Shen Wujiu told me.

sentences.en: The message was folded into the shape of a crane and left on my windowsill.
sentences.cn: 纸鹤被叠成起翔的样子，搁在我的窗台上。

sentences.en: I opened it to find a single line written on pale *paper* in Master Qingwu's hand: the word for ascent, followed by a question mark.
No explanation.
sentences.cn: 没有任何解释。

sentences.en: The ink smelled faintly of pine and altitude.
sentences.cn: 墨水里淡淡地飘着松脂和高度的味道。

art:2.en: Shen Wujiu called it the *art* of listening: you did not read the ascending words so much as let them speak through the silence between strokes. He demonstrated once, eyes closed, brush moving without touching the page, and still the characters appeared. I watched and understood nothing — yet.
art:2.cnHint: 师兄将这种倾听之____展示给我看：闭眼悬笔，字迹竟自行浮现在纸上。
art:2.hook: The characters he had not written slowly rearranged themselves into a warning.
art:2.line: 'The *art* of ascending is not in the word but in the breath before it,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu called it the *art* of listening: you did not read the ascending words so much as let them speak through the silence between strokes.
He demonstrated once, eyes closed, brush moving without touching the page, and still the characters appeared.
sentences.cn: 他演示过一次，闭着眼睛，笔尖悬空而动，文字却自己浮现了出来。

sentences.en: I watched and understood nothing — yet.
sentences.cn: 我看着，什么都没懂——但还没到时候。

street:2.en: In the vision that came with the fever, I walked a *street* of cloud-stone between two rows of empty sect halls. Every door bore a word I did not know. At the far end stood a figure with its back to me. When I called out, my voice made no sound, and the figure began to rise slowly off the ground.
street:2.cnHint: 高烧引发的幻象中，我走在云石铺成的____上，两旁空荡荡的宗门大殿每扇门上都刻着陌生字符。
street:2.hook: I woke clutching a word I had never studied — and I knew its meaning exactly.
street:2.line: 'That *street* appears only to disciples on the edge of breakthrough,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: In the vision that came with the fever, I walked a *street* of cloud-stone between two rows of empty sect halls.
Every door bore a word I did not know.
sentences.cn: 每道门上都写着我不认识的字。

sentences.en: At the far end stood a figure with its back to me.
sentences.cn: 远处站着一个背对着我的身影。

sentences.en: When I called out, my voice made no sound, and the figure began to rise slowly off the ground.
sentences.cn: 我叫了一声，声音却没有传出去，那身影开始缓缓升起。

talent:2.en: Master Qingwu reviewed my practice scrolls without expression. Then she said: '*Talent* for the ascending words is not speed — it is the size of the silence you can hold between them.' She handed the scrolls back and walked away. I read them again and heard, for the first time, what I had been missing.
talent:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊审阅我的练习卷轴后说，掌握飞升字诀的____不在于速度，而在于字与字之间能容纳多大的静默。
talent:2.hook: That night my brush moved on its own and wrote a word I had never seen before.
talent:2.line: 'Your *talent* is real, but you keep filling the silence with noise,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu reviewed my practice scrolls without expression.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊看我的练习卷，面无表情。

sentences.en: Then she said: '*Talent* for the ascending words is not speed — it is the size of the silence you can hold between them.'
She handed the scrolls back and walked away.
sentences.cn: 她把卷子递回来，转身走了。

sentences.en: I read them again and heard, for the first time, what I had been missing.
sentences.cn: 我再读一遍，第一次听到了自己一直在错过的东西。

overall:2.en: Xiaoxing spread all my practice sheets on the stone floor and stepped back. The *overall* pattern was clear from a distance: every mistake clustered around the third word of the sequence, the one meaning 'release.' Up close I had never seen it. She said nothing and let the pattern speak for itself.
overall:2.cnHint: 小星将我所有的练习纸铺在地上，从远处看，____规律一目了然——所有错误都集中在第三个字诀上。
overall:2.hook: The third word began to glow red on every single sheet at once.
overall:2.line: 'The *overall* shape of your practice reveals what one page hides,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread all my practice sheets on the stone floor and stepped back.
sentences.cn: 小杏把我所有的练习纸铺满了石地，往后退了一步。

sentences.en: The *overall* pattern was clear from a distance: every mistake clustered around the third word of the sequence, the one meaning 'release.'
Up close I had never seen it.
sentences.cn: 凑近了根本看不出来。

sentences.en: She said nothing and let the pattern speak for itself.
sentences.cn: 她什么也没说，让图案自己说话。

respond:2.en: A sealed jade slip arrived at my window before dawn, carrying Master Qingwu's mark. Inside, one line glowed: 'The sky gate opens only for those who *respond* to its call before the third bell.' I pressed my hand to the slip and felt a faint trembling — as though the mountain itself was listening for my answer.
respond:2.cnHint: 一枚玉简在黎明前飘至窗口，要求弟子在第三声钟响前____。
respond:2.hook: The second bell had already rung.
respond:2.line: 'You must *respond* before the third bell, or the gate seals forever.'

sentences.en: A sealed jade slip arrived at my window before dawn, carrying Master Qingwu's mark.
sentences.cn: 天亮前，一枚密封的玉简敲上我的窗，带着青梧师尊的印记。

sentences.en: Inside, one line glowed: 'The sky gate opens only for those who *respond* to its call before the third bell.'
I pressed my hand to the slip and felt a faint trembling — as though the mountain itself was listening for my answer.
sentences.cn: 我按住玉简，感到一丝微颤——仿佛山峦本身在侧耳倾听我的答复。

welcome:2.en: At the Archive of Drifting Clouds, rows of glowing scrolls lined the shelves like sleeping fireflies. Shen Wujiu handed me a pale blue token. 'New disciples are *welcome* here only once without an elder,' he said quietly. I took the token, noticing that the characters on it shifted and rearranged themselves whenever I looked away.
welcome:2.cnHint: 在流云典籍阁，师兄递给我一块令牌，说明新弟子____的条件。
welcome:2.hook: One scroll had already begun to unroll on its own.
welcome:2.line: 'New disciples are *welcome* here only once without an elder.'

sentences.en: At the Archive of Drifting Clouds, rows of glowing scrolls lined the shelves like sleeping fireflies.
sentences.cn: 在流云文库，一排排发光的卷轴像睡着的萤火虫一样排满了架子。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a pale blue token.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一枚淡蓝色的令牌。

sentences.en: 'New disciples are *welcome* here only once without an elder,' he said quietly.
I took the token, noticing that the characters on it shifted and rearranged themselves whenever I looked away.
sentences.cn: 我接过令牌，发现上面的字每次我别开眼睛就会重新排列。

appeal:2.en: Deep inside the Peak of Listening Stones, I found a hollow rock with words carved into it: 'Whoever reads this makes an *appeal* to the wind — it will carry your name to the highest court of clouds.' I read the words aloud without thinking. A cold current wrapped around my shoulders like a hand, and lifted.
appeal:2.cnHint: 在听石峰的空心岩内，我读出一段铭文，无意间向风发出了____。
appeal:2.hook: Something far above had heard my name.
appeal:2.line: 'To carve these words is to send an *appeal* no elder can ignore.'

sentences.en: Deep inside the Peak of Listening Stones, I found a hollow rock with words carved into it: 'Whoever reads this makes an *appeal* to the wind — it will carry your name to the highest court of clouds.'
I read the words aloud without thinking.
sentences.cn: 我脱口念出了这些字。

sentences.en: A cold current wrapped around my shoulders like a hand, and lifted.
sentences.cn: 一股寒流像一只手一样缠上我的肩膀，然后托起了我。

finally:2.en: Xiaoxing and I had climbed the Spiral Staircase of Mist for what felt like hours, the clouds thickening with every step. Then the mist broke, and we *finally* stood on a platform of white stone that floated free of the mountain, anchored by nothing but a single silver chain. Below us, the whole Cloud Sea Sect lay small as a dream.
finally:2.cnHint: 在迷雾螺旋台阶上攀爬许久后，我和师妹____站上了悬空白石台。
finally:2.hook: The silver chain gave one slow, deliberate shudder.
finally:2.line: 'We have *finally* reached the place Master Qingwu told us never to seek.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing and I had climbed the Spiral Staircase of Mist for what felt like hours, the clouds thickening with every step.
sentences.cn: 小杏和我爬了几个小时的雾中螺梯，雾气随着每一步都在变浓。

sentences.en: Then the mist broke, and we *finally* stood on a platform of white stone that floated free of the mountain, anchored by nothing but a single silver chain.
Below us, the whole Cloud Sea Sect lay small as a dream.
sentences.cn: 我们下面，整个云海宗小得像一场梦。

guess:2.en: Shen Wujiu held up a sealed porcelain jar he had found beneath the roots of the Eldest Pine. He shook it once; something inside shifted with a sound like dry leaves. 'I *guess* it contains a compressed word-seed,' he said, studying the lid, 'powerful enough to bloom into a full formula on its own.' I stepped back without knowing why.
guess:2.cnHint: 师兄在古松根下发现了一只封口瓷罐，他____里面藏着一枚能自行开花的词种。
guess:2.hook: The lid had already begun to loosen from the inside.
guess:2.line: 'I *guess* this seed has been waiting longer than our sect has existed.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu held up a sealed porcelain jar he had found beneath the roots of the Eldest Pine.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎拿起一个他在最老的松树根下找到的密封瓷罐。

sentences.en: He shook it once; something inside shifted with a sound like dry leaves.
sentences.cn: 他晃了一下；罐子里的东西发出了像干叶子一样的声音。

sentences.en: 'I *guess* it contains a compressed word-seed,' he said, studying the lid, 'powerful enough to bloom into a full formula on its own.'
I stepped back without knowing why.
sentences.cn: 我往后退了一步，不知道为什么。

protection:2.en: In the Chamber of First Oaths, a ring of pale flame circled the ceiling. Master Qingwu placed a small carved disc in my palm. 'This carries the sect's *protection*,' she said. 'While you hold it, the cloud-wind will not pull you from the path.' The disc felt heavier than stone, and warmer than my own hand.
protection:2.cnHint: 在初誓堂，师尊将一枚刻纹圆牌放在我手中，说它承载着宗门的____。
protection:2.hook: The pale flame above suddenly leaned toward me, as if curious.
protection:2.line: 'While you hold this, the sect's *protection* travels with you.'

sentences.en: In the Chamber of First Oaths, a ring of pale flame circled the ceiling.
sentences.cn: 在初誓殿里，淡色的火焰围成了一圈，在天花板边缘燃烧。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a small carved disc in my palm.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把一个小小的刻花木盘放在我的手心里。

sentences.en: 'This carries the sect's *protection*,' she said.
'While you hold it, the cloud-wind will not pull you from the path.'
sentences.cn: 只要你拿着它，云风就拉不动你。

sentences.en: The disc felt heavier than stone, and warmer than my own hand.
sentences.cn: 木盘比石头还沉，比我自己的手还烫。

resident:2.en: Near the eastern edge of the floating mountain, a small stone hut sat half-buried in moss. Xiaoxing whispered that a *resident* of the hut had not been seen in forty years, yet fresh tea steamed on the windowsill. I leaned closer. Inside, a single candle burned, and beside it lay an open letter addressed to me.
resident:2.cnHint: 东崖石屋长年无人，但师妹说这里有一位____，屋内竟有新沏的热茶和写着我名字的信。
resident:2.line: 'The *resident* of that hut left this letter before you were even born.'

sentences.en: Near the eastern edge of the floating mountain, a small stone hut sat half-buried in moss.
sentences.cn: 浮山的东边边缘，有一间半埋在苔藓里的小石屋。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing whispered that a *resident* of the hut had not been seen in forty years, yet fresh tea steamed on the windowsill.
I leaned closer.
sentences.cn: 我凑得更近了。

sentences.en: Inside, a single candle burned, and beside it lay an open letter addressed to me.
sentences.cn: 屋里一支蜡烛在燃烧，蜡烛旁边放着一封信，收件人是我。

willing:2.en: The Map of Ascending Paths unrolled itself across the stone table, rivers of light tracing routes through the upper clouds. Master Qingwu looked at me steadily. 'Only those who are *willing* to release what they carry may pass the final gate,' she said. I glanced at the jade slip in my hand — the one that held every formula I had learned.
willing:2.cnHint: 升天路途图在石桌上展开，师尊告知我只有____放下所携之物的人才能通过最终关隘。
willing:2.hook: The jade slip in my hand began to grow warm, then warmer still.
willing:2.line: 'Are you truly *willing* to set down everything you have learned?'

sentences.en: The Map of Ascending Paths unrolled itself across the stone table, rivers of light tracing routes through the upper clouds.
sentences.cn: 《升道图》在石桌上展开，光之长河勾勒出通往上层云境的路线。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu looked at me steadily.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用沉静的目光注视着我。

sentences.en: 'Only those who are *willing* to release what they carry may pass the final gate,' she said.
I glanced at the jade slip in my hand — the one that held every formula I had learned.
sentences.cn: 我瞥了一眼掌中的玉简——里面存着我学过的每一道法诀。

satisfaction:2.en: I found the old scroll tucked behind a loose stone in the archive hall. Inside, a single word glowed like a warm coal. I spoke it aloud, and the cloud beneath my feet grew solid. Master Qingwu watched from the doorway, her eyes calm. A quiet *satisfaction* filled my chest — the kind that comes only from earning a thing.
satisfaction:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现了一卷古老的卷轴，念出其中的字后，脚下的云变得坚实，心中涌起深深的____。
satisfaction:2.hook: Then the stone where the scroll had rested began to glow.
satisfaction:2.line: 'This *satisfaction* you feel — let it teach you, not spoil you,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: I found the old scroll tucked behind a loose stone in the archive hall.
sentences.cn: 我在档案殿的松动石缝里发现了那卷古籍。

sentences.en: Inside, a single word glowed like a warm coal.
sentences.cn: 卷轴内一个字闪烁如温热的炭火。

sentences.en: I spoke it aloud, and the cloud beneath my feet grew solid.
sentences.cn: 我大声念出那个字，脚下的云霭顿时凝实了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched from the doorway, her eyes calm.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从门框里注视，眼神平静如镜。

sentences.en: A quiet *satisfaction* filled my chest — the kind that comes only from earning a thing.

cultivate:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small clay pot at the edge of the eastern terrace. Inside it sat a single root — a word-herb no bigger than my thumb. 'You must *cultivate* it with patience,' he said, 'the way you would a good habit.' I pressed the soil down and felt the root hum against my palm.
cultivate:2.cnHint: 师兄在东边平台给了我一株字草，要我用心____它，就像养成一个好习惯。
cultivate:2.hook: By nightfall, the pot had risen three inches off the shelf on its own.
cultivate:2.line: '*Cultivate* this word-herb well, and it will carry you higher than any wind,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small clay pot at the edge of the eastern terrace.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在东台边缘递给我一只小陶罐。

sentences.en: Inside it sat a single root — a word-herb no bigger than my thumb.
sentences.cn: 罐里躺着一根根茎——一株大不过我拇指的字草。

sentences.en: 'You must *cultivate* it with patience,' he said, 'the way you would a good habit.'
I pressed the soil down and felt the root hum against my palm.
sentences.cn: 我压紧了土壤，根茎在掌心发出嗡鸣。

productive:2.en: Xiaoxing and I spent the morning copying word-formulas in the quiet study hall. She filled four pages; I filled two, but mine held no errors. 'A short session can still be *productive*,' she said, tapping my pages with one finger. Outside, a crane landed on the railing and stood there, perfectly still, watching us.
productive:2.cnHint: 小星说，即使时间短，只要没有错误，这个早晨的练习也是很____的。
productive:2.hook: The crane tilted its head, as though it had understood every word.
productive:2.line: 'Two clean pages are more *productive* than four that must be rewritten,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing and I spent the morning copying word-formulas in the quiet study hall.
sentences.cn: 小杏和我在静谧的书房里整个上午都在抄写字诀。

sentences.en: She filled four pages; I filled two, but mine held no errors.
sentences.cn: 她填满了四页，我只填了两页，但我的页面无一错漏。

sentences.en: 'A short session can still be *productive*,' she said, tapping my pages with one finger.
Outside, a crane landed on the railing and stood there, perfectly still, watching us.
sentences.cn: 外面，一只鹤落在栏杆上，笔直地站立，注视着我们。

vision:2.en: Master Qingwu led me to the peak of Mirror Cliff just before dawn. She told me to close my eyes and speak the word for 'far.' When I opened them, my *vision* stretched beyond the nearest mountain, past the cloud-sea, to a line of peaks I had never seen before. They glittered like salt crystals in the first light.
vision:2.cnHint: 师尊带我来到镜崖，念出"远"字后，我的____延伸到了从未见过的山峰。
vision:2.hook: One of those distant peaks flickered, as if something on it had just woken.
vision:2.line: 'A wide *vision* is the first gift this sect will give you,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led me to the peak of Mirror Cliff just before dawn.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在天亮前夕引我登上镜崖之巅。

sentences.en: She told me to close my eyes and speak the word for 'far.'
sentences.cn: 她让我闭上眼睛，念出"远"这个字。

sentences.en: When I opened them, my *vision* stretched beyond the nearest mountain, past the cloud-sea, to a line of peaks I had never seen before.
They glittered like salt crystals in the first light.
sentences.cn: 它们在晨曦中闪烁如盐晶。

distance:2.en: I carried a message-stone across the rope bridge to the south pavilion. The bridge swayed over the cloud-sea, and the *distance* to the nearest safe ledge felt endless. I held the stone tightly; it pulsed with Shen Wujiu's voice, urging calm. I reached the pavilion just as the last plank cracked behind me.
distance:2.cnHint: 我手持传话石走过摇晃的绳桥，身下云海与安全落脚处之间的____让人心跳加速。
distance:2.hook: A second crack echoed — and the rope bridge was no longer there.
distance:2.line: 'The *distance* means nothing if your heart stays steady,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: I carried a message-stone across the rope bridge to the south pavilion.
sentences.cn: 我穿过云海上的绳桥，把传讯石送往南亭。

sentences.en: The bridge swayed over the cloud-sea, and the *distance* to the nearest safe ledge felt endless.
I held the stone tightly; it pulsed with Shen Wujiu's voice, urging calm.
sentences.cn: 我紧握着石子，它跳动着沈无咎的声音，劝我平心静气。

sentences.en: I reached the pavilion just as the last plank cracked behind me.
sentences.cn: 我刚踏上亭台，身后最后一块木板就裂开了。

forward:2.en: The sealed door at the hall's end had no handle, only a carved word none of us could read. Xiaoxing studied it for a long time, then stepped *forward* and traced the carving with one finger. The door did not open, but a thin line of gold appeared along its edge, as though something inside had noticed.
forward:2.cnHint: 小星向____迈了一步，用手指描摹那个无人能读的刻字，门缝中透出了一线金光。
forward:2.hook: The gold line pulsed once, then spelled a new word none of us recognized.
forward:2.line: 'Step *forward* and touch it — hesitation never opened any door,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: The sealed door at the hall's end had no handle, only a carved word none of us could read.
sentences.cn: 殿堂末端的密闭门上没有门把，只有一个我们都认不出的刻字。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing studied it for a long time, then stepped *forward* and traced the carving with one finger.
The door did not open, but a thin line of gold appeared along its edge, as though something inside had noticed.
sentences.cn: 门没有打开，但沿着边缘浮现了一道金色的细线，仿佛里面的什么注意到了。

harmful:2.en: I found a jar of ink in the storeroom, labeled with a word-formula I did not know. Shen Wujiu arrived before I could open it. He shook his head slowly. 'That one is *harmful* to a new disciple,' he said. 'It does not teach — it only takes.' He placed the jar on a high shelf and sealed it with a quiet word.
harmful:2.cnHint: 师兄阻止我打开那罐奇怪的墨水，说那个字对新弟子是____的，只会夺取而不会给予。
harmful:2.hook: From the high shelf, the jar gave off a single soft pulse of red light.
harmful:2.line: '*Harmful* words look tempting — that is exactly why they are locked away,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: I found a jar of ink in the storeroom, labeled with a word-formula I did not know.
sentences.cn: 我在储藏室里找到一罐墨，标着一个我不认识的字诀。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu arrived before I could open it.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在我打开前就到了。

sentences.en: He shook his head slowly.
sentences.cn: 他缓缓摇头。

sentences.en: 'That one is *harmful* to a new disciple,' he said.
'It does not teach — it only takes.'
sentences.cn: 它不会教导——只会夺取。

sentences.en: He placed the jar on a high shelf and sealed it with a quiet word.
sentences.cn: 他把罐子放上高架，用一个无声的字将它封印了。

impossible:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a stone in my palm and told me to lift it using only the word for 'rise.' I tried twelve times. On the thirteenth, the stone trembled. 'Nothing is *impossible* here,' she said, 'only unready.' The stone rose one inch, hung in the air, then fell — but this time it fell slowly, as if reluctant to return.
impossible:2.cnHint: 师尊让我仅凭"升"字抬起石头，她说在这里没有什么是____的，只有还未准备好的人。
impossible:2.hook: When the stone touched my palm again, it was warm — and lighter than before.
impossible:2.line: 'Call nothing *impossible* — call it a lesson you have not yet finished,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a stone in my palm and told me to lift it using only the word for 'rise.'
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我掌心放了一块石头，让我只用"起"这个字来举起它。

sentences.en: I tried twelve times.
sentences.cn: 我试了十二次。

sentences.en: On the thirteenth, the stone trembled.
sentences.cn: 第十三次，石头颤动了。

sentences.en: 'Nothing is *impossible* here,' she said, 'only unready.'
The stone rose one inch, hung in the air, then fell — but this time it fell slowly, as if reluctant to return.
sentences.cn: 石头升起一寸，悬在空中，然后下落——但这次它下得很慢，似乎不情愿回到原位。

admit:2.en: The sealed gate of the Archive Tower had never opened for a new disciple — until today. Master Qingwu pressed one finger to the stone and said nothing. The lock clicked. I had to *admit* that the word carved above the door was not decoration; it was a living key, breathing faintly in the mountain cold. Behind me, Shen Wujiu went very still.
admit:2.cnHint: 我不得不____这扇门上刻的字并非装饰，而是一把活着的钥匙。
admit:2.hook: The word above the door had begun to glow on its own.
admit:2.line: 'You must *admit* what you see, or the tower will never open for you again.'

sentences.en: The sealed gate of the Archive Tower had never opened for a new disciple — until today.
sentences.cn: 档案塔的密门从来没有为新弟子打开过——直到今天。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu pressed one finger to the stone and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊一根手指按在石面上，什么也没说。

sentences.en: The lock clicked.
sentences.cn: 锁发出了咔哒声。

sentences.en: I had to *admit* that the word carved above the door was not decoration; it was a living key, breathing faintly in the mountain cold.
Behind me, Shen Wujiu went very still.
sentences.cn: 身后，沈无咎完全静止了。

association:2.en: Deep in the library cave, I found a scroll listing every herb-word ever paired with wind. The *association* between 'rise' and 'light' was marked in red ink, meaning the pair could lift a person off the ground. Xiaoxing had been searching for this pairing for a month. I rolled the scroll tight and ran toward the eastern bridge.
association:2.cnHint: 我在山洞书库里发现了'升'与'轻'之间的____，这个组合据说能让人离地而起。
association:2.hook: Footsteps I did not recognize echoed behind me on the stone path.
association:2.line: 'The *association* between those two words is older than the Sect itself,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: Deep in the library cave, I found a scroll listing every herb-word ever paired with wind.
sentences.cn: 在图书洞的深处，我找到了一卷列出每一对风之草字的名单。

sentences.en: The *association* between 'rise' and 'light' was marked in red ink, meaning the pair could lift a person off the ground.
Xiaoxing had been searching for this pairing for a month.
sentences.cn: 小杏已经在寻找这个配对一个月了。

sentences.en: I rolled the scroll tight and ran toward the eastern bridge.
sentences.cn: 我卷紧了卷轴，朝东桥跑去。

brand:2.en: Inside the supply room, every medicine jar carried a small flame symbol burned into the clay. Xiaoxing explained that Master Qingwu had placed that *brand* on each jar herself, and any jar without it held false medicine. I checked the jar in my own pack. The flame was missing. My hands grew cold.
brand:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，师尊亲手在每个药罐上烙下____，没有这个印记的罐子装的是假药。
brand:2.hook: Someone had replaced the jar in my pack while I slept.
brand:2.line: 'Check for the *brand* before you swallow anything in this mountain,' Xiaoxing warned.

sentences.en: Inside the supply room, every medicine jar carried a small flame symbol burned into the clay.
sentences.cn: 在供应室里，每个药罐上都烙着一个小火焰符号。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing explained that Master Qingwu had placed that *brand* on each jar herself, and any jar without it held false medicine.
I checked the jar in my own pack.
sentences.cn: 我检查了自己包里的罐子。

sentences.en: The flame was missing.
sentences.cn: 火焰不见了。

sentences.en: My hands grew cold.
sentences.cn: 我的手冷了下来。

deep:2.en: The message was folded into a crane and left on my sleeping mat. I opened it to find only four words in Shen Wujiu's handwriting: 'Do not go *deep*.' Below the writing, a rough map showed the inner valleys of the mountain, with one passage crossed out in heavy ink. I had planned to enter that passage at dawn.
deep:2.cnHint: 信里只写了四个字，叫我不要走____，还画出了一条被墨水划掉的山谷通道。
deep:2.hook: The ink on the map was still wet.
deep:2.line: 'Never go *deep* into the inner valley before the fog lifts,' Shen Wujiu had written.

sentences.en: The message was folded into a crane and left on my sleeping mat.
sentences.cn: 那条消息被叠成了一只纸鹤，留在我的睡垫上。

sentences.en: I opened it to find only four words in Shen Wujiu's handwriting: 'Do not go *deep*.'
Below the writing, a rough map showed the inner valleys of the mountain, with one passage crossed out in heavy ink.
sentences.cn: 下面是一张粗糙的地图，画着山内的几条谷道，其中一条被浓黑的墨迹划掉了。

sentences.en: I had planned to enter that passage at dawn.
sentences.cn: 我原本打算天亮就进那条谷道。

discover:2.en: Pressed between two old texts, I found a thin leaf the color of still water. I brought it to the window and let morning light pass through it. Letters appeared in the veins. To *discover* a word-leaf was said to happen once in a generation; Master Qingwu had told us so on our first day. My breath fogged the cold glass.
discover:2.cnHint: 我在两本旧书之间夹到一片薄叶，对着光才____了叶脉里隐藏的文字。
discover:2.hook: The letters in the leaf slowly rearranged themselves into a warning.
discover:2.line: 'To *discover* a word-leaf means the mountain has chosen to speak to you,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Pressed between two old texts, I found a thin leaf the color of still water.
sentences.cn: 我在两本陈旧的书之间夹着一片薄叶，叶色如静水。

sentences.en: I brought it to the window and let morning light pass through it.
sentences.cn: 我把它拿到窗边，让晨光透过去。

sentences.en: Letters appeared in the veins.
sentences.cn: 字迹在叶脉上显现出来。

sentences.en: To *discover* a word-leaf was said to happen once in a generation; Master Qingwu had told us so on our first day.
My breath fogged the cold glass.
sentences.cn: 我的呼吸在冷玻璃上蒙上了一层雾。

essential:2.en: The repair kit for a broken word-stone contained seven items, and the instruction slip listed each one. Six could be replaced; the seventh, a drop of morning dew collected before sunrise, was *essential* and could not be swapped for anything else. I had none. Shen Wujiu read over my shoulder, then pointed silently at the sky — still dark, still time.
essential:2.cnHint: 修复词石需要七样东西，其中日出前的晨露是____，无可替代，而天还没亮。
essential:2.hook: A crack ran across the word-stone, spreading wider with each breath.
essential:2.line: 'Morning dew is *essential*; without it the stone will not hold the word,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: The repair kit for a broken word-stone contained seven items, and the instruction slip listed each one.
sentences.cn: 修复一块碎裂的文字石需要七样东西，说明条上一一列着。

sentences.en: Six could be replaced; the seventh, a drop of morning dew collected before sunrise, was *essential* and could not be swapped for anything else.
I had none.
sentences.cn: 我一样都没有。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu read over my shoulder, then pointed silently at the sky — still dark, still time.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从我肩后读完，然后无言地指向天空——还是黑的，还有时间。

fine:2.en: The cloud-compass had been dropped and its needle spun without stopping. I feared it was broken beyond use, but Xiaoxing turned it over, blew on the base, and set it on a flat rock. The needle slowed and settled north. 'It is *fine*,' she said, handing it back with a small smile. Through the window, the mountain peak wore a ring of dark cloud.
fine:2.cnHint: 云罗盘的指针一直在转，但小星检查后说它____，随即将其还给了我。
fine:2.hook: The dark cloud around the peak had not been there an hour ago.
fine:2.line: 'It is *fine* — but do not drop it a second time,' Xiaoxing said, her voice soft but firm.

sentences.en: The cloud-compass had been dropped and its needle spun without stopping.
sentences.cn: 云罗盘被摔了，指针不停地转圈。

sentences.en: I feared it was broken beyond use, but Xiaoxing turned it over, blew on the base, and set it on a flat rock.
sentences.cn: 我担心它坏掉了，但小杏把它翻过来，吹了吹底座，放在一块平石上。

sentences.en: The needle slowed and settled north.
sentences.cn: 指针渐渐慢了下来，停在北方。

sentences.en: 'It is *fine*,' she said, handing it back with a small smile.
Through the window, the mountain peak wore a ring of dark cloud.
sentences.cn: 通过窗户，山峰戴着一圈乌云。

largely:2.en: A torn map of the upper terraces showed the growing zones for word-herbs, and I studied it by candlelight. The eastern slopes were *largely* covered in silence-moss, which dulls the voice and must never be harvested at noon. A single note in small handwriting at the map's edge read: 'One patch is missing.' I looked at the eastern slope and counted.
largely:2.cnHint: 残旧地图显示上层台地____被消声苔覆盖，地图边缘还有人留下了一行小字。
largely:2.hook: The patch marked 'missing' was exactly where I had walked that morning.
largely:2.line: 'The eastern slope is *largely* safe, but trust the map only where it still has color,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: A torn map of the upper terraces showed the growing zones for word-herbs, and I studied it by candlelight.
sentences.cn: 一张上层梯田的破地图标出了词草的种植区，我对着烛光研究。

sentences.en: The eastern slopes were *largely* covered in silence-moss, which dulls the voice and must never be harvested at noon.
A single note in small handwriting at the map's edge read: 'One patch is missing.'
sentences.cn: 地图边缘用细小的字迹写着："有一处消失了。"

sentences.en: I looked at the eastern slope and counted.
sentences.cn: 我看着东坡，数了数。

machine:2.en: Deep inside the library peak, I found a bronze *machine* the size of a cart, its gears carved with forgotten word-formulas. Each turning wheel pressed a different herb-character onto silk. Shen Wujiu said the device had not moved in a hundred years. Yet when I touched the central gear, it began to turn on its own.
machine:2.cnHint: 我在藏经峰深处发现了一台古老的____，上面刻满了失传的字诀，当我触碰它时，它竟然自行转动了。
machine:2.hook: The silk it printed showed a word no living master could read.
machine:2.line: 'This *machine* has been waiting,' said Shen Wujiu, 'for the right hand to wake it.'

sentences.en: Deep inside the library peak, I found a bronze *machine* the size of a cart, its gears carved with forgotten word-formulas.
Each turning wheel pressed a different herb-character onto silk.
sentences.cn: 每一个转动的轮子都在丝绸上压出不同的草字。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said the device had not moved in a hundred years.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说这台器械已经一百年没动过了。

sentences.en: Yet when I touched the central gear, it began to turn on its own.
sentences.cn: 可当我碰到中央的齿轮时，它自己转动起来了。

observe:2.en: Master Qingwu told us to *observe* the Silence Festival and speak no word-formula from dawn until the clouds turned gold. Xiaoxing folded her hands and kept still. I nearly broke the rule when a wind-spirit pulled at my sleeve. The mountain held its breath with us.
observe:2.cnHint: 师尊命弟子们____无声节，从清晨到云霞变金不得使用任何字诀，我几乎忍不住开口。
observe:2.hook: At sunset, a single black feather drifted down from an empty sky.
observe:2.line: 'We must *observe* this silence,' said Master Qingwu, 'or the mountain will not trust us.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told us to *observe* the Silence Festival and speak no word-formula from dawn until the clouds turned gold.
Xiaoxing folded her hands and kept still.
sentences.cn: 小杏合起双手，保持沉默。

sentences.en: I nearly broke the rule when a wind-spirit pulled at my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 一只风灵扯了我的袖子，我差点破了戒。

sentences.en: The mountain held its breath with us.
sentences.cn: 山和我们一起屏住了呼吸。

fat:2.en: The scroll described how a sky-whale stores spiritual energy as a dense *fat* beneath its skin, which ancient healers would render into a salve for broken word-channels. I found a small sealed jar of the stuff on a forgotten shelf. The jar was warm, as if something inside it was still alive.
fat:2.cnHint: 古籍记载天鲸将灵力储存为一种____，可用来修复受损的字脉，而我在角落里发现了一罐这样的东西。
fat:2.hook: The seal on the jar bore a warning I had not yet learned to read.
fat:2.line: 'The *fat* of a sky-whale,' Xiaoxing whispered, 'is rarer than any herb we know.'

sentences.en: The scroll described how a sky-whale stores spiritual energy as a dense *fat* beneath its skin, which ancient healers would render into a salve for broken word-channels.
I found a small sealed jar of the stuff on a forgotten shelf.
sentences.cn: 我在一个被遗忘的架子上找到了一小罐密封的东西。

sentences.en: The jar was warm, as if something inside it was still alive.
sentences.cn: 罐子是热的，仿佛里面还有什么活着。

helpful:2.en: Xiaoxing left a small note on my desk with the three word-formulas I always forgot, arranged in a way that made them easy to remember. It was a simple thing, but more *helpful* than a week of my own study. I copied her pattern into the cover of my practice scroll.
helpful:2.cnHint: 师妹留给我一张纸条，用一种令人印象深刻的方式整理了我总是忘记的字诀，这比我自己苦读一周更____。
helpful:2.hook: That night the three words glowed faintly on the scroll's cover without my asking.
helpful:2.line: 'I hope it is *helpful*,' said Xiaoxing with a calm smile. 'The order matters more than the words.'
