sentences.en: Xiaoxing left a small note on my desk with the three word-formulas I always forgot, arranged in a way that made them easy to remember.
sentences.cn: 小杏在我的书桌上留了一张小纸条，写着我老是记不住的三个词诀，排列得很容易记住。

sentences.en: It was a simple thing, but more *helpful* than a week of my own study.
I copied her pattern into the cover of my practice scroll.
sentences.cn: 我把她的方法抄进了练习卷的封面里。

position:2.en: Master Qingwu adjusted my *position* at the word-altar: feet at the width of my shoulders, left hand open at my side, right hand raised to the level of my heart. From that exact placement the formula rose clearly, steady as a root in stone. I had been standing wrong for two full weeks.
position:2.cnHint: 师尊纠正了我在字坛前的____，就是这微小的调整，让字诀终于清晰稳定地升起来了。
position:2.hook: A thin line of light appeared on the altar floor, pointing toward the cloud sea below.
position:2.line: 'Your *position* changes everything,' said Master Qingwu. 'The word follows the body.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu adjusted my *position* at the word-altar: feet at the width of my shoulders, left hand open at my side, right hand raised to the level of my heart.
From that exact placement the formula rose clearly, steady as a root in stone.
sentences.cn: 从那个确切的位置，词诀清晰地升起来，稳如石中生根。

sentences.en: I had been standing wrong for two full weeks.
sentences.cn: 我站错了整整两周。

threat:2.en: A torn message arrived by wind-bird, its edges burned. The words that remained read only: 'the lower peaks are a *threat* no longer — they have been silenced.' Shen Wujiu read it twice and said nothing. Master Qingwu locked the gate of our courtyard before the sun had fully set.
threat:2.cnHint: 一封残缺的风鸟信件传来，说下方山峰已不再构成____，师尊在日落前锁上了院门。
threat:2.hook: A second wind-bird arrived at midnight, but its message capsule was empty.
threat:2.line: 'A *threat* written in ash,' said Shen Wujiu quietly, 'is not a boast — it is a record.'

sentences.en: A torn message arrived by wind-bird, its edges burned.
sentences.cn: 一条破损的消息由风鸟送来，边缘被烧焦了。

sentences.en: The words that remained read only: 'the lower peaks are a *threat* no longer — they have been silenced.'
Shen Wujiu read it twice and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎读了两遍，什么都没说。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu locked the gate of our courtyard before the sun had fully set.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在太阳完全落山前锁上了我们院子的门。

trend:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread five years of sect records on the floor and showed me the *trend*: each winter, one more disciple failed to return from the cloud sea crossing. The numbers were small but the direction was clear. He tapped the final column and looked at me without blinking.
trend:2.cnHint: 师兄将五年的宗门记录铺在地上，让我看到一个令人不安的____：每年冬天失踪的弟子都在增加。
trend:2.hook: The record for this coming winter had already been opened, and a name was written in it.
trend:2.line: 'The *trend* does not lie,' said Shen Wujiu. 'Someone must go down there and find out why.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread five years of sect records on the floor and showed me the *trend*: each winter, one more disciple failed to return from the cloud sea crossing.
The numbers were small but the direction was clear.
sentences.cn: 数字很少，但方向很清楚。

sentences.en: He tapped the final column and looked at me without blinking.
sentences.cn: 他点了最后一列，直直地看着我。

ultimately:2.en: I tried three different paths through the formula garden and each one led me to the same locked gate. *Ultimately* it was Xiaoxing who saw the answer: the gate opened not from the outside but from within, and the key was the very first word we had ever been taught. I had walked past it a hundred times.
ultimately:2.cnHint: 我尝试了三条不同的路径，____还是师妹发现了真相：开门的钥匙正是我们最初学会的那个字。
ultimately:2.hook: Beyond the gate, the garden held a ninth herb that appeared in no scroll I had ever read.
ultimately:2.line: '*Ultimately*,' said Xiaoxing, 'every path in this sect leads back to the beginning.'

sentences.en: I tried three different paths through the formula garden and each one led me to the same locked gate.
sentences.cn: 我试过三条不同的路穿过那片药园，每一条都通向同一扇紧闭的门。

sentences.en: *Ultimately* it was Xiaoxing who saw the answer: the gate opened not from the outside but from within, and the key was the very first word we had ever been taught.
I had walked past it a hundred times.
sentences.cn: 我已经走过它百来次了。

digital:2.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found a jade tablet unlike any other. Its surface held no ink — only light. Rows of glowing marks shifted and changed like living things. Master Qingwu called them *digital* seals: patterns that carried meaning not through brushstrokes but through pure luminous number.
digital:2.cnHint: 在档案殿深处，我发现了一块玉牌，其表面的____印记以光代墨，不断流转变幻。
digital:2.hook: One seal, still shifting, had no match in any record.
digital:2.line: 'These *digital* seals hold truths that ink can never fix,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found a jade tablet unlike any other.
sentences.cn: 在藏书殿的深处，我发现了一块从未见过的玉简。

sentences.en: Its surface held no ink — only light.
sentences.cn: 它的表面没有墨迹——只有光。

sentences.en: Rows of glowing marks shifted and changed like living things.
sentences.cn: 一行行发光的符号像活物一样流动变化。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu called them *digital* seals: patterns that carried meaning not through brushstrokes but through pure luminous number.

sale:2.en: At the foot of Misty Peak, a travelling merchant spread rare spirit-herbs across a low stone table. Each bundle bore a small flag naming its price in spirit stones. Shen Wujiu warned me that a herb of such colour was never meant for open *sale* — someone powerful must have released it on purpose.
sale:2.cnHint: 在迷雾峰山脚，一位行商公开____罕见的灵草，师兄认为此事另有深意。
sale:2.hook: The merchant's eyes never once met mine.
sale:2.line: 'A herb this pure should never be on *sale*,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: At the foot of Misty Peak, a travelling merchant spread rare spirit-herbs across a low stone table.
sentences.cn: 在迷雾峰脚下，一个行商把珍贵的灵草铺满了一张低石台。

sentences.en: Each bundle bore a small flag naming its price in spirit stones.
sentences.cn: 每捆灵草上都插着小旗子，标着用灵石计价的价格。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu warned me that a herb of such colour was never meant for open *sale* — someone powerful must have released it on purpose.

contact:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed her fingers to the carved stone door and closed her eyes. The sect records said only a disciple of pure intent could *contact* the spirit within the gate and receive its answer. A long silence filled the corridor. Then the stone grew warm beneath her hand.
contact:2.cnHint: 小星触摸石门，试图____其中沉睡的灵识，走廊里一片寂静。
contact:2.hook: The warmth spread upward — far higher than any hand could reach.
contact:2.line: 'I will *contact* the spirit myself,' Xiaoxing said, voice steady.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed her fingers to the carved stone door and closed her eyes.
sentences.cn: 小杏把手指按在雕刻的石门上，闭上了眼睛。

sentences.en: The sect records said only a disciple of pure intent could *contact* the spirit within the gate and receive its answer.
A long silence filled the corridor.
sentences.cn: 走廊里充满了漫长的沉默。

sentences.en: Then the stone grew warm beneath her hand.
sentences.cn: 然后石门在她手下渐渐温热了起来。

failure:2.en: Master Qingwu set the same test three mornings in a row. Each morning I reached for the cloud-step formula and each morning my feet stayed on the ground. She did not scold me. She only said that *failure* to rise was not the same as falling — it was the ground asking whether I was ready.
failure:2.cnHint: 连续三日，我在飞升试炼中____，师尊却说这不等于跌落。
failure:2.hook: On the fourth morning, mist gathered beneath my feet unbidden.
failure:2.line: '*Failure* to rise once tells me more than rising ten times,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set the same test three mornings in a row.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊连续三个早上出了同样的考题。

sentences.en: Each morning I reached for the cloud-step formula and each morning my feet stayed on the ground.
sentences.cn: 每个早上我都去抓云步诀，每个早上我的脚都还是落在地上。

sentences.en: She did not scold me.
sentences.cn: 她没有骂我。

sentences.en: She only said that *failure* to rise was not the same as falling — it was the ground asking whether I was ready.

bird:2.en: A white *bird* landed on the windowsill of the outer hall just as the sect bell rang. Disciples said such birds carried sealed messages between mountain peaks when the wind roads were closed. This one held nothing in its beak — yet it stared at me alone, tilting its head as if waiting for an answer.
bird:2.cnHint: 一只白____停在外堂窗台，众弟子说它是山峰之间的信使，却似乎专门在等我回应。
bird:2.hook: It left one pale feather and was gone before I blinked.
bird:2.line: 'That *bird* has not visited this hall in forty years,' Shen Wujiu whispered.

sentences.en: A white *bird* landed on the windowsill of the outer hall just as the sect bell rang.
Disciples said such birds carried sealed messages between mountain peaks when the wind roads were closed.
sentences.cn: 弟子们都说这样的白鸟在风路断绝时会在山峰间传递封印的讯息。

sentences.en: This one held nothing in its beak — yet it stared at me alone, tilting its head as if waiting for an answer.
sentences.cn: 这只鸟的嘴里什么都没有——但它只盯着我，歪着头好像在等我的回答。

official:2.en: A sealed letter arrived bearing the gold mark of the Cloud Sea Sect council — the highest *official* stamp a disciple could receive outside of ceremony. Inside was a single line asking me to appear before the elders at dawn. Xiaoxing read it over my shoulder and said nothing, which worried me more than words would have.
official:2.cnHint: 一封盖有云海宗最高____印章的信送到我手中，命我黎明前往见长老。
official:2.hook: Xiaoxing folded the letter back with hands that trembled slightly.
official:2.line: 'An *official* summons at dawn means the elders have already decided something,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: A sealed letter arrived bearing the gold mark of the Cloud Sea Sect council — the highest *official* stamp a disciple could receive outside of ceremony.
Inside was a single line asking me to appear before the elders at dawn.
sentences.cn: 信里只有一行字，让我在天亮时去见长老们。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing read it over my shoulder and said nothing, which worried me more than words would have.
sentences.cn: 小杏从我肩膀后读了一遍，什么话都没说，这让我比听到什么话都更担心。

confidence:2.en: Before the ascent trial, Shen Wujiu handed me a small smooth stone he had carried since his own first flight. He said it held no power at all — that was the point. True *confidence* did not come from a charm; it came from knowing that even without one, you were enough to step off the edge.
confidence:2.cnHint: 飞升试炼前，师兄送我一块普通石头，说真正的____不依赖法宝。
confidence:2.hook: I closed my fingers around the stone and walked toward the open sky.
confidence:2.line: '*Confidence* is not the absence of fear — it is the step you take anyway,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Before the ascent trial, Shen Wujiu handed me a small smooth stone he had carried since his own first flight.
sentences.cn: 渡劫试之前，沈无咎递给我一块小光滑的石头，他自己第一次飞升时就带着它。

sentences.en: He said it held no power at all — that was the point.
sentences.cn: 他说它根本没有什么力量——这正是关键。

sentences.en: True *confidence* did not come from a charm; it came from knowing that even without one, you were enough to step off the edge.

display:2.en: At the summit pavilion, the elders asked each disciple to *display* one skill before the gathered sect. Some called fire; some shaped wind. When my turn came I did nothing loud. I simply let the word I had spent a season learning rise from my palm as soft silver light, and every lamp in the hall went out.
display:2.cnHint: 在峰顶凉亭，长老要求每位弟子____一项技能，我的选择让殿内所有灯光熄灭。
display:2.hook: In the sudden dark, Master Qingwu smiled — and that was sign enough.
display:2.line: '*Display* what you have truly mastered, nothing more,' Master Qingwu had told me.

sentences.en: At the summit pavilion, the elders asked each disciple to *display* one skill before the gathered sect.
Some called fire; some shaped wind.
sentences.cn: 有人召唤火焰，有人驾驭风。

sentences.en: When my turn came I did nothing loud.
sentences.cn: 轮到我时我没有做什么声势浩大的事。

sentences.en: I simply let the word I had spent a season learning rise from my palm as soft silver light, and every lamp in the hall went out.
sentences.cn: 我只是让那个我花了一个季节去学的字从我掌心升起，化作柔和的银色光芒，大殿里的每一盏灯都熄灭了。

experiment:2.en: In the Herb Loft, rows of clay pots held mixtures of crushed spirit-leaves and morning dew. Shen Wujiu bent over his workbench, recording each result with careful strokes. 'Every *experiment* teaches us something,' he said quietly. Outside, a single white crane circled the loft three times and did not land.
experiment:2.cnHint: 师兄在药阁里做____，观察灵草与晨露混合后的变化。
experiment:2.hook: The crane's third circle meant something had changed forever.
experiment:2.line: 'Every *experiment* teaches us something, even the ones that fail.'

sentences.en: In the Herb Loft, rows of clay pots held mixtures of crushed spirit-leaves and morning dew.
sentences.cn: 草药楼里，一排排陶罐装着碾碎的灵叶和清晨的露水混合物。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu bent over his workbench, recording each result with careful strokes.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎弯身伏在工作台上，一笔一划地记录下每一个结果。

sentences.en: 'Every *experiment* teaches us something,' he said quietly.
Outside, a single white crane circled the loft three times and did not land.
sentences.cn: 外面，一只白鹤绕着楼舍飞了三圈，最后没有落下来。

nature:2.en: Master Qingwu led the new disciples to the Edge Cliff, where the clouds moved like slow breath. She spread her arms wide. 'Observe,' she said. 'The *nature* of the wind is to carry; the nature of the herb is to heal. Know what a thing truly is before you name it.' A seed drifted past, glowing faintly gold.
nature:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊在悬崖边讲解万物的____，告诫弟子认清本质方能修行。
nature:2.hook: The glowing seed settled on the narrator's sleeve and did not blow away.
nature:2.line: 'Know the *nature* of a thing before you dare to use it.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led the new disciples to the Edge Cliff, where the clouds moved like slow breath.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊带着新弟子来到崖边，那里云像缓慢的呼吸一样流动。

sentences.en: She spread her arms wide.
sentences.cn: 她张开双臂。

sentences.en: 'Observe,' she said.
sentences.cn: "看好了，"她说。

sentences.en: 'The *nature* of the wind is to carry; the nature of the herb is to heal.
Know what a thing truly is before you name it.'
sentences.cn: 在你给一样东西命名之前，先要知道它真正是什么。

sentences.en: A seed drifted past, glowing faintly gold.
sentences.cn: 一颗发着淡淡金光的种子飘了过去。

status:2.en: A stone board at the sect gate showed every disciple's rank in carved silver characters. Xiaoxing pointed to the lowest line, where the narrator's name had just appeared. 'Your *status* here is new and small,' she said gently, 'but the board is recarved each season.' Above them, a loose stone fell from the gate arch and cracked cleanly in two.
status:2.cnHint: 小星在宗门石碑前指着____栏，提醒叙述者自己刚入门的位置。
status:2.hook: The cracked stone left two halves — one bright, one dark.
status:2.line: 'Your *status* is low now, but the board is recarved each season.'

sentences.en: A stone board at the sect gate showed every disciple's rank in carved silver characters.
sentences.cn: 宗门大门的石板上用银色字刻着每个弟子的品阶。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the lowest line, where the narrator's name had just appeared.
sentences.cn: 小杏指向最下面一行，我的名字刚刚在那里出现。

sentences.en: 'Your *status* here is new and small,' she said gently, 'but the board is recarved each season.'
Above them, a loose stone fell from the gate arch and cracked cleanly in two.
sentences.cn: 他们上方，门楼的一块松动的石头掉了下来，笔直地裂成两半。

accident:2.en: Shen Wujiu arrived at the Cloud Bridge carrying a torn scroll. He explained that he had reached for a high shelf and knocked a spirit-lamp to the floor. 'It was an *accident*,' he said, 'but the burnt formula cannot be read again.' In the scorched centre of the parchment, one word remained perfectly clear.
accident:2.cnHint: 师兄因____打翻了灵灯，烧毁了一张重要符文卷轴。
accident:2.hook: The one surviving word was the name of a forbidden peak.
accident:2.line: 'It was an *accident*, yet the timing feels far too precise.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu arrived at the Cloud Bridge carrying a torn scroll.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎怀里抱着一卷残破的竹简来到了云桥。

sentences.en: He explained that he had reached for a high shelf and knocked a spirit-lamp to the floor.
sentences.cn: 他解释说自己伸手去够高架上的东西，一不小心把灵灯打到了地上。

sentences.en: 'It was an *accident*,' he said, 'but the burnt formula cannot be read again.'
In the scorched centre of the parchment, one word remained perfectly clear.
sentences.cn: 在烧焦的羊皮纸中心，有一个字清晰无比地保留了下来。

active:2.en: The sect's practice ground hummed with morning drills. Master Qingwu watched from a high stone platform. 'A disciple must stay *active* in both body and thought,' she called out. 'A still mind gathers dust like an untended altar.' As she spoke, the wind dropped to perfect silence, and every lamp on the ground flared bright at once.
active:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊在练功场强调弟子须保持____，心与身都不能懈怠。
active:2.hook: Every lamp flared at once — but no hand had touched them.
active:2.line: 'Stay *active* in thought, or your path will close before you walk it.'

sentences.en: The sect's practice ground hummed with morning drills.
sentences.cn: 宗派的练功场在晨练中嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched from a high stone platform.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从高高的石台上看着下面。

sentences.en: 'A disciple must stay *active* in both body and thought,' she called out.
'A still mind gathers dust like an untended altar.'
sentences.cn: "一个静止的心就像一座无人照料的祭坛，积满了灰尘。"

sentences.en: As she spoke, the wind dropped to perfect silence, and every lamp on the ground flared bright at once.
sentences.cn: 她说话的同时，风停了下来，陷入了完全的寂静，地上的每盏灯突然都亮得炽热。

feed:2.en: Deep in the Misty Garden, Xiaoxing knelt beside a row of spirit-seedlings barely taller than a finger. She poured a thin silver liquid from a jade flask. 'We *feed* them cloud-water each dawn,' she explained softly, 'or their roots forget how to reach upward.' One seedling turned toward the narrator before anyone had touched it.
feed:2.cnHint: 小星在迷雾园中用云水____灵苗，讲解培育之法。
feed:2.hook: The seedling that turned had no reason to move — yet it did.
feed:2.line: 'We *feed* them cloud-water at dawn, or they lose the will to grow.'

sentences.en: Deep in the Misty Garden, Xiaoxing knelt beside a row of spirit-seedlings barely taller than a finger.
sentences.cn: 深处迷蒙花园里，小杏跪在一排比手指还矮的灵苗旁。

sentences.en: She poured a thin silver liquid from a jade flask.
sentences.cn: 她从玉瓶里倒出一股银白色的液体。

sentences.en: 'We *feed* them cloud-water each dawn,' she explained softly, 'or their roots forget how to reach upward.'
One seedling turned toward the narrator before anyone had touched it.
sentences.cn: 灵苗在没人触碰它之前就转向了叙述者。

principle:2.en: On a shelf in the inner hall, the narrator found a thin wooden tablet engraved with three lines of text. Shen Wujiu read it aloud: 'The first *principle* of this sect is to give back what you take from the sky.' He set the tablet down carefully. A thin mist rose from the wood the moment it left his hands.
principle:2.cnHint: 叙述者在内堂发现木牌，上面刻着宗门修行的第一条____。
principle:2.hook: The mist from the tablet shaped itself into a single open hand.
principle:2.line: 'The first *principle* here is simple: give back what the sky lent you.'

sentences.en: On a shelf in the inner hall, the narrator found a thin wooden tablet engraved with three lines of text.
sentences.cn: 在内殿的架子上，叙述者找到了一块薄薄的木片，上面刻着三行文字。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu read it aloud: 'The first *principle* of this sect is to give back what you take from the sky.'
He set the tablet down carefully.
sentences.cn: 他小心地放下了木片。

sentences.en: A thin mist rose from the wood the moment it left his hands.
sentences.cn: 木片离开他的手的那一刻，一缕薄雾从木头上升起。

article:2.en: In the archive room, the narrator unrolled a yellowed scroll and found a short *article* written in faded ink, listing objects left behind by a disciple who had vanished one hundred years before. The handwriting was calm and neat, as if written without fear. At the bottom, a fresh ink spot had appeared, though no one had entered the room that day.
article:2.cnHint: 叙述者在档案室发现一篇旧____，记录着百年前失踪弟子遗留的物品。
article:2.hook: The fresh ink spot was still wet — and shaped like a footprint.
article:2.line: 'This *article* was sealed a century ago — so who just added to it?'

sentences.en: In the archive room, the narrator unrolled a yellowed scroll and found a short *article* written in faded ink, listing objects left behind by a disciple who had vanished one hundred years before.
The handwriting was calm and neat, as if written without fear.
sentences.cn: 笔迹平静而整洁，仿佛写的人毫不恐惧。

sentences.en: At the bottom, a fresh ink spot had appeared, though no one had entered the room that day.
sentences.cn: 页脚出现了一个新鲜的墨迹，虽然那天没人进过这个房间。

slightly:2.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found a sealed scroll resting on a stone shelf. Its ribbon was *slightly* loose, as though someone had opened it in haste and left in a hurry. Master Qingwu's name was brushed across the cover in fading ink — but the handwriting was not hers.
slightly:2.cnHint: 我在藏经洞发现一卷封印松动的古卷，上面写着师尊的名字，字迹却不像她的手笔。
slightly:2.hook: The candle behind me went out without wind.
slightly:2.line: 'The seal is *slightly* broken — someone has already read this.'

sentences.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found a sealed scroll resting on a stone shelf.
sentences.cn: 深藏在档案石窟里，我在一块石架上发现了一卷密封的竹简。

sentences.en: Its ribbon was *slightly* loose, as though someone had opened it in haste and left in a hurry.
Master Qingwu's name was brushed across the cover in fading ink — but the handwriting was not hers.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊的名字用褪色的墨迹笔在封面上——但笔迹不是她的。

mention:2.en: I searched the elder's notes for any *mention* of the Ascending Gate, but found only silence where the key passage should have been. Three pages had been carefully removed, leaving only thin paper edges still bound in the spine. Xiaoxing leaned over my shoulder and drew a slow breath.
mention:2.cnHint: 长老笔记中关于飞升之门的____踪迹全无，相关书页似乎已被人取走。
mention:2.hook: Her breath stopped before mine did.
mention:2.line: 'There is no *mention* of the Gate — not even a rumour.'

sentences.en: I searched the elder's notes for any *mention* of the Ascending Gate, but found only silence where the key passage should have been.
Three pages had been carefully removed, leaving only thin paper edges still bound in the spine.
sentences.cn: 三页被仔细地撕了出来，只留下绑在书脊上的薄纸边缘。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing leaned over my shoulder and drew a slow breath.
sentences.cn: 小杏趴在我肩膀上，缓缓吸了口气。

rare:2.en: On the eastern ledge, above the cloud line where few disciples ever climbed, I discovered a small hollow filled with silver-veined leaves. Master Qingwu had spoken of this herb only once, calling it *rare* enough that a single leaf could open a sealed meridian. I counted seven leaves. Then six.
rare:2.cnHint: 我在东侧崖壁上发现了一丛师尊口中____的灵草，却发现叶片正在无声消失。
rare:2.hook: I had not touched a single one.
rare:2.line: 'These leaves are *rare* — guard them with your life tonight.'

sentences.en: On the eastern ledge, above the cloud line where few disciples ever climbed, I discovered a small hollow filled with silver-veined leaves.
sentences.cn: 在东边的悬崖上，在云线之上——很少有弟子能爬到那里——我发现了一个小凹陷，里面堆满了银色纹理的叶子。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had spoken of this herb only once, calling it *rare* enough that a single leaf could open a sealed meridian.
I counted seven leaves.
sentences.cn: 我数了数，一共七片。

sentences.en: Then six.
sentences.cn: 然后是六片。

useful:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small jade slip into my palm before I entered the trial chamber. 'It only holds one formula,' she said, 'but it may be *useful* when the path forks.' Inside the chamber, carved into the far wall, was a fork exactly as she had described — and beside it, a warning I could not yet read.
useful:2.cnHint: 师妹在我进入试炼之前交给我一块玉简，说关键时刻会____。
useful:2.hook: The warning moved when I stepped closer.
useful:2.line: 'Keep it — one formula can be *useful* when choices run out.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small jade slip into my palm before I entered the trial chamber.
sentences.cn: 在我走进试炼室之前，小杏在我手心里塞了一个小玉简。

sentences.en: 'It only holds one formula,' she said, 'but it may be *useful* when the path forks.'
Inside the chamber, carved into the far wall, was a fork exactly as she had described — and beside it, a warning I could not yet read.
sentences.cn: 在石室里，远处的墙上刻着一个岔路，正如她所说的那样——它旁边还有一句我还读不懂的警告。

blood:2.en: The inscription on the iron door required no key. It required *blood* — a single drop pressed to the centre glyph, which would read the bearer's lineage and either open or seal the passage forever. Shen Wujiu studied the glyph for a long time without speaking, his face unreadable in the pale light.
blood:2.cnHint: 铁门上的铭文不需要钥匙，需要的是____，它会读取来者的血统以决定开闭。
blood:2.hook: He had not yet told me whose lineage the door expected.
blood:2.line: 'One drop of *blood* decides whether this door trusts you.'

sentences.en: The inscription on the iron door required no key.
sentences.cn: 铁门上的铭文不需要钥匙。

sentences.en: It required *blood* — a single drop pressed to the centre glyph, which would read the bearer's lineage and either open or seal the passage forever.
Shen Wujiu studied the glyph for a long time without speaking, his face unreadable in the pale light.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎盯着那个符号看了很久，没有说话，他的脸在苍白的光线里读不出表情。

fund:2.en: Inside the locked supply room, I found a ledger recording a hidden *fund* of spirit-stones accumulated over forty years, set aside for a single purpose written at the bottom of the last page. The purpose had been crossed out and rewritten twice. The final version read: 'For the day the mountain falls.'
fund:2.cnHint: 库房账册里记载着一笔秘密____，用途被改写两次，最终写明是为了某个可怕的日子。
fund:2.hook: The date beside the words was next month.
fund:2.line: 'This *fund* was never meant for healing — read the last line.'

sentences.en: Inside the locked supply room, I found a ledger recording a hidden *fund* of spirit-stones accumulated over forty years, set aside for a single purpose written at the bottom of the last page.
The purpose had been crossed out and rewritten twice.
sentences.cn: 目的被划掉又重写了两次。

sentences.en: The final version read: 'For the day the mountain falls.'
sentences.cn: 最后的版本写着："等到山崩的那一天。"

anxiety:2.en: I waited at the base of the Ascending Steps as the fog thickened around me. A quiet *anxiety* settled in my chest — not fear exactly, but the feeling of standing at the edge of something I could not undo. Above, a single bell rang from the summit, one stroke, then silence. It was not the hour for bells.
anxiety:2.cnHint: 我在飞升台阶下等待时，心中升起一种莫名的____，山顶的钟声在不该响起的时刻悄然响了一声。
anxiety:2.hook: No one was supposed to be at the summit bell.
anxiety:2.line: 'Your *anxiety* is a sign — the mountain is trying to warn you.'

sentences.en: I waited at the base of the Ascending Steps as the fog thickened around me.
sentences.cn: 我在升天阶梯的底部等待，雾气在我周围越来越浓。

sentences.en: A quiet *anxiety* settled in my chest — not fear exactly, but the feeling of standing at the edge of something I could not undo.
Above, a single bell rang from the summit, one stroke, then silence.
sentences.cn: 上面，一声钟声从山顶传来，只有一下，然后是沉默。

sentences.en: It was not the hour for bells.
sentences.cn: 这不是敲钟的时辰。

australia:2.en: Inside the archive chamber, I found an old scroll unlike any other. It described a distant land called *Australia* — no floating peaks, no sea of clouds, only red earth and open sky. A note in Master Qingwu's hand read: 'Even words from worlds without spirit can carry power.' I held the scroll and felt a strange warmth rise through my fingers.
australia:2.cnHint: 我在典藏室发现一卷古籍，记载着名为____的遥远大陆，师尊的批注令我心头一震。
australia:2.hook: The warmth suddenly shifted — cold, then burning, then gone.
australia:2.line: 'Even *Australia* holds a word that once calmed a storm,' Master Qingwu said softly.

sentences.en: Inside the archive chamber, I found an old scroll unlike any other.
sentences.cn: 在档案室里，我发现了一卷异乎寻常的古老卷轴。

sentences.en: It described a distant land called *Australia* — no floating peaks, no sea of clouds, only red earth and open sky.
A note in Master Qingwu's hand read: 'Even words from worlds without spirit can carry power.'
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊的笔迹写着："即便来自无灵之地的文字，也能承载力量。"

sentences.en: I held the scroll and felt a strange warmth rise through my fingers.
sentences.cn: 我握着卷轴，感到一股奇异的温暖从指尖升起。

authority:2.en: A sealed letter arrived at dawn, pressed with the sect's cloud-mark. Inside, three words granted me full *authority* over the herb garden on Peak Seven. Shen Wujiu read it twice and said nothing. Xiaoxing smiled, but her eyes asked the same question mine did: why me, and why now?
authority:2.cnHint: 清晨一封盖有宗门印记的信函赋予了我____，同门们的反应却令我疑惑。
authority:2.hook: At the bottom of the letter, a single character bled red like fresh ink.
authority:2.line: 'With *authority* comes a weight even the clouds cannot lift,' Shen Wujiu murmured.

sentences.en: A sealed letter arrived at dawn, pressed with the sect's cloud-mark.
sentences.cn: 黎明时分，一封密函送到了宗门，按着云纹的印记。

sentences.en: Inside, three words granted me full *authority* over the herb garden on Peak Seven.
Shen Wujiu read it twice and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎读了两遍，什么也没说。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing smiled, but her eyes asked the same question mine did: why me, and why now?
sentences.cn: 小杏笑了，但她的眼睛问出了我心中的同一个问题：为什么是我，为什么是现在？

confident:2.en: The test required me to name a healing word while blindfolded, relying only on its scent. I breathed slowly and spoke. Master Qingwu removed the cloth, and I saw I had chosen correctly. Xiaoxing clapped once. I had not felt so *confident* since the day I first climbed the mountain path to the sect gate.
confident:2.cnHint: 蒙眼辨识药草之词的考验中，我成功作答，心中生出久违的____之感。
confident:2.hook: Then I noticed Master Qingwu's smile had not quite reached her eyes.
confident:2.line: 'Be *confident*, but never let confidence close your ears,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: The test required me to name a healing word while blindfolded, relying only on its scent.
sentences.cn: 测试要求我蒙上眼睛，只凭气味叫出一个治愈词。

sentences.en: I breathed slowly and spoke.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓吸气，开了口。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu removed the cloth, and I saw I had chosen correctly.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊拿下布条，我看到自己选对了。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing clapped once.
sentences.cn: 小杏拍了一下手。

sentences.en: I had not felt so *confident* since the day I first climbed the mountain path to the sect gate.

crowd:2.en: On the Bridge of First Names, new disciples gathered in a quiet *crowd*, each waiting to receive one word from Master Qingwu. The word would become their first spiritual tool. I stood near the edge and watched the mist below swallow the bridge's shadow. My turn felt both near and impossibly far.
crowd:2.cnHint: 在初名桥上，新弟子们____聚集，等待师尊赐予各自的第一个灵词。
crowd:2.hook: One disciple opened their hand — and the word inside had already faded.
crowd:2.line: 'A *crowd* of voices cannot carry a single word to heaven,' Master Qingwu reminded us.

sentences.en: On the Bridge of First Names, new disciples gathered in a quiet *crowd*, each waiting to receive one word from Master Qingwu.
The word would become their first spiritual tool.
sentences.cn: 那个词会成为他们的第一件灵器。

sentences.en: I stood near the edge and watched the mist below swallow the bridge's shadow.
sentences.cn: 我站在边缘附近，看着下方的雾气吞没了桥影。

sentences.en: My turn felt both near and impossibly far.
sentences.cn: 轮到我的时刻既近在咫尺，又遥不可及。

highly:2.en: Shen Wujiu returned from the outer peaks carrying a small stone disc. He said the elder there spoke *highly* of a lost word carved on its face — a word that could slow time for one breath. He placed the disc on the table between us. Neither of us moved to touch it first.
highly:2.cnHint: 师兄带回一块石碟，据说外峰长老对其上刻载的失传灵词____评价，那词据称能凝滞时光。
highly:2.hook: The disc cast no shadow, though the lantern burned directly above it.
highly:2.line: 'The elder spoke *highly* of this word — and elders do not praise lightly,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu returned from the outer peaks carrying a small stone disc.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从外峰返回，手里提着一个小石盘。

sentences.en: He said the elder there spoke *highly* of a lost word carved on its face — a word that could slow time for one breath.
He placed the disc on the table between us.
sentences.cn: 他把石盘放在我们之间的桌上。

sentences.en: Neither of us moved to touch it first.
sentences.cn: 我们都没有率先去碰它。

occur:2.en: I copied the formula three times, then sat in stillness. It did not *occur* to me until the candle burned low that the last character was not ink — it was a tiny pressed wing of a cloud-moth, sealed into the paper itself. Someone had prepared this lesson long before I ever arrived at the sect.
occur:2.cnHint: 我抄写完功法后静坐沉思，直到烛光将尽才____想到最后一个字竟是真实的云蛾翅膀。
occur:2.hook: Outside, a cloud-moth circled the window once, then vanished.
occur:2.line: 'Did it not *occur* to you that the paper itself was speaking?' Xiaoxing asked gently.

sentences.en: I copied the formula three times, then sat in stillness.
sentences.cn: 我抄了三遍法诀，然后静坐不动。

sentences.en: It did not *occur* to me until the candle burned low that the last character was not ink — it was a tiny pressed wing of a cloud-moth, sealed into the paper itself.
Someone had prepared this lesson long before I ever arrived at the sect.
sentences.cn: 有人在我到宗门之前，早就为这堂课做好了准备。

regularly:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me the garden log: every seventh day, someone had *regularly* watered the silver-root herbs with a spoken word rather than water. The characters in the log were neat and old. No name was written, but the ink smelled faintly of pine — the same scent Master Qingwu's sleeves always carried.
regularly:2.cnHint: 小星给我看园圃记录，显示每隔七日便有人____以灵词代水浇灌银根草，字迹古老却无署名。
regularly:2.hook: The most recent entry was dated the morning I first arrived.
regularly:2.line: 'Whoever did this *regularly* loved these herbs more than their own rest,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me the garden log: every seventh day, someone had *regularly* watered the silver-root herbs with a spoken word rather than water.
The characters in the log were neat and old.
sentences.cn: 日志里的笔迹工整而古老。

sentences.en: No name was written, but the ink smelled faintly of pine — the same scent Master Qingwu's sleeves always carried.
sentences.cn: 没有署名，但墨水散发着淡淡的松香——和青梧师尊衣袖上一样的气味。

responsible:2.en: The missing word-jar was found empty on my shelf. Master Qingwu did not accuse; she only asked who was *responsible* for the eastern store-room key. I held up my hand. She nodded slowly and said the jar had been empty since before I came — she only needed to know if I would answer honestly.
responsible:2.cnHint: 失踪的灵词罐被发现后，师尊询问谁对东储室负____，考验的其实是弟子是否诚实。
responsible:2.hook: She then placed a full jar on the shelf — one I had never seen before.
responsible:2.line: 'Be *responsible* not because you must, but because the words deserve it,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: The missing word-jar was found empty on my shelf.
sentences.cn: 失踪的词罐被找到了，空空如也，就摆在我的书架上。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu did not accuse; she only asked who was *responsible* for the eastern store-room key.
I held up my hand.
sentences.cn: 我举起了手。

sentences.en: She nodded slowly and said the jar had been empty since before I came — she only needed to know if I would answer honestly.
sentences.cn: 她缓缓点头，说那罐子打我来之前就已经空了——她只想知道我是否会老实回答。

awareness:2.en: A sealed bronze tube arrived at my door before dawn, tied with a ribbon of pale cloud. Inside lay a single strip of paper bearing one word in Master Qingwu's hand. The word was not one I had studied. Yet as I held it, a slow *awareness* opened in my chest — the word was already alive inside me, waiting.
awareness:2.cnHint: 清晨，一封密封的信筒送到门前，让我对那个陌生词语产生了____。
awareness:2.hook: The ribbon of cloud had no knot — it had tied itself.
awareness:2.line: 'True *awareness* begins not when you read the word, but when the word reads you.'

sentences.en: A sealed bronze tube arrived at my door before dawn, tied with a ribbon of pale cloud.
sentences.cn: 黎明前，一只密封的铜筒送到了我的门前，用淡云色的缎带系着。

sentences.en: Inside lay a single strip of paper bearing one word in Master Qingwu's hand.
sentences.cn: 里面铺着一张纸条，上面是青梧师尊笔下的一个词。

sentences.en: The word was not one I had studied.
sentences.cn: 那个词不是我学过的。

sentences.en: Yet as I held it, a slow *awareness* opened in my chest — the word was already alive inside me, waiting.

introduce:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me across a bridge of braided wind to a small pavilion at the mountain's northern edge. Inside stood a single stone shelf lined with glowing scrolls. 'I will *introduce* you to the oldest formula in our sect,' he said, lifting the first one carefully. The scroll hummed at his touch.
introduce:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到一处石阁，将门派最古老的法诀____给我。
introduce:2.hook: Behind the shelf, a second door stood where no door had been yesterday.
introduce:2.line: 'Let me *introduce* you to this formula — it has been waiting for the right disciple.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me across a bridge of braided wind to a small pavilion at the mountain's northern edge.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎领我跨过一座风编成的桥，来到山北边缘的小亭子。

sentences.en: Inside stood a single stone shelf lined with glowing scrolls.
sentences.cn: 亭子里立着一个石架，架上排满了闪闪发光的卷轴。

sentences.en: 'I will *introduce* you to the oldest formula in our sect,' he said, lifting the first one carefully.
The scroll hummed at his touch.
sentences.cn: 卷轴在他触碰时嗡鸣作响。

expense:2.en: Xiaoxing found a merchant's ledger wedged between two stones near the archive gate. The entries listed not coins but words — rare healing words traded away, one by one. At the bottom, a final line read: 'All remaining words sold at great *expense* to one who must not be named.' The ink was still fresh.
expense:2.cnHint: 小星发现了一本账簿，记录着珍贵词语以沉重的____被逐一售出。
expense:2.hook: The name had been cut away, but the blade that cut it still lay beside the ledger.
expense:2.line: 'No healing word is worth this *expense* — something precious beyond measure was lost here.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found a merchant's ledger wedged between two stones near the archive gate.
sentences.cn: 小杏在档案库门附近的两块石头间发现了一本商人账簿。

sentences.en: The entries listed not coins but words — rare healing words traded away, one by one.
sentences.cn: 账簿上记的不是铜钱，而是词——一个个稀有的治愈词被交易出去。

sentences.en: At the bottom, a final line read: 'All remaining words sold at great *expense* to one who must not be named.'
The ink was still fresh.
sentences.cn: 墨水还是新鲜的。

track:2.en: Shen Wujiu crouched beside a narrow path behind the medicine garden and pressed two fingers to the soil. A faint luminous *track* ran along the ground — the kind left only by a word-scroll moving on its own. 'It came from the sealed chamber,' he said quietly. We followed the light to a locked iron door.
track:2.cnHint: 师兄在药园小径发现了一道发光的____，顺着它我们找到了一扇铁门。
track:2.hook: The locked door was warm, as though something behind it was still breathing.
track:2.line: 'This *track* was made after midnight — no disciple was permitted out that late.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu crouched beside a narrow path behind the medicine garden and pressed two fingers to the soil.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎蹲在药园后面的一条窄路旁，两根手指按到了土里。

sentences.en: A faint luminous *track* ran along the ground — the kind left only by a word-scroll moving on its own.
'It came from the sealed chamber,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "它来自密封的密室，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: We followed the light to a locked iron door.
sentences.cn: 我们跟着光亮来到一扇上了锁的铁门。

afford:2.en: In the archive basement I found a cracked storage jar labelled in old script: 'Words too costly to keep.' A note tucked inside explained that the sect could no longer *afford* to store certain rare formulas — the energy they consumed was draining the mountain itself. Three words still remained in the jar, faintly pulsing.
afford:2.cnHint: 我在库房发现了一个标着'代价太高'的罐子，门派已无力____继续保存那些珍稀词语。
afford:2.hook: One of the three remaining words had already begun to dim.
afford:2.line: 'We cannot *afford* to let even one rare formula go dark — the cost is too great.'

sentences.en: In the archive basement I found a cracked storage jar labelled in old script: 'Words too costly to keep.'
sentences.cn: 我在档案库的地下室找到了一个裂开的陶罐，上面用古体字标着："代价太高，不敢保留的话语"。

sentences.en: A note tucked inside explained that the sect could no longer *afford* to store certain rare formulas — the energy they consumed was draining the mountain itself.
Three words still remained in the jar, faintly pulsing.
sentences.cn: 罐子里还剩三个字，微弱地跳动着。

feature:2.en: Xiaoxing spread a hand-drawn map across the study table and traced a curved line with her finger. 'The most important *feature* of our mountain,' she said, 'is not the peak or the archive — it is this narrow channel where cloud-breath rises every dawn.' She had circled it twice in red. The circle was still warm.
feature:2.cnHint: 小星展开一张手绘地图，向我指出浮山最关键的地理____，那个标记圈还带着温度。
feature:2.hook: Below the circled channel, someone had written a warning in a hand neither of us recognized.
feature:2.line: 'This channel is the one *feature* of the mountain that even Master Qingwu has not fully explained.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread a hand-drawn map across the study table and traced a curved line with her finger.
sentences.cn: 小杏在书房的桌上铺开一张手绘的地图，用手指沿着一条弧线描了一遍。

sentences.en: 'The most important *feature* of our mountain,' she said, 'is not the peak or the archive — it is this narrow channel where cloud-breath rises every dawn.'
She had circled it twice in red.
sentences.cn: 她用红色圈了两遍。

sentences.en: The circle was still warm.
sentences.cn: 圈子摸起来还是温热的。

innovative:2.en: Tucked inside an old practice manual I found a loose page covered in neat annotations. The margin note read: 'This breathing method is *innovative* — it layers three formulas that were never meant to meet.' Below, a diagram showed the three words arranged in a triangle, their roots intertwined. No name marked the author.
innovative:2.cnHint: 我在旧手册中发现一张批注页，记载了一种____的修炼方法，将三个法诀以前所未有的方式组合。
innovative:2.hook: The three words in the diagram had begun to glow the moment I unfolded the page.
innovative:2.line: 'An *innovative* method has no teacher — it arrives when a disciple is desperate enough to invent one.'

sentences.en: Tucked inside an old practice manual I found a loose page covered in neat annotations.
sentences.cn: 我在一本旧的功法秘籍里发现了一页散落的纸张，密密麻麻地写满了注解。

sentences.en: The margin note read: 'This breathing method is *innovative* — it layers three formulas that were never meant to meet.'
Below, a diagram showed the three words arranged in a triangle, their roots intertwined.
sentences.cn: 下面一张图表显示三个字按三角形排列，它们的根部纠缠在一起。

sentences.en: No name marked the author.
sentences.cn: 没有署名。

operation:2.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found a jade slip etched with an *operation* for converting raw spirit-breath into flight energy. Each step was numbered, precise, and cold as winter stone. Master Qingwu had left it here deliberately — her brushwork was unmistakable. But why had no disciple ever spoken of it?
operation:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现了一枚玉简，记载着将灵气转化为飞升之力的____。
operation:2.hook: One step in the sequence had been deliberately erased.
operation:2.line: 'This *operation* must be performed exactly once, or the mountain will not hold you.'

sentences.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found a jade slip etched with an *operation* for converting raw spirit-breath into flight energy.
Each step was numbered, precise, and cold as winter stone.
sentences.cn: 每一步都编号了，精确得如同冬日的石头一样冷硬。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had left it here deliberately — her brushwork was unmistakable.
sentences.cn: 这是青梧师尊故意留在这里的——她的笔迹我认得。

sentences.en: But why had no disciple ever spoken of it?
sentences.cn: 但为什么没有弟子提起过它？

population:2.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a wide map across the stone table. Every floating peak was marked, and beside each peak was a number — the *population* of disciples who had attempted the ascent. Most peaks showed only a single stroke. I counted slowly, and my hands grew cold.
population:2.cnHint: 师兄展开一张地图，上面标注着每座浮峰尝试飞升的____数量。
population:2.hook: The peak assigned to me showed no number at all.
population:2.line: 'The *population* of those who returned from that peak is exactly zero.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a wide map across the stone table.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在石桌上铺开了一张宽大的地图。

sentences.en: Every floating peak was marked, and beside each peak was a number — the *population* of disciples who had attempted the ascent.
Most peaks showed only a single stroke.
sentences.cn: 大多数山峰上只有一道划痕。

sentences.en: I counted slowly, and my hands grew cold.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢数着，手渐渐冰冷。

quick:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a warm seed-stone into my palm and gave a *quick* nod, her eyes saying what her voice could not. The morning bell had already rung twice. Above us, a narrow bridge of cloud was forming between our peak and the trial summit, and it would not last long.
quick:2.cnHint: 小星迅速地向我点头，把一块种石塞进我的手心，示意我赶紧行动。
quick:2.hook: The cloud bridge trembled, already beginning to dissolve.
quick:2.line: 'Be *quick* — that bridge holds for one breath and no more.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed a warm seed-stone into my palm and gave a *quick* nod, her eyes saying what her voice could not.
The morning bell had already rung twice.
sentences.cn: 晨钟已经敲了两遍。

sentences.en: Above us, a narrow bridge of cloud was forming between our peak and the trial summit, and it would not last long.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶上，一道狭窄的云桥正在我们的山峰和试炼之顶之间形成，转眼就会散开。

scale:2.en: The elder's chart ranked every ascent technique on a *scale* of one to nine, carved into a bronze plate hanging outside the trial hall. My assigned method sat at level three. Shen Wujiu traced the higher marks with one finger and said nothing, which felt worse than any warning.
scale:2.cnHint: 青铜牌上的____将飞升法门从一到九依次排列，我的法门仅列第三级。
scale:2.hook: Someone had scratched a tenth mark below the bronze plate, in the stone itself.
scale:2.line: 'On this *scale*, reaching level five already costs a disciple half their spirit-root.'

sentences.en: The elder's chart ranked every ascent technique on a *scale* of one to nine, carved into a bronze plate hanging outside the trial hall.
My assigned method sat at level three.
sentences.cn: 我被分配的方法在第三层。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu traced the higher marks with one finger and said nothing, which felt worse than any warning.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎用一根手指描过更高的等级，什么也没说，这比任何警告听起来都更吓人。

basic:2.en: Master Qingwu set down her brush and looked at me steadily. 'Flight,' she said, 'is not an achievement. It is a *basic* — the first honest question the sky asks of you.' I had expected praise for my progress. Instead she opened a thin, worn manual and pointed at page one.
basic:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，飞升不是成就，而是修行的____，并让我重新翻开第一页。
basic:2.hook: Page one held a warning I had never bothered to read.
basic:2.line: 'Without this *basic*, every higher skill you have learned is hollow.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set down her brush and looked at me steadily.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊放下毛笔，稳稳地看着我。

sentences.en: 'Flight,' she said, 'is not an achievement.
sentences.cn: "飞行，"她说，"不是成就。

sentences.en: It is a *basic* — the first honest question the sky asks of you.'
I had expected praise for my progress.
sentences.cn: 我本期待她为我的进步夸奖一番。

sentences.en: Instead she opened a thin, worn manual and pointed at page one.
sentences.cn: 但她翻开了一本薄薄的、磨得很旧的秘籍，指向第一页。

constantly:2.en: The wind above the Cloud Sea does not blow in one direction. It *constantly* shifts, testing each body that dares to rise into it. I had read this in every manual, yet feeling it was different — the air pulled at me from six sides at once, and my footing on nothing became suddenly real.
constantly:2.cnHint: 云海之上的风____变换方向，我初次腾空时才真正明白这句话的重量。
constantly:2.hook: On the seventh shift, the wind carried a voice that knew my name.
constantly:2.line: 'It *constantly* changes because the sky is deciding whether to accept you.'

sentences.en: The wind above the Cloud Sea does not blow in one direction.
sentences.cn: 云海上方的风不是单向吹动的。

sentences.en: It *constantly* shifts, testing each body that dares to rise into it.
I had read this in every manual, yet feeling it was different — the air pulled at me from six sides at once, and my footing on nothing became suddenly real.
sentences.cn: 我在每本功法秘籍里都读过这句话，但真正感受到时完全不同——风从六个方向同时扯我，我踩在虚无上的脚突然变得真实起来。

favor:2.en: Among the three trial routes carved on the gate-stone, Xiaoxing said Master Qingwu would *favor* the northern path for a disciple with water-spirit roots. I studied the gate-stone for a long time. All three routes were described in the same careful words, yet the northern characters were worn smoother than the rest.
favor:2.cnHint: 小星说师尊会____水灵根弟子走北道，而石碑上的字迹似乎也印证了这一点。
favor:2.hook: A single fresh scratch crossed the northern path's name.
favor:2.line: 'She has always *favored* those who can read what the stone remembers.'

sentences.en: Among the three trial routes carved on the gate-stone, Xiaoxing said Master Qingwu would *favor* the northern path for a disciple with water-spirit roots.
I studied the gate-stone for a long time.
sentences.cn: 我久久盯着门石。

sentences.en: All three routes were described in the same careful words, yet the northern characters were worn smoother than the rest.
sentences.cn: 三条路的描述用词都一样讲究，可北边的字被磨得更光滑了。

absence:2.en: I reached the message shelf and found only an empty groove where my name-tablet should have rested. The *absence* of that small carved stone meant one thing: I had not been assigned a trial date — I had already been entered into the ascent record, without my knowledge or consent. The shelf dust was undisturbed.
absence:2.cnHint: 我发现名架上属于我的名牌____了，这意味着有人已经替我登记了飞升日期。
absence:2.hook: The record showed today's date, written in Master Qingwu's hand.
absence:2.line: 'The *absence* of your tablet is itself the message she left you.'

sentences.en: I reached the message shelf and found only an empty groove where my name-tablet should have rested.
sentences.cn: 我赶到了传讯架，却只看到一道空的凹槽，我的名牌应该在这里。

sentences.en: The *absence* of that small carved stone meant one thing: I had not been assigned a trial date — I had already been entered into the ascent record, without my knowledge or consent.
The shelf dust was undisturbed.
sentences.cn: 架子上的灰尘没有被扰动过。

safe:2.en: Behind the waterfall at the base of Cloud Peak, I found a stone *safe* sealed with moss and old light. Inside lay a single jade slip, warm to the touch, as though someone had placed it there only moments ago. Master Qingwu had never spoken of this place.
safe:2.cnHint: 我在云峰瀑布后发现一个石制____，里面藏着一枚温热的玉简。
safe:2.hook: The slip held a name — and the name was mine.
safe:2.line: 'This *safe* was hidden long before you were born,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

sentences.en: Behind the waterfall at the base of Cloud Peak, I found a stone *safe* sealed with moss and old light.
Inside lay a single jade slip, warm to the touch, as though someone had placed it there only moments ago.
sentences.cn: 里面放着一枚玉简，摸起来还温热，好像有人刚才才放进去的。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had never spoken of this place.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从未提过这个地方。

speed:2.en: Xiaoxing crossed the thousand steps in a single breath, her robes barely stirring. I had trained for months, yet her *speed* left me motionless with wonder. She reached the summit altar, pressed her palm to the stone, and looked back at me with calm eyes, as if waiting had cost her nothing.
speed:2.cnHint: 小星以惊人的____登上千级石阶，在顶端平静地等待着我。
speed:2.hook: A crack split the altar stone the moment her hand lifted.
speed:2.line: 'Your *speed* will come,' Xiaoxing said, 'when you stop fighting the wind.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing crossed the thousand steps in a single breath, her robes barely stirring.
sentences.cn: 小杏一口气跨越千阶，衣袂几乎未曾飘动。

sentences.en: I had trained for months, yet her *speed* left me motionless with wonder.
She reached the summit altar, pressed her palm to the stone, and looked back at me with calm eyes, as if waiting had cost her nothing.
sentences.cn: 她到了山顶祭坛，把手按在石头上，转身看我，眼神平静得像等待对她毫无消耗。

burden:2.en: Shen Wujiu carried the sect's sealed archive chest alone up the slope of Hollow Cloud Ridge. No one had asked him to. The chest was a *burden* in both weight and meaning — it held every record of disciples who had vanished during ascension. He did not stop once to rest.
burden:2.cnHint: 师兄独自背负着记载失踪弟子档案的沉重____，默默登上山脊。
burden:2.hook: One name in the archive had been scratched out with great force.
burden:2.line: 'Let me share this *burden*,' I said, reaching for the handle.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu carried the sect's sealed archive chest alone up the slope of Hollow Cloud Ridge.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎独自抱着宗门的封印档案箱沿着空云岭的斜坡往上走。

sentences.en: No one had asked him to.
sentences.cn: 没有人让他去。

sentences.en: The chest was a *burden* in both weight and meaning — it held every record of disciples who had vanished during ascension.
He did not stop once to rest.
sentences.cn: 他一次都没有停下来休息。

former:2.en: Master Qingwu placed two jade slips on the low table. 'Study both paths,' she said. 'The *former* leads through the Mirror Gorge; the latter climbs the open ridge.' I lifted the first slip and felt a coldness that had nothing to do with the morning air settle into my fingers.
former:2.cnHint: 师尊让我比较两条飞升路线，____那条穿越镜谷，令我指尖发凉。
former:2.hook: The cold in my fingers would not fade for the rest of that day.
former:2.line: 'The *former* path has not been walked in thirty years,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed two jade slips on the low table.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在矮桌上放了两枚玉简。

sentences.en: 'Study both paths,' she said.
sentences.cn: 她说，两条路都要研习。

sentences.en: 'The *former* leads through the Mirror Gorge; the latter climbs the open ridge.'
I lifted the first slip and felt a coldness that had nothing to do with the morning air settle into my fingers.
sentences.cn: 我拿起第一枚玉简，感觉到一股寒意从指尖渗进来，那不是晨风的冷。

oppose:2.en: At the sect council, every elder nodded when the new ascension route was announced — every elder but one. Shen Wujiu stood, calm and straight, and chose to *oppose* it without raising his voice. He placed a worn map on the table and said nothing more. The room grew very still.
oppose:2.cnHint: 宗门议事时，师兄平静地____了新的飞升路线，只将一幅旧地图放在桌上。
oppose:2.hook: The map showed a path that had been officially erased.
oppose:2.line: 'I must *oppose* this,' Shen Wujiu said, 'because I have walked that road.'

sentences.en: At the sect council, every elder nodded when the new ascension route was announced — every elder but one.
sentences.cn: 在宗门议会上，宣布新的飞升路线时，每个长老都点了头——除了一个。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood, calm and straight, and chose to *oppose* it without raising his voice.
He placed a worn map on the table and said nothing more.
sentences.cn: 他把一张旧地图放在桌上，再没有说什么。

sentences.en: The room grew very still.
sentences.cn: 整个房间都静了下来。

unable:2.en: I reached for the ascending current above the third cloud tier, stretching every thread of spirit I had. My hand passed through it like smoke through smoke. I was *unable* to hold even a wisp. Below me, Xiaoxing watched without comment, her expression neither pitying nor cold, only patient.
unable:2.cnHint: 我竭尽全力，却____抓住第三云层的上升灵流，小星在下方静静注视。
unable:2.hook: Then the current shifted — and reached toward me instead.
unable:2.line: 'Being *unable* today means nothing about tomorrow,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: I reached for the ascending current above the third cloud tier, stretching every thread of spirit I had.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去抓第三层云雾上方的上升气流，把所有的灵力都拉扯到了极限。

sentences.en: My hand passed through it like smoke through smoke.
sentences.cn: 我的手穿过它，就像烟穿过烟。

sentences.en: I was *unable* to hold even a wisp.
Below me, Xiaoxing watched without comment, her expression neither pitying nor cold, only patient.
sentences.cn: 下面的小杏看着，面无表情，既不怜悯也不冷漠，只是很耐心。

unusual:2.en: The message arrived folded inside a lotus leaf, sealed with a drop of silver dew. Master Qingwu turned it over twice before opening it, which was *unusual* — she never hesitated. She read it once, set it down, and looked out at the sea of clouds for a long, wordless moment.
unusual:2.cnHint: 那封用荷叶包裹的信让师尊停顿了片刻，这____的举动令我心生不安。
unusual:2.line: 'It is *unusual* for a message to arrive before the question is asked,' she murmured.

sentences.en: The message arrived folded inside a lotus leaf, sealed with a drop of silver dew.
sentences.cn: 消息用荷叶折起来送来的，用一滴银露封住。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu turned it over twice before opening it, which was *unusual* — she never hesitated.
She read it once, set it down, and looked out at the sea of clouds for a long, wordless moment.
sentences.cn: 她读了一遍，放下来，看着云海沉默了很久。

apart:2.en: Xiaoxing and I stood at opposite ends of the sky bridge, one step *apart* from the open air on either side. Between us lay the cracked centre stone. If it broke, only one of us could reach the far platform. She looked at me, then at the stone, and smiled without fear.
apart:2.cnHint: 小星和我站在断裂石桥两端，仅与虚空____咫尺，她却微笑如常。
apart:2.hook: She stepped onto the cracked stone before I could speak.
apart:2.line: 'Standing *apart* is not the same as being alone,' Xiaoxing called across the gap.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing and I stood at opposite ends of the sky bridge, one step *apart* from the open air on either side.
Between us lay the cracked centre stone.
sentences.cn: 中间是一块裂开的中心石。

sentences.en: If it broke, only one of us could reach the far platform.
sentences.cn: 如果它碎了，我们中只有一个人能到达另一边的平台。

sentences.en: She looked at me, then at the stone, and smiled without fear.
sentences.cn: 她看看我，又看看那块石头，笑得毫无惧色。

advice:2.en: A folded paper fell from the hollow of the old cedar tree at the mountain gate. I opened it slowly. In careful brushstrokes, three lines of warning waited there. Master Qingwu's *advice* was plain: do not speak a word of power before the morning bell, or the clouds below would remember your voice forever.
advice:2.cnHint: 山门古树的树洞里掉出一张纸，上面写着师尊的____：清晨钟响前不可开口念诀。
advice:2.hook: The bell had already rung — one hour ago.
advice:2.line: 'My *advice* is simple: silence is the first step toward the sky.'

sentences.en: A folded paper fell from the hollow of the old cedar tree at the mountain gate.
sentences.cn: 一张折起的纸从山门口那棵老雪松的树洞里掉下来。

sentences.en: I opened it slowly.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢打开它。

sentences.en: In careful brushstrokes, three lines of warning waited there.
sentences.cn: 工整的笔画里等着三行警告。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu's *advice* was plain: do not speak a word of power before the morning bell, or the clouds below would remember your voice forever.

attempt:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed his palm to the sealed stone door at the base of Hollow Peak. Every disciple had tried before him and failed. I watched him close his eyes and *attempt* the three-root formula once more, his breath steady as still water, his fingers tracing the oldest lines carved into the rock.
attempt:2.cnHint: 师兄在空心峰石门前____用三根诀破门，每一位弟子在他之前都失败了。
attempt:2.hook: A thin crack of gold light split the stone from top to bottom.
attempt:2.line: 'I will *attempt* the door one final time — stand back.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed his palm to the sealed stone door at the base of Hollow Peak.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把手按在空云峰底部的封印石门上。

sentences.en: Every disciple had tried before him and failed.
sentences.cn: 之前每个弟子都试过，都失败了。

sentences.en: I watched him close his eyes and *attempt* the three-root formula once more, his breath steady as still water, his fingers tracing the oldest lines carved into the rock.

draw:2.en: Xiaoxing and I reached the archive pavilion at the same moment, each carrying a sealed jar of morning dew for Master Qingwu. Neither of us could claim the right to enter first. We agreed on a fair *draw*, pulling river-reeds of different lengths from a bundle by the door, and I lost.
draw:2.cnHint: 我和师妹同时到达典籍阁，为争先入门以____决定顺序，我输了。
draw:2.hook: Inside, a single candle burned though no one had entered in a week.
draw:2.line: 'A *draw* is the fairest answer when two hearts are equally ready.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing and I reached the archive pavilion at the same moment, each carrying a sealed jar of morning dew for Master Qingwu.
sentences.cn: 小杏和我同时到达档案阁，各自端着一罐给青梧师尊用的晨露。

sentences.en: Neither of us could claim the right to enter first.
sentences.cn: 我们都没有先进去的理由。

sentences.en: We agreed on a fair *draw*, pulling river-reeds of different lengths from a bundle by the door, and I lost.

facility:2.en: Beyond the eastern ridge stood a low stone hall the older disciples called the Refining Room. It was the only *facility* on the mountain built to hold ten thousand words at once, their power sealed within iron rings set into the floor. I had never been allowed inside — until this morning.
facility:2.cnHint: 东岭石室是山上唯一能封存万道字诀的____，今天清晨我第一次被允许进入。
facility:2.hook: Every iron ring on the floor was already broken open.
facility:2.line: 'This *facility* holds more forgotten power than any of us were told.'

sentences.en: Beyond the eastern ridge stood a low stone hall the older disciples called the Refining Room.
sentences.cn: 东岭外有一座低矮的石殿，年长的弟子们叫它精炼室。

sentences.en: It was the only *facility* on the mountain built to hold ten thousand words at once, their power sealed within iron rings set into the floor.
I had never been allowed inside — until this morning.
sentences.cn: 我一次都没被允许进去过——直到今天早上。

firm:2.en: The letter was rolled tight and tied with a cord of dried cloud-grass. Inside, Master Qingwu's handwriting was small but *firm*, each character pressed deep into the paper as though the brush itself believed every word. She had written only one instruction, and it could not be misread or softened.
firm:2.cnHint: 师尊的信笔迹____有力，只写了一条无法误解的指令。
firm:2.hook: The instruction named a path no disciple had walked in three hundred years.
firm:2.line: 'Be *firm* in your reading — she wrote this once and will not write it again.'

sentences.en: The letter was rolled tight and tied with a cord of dried cloud-grass.
sentences.cn: 信卷得紧紧的，用一根干云草绳子绑着。

sentences.en: Inside, Master Qingwu's handwriting was small but *firm*, each character pressed deep into the paper as though the brush itself believed every word.
She had written only one instruction, and it could not be misread or softened.
sentences.cn: 她只写了一条指示，没有歧义，也软化不了。

innovation:2.en: Tucked inside the oldest logbook in the archive pavilion, I found a page in handwriting I did not recognise. It described an *innovation* in the cloud-flight formula — a small change in the final breath-step that could cut the height cost by half. No name was signed, and the date was torn away.
innovation:2.cnHint: 在典籍阁最旧的日志里，我发现一页记录着飞升诀____的残页，没有署名。
innovation:2.hook: The ink was still faintly warm to the touch.
innovation:2.line: 'An *innovation* without a name is either a gift or a warning.'

sentences.en: Tucked inside the oldest logbook in the archive pavilion, I found a page in handwriting I did not recognise.
sentences.cn: 我在档案阁最古老的日志里翻到一页，笔迹陌生得很。

sentences.en: It described an *innovation* in the cloud-flight formula — a small change in the final breath-step that could cut the height cost by half.
No name was signed, and the date was torn away.
sentences.cn: 没有署名，日期也被撕掉了。

path:2.en: Behind the Refining Room, half hidden by pale ferns, a narrow *path* cut between two boulders and dropped sharply toward the cloud-sea below. No sign marked it. No lantern hung beside it. But the stones along its edge were worn smooth, as though many feet had passed this way — all going down, none returning.
path:2.cnHint: 炼室后方的岩缝间有一条隐秘的____，通向云海，踏石磨光，却无人从下方归来。
path:2.hook: Xiaoxing was standing at its entrance, one foot already forward.
path:2.line: 'This *path* was walked by those who were ready — and those who only thought they were.'

sentences.en: Behind the Refining Room, half hidden by pale ferns, a narrow *path* cut between two boulders and dropped sharply toward the cloud-sea below.
No sign marked it.
sentences.cn: 没有标记。

sentences.en: No lantern hung beside it.
sentences.cn: 旁边也没挂灯笼。

sentences.en: But the stones along its edge were worn smooth, as though many feet had passed this way — all going down, none returning.
sentences.cn: 但边上的石头被磨得很光滑，像是有许多脚踏过这条路——都是往下去，没有人回来过。

character:2.en: Deep in the Archive Grotto, I found a silk scroll older than the Sect itself. One *character* was burned into the silk — not written, but branded by qi so fierce the fabric still trembled. Master Qingwu said a single mark could hold a cultivator's entire will, their virtue or their ruin.
character:2.cnHint: 在档案石窟中，我发现一卷古老丝绸上有一个被灵气烙印的____，师尊说它蕴含着某位修炼者的全部意志。
character:2.hook: The silk trembled again, though no wind moved.
character:2.line: 'This *character* does not belong to any elder we know,' said Master Qingwu softly.

sentences.en: Deep in the Archive Grotto, I found a silk scroll older than the Sect itself.
sentences.cn: 在档案洞深处，我找到了一卷比宗门还古老的丝绸。

sentences.en: One *character* was burned into the silk — not written, but branded by qi so fierce the fabric still trembled.
Master Qingwu said a single mark could hold a cultivator's entire will, their virtue or their ruin.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说单独一个字能承载一个修士的整个意志，是他的品德还是他的毁灭。

clean:2.en: Xiaoxing handed me a cloth and pointed at the stone altar near the East Peak path. 'Your first duty,' she said. To *clean* it was no chore — each stroke of the cloth revealed faint glyphs beneath years of ash, glowing faintly blue, as if waiting to be read again.
clean:2.cnHint: 小星让我去____东峰小径旁的石坛，擦去灰烬后，坛上隐约浮现出蓝色符文。
clean:2.hook: The last glyph pulsed once, then went dark.
clean:2.line: '*Clean* it carefully — do not let the cloth touch the centre ring,' Xiaoxing warned.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me a cloth and pointed at the stone altar near the East Peak path.
sentences.cn: 小杏递给我一块布，指向东峰路旁的石祭坛。

sentences.en: 'Your first duty,' she said.
sentences.cn: "你第一个任务，"她说。

sentences.en: To *clean* it was no chore — each stroke of the cloth revealed faint glyphs beneath years of ash, glowing faintly blue, as if waiting to be read again.

convey:2.en: A folded paper crane landed on my windowsill before dawn, sent by Shen Wujiu from the Upper Terrace. The message inside used no words at all — only a pressed herb and a torn corner of star map. I understood: some truths *convey* themselves better through objects than through speech.
convey:2.cnHint: 沈无咎送来一只纸鹤，里面没有文字，却用一株草药和一角星图____了某种紧迫的消息。
convey:2.hook: The herb was one used only before a Trial.
convey:2.line: 'A true cultivator can *convey* more with silence than with a hundred words,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: A folded paper crane landed on my windowsill before dawn, sent by Shen Wujiu from the Upper Terrace.
sentences.cn: 天亮前，一只折叠的纸鹤落在我的窗台上，是沈无咎从上阁台寄来的。

sentences.en: The message inside used no words at all — only a pressed herb and a torn corner of star map.
sentences.cn: 里面的讯息没有用一个字——只有一株压干的草药和一张星图的撕角。

sentences.en: I understood: some truths *convey* themselves better through objects than through speech.

distraction:2.en: On the Bridge of Lifted Fog, I paused to watch cloud shapes shift below — a fish, a mountain, a hand. Shen Wujiu caught my sleeve. 'Every *distraction* here is a test,' he said quietly. The clouds parted to reveal a narrow second bridge I had nearly missed entirely.
distraction:2.cnHint: 我在云雾桥上分神赏云，沈无咎提醒我这里的每一个____都是考验，云层随即散开，露出一条隐藏的小桥。
distraction:2.hook: The hidden bridge led somewhere no map showed.
distraction:2.line: 'Do not let *distraction* cost you the path forward,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: On the Bridge of Lifted Fog, I paused to watch cloud shapes shift below — a fish, a mountain, a hand.
sentences.cn: 在举雾桥上，我停下来看下面的云形变化——一条鱼、一座山、一只手。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu caught my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎拉住了我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'Every *distraction* here is a test,' he said quietly.
The clouds parted to reveal a narrow second bridge I had nearly missed entirely.
sentences.cn: 云层裂开，露出一座狭窄的第二座桥，我差点就完全错过了。

fight:2.en: Inside the Sealed Vault below the Pill Hall, three locked iron boxes sat side by side. Master Qingwu told me to choose one without touching them. I felt *fight* rising in my chest — not anger, but a fierce, quiet will that pulled my hand toward the smallest box.
fight:2.cnHint: 在封印库中，师尊让我不用触碰就选一只铁箱，我感到胸中升起一股____，手不由自主地伸向最小的那只。
fight:2.hook: The smallest box was the only one still warm.
fight:2.line: 'Let the *fight* in your spirit guide you, not your eyes,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Inside the Sealed Vault below the Pill Hall, three locked iron boxes sat side by side.
sentences.cn: 在丹厅下面的封闭库房里，三个锁着的铁盒并排放着。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told me to choose one without touching them.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊让我选一个，但不能摸。

sentences.en: I felt *fight* rising in my chest — not anger, but a fierce, quiet will that pulled my hand toward the smallest box.

finish:2.en: The Naming Stone at the garden's heart recorded every disciple who had completed their first ascent. I traced the column of names until I found a gap — one name chiseled away, leaving only a clean scar. Whatever *finish* that disciple had reached, the Sect wished it forgotten.
finish:2.cnHint: 命名石记录了所有完成初次飞升的弟子，我发现其中有一个名字被凿去，那人所达到的____似乎被刻意抹除。
finish:2.hook: The scar in the stone was still pale, not yet weathered.
finish:2.line: 'Some *finish* lines,' said Xiaoxing, 'are better left unmarked.'

sentences.en: The Naming Stone at the garden's heart recorded every disciple who had completed their first ascent.
sentences.cn: 花园中心的命名石记录了每一位完成首次飞升的弟子。

sentences.en: I traced the column of names until I found a gap — one name chiseled away, leaving only a clean scar.
sentences.cn: 我沿着名字一列列往下找，找到了一个缺口——一个名字被凿掉了，只留下一道干净的疤痕。

sentences.en: Whatever *finish* that disciple had reached, the Sect wished it forgotten.

frequently:2.en: I noticed the ink lamp in the study passage flickered *frequently* near the seventh shelf — not from wind, but in a steady rhythm, like a pulse. Xiaoxing said no one had placed a flame there in years. I counted the flickers: they matched the beat of a summoning chant.
frequently:2.cnHint: 走廊第七架附近的墨灯____闪烁，小星说那里多年无人点灯，我发现闪烁的节奏竟与一段召唤咒语的拍子吻合。
frequently:2.hook: On the count of nine, the lamp burned blue.
frequently:2.line: 'It *frequently* flickers before someone in this hall makes a breakthrough,' Xiaoxing murmured.

sentences.en: I noticed the ink lamp in the study passage flickered *frequently* near the seventh shelf — not from wind, but in a steady rhythm, like a pulse.
Xiaoxing said no one had placed a flame there in years.
sentences.cn: 小杏说这么多年来没人在那儿放过火焰。

sentences.en: I counted the flickers: they matched the beat of a summoning chant.
sentences.cn: 我数了数闪烁的次数：和一个召唤咒的节奏一模一样。

invest:2.en: At the Seed Pool behind the library, disciples pressed qi into dormant herb cores to wake them. Shen Wujiu showed me how to *invest* a single slow breath rather than a burst — patience over force. My herb core cracked open into a pale green shoot before anyone else's had stirred.
invest:2.cnHint: 在种子池边，沈无咎教我用缓慢的呼吸而非爆发之力将灵气____入休眠的草药核，我的草药核率先萌芽。
invest:2.hook: The shoot leaned toward the cliff's edge, not the light.
invest:2.line: '*Invest* your breath slowly — the core will trust you more than it fears you,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: At the Seed Pool behind the library, disciples pressed qi into dormant herb cores to wake them.
sentences.cn: 在图书馆后面的种子池里，弟子们把气注入休眠的草药核来唤醒它们。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu showed me how to *invest* a single slow breath rather than a burst — patience over force.
My herb core cracked open into a pale green shoot before anyone else's had stirred.
sentences.cn: 我的草药核在别人的还没动静的时候就裂开了，冒出一颗淡绿色的芽。

moment:2.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found a sealed jade slip resting on a stone shelf. The inscription read: open only at the right *moment*. I held it, uncertain, while the clouds outside began to glow with a pale gold light no one had seen before.
moment:2.cnHint: 我在藏经洞中发现了一枚玉简，上面写着只有在合适的____才能开启。
moment:2.hook: The jade slip grew warm, as if it had been waiting for me.
moment:2.line: 'There is only one *moment* to open it — and I fear it is now.'

sentences.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found a sealed jade slip resting on a stone shelf.
sentences.cn: 在档案洞深处，我在一块石架上找到了一枚密封的玉简。

sentences.en: The inscription read: open only at the right *moment*.
I held it, uncertain, while the clouds outside began to glow with a pale gold light no one had seen before.
sentences.cn: 我拿着它，不确定该不该打开，这时窗外的云开始泛起一种没人见过的淡金色光芒。

nice:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread the old formation diagram across a flat stone and studied each line. 'The spacing here is too rough,' he said. 'A *nice* calculation of distances is what keeps the seal from collapsing.' He pressed one finger to a faint mark, and the diagram began to hum.
nice:2.cnHint: 师兄审视阵图，指出唯有____的距离计算才能稳住封印。
nice:2.hook: Beneath his fingertip, a crack ran slowly to the diagram's edge.
nice:2.line: 'A *nice* balance of forces holds the whole seal in place.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread the old formation diagram across a flat stone and studied each line.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把那份古老的阵法图摊开在平石上，逐一研究每一条线。

sentences.en: 'The spacing here is too rough,' he said.
sentences.cn: "这里的间隔太粗糙了，"他说。

sentences.en: 'A *nice* calculation of distances is what keeps the seal from collapsing.'
He pressed one finger to a faint mark, and the diagram began to hum.
sentences.cn: 他用一根手指按在一个淡淡的标记上，图开始嗡嗡作响。

peer:2.en: The message arrived folded inside a hollow reed, tossed up from the clouds below. I had to *peer* at the tiny script by the light of a floating lantern before the words became clear: 'Leave the summit before the third bell.' It was signed with a leaf I did not know.
peer:2.cnHint: 我费力地____着一张用细小字迹写成的神秘纸条，上面警告我在第三声钟响前离开山顶。
peer:2.hook: A second reed rose from the clouds before I could move.
peer:2.line: 'You must *peer* closely — the last word is the most important.'

sentences.en: The message arrived folded inside a hollow reed, tossed up from the clouds below.
sentences.cn: 信笺叠成一纸，塞进一根空心的芦苇里，从下方的云海里抛了上来。

sentences.en: I had to *peer* at the tiny script by the light of a floating lantern before the words became clear: 'Leave the summit before the third bell.'
It was signed with a leaf I did not know.
sentences.cn: 它签的是一片我不认识的叶子。

pretty:2.en: Xiaoxing lifted a small crystal pendant from the floor of the hollow tree. 'Someone left a *pretty* here on purpose,' she said, turning the glittering piece in her palm. The crystal held a frozen spark at its centre, and when the wind touched it, the spark pulsed once like a heartbeat.
pretty:2.cnHint: 小星在树洞里捡到一件被人刻意遗留的____，其中似乎封存着一道微弱的灵火。
pretty:2.hook: The spark inside the crystal pulsed a second time, faster.
pretty:2.line: 'A *pretty* this lovely is never left behind by accident.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing lifted a small crystal pendant from the floor of the hollow tree.
sentences.cn: 小杏从空心树的地上捡起一个小小的水晶坠子。

sentences.en: 'Someone left a *pretty* here on purpose,' she said, turning the glittering piece in her palm.
The crystal held a frozen spark at its centre, and when the wind touched it, the spark pulsed once like a heartbeat.
sentences.cn: 水晶的中心冻着一簇光火，风一吹，那簇火就跳动一下，像心跳。

recommendation:2.en: Pinned to the door of the outer hall was a notice in Master Qingwu's hand. It was a formal *recommendation* that I be permitted to attempt the Ascension Trial alone, ahead of all others my age. My name was written in bright red ink, which on this mountain meant both honour and danger.
recommendation:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊在告示栏上张贴了一份正式的____，允许我独自提前挑战飞升试炼。
recommendation:2.hook: Below my name, a second name had been carefully crossed out.
recommendation:2.line: 'This *recommendation* was written for you — and for you alone.'

sentences.en: Pinned to the door of the outer hall was a notice in Master Qingwu's hand.
sentences.cn: 外厅的门上钉着青梧师尊的笔记。

sentences.en: It was a formal *recommendation* that I be permitted to attempt the Ascension Trial alone, ahead of all others my age.
My name was written in bright red ink, which on this mountain meant both honour and danger.
sentences.cn: 我的名字用大红色的墨水写的，在这座山上，红色既是荣誉也是危险。

strange:2.en: At the foot of the eastern pillar I found a bundle of spirit herbs no one had planted there. Their scent was *strange* to me, unlike anything in Master Qingwu's garden, sharp and faintly cold, like snow on a fire. A single note beneath the bundle read: 'Use these before dawn.'
strange:2.cnHint: 在东柱脚下，我发现了一束气味____的灵草，附着一张叮嘱我黎明前使用的纸条。
strange:2.hook: The herbs were still damp, as if just gathered from somewhere far below.
strange:2.line: 'That *strange* scent means they were picked above the storm layer.'

sentences.en: At the foot of the eastern pillar I found a bundle of spirit herbs no one had planted there.
sentences.cn: 在东柱脚下我找到了一束没人种过的灵草。

sentences.en: Their scent was *strange* to me, unlike anything in Master Qingwu's garden, sharp and faintly cold, like snow on a fire.
A single note beneath the bundle read: 'Use these before dawn.'
sentences.cn: 束子下压着一张纸条："天亮前用上。"

widespread:2.en: Shen Wujiu returned from the lower peaks looking troubled. '*Widespread* cracks have appeared along the cloud-root paths,' he told me, unrolling a rough map on the table. Every route marked in blue was now crossed out in black. Only one path to the summit remained open, thin as a thread.
widespread:2.cnHint: 师兄带回消息：通往山顶的云根古道上出现了____的裂痕，几乎所有路线都已封闭。
widespread:2.hook: He tapped the one remaining path and said nothing more.
widespread:2.line: 'The *widespread* damage means someone — or something — came through here.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu returned from the lower peaks looking troubled. '*Widespread* cracks have appeared along the cloud-root paths,' he told me, unrolling a rough map on the table.
Every route marked in blue was now crossed out in black.
sentences.cn: 每条用蓝色标记的路线现在都被黑线划掉了。

sentences.en: Only one path to the summit remained open, thin as a thread.
sentences.cn: 只有一条路还通往山顶，细得像一根线。

wonderful:2.en: Tucked between two stones on the bridge of mist was a small book bound in cloud-silk. Its pages held diagrams of flight paths no living disciple had tried. 'What a *wonderful* find,' Xiaoxing whispered, eyes bright. But the last page was torn away, and the missing piece was nowhere on the bridge.
wonderful:2.cnHint: 小星在云雾桥上发现了一本记载着飞行路线的云丝古书，她称其____，但最后一页已被撕走。
wonderful:2.hook: The torn edge of the last page was still faintly warm.
wonderful:2.line: 'A *wonderful* map means nothing without the page that shows the end.'

sentences.en: Tucked between two stones on the bridge of mist was a small book bound in cloud-silk.
sentences.cn: 雾桥的两块石头中间夹着一本云丝装订的小书。

sentences.en: Its pages held diagrams of flight paths no living disciple had tried.
sentences.cn: 书页里全是没有活着的弟子试过的飞行路线图。

sentences.en: 'What a *wonderful* find,' Xiaoxing whispered, eyes bright.
But the last page was torn away, and the missing piece was nowhere on the bridge.
sentences.cn: 可最后一页被撕掉了，那页纸在桥上找不着。

announce:2.en: A sealed jade scroll arrived at my door before dawn. I unrolled it with trembling hands and read: Master Qingwu would *announce* the name of the disciple chosen to attempt the Sky-Ascent Trial at noon. The mountain fell silent as cloud mist curled around the words, as if the scroll itself were breathing.
announce:2.cnHint: 一封玉简送到门前，师尊将在正午____一位弟子参加飞升试炼的名单。
announce:2.hook: At noon, a single name rose in smoke above the sect bell.
announce:2.line: 'Master Qingwu will *announce* the chosen name when the sun reaches its peak.'

sentences.en: A sealed jade scroll arrived at my door before dawn.
sentences.cn: 天亮前一枚封好的玉卷送到我门外。

sentences.en: I unrolled it with trembling hands and read: Master Qingwu would *announce* the name of the disciple chosen to attempt the Sky-Ascent Trial at noon.
The mountain fell silent as cloud mist curled around the words, as if the scroll itself were breathing.
sentences.cn: 山里一下子没了声音，云雾缠绕着字迹，好像这卷子本身在呼吸。

appropriate:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a small jade vial into my palm. 'One drop of Cloud-Root Dew is *appropriate* for calming the spirit before the trial,' he said quietly. The vial was warm, as though the herb inside still lived. Outside, the wind shifted and the floating mountain groaned like a sleeping beast.
appropriate:2.cnHint: 师兄递来一瓶露水，说一滴是定神的____用量。
appropriate:2.hook: The mountain groaned once, then fell into unnatural silence.
appropriate:2.line: 'One drop is *appropriate* — no more, or your spirit core will tremble.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a small jade vial into my palm.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把一个小小的玉瓶塞进我的手心。

sentences.en: 'One drop of Cloud-Root Dew is *appropriate* for calming the spirit before the trial,' he said quietly.
The vial was warm, as though the herb inside still lived.
sentences.cn: 玉瓶是温的，里面的草药好像还活着。

sentences.en: Outside, the wind shifted and the floating mountain groaned like a sleeping beast.
sentences.cn: 外面风转了向，浮山呻吟了一声，像一头睡着的野兽。
