chief:2.en: The sect elder pinned a copper token to my robe. It marked me as a trial messenger, whose *chief* duty was to carry the sealed word-scroll to the highest peak before the clouds closed. I bowed, slipped the scroll into my sleeve, and stepped off the stone path into open sky.
chief:2.cnHint: 长老嘱咐我，此行____任务是将封印的字卷送上最高峰。
chief:2.hook: The cloud gate began to close, faster than anyone had seen before.
chief:2.line: 'Your *chief* duty is to guard that scroll with your life.'

sentences.en: The sect elder pinned a copper token to my robe.
sentences.cn: 宗门长老在我的衣服上别了一枚铜牌。

sentences.en: It marked me as a trial messenger, whose *chief* duty was to carry the sealed word-scroll to the highest peak before the clouds closed.
I bowed, slipped the scroll into my sleeve, and stepped off the stone path into open sky.
sentences.cn: 我行了礼，把卷子塞进袖子里，踏离了石路，一步踩进了开阔的天空。

clearly:2.en: Xiaoxing spread the old map across the stone table and traced a path with one finger. 'The sky bridge is *clearly* marked here,' she said, 'yet no disciple who followed it has returned to describe what they found.' The candle between us dimmed without a breeze, and the map's ink bled slowly toward the edge.
clearly:2.cnHint: 小星指着地图说，天桥的位置被____标注出来了，但走过的弟子从未回来。
clearly:2.hook: The candle went out, and the ink kept moving on its own.
clearly:2.line: 'The path is *clearly* drawn — the danger lies in what the map does not show.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread the old map across the stone table and traced a path with one finger.
sentences.cn: 小杏把那份老地图铺在石桌上，用一根手指尖描出一条路。

sentences.en: 'The sky bridge is *clearly* marked here,' she said, 'yet no disciple who followed it has returned to describe what they found.'
The candle between us dimmed without a breeze, and the map's ink bled slowly toward the edge.
sentences.cn: 我们中间的烛火没有风吹就暗了下去，地图上的墨迹慢慢往边上渗。

communicate:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a pale feather on the altar. 'In the upper clouds,' she said, 'words lose their power and even the oldest formulas fall silent. This feather will help you *communicate* across that silence.' I tucked it inside my robe. That night, the feather pulsed once with faint golden light, as though answering something I had not yet said.
communicate:2.cnHint: 师尊给了我一根羽毛，说在高云之上可以用它____，因为那里文字会失效。
communicate:2.hook: The feather pulsed again at midnight, with no one near the altar.
communicate:2.line: 'Keep the feather close — it is the only way to *communicate* above the cloud barrier.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a pale feather on the altar.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在法坛上放了一根淡色的羽毛。

sentences.en: 'In the upper clouds,' she said, 'words lose their power and even the oldest formulas fall silent.
sentences.cn: "上面的云层里，"她说，"词失了力，连最古老的咒诀都会没声音。

sentences.en: This feather will help you *communicate* across that silence.'
I tucked it inside my robe.
sentences.cn: 我把它塞进了衣服里。

sentences.en: That night, the feather pulsed once with faint golden light, as though answering something I had not yet said.
sentences.cn: 那晚羽毛跳动了一下，泛出淡金色的光，好像在回应什么我还没说过的话。

emphasis:2.en: Shen Wujiu read the trial rules aloud, his voice steady, placing *emphasis* on one line above all others: do not speak any word-formula after the third gate, or the sky will answer back. He folded the paper carefully, as if folding away a warning. A distant bell rang once, and its echo lasted far too long.
emphasis:2.cnHint: 师兄朗读试炼规则时，特别对一条规定加以____：第三关后不得念咒。
emphasis:2.hook: The bell's echo returned from a direction the mountain did not face.
emphasis:2.line: 'I place great *emphasis* on this one rule — break it and the sky itself becomes your trial.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu read the trial rules aloud, his voice steady, placing *emphasis* on one line above all others: do not speak any word-formula after the third gate, or the sky will answer back.
He folded the paper carefully, as if folding away a warning.
sentences.cn: 他小心地折好纸，好像在折叠一个警告。

sentences.en: A distant bell rang once, and its echo lasted far too long.
sentences.cn: 远处的钟敲了一下，回音却拖了很久很久。

emphasize:2.en: The word-scroll glowed faintly as I unrolled it. Master Qingwu had written one passage in red ink to *emphasize* its weight: 'Above the final cloud, every word you know will be tested at once.' I read the line three times, then noticed that the red ink was slowly sinking into the paper, as if being swallowed.
emphasize:2.cnHint: 师尊在字卷中用红墨水____了最关键的那句话，说到了最终云层之上，所有字将被同时考验。
emphasize:2.hook: When the red ink vanished, the scroll felt heavier than stone.
emphasize:2.line: 'I use red ink only to *emphasize* the passages that have cost lives before.'

sentences.en: The word-scroll glowed faintly as I unrolled it.
sentences.cn: 字卷在我展开时微微发亮。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had written one passage in red ink to *emphasize* its weight: 'Above the final cloud, every word you know will be tested at once.'
I read the line three times, then noticed that the red ink was slowly sinking into the paper, as if being swallowed.
sentences.cn: 我读了三遍那一行，然后注意到红墨在缓缓渗进纸里，像是被纸吸了进去。

england:2.en: Inside a locked chest I found one curious relic: a small book, its cover worn smooth, marked with foreign letters spelling *England*. Xiaoxing said it had washed up on the cloud shore long ago. No one knew which wind had carried it, or what words slept between its pages. That evening, the book fell open on its own.
england:2.cnHint: 我在锁着的箱子里发现了一本标着____字样的旧书，没人知道是哪阵风将它带到了云海边。
england:2.hook: The book fell open to a page no one had touched, and one word glowed.
england:2.line: 'That mark says *England* — a land so distant its words carry power even here.'

sentences.en: Inside a locked chest I found one curious relic: a small book, its cover worn smooth, marked with foreign letters spelling *England*.
Xiaoxing said it had washed up on the cloud shore long ago.
sentences.cn: 小杏说它很久以前冲上了云岸。

sentences.en: No one knew which wind had carried it, or what words slept between its pages.
sentences.cn: 没人知道是哪阵风吹来的，也不知道它的书页里睡着什么字。

sentences.en: That evening, the book fell open on its own.
sentences.cn: 那天晚上，书自己打开了。

institution:2.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found a sealed scroll bearing the mark of an ancient *institution* — a council of sky-masters who once governed all floating peaks. Master Qingwu had never spoken of them. The seal was unbroken, yet warm to the touch, as if something inside still breathed.
institution:2.cnHint: 我在典藏阁发现一封古老____的封印卷轴，师尊从未提及此事。
institution:2.hook: The seal cracked open on its own, just once.
institution:2.line: 'This *institution* vanished three hundred years ago,' said Master Qingwu, 'yet its seal finds you.'

sentences.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found a sealed scroll bearing the mark of an ancient *institution* — a council of sky-masters who once governed all floating peaks.
Master Qingwu had never spoken of them.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从来没有提过他们。

sentences.en: The seal was unbroken, yet warm to the touch, as if something inside still breathed.
sentences.cn: 封印没有被打破，但摸上去是温的，好像里面还有什么东西在呼吸。

outcome:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread the star-charts across the cold stone floor and studied each line in silence. He had run the formula seven times. Every path through the Cloud Gate led to the same *outcome*: one disciple ascends, one stays behind. He looked at me, and said nothing.
outcome:2.cnHint: 师兄推算了七遍，飞升之路的____令他沉默。
outcome:2.hook: He folded the chart before I could read the names.
outcome:2.line: 'The *outcome* is fixed,' said Shen Wujiu, 'but who it names — that is not.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread the star-charts across the cold stone floor and studied each line in silence.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把星图铺在冰冷的石地上，默默地研究着每一条线。

sentences.en: He had run the formula seven times.
sentences.cn: 他已经推演了七次。

sentences.en: Every path through the Cloud Gate led to the same *outcome*: one disciple ascends, one stays behind.
He looked at me, and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 他看着我，什么都没说。

recognize:2.en: At the Gate of Morning Mist, a carved face stared from the stone arch — ancient, worn, almost featureless. Yet I felt my feet stop on their own. Somewhere below memory, I could *recognize* those eyes. Xiaoxing touched my sleeve and whispered that the face had changed since yesterday.
recognize:2.cnHint: 晨雾之门的石刻面孔令我莫名____，小星说它昨天还不是这样。
recognize:2.hook: The stone eyes had turned to follow the path ahead.
recognize:2.line: 'Do you *recognize* it?' Xiaoxing asked. 'Because it seems to recognize you.'

sentences.en: At the Gate of Morning Mist, a carved face stared from the stone arch — ancient, worn, almost featureless.
sentences.cn: 在晨雾门的石拱上，一张雕刻的脸盯着前方——古老、磨损、几乎没有五官。

sentences.en: Yet I felt my feet stop on their own.
sentences.cn: 但我的脚自己停了下来。

sentences.en: Somewhere below memory, I could *recognize* those eyes.
Xiaoxing touched my sleeve and whispered that the face had changed since yesterday.
sentences.cn: 小杏拉了拉我的袖子，低声说那张脸从昨天就变了。

safety:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small jade token into my palm before I stepped onto the sky-bridge. She said Master Qingwu had carried it for thirty years without ever needing it. Worn smooth by long habit, it hummed faintly — a quiet promise of *safety* drawn from someone else's faith.
safety:2.cnHint: 小星将师尊珍藏多年的玉牌交给我，说它能保____。
safety:2.hook: The hum stopped the moment I reached the bridge's center.
safety:2.line: 'Keep it close,' said Xiaoxing. '*Safety* does not always come from strength.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small jade token into my palm before I stepped onto the sky-bridge.
sentences.cn: 小杏在我踏上天桥前把一枚小玉牌按进了我的掌心。

sentences.en: She said Master Qingwu had carried it for thirty years without ever needing it.
sentences.cn: 她说青梧师尊带了它三十年，从来没用过。

sentences.en: Worn smooth by long habit, it hummed faintly — a quiet promise of *safety* drawn from someone else's faith.

collect:2.en: Master Qingwu sent me to the eastern ledge at dawn to *collect* the dew that gathers only on the leaves of cloud-mint — three drops, no more. The herb blooms once each season. I knelt in the mist, bowl in both hands, and heard a low sound rising from far below the clouds.
collect:2.cnHint: 师尊命我去东崖____云薄荷上的晨露，不多不少三滴。
collect:2.hook: The sound from below the clouds was growing louder.
collect:2.line: '*Collect* only what the leaf offers freely,' said Master Qingwu, 'or the herb will remember.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu sent me to the eastern ledge at dawn to *collect* the dew that gathers only on the leaves of cloud-mint — three drops, no more.
The herb blooms once each season.
sentences.cn: 这种草一个季节才开一次。

sentences.en: I knelt in the mist, bowl in both hands, and heard a low sound rising from far below the clouds.
sentences.cn: 我跪在雾里，两手捧着碗，听到远远的云下传来一阵低鸣。

door:2.en: The hall of trials had seven passages, but Shen Wujiu led me past all of them to a plain wooden panel at the far end with no handle and no mark. He said every generation one disciple finds this *door* without being told. He was watching my hand, not my face.
door:2.cnHint: 师兄带我走到试炼堂尽头那扇无人告知的____前。
door:2.hook: My hand rose toward the wood before I decided to move.
door:2.line: 'This *door* only opens,' said Shen Wujiu, 'for someone already half through it.'

sentences.en: The hall of trials had seven passages, but Shen Wujiu led me past all of them to a plain wooden panel at the far end with no handle and no mark.
sentences.cn: 试炼殿有七条通道，但沈无咎带我越过了所有的，走到最远处一面没有把手、没有标记的素木板前。

sentences.en: He said every generation one disciple finds this *door* without being told.
He was watching my hand, not my face.
sentences.cn: 他在看我的手，不是我的脸。

eventually:2.en: The climb to the upper peak should take a full day; the path folds and doubles back through low cloud. Master Qingwu had said that all sincere disciples *eventually* find the summit, but the word 'eventually' sat uneasy in my chest as the mist thickened and my lantern dimmed to a pale thread.
eventually:2.cnHint: 师尊说心诚的弟子____都能登顶，但浓雾中我开始怀疑这句话。
eventually:2.hook: The lantern went out, and the path kept climbing.
eventually:2.line: 'You will *eventually* see clearly,' said Master Qingwu, 'but not before the mist tests you.'

sentences.en: The climb to the upper peak should take a full day; the path folds and doubles back through low cloud.
sentences.cn: 上山顶要走整整一天；路在低云里折来折去。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had said that all sincere disciples *eventually* find the summit, but the word 'eventually' sat uneasy in my chest as the mist thickened and my lantern dimmed to a pale thread.

match:2.en: Shen Wujiu pinned the notice to the sect board without a word: an open *match* at Cloud-Peak Platform, any disciple may enter, winner earns the right to attempt the ascent rite first. Xiaoxing read it twice, then looked at me with something between a smile and a warning.
match:2.cnHint: 师兄在布告栏贴出云顶台____告示，胜者可优先尝试飞升之礼。
match:2.hook: Below our names on the sign-up sheet, someone had added a third.
match:2.line: 'Enter the *match*,' said Xiaoxing softly. 'I have already written your name.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pinned the notice to the sect board without a word: an open *match* at Cloud-Peak Platform, any disciple may enter, winner earns the right to attempt the ascent rite first.
Xiaoxing read it twice, then looked at me with something between a smile and a warning.
sentences.cn: 小杏读了两遍，然后看着我，眼神介于微笑和警告之间。

immediately:2.en: A sealed jade slip landed on my desk in the eastern study hall. I broke the seal and *immediately* felt the words inside rise like warm smoke — Master Qingwu's voice, calm and clear: 'Come to the Summit of First Light before the incense burns out.' I rolled the slip closed and stepped into the open sky.
immediately:2.cnHint: 一枚玉简落在案上，我____感受到师尊召唤的气息，急忙动身前往。
immediately:2.hook: The incense was already half gone.
immediately:2.line: 'Come *immediately* — the summit will not wait for slow feet.'

sentences.en: A sealed jade slip landed on my desk in the eastern study hall.
sentences.cn: 一枚封好的玉简落在了我东厢书房的桌子上。

sentences.en: I broke the seal and *immediately* felt the words inside rise like warm smoke — Master Qingwu's voice, calm and clear: 'Come to the Summit of First Light before the incense burns out.'
I rolled the slip closed and stepped into the open sky.
sentences.cn: 我卷起玉简，踏进了开阔的天空。

improvement:2.en: Xiaoxing spread three ink-brushed word-charts across the stone table and pointed to the center one. 'Look here,' she said. 'This small curve in the stroke — that is the *improvement* Master Qingwu marked last night.' The corrected line glowed faint gold, and I felt the air around the paper shift, as if the mountain itself had taken a deeper breath.
improvement:2.cnHint: 小星展开字图，指出师尊修改的笔画——那一处____让整张符文都透出新的灵气。
improvement:2.hook: But the gold light was fading fast, and something else was rising in its place.
improvement:2.line: 'This one stroke of *improvement* changed the whole formula's breath.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread three ink-brushed word-charts across the stone table and pointed to the center one.
sentences.cn: 小杏把三张墨笔的字帖摊在石桌上，指着中间那一张。

sentences.en: 'Look here,' she said.
sentences.cn: "看这儿，"她说。

sentences.en: 'This small curve in the stroke — that is the *improvement* Master Qingwu marked last night.'
The corrected line glowed faint gold, and I felt the air around the paper shift, as if the mountain itself had taken a deeper breath.
sentences.cn: 那条改正的笔画闪着淡淡的金光，我感到纸周围的空气都深吸了一口气，像是山峰本身也屏住了呼吸。

afternoon:2.en: In the slow *afternoon*, when the sea of clouds turned the color of warm jade, Shen Wujiu found a sealed wooden box wedged between two roots of the old pine. The box held a single character carved in bone — a word none of us had been taught. He set it on the altar stone and stepped back.
afternoon:2.cnHint: 在悠长的____时分，师兄在古松根部发现了一个木匣，里面藏着一个无人认识的骨刻文字。
afternoon:2.hook: The carved word began to hum on its own.
afternoon:2.line: 'I found it this *afternoon* — no name, no seal, no master's mark.'

sentences.en: In the slow *afternoon*, when the sea of clouds turned the color of warm jade, Shen Wujiu found a sealed wooden box wedged between two roots of the old pine.
The box held a single character carved in bone — a word none of us had been taught.
sentences.cn: 盒子里装着一个用骨头刻出来的单字——这个字没人教过我们。

sentences.en: He set it on the altar stone and stepped back.
sentences.cn: 他把它放在祭坛石上,退开了一步。

expand:2.en: Master Qingwu placed the seed-word on the stone dish and breathed once across it. The small character began to *expand*, its lines reaching outward like roots drinking rain, until it filled the dish and spilled soft light onto the floor. 'A word fed with enough stillness,' she said, 'will always show you its true size.'
expand:2.cnHint: 师尊对着种字轻轻吐息，那个字开始____，向四周蔓延，铺满石盘，透出柔和的光芒。
expand:2.hook: The light reached my feet, and I felt a pull I could not explain.
expand:2.line: 'Watch how one true word can *expand* until it fills the whole room.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed the seed-word on the stone dish and breathed once across it.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把这个种字放在石盘上,轻轻吹了一口气。

sentences.en: The small character began to *expand*, its lines reaching outward like roots drinking rain, until it filled the dish and spilled soft light onto the floor.
'A word fed with enough stillness,' she said, 'will always show you its true size.'
sentences.cn: "一个字如果被足够的寂静喂养,"她说,"总会向你展示它真正的样子。"

regardless:2.en: The old storage hall held scrolls no disciple had touched in a hundred years. I climbed the far shelf *regardless*, drawn by a faint silver glow behind the last row. My fingers closed around a thin roll of bark-paper. On it, a single line: 'The sky does not ask if you are ready.'
regardless:2.cnHint: 库房深处尘封已久，我____攀上高架，取下那卷发着银光的树皮纸。
regardless:2.hook: The bark-paper was warm, as if someone had held it just moments before.
regardless:2.line: 'Go, *regardless* of fear — the word will hold you if you trust it.'

sentences.en: The old storage hall held scrolls no disciple had touched in a hundred years.
sentences.cn: 这间老库房里堆着百年无人触碰的经卷。

sentences.en: I climbed the far shelf *regardless*, drawn by a faint silver glow behind the last row.
My fingers closed around a thin roll of bark-paper.
sentences.cn: 我的手指合上了一卷树皮纸。

sentences.en: On it, a single line: 'The sky does not ask if you are ready.'
sentences.cn: 纸上只有一行字:"天空不会问你是否已经准备好。"

rid:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small iron bowl filled with bitter smoke. 'Hold the word "clear" in your mind and breathe in,' he said. 'It will *rid* the copied scroll of the false strokes someone planted there.' I breathed. The smoke turned white, and three wrong lines dissolved from the page like frost in morning sun.
rid:2.cnHint: 师兄让我吸入苦烟，以"清"字之意____抄本中被人暗植的伪笔，错误的笔画随之消散。
rid:2.hook: A fourth stroke lingered, trembling, and would not leave.
rid:2.line: 'This smoke will *rid* the page of every stroke that does not belong.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small iron bowl filled with bitter smoke.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一只铁碗,里面装着苦烟。

sentences.en: 'Hold the word "clear" in your mind and breathe in,' he said.
sentences.cn: "在心里想着'清'这个字,然后吸进去,"他说。

sentences.en: 'It will *rid* the copied scroll of the false strokes someone planted there.'
I breathed.
sentences.cn: 我吸了进去。

sentences.en: The smoke turned white, and three wrong lines dissolved from the page like frost in morning sun.
sentences.cn: 烟雾变成了白色,页面上三条错误的笔画像早晨的霜一样融化了。

dog:2.en: A small *dog* made of folded cloud-paper sat on the gate post, left by no hand I could see. Xiaoxing said the Sect used such paper shapes as message-carriers long ago, before jade slips were common. When I touched its ear, it opened its mouth and spoke one word in Master Qingwu's voice, then dissolved into mist.
dog:2.cnHint: 山门石柱上蹲着一只云纸折叠的____，小星说这是古老的传信之物，我一触碰它便开口说话。
dog:2.hook: The word it spoke was one I had been warned never to say aloud.
dog:2.line: 'The paper *dog* carried only one word — and that word was yours.'

sentences.en: A small *dog* made of folded cloud-paper sat on the gate post, left by no hand I could see.
Xiaoxing said the Sect used such paper shapes as message-carriers long ago, before jade slips were common.
sentences.cn: 小杏说宗派很久以前用这样的云纸折成的东西当信使,那时候还没有玉简。

sentences.en: When I touched its ear, it opened its mouth and spoke one word in Master Qingwu's voice, then dissolved into mist.
sentences.cn: 我摸了摸它的耳朵,它张开嘴说了一个词,用的是青梧师尊的声音,然后消散成了雾。

busy:2.en: The copy hall was *busy* with the soft scratch of brushes — twelve disciples tracing the same wind-word over and over. I reached my desk last and found my ink-stone already ground, my brush already wet, and a note tucked beneath the paper: 'I prepared yours. Do not waste the morning. — X.' I did not look up, but I felt her smile across the room.
busy:2.cnHint: 抄经堂里一片____，我最后到达，却发现砚台已研好、笔已润湿，小星悄悄为我备好了一切。
busy:2.hook: At the bottom of the note, a second line had been added in a different hand.
busy:2.line: 'The hall is *busy*, but your place at the desk has been kept.'

sentences.en: The copy hall was *busy* with the soft scratch of brushes — twelve disciples tracing the same wind-word over and over.
I reached my desk last and found my ink-stone already ground, my brush already wet, and a note tucked beneath the paper: 'I prepared yours.
sentences.cn: 我最后到达我的桌子,发现我的砚台已经磨好了,笔已经沾湿了,纸下面还压着一张纸条:"我给你准备好的。

sentences.en: Do not waste the morning. — X.'
sentences.cn: 不要浪费这个早晨。——X。"

sentences.en: I did not look up, but I felt her smile across the room.
sentences.cn: 我没有抬头,但我能感觉到她在房间另一边的微笑。

male:2.en: The ancient scroll listed every herb by its nature. Some roots were *male* in spirit — sharp, rising, bold — and could lift a disciple clear off the mountain path if spoken aloud at dawn. I read the word once. My feet left the stone for three full breaths. Shen Wujiu caught my sleeve before the clouds took me.
male:2.cnHint: 古卷中记载，某些草药的灵性属____性，大声念出后我的双脚竟离地而起。
male:2.hook: The scroll had one more word beneath, blurred by old water.
male:2.line: 'A *male* herb word, spoken wrong, could pull you into the sky forever,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The ancient scroll listed every herb by its nature.
sentences.cn: 古老的卷轴按照草药的性质把每一株都列了出来。

sentences.en: Some roots were *male* in spirit — sharp, rising, bold — and could lift a disciple clear off the mountain path if spoken aloud at dawn.
I read the word once.
sentences.cn: 我读了一遍这个字。

sentences.en: My feet left the stone for three full breaths.
sentences.cn: 我的脚离开石头足足三个呼吸的时间。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu caught my sleeve before the clouds took me.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在云把我带走之前抓住了我的袖子。

fish:2.en: At the still pond between the east peaks, Xiaoxing knelt and read a word from a flat stone into the water. A silver *fish* rose at once, carrying a sealed message in its mouth. She took it without blinking. The message was addressed not to her, but to me — a disciple not yet named in any record.
fish:2.cnHint: 小星在山间水池边读出石上的字，一条____便衔着密信浮出水面。
fish:2.hook: The seal on the message bore a mark no living master claimed.
fish:2.line: 'The *fish* only rises for the one the message was meant for,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: At the still pond between the east peaks, Xiaoxing knelt and read a word from a flat stone into the water.
sentences.cn: 在东峰之间的静池边,小杏跪下身,从一块平石上读出一个字到水里。

sentences.en: A silver *fish* rose at once, carrying a sealed message in its mouth.
She took it without blinking.
sentences.cn: 她毫不眨眼地接了过来。

sentences.en: The message was addressed not to her, but to me — a disciple not yet named in any record.
sentences.cn: 信件的收信人不是她,而是我——一个还没有在任何记录里被命名的弟子。

fashion:2.en: Master Qingwu shaped the wind in the *fashion* of an open hand — slow, deliberate, each finger a spoken glyph. I copied the motion and the word together. The air around me thinned, then lifted. For a moment the floating mountain felt light beneath my feet, as if it too were learning to rise.
fashion:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊以一种特定的____做出手势，传授我御风之法。
fashion:2.hook: Then the mountain shuddered once, deep below the roots.
fashion:2.line: 'Shape the word in the *fashion* of a breath, not a shout,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu shaped the wind in the *fashion* of an open hand — slow, deliberate, each finger a spoken glyph.
I copied the motion and the word together.
sentences.cn: 我把这个动作和这个字一起复制了。

sentences.en: The air around me thinned, then lifted.
sentences.cn: 我周围的空气变薄了,然后升起来了。

sentences.en: For a moment the floating mountain felt light beneath my feet, as if it too were learning to rise.
sentences.cn: 有那么一刻,浮空的山峰在我脚下感觉很轻,好像它也在学着升起。

weather:2.en: High on the outer terrace, Shen Wujiu read a line from the sky-calendar and frowned. The *weather* above the Cloud Sea was changing — not by season, but by something older, something the words in our texts had no name for yet. He rolled the scroll tight and told me to stay close to the hall.
weather:2.cnHint: 师兄查阅天历后发现云海上方的____正在发生异常变化。
weather:2.hook: By dusk the clouds had turned the color of bruised ink.
weather:2.line: 'This *weather* was not written in any forecast I have read,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: High on the outer terrace, Shen Wujiu read a line from the sky-calendar and frowned.
sentences.cn: 在外面的平台上很高的地方,沈无咎读了一行天历上的字,皱起了眉头。

sentences.en: The *weather* above the Cloud Sea was changing — not by season, but by something older, something the words in our texts had no name for yet.
He rolled the scroll tight and told me to stay close to the hall.
sentences.cn: 他把卷轴卷紧,告诉我要靠近大殿。

device:2.en: Locked in the archive room was a small copper *device* no wider than my palm. Each face held a carved word, and turning it aligned the glyphs into a formula. Master Qingwu said it was left by a disciple who had already ascended. I turned it once, gently, and heard a tone rise from nowhere.
device:2.cnHint: 档案室里有一件铜制的____，转动它能将灵文排列成完整的飞升法诀。
device:2.hook: The tone did not stop when my hand did.
device:2.line: 'Do not turn the *device* past the third glyph,' Master Qingwu warned quietly.

sentences.en: Locked in the archive room was a small copper *device* no wider than my palm.
Each face held a carved word, and turning it aligned the glyphs into a formula.
sentences.cn: 每个面都刻着一个字,转动它可以把符号排成一个公式。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said it was left by a disciple who had already ascended.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说这是一个已经飞升的弟子留下来的。

sentences.en: I turned it once, gently, and heard a tone rise from nowhere.
sentences.cn: 我轻轻转了一次,听到一个音调从虚无中升起。

farm:2.en: Before the Cloud Sea Sect claimed these peaks, the land below was a *farm* — rice fields and herb rows tended by people who had no words for flight. Their old seed-songs, Xiaoxing told me, were the first formulas. I found one carved on a roof beam in the lower hall and felt the ground hum under me.
farm:2.cnHint: 云海宗建立之前，这片土地曾是一座____，先民的农耕歌谣竟是最早的飞升法诀。
farm:2.hook: The beam was warm, as if something in it had just woken.
farm:2.line: 'Every word we use once grew on a *farm* no one remembers,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Before the Cloud Sea Sect claimed these peaks, the land below was a *farm* — rice fields and herb rows tended by people who had no words for flight.
Their old seed-songs, Xiaoxing told me, were the first formulas.
sentences.cn: 小杏告诉我,他们最早的公式就是那些古老的种字歌。

sentences.en: I found one carved on a roof beam in the lower hall and felt the ground hum under me.
sentences.cn: 我在下面大殿的一根屋梁上找到了一首,感觉地面在我脚下嗡嗡地振动。

drug:2.en: The amber vial on Master Qingwu's shelf was not medicine in the common sense. Each drop held a single compressed word — a *drug* for the spirit, she said, that could open a sealed glyph in the mind if the disciple was ready. I was told to wait. The vial glowed faintly all through the night.
drug:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊架上的琥珀瓶里装着一种灵魂之____，能在弟子心中开启封印的灵文。
drug:2.hook: By morning the glow had shifted to the corner where I slept.
drug:2.line: 'A word used too fast acts like a *drug* — it opens more than you meant to,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The amber vial on Master Qingwu's shelf was not medicine in the common sense.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊架上的琥珀色瓶子，按常理说不算是药。

sentences.en: Each drop held a single compressed word — a *drug* for the spirit, she said, that could open a sealed glyph in the mind if the disciple was ready.
I was told to wait.
sentences.cn: 我被吩咐等待。

sentences.en: The vial glowed faintly all through the night.
sentences.cn: 瓶子整夜都泛着微弱的光。

heat:2.en: The ascension stone at the peak gave off a steady *heat* — not fire, but something closer to memory made warm. Shen Wujiu pressed his hand to it and read the word carved at its center aloud. The stone answered. I watched his outline go briefly bright, then still, and I understood for the first time what rising truly cost.
heat:2.cnHint: 山顶的飞升石散发出一种____，师兄将手贴上去大声念出灵文，石头竟作出了回应。
heat:2.hook: A second outline, faint and unfamiliar, appeared beside his.
heat:2.line: 'Feel the *heat* before you speak the word — it tells you if the stone accepts you,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The ascension stone at the peak gave off a steady *heat* — not fire, but something closer to memory made warm.
Shen Wujiu pressed his hand to it and read the word carved at its center aloud.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把手按在飞升石上，念出了刻在石心的那个字。

sentences.en: The stone answered.
sentences.cn: 石头应了。

sentences.en: I watched his outline go briefly bright, then still, and I understood for the first time what rising truly cost.
sentences.cn: 我看着他的身影闪亮了一瞬，然后静止，我第一次明白了什么叫真正的飞升要付出的代价。

intelligence:2.en: Deep within the Archive Grotto, I found a jade slip unlike the others. It held not a formula, but a map of hidden herb-fields, drawn by an unknown hand. Master Qingwu studied it in silence, then said our sect had long underestimated the *intelligence* of the earth itself — its quiet knowing of where power pools and waits.
intelligence:2.cnHint: 在档案石窟中，我发现了一块记录大地____的玉简，师尊沉默地凝视着它。
intelligence:2.hook: A faint warmth rose from the slip, as if it breathed.
intelligence:2.line: 'The *intelligence* of this earth has watched us longer than we know,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Deep within the Archive Grotto, I found a jade slip unlike the others.
sentences.cn: 深入藏经洞窟，我找到了一块与众不同的玉简。

sentences.en: It held not a formula, but a map of hidden herb-fields, drawn by an unknown hand.
sentences.cn: 上面记的不是功法，而是一份隐秘药田的地图，出自某个无名人之手。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu studied it in silence, then said our sect had long underestimated the *intelligence* of the earth itself — its quiet knowing of where power pools and waits.

uk:2.en: Shen Wujiu returned from the outer-gate messenger tower holding a folded letter sealed with blue wax. He said a wandering scholar from a distant land called the *uk* had once passed through Cloud Sea Sect and left behind notes on word-herb combinations no elder here had seen before. The letter was from his student, asking to reclaim them.
uk:2.cnHint: 师兄收到一封来自远方名为____的地方的学者之信，信中要求取回珍贵的典籍。
uk:2.hook: The blue wax seal bore a mountain shape no sect in our world could claim.
uk:2.line: 'A scholar of the *uk* once walked this mountain,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu returned from the outer-gate messenger tower holding a folded letter sealed with blue wax.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从外门传讯塔回来，手里拿着一封用蓝蜡封着的折信。

sentences.en: He said a wandering scholar from a distant land called the *uk* had once passed through Cloud Sea Sect and left behind notes on word-herb combinations no elder here had seen before.
The letter was from his student, asking to reclaim them.
sentences.cn: 信是从他学生那儿寄来的，要求取回那些东西。

user:2.en: On the inner-gate notice board, a new wooden plaque had appeared overnight. It listed rules for the Sect's shared spirit-lamp, a flame that amplifies any spoken formula. The first rule read: every *user* of the lamp must record their name and intent in the stone ledger below. Three names were already written. Mine was not among them.
user:2.cnHint: 内门告示板上出现了新规，每位灵灯的____都必须在石册上登记名字。
user:2.hook: The third name in the ledger was written in ash, not ink.
user:2.line: 'Every *user* of this flame carries a debt to it,' Shen Wujiu warned me.

sentences.en: On the inner-gate notice board, a new wooden plaque had appeared overnight.
sentences.cn: 内门布告栏上一夜间出现了一块新木牌。

sentences.en: It listed rules for the Sect's shared spirit-lamp, a flame that amplifies any spoken formula.
sentences.cn: 上面列着宗门共用灵灯的规则，那是一盏能放大任何咒语的火焰。

sentences.en: The first rule read: every *user* of the lamp must record their name and intent in the stone ledger below.
Three names were already written.
sentences.cn: 已经有三个名字写在上面了。

sentences.en: Mine was not among them.
sentences.cn: 我的不在其中。

park:2.en: Beyond the east pavilion lay a wide terrace of pale stone where disciples were told to *park* their spirit-swords before entering the archive. I set mine down among dozens of others, each blade humming at a different pitch. Xiaoxing leaned close and whispered that the swords remember every place they have rested.
park:2.cnHint: 在东阁外的石台上，弟子们须将灵剑____在此处，再入档案室。
park:2.hook: My sword's hum changed the moment it touched the cold stone.
park:2.line: '*Park* your sword here and listen to what it tells you after,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Beyond the east pavilion lay a wide terrace of pale stone where disciples were told to *park* their spirit-swords before entering the archive.
I set mine down among dozens of others, each blade humming at a different pitch.
sentences.cn: 我把剑放在其他数十把刀剑中间，每一把都在用不同的音高嗡鸣。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing leaned close and whispered that the swords remember every place they have rested.
sentences.cn: 小杏凑过来低声说，剑会记住它们曾经搁过的每个地方。

reward:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a small vial of dawn-dew on the altar and announced it as a *reward* for whoever could correctly name the three silent herbs growing at the cliff's edge before the morning bell. Xiaoxing stepped forward without hesitation, spoke three words, and the herbs turned briefly gold. No one else had even raised a hand.
reward:2.cnHint: 师尊将一瓶晨露作为____，颁给能在晨钟前说出崖边三株沉默药草名字的弟子。
reward:2.hook: The herbs turned gold — then one of them slowly bent away from Xiaoxing.
reward:2.line: 'A *reward* given by the mountain is heavier than one given by any elder,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a small vial of dawn-dew on the altar and announced it as a *reward* for whoever could correctly name the three silent herbs growing at the cliff's edge before the morning bell.
Xiaoxing stepped forward without hesitation, spoke three words, and the herbs turned briefly gold.
sentences.cn: 小杏毫不犹豫地走上前去，说出三个字，那些草本瞬间闪出了金色。

sentences.en: No one else had even raised a hand.
sentences.cn: 没有其他人甚至抬过手。

credit:2.en: I had carried a borrowed jade slip for two weeks, studying its formulas in secret. When I finally solved the binding problem it described, Shen Wujiu told me to give full *credit* to the disciple who first inscribed it, a name I did not know. He pressed a finger to the faded mark in the corner. I had not noticed it before.
credit:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，解出古法阵的功劳和____应归于最初镌刻玉简的那位弟子。
credit:2.hook: The faded mark in the corner began, very slowly, to glow.
credit:2.line: 'Give *credit* to the one who carved this, or the formula will know,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: I had carried a borrowed jade slip for two weeks, studying its formulas in secret.
sentences.cn: 我借来一块玉简，偷偷研究了两周上面的功法。

sentences.en: When I finally solved the binding problem it described, Shen Wujiu told me to give full *credit* to the disciple who first inscribed it, a name I did not know.
He pressed a finger to the faded mark in the corner.
sentences.cn: 他用手指按在角落那个褪色的记号上。

sentences.en: I had not noticed it before.
sentences.cn: 我之前没注意到。

snack:2.en: Xiaoxing appeared at my study alcove just before the midday bell, carrying a small cloth pouch. Inside were dried cloud-berries, a light *snack* given to disciples who complete an unbroken week of dawn practice. She set the pouch down without a word. I had not told anyone I had kept that streak. Someone, it seemed, had been watching the practice log.
snack:2.cnHint: 小星悄悄送来一袋云莓作为____，那是连续七天参加晨练的弟子才能得到的奖励。
snack:2.hook: Inside the pouch, beneath the berries, lay a folded slip of paper.
snack:2.line: 'A small *snack* for a quiet effort,' Xiaoxing said, eyes bright.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing appeared at my study alcove just before the midday bell, carrying a small cloth pouch.
sentences.cn: 小杏在正午钟声前来到我的学舍，拿着一个小布袋。

sentences.en: Inside were dried cloud-berries, a light *snack* given to disciples who complete an unbroken week of dawn practice.
She set the pouch down without a word.
sentences.cn: 她把布袋放下，什么话都没说。

sentences.en: I had not told anyone I had kept that streak.
sentences.cn: 我没跟任何人说过我坚持了那个纪录。

sentences.en: Someone, it seemed, had been watching the practice log.
sentences.cn: 看来是有人在看练功簿。

retire:2.en: The stone lamp in Master Qingwu's study burned low. 'A disciple who cannot name the five wind herbs must *retire* before the midnight bell,' she said, setting a scroll on the table. I stared at the page. Five names — I knew only three. Outside, the clouds rolled silver beneath the floating peak.
retire:2.cnHint: 师尊说，不能说出五种风草名字的弟子必须在午夜钟声前____。
retire:2.hook: The fourth name rose in my throat — then vanished like smoke.
retire:2.line: 'Those who cannot name what heals must *retire* before the bell rings.'

sentences.en: The stone lamp in Master Qingwu's study burned low.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊书房里的石灯烧得很低。

sentences.en: 'A disciple who cannot name the five wind herbs must *retire* before the midnight bell,' she said, setting a scroll on the table.
I stared at the page.
sentences.cn: 我盯着页面。

sentences.en: Five names — I knew only three.
sentences.cn: 五个名字——我只认识三个。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds rolled silver beneath the floating peak.
sentences.cn: 窗外，云在浮峰下翻滚成银色。

sea:2.en: The archive room jutted out beyond the cliff edge, its floor made of clouded glass. Below, the *sea* of clouds stretched without end, pale and vast as a sleeping thought. Shen Wujiu handed me a scroll stamped with a red crane. 'Found this in the lower shelf,' he said. 'It has your name on it.'
sea:2.cnHint: 在档案室里，同门师兄找到一卷写有我名字的卷轴，下方是无边的云____。
sea:2.hook: The red crane on the seal slowly opened one painted eye.
sea:2.line: 'Look down — the *sea* of clouds hides what the mountain forgets.'

sentences.en: The archive room jutted out beyond the cliff edge, its floor made of clouded glass.
sentences.cn: 藏经室伸出了悬崖边缘，地板是浑浊的玻璃。

sentences.en: Below, the *sea* of clouds stretched without end, pale and vast as a sleeping thought.
Shen Wujiu handed me a scroll stamped with a red crane.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一卷盖着红鹤印章的卷轴。

sentences.en: 'Found this in the lower shelf,' he said.
sentences.cn: "在下面的架子上找到的，"他说。

sentences.en: 'It has your name on it.'
sentences.cn: "上面写着你的名字。"

town:2.en: A messenger bird landed on my windowsill carrying a letter from the *town* below the mountain. The words were my mother's, small and careful: she had found a strange herb growing in the market square, one that glowed faint green at dusk. Xiaoxing leaned over my shoulder and went very still.
town:2.cnHint: 山下____来了一封信，信里提到集市上出现了一株奇异的、会发光的草药。
town:2.hook: Xiaoxing whispered that no herb of that kind had grown at low ground in a hundred years.
town:2.line: 'A herb that glows — in a *town* below the clouds? That should not be.'

sentences.en: A messenger bird landed on my windowsill carrying a letter from the *town* below the mountain.
The words were my mother's, small and careful: she had found a strange herb growing in the market square, one that glowed faint green at dusk.
sentences.cn: 字迹是我母亲的，小而工整：她在山下镇集上发现了一种奇异的草本，黄昏时会泛出淡淡的绿光。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing leaned over my shoulder and went very still.
sentences.cn: 小杏靠到我肩上看，忽然静止了。

gap:2.en: Shen Wujiu traced his finger along the shelf of jade tablets, then stopped. There was a clear *gap* where three tablets should have stood. Dust marked the shape of what was missing. 'Someone removed them before dawn,' he said quietly. I checked the record book. The three tablets named the highest flying word of our sect.
gap:2.cnHint: 书架上有一处明显的____，三块记载着本门最高飞升字诀的玉简不见了。
gap:2.hook: The dust outline was still warm to the touch.
gap:2.line: 'See this *gap* on the shelf — three tablets of the flying word are gone.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu traced his finger along the shelf of jade tablets, then stopped.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎的手指沿着玉简的架子滑过，然后停了下来。

sentences.en: There was a clear *gap* where three tablets should have stood.
Dust marked the shape of what was missing.
sentences.cn: 灰尘标记出了失踪东西的轮廓。

sentences.en: 'Someone removed them before dawn,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "有人在天亮前拿走了它们，"他静静地说。

sentences.en: I checked the record book.
sentences.cn: 我查了记录簿。

sentences.en: The three tablets named the highest flying word of our sect.
sentences.cn: 这三块玉简记载的是我们宗派飞升的最高之言。

generation:2.en: The oldest scroll in the east hall had not been opened in sixty years. Master Qingwu unrolled it with steady hands. 'Each *generation* of disciples has added one word to this record,' she said. The final entry was a single character drawn in silver ink, still bright. There was room below it for exactly one more line.
generation:2.cnHint: 师尊展开古卷，说每____的弟子都在上面添写了一个字，而最后一行仍留有空白。
generation:2.hook: The silver character seemed to shift when I looked away.
generation:2.line: 'Every *generation* leaves one word — now the scroll waits for ours.'

sentences.en: The oldest scroll in the east hall had not been opened in sixty years.
sentences.cn: 东殿里最古老的卷轴已经六十年没打开过了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled it with steady hands.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用稳定的手展开了它。

sentences.en: 'Each *generation* of disciples has added one word to this record,' she said.
The final entry was a single character drawn in silver ink, still bright.
sentences.cn: 最后的记录是一个用银墨写的单独字符，依然闪烁着光芒。

sentences.en: There was room below it for exactly one more line.
sentences.cn: 它下面正好还有空间写下最后一行。

guide:2.en: Tucked inside my practice robe I found a thin booklet I had never seen before. On the cover were two words: 'Cloud *Guide*.' The pages named twelve paths through the upper air, with small drawings of wind and stone. Xiaoxing said she had never heard of such a booklet being given to a first-year disciple.
guide:2.cnHint: 我在练功服里发现了一本从未见过的小册子，上面写着"云____"，记载了十二条高空路径。
guide:2.hook: The last path in the booklet was drawn in ink that had not yet dried.
guide:2.line: 'This *guide* names twelve air paths — who left it in your robe?'

sentences.en: Tucked inside my practice robe I found a thin booklet I had never seen before.
sentences.cn: 我在修行袍的褶皱里找到了一本从未见过的薄册子。

sentences.en: On the cover were two words: 'Cloud *Guide*.'
The pages named twelve paths through the upper air, with small drawings of wind and stone.
sentences.cn: 书页上画着十二条穿过上空的路径，配着风和石头的小幅画。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing said she had never heard of such a booklet being given to a first-year disciple.
sentences.cn: 小杏说她从没听说过有人会把这样的册子给一年级弟子。

household:2.en: The letter from the valley registry listed my family as a common *household*, owners of no spiritual land and no recorded words. Shen Wujiu read it over my shoulder without comment. Then he pointed to a small mark in the corner of the page — a crane stamp, very faint, used only by the sect's own record keepers.
household:2.cnHint: 来自山谷户籍的信函将我家列为普通____，但同门师兄发现页角有一枚极淡的宗门印记。
household:2.hook: The crane stamp should only appear on documents the sect itself had already chosen to watch.
household:2.line: 'A common *household* marked by the sect — that is not a small thing.'

sentences.en: The letter from the valley registry listed my family as a common *household*, owners of no spiritual land and no recorded words.
Shen Wujiu read it over my shoulder without comment.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎靠在我肩膀上读它，一句话都没说。

sentences.en: Then he pointed to a small mark in the corner of the page — a crane stamp, very faint, used only by the sect's own record keepers.
sentences.cn: 然后他指向页面角落的一个小标记——一个很淡的鹤形印章，只有宗派自己的记录员才用。

luxury:2.en: Clean water for washing was a *luxury* on the upper peaks; most disciples used dew collected before sunrise. I found a small jade basin on my desk, full and cold, with a folded paper beneath it. The paper held one word written in Master Qingwu's hand — the word for 'patience.' I did not know yet what I was being asked to wait for.
luxury:2.cnHint: 清洗用水在高峰是一种____，我桌上却出现了一盆清水，下压着师尊亲笔写的"忍"字。
luxury:2.hook: By evening the water in the basin had turned the faint colour of clouds before a storm.

sentences.en: Clean water for washing was a *luxury* on the upper peaks; most disciples used dew collected before sunrise.
I found a small jade basin on my desk, full and cold, with a folded paper beneath it.
sentences.cn: 我在书桌上发现了一个小玉盆，装满了冷水，下面压着一张折好的纸。

sentences.en: The paper held one word written in Master Qingwu's hand — the word for 'patience.'
sentences.cn: 纸上用青梧师尊的字迹写了一个字——"耐心"。

sentences.en: I did not know yet what I was being asked to wait for.
sentences.cn: 那时我还不知道自己被要求等待什么。

analysis:2.en: Deep within the Archive Grotto, I found a jade slip carved with Master Qingwu's handwriting. Her careful *analysis* of the three Ascending Winds revealed a hidden fourth path — one no disciple had ever walked. The words glowed faintly, as if waiting for a reader worthy of them.
analysis:2.cnHint: 我在典籍石窟中发现了师尊留下的玉简，她对飞升之风的____揭示了一条隐秘的第四路。
analysis:2.hook: The fourth path had no name, only a warning.
analysis:2.line: 'My *analysis* shows a fourth wind — but it has never been survived.'

sentences.en: Deep within the Archive Grotto, I found a jade slip carved with Master Qingwu's handwriting.
sentences.cn: 在档案洞窟的深处，我找到了一块玉简，上面刻着青梧师尊的笔迹。

sentences.en: Her careful *analysis* of the three Ascending Winds revealed a hidden fourth path — one no disciple had ever walked.
The words glowed faintly, as if waiting for a reader worthy of them.
sentences.cn: 这些字微微发光，仿佛在等待一个配得上它们的读者。

application:2.en: On the notice stone near the Hall of Clouds, a new list had appeared. Shen Wujiu pointed to my name near the bottom. 'Your *application* to attempt the Ascension Trial was accepted,' he said quietly. Around us, other disciples fell silent, their eyes heavy with something between envy and concern.
application:2.cnHint: 云殿前的告示石上出现了新名单，我向飞升试炼提交的____已获批准。
application:2.hook: No disciple below the third ring had ever been accepted before.
application:2.line: 'Your *application* was accepted — but the elders argued for an hour.'

sentences.en: On the notice stone near the Hall of Clouds, a new list had appeared.
sentences.cn: 在云殿附近的布告石上，出现了一份新的名单。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pointed to my name near the bottom.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎指向我的名字，在最下面。

sentences.en: 'Your *application* to attempt the Ascension Trial was accepted,' he said quietly.
Around us, other disciples fell silent, their eyes heavy with something between envy and concern.
sentences.cn: 我们周围的其他弟子沉默了下来，眼神里带着嫉妒和担忧的混合。

living:2.en: Xiaoxing led me across the Sky Bridge to the outer terrace, where small herb gardens clung to the cliff face. 'Every *living* thing here draws power from the clouds below,' she said, kneeling beside a silver-leafed plant. Its roots reached through stone, drinking mist, trembling faintly as if aware of us.
living:2.cnHint: 晓星带我来到悬崖外台，告诉我这里所有____的事物都从云海中汲取灵力。
living:2.hook: The silver leaves turned toward me, though there was no wind.
living:2.line: 'Every *living* thing on this terrace knows who does not belong.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing led me across the Sky Bridge to the outer terrace, where small herb gardens clung to the cliff face.
sentences.cn: 小杏带我穿过天桥来到外露台，那里有小草药园紧贴着悬崖生长。

sentences.en: 'Every *living* thing here draws power from the clouds below,' she said, kneeling beside a silver-leafed plant.
Its roots reached through stone, drinking mist, trembling faintly as if aware of us.
sentences.cn: 它的根穿过石头，吸饮雾气，微微颤抖，仿佛察觉到了我们。

proposal:2.en: I discovered a folded letter tucked beneath the incense burner in the study hall. It was a *proposal* written in Shen Wujiu's steady hand — a plan to open a forgotten meridian route said to reduce the dangers of ascension. The ink was fresh. He had written it that very morning.
proposal:2.cnHint: 我在书房香炉下发现了一封信，是师兄提出的关于降低飞升风险的____。
proposal:2.hook: The proposal was addressed not to the elders, but to me.
proposal:2.line: 'This *proposal* may anger Master Qingwu — read it before she does.'

sentences.en: I discovered a folded letter tucked beneath the incense burner in the study hall.
sentences.cn: 我在书房的香炉下发现了一封折好的信。

sentences.en: It was a *proposal* written in Shen Wujiu's steady hand — a plan to open a forgotten meridian route said to reduce the dangers of ascension.
The ink was fresh.
sentences.cn: 墨迹还很新鲜。

sentences.en: He had written it that very morning.
sentences.cn: 他是今天早上才写的。

relevant:2.en: In the library pavilion, I searched shelf after shelf for texts on the Ascension Wind. Master Qingwu appeared beside me without a sound. She pulled a single thin volume from the highest shelf. 'Only this one is *relevant*,' she said. Every other book, it seemed, had been placed there to distract.
relevant:2.cnHint: 在藏书阁中，师尊从最高处取下一本薄册，说只有这本____的资料真正有用。
relevant:2.hook: The thin volume had no author, and no title at all.
relevant:2.line: 'Only this text is *relevant* — the rest are beautiful distractions.'

sentences.en: In the library pavilion, I searched shelf after shelf for texts on the Ascension Wind.
sentences.cn: 在图书馆里，我在架子上一排排地搜寻关于飞升风的文献。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu appeared beside me without a sound.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊无声地出现在我身旁。

sentences.en: She pulled a single thin volume from the highest shelf.
sentences.cn: 她从最高的架子上拉下了一卷薄薄的书册。

sentences.en: 'Only this one is *relevant*,' she said.
Every other book, it seemed, had been placed there to distract.
sentences.cn: 看起来，所有其他的书都是被放在那儿来迷惑人的。

senior:2.en: At the edge of the Moon Terrace, a *senior* disciple I did not recognise stood alone, watching the clouds shift below. He wore no sect colours. When I approached, he handed me a smooth stone carved with a single word and walked away without speaking, disappearing before I reached the steps.
senior:2.cnHint: 在月台边缘，一位不知名的____弟子默默递给我一块刻字石，随即消失无踪。
senior:2.hook: The carved word on the stone meant only one thing: flee.
senior:2.line: 'A *senior* left this for you at dawn — he has not been seen since.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the Moon Terrace, a *senior* disciple I did not recognise stood alone, watching the clouds shift below.
He wore no sect colours.
sentences.cn: 他没有穿宗派的颜色。

sentences.en: When I approached, he handed me a smooth stone carved with a single word and walked away without speaking, disappearing before I reached the steps.
sentences.cn: 当我靠近时，他递给我一块光滑的石头，石头上刻着一个字，然后无声地走开了，在我走到台阶前就消失了。

table:2.en: The map room held one long stone *table*, covered in carved routes of the floating mountains. When I leaned close, I noticed one route had been freshly re-cut — deeper than the rest, leading to a peak marked with no name. Dust from the new cutting still lay in a fine circle around it.
table:2.cnHint: 地图室中的石____上，我发现有一条山路被新近重新刻深，通向一座无名山峰。
table:2.hook: Someone had changed the map in the night, and left no trace but dust.
table:2.line: 'Look at this *table* — someone re-carved the northern route before sunrise.'

sentences.en: The map room held one long stone *table*, covered in carved routes of the floating mountains.
When I leaned close, I noticed one route had been freshly re-cut — deeper than the rest, leading to a peak marked with no name.
sentences.cn: 当我凑近看时，我注意到其中一条路线被重新刻过——比其他的都深，通向一个没有标记名字的山峰。

sentences.en: Dust from the new cutting still lay in a fine circle around it.
sentences.cn: 新切割留下的灰尘还形成了一个细细的圆圈围绕着它。

campus:2.en: As evening fell, I walked the full length of the sect *campus*, from the flame-lit gate to the silent outer gardens. Every stone path, every carved pillar seemed to breathe with stored memory. Near the far wall, I found a small door I had never noticed — sealed with a lock shaped like a rising bird.
campus:2.cnHint: 黄昏时我走遍了宗门____，在最远处的墙边发现了一扇从未见过的小门。
campus:2.hook: The lock was warm to the touch, as if someone had just let go.
campus:2.line: 'This *campus* hides more doors than any disciple has ever been shown.'

sentences.en: As evening fell, I walked the full length of the sect *campus*, from the flame-lit gate to the silent outer gardens.
Every stone path, every carved pillar seemed to breathe with stored memory.
sentences.cn: 每块石板路、每根雕花柱子仿佛都呼吸着沉淀的记忆。

sentences.en: Near the far wall, I found a small door I had never noticed — sealed with a lock shaped like a rising bird.
sentences.cn: 在远处的墙边，我发现了一扇从未见过的小门——用一把飞鸟造型的锁封住了。

extreme:2.en: The sealed chamber beneath the peak held a single scroll. I unrolled it with care, and the first word burned with *extreme* heat against my fingertips — not painful, but urgent, as if the word itself refused to wait. Xiaoxing had warned me the oldest formulas carried their own will. Now I understood her warning.
extreme:2.cnHint: 我在山峰地下密室中展开一卷古老卷轴，第一个字散发出____的热量。
extreme:2.hook: The word was still burning — and the door behind me had sealed shut.
extreme:2.line: 'The *extreme* heat means the formula has chosen you — or is testing you.'

sentences.en: The sealed chamber beneath the peak held a single scroll.
sentences.cn: 山峰下的密室里放着一卷书简。

sentences.en: I unrolled it with care, and the first word burned with *extreme* heat against my fingertips — not painful, but urgent, as if the word itself refused to wait.
Xiaoxing had warned me the oldest formulas carried their own will.
sentences.cn: 小杏曾警告我，最古老的咒式都有自己的意志。

sentences.en: Now I understood her warning.
sentences.cn: 现在我理解她的警告了。

style:2.en: Shen Wujiu left a note folded beside my inkstone. In it he had copied the same healing word three times, each in a different *style* of script — one flowing like river water, one sharp as cut stone, one so faint it seemed made of breath. Beneath all three he wrote: the shape of the word changes its power.
style:2.cnHint: 师兄在纸条上用三种不同的____抄写了同一个疗愈字符。
style:2.hook: When I tried a fourth style no one had taught me, the ink rose off the page.
style:2.line: 'Each *style* of script calls a different spirit from the same word.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu left a note folded beside my inkstone.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在我砚台边留了一张折起来的纸条。

sentences.en: In it he had copied the same healing word three times, each in a different *style* of script — one flowing like river water, one sharp as cut stone, one so faint it seemed made of breath.
Beneath all three he wrote: the shape of the word changes its power.
sentences.cn: 他在三种写法下面写道：文字的形状改变了它的力量。

color:2.en: I found the jade tablet half-buried in the moss near the eastern cliff. When I lifted it, the carved word on its face shifted *color* — pale at rest, deep amber as my hand grew warmer, then a sharp blue the moment I held my breath. Master Qingwu had said that living words respond to the body. This one was listening.
color:2.cnHint: 一块玉简上的字随我体温变化而改变____。
color:2.hook: The blue did not fade when I breathed again — it deepened.
color:2.line: 'If the *color* turns blue and holds, the word has bonded to your spirit.'

sentences.en: I found the jade tablet half-buried in the moss near the eastern cliff.
sentences.cn: 我在东崖边苔藓里找到了半埋的玉牌。

sentences.en: When I lifted it, the carved word on its face shifted *color* — pale at rest, deep amber as my hand grew warmer, then a sharp blue the moment I held my breath.
Master Qingwu had said that living words respond to the body.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说过，活着的文字会对身体做出反应。

sentences.en: This one was listening.
sentences.cn: 这一个在倾听。

meeting:2.en: The notice was pinned to the great pine at the sect gate when I passed it at dawn. It read: all new disciples must attend a *meeting* at the Cloud Bridge before the second bell. Xiaoxing was already waiting there, her sleeve cuffed to show the ink marks from last night's practice, her expression caught between worry and excitement.
meeting:2.cnHint: 告示牌上写着新弟子须参加一场____，小星已先到了。
meeting:2.hook: When the second bell rang, Master Qingwu had not yet arrived — but her brush had.
meeting:2.line: 'This *meeting* is not a lesson — Master Qingwu says it is a test of readiness.'

sentences.en: The notice was pinned to the great pine at the sect gate when I passed it at dawn.
sentences.cn: 天亮时我经过宗门大门，发现一张公告钉在那棵老松树上。

sentences.en: It read: all new disciples must attend a *meeting* at the Cloud Bridge before the second bell.
Xiaoxing was already waiting there, her sleeve cuffed to show the ink marks from last night's practice, her expression caught between worry and excitement.
sentences.cn: 小杏已经在那儿等我了，袖口卷起来露出昨晚练习留下的墨迹，表情在担忧和兴奋之间摇摆。

volunteer:2.en: Master Qingwu asked which of us would carry the sealed word-vessel down to the lower mountain and return before nightfall. No one moved for a long breath. Then I raised my hand. Shen Wujiu looked at me with something between respect and worry. Master Qingwu simply nodded, as though she had known all along who would *volunteer*.
volunteer:2.cnHint: 师尊问谁愿意____完成一项危险的传送任务，我举起了手。
volunteer:2.hook: She handed me the vessel — and it was far heavier than it looked.
volunteer:2.line: 'I will *volunteer*, Master Qingwu — I know the lower path.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu asked which of us would carry the sealed word-vessel down to the lower mountain and return before nightfall.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊问我们谁会把那个封印的文字容器送到下山去，在天黑前赶回来。

sentences.en: No one moved for a long breath.
sentences.cn: 没人动，停顿了很久。

sentences.en: Then I raised my hand.
sentences.cn: 然后我举起了手。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu looked at me with something between respect and worry.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎看我的眼神里混着尊重和担忧。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu simply nodded, as though she had known all along who would *volunteer*.

deliver:2.en: Shen Wujiu asked me to *deliver* a wrapped bundle of word-scrolls to the archive tower before the evening mist rose and the bridge became unsafe. He pressed it into my arms with both hands, which meant it held something rare. The bundle was warm, and I could feel the words inside shifting like sleeping birds.
deliver:2.cnHint: 师兄托我在傍晚前把一捆卷轴____到档案塔。
deliver:2.hook: Halfway across the bridge, one scroll began to glow through the cloth.
deliver:2.line: 'Please *deliver* these before the mist — after that, the archive seals itself.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu asked me to *deliver* a wrapped bundle of word-scrolls to the archive tower before the evening mist rose and the bridge became unsafe.
He pressed it into my arms with both hands, which meant it held something rare.
sentences.cn: 他用两只手把它压进我怀里，这说明它装着什么稀罕东西。

sentences.en: The bundle was warm, and I could feel the words inside shifting like sleeping birds.
sentences.cn: 包裹是热的，我能感觉里面的文字在翻动，像睡着的鸟。

engineering:2.en: The diagram pinned inside my room showed the sect's water-channel system carved through the living rock of the mountain. Beneath it, a note in Xiaoxing's neat hand read: this is *engineering* done with word-formulas, not tools — every joint held by a spoken shape, every slope guided by a written command. I had thought cultivation was only flight and healing. I was wrong.
engineering:2.cnHint: 小星的笔记解释道，山中的水渠系统是用字符公式完成的____，而非普通工具。
engineering:2.hook: One channel, the note said, had been carrying the same unspoken word for three hundred years.
engineering:2.line: 'Real *engineering* here means knowing which word holds the stone together.'

sentences.en: The diagram pinned inside my room showed the sect's water-channel system carved through the living rock of the mountain.
sentences.cn: 我房间里钉着的那张图显示了宗门的水渠系统是如何在山体活石中雕刻出来的。

sentences.en: Beneath it, a note in Xiaoxing's neat hand read: this is *engineering* done with word-formulas, not tools — every joint held by a spoken shape, every slope guided by a written command.
I had thought cultivation was only flight and healing.
sentences.cn: 我原以为修行只是飞行和治愈。

sentences.en: I was wrong.
sentences.cn: 我错了。

tiny:2.en: Between the pages of the manual Shen Wujiu lent me, I found a *tiny* slip of paper no wider than my thumb. On it was a single character — one I had never seen in any lesson — drawn in ink so fine it seemed more like a scratch than a stroke. Yet when I held it near the window, the clouds outside slowed, as if the sky itself had paused to read it.
tiny:2.cnHint: 我在借来的手册页缝中发现了一张____的纸条，上面写着一个从未见过的字符。
tiny:2.hook: The character had no name in any index — but it knew mine.
tiny:2.line: 'That *tiny* slip should not exist — where exactly did you find it?'

sentences.en: Between the pages of the manual Shen Wujiu lent me, I found a *tiny* slip of paper no wider than my thumb.
On it was a single character — one I had never seen in any lesson — drawn in ink so fine it seemed more like a scratch than a stroke.
sentences.cn: 上面写着一个字——是我在任何课里都没见过的——用细得不像笔画更像刮痕的墨水写的。

sentences.en: Yet when I held it near the window, the clouds outside slowed, as if the sky itself had paused to read it.
sentences.cn: 可当我把它拿到窗边，窗外的云忽然慢了下来，好像天空本身停下来要读这个字。

destroy:2.en: The old stone shelf in the archive cave held a single rolled scroll. I reached for it, but Shen Wujiu caught my wrist. 'Careful,' he said quietly. 'The wrong breath can *destroy* a word-herb that took a hundred years to grow.' I pulled my hand back. The scroll shivered on its own, and a thin crack ran across the shelf beneath it.
destroy:2.cnHint: 师兄警告我，一次错误的呼吸就能____珍藏百年的词草。
destroy:2.hook: The crack spread toward the cave wall, silent as a held breath.
destroy:2.line: 'One careless touch can *destroy* what a hundred years built.'

sentences.en: The old stone shelf in the archive cave held a single rolled scroll.
sentences.cn: 档案洞里那只老石架上放着一卷书简。

sentences.en: I reached for it, but Shen Wujiu caught my wrist.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去拿，沈无咎抓住了我的手腕。

sentences.en: 'Careful,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "小心，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: 'The wrong breath can *destroy* a word-herb that took a hundred years to grow.'
I pulled my hand back.
sentences.cn: 我把手缩了回来。

sentences.en: The scroll shivered on its own, and a thin crack ran across the shelf beneath it.
sentences.cn: 书简自己抖动了一下，石架下面裂了一条细缝。

drop:2.en: Master Qingwu led us to the Edge Pool, a still basin at the cliff's rim. She held a word-herb over the water and let one small *drop* fall from its leaf. Where it touched, a ring of pale light opened and then closed, like an eye blinking. 'That single drop carried the formula for rising wind,' she said. The pool went dark before she finished speaking.
drop:2.cnHint: 师尊让一____液体落入边缘水池，池中出现了一个发光的圆圈。
drop:2.hook: The pale ring reappeared deeper in the water, far below the surface.
drop:2.line: 'Even one *drop* of this herb holds enough power to lift a mountain.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us to the Edge Pool, a still basin at the cliff's rim.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊带我们去了崖边的幽池，一个静止的水潭。

sentences.en: She held a word-herb over the water and let one small *drop* fall from its leaf.
Where it touched, a ring of pale light opened and then closed, like an eye blinking.
sentences.cn: 光环在水面打开又关上，像眼睛眨一下。

sentences.en: 'That single drop carried the formula for rising wind,' she said.
sentences.cn: "那一滴承载的是起风的咒式，"她说。

sentences.en: The pool went dark before she finished speaking.
sentences.cn: 她还没说完，池水就暗了下去。

efficiency:2.en: Xiaoxing spread three word-herbs on a flat stone and began sorting them by colour. 'You are doing it by feel,' I said. She shook her head. 'By pattern. *Efficiency* in cultivation is not speed — it is choosing the right herb for the right need so nothing is wasted.' She tied them into a neat bundle. Outside, the clouds below us began to spin slowly, as though listening.
efficiency:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，修炼中的____不是速度，而是为正确需求选对药草。
efficiency:2.hook: The spinning clouds formed a shape none of us had a name for.
efficiency:2.line: 'True *efficiency* means zero waste — every herb used for exactly its purpose.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread three word-herbs on a flat stone and began sorting them by colour.
sentences.cn: 小杏在一块平石上铺开三株文字草，开始按颜色分类。

sentences.en: 'You are doing it by feel,' I said.
sentences.cn: "你是靠感觉在分，"我说。

sentences.en: She shook her head.
sentences.cn: 她摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'By pattern.
sentences.cn: "按规律。

sentences.en: *Efficiency* in cultivation is not speed — it is choosing the right herb for the right need so nothing is wasted.'
She tied them into a neat bundle.
sentences.cn: 她把它们扎成了一个整齐的束。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds below us began to spin slowly, as though listening.
sentences.cn: 外面，我们下方的云开始慢慢打转，好像在听。

italian:2.en: Deep in the archive cave I found a thin book wedged between two word-scrolls. Its cover held writing in many languages — one column read like music, another like mathematics, and one Shen Wujiu said was *Italian*, a tongue from far beyond the sea of clouds. 'Someone brought knowledge from every world,' he murmured. The candle flame beside us bent toward the book, as if drawn.
italian:2.cnHint: 在档案洞中，师兄认出书皮上有一列文字是____语，来自云海之外的遥远地方。
italian:2.hook: The candle flame touched the cover and left no mark, no burn, nothing.
italian:2.line: 'This column is *Italian* — written by a traveller who crossed the cloud sea.'

sentences.en: Deep in the archive cave I found a thin book wedged between two word-scrolls.
sentences.cn: 我在档案洞里翻到一本薄薄的书，夹在两卷竹简之间。

sentences.en: Its cover held writing in many languages — one column read like music, another like mathematics, and one Shen Wujiu said was *Italian*, a tongue from far beyond the sea of clouds.
'Someone brought knowledge from every world,' he murmured.
sentences.cn: "有人从每个世界带来了知识，"他低声说。

sentences.en: The candle flame beside us bent toward the book, as if drawn.
sentences.cn: 我们身边的烛火弯向那本书，仿佛被吸引了过去。

newspaper:2.en: Among the donated offerings at the sect gate lay a folded sheet printed with tiny words. Xiaoxing picked it up. 'A *newspaper*,' she said, surprised. 'People below the clouds use these to carry news from town to town.' The words on it shifted as I watched, rearranging themselves into a single sentence none of us could read. Then they went still again.
newspaper:2.cnHint: 小星在宗门门口发现了一份____，上面的文字在我们眼前自行重新排列。
newspaper:2.hook: The rearranged sentence glowed once, faintly gold, then faded.
newspaper:2.line: 'This *newspaper* came from the lowland towns — but its words just moved on their own.'

sentences.en: Among the donated offerings at the sect gate lay a folded sheet printed with tiny words.
sentences.cn: 在宗门大门口的捐献物品里，躺着一张折起来的纸张，上面印满了密密麻麻的字。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing picked it up.
sentences.cn: 小杏捡了起来。

sentences.en: 'A *newspaper*,' she said, surprised.
'People below the clouds use these to carry news from town to town.'
sentences.cn: "云下的人用这东西在城镇之间传递消息。"

sentences.en: The words on it shifted as I watched, rearranging themselves into a single sentence none of us could read.
sentences.cn: 纸上的字在我眼前移动，重新排列成一句我们谁都看不懂的句子。

sentences.en: Then they went still again.
sentences.cn: 然后又静止了下来。

piece:2.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a map on the study table. One corner was missing, torn away cleanly. 'This *piece* held the name of the upper peak where the final formula is sealed,' he said, tracing the empty edge with one finger. I noticed the torn edge was not ragged but smooth, as if cut by something very sharp, and very deliberate. A cold wind moved through the closed room.
piece:2.cnHint: 师兄展开地图，发现缺失的那____正好记载着最终法诀所在的山峰名称。
piece:2.hook: The cold wind carried the faint smell of ink, fresh and recent.
piece:2.line: 'The missing *piece* is the only part that names the sealed peak.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a map on the study table.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在书房的桌子上铺开了一张地图。

sentences.en: One corner was missing, torn away cleanly.
sentences.cn: 一角被撕掉了，撕得很干净。

sentences.cn: 我注意到撕裂的边缘并不毛糙，而是很平整，像是被什么非常锋利、非常有意图的东西割过。

sentences.en: A cold wind moved through the closed room.
sentences.cn: 一阵冷风吹过紧闭的房间。

target:2.en: Master Qingwu set a paper lantern adrift above the practice yard. 'Your *target* is not the lantern,' she said, before any of us could raise a word-herb. 'Your target is the single written character painted on its side. Strike the character; leave the paper whole.' I breathed slowly and focused. The lantern stopped drifting, as though it too was waiting.
target:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我们，修炼场上漂浮灯笼侧面的字才是真正的____。
target:2.hook: The character on the lantern began to glow before anyone had moved.
target:2.line: 'Your *target* is the character on the side — not the lantern around it.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set a paper lantern adrift above the practice yard.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在练功场上方放起了一盏纸灯笼。

sentences.en: 'Your *target* is not the lantern,' she said, before any of us could raise a word-herb.
'Your target is the single written character painted on its side.
sentences.cn: "你的目标是画在灯笼侧面的那个字。

sentences.cn: 打中那个字，纸得保持完好。"

sentences.en: I breathed slowly and focused.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓呼吸，集中精神。

sentences.en: The lantern stopped drifting, as though it too was waiting.
sentences.cn: 灯笼停止了漂浮，仿佛它也在等待。

actual:2.en: I had memorised the formula for cloud-walking three times over, yet my feet still sank at the edge. Xiaoxing watched and then said, gently, 'The words you studied are only a description. The *actual* formula lives in the moment you stop thinking and simply step.' I looked down at the sea of clouds far below. Somewhere beneath it, something large moved.
actual:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，我背诵的只是描述，____的法诀存在于停止思考、迈步而出的那一刻。
actual:2.hook: The large shape beneath the clouds rose slowly, steadily, toward the mountain's edge.
actual:2.line: 'The *actual* formula is not in the words — it wakes when you stop reciting.'

sentences.en: I had memorised the formula for cloud-walking three times over, yet my feet still sank at the edge.
sentences.cn: 我已经把踏云的诀窍背过三遍了，可在云海边缘我的脚还是往下沉。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing watched and then said, gently, 'The words you studied are only a description.
sentences.cn: 小杏看着，然后温和地说，"你学的那些字只是描述。

sentences.en: The *actual* formula lives in the moment you stop thinking and simply step.'
I looked down at the sea of clouds far below.
sentences.cn: 我低头看向远处的云海。

sentences.en: Somewhere beneath it, something large moved.
sentences.cn: 什么大东西在云层下面移动。

disadvantage:2.en: A sealed jade scroll fell from the archive shelf, landing open at my feet. The text warned that disciples who ascend without a spirit-root above the third grade carry a grave *disadvantage* — their core may shatter at the cloud boundary. I read the line twice, then looked at my own pale, ordinary hands.
disadvantage:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现一卷玉简，记载着灵根不足者飞升时所面临的____。
disadvantage:2.hook: Outside, a single feather drifted upward and did not fall.
disadvantage:2.line: 'Your weak spirit-root is a real *disadvantage* at the cloud boundary,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: A sealed jade scroll fell from the archive shelf, landing open at my feet.
sentences.cn: 一卷封好的玉简从档案架上掉了下来，落地时正好展开在我脚边。

sentences.en: The text warned that disciples who ascend without a spirit-root above the third grade carry a grave *disadvantage* — their core may shatter at the cloud boundary.
I read the line twice, then looked at my own pale, ordinary hands.
sentences.cn: 我读了两遍这一行，然后看着自己苍白、平凡的手。

discuss:2.en: Master Qingwu summoned Shen Wujiu and me to the peak pavilion, where wind moved through stone chimes like slow breath. She spread a sky-chart across the low table and said we must *discuss* the route before the next moon, for three paths led upward and each carried a different cost.
discuss:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊召我们到山顶亭阁，要在下次月升前____飞升的路线。
discuss:2.hook: The stone chimes fell silent all at once.
discuss:2.line: 'We must *discuss* this route before the moon turns,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu summoned Shen Wujiu and me to the peak pavilion, where wind moved through stone chimes like slow breath.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把沈无咎和我召到山顶凉亭，那里风吹过石磬，像缓缓的呼吸。

sentences.en: She spread a sky-chart across the low table and said we must *discuss* the route before the next moon, for three paths led upward and each carried a different cost.

psychological:2.en: Xiaoxing found me sitting alone in the herb garden, staring at nothing. She knelt beside me and said that before any true ascent, a disciple must pass not only physical trials but a *psychological* one — a vision in which the mind turns against itself. I had not known there was such a test.
psychological:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，飞升之前还有一项____考验，是我从未听说过的。
psychological:2.hook: She pressed a small stone into my palm and said nothing more.
psychological:2.line: 'The hardest trial is *psychological* — the mountain shows you your own fears,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found me sitting alone in the herb garden, staring at nothing.
sentences.cn: 小杏在药草园里找到了我，我坐在那儿盯着什么都看不见的地方。

sentences.en: She knelt beside me and said that before any true ascent, a disciple must pass not only physical trials but a *psychological* one — a vision in which the mind turns against itself.
I had not known there was such a test.
sentences.cn: 我不知道还有这么一个考验。

request:2.en: A folded paper bird landed on my windowsill at dawn, carrying ink still damp from a brush. Inside was a single formal line: a *request* from the Sect Elder that I present myself at the Ascension Gate before the hour of noon. No reason was given. The bird crumbled to ash after I read it.
request:2.cnHint: 清晨，一只纸鹤飞到我的窗台，带来一份要我去飞升之门的____。
request:2.hook: Ash from the paper bird spelled one extra word on the sill.
request:2.line: 'This *request* comes from the Elder himself — do not be late,' Shen Wujiu warned.

sentences.en: A folded paper bird landed on my windowsill at dawn, carrying ink still damp from a brush.
sentences.cn: 一只折纸鸟在天亮时落在我的窗台上，笔墨还没干。

sentences.en: Inside was a single formal line: a *request* from the Sect Elder that I present myself at the Ascension Gate before the hour of noon.
No reason was given.
sentences.cn: 没有给出任何理由。

sentences.en: The bird crumbled to ash after I read it.
sentences.cn: 我读完后，纸鸟化成了灰烬。

symptom:2.en: The old healer at the foot of the inner peak examined my wrist and frowned. She said the trembling in my left hand was a known *symptom* in disciples who had absorbed sky-herbs too quickly — the spiritual channels were swelling like rivers after rain. She told me to stop all practice for three days.
symptom:2.cnHint: 山脚的老医者查看我的手腕，说颤抖是吸收天材过快的一种____。
symptom:2.hook: Three days, she had said — but the ascension date was in two.
symptom:2.line: 'Trembling is a clear *symptom* that your channels are under too much pressure,' the healer said.

sentences.en: The old healer at the foot of the inner peak examined my wrist and frowned.
sentences.cn: 内峰山脚的老医者给我把了把脉，皱起了眉头。

sentences.en: She said the trembling in my left hand was a known *symptom* in disciples who had absorbed sky-herbs too quickly — the spiritual channels were swelling like rivers after rain.
She told me to stop all practice for three days.
sentences.cn: 她让我停止所有修炼三天。

upon:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a hidden terrace carved into the cliff face, invisible from below. *Upon* the flat stone floor lay a ring of dried sky-moss arranged in the exact shape of the constellation that governs ascension. Someone had placed it there recently — the moss was not yet grey.
upon:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到悬崖上一处隐秘台地，石地上____摆着一圈与飞升星宿形状相同的枯苔。
upon:2.hook: A footprint in the moss pointed toward the edge.
upon:2.line: 'Look — *upon* this stone, someone has marked the ascension pattern,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a hidden terrace carved into the cliff face, invisible from below.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎领我来到一个刻在悬崖上的隐秘露台，从下面看不见。

sentences.en: *Upon* the flat stone floor lay a ring of dried sky-moss arranged in the exact shape of the constellation that governs ascension.
Someone had placed it there recently — the moss was not yet grey.
sentences.cn: 有人最近放的——苔藓还没变灰。

argument:2.en: I arrived at the archive to find Master Qingwu and the Sect Elder standing face to face in silence, the air between them still sharp. Xiaoxing whispered that their *argument* had ended only moments before I walked in — the subject was whether I should be allowed to attempt the ascent at all.
argument:2.cnHint: 我走进藏经阁时，清雾师尊与长老刚刚结束了一场关于我能否飞升的____。
argument:2.hook: Neither of them looked at me, which was worse than anger.
argument:2.line: 'Their *argument* was about you — the Elder wants to forbid your ascent,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: I arrived at the archive to find Master Qingwu and the Sect Elder standing face to face in silence, the air between them still sharp.
sentences.cn: 我来到档案室，发现青梧师尊和宗门长老面对面地站着，沉默不语，他们之间的空气还很紧张。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing whispered that their *argument* had ended only moments before I walked in — the subject was whether I should be allowed to attempt the ascent at all.

crisis:2.en: The sky above the Ascension Gate turned the colour of old bronze, and a low hum rose from the cloud sea below. Master Qingwu appeared beside me in an instant, her sleeve still trailing ink. She said the gate was entering a *crisis* — an unstable surge that came once in a hundred years, and it was happening now.
crisis:2.cnHint: 飞升之门上方天色骤变，清雾师尊赶来说，百年一遇的____正在发生。
crisis:2.hook: The cloud sea below the gate began to rise.
crisis:2.line: 'This *crisis* will close the gate within the hour — you must decide now,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: The sky above the Ascension Gate turned the colour of old bronze, and a low hum rose from the cloud sea below.
sentences.cn: 上升之门上方的天空转成了古铜色，下方云海中升起了一阵低沉的嗡鸣。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu appeared beside me in an instant, her sleeve still trailing ink.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在瞬间出现在我身边，袖子上还拖着未干的墨迹。

sentences.en: She said the gate was entering a *crisis* — an unstable surge that came once in a hundred years, and it was happening now.

campaign:2.en: A rolled scroll lay on the stone table, sealed with blue wax. Inside, Master Qingwu had mapped a great *campaign* to restore the Forgotten Glyphs — lost words that once let disciples walk on wind. My name was written at the bottom, third from the list. Outside, the clouds below the mountain turned a deep and warning red.
campaign:2.cnHint: 师尊发起了一场恢复失落字符的____，叙述者的名字赫然列于其上。
campaign:2.hook: Why was my name written before those of senior disciples?
campaign:2.line: 'This *campaign* begins at dawn — be ready, or be left behind.'

sentences.en: A rolled scroll lay on the stone table, sealed with blue wax.
sentences.cn: 一卷书轴躺在石桌上，用蓝色的蜡封着。

sentences.en: Inside, Master Qingwu had mapped a great *campaign* to restore the Forgotten Glyphs — lost words that once let disciples walk on wind.
My name was written at the bottom, third from the list.
sentences.cn: 我的名字写在最下面，第三个。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds below the mountain turned a deep and warning red.
sentences.cn: 山下的云变成了深沉而令人警惕的红色。

hurt:2.en: The jade slip Shen Wujiu pressed into my hand held one word: 'endure.' I had copied it wrong three times, and each failure sent a small shock through my fingers. Words that carry healing power can *hurt* when misread — that, Master Qingwu said, is how they teach you to be careful. A thin crack ran along the slip when I set it down.
hurt:2.cnHint: 叙述者抄写字符时出了错，感受到了字符的____。
hurt:2.hook: The crack in the jade slip slowly spread toward the center.
hurt:2.line: 'It will *hurt* at first — but pain is the word reminding you to listen.'

sentences.en: The jade slip Shen Wujiu pressed into my hand held one word: 'endure.'
sentences.cn: 沈无咎塞进我手里的玉简上只有一个字——"忍"。

sentences.en: I had copied it wrong three times, and each failure sent a small shock through my fingers.
sentences.cn: 我抄错了三次，每次失手都让指尖传来一阵小小的刺痛。

sentences.en: Words that carry healing power can *hurt* when misread — that, Master Qingwu said, is how they teach you to be careful.
A thin crack ran along the slip when I set it down.
sentences.cn: 我放下玉简时，一条细微的裂纹沿着它蔓延开来。

initiative:2.en: No one told me to climb the eastern spire before sunrise. I took the *initiative* myself, carrying a worn text Xiaoxing had left by the water basin. The words inside glowed faintly in the dark, as if rewarding the early effort. When I reached the top, a single white feather rested on the final page.
initiative:2.cnHint: 叙述者凭借自己的____，独自在清晨攀上了东塔。
initiative:2.hook: The feather was still warm, as though something had just left.
initiative:2.line: 'I respect your *initiative* — but next time, tell someone where you are going.'

sentences.en: No one told me to climb the eastern spire before sunrise.
sentences.cn: 没有人让我在日出前爬上东塔。

sentences.en: I took the *initiative* myself, carrying a worn text Xiaoxing had left by the water basin.
The words inside glowed faintly in the dark, as if rewarding the early effort.
sentences.cn: 里面的字在黑暗中隐隐发光，仿佛在奖励我的早起。
