sentences.en: When I reached the top, a single white feather rested on the final page.
sentences.cn: 当我到达塔顶时，最后一页上放着一根洁白的羽毛。

jump:2.en: Xiaoxing dared me to read the Wind Glyph aloud at the cliff edge. I shaped my mouth around each sound — then felt my heels lift from the stone. For one held breath I seemed to *jump* without jumping, pulled upward by the syllables alone. The mountain hummed beneath me, and then my feet touched down again, trembling.
jump:2.cnHint: 叙述者念出风字符的瞬间，身体如同____了起来。
jump:2.hook: The stone where I had stood was marked with a faint glowing print.
jump:2.line: 'You did not *jump* — the word carried you. That is the difference.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing dared me to read the Wind Glyph aloud at the cliff edge.
sentences.cn: 小杏敢我在悬崖边大声念诵风之字符。

sentences.en: I shaped my mouth around each sound — then felt my heels lift from the stone.
sentences.cn: 我张嘴发出每一个音节——然后感觉脚跟离开了石头。

sentences.en: For one held breath I seemed to *jump* without jumping, pulled upward by the syllables alone.
The mountain hummed beneath me, and then my feet touched down again, trembling.
sentences.cn: 山在我脚下低鸣，随后我的脚又颤抖着落地了。

lie:2.en: The archive *lies* deep inside the mountain, past three locked doors and a passage that smells of old rain. I found it by following a map Shen Wujiu had drawn on the back of a tea wrapper. The shelves held words no living disciple could read aloud. One character on the highest shelf pulsed with a cold blue light.
lie:2.cnHint: 档案室____在山体深处，叙述者循图找到了它。
lie:2.hook: The pulsing glyph slowed when I stepped closer, as if watching me.
lie:2.line: 'The oldest words *lie* where the mountain keeps its longest silence.'

sentences.en: The archive *lies* deep inside the mountain, past three locked doors and a passage that smells of old rain.
I found it by following a map Shen Wujiu had drawn on the back of a tea wrapper.
sentences.cn: 我是按照沈无咎画在茶叶纸背上的地图找到它的。

sentences.en: The shelves held words no living disciple could read aloud.
sentences.cn: 架子上放的是任何活着的弟子都读不出来的字。

sentences.en: One character on the highest shelf pulsed with a cold blue light.
sentences.cn: 最高的架子上有一个字散发着冷冷的蓝光。

lunch:2.en: During *lunch* on the open terrace, Shen Wujiu slid a folded paper under my bowl without a word. Inside was a single character I had never seen — drawn in red ink that had not yet dried. I looked up, but he was already walking away. The character began to fade the moment the clouds below us turned dark.
lunch:2.cnHint: 午____时分，叙述者在碗底发现了一张神秘的字符纸条。
lunch:2.hook: The red ink vanished completely before I could copy the shape.
lunch:2.line: 'Eat your *lunch* — the message will wait, but the glyph will not.'

sentences.en: During *lunch* on the open terrace, Shen Wujiu slid a folded paper under my bowl without a word.
Inside was a single character I had never seen — drawn in red ink that had not yet dried.
sentences.cn: 里面是一个我从未见过的字——用还未干的红墨水画的。

sentences.en: I looked up, but he was already walking away.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头，但他已经走开了。

sentences.en: The character began to fade the moment the clouds below us turned dark.
sentences.cn: 下面的云变黑的那一刻，这个字开始褪去。

necessarily:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled the old text and spoke quietly. 'A word that flies does not *necessarily* carry you safely,' she said, tracing the glyph for ascent. 'Speed without understanding is just falling in a different direction.' She rolled the text closed. A gust rose from nowhere and pressed every candle flame flat for a moment.
necessarily:2.cnHint: 师尊告诫叙述者，会飞翔的字符不____代表安全。
necessarily:2.hook: When the candles rose again, the shadows behind Master Qingwu faced the wrong way.
necessarily:2.line: 'Power does not *necessarily* mean wisdom — this mountain has buried many who forgot that.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled the old text and spoke quietly.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊展开古籍，轻声说道。

sentences.en: 'A word that flies does not *necessarily* carry you safely,' she said, tracing the glyph for ascent.
'Speed without understanding is just falling in a different direction.'
sentences.cn: "没有理解的速度只是换个方向坠落。"

sentences.en: She rolled the text closed.
sentences.cn: 她卷起了书轴。

sentences.en: A gust rose from nowhere and pressed every candle flame flat for a moment.
sentences.cn: 一阵无处而来的风猛地把每一根烛火都压平了一瞬。

psychologist:2.en: The sect kept one unusual record: the account of a wandering *psychologist* who had visited three hundred years ago and written that words, as used here, healed the mind before they healed the body. His scroll sat apart from the others, tied with plain cord. The moment I lifted it, every lamp in the archive went out at once.
psychologist:2.cnHint: 典籍中记载了一位____的访客，他认为字符先治心后治身。
psychologist:2.hook: In the sudden dark, something in the archive quietly turned a page.
psychologist:2.line: 'Even a *psychologist* who mapped the mind could not explain what the words do to the soul.'

sentences.en: The sect kept one unusual record: the account of a wandering *psychologist* who had visited three hundred years ago and written that words, as used here, healed the mind before they healed the body.
His scroll sat apart from the others, tied with plain cord.
sentences.cn: 他的书轴单独放着，用素绳缠绕。

sentences.en: The moment I lifted it, every lamp in the archive went out at once.
sentences.cn: 我一拿起它，档案室的每一盏灯瞬间全灭了。

gather:2.en: The morning bell had not yet rung when I climbed to the Herb Ledge. Dew still clung to the stone. Master Qingwu stood at the edge, her robe beginning to *gather* in the rising wind, its soft folds pressing against her like petals closing at dusk. She did not turn. She simply said, 'The mountain is listening.'
gather:2.cnHint: 清晨，我来到药崖，只见师尊的衣袍在风中____，她静静伫立，说山在聆听。
gather:2.hook: Behind her, the clouds below the ledge had begun to spin.
gather:2.line: 'Watch how the wind makes my robe *gather* — the mountain speaks through cloth.'

sentences.en: The morning bell had not yet rung when I climbed to the Herb Ledge.
sentences.cn: 晨钟还没敲响，我已经爬上了药草崖。

sentences.en: Dew still clung to the stone.
sentences.cn: 露珠还粘在石头上。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the edge, her robe beginning to *gather* in the rising wind, its soft folds pressing against her like petals closing at dusk.
She did not turn.
sentences.cn: 她没有转身。

sentences.en: She simply said, 'The mountain is listening.'
sentences.cn: 她只是说，"山在听。"

imagine:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a rolled scroll into my hands before the morning mist had lifted. 'Read it tonight,' he said quietly. Inside were words I had never seen — words so rare that I could not yet *imagine* the power they might carry, only feel them hum faintly against my palms like a held breath.
imagine:2.cnHint: 师兄递给我一卷古老的字符卷轴，那些词语如此陌生，我根本无法____它们蕴含的力量。
imagine:2.hook: At midnight the scroll grew warm, and one word began to glow.
imagine:2.line: 'Can you *imagine* speaking a word that makes the clouds part?'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a rolled scroll into my hands before the morning mist had lifted.
sentences.cn: 晨雾还没散，沈无咎就把一卷书轴塞进了我的手里。

sentences.en: 'Read it tonight,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "今晚读，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: Inside were words I had never seen — words so rare that I could not yet *imagine* the power they might carry, only feel them hum faintly against my palms like a held breath.

instance:2.en: Master Qingwu set three stones on the teaching platform and asked which word could lift them. Two disciples tried and failed. Then she pointed to me. I stepped forward and spoke 'rise' — one clear breath — and in that single *instance* all three stones left the ground together, steady as sleeping birds.
instance:2.cnHint: 师尊让三块石头同时升空，在那个____中，我轻声说出'rise'，石头便都离地了。
instance:2.hook: The third stone did not come back down.
instance:2.line: 'In every *instance* that a word lifts stone, the mountain grows lighter too.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set three stones on the teaching platform and asked which word could lift them.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在讲台上放了三块石头，问哪个字能让它们浮起来。

sentences.en: Two disciples tried and failed.
sentences.cn: 两个弟子试过了，都失败了。

sentences.en: Then she pointed to me.
sentences.cn: 然后她指向我。

sentences.en: I stepped forward and spoke 'rise' — one clear breath — and in that single *instance* all three stones left the ground together, steady as sleeping birds.

numerous:2.en: The archive room held *numerous* small jars, each sealed with a word written in red. Xiaoxing counted them once and gave up at three hundred. 'Every jar is a spoken formula someone captured long ago,' she whispered. The air smelled of pine and something older — like wind pressed flat between pages.
numerous:2.cnHint: 档案室里有____个封存着咒语的小罐子，小星数到三百便放弃了，空气中弥漫着古老的气息。
numerous:2.hook: One jar in the far corner was vibrating softly on its shelf.
numerous:2.line: '*Numerous* as these jars are, not one holds the word for flight.'

sentences.en: The archive room held *numerous* small jars, each sealed with a word written in red.
Xiaoxing counted them once and gave up at three hundred.
sentences.cn: 小杏数过一次，数到三百就放弃了。

sentences.en: 'Every jar is a spoken formula someone captured long ago,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "每一个罐子里都装着很久以前被人捕捉下来的咒语。"她低声说。

sentences.en: The air smelled of pine and something older — like wind pressed flat between pages.
sentences.cn: 空气里弥漫着松脂的味道，还有什么更古老的东西——像是风被压平了夹在书页之间。

puzzle:2.en: A stone door at the edge of the inner courtyard bore no handle, only seven words carved in a circle. Shen Wujiu had tried for a week to open it. The door was a *puzzle* that seemed to change each morning — one carved word always different from the day before, as if the mountain itself were editing its own question.
puzzle:2.cnHint: 内院石门上刻着七个字，这道____每天都会变化一个词，师兄研究了一周也没解开。
puzzle:2.hook: This morning, one of the seven words was mine.
puzzle:2.line: 'This door is a *puzzle*, and I think it only opens from the inside.'

sentences.en: A stone door at the edge of the inner courtyard bore no handle, only seven words carved in a circle.
sentences.cn: 内院边缘有扇石门，没有把手，只有七个字刻成一圈。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu had tried for a week to open it.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎试了一整周都没打开它。

sentences.en: The door was a *puzzle* that seemed to change each morning — one carved word always different from the day before, as if the mountain itself were editing its own question.

remind:2.en: Xiaoxing left a small folded note on my sleeping mat before the dawn bell. It read: 'Three breaths before you speak any word of power. Always.' She did not sign it. I knew the handwriting. She had written it to *remind* me of the lesson I had nearly forgotten the evening before, when a word slipped out too fast and singed the air.
remind:2.cnHint: 小星留了一张便条提醒我，要在说出任何力量之词前先____，因为昨晚我险些出了事故。
remind:2.hook: The paper dissolved at sunrise, leaving a faint smell of smoke.
remind:2.line: 'Let this note *remind* you: the mountain forgives once, not twice.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing left a small folded note on my sleeping mat before the dawn bell.
sentences.cn: 天明钟响前，小杏在我的睡垫上留了张折好的纸条。

sentences.en: It read: 'Three breaths before you speak any word of power.
sentences.cn: 纸条上写着："说任何咒语之前，先呼吸三次。

sentences.en: Always.'
sentences.cn: 总是这样。"

sentences.en: She did not sign it.
sentences.cn: 她没有署名。

sentences.en: I knew the handwriting.
sentences.cn: 我认出了笔迹。

sentences.en: She had written it to *remind* me of the lesson I had nearly forgotten the evening before, when a word slipped out too fast and singed the air.

truly:2.en: I had spoken the word for 'still' a hundred times in practice, but tonight, standing alone above the open clouds, I felt it land differently — it settled into the air like a root finding soil. For the first time I understood what Master Qingwu meant: a word is not *truly* yours until the silence after it belongs to you as well.
truly:2.cnHint: 我第一次感受到'止'字____落入了空气，明白了师尊说的：一个词只有连同其后的沉默才算真正属于你。
truly:2.hook: In that silence, something far below the clouds answered back.
truly:2.line: 'You have not *truly* learned a word until you can unspeak it.'

sentences.en: I had spoken the word for 'still' a hundred times in practice, but tonight, standing alone above the open clouds, I felt it land differently — it settled into the air like a root finding soil.
sentences.cn: 我在练习中说过"静止"这个字一百遍，但今晚，独自站在云海上方，我感觉它落地的方式不同了——它像根扎进泥土一样沉入空气里。

sentences.en: For the first time I understood what Master Qingwu meant: a word is not *truly* yours until the silence after it belongs to you as well.

valuable:2.en: After the trial, Master Qingwu returned my practice scroll with one line added at the bottom in her precise, narrow script: 'Your errors are your most *valuable* possession — do not correct them too quickly.' I read the line four times. Xiaoxing, reading over my shoulder, said nothing, but I heard her breath change.
valuable:2.cnHint: 师尊在我的练习卷轴上写道：你的错误是你最____的财富，不要急着改正它们。
valuable:2.hook: The ink of her added line was still faintly warm to the touch.
valuable:2.line: 'Errors, kept honestly, are more *valuable* than a perfect form.'

sentences.en: After the trial, Master Qingwu returned my practice scroll with one line added at the bottom in her precise, narrow script: 'Your errors are your most *valuable* possession — do not correct them too quickly.'
I read the line four times.
sentences.cn: 我读了四遍这一行。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing, reading over my shoulder, said nothing, but I heard her breath change.
sentences.cn: 小杏从我肩后看着，什么都没说，但我听出了她呼吸的变化。

pursue:2.en: The ancient scroll named three paths a disciple could *pursue*: the path of healing, the path of flight, and the path of storm. I unrolled it at the stone table near the cliff edge, where the clouds moved below like slow rivers. Each path glowed with a different colour. I had not yet chosen, but my hand drifted toward the storm.
pursue:2.cnHint: 弟子在悬崖边的石桌旁展开古卷，卷上列出了三条可以____的修炼之路。
pursue:2.hook: Behind me, a fourth glow appeared on the scroll — one no master had named.
pursue:2.line: 'You must choose which path to *pursue* before the next bell,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The ancient scroll named three paths a disciple could *pursue*: the path of healing, the path of flight, and the path of storm.
I unrolled it at the stone table near the cliff edge, where the clouds moved below like slow rivers.
sentences.cn: 我在悬崖边那张石桌旁展开了它，那里的云像缓慢的河流在下方流动。

sentences.en: Each path glowed with a different colour.
sentences.cn: 每条路都闪烁着不同的颜色。

sentences.en: I had not yet chosen, but my hand drifted toward the storm.
sentences.cn: 我还没有选择，但我的手飘向了雷电之路。

site:2.en: Master Qingwu led us to a bare ledge of white rock high above the cloud sea. 'This is the *site* where the first disciple of our sect spoke a word so powerful it split the mountain,' she said quietly. The rock still carried a long, clean crack. I pressed my palm against it and felt something old press back.
site:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊带我们来到一处悬崖岩台，那是古代弟子说出力量之词的____。
site:2.hook: The crack in the rock began, very slowly, to glow.
site:2.line: 'No one should speak a new word aloud at this *site*,' Master Qingwu warned.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us to a bare ledge of white rock high above the cloud sea.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊领我们走上了白石峭壁，高高悬在云海之上。

sentences.en: 'This is the *site* where the first disciple of our sect spoke a word so powerful it split the mountain,' she said quietly.
The rock still carried a long, clean crack.
sentences.cn: 那块石头上至今还留着一道笔直的裂缝。

sentences.en: I pressed my palm against it and felt something old press back.
sentences.cn: 我把掌心贴在上面，感觉有什么古老的东西贴了回来。

absorb:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me how to hold a written word against my chest and breathe slowly until the ink seemed to fade. 'Your body will *absorb* its meaning,' she said, 'the way dry earth drinks rain.' I tried with the word for 'rise.' For a moment my feet left the stone floor, then I dropped back down, laughing softly.
absorb:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，把写有词语的纸贴在胸口缓缓呼吸，身体就会____它的含义。
absorb:2.hook: The ink on the paper did not fade — it moved, tracing a new shape I could not read.
absorb:2.line: 'Breathe slowly and let your spirit *absorb* the word,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me how to hold a written word against my chest and breathe slowly until the ink seemed to fade.
sentences.cn: 小杏教我如何把一个写好的字贴在胸前，然后缓缓呼吸，直到墨迹似乎褪去。

sentences.en: 'Your body will *absorb* its meaning,' she said, 'the way dry earth drinks rain.'
I tried with the word for 'rise.'
sentences.cn: 我用"上升"这个字试了试。

sentences.en: For a moment my feet left the stone floor, then I dropped back down, laughing softly.
sentences.cn: 一瞬间我的脚离开了石地板，然后我掉了下来，轻声笑着。

advance:2.en: Each week a disciple could *advance* one level by writing a word from memory in perfect form and placing it on the testing stone. Shen Wujiu had advanced seven levels in a single month. I watched him set his paper down and the stone shine bright gold. I gripped my own paper tightly and stepped forward.
advance:2.cnHint: 弟子每周可凭默写出完美词形来____一个等级，申无咎上月已连升七级。
advance:2.hook: When my paper touched the stone, the gold light flickered and turned a deep, still blue.
advance:2.line: 'One careful step will *advance* you further than ten rushed ones,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Each week a disciple could *advance* one level by writing a word from memory in perfect form and placing it on the testing stone.
Shen Wujiu had advanced seven levels in a single month.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在一个月内升了七级。

sentences.en: I watched him set his paper down and the stone shine bright gold.
sentences.cn: 我看着他放下纸张，石头闪闪发光，金色的。

sentences.en: I gripped my own paper tightly and stepped forward.
sentences.cn: 我紧紧握着自己的纸张，走上前去。

capable:2.en: 'You are more *capable* than you believe,' Master Qingwu told me, setting a sealed jar of cloud-water on the table between us. 'Open it with only the word for wind.' I had never tried to move a physical object with a spoken word alone. I breathed, I spoke, and the lid turned. It was a small thing, but the air in the room changed.
capable:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊认为我比自己以为的更____，她让我只用风字打开一个密封的云水罐。
capable:2.hook: The cloud-water inside rose as a thin column and pointed, like a finger, at the door.

sentences.en: 'You are more *capable* than you believe,' Master Qingwu told me, setting a sealed jar of cloud-water on the table between us.
'Open it with only the word for wind.'
sentences.cn: "只用一个'风'字打开它。"

sentences.en: I had never tried to move a physical object with a spoken word alone.
sentences.cn: 我从来没试过只用说出来的字来移动物体。

sentences.en: I breathed, I spoke, and the lid turned.
sentences.cn: 我呼吸，我说了那个字，罐盖转动了。

sentences.en: It was a small thing, but the air in the room changed.
sentences.cn: 这是件小事，但房间里的空气变了。

dollar:2.en: In the market cave below the main peak, herbs and word-scrolls were traded not for gold but for spirit stones. Still, old merchants sometimes called out prices in older terms. One bent woman held up a vial of rare cloud-ink and said, 'Worth more than a thousand *dollar* coins of the old world, this is.' I did not have even one.
dollar:2.cnHint: 在集市石窟里，一位老商贩比较云墨的价值，用了旧世界____这个计价单位。
dollar:2.hook: The old woman tucked the vial away and looked at me as if she had already decided something.
dollar:2.line: 'Not one *dollar* of old metal could buy this ink,' the merchant said.

sentences.en: In the market cave below the main peak, herbs and word-scrolls were traded not for gold but for spirit stones.
sentences.cn: 在主峰下方的集市洞穴里，草药和咒语卷轴不用金币交易，而是用灵石。

sentences.en: Still, old merchants sometimes called out prices in older terms.
sentences.cn: 可是，老商人有时还会用更古老的术语报价。

sentences.en: One bent woman held up a vial of rare cloud-ink and said, 'Worth more than a thousand *dollar* coins of the old world, this is.'
I did not have even one.
sentences.cn: 我连一个都没有。

double:2.en: The trial required me to copy a healing word onto two strips of bark — the second copy had to *double* the strength of the first, written with twice the care and half the breath. Shen Wujiu stood beside me timing each stroke. My brush did not shake. When both strips were tested, the second burned twice as bright.
double:2.cnHint: 考验要求我写出同一个疗愈字词的两份，第二份必须____第一份的力量。
double:2.hook: A third strip of bark, which I had not written, appeared between the two.
double:2.line: 'The second word must *double* the power of the first,' Shen Wujiu reminded me.

sentences.en: The trial required me to copy a healing word onto two strips of bark — the second copy had to *double* the strength of the first, written with twice the care and half the breath.
Shen Wujiu stood beside me timing each stroke.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在我身边计时每一笔。

sentences.en: My brush did not shake.
sentences.cn: 我的笔没有颤抖。

sentences.en: When both strips were tested, the second burned twice as bright.
sentences.cn: 两张树皮都测试过后，第二张燃烧得是第一张的两倍明亮。

federal:2.en: A travelling scholar arrived carrying a sealed letter marked with the crest of the *Federal* Council of Peaks — the rare body that bound all seven sects to shared law. Master Qingwu read it without changing her expression. Then she folded it carefully and looked at each of us in turn. No one spoke for a long time.
federal:2.cnHint: 一位旅行学者带来了山峰____议会的密封信函，师尊读后神色不变，只是逐一打量我们。
federal:2.hook: That night, every word-lantern on the mountain went dark at the same moment.
federal:2.line: 'The *federal* law of the peaks concerns us all now,' Master Qingwu said at last.

sentences.en: A travelling scholar arrived carrying a sealed letter marked with the crest of the *Federal* Council of Peaks — the rare body that bound all seven sects to shared law.
Master Qingwu read it without changing her expression.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊读完信后面无表情。

sentences.en: Then she folded it carefully and looked at each of us in turn.
sentences.cn: 然后她小心地折好信，逐个看向我们每一个人。

sentences.en: No one spoke for a long time.
sentences.cn: 很长一段时间里没人说话。

writer:2.en: Inside the Archive Tower, I found an old scroll sealed with cloud-foam wax. The *writer* of the scroll had pressed a single silver leaf into the corner — a mark no living elder claimed. Master Qingwu held it to the light and said nothing for a long moment. The leaf began, slowly, to glow.
writer:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现一卷古老卷轴，其____留下了神秘印记，连师尊也沉默不语。
writer:2.hook: No one in the Sect had seen that seal for three hundred years.
writer:2.line: 'The *writer* of these words has not been seen since the last great ascension,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Inside the Archive Tower, I found an old scroll sealed with cloud-foam wax.
sentences.cn: 在藏经阁里，我找到了一卷用云雾蜡封印的古老卷轴。

sentences.en: The *writer* of the scroll had pressed a single silver leaf into the corner — a mark no living elder claimed.
Master Qingwu held it to the light and said nothing for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊将它对着光，沉默了很久。

sentences.en: The leaf began, slowly, to glow.
sentences.cn: 那片叶子开始缓缓发出光芒。

addition:2.en: Shen Wujiu laid five word-stones on the altar in a careful row. Each one hummed with stored breath. Then he placed a sixth — a pale stone none of us had seen before. This *addition* made the whole row ring like a struck bell, and a door of light opened in the empty air above the clouds.
addition:2.cnHint: 师兄在祭坛上摆好五块字石后，又多放了一块作为____，竟打开了一道光门。
addition:2.hook: Whatever waited beyond that door had been waiting a very long time.
addition:2.line: 'This *addition* changes the formula entirely,' Shen Wujiu said, his voice tight.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu laid five word-stones on the altar in a careful row.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在祭坛上整齐地摆放了五块字石。

sentences.en: Each one hummed with stored breath.
sentences.cn: 每一块都发出了储存的气音。

sentences.en: Then he placed a sixth — a pale stone none of us had seen before.
sentences.cn: 然后他放上第六块——一块苍白的石头，我们之前从未见过。

sentences.en: This *addition* made the whole row ring like a struck bell, and a door of light opened in the empty air above the clouds.

alternative:2.en: My word-herb was wilting. Master Qingwu said the mountain water could no longer feed it. She offered me a small vial of cloud-dew as an *alternative*, explaining that some roots need sky rather than stone. I poured it in. The herb straightened at once and put out a pale new leaf.
alternative:2.cnHint: 字草枯萎后，师尊给了我云露作为____，浇灌后它竟重新焕发生机。
alternative:2.hook: The new leaf bore a character none of us could yet read.
alternative:2.line: 'Sky-dew is your only *alternative* now,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

sentences.en: My word-herb was wilting.
sentences.cn: 我的字草在枯萎。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said the mountain water could no longer feed it.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说山泉已经无法滋养它了。

sentences.en: She offered me a small vial of cloud-dew as an *alternative*, explaining that some roots need sky rather than stone.
I poured it in.
sentences.cn: 我倒了进去。

sentences.en: The herb straightened at once and put out a pale new leaf.
sentences.cn: 那株草立刻挺直了身子，长出了一片苍白的新叶。

amazing:2.en: Xiaoxing spoke the word 'rise' for the first time without a teacher's help. What happened next was *amazing*: every loose pebble on our ledge lifted a foot into the air and hung there, trembling, as if the mountain itself were listening. She covered her mouth. The pebbles did not fall.
amazing:2.cnHint: 师妹独自说出'升'字后，发生了令人____的事——所有碎石都悬浮在空中不落下。
amazing:2.hook: Even the wind seemed to hold its breath.
amazing:2.line: 'It is *amazing* what one true word can lift,' said Shen Wujiu softly.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spoke the word 'rise' for the first time without a teacher's help.
sentences.cn: 小杏第一次没有老师帮助就念出了"起"这个字。

sentences.en: What happened next was *amazing*: every loose pebble on our ledge lifted a foot into the air and hung there, trembling, as if the mountain itself were listening.
She covered her mouth.
sentences.cn: 她捂住了嘴。

sentences.en: The pebbles did not fall.
sentences.cn: 石头没有掉下来。

ease:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a character written on bark-paper. He said to copy it ten times, then burn the copies. I worked with slow *ease*, letting my brush follow the curves without force. When I burned the last sheet, the ash rose in a perfect spiral and drifted out over the sea of clouds below.
ease:2.cnHint: 师兄让我抄写一个字并焚烧，我以从容的____完成后，灰烬竟化作螺旋飘向云海。
ease:2.hook: A spiral of ash never rises — unless something below is calling it.
ease:2.line: 'Copy it with *ease*, not effort,' Shen Wujiu told me, 'or the word will not open.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a character written on bark-paper.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一个写在树皮纸上的字。

sentences.en: He said to copy it ten times, then burn the copies.
sentences.cn: 他说要把它抄十遍，然后烧掉这些抄本。

sentences.en: I worked with slow *ease*, letting my brush follow the curves without force.
When I burned the last sheet, the ash rose in a perfect spiral and drifted out over the sea of clouds below.
sentences.cn: 当我烧掉最后一张纸时，灰烬升起，形成了完美的螺旋，飘过下方的云海。

frequent:2.en: Xiaoxing visited the Cloud Mirror pond more *frequent*ly than any other disciple. She said she was practicing reflection-reading, a way of seeing hidden words in still water. One morning I found her there, frozen, staring at a character that had risen from the deep and would not fade.
frequent:2.cnHint: 师妹____地来到云镜池练习，某天清晨她在水中看到了一个浮现后久不消散的字。
frequent:2.hook: A word that stays on still water is a word that has chosen its reader.
frequent:2.line: 'I visit *frequently* because the pond shows me things no scroll will,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing visited the Cloud Mirror pond more *frequent*ly than any other disciple.
She said she was practicing reflection-reading, a way of seeing hidden words in still water.
sentences.cn: 她说自己在练习镜面读字，一种在静水中看到隐藏文字的方法。

sentences.en: One morning I found her there, frozen, staring at a character that had risen from the deep and would not fade.
sentences.cn: 一个早晨我在那里找到她时，她僵住了，盯着一个从深处浮起、迟迟不褪的字。

hope:2.en: I carried Master Qingwu's message-stone to the northern peak before dawn. The stone held one compressed word inside it. She said to release the word only if the cloud-bridge was still standing. It was. With quiet *hope* I pressed the stone and watched the word fly out — a bright thread crossing the sky.
hope:2.cnHint: 我带着师尊的信石前往北峰，怀着____按下信石，看着那个字化作光线飞过天空。
hope:2.hook: But the cloud-bridge began to dissolve the moment the word left my hand.
hope:2.line: 'Carry it with *hope*,' Master Qingwu had told me, 'because a stone feels the heart that holds it.'

sentences.en: I carried Master Qingwu's message-stone to the northern peak before dawn.
sentences.cn: 我在天亮前把青梧师尊的传讯石带到了北峰。

sentences.en: The stone held one compressed word inside it.
sentences.cn: 石头里面压缩着一个字。

sentences.en: She said to release the word only if the cloud-bridge was still standing.
sentences.cn: 她说只有云桥还立着的时候才能释放这个字。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.cn: 它还在。

sentences.en: With quiet *hope* I pressed the stone and watched the word fly out — a bright thread crossing the sky.

imply:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me a carved tablet near the east gate. The surface held only three symbols, but she said they *implied* a complete sky-formula — one word standing for twenty, the way a single root can feed an entire branch. I touched the tablet. A low hum moved up my arm and settled behind my eyes.
imply:2.cnHint: 师妹给我看一块石碑，说上面三个符号____着一整套飞升法诀，我触碰后感到奇异的共鸣。
imply:2.hook: My vision went white for just a breath, and in that white I saw a mountain I had never climbed.
imply:2.line: 'Three marks can *imply* a thousand steps,' Xiaoxing said, tracing the stone with one finger.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me a carved tablet near the east gate.
sentences.cn: 小杏给我看了东门附近的一块雕刻石板。

sentences.en: The surface held only three symbols, but she said they *implied* a complete sky-formula — one word standing for twenty, the way a single root can feed an entire branch.
I touched the tablet.
sentences.cn: 我摸了摸那块石板。

sentences.en: A low hum moved up my arm and settled behind my eyes.
sentences.cn: 一阵低沉的嗡鸣从我的手臂向上移动，最后在我的眼后停留下来。

pose:2.en: Deep within the archive hall, I found an ancient scroll. The ink showed a cultivator in a careful *pose*: one hand raised toward the sky, one palm pressed to the heart. Master Qingwu had described this exact stance. It was not decoration — it was the opening form of the Cloud Sea Sect's highest ascent technique.
pose:2.cnHint: 我在典籍阁发现一幅古图，图中人物的____暗示着飞升功法的起手式。
pose:2.hook: But the figure in the scroll had no face.
pose:2.line: 'Hold that *pose* perfectly still, or the qi will scatter,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Deep within the archive hall, I found an ancient scroll.
sentences.cn: 在档案厅的深处，我找到了一卷古老的卷轴。

sentences.en: The ink showed a cultivator in a careful *pose*: one hand raised toward the sky, one palm pressed to the heart.
Master Qingwu had described this exact stance.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊曾经描述过这个确切的姿态。

sentences.en: It was not decoration — it was the opening form of the Cloud Sea Sect's highest ascent technique.
sentences.cn: 这不是装饰——这是云海派最高飞升秘法的起势。

stimulate:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a narrow ridge where cold wind rose sharply from the clouds below. 'Breathe it in,' he said. The bitter air seemed to *stimulate* something deep in my chest — a warmth that had never stirred before. The clouds parted, and for one breath, I felt weightless.
stimulate:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到山脊，那股寒气____了我体内从未觉醒的力量。
stimulate:2.hook: Then the warmth vanished, leaving only cold silence.
stimulate:2.line: 'The morning wind will *stimulate* your dormant meridians,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a narrow ridge where cold wind rose sharply from the clouds below.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我来到一处狭窄的山脊，冷风从下方的云海中猛烈地涌起。

sentences.en: 'Breathe it in,' he said.
sentences.cn: "吸气，"他说。

sentences.en: The bitter air seemed to *stimulate* something deep in my chest — a warmth that had never stirred before.
The clouds parted, and for one breath, I felt weightless.
sentences.cn: 云层分开了，有那么一瞬间，我感到身体变得轻飘飘的。

switch:2.en: Xiaoxing placed two glowing seed-herbs on the stone table. 'Most disciples *switch* from the red line to the blue line too early,' she warned, pressing the smaller one into my palm. 'Wait for the light to steady.' I watched the seed pulse and understood — impatience was the only true enemy here.
switch:2.cnHint: 小星提醒我，在修炼时____功法路线的时机至关重要。
switch:2.hook: A distant bell rang once — the wrong hour entirely.
switch:2.line: 'Never *switch* your focus until the inner light holds firm,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing placed two glowing seed-herbs on the stone table.
sentences.cn: 小杏在石桌上放了两株发光的种子草。

sentences.en: 'Most disciples *switch* from the red line to the blue line too early,' she warned, pressing the smaller one into my palm.
'Wait for the light to steady.'
sentences.cn: "等着光稳定下来。"

sentences.en: I watched the seed pulse and understood — impatience was the only true enemy here.
sentences.cn: 我看着种子脉动，明白了——在这里，急躁才是唯一真正的敌人。

treatment:2.en: I discovered a worn journal hidden beneath a loose floor stone in the eastern pavilion. Its pages described the *treatment* of wounded disciples who had attempted ascent too soon — each given a certain pale herb and three days of silence. The journal's last entry had no date and no name.
treatment:2.cnHint: 我在东厢发现一本旧册，记载着飞升失败弟子的____方式。
treatment:2.hook: The handwriting on the last page matched Master Qingwu's.
treatment:2.line: 'The proper *treatment* is rest and the white-leaf brew,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: I discovered a worn journal hidden beneath a loose floor stone in the eastern pavilion.
sentences.cn: 我在东阁一块松动的地板石下发现了一本破旧的日记。

sentences.en: Its pages described the *treatment* of wounded disciples who had attempted ascent too soon — each given a certain pale herb and three days of silence.
The journal's last entry had no date and no name.
sentences.cn: 日记的最后一页没有日期，也没有署名。

union:2.en: At the peak altar, Master Qingwu spoke of ascent not as a departure but as a *union* — the disciple's breath joining the great wind that circled all the floating mountains. Shen Wujiu stood very still beside me. I realised he was listening as though hearing the words for the last time.
union:2.cnHint: 师尊在祭坛讲述飞升是人与天风之间的____，师兄神色异样。
union:2.hook: Shen Wujiu's robe edge rippled — though the air was calm.
union:2.line: 'Ascent is a *union* with the sky, not an escape from the earth,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: At the peak altar, Master Qingwu spoke of ascent not as a departure but as a *union* — the disciple's breath joining the great wind that circled all the floating mountains.
Shen Wujiu stood very still beside me.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在我身边，一动不动。

sentences.en: I realised he was listening as though hearing the words for the last time.
sentences.cn: 我意识到他在听，就像在听最后一次似的。

acknowledge:2.en: I brought my completed ascent diagram to Shen Wujiu. He studied it for a long moment, then gave a single slow nod. To *acknowledge* another disciple's work openly was rare in this sect — a quiet mark of trust that meant more than any spoken praise. I folded the diagram carefully.
acknowledge:2.cnHint: 师兄以一个点头____了我的修炼成果，这在本门极为少见。
acknowledge:2.hook: His eyes, though, were already looking toward the far horizon.
acknowledge:2.line: 'I must *acknowledge* what you have done — this diagram is correct,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: I brought my completed ascent diagram to Shen Wujiu.
sentences.cn: 我把完成的飞升图带给了沈无咎。

sentences.en: He studied it for a long moment, then gave a single slow nod.
sentences.cn: 他研究了很久，然后缓缓点了一下头。

sentences.en: To *acknowledge* another disciple's work openly was rare in this sect — a quiet mark of trust that meant more than any spoken praise.
I folded the diagram carefully.
sentences.cn: 我小心地折好了图纸。

alike:2.en: Xiaoxing set two ascent stones side by side. To any newcomer they looked *alike* — same pale colour, same smooth surface. But she showed me the difference: one hummed softly, one was silent. 'Never confuse them,' she said. The silent one, she explained, had already been used and could not rise again.
alike:2.cnHint: 小星展示两块飞升石，外表____，但只有一块仍有灵力。
alike:2.hook: I had already touched the silent one first.
alike:2.line: 'They seem *alike*, but one holds life and one holds nothing,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing set two ascent stones side by side.
sentences.cn: 小杏把两块飞升石并排放在一起。

sentences.en: To any newcomer they looked *alike* — same pale colour, same smooth surface.
But she showed me the difference: one hummed softly, one was silent.
sentences.cn: 但她给我指出了不同之处：一块微微发声，一块无声。

sentences.en: 'Never confuse them,' she said.
sentences.cn: "千万别搞混了，"她说。

sentences.en: The silent one, she explained, had already been used and could not rise again.
sentences.cn: 那块无声的，她解释说，已经用过了，再也升不起来了。

analyze:2.en: In the library tower I spent the morning trying to *analyze* a fragment of cloud-script found pressed inside an old text. Each symbol seemed to shift when viewed directly. Slowly a pattern emerged — the fragment was not a record but a warning, written by someone who had reached the final gate and turned back.
analyze:2.cnHint: 我在藏书楼____一段云文碎片，发现它竟是一则警告而非记录。
analyze:2.hook: The last symbol translated to a single word: wait.
analyze:2.line: '*Analyze* the pattern of strokes before you assume the meaning,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: In the library tower I spent the morning trying to *analyze* a fragment of cloud-script found pressed inside an old text.
Each symbol seemed to shift when viewed directly.
sentences.cn: 每个符号在直视时似乎都会变化。

sentences.en: Slowly a pattern emerged — the fragment was not a record but a warning, written by someone who had reached the final gate and turned back.
sentences.cn: 渐渐地，一个图案浮现了出来——这个残片不是记录，而是一个警告，是某个到达了最后之门却转身返回的人写的。

insist:2.en: A sealed jade tube had appeared on my desk overnight, humming faintly with cold light. Inside was a single strip of paper bearing the word 'ascend.' Shen Wujiu studied it with narrow eyes. 'Whoever left this will *insist* you act before dawn,' he said, pressing the tube back into my hands. The clouds below our mountain began to glow.
insist:2.cnHint: 师兄说，留下这封信的人会____你在天亮前行动。
insist:2.hook: By the time I looked up, Shen Wujiu was already gone.
insist:2.line: 'They will *insist* you climb before the first bell rings.'

sentences.en: A sealed jade tube had appeared on my desk overnight, humming faintly with cold light.
sentences.cn: 一个密封的翡翠管在一夜间出现在了我的桌子上，散发着微弱的冷光嗡鸣声。

sentences.en: Inside was a single strip of paper bearing the word 'ascend.'
sentences.cn: 里面是一张纸条，上面只写着一个字："飞升"。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu studied it with narrow eyes.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎眯着眼睛研究着它。

sentences.en: 'Whoever left this will *insist* you act before dawn,' he said, pressing the tube back into my hands.
The clouds below our mountain began to glow.
sentences.cn: 我们山下的云开始泛起光来。

investigation:2.en: I found a ring of burned herbs arranged in a perfect circle on the stone terrace, each one a word-formula I had never been taught. Xiaoxing knelt and drew a small map of the pattern. 'This deserves a careful *investigation*,' she said quietly, her brush not stopping. Far above, a lone crane turned and flew north into the dark.
investigation:2.cnHint: 小星认为，这片被烧毁的草药阵需要认真____。
investigation:2.hook: The crane did not return before the moon set.
investigation:2.line: 'A proper *investigation* begins before the wind erases the ash.'

sentences.en: I found a ring of burned herbs arranged in a perfect circle on the stone terrace, each one a word-formula I had never been taught.
sentences.cn: 我在石露台上发现了一圈完美排列的焚香，每一根都是我从未学过的字诀。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing knelt and drew a small map of the pattern.
sentences.cn: 小杏跪下来，用笔描绘了这个图案的小地图。

sentences.en: 'This deserves a careful *investigation*,' she said quietly, her brush not stopping.
Far above, a lone crane turned and flew north into the dark.
sentences.cn: 远方高空，一只孤鹤转身飞向黑暗中的北方。

limited:2.en: Master Qingwu placed seven small vials on the altar, each holding a glowing word sealed in mist. 'Our supply of ascent-formulas is *limited*,' she said, voice steady as still water. 'Each disciple may carry only one to the summit.' I chose mine slowly, and when I closed my fingers around the vial, it turned cold.
limited:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊说，飞升所用的字诀____，每位弟子只能带走一枚。
limited:2.hook: The vial in my pocket had not been cold a moment ago.
limited:2.line: 'Time and strength are both *limited* — choose the word that fits you best.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed seven small vials on the altar, each holding a glowing word sealed in mist.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在祭坛上摆了七个小瓶子，每个瓶子里都装着一个被雾气封住的闪闪发光的字。

sentences.en: 'Our supply of ascent-formulas is *limited*,' she said, voice steady as still water.
'Each disciple may carry only one to the summit.'
sentences.cn: "每个弟子登顶时只能带一个。"

sentences.en: I chose mine slowly, and when I closed my fingers around the vial, it turned cold.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢选了一个，手指合上瓶子的时候，它变冷了。

listen:2.en: Deep inside the Herb Library, a scroll had unrolled itself against the wall and was emitting a low, clear sound — almost a voice. Xiaoxing touched my sleeve. '*Listen*,' she whispered. The sound shaped itself into a single word I had never heard, then the scroll rolled shut on its own. Dust drifted down from the shelves above us.
listen:2.cnHint: 小星让我____，那卷自己展开的书卷正在发出低沉的声音。
listen:2.hook: The word it had spoken was already fading from my memory.
listen:2.line: '*Listen* carefully — some words only speak once and never again.'

sentences.en: Deep inside the Herb Library, a scroll had unrolled itself against the wall and was emitting a low, clear sound — almost a voice.
sentences.cn: 在药草库的深处，一卷书册自己展开靠在墙边，发出一声低沉、清晰的音——几乎像是声音。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing touched my sleeve. '*Listen*,' she whispered.
The sound shaped itself into a single word I had never heard, then the scroll rolled shut on its own.
sentences.cn: 那声音化成了一个我从未听过的单字，然后书册自己卷了起来。

sentences.en: Dust drifted down from the shelves above us.
sentences.cn: 灰尘从上面的架子飘落下来。

master:2.en: At the base of the Ascension Stele, I read an old inscription: every disciple who wished to fly had to become the *master* of at least one complete word-formula before setting foot on the upper cloud road. I had learned only half of mine. Shen Wujiu stood beside me, saying nothing, watching the stele's carved letters slowly brighten.
master:2.cnHint: 升天石碑上写着，成为一个完整字诀的____，才能踏上云路。
master:2.hook: The carved letters were not bright when we arrived.
master:2.line: 'To fly, you must first become the *master* of a single true word.'

sentences.en: At the base of the Ascension Stele, I read an old inscription: every disciple who wished to fly had to become the *master* of at least one complete word-formula before setting foot on the upper cloud road.
I had learned only half of mine.
sentences.cn: 我只学会了一半。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood beside me, saying nothing, watching the stele's carved letters slowly brighten.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在我身边，一言不发，看着石碑上的刻字慢慢亮了起来。

newly:2.en: A *newly* placed lantern hung at the entrance to the cloud road, its flame burning silver instead of gold. No such lantern had been there at sunset; I had walked this path twice and was certain. Shen Wujiu read the character painted on its paper shade and went very still. Below us, the sea of clouds began to rise.
newly:2.cnHint: 云路入口挂着一盏____出现的灯笼，火焰是银色的，昨晚还不在那里。
newly:2.hook: Shen Wujiu refused to tell me what the character said.
newly:2.line: 'A *newly* lit silver flame on this road means someone passed through tonight.'

sentences.en: A *newly* placed lantern hung at the entrance to the cloud road, its flame burning silver instead of gold.
No such lantern had been there at sunset; I had walked this path twice and was certain.
sentences.cn: 日落时这里没有这样的灯笼；我走过这条路两次了，很确定。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu read the character painted on its paper shade and went very still.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎读了灯笼纸罩上画的那个字，整个人僵住了。

sentences.en: Below us, the sea of clouds began to rise.
sentences.cn: 我们下方的云海开始升起。

obviously:2.en: I had left my copy of the ascent-formula on the study table before dawn. When I returned, the page was open to a different line — one I had not read. Someone had been here; that was *obviously* true. But the door had been locked from inside, and no footprint marked the dust. Xiaoxing arrived a moment later, carrying a candle and a careful expression.
obviously:2.cnHint: 有人动过我的字诀书页，这____是真的，但房门从里面锁着，地上没有脚印。
obviously:2.hook: Xiaoxing's candle flickered though the air was perfectly still.
obviously:2.line: 'Someone was here — that is *obviously* true, and it is not a small thing.'

sentences.en: I had left my copy of the ascent-formula on the study table before dawn.
sentences.cn: 天亮前我把飞升字诀的副本留在了书桌上。

sentences.en: When I returned, the page was open to a different line — one I had not read.
sentences.cn: 我回来时，那一页打开的是不同的一行——我没有读过的。

sentences.en: Someone had been here; that was *obviously* true.
But the door had been locked from inside, and no footprint marked the dust.
sentences.cn: 但门是从里面锁着的，灰尘上没有留下脚印。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing arrived a moment later, carrying a candle and a careful expression.
sentences.cn: 小杏过了一会儿到来了，手里拿着蜡烛和一副谨慎的表情。

belong:2.en: The sealed jade box had lain in the sect's lower vault for three seasons. When I finally opened it, a folded note inside read: 'This word does not *belong* to any single hand — it must be earned by all four disciples together.' I looked up. The mountain trembled once, softly, like a held breath.
belong:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现一个玉盒，里面的字条说这个词____于全体弟子。
belong:2.hook: Outside, three lanterns lit themselves without wind.
belong:2.line: 'This word does not *belong* to one disciple alone,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

sentences.en: The sealed jade box had lain in the sect's lower vault for three seasons.
sentences.cn: 密封的玉盒在宗派下层密室里放了三个季节。

sentences.en: When I finally opened it, a folded note inside read: 'This word does not *belong* to any single hand — it must be earned by all four disciples together.'
I looked up.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头。

sentences.en: The mountain trembled once, softly, like a held breath.
sentences.cn: 山峰轻轻地颤动了一下，像是屏住的呼吸。

beneficial:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a thin scroll into my hands at the base of the Ascent Steps. 'Read it before dawn,' he said. 'The formula inside is *beneficial* — it opens the upper air to those who have not yet earned wings.' I unrolled the scroll. The ink was still warm.
beneficial:2.cnHint: 师兄给我一卷功法，说其中的修炼方法对飞升____无比。
beneficial:2.hook: At the scroll's final line, a single feather drifted up from the page.
beneficial:2.line: 'Trust me — this method is *beneficial* to every disciple who wants to rise,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a thin scroll into my hands at the base of the Ascent Steps.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在登仙阶梯的底部把一卷薄薄的竹简塞进我的手里。

sentences.en: 'Read it before dawn,' he said.
sentences.cn: "天亮前读完，"他说。

sentences.en: 'The formula inside is *beneficial* — it opens the upper air to those who have not yet earned wings.'
I unrolled the scroll.
sentences.cn: 我展开了竹简。

sentences.en: The ink was still warm.
sentences.cn: 墨迹还是温的。

characteristic:2.en: Xiaoxing found the stone tablet half-buried in cloud moss near the outer cliff. Its carved words glowed faint silver — a *characteristic* of formulas meant only for ascension rites. She called to me without raising her voice, the way one does when something feels too important to disturb.
characteristic:2.cnHint: 师妹发现一块石碑，发着银光——这是专门用于飞升仪式的法诀的____。
characteristic:2.hook: The glow deepened the moment a second disciple touched the stone.
characteristic:2.line: 'That silver light is a *characteristic* of the highest ascension words,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found the stone tablet half-buried in cloud moss near the outer cliff.
sentences.cn: 小杏在外崖附近云苔丛生的地方找到了半埋的石碑。

sentences.en: Its carved words glowed faint silver — a *characteristic* of formulas meant only for ascension rites.
She called to me without raising her voice, the way one does when something feels too important to disturb.
sentences.cn: 她没有抬高嗓音就朝我喊了一声，就像人们在什么事情显得太重要、不忍打扰时的那种方式。

director:2.en: The notice pinned to the Hall of Records named no teacher by rank — only 'the *director* of the Ascent Rite,' a title none of us had heard before. Below the name stood a single instruction: bring the word you fear most and leave it at the cloud gate by midnight.
director:2.cnHint: 告示板上出现了一个神秘职位——飞升典仪的____，要求弟子在午夜前交出最恐惧的字。
director:2.hook: By evening, the notice had rewritten itself in red ink.
director:2.line: 'I am the *director* of this rite, and I will read every word you bring,' the voice announced.

sentences.en: The notice pinned to the Hall of Records named no teacher by rank — only 'the *director* of the Ascent Rite,' a title none of us had heard before.
Below the name stood a single instruction: bring the word you fear most and leave it at the cloud gate by midnight.
sentences.cn: 名字下面写着一条指令：把你最害怕的字带来，在午夜前留在云门。

emerge:2.en: I pressed the carved word against the gate stone as instructed. For a long moment nothing moved. Then light began to *emerge* from the seam between the doors — thin at first, then wide enough to read by. Inside, on a plain wooden stand, rested a single unbound page.
emerge:2.cnHint: 我按指示将刻字压在门石上，光芒开始从门缝中____出来。
emerge:2.hook: The page bore my name written in a hand that was not mine.
emerge:2.line: 'Watch the gate — the true path will *emerge* only when all four words are placed,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: I pressed the carved word against the gate stone as instructed.
sentences.cn: 我按照指令把刻好的字按在门石上。

sentences.en: For a long moment nothing moved.
sentences.cn: 有一阵子什么都没动。

sentences.en: Then light began to *emerge* from the seam between the doors — thin at first, then wide enough to read by.
Inside, on a plain wooden stand, rested a single unbound page.
sentences.cn: 里面的一个朴素木架上，放着一张单独的没有装订的纸页。

exact:2.en: The formula required *exact* placement: four written words set at four corners of the sky-circle, no wider and no narrower than one arm's reach apart. Shen Wujiu measured twice with a knotted cord. When the last word touched the stone, the wind stopped as if cut by a blade.
exact:2.cnHint: 这道法诀要求四个字以____的距离摆放在天圆的四角。
exact:2.hook: In the sudden silence, the clouds below the mountain began to rise.
exact:2.line: 'The *exact* distance matters — a single finger's error and the gate will not open,' Shen Wujiu warned.

sentences.en: The formula required *exact* placement: four written words set at four corners of the sky-circle, no wider and no narrower than one arm's reach apart.
Shen Wujiu measured twice with a knotted cord.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎用一根打过结的绳子量了两遍。

sentences.en: When the last word touched the stone, the wind stopped as if cut by a blade.
sentences.cn: 最后一个字触到石头的时候，风停了，就像被刀子割断了一样。

guest:2.en: A figure waited at the cloud gate, robes the colour of early morning. Master Qingwu introduced her to us in a low voice: 'She is a *guest* of the sect, come to witness the ascension and carry its record back to the far peaks.' The figure bowed and said nothing.
guest:2.cnHint: 一位神秘人物在云门等候，师尊介绍说她是来见证飞升仪式的____。
guest:2.hook: As she turned, her shadow fell upward, not down.
guest:2.line: 'As a *guest* of the Cloud Sea Sect, I have come only to observe and to remember,' she said.

sentences.en: A figure waited at the cloud gate, robes the colour of early morning.
sentences.cn: 一个身影在云门等着，穿的衣服是清晨的颜色。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu introduced her to us in a low voice: 'She is a *guest* of the sect, come to witness the ascension and carry its record back to the far peaks.'
The figure bowed and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 那个身影鞠了一躬，什么都没说。

massive:2.en: Xiaoxing spotted it first — a *massive* word carved into the underside of the floating peak, invisible from below unless you leaned past the cloud line. Each stroke was as tall as a grown person. Shen Wujiu went pale. 'That word has not been read aloud in three hundred years,' he said.
massive:2.cnHint: 师妹发现飞峰底部刻有一个____的字，每一笔都高如成人。
massive:2.hook: A low tone, like a bell struck underground, rose slowly through the stone.
massive:2.line: 'That *massive* inscription was sealed for a reason — do not speak it yet,' Master Qingwu said firmly.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spotted it first — a *massive* word carved into the underside of the floating peak, invisible from below unless you leaned past the cloud line.
Each stroke was as tall as a grown person.
sentences.cn: 每一笔都有成年人那么高。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu went pale.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎脸色苍白了。

sentences.en: 'That word has not been read aloud in three hundred years,' he said.
sentences.cn: "那个字已经三百年没有人读过了，"他说。

mix:2.en: In the archive chamber carved into the mountain's heart, I found a jade scroll describing the *mix* of three rare word-herbs: one for wind, one for stone, one whose name I could not yet read. Each herb alone was weak. Together, Master Qingwu had written, they could lift a body clear off the peak.
mix:2.cnHint: 我在山腹档案室发现一卷玉简，记载了三种灵草的____方法，据说合用能令人飞离山顶。
mix:2.hook: The third herb's name pulsed once, then faded from the page.
mix:2.line: 'This *mix* of wind and stone is the oldest formula our sect holds,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: In the archive chamber carved into the mountain's heart, I found a jade scroll describing the *mix* of three rare word-herbs: one for wind, one for stone, one whose name I could not yet read.
Each herb alone was weak.
sentences.cn: 每种草药单独使用都很虚弱。

sentences.en: Together, Master Qingwu had written, they could lift a body clear off the peak.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊写过，它们合在一起能让一个身体从山峰上直接飞起来。

necessity:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a narrow stone shelf above the cloud line, where a single word-herb grew in a crack. 'Disciples debate whether courage or skill matters most,' he said quietly. 'But up here, only one thing keeps you alive.' He pointed to the herb. Its name meant *necessity*.
necessity:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到云线上方的岩架，指着一株灵草说，在此处生存只有____才是关键。
necessity:2.hook: Below us, the clouds shifted and revealed nothing but open sky.
necessity:2.line: '*Necessity* teaches faster than any lesson Master Qingwu can give,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a narrow stone shelf above the cloud line, where a single word-herb grew in a crack.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我到云线上方的一个狭窄石架，那里一道裂缝里长着一株灵字草。

sentences.en: 'Disciples debate whether courage or skill matters most,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "弟子们争论勇气和技巧哪个更重要，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: 'But up here, only one thing keeps you alive.'
sentences.cn: "但在这里，只有一件事能让你活着。"

sentences.en: He pointed to the herb.
sentences.cn: 他指向那株草。

sentences.en: Its name meant *necessity*.

stuff:2.en: Xiaoxing spread her collected word-herbs across a flat rock and sorted them by color and weight. 'Half of these are the *stuff* that healing formulas are built from,' she told me, 'and the other half I have no name for yet.' She picked up one pale leaf and held it toward the light.
stuff:2.cnHint: 小星将采来的灵草铺开分类，说其中一半是疗愈法诀的____，另一半她还不认识。
stuff:2.hook: The pale leaf hummed once, then went completely still.
stuff:2.line: 'Light *stuff* like this can still carry the heaviest kind of power,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread her collected word-herbs across a flat rock and sorted them by color and weight.
sentences.cn: 小杏把收集的灵字草摊开在一块平石上，按颜色和重量分类。

sentences.en: 'Half of these are the *stuff* that healing formulas are built from,' she told me, 'and the other half I have no name for yet.'
She picked up one pale leaf and held it toward the light.
sentences.cn: 她拿起一片淡色的叶子，举向光线。

translate:2.en: I carried Master Qingwu's old scroll to the peak library and set it beside the newer texts. The ancient characters did not match any word I knew. My task was to *translate* each line into the sect's current language before the next new moon — or the formula would be lost for another century.
translate:2.cnHint: 我奉命将师尊的古老卷轴____成本门现用的文字，否则法诀将再沉寂百年。
translate:2.hook: The final line of the scroll seemed to rewrite itself as I watched.
translate:2.line: 'Can you *translate* the third seal before the clouds rise?' Master Qingwu asked quietly.

sentences.en: I carried Master Qingwu's old scroll to the peak library and set it beside the newer texts.
sentences.cn: 我把青梧师尊的旧竹简带到山峰图书室，放在较新的文献旁边。

sentences.en: The ancient characters did not match any word I knew.
sentences.cn: 古老的篆字不符合我认识的任何词汇。

sentences.en: My task was to *translate* each line into the sect's current language before the next new moon — or the formula would be lost for another century.

wander:2.en: The archive map showed seven reading rooms, but I found an eighth behind a curtain of hanging moss. It had no label. Disciples who *wander* beyond the marked paths, a small notice on the wall read, do so at their own instruction. The shelves inside held scrolls with no titles at all.
wander:2.cnHint: 我在档案室迷路，发现了地图上没有标注的第八室，里面的卷轴都没有名字。
wander:2.hook: One scroll unrolled itself, just slightly, as if it had been waiting.
wander:2.line: 'Those who *wander* here without a guide rarely leave with what they came for,' the notice read.

sentences.en: The archive map showed seven reading rooms, but I found an eighth behind a curtain of hanging moss.
sentences.cn: 档案地图显示有七间藏书室，但我在一道苔藓帘子后面找到了第八间。

sentences.en: It had no label.
sentences.cn: 它没有标签。

sentences.en: Disciples who *wander* beyond the marked paths, a small notice on the wall read, do so at their own instruction.
The shelves inside held scrolls with no titles at all.
sentences.cn: 架子上放着没有标题的卷轴。

warn:2.en: Shen Wujiu found me reading a sealed word-formula near the mountain's edge. He set a firm hand on my shoulder. 'I have to *warn* you,' he said, keeping his voice low and even. 'That formula has no safe ending written in it. Someone removed the last line on purpose.' He folded the scroll closed.
warn:2.cnHint: 师兄发现我在山崖边研读一卷封印法诀，郑重地____我说那法诀被人删去了结尾。
warn:2.hook: Where the last line had been, the paper was faintly warm.
warn:2.line: 'I *warn* every new disciple once — read the seal date before you open anything here,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu found me reading a sealed word-formula near the mountain's edge.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎发现我在山边读一道封印的字诀。

sentences.en: He set a firm hand on my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 他稳稳地把手按在我肩上。

sentences.en: 'I have to *warn* you,' he said, keeping his voice low and even.
'That formula has no safe ending written in it.
sentences.cn: '那道字诀没有安全的结局。

sentences.en: Someone removed the last line on purpose.'
sentences.cn: 有人故意把最后一行删掉了。'

sentences.en: He folded the scroll closed.
sentences.cn: 他合上了卷轴。

advocate:2.en: A carved stone near the gate listed the names of past disciples who had shaped the sect's teaching. Beside one name was a small mark meaning teacher-of-teachers. Master Qingwu had told me this disciple was the greatest *advocate* for writing word-formulas down rather than passing them only by voice.
advocate:2.cnHint: 石碑上记载着一位被称为"师之师"的前辈，他是将法诀____以文字记录而非口传的最大倡导者。
advocate:2.hook: That disciple's name had been partly worn away, as though someone had tried to erase it.
advocate:2.line: 'Be an *advocate* for the written word,' Master Qingwu said, 'before the spoken one fades.'

sentences.en: A carved stone near the gate listed the names of past disciples who had shaped the sect's teaching.
sentences.cn: 山门附近的石碑上刻着过去那些塑造宗派教义的弟子的名字。

sentences.en: Beside one name was a small mark meaning teacher-of-teachers.
sentences.cn: 其中一个名字旁边有个小记号，表示师中之师。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had told me this disciple was the greatest *advocate* for writing word-formulas down rather than passing them only by voice.

cite:2.en: In my first formal lesson, Master Qingwu asked me to explain why wind-words required an open hand. I gave my answer, then added the name of an elder text I had read the night before. 'Good,' she said. 'You *cite* your source. That tells me you did not simply guess.' She made a small mark in her record book.
cite:2.cnHint: 在第一堂正式课上，我回答问题后引用了一部古籍，师尊说能____出处证明我不是在猜测。
cite:2.hook: The mark she made in the book glowed for just a moment before it settled into ink.
cite:2.line: 'Always *cite* the text you learned from — a formula without a source is just a rumor,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: In my first formal lesson, Master Qingwu asked me to explain why wind-words required an open hand.
sentences.cn: 在我第一堂正式课上，青梧师尊问我为什么风之词需要张开的手掌。

sentences.en: I gave my answer, then added the name of an elder text I had read the night before.
sentences.cn: 我给出了答案，还补充了一本我前一晚读过的古籍的名字。

sentences.en: 'Good,' she said.
sentences.cn: 她说，"很好。"

sentences.en: 'You *cite* your source.
That tells me you did not simply guess.'
sentences.cn: 那告诉我你不是单纯地猜测。

sentences.en: She made a small mark in her record book.
sentences.cn: 她在记录簿上做了个小记号。

content:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a folded note into my hand without a word. Inside, three ancient characters glowed faintly — a gift of the Word for 'sky.' I traced each stroke until the meaning settled in my chest like warm tea, and I felt *content*, needing nothing more. Then the glow turned cold.
content:2.cnHint: 小星悄悄递给我一张字条，我研读其中的天字真言，感到深深的____，直到字迹骤然变冷。
content:2.hook: The warmth in my chest turned to ice without warning.
content:2.line: 'I am *content* with three words — they are enough to lift me above the clouds.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed a folded note into my hand without a word.
sentences.cn: 小杏默不作声地把一张折叠的纸条塞进我手里。

sentences.en: Inside, three ancient characters glowed faintly — a gift of the Word for 'sky.'
sentences.cn: 里面三个古字微微发光——这是'天'这个字的礼物。

sentences.en: I traced each stroke until the meaning settled in my chest like warm tea, and I felt *content*, needing nothing more.
Then the glow turned cold.
sentences.cn: 然后光变冷了。

divide:2.en: Master Qingwu drew a single line of ink across the stone floor of the archive hall. 'This mark,' she said quietly, 'will *divide* the words of healing from the words of force. Cross it without permission and the mountain itself will answer.' A crack opened in the ceiling above the line.
divide:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊在档案堂石地上画了一道线，说这道线____着治愈之言与力量之言，话音未落，天花板裂开了。
divide:2.hook: Stone dust fell as the ceiling crack spread toward the door.
divide:2.line: 'Let this line *divide* what heals from what harms — never forget which side you stand on.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a single line of ink across the stone floor of the archive hall.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在档案厅的石地板上用墨画了一条直线。

sentences.en: 'This mark,' she said quietly, 'will *divide* the words of healing from the words of force.
Cross it without permission and the mountain itself will answer.'
sentences.cn: 没有允许就跨过它，山本身会回应。'

sentences.en: A crack opened in the ceiling above the line.
sentences.cn: 这条线上方的天花板裂开了。

generate:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a hollow jade tube and told me to breathe a chosen word into it three times. On the third breath the tube began to *generate* a thin, silver mist that curled upward and took the shape of a crane. The crane looked directly at me, then dissolved.
generate:2.cnHint: 沈无咎让我对玉管吹入一个词，第三口气后，玉管开始____出银雾，化作仙鹤，随即消散。
generate:2.hook: No one in the sect had seen that particular crane shape before.
generate:2.line: 'One spoken word can *generate* enough force to carry you across the cloud sea.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a hollow jade tube and told me to breathe a chosen word into it three times.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一根空心的玉管，叫我把选中的一个字吹进去三次。

sentences.en: On the third breath the tube began to *generate* a thin, silver mist that curled upward and took the shape of a crane.
The crane looked directly at me, then dissolved.
sentences.cn: 鹤鹤直直看着我，然后消散了。

operate:2.en: The old loom in the archive hall had not moved in a hundred years, yet the scroll beside it said a disciple who knew the Word for 'wind' could *operate* it alone. I whispered the word. The shuttle flew. It wove my name into the cloth before stopping dead.
operate:2.cnHint: 档案堂旧织机百年未动，传说懂得风字真言的弟子能独自____它，我低语之后，它将我的名字织入布中。
operate:2.hook: My name in the cloth was already beginning to fade.
operate:2.line: 'To *operate* this loom, you must first let the word move through you, not the other way around.'

sentences.en: The old loom in the archive hall had not moved in a hundred years, yet the scroll beside it said a disciple who knew the Word for 'wind' could *operate* it alone.
I whispered the word.
sentences.cn: 我低声说出了那个字。

sentences.en: The shuttle flew.
sentences.cn: 梭子飞了。

sentences.en: It wove my name into the cloth before stopping dead.
sentences.cn: 它把我的名字织进布料里，然后突然停下。

properly:2.en: Xiaoxing watched me copy the Word for 'root' and shook her head. 'You have not *properly* traced the third stroke,' she said, guiding my brush back. When I drew it correctly the character lifted off the page, hung in the air a moment, and sank silently into the stone.
properly:2.cnHint: 小星纠正我，说我没有____临摹第三笔，改正之后，字迹竟从纸上浮起，沉入石中。
properly:2.hook: The stone where the character sank began to hum softly.
properly:2.line: '*Properly* written, even one word holds the weight of the whole mountain.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing watched me copy the Word for 'root' and shook her head.
sentences.cn: 小杏看我描写'根'这个字，摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'You have not *properly* traced the third stroke,' she said, guiding my brush back.
When I drew it correctly the character lifted off the page, hung in the air a moment, and sank silently into the stone.
sentences.cn: 我正确地画出来时，这个字从纸上浮起，在空中悬停了一会儿，无声地沉入了石头。

render:2.en: I found a sealed jar on the highest shelf of the archive hall. The label read: 'Word of fog — *render* the path invisible.' I lifted the lid only a crack. A pale mist poured out and swallowed the entire corridor in seconds, leaving me with no walls, no floor, no sky.
render:2.cnHint: 我在档案堂顶架上找到封印之罐，标签说雾之真言能____道路于无形，我稍一开盖，整条走廊瞬间消失。
render:2.hook: Somewhere in the white silence, footsteps moved closer.
render:2.line: 'One careless word can *render* the clearest path into empty nothing.'

sentences.en: I found a sealed jar on the highest shelf of the archive hall.
sentences.cn: 我在档案厅最高的架子上找到一个密封的罐子。

sentences.en: The label read: 'Word of fog — *render* the path invisible.'
I lifted the lid only a crack.
sentences.cn: 我只打开了一条缝。

sentences.en: A pale mist poured out and swallowed the entire corridor in seconds, leaving me with no walls, no floor, no sky.
sentences.cn: 一股苍白的雾气倾泻而出，在几秒钟内吞没了整条走廊，留下我什么都看不到——没有墙，没有地板，没有天空。

resolve:2.en: Shen Wujiu sat very still at the edge of the cloud-viewing ledge, a worn scroll across his knees. 'Every disciple reaches a night when doubt is louder than training,' he said. 'What carries you through is *resolve* — a decision made before the doubt arrives.' Below us, something large moved inside the clouds.
resolve:2.cnHint: 沈无咎告诉我，每个弟子都会经历怀疑压过修炼的夜晚，真正支撑你走过去的是____，是提前做好的决定。
resolve:2.hook: The movement in the clouds below us rose, slow and deliberate.
resolve:2.line: 'Write your *resolve* into the word before you speak it — or the word will speak for itself.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu sat very still at the edge of the cloud-viewing ledge, a worn scroll across his knees.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎静静地坐在观云台的边缘，一卷破旧的卷轴放在膝盖上。

sentences.en: 'Every disciple reaches a night when doubt is louder than training,' he said.
sentences.cn: '每个弟子都会经历一个夜晚，怀疑的声音比训练还要响，'他说。

sentences.en: 'What carries you through is *resolve* — a decision made before the doubt arrives.'
Below us, something large moved inside the clouds.
sentences.cn: 我们下方，什么大东西在云里动了。

seemingly:2.en: Master Qingwu left a *seemingly* ordinary stone on my desk — grey, round, light as a feather. Yet when I picked it up, every Word I had ever learned rose in my mind at once, clear and loud, as if the stone had been listening to every lesson. I set it down and the words went silent.
seemingly:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊在我桌上留了一块____普通的石头，但我一拿起它，学过的所有真言便同时在脑中响起。
seemingly:2.hook: When I reached for the stone a second time, it was gone.
seemingly:2.line: 'A *seemingly* simple object can hold more memory than a whole hall of scrolls.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu left a *seemingly* ordinary stone on my desk — grey, round, light as a feather.
Yet when I picked it up, every Word I had ever learned rose in my mind at once, clear and loud, as if the stone had been listening to every lesson.
sentences.cn: 可是当我拿起它时，我学过的每一个字都一下子涌入我的脑海，清晰而响亮，好像这块石头一直在听每一堂课。

sentences.en: I set it down and the words went silent.
sentences.cn: 我把它放下，那些字就沉默了。

therefore:2.en: The sealed scroll had been silent for three seasons. I pressed my palm to its surface and felt a faint pulse — the word inside was ready to wake. Master Qingwu had warned me: a word that chooses its moment is *therefore* more dangerous than one you call yourself. I lifted the seal anyway.
therefore:2.cnHint: 封存的卷轴终于有了回应，师尊曾警告我，自行醒来的词语____更难驾驭。
therefore:2.hook: The scroll unrolled on its own, and the last line was addressed to me.
therefore:2.line: 'A word that wakes alone is *therefore* one you must approach with both hands open.'

sentences.en: The sealed scroll had been silent for three seasons.
sentences.cn: 那卷密封的纸条已经沉默了三个季节。

sentences.en: I pressed my palm to its surface and felt a faint pulse — the word inside was ready to wake.
sentences.cn: 我把掌心贴在它的表面，感受到一阵微弱的脉动——里面的字准备苏醒了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had warned me: a word that chooses its moment is *therefore* more dangerous than one you call yourself.
I lifted the seal anyway.
sentences.cn: 我还是揭开了封印。

truth:2.en: Deep in the archive cave, I found a stone tablet no one had dusted in years. The characters carved there were not spells but statements — plain, hard facts about the Cloud Sea Sect's founding. Xiaoxing had told me stories. The tablet told me *truth*, and the two did not match.
truth:2.cnHint: 石碑上刻着的不是咒语，而是关于本门起源的____，与师妹讲的故事并不相符。
truth:2.hook: One name on the tablet had been chiseled away, and the chisel marks were fresh.
truth:2.line: 'I came here for a formula, but I found *truth* instead — and it is heavier than any spell.'

sentences.en: Deep in the archive cave, I found a stone tablet no one had dusted in years.
sentences.cn: 深入档案洞窟，我发现了一块多年没人擦拭过的石碑。

sentences.en: The characters carved there were not spells but statements — plain, hard facts about the Cloud Sea Sect's founding.
sentences.cn: 刻在上面的不是咒语，而是陈述——关于云海宗建立的赤裸裸的事实。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had told me stories.
sentences.cn: 小杏曾经给我讲过故事。

sentences.en: The tablet told me *truth*, and the two did not match.

protein:2.en: Shen Wujiu slid a small jade case across the stone table. Inside lay a single dried seed, pale and dense. 'Every advanced formula draws on body and mind alike,' he said. 'This seed holds pure *protein*, the kind that feeds a disciple's spirit-core before a long ascent.' I swallowed it without water.
protein:2.cnHint: 师兄给了我一粒储有____的种子，说修炼飞升前必须以此滋养灵核。
protein:2.hook: The warmth that followed moved not to my stomach but straight to my hands.
protein:2.line: 'Pure *protein* from a cloud-root seed — eat it before you attempt the upper wind.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu slid a small jade case across the stone table.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把一个小玉盒推过石桌。

sentences.en: Inside lay a single dried seed, pale and dense.
sentences.cn: 盒子里躺着一粒干种子，苍白而沉实。

sentences.en: 'Every advanced formula draws on body and mind alike,' he said.
sentences.cn: "任何高阶配方都需要身心兼修，"他说。

sentences.en: 'This seed holds pure *protein*, the kind that feeds a disciple's spirit-core before a long ascent.'
I swallowed it without water.
sentences.cn: 我没喝水，直接吞了下去。

traffic:2.en: On the bridge between the second and third peaks, I stopped. Below, the usual *traffic* of junior disciples carrying herb baskets had vanished. The bridge was empty in both directions, and the air smelled of lightning though the sky was clear.
traffic:2.cnHint: 连接两峰的石桥上，往日川流不息的弟子____消失得无影无踪。
traffic:2.hook: A single basket lay on its side, herbs still fresh, owner nowhere to be seen.
traffic:2.line: 'There is no *traffic* on the bridge today — that alone tells you something is wrong.'

sentences.en: On the bridge between the second and third peaks, I stopped.
sentences.cn: 在第二峰和第三峰之间的桥上，我停下了脚步。

sentences.en: Below, the usual *traffic* of junior disciples carrying herb baskets had vanished.
The bridge was empty in both directions, and the air smelled of lightning though the sky was clear.
sentences.cn: 桥在两个方向都空荡荡的，空气里闻起来有闪电的味道，可天空晴朗得很。

cat:2.en: Tucked behind the medicine shelf, a small stone figure caught my eye: a *cat*, carved from pale green jade, seated with one paw raised. A thin paper strip was tied to its neck. The strip held three words in Master Qingwu's hand — not a greeting but a warning I did not yet understand.
cat:2.cnHint: 药架后藏着一只玉制____雕像，脖子上系着一张写有师尊警告的纸条。
cat:2.hook: When I reached for the paper, the raised paw of the figure slowly turned toward the door.
cat:2.line: 'Leave the jade *cat* where it sits — moving it opens something we are not ready for.'

sentences.en: Tucked behind the medicine shelf, a small stone figure caught my eye: a *cat*, carved from pale green jade, seated with one paw raised.
A thin paper strip was tied to its neck.
sentences.cn: 一条薄纸片被绑在它的脖子上。

sentences.en: The strip held three words in Master Qingwu's hand — not a greeting but a warning I did not yet understand.
sentences.cn: 纸片上用青梧师尊的笔迹写了三个字——不是问候，而是我还没有理解的警告。

sugar:2.en: The formula called for seven herbs and one sweetener. Xiaoxing read aloud from her notes: 'Add cloud-blossom *sugar* last, or the word you are brewing will turn bitter and refuse to rise.' I added it last. The mixture glowed a soft gold — and then, without warning, went dark.
sugar:2.cnHint: 配方要求最后加入____，否则炼制的词语会变苦而无法升华，但混合物还是突然暗了下去。
sugar:2.hook: Xiaoxing's notes had one more line, written in a different hand entirely.
sugar:2.line: 'Cloud-blossom *sugar* is the kindness you add to a harsh word — never skip it.'

sentences.en: The formula called for seven herbs and one sweetener.
sentences.cn: 配方需要七种草药和一种甜味剂。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing read aloud from her notes: 'Add cloud-blossom *sugar* last, or the word you are brewing will turn bitter and refuse to rise.'
I added it last.
sentences.cn: 我最后加的。

sentences.en: The mixture glowed a soft gold — and then, without warning, went dark.
sentences.cn: 混合物闪出柔和的金光——然后，没有任何预兆地变黑了。

balance:2.en: The ascent platform was a single flat stone no wider than my arms could reach. Master Qingwu told me to stand at the center and *balance* the word 'rise' on my breath — too much force and it would scatter; too little and I would fall. I found the midpoint. The stone trembled.
balance:2.cnHint: 师尊要我站在升台正中，用气息____住'升'这个词，力道过重或过轻都会失败。
balance:2.hook: The stone held still for one breath, then rose three inches off the mountain.
balance:2.line: 'To *balance* a flying word, you must first be still enough to hear your own heartbeat.'

sentences.en: The ascent platform was a single flat stone no wider than my arms could reach.
sentences.cn: 渡劫台是一块单独的石头，宽度不超过我双臂能够触及的范围。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told me to stand at the center and *balance* the word 'rise' on my breath — too much force and it would scatter; too little and I would fall.
I found the midpoint.
sentences.cn: 我找到了平衡点。

sentences.en: The stone trembled.
sentences.cn: 石头开始颤动。

baby:2.en: In the records room I found my own entry, written the day I arrived: age, origin, spirit-root grade. At the bottom, in small letters, someone had added a private note: 'A *baby* step into the clouds is still a step.' The ink was older than the rest of the page, as if written before I was even born.
baby:2.cnHint: 入门档案的末尾，有人用旧墨写下一句关于____步伐的私语，墨迹比整页记录都要古老。
baby:2.hook: The handwriting matched no master I had ever met — but it matched mine.
baby:2.line: 'Every great flier took a *baby* step first — do not be ashamed of where you stand.'

sentences.en: In the records room I found my own entry, written the day I arrived: age, origin, spirit-root grade.
sentences.cn: 在档案室我找到了自己的条目，写于我到来的那天：年纪、出身、灵根品阶。

sentences.en: At the bottom, in small letters, someone had added a private note: 'A *baby* step into the clouds is still a step.'
The ink was older than the rest of the page, as if written before I was even born.
sentences.cn: 笔迹比页面其余部分更陈旧，仿佛在我出生前就写好了。

store:2.en: Deep in the sect's inner hall, I found a *store* of forgotten word-scrolls stacked behind a stone door no one had opened in years. Each scroll held a healing formula, dry and waiting like seeds before rain. Shen Wujiu said the old disciples had sealed them away during a great storm. I counted twelve. Then I counted eleven.
store:2.cnHint: 我在内殿深处发现了一批被遗忘已久的____，取出时却发现数目少了一卷。
store:2.hook: One scroll was gone, and the stone door had no dust on its handle.
store:2.line: 'This *store* of scrolls was sealed by our founders — touch nothing until Master Qingwu arrives.'

sentences.en: Deep in the sect's inner hall, I found a *store* of forgotten word-scrolls stacked behind a stone door no one had opened in years.
Each scroll held a healing formula, dry and waiting like seeds before rain.
sentences.cn: 每卷都藏着一个治愈的配方，干枯而沉寂，像暴雨前的种子。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said the old disciples had sealed them away during a great storm.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说老一代弟子在一场大风暴中把它们封存了起来。

sentences.en: I counted twelve.
sentences.cn: 我数了一遍，十二卷。

sentences.en: Then I counted eleven.
sentences.cn: 然后我又数了一遍，十一卷。

budget:2.en: Master Qingwu spread a worn ledger across the altar stone and showed us the sect's yearly *budget* for spiritual herbs — enough for forty word-seeds, no more. Xiaoxing traced the numbers with one careful finger. Outside, the cloud-sea shifted, and three herbs we had already planted turned grey before sunset.
budget:2.cnHint: 师尊展示了门派的草药____，但当晚种下的灵草无故枯萎了三株。
budget:2.hook: The numbers balanced perfectly, yet something vital was already missing.
budget:2.line: 'Our *budget* for rare herbs is fixed — every wasted seed is a word we cannot speak.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu spread a worn ledger across the altar stone and showed us the sect's yearly *budget* for spiritual herbs — enough for forty word-seeds, no more.
Xiaoxing traced the numbers with one careful finger.
sentences.cn: 小杏用一根谨慎的手指描过那些数字。

sentences.en: Outside, the cloud-sea shifted, and three herbs we had already planted turned grey before sunset.
sentences.cn: 在外面，云海翻滚，我们已经种下的三株草药在日落前就变灰了。

grant:2.en: The sect elders gathered at dawn and, after long silence, offered to *grant* me a single sky-passage token — permission to climb to the highest peak where living word-flowers grew. Shen Wujiu squeezed my shoulder once and said nothing. I bowed and accepted. A cold wind rose the moment the token touched my palm.
grant:2.cnHint: 长老们决定____我一枚通行令牌，我接过的瞬间，山风骤然变冷。
grant:2.hook: The token was warm when they held it, and ice-cold the moment it reached me.
grant:2.line: 'We *grant* this passage to you alone — return before the cloud-sea rises at dusk.'

sentences.en: The sect elders gathered at dawn and, after long silence, offered to *grant* me a single sky-passage token — permission to climb to the highest peak where living word-flowers grew.
Shen Wujiu squeezed my shoulder once and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎轻轻握了一下我的肩膀，什么都没说。

sentences.en: I bowed and accepted.
sentences.cn: 我行礼接受了。

sentences.en: A cold wind rose the moment the token touched my palm.
sentences.cn: 令牌触到我掌心的瞬间，一阵寒风吹起来了。

hospital:2.en: In the old records I found a drawing of the Healing Pavilion, which the text called a *hospital* of words — a place where sick disciples came to hear formulas read aloud until their breath steadied. It had stood on the east cliff for three hundred years. I looked east. The cliff held only empty air and a ring of dead flowers.
hospital:2.cnHint: 古籍中记载着一座以词语为药的____，但我抬头望去，那处山崖已空无一物。
hospital:2.hook: Three hundred years of healing, and not one stone remained to show it.
hospital:2.line: 'Every great sect once kept a *hospital* of words — ours was lost the night the east cliff fell.'

sentences.en: In the old records I found a drawing of the Healing Pavilion, which the text called a *hospital* of words — a place where sick disciples came to hear formulas read aloud until their breath steadied.
It had stood on the east cliff for three hundred years.
sentences.cn: 它在东悬崖上屹立了三百年。

sentences.en: I looked east.
sentences.cn: 我朝东看去。

sentences.en: The cliff held only empty air and a ring of dead flowers.
sentences.cn: 悬崖上只有空荡荡的空气和一圈枯死的花。

island:2.en: Among the floating peaks, one stood fully alone, cut off from all rope-bridges — a true *island* of stone above the cloud-sea. Xiaoxing pointed to it at midday and said a single word-tree grew there, its roots gripping bare rock. By evening the peak had drifted closer. No wind had blown all day.
island:2.cnHint: 云海之上有一座孤悬的浮峰____，傍晚时它在无风之中悄悄靠近了。
island:2.hook: It moved without wind, without sound, and its roots glowed faintly in the dusk.
island:2.line: 'That *island* of stone has no bridge and no path — yet someone has been tending the tree on it.'
