sentences.en: Inside, written in silver ink, was an offer: the Cloud Market below the eastern peak wished to *hire* a disciple who could speak the word for wind.
Master Qingwu set the letter on the table without a word and watched my face.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把信放在桌上，没有说一句话，只是看着我的脸。

aid:2.en: Shen Wujiu had been studying the ascent formula for three days without sleep. I found him slumped over his scroll at dawn. I set a warm stone tablet beside him — a focus herb pressed flat — and let the word for clarity rise softly from my lips. That small *aid* was all he needed.
aid:2.cnHint: 师兄连续苦读三天，我用一块草药石片给予了他小小的____。
aid:2.hook: He woke with a word on his lips that was not in any scroll.
aid:2.line: 'Your *aid* kept the formula from slipping away,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu had been studying the ascent formula for three days without sleep.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎已经三天没睡觉，一直在研究上升公式。

sentences.en: I found him slumped over his scroll at dawn.
sentences.cn: 我在黎明时分发现他瘫倒在卷轴上。

sentences.en: I set a warm stone tablet beside him — a focus herb pressed flat — and let the word for clarity rise softly from my lips.
sentences.cn: 我在他身旁放了一块温热的石板——一片压扁的聚焦草药——然后让清晰的字从我的唇间轻轻升起。

sentences.en: That small *aid* was all he needed.

bill:2.en: After the monthly supply run, Master Qingwu spread a long paper across the courtyard table. It was the Sect's *bill* for spiritual materials: cloud-moss, echo-root, and three jars of still-water ink. Each item carried a word-cost, not a coin-cost. I had not known words could be spent like money.
bill:2.cnHint: 师尊展开了一张记录灵材消耗的____，我才知道字咒也可以像钱一样被花掉。
bill:2.hook: My own name appeared at the bottom, beside a debt I had not made.
bill:2.line: 'Read the *bill* carefully,' Master Qingwu said, 'every word you waste is written here.'

sentences.en: After the monthly supply run, Master Qingwu spread a long paper across the courtyard table.
sentences.cn: 月度物资补给后，青梧师尊在院子的桌上铺开了一张长纸。

sentences.en: It was the Sect's *bill* for spiritual materials: cloud-moss, echo-root, and three jars of still-water ink.
Each item carried a word-cost, not a coin-cost.
sentences.cn: 每一项都标着字的代价，而不是硬币。

sentences.en: I had not known words could be spent like money.
sentences.cn: 我从未想过字可以像钱一样被花费。

paint:2.en: Xiaoxing discovered an old mural behind the waterfall on the third peak. Someone had used sky-blue mineral dust to *paint* the full path of ascent — every word, every step — across the stone in letters taller than a person. The image was faded but whole. We stood in silence for a long time.
paint:2.cnHint: 小星在瀑布后发现了一幅用蓝色矿粉____出的飞升路径壁画，字字清晰。
paint:2.hook: The final word at the mural's peak had been deliberately scratched away.
paint:2.line: 'Someone took great care to *paint* this,' Xiaoxing said, 'and greater care to hide it.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing discovered an old mural behind the waterfall on the third peak.
sentences.cn: 小杏在第三座山峰的瀑布后面发现了一幅古老的壁画。

sentences.en: Someone had used sky-blue mineral dust to *paint* the full path of ascent — every word, every step — across the stone in letters taller than a person.
The image was faded but whole.
sentences.cn: 画面褪色但完整。

sentences.en: We stood in silence for a long time.
sentences.cn: 我们沉默地站了很久。

bean:2.en: In the lower garden I was set to sort the season's harvest: cloud-pepper, sky-mint, and a small pouch of pale *bean*, each one carrying a faint hum of stored sound. Shen Wujiu told me the humming meant a word had been sealed inside during growth. I held one to my ear and heard something very close to flight.
bean:2.cnHint: 我在花园整理收成时，捡到一颗嗡嗡作响的____，据说里面封印着一个字咒。
bean:2.hook: The sound inside the bean changed when I thought of leaving.
bean:2.line: 'Every *bean* from this row holds a different word,' Shen Wujiu said with a small smile.

sentences.en: In the lower garden I was set to sort the season's harvest: cloud-pepper, sky-mint, and a small pouch of pale *bean*, each one carrying a faint hum of stored sound.
Shen Wujiu told me the humming meant a word had been sealed inside during growth.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎告诉我，嗡嗡声意味着在生长期间有一个字被封在了里面。

sentences.en: I held one to my ear and heard something very close to flight.
sentences.cn: 我把其中一个放到耳边，听到了很接近飞行的声音。

birthday:2.en: No one marks *birthday* celebrations in the Cloud Sea Sect — the masters say the day you first speak a living word is your true beginning. Still, Xiaoxing left a single white flower on my window-stone this morning, and somehow that felt like being known. Outside, the clouds below were unusually still.
birthday:2.cnHint: 云海宗不庆祝____，但小星还是在我窗台留下了一朵白花。
birthday:2.hook: By evening the white flower had turned the pale gold of a word about to be spoken.
birthday:2.line: 'We don't mark the *birthday* of the body here,' Xiaoxing said softly, 'only the birth of the word.'

sentences.en: No one marks *birthday* celebrations in the Cloud Sea Sect — the masters say the day you first speak a living word is your true beginning.
Still, Xiaoxing left a single white flower on my window-stone this morning, and somehow that felt like being known.
sentences.cn: 不过，小杏今天早上在我的窗石上留下了一朵白花，不知怎的，那感觉像是被人了解了。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds below were unusually still.
sentences.cn: 外面，云海下面的云彩异常静止。

flight:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled the oldest scroll in the teaching hall and pointed to a single character at the center. Around it, in fading ink, thirty lesser words formed a ring. 'Each one of these supports *flight*,' she said, 'remove any one and the ascent fails.' I counted the words I already knew. I was missing seven.
flight:2.cnHint: 师尊指着古卷中心的飞字，说明周围三十个字如何支撑着____，我数了数自己还差七个。
flight:2.hook: The seventh missing word began to appear, faintly, on the back of my own hand.
flight:2.line: 'True *flight* is not one word,' Master Qingwu said, 'it is thirty words trusting each other.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled the oldest scroll in the teaching hall and pointed to a single character at the center.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在教学厅里展开了最古老的卷轴，指向中央的一个字。

sentences.en: Around it, in fading ink, thirty lesser words formed a ring.
sentences.cn: 在它周围，用褪色的墨迹，三十个较小的字围成了一圈。

sentences.en: 'Each one of these supports *flight*,' she said, 'remove any one and the ascent fails.'
I counted the words I already knew.
sentences.cn: 我数了数我已经知道的字。

sentences.en: I was missing seven.
sentences.cn: 我还缺七个。

housing:2.en: Deep within the sect's archive tower, I unrolled an ancient map. It showed the *housing* of a hundred disciples arranged across seven floating peaks, each dwelling marked with a spirit-flame glyph. Master Qingwu had sent me here alone to find the forgotten Ninth Peak, erased from all newer records.
housing:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现了一张古老地图，标注着弟子们的____分布与第九峰的秘密。
housing:2.hook: The Ninth Peak's glyph still burned, faint but alive.
housing:2.line: 'The *housing* on that peak was sealed after the last great storm,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Deep within the sect's archive tower, I unrolled an ancient map.
sentences.cn: 在宗派档案塔的深处，我展开了一张古老的地图。

sentences.en: It showed the *housing* of a hundred disciples arranged across seven floating peaks, each dwelling marked with a spirit-flame glyph.
Master Qingwu had sent me here alone to find the forgotten Ninth Peak, erased from all newer records.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊独自派我来这里寻找被遗忘的第九座山峰，它在所有较新的记录中都被抹去了。

behaviour:2.en: Shen Wujiu called me to the bamboo bridge at dawn. He had been watching a cloud-deer pace the same narrow ledge for three days without eating. 'Strange *behaviour* in a spirit beast means the mountain is trying to speak,' he said, pressing a smooth stone into my hand.
behaviour:2.cnHint: 师兄观察到一只灵鹿异常的____，认为这是山峰传递的信号。
behaviour:2.hook: The stone grew warm the moment the deer stopped moving.
behaviour:2.line: 'Its *behaviour* has not changed since the seal on the east cliff cracked,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu called me to the bamboo bridge at dawn.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在竹桥上在黎明时分叫我。

sentences.en: He had been watching a cloud-deer pace the same narrow ledge for three days without eating.
sentences.cn: 他一直在看一只云鹿在同一条狭窄的山崖上踱步，三天没有进食。

sentences.en: 'Strange *behaviour* in a spirit beast means the mountain is trying to speak,' he said, pressing a smooth stone into my hand.

husband:2.en: In the valley market below the clouds, an old herbalist pressed a folded letter into my sleeve. 'Give this to Master Qingwu,' she whispered. 'Her *husband* left it here thirty years ago, the morning he attempted the ascent alone.' Her eyes held no hope, only duty.
husband:2.cnHint: 一位草药商人请我将一封信转交师尊，信是她____三十年前留下的。
husband:2.hook: The letter smelled faintly of the herb that stops time.
husband:2.line: 'Her *husband* never came back down from that cloud,' the old woman said.

sentences.en: In the valley market below the clouds, an old herbalist pressed a folded letter into my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 在云下的山谷市集，一位年迈的草药商人把一封折叠的信件塞进了我的袖子里。

sentences.en: 'Give this to Master Qingwu,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "把这个交给青梧师尊，"她低声说。

sentences.en: 'Her *husband* left it here thirty years ago, the morning he attempted the ascent alone.'
Her eyes held no hope, only duty.
sentences.cn: 她的眼神里没有希望，只有责任。

tourist:2.en: A young man in plain cotton clothes wandered onto the sect's outer terrace, mouth open, staring at the floating peaks. Every disciple could tell he was a *tourist* from the valley below, drawn up by the public lift-stone. He reached out and touched a spirit-lantern — and the lantern screamed.
tourist:2.cnHint: 一位来自山下的____误触了灵灯，引发了意想不到的反应。
tourist:2.hook: Every lantern on the terrace turned its light toward him.
tourist:2.line: 'A *tourist* should not be able to wake a sealed lantern,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: A young man in plain cotton clothes wandered onto the sect's outer terrace, mouth open, staring at the floating peaks.
sentences.cn: 一个穿着素棉衣的年轻人漫步来到了宗派的外露台，张着嘴，盯着浮动的山峰。

sentences.en: Every disciple could tell he was a *tourist* from the valley below, drawn up by the public lift-stone.
He reached out and touched a spirit-lantern — and the lantern screamed.
sentences.cn: 他伸出手去碰了一盏灵灯——灯尖叫了。

agent:2.en: The sealed letter I carried bore a mark I did not recognise. Xiaoxing studied it and went pale. 'That circle with three lines means the sender is an *agent* of the Sky Tribunal,' she said, stepping back. 'They do not write letters. They only write verdicts.' Outside, thunder rolled without clouds.
agent:2.cnHint: 小星认出信上的印记，说寄信人是天庭裁判所的____。
agent:2.hook: The verdict inside was dated three days from now.
agent:2.line: 'An *agent* of the Sky Tribunal has not visited this sect in a hundred years,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: The sealed letter I carried bore a mark I did not recognise.
sentences.cn: 我携带的那封密信上有个我不认识的记号。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing studied it and went pale.
sentences.cn: 小杏研究了一会儿，脸色苍白。

sentences.en: 'That circle with three lines means the sender is an *agent* of the Sky Tribunal,' she said, stepping back.
'They do not write letters.
sentences.cn: 他们不写信。

sentences.en: They only write verdicts.'
sentences.cn: 他们只写判决。

sentences.en: Outside, thunder rolled without clouds.
sentences.cn: 外面雷声隆隆，却不见半片云。

cash:2.en: Behind the waterfall on the third peak I found a hollow stone. Inside lay a small cloth bag of copper spirit-coins — the old kind, no longer in use — and a note: 'For the one who reaches here first.' There was no *cash* like this anywhere in the sect's records. Someone had planned this long ago.
cash:2.cnHint: 我在瀑布后的石洞里发现了一袋古铜灵币，但宗门记录中从未提及这笔____。
cash:2.hook: The note was signed with my own name.
cash:2.line: 'That *cash* was placed here before you were even born,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Behind the waterfall on the third peak I found a hollow stone.
sentences.cn: 在第三座峰顶后的瀑布下，我找到了一块中空的石头。

sentences.en: Inside lay a small cloth bag of copper spirit-coins — the old kind, no longer in use — and a note: 'For the one who reaches here first.'
sentences.cn: 里面放着一个布袋，装满了铜灵币——那种早已废用的旧币——还有一张纸条：「先到者，此为所属。」

sentences.en: There was no *cash* like this anywhere in the sect's records.
Someone had planned this long ago.
sentences.cn: 有人很久以前就计划好了这一切。

competition:2.en: The notice board outside the hall listed a *competition* among inner disciples: whoever could collect all five cloud-herbs before the next bell would earn the right to enter the Ascension Chamber alone. I read the rules twice. Shen Wujiu's name was already crossed off the list — he had withdrawn without reason.
competition:2.cnHint: 告示板上公布了一项____，师兄却无缘无故地退出了。
competition:2.hook: His name was crossed out in the same ink as the rules.
competition:2.line: 'A *competition* that only one person can win is not a test of skill,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: The notice board outside the hall listed a *competition* among inner disciples: whoever could collect all five cloud-herbs before the next bell would earn the right to enter the Ascension Chamber alone.
I read the rules twice.
sentences.cn: 我把规则读了两遍。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu's name was already crossed off the list — he had withdrawn without reason.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎的名字已经从名单上划掉了——他无故退出了。

farmer:2.en: At the base of the lowest floating peak, I met a sun-worn *farmer* pulling cloud-moss from the cliff's edge. He did not look up as he spoke: 'Three nights ago a light fell from the high peaks and burned a perfect circle in my field. The seeds inside the circle have already sprouted.' He offered me one small green shoot.
farmer:2.cnHint: 山脚下的____发现田地里出现了神秘的焦痕与迅速发芽的种子。
farmer:2.hook: The sprout in my palm pointed straight up, trembling.
farmer:2.line: 'A *farmer* notices what falls from the sky,' he said, still not looking up.

sentences.en: At the base of the lowest floating peak, I met a sun-worn *farmer* pulling cloud-moss from the cliff's edge.
He did not look up as he spoke: 'Three nights ago a light fell from the high peaks and burned a perfect circle in my field.
sentences.cn: 他没有抬头，只是开口说：「三晚前，高峰上落下一道光，在我的田里烧出了一个完美的圆圈。

sentences.en: The seeds inside the circle have already sprouted.'
sentences.cn: 圆圈里的种子已经发芽了。」

sentences.en: He offered me one small green shoot.
sentences.cn: 他递给我一根小小的绿芽。

female:2.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found an old scroll listing every Cloud Sea Sect disciple by rank. Beside each name, a small mark showed whether the disciple was male or *female*. I counted: of the ten greatest healers in the sect's history, seven were women. The ink on those names glowed faintly, as if proud.
female:2.cnHint: 我在档案堂发现一卷古老名册，记录着历代弟子的性别与成就，其中____治愈者居多。
female:2.hook: The last name on the list had been carefully erased by someone.
female:2.line: 'Seven of the greatest healers were *female* — the sect has always known this,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found an old scroll listing every Cloud Sea Sect disciple by rank.
sentences.cn: 深藏在档案室里，我找到了一份古老的卷轴，上面列着云海宗每一位弟子的品阶。

sentences.en: Beside each name, a small mark showed whether the disciple was male or *female*.
I counted: of the ten greatest healers in the sect's history, seven were women.
sentences.cn: 我数了数：宗门历史上最伟大的十位治疗者中，有七位是女性。

sentences.en: The ink on those names glowed faintly, as if proud.
sentences.cn: 那些名字上的墨迹泛着淡淡的光，仿佛在为自己骄傲。

holiday:2.en: On the first day of the Cloud Festival, Master Qingwu declared a *holiday* for all disciples. No word-study, no drills. Xiaoxing laughed and pulled me to the eastern cliff, where paper lanterns shaped like cranes drifted out over the sea of clouds, carrying small wishes written in spiritual ink.
holiday:2.cnHint: 云海宗宣布____，师妹拉着我去放印有心愿的纸灯笼。
holiday:2.hook: One lantern turned back against the wind and stopped before my face.
holiday:2.line: 'A *holiday* is rare — write your wish before the ink cools,' Xiaoxing said, pressing a brush into my hand.

sentences.en: On the first day of the Cloud Festival, Master Qingwu declared a *holiday* for all disciples.
No word-study, no drills.
sentences.cn: 没有文字修习，没有套路训练。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing laughed and pulled me to the eastern cliff, where paper lanterns shaped like cranes drifted out over the sea of clouds, carrying small wishes written in spiritual ink.
sentences.cn: 小杏笑着拉我到东悬崖，那里纸鹤灯笼飘散在云海之上，灯笼上用灵性之墨写着小小的心愿。

pain:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a sealed clay jar he had carried up from the lower mountain. Inside was a grey paste made from crushed word-roots. 'This will ease the *pain* in your channels after hard training,' he said. The paste smelled of rain and old stone, and one touch numbed my fingertip completely.
pain:2.cnHint: 师兄递给我一罐草药膏，说它能减轻修炼后经脉里的____。
pain:2.hook: When I opened the jar a second time, the paste had turned deep red.
pain:2.line: 'Spread it slowly — if the *pain* fades too fast, your channels will not strengthen,' Shen Wujiu warned.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a sealed clay jar he had carried up from the lower mountain.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一个从下山带上来的密封泥罐。

sentences.en: Inside was a grey paste made from crushed word-roots.
sentences.cn: 里面装着用碎字根捣碎成的灰色膏药。

sentences.en: 'This will ease the *pain* in your channels after hard training,' he said.
The paste smelled of rain and old stone, and one touch numbed my fingertip completely.
sentences.cn: 膏药闻起来有雨和老石头的味道，轻轻一碰我的指尖就完全麻木了。

player:2.en: The sect held its autumn word-duel under the Stone-Bell Pavilion. Each *player* had to speak a living formula loud enough to make the bronze bell hum. I was the last to step forward. My voice shook, but the bell rang — a single clear note that echoed far below into the clouds.
player:2.cnHint: 宗门举办秋季斗法，每位____须念出使铜钟共鸣的咒语，我是最后上场的人。
player:2.hook: The bell kept ringing long after everyone else had gone silent.
player:2.line: 'Every *player* in this duel carries a word they have never spoken aloud before,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: The sect held its autumn word-duel under the Stone-Bell Pavilion.
sentences.cn: 宗门在石钟亭举办了秋季文字对决。

sentences.en: Each *player* had to speak a living formula loud enough to make the bronze bell hum.
I was the last to step forward.
sentences.cn: 我是最后一个上前的。

sentences.en: My voice shook, but the bell rang — a single clear note that echoed far below into the clouds.
sentences.cn: 我的声音在颤抖，但钟声响了——一个清晰的音符在云下远远地回荡。

production:2.en: Master Qingwu led us into the Herb-Word Garden, where disciples cultivated rare syllables in long stone troughs. She explained that the *production* of each healing word took three seasons: planting, tending, and harvesting. One trough held a word still half-formed, its letters faintly visible in the soil like buried light.
production:2.cnHint: 师尊带我们参观药词园，解释每种治愈词语的____需要整整三个季节。
production:2.hook: One trough was empty, and its soil was cold as winter stone.
production:2.line: 'The *production* of a single flight-word costs more care than most disciples expect,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us into the Herb-Word Garden, where disciples cultivated rare syllables in long stone troughs.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊领我们进入了养字园，弟子们在长长的石槽里培养稀有的字音。

sentences.en: She explained that the *production* of each healing word took three seasons: planting, tending, and harvesting.
One trough held a word still half-formed, its letters faintly visible in the soil like buried light.
sentences.cn: 一个槽里装着一个还没完全成形的字，它的笔画在土里模糊可见，像埋在地下的光。

secure:2.en: Before I crossed the rope bridge to the outer peak, Shen Wujiu checked every knot by hand. 'The bridge looks safe, but you must make it *secure* yourself before you trust it,' he said. I pulled each cord tight and felt the mountain wind test my work the moment I stepped out over the clouds.
secure:2.cnHint: 师兄叮嘱我过桥前要亲手检查，确保绳索____，不能只靠外表判断。
secure:2.hook: Halfway across, one board shifted under my foot without a sound.
secure:2.line: 'A disciple who cannot make their own path *secure* should not yet seek the summit,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Before I crossed the rope bridge to the outer peak, Shen Wujiu checked every knot by hand.
sentences.cn: 在我踏上通往外峰的绳桥前，沈无咎逐个用手检查了每一个结。

sentences.en: 'The bridge looks safe, but you must make it *secure* yourself before you trust it,' he said.
I pulled each cord tight and felt the mountain wind test my work the moment I stepped out over the clouds.
sentences.cn: 我拉紧了每一根绳，山风一吹到我踏上云海的瞬间，就考验起了我的手艺。

audience:2.en: A sealed letter arrived at dawn, stamped with the sect's cloud emblem. It granted me a private *audience* with Master Qingwu at the Hour of the Crane. Xiaoxing read it over my shoulder and let out a slow breath. In three years here, she had never been summoned alone to the master's hall.
audience:2.cnHint: 清晨一封密信送到，宣布师尊将单独____我，师妹从未得到过这样的召见。
audience:2.hook: The letter carried a faint smell of burning that no one could explain.
audience:2.line: 'An *audience* with Master Qingwu alone means she has seen something in you — be ready,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: A sealed letter arrived at dawn, stamped with the sect's cloud emblem.
sentences.cn: 天亮时一封密信送来了，盖着宗门的云纹印章。

sentences.en: It granted me a private *audience* with Master Qingwu at the Hour of the Crane.
Xiaoxing read it over my shoulder and let out a slow breath.
sentences.cn: 小杏从我肩后读完，缓缓吐了口气。

sentences.en: In three years here, she had never been summoned alone to the master's hall.
sentences.cn: 在这里三年了，她从没被单独传唤过师尊的大殿。

borrow:2.en: I needed the star-chart scroll to finish my night exercise, but mine had been lost in the last storm. Xiaoxing offered to *borrow* Shen Wujiu's copy for me without telling him. I thanked her but went to ask him myself — in this sect, taking a word without permission, even briefly, weakens its power.
borrow:2.cnHint: 我遗失了星图，师妹想偷偷____师兄的那份给我，但我选择亲自去请求。
borrow:2.hook: When I reached Shen Wujiu's door, it was already open and the scroll was gone.
borrow:2.line: 'You may *borrow* it — but return it before the moon moves one hand-width,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: I needed the star-chart scroll to finish my night exercise, but mine had been lost in the last storm.
sentences.cn: 我需要星图卷轴来完成夜间功课，但我的那份在上次暴雨中丢了。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing offered to *borrow* Shen Wujiu's copy for me without telling him.
I thanked her but went to ask him myself — in this sect, taking a word without permission, even briefly, weakens its power.
sentences.cn: 我谢了她，但还是自己去问他——在这宗门里，不经许可取一个字，哪怕只是短暂的，都会削弱它的力量。

burn:2.en: Inside the Archive Cave, I found a scroll sealed with red wax. When I broke the seal, a sharp heat rose from the page — not fire, but the *burn* of a word too powerful to read unprepared. Master Qingwu had warned us: some formulas leave their mark before you understand them.
burn:2.cnHint: 我在藏经洞发现一卷封蜡竹简，触碰封印时感受到一种____，师尊曾警告过我们某些词语的力量。
burn:2.hook: A red mark, shaped like a wing, had appeared on my palm.
burn:2.line: 'This *burn* means the word has chosen you,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Inside the Archive Cave, I found a scroll sealed with red wax.
sentences.cn: 在藏经洞里，我找到了一卷用红蜡封好的书卷。

sentences.en: When I broke the seal, a sharp heat rose from the page — not fire, but the *burn* of a word too powerful to read unprepared.
Master Qingwu had warned us: some formulas leave their mark before you understand them.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊早就警告过我们，有些法诀会在你理解之前就在你身上留下痕迹。

cook:2.en: Deep in the herb valley below the east peak, Xiaoxing knelt by a small stone stove. She was learning to *cook* the three-petal cloud-root into a paste that could seal a broken spiritual channel. The steam rose in the shape of characters, and each one whispered its own meaning to whoever stood close enough.
cook:2.cnHint: 小星在东峰草药谷里用石炉____云根草，蒸汽升起时形成了奇异的文字形状。
cook:2.hook: One character in the steam was not from any scroll I had ever seen.
cook:2.line: 'Watch how I *cook* it — the heat must never rush the root,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Deep in the herb valley below the east peak, Xiaoxing knelt by a small stone stove.
sentences.cn: 在东峰下的草药谷深处，小杏跪在一个小石炉前。

sentences.en: She was learning to *cook* the three-petal cloud-root into a paste that could seal a broken spiritual channel.
The steam rose in the shape of characters, and each one whispered its own meaning to whoever stood close enough.
sentences.cn: 升起的蒸汽幻化成了字，每个字都向站得足够近的人低声诉说它自己的含义。

corporate:2.en: In the Hall of Shared Vows, every disciple pressed a hand to the stone tablet. The *corporate* pledge bound us all: one sect, one breath, one sky. Shen Wujiu said the old words still held power because so many voices had spoken them across so many years. I felt the mountain itself hum when I added my own voice.
corporate:2.cnHint: 在共誓大殿，我们在石碑上按手，立下了____誓言，将全体弟子联结在一起。
corporate:2.hook: The stone cracked at the edge — just a hair, but everyone saw it.
corporate:2.line: 'A *corporate* vow is only as strong as its weakest voice,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: In the Hall of Shared Vows, every disciple pressed a hand to the stone tablet.
sentences.cn: 在共誓殿里，每个弟子都把手按在石碑上。

sentences.en: The *corporate* pledge bound us all: one sect, one breath, one sky.
Shen Wujiu said the old words still held power because so many voices had spoken them across so many years.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说那些古老的词语之所以仍有力量，是因为这么多年来有那么多的声音说过它们。

sentences.en: I felt the mountain itself hum when I added my own voice.
sentences.cn: 当我加入自己的声音时，我感觉到整座山都在嗡鸣。

dangerous:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the edge of the Outer Shelf, where the cloud sea churned far below. He pointed to a cluster of violet herbs clinging to the rock face. 'Those are *dangerous* to carry unbound,' he said quietly. The wind shifted, and one leaf broke free, cutting a clean line through the mist before it vanished.
dangerous:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到外台边缘，指着岩壁上的一丛紫草，告诫我那些草药是____的。
dangerous:2.hook: Below the shelf, something large moved slowly through the clouds.
dangerous:2.line: 'The word inside that herb is *dangerous* if you speak it incomplete,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the edge of the Outer Shelf, where the cloud sea churned far below.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我来到外架的边缘，云海在远处翻滚。

sentences.en: He pointed to a cluster of violet herbs clinging to the rock face.
sentences.cn: 他指向岩壁上紧贴着的一簇紫色草药。

sentences.en: 'Those are *dangerous* to carry unbound,' he said quietly.
The wind shifted, and one leaf broke free, cutting a clean line through the mist before it vanished.
sentences.cn: 风吹动了，其中一片叶子脱落，在雾中划出一道干净的线，然后消失了。

debt:2.en: Master Qingwu placed an old wooden tablet in my hands. Every word I would learn this season had been gathered by disciples before me, some of whom never came back. 'You carry a *debt* to them,' she said. The tablet was warm, as though many hands had held it in the cold.
debt:2.cnHint: 师尊将一块古木牌交给我，说我对从前那些弟子负有____，因为是他们为我积累了这些知识。
debt:2.hook: One name carved into the back of the tablet had been crossed out.
debt:2.line: 'Mastering each word repays a small part of that *debt*,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed an old wooden tablet in my hands.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把一块古老的木牌放进我的手里。

sentences.en: Every word I would learn this season had been gathered by disciples before me, some of whom never came back.
sentences.cn: 我这一季要学的每个字都是前面的弟子们收集的，其中有些人再也没有回来。

sentences.en: 'You carry a *debt* to them,' she said.
The tablet was warm, as though many hands had held it in the cold.
sentences.cn: 那块牌子是温热的，好像许多手都在寒冷中握过它。

discipline:2.en: The morning bell rang before the clouds had lightened. In the Training Court, Shen Wujiu stood still as stone, reciting the same formula for the hundredth time. He told me later that *discipline* was not about force — it was about returning, again and again, to the same word until the word returned to you. I wrote that down and pinned it above my sleeping mat.
discipline:2.cnHint: 在修炼场，师兄向我解释，____并不是逼迫自己，而是一次次回到同一个词语，直到它向你开口。
discipline:2.hook: That night my own mat rose three inches off the floor in my sleep.
discipline:2.line: '*Discipline* is how a word learns to trust you,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The morning bell rang before the clouds had lightened.
sentences.cn: 晨钟在云还没有亮起来时响了。

sentences.en: In the Training Court, Shen Wujiu stood still as stone, reciting the same formula for the hundredth time.
sentences.cn: 在训练场里，沈无咎站得像块石头一样，第一百次念诵同一个法诀。

sentences.en: He told me later that *discipline* was not about force — it was about returning, again and again, to the same word until the word returned to you.
I wrote that down and pinned it above my sleeping mat.
sentences.cn: 我把这写下来，钉在我的睡垫上方。

error:2.en: I copied the healing formula onto rice paper, stroke by careful stroke. When I finished, Xiaoxing pointed to a single misplaced curve near the end. 'That *error* would reverse the flow,' she said, not unkindly. I burned the copy and began again, and this time the finished page gave off a faint green light.
error:2.cnHint: 我抄写完一个治愈符文后，小星指出了其中一处____，那个小错误会让能量逆流。
error:2.hook: The ash from my burned page drifted upward instead of falling.
error:2.line: 'One *error* in a formula can turn a cure into a wound,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: I copied the healing formula onto rice paper, stroke by careful stroke.
sentences.cn: 我用细致的笔画把治愈的法诀抄到宣纸上。

sentences.en: When I finished, Xiaoxing pointed to a single misplaced curve near the end.
sentences.cn: 我完成时，小杏指向了最后附近一个错位的弧线。

sentences.en: 'That *error* would reverse the flow,' she said, not unkindly.
I burned the copy and began again, and this time the finished page gave off a faint green light.
sentences.cn: 我烧掉了那份抄本，重新开始，这一次完成的页面散发出淡淡的绿光。

gym:2.en: The Strength Pavilion was nothing like I had imagined. I had pictured a grand hall, but the sect's *gym* was a single bare platform open to the sky, with iron rings hanging over open air above the cloud sea. Shen Wujiu said the drop was the point: you learn to hold on when letting go means falling through clouds.
gym:2.cnHint: 我终于见到了宗门的____，那是一个向天敞开的平台，铁环悬在云海之上。
gym:2.hook: One of the iron rings was spinning slowly, with no wind to move it.
gym:2.line: 'Every disciple who left this *gym* stronger had once wanted to quit,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The Strength Pavilion was nothing like I had imagined.
sentences.cn: 力量楼一点都不像我想象的那样。

sentences.en: I had pictured a grand hall, but the sect's *gym* was a single bare platform open to the sky, with iron rings hanging over open air above the cloud sea.
Shen Wujiu said the drop was the point: you learn to hold on when letting go means falling through clouds.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说那道深渊就是重点，你会在放手就意味着坠入云海的时候学会坚守。

collection:2.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found Master Qingwu's *collection* of pressed spirit-words — each leaf sealed under pale stone, each word still faintly glowing. Shen Wujiu said the oldest ones dated back three hundred years. I reached for one, and the whole shelf hummed like a held breath.
collection:2.cnHint: 我在典藏阁发现了师尊珍藏的灵字标本，每一片都封存在石板之下，散发着微光。
collection:2.hook: The humming stopped the moment my fingers made contact.
collection:2.line: 'This *collection* holds words even Master Qingwu has not yet spoken aloud.'

sentences.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found Master Qingwu's *collection* of pressed spirit-words — each leaf sealed under pale stone, each word still faintly glowing.
Shen Wujiu said the oldest ones dated back three hundred years.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说最老的那些可以追溯到三百年前。

sentences.en: I reached for one, and the whole shelf hummed like a held breath.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去拿其中一个，整个书架都发出了像屏住呼吸一样的嗡鸣。

depression:2.en: After failing the morning recitation, a quiet *depression* settled over me like cloud-fog on low stone. Xiaoxing sat beside me without speaking, and placed a small warm herb-word in my palm. It read 'persevere.' By evening the fog had thinned, but the sky to the north had turned an odd shade of copper.
depression:2.cnHint: 早课背诵失败后，我陷入了__________，师妹无声地将一枚草药灵字放在我手心。
depression:2.hook: The copper sky deepened, and something vast moved within it.
depression:2.line: '*Depression* is just the mountain before the climb — I have seen it break stronger disciples than this.'

sentences.en: After failing the morning recitation, a quiet *depression* settled over me like cloud-fog on low stone.
Xiaoxing sat beside me without speaking, and placed a small warm herb-word in my palm.
sentences.cn: 小杏无言地坐在我身边，把一个小小的温热的草药字放在我的掌心里。

sentences.en: It read 'persevere.'
sentences.cn: 它写的是"坚持"。

sentences.en: By evening the fog had thinned, but the sky to the north had turned an odd shade of copper.
sentences.cn: 到傍晚时雾气已经消散，但北边的天空变成了奇怪的铜色。

foot:2.en: The stone path ended at the cliff's edge, and the next floating peak hung a full *foot* too far to step across. Shen Wujiu crouched and studied the gap, then pressed two fingers to the rock. A word rose from the stone — 'bridge' — and the gap slowly closed. Behind us, the path we had walked began to dissolve.
foot:2.cnHint: 石径尽头，相邻山峰之间隔着整整一__________的距离，师兄用一个字将其合拢。
foot:2.hook: The dissolving path whispered a single word as it vanished.
foot:2.line: 'One *foot* of open air is enough to swallow a disciple who hesitates.'

sentences.en: The stone path ended at the cliff's edge, and the next floating peak hung a full *foot* too far to step across.
Shen Wujiu crouched and studied the gap, then pressed two fingers to the rock.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎蹲下来研究那道缝隙，然后把两根手指按在岩石上。

sentences.en: A word rose from the stone — 'bridge' — and the gap slowly closed.
sentences.cn: 一个字从石头里升起——"桥"——那道缝隙慢慢合上了。

sentences.en: Behind us, the path we had walked began to dissolve.
sentences.cn: 我们身后，我们走过的路开始消散。

graduate:2.en: Pinned to the message board was a list of names — those permitted to attempt the Sky Trial. I was not on it, but one name surprised me: Shen Wujiu, listed as a *graduate* of the inner hall, already cleared for ascent. He had never mentioned it. I looked for him all afternoon, but his room was empty and his lamp was cold.
graduate:2.cnHint: 布告栏上，师兄被列为内堂__________，有资格参加升天试炼，但他的房间已经空了。
graduate:2.hook: A single folded note lay on his empty mat, addressed to no one.
graduate:2.line: 'A *graduate* of the inner hall carries secrets the outer disciples are not ready to hear.'

sentences.en: Pinned to the message board was a list of names — those permitted to attempt the Sky Trial.
sentences.cn: 贴在布告栏上的是一份名单——那些被允许尝试天空试炼的人。

sentences.en: I was not on it, but one name surprised me: Shen Wujiu, listed as a *graduate* of the inner hall, already cleared for ascent.
He had never mentioned it.
sentences.cn: 他从来没有提起过。

sentences.en: I looked for him all afternoon, but his room was empty and his lamp was cold.
sentences.cn: 我整个下午都在找他，但他的房间是空的，他的灯没有亮。

intake:2.en: Master Qingwu watched my *intake* of breath before each spoken word, correcting the depth with a tap of her finger. 'Words drawn from shallow air fall apart mid-flight,' she said. After an hour my ribs ached, but the practice word I released rose twenty feet before fading. Then the wind changed direction, carrying ash from somewhere far below.
intake:2.cnHint: 师尊观察我每次开口前气息的__________，纠正我的呼吸深度，练习灵字终于飞升了二十尺。
intake:2.hook: Ash from below the clouds meant something on the lower peaks was burning.
intake:2.line: 'Control your *intake* of breath and you control the shape of every word you speak.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched my *intake* of breath before each spoken word, correcting the depth with a tap of her finger.
'Words drawn from shallow air fall apart mid-flight,' she said.
sentences.cn: "从浅薄的空气中汲取的词语会在半途瓦解。"她说。

sentences.en: After an hour my ribs ached, but the practice word I released rose twenty feet before fading.
sentences.cn: 一小时后我的肋骨酸痛，但我释放的练习词升起了二十英尺才消散。

sentences.en: Then the wind changed direction, carrying ash from somewhere far below.
sentences.cn: 然后风向改变了，吹来了来自远方某处的灰烬。

screen:2.en: A bamboo *screen* divided the examination chamber, hiding the examiner's face. I recited the three healing words from memory, then waited. Nothing came back for a long time. At last a hand appeared around the edge of the screen and set a small token on the floor — a carved cloud, the mark of conditional passage. The candle behind the screen cast two shadows, not one.
screen:2.cnHint: 考堂里一道竹制的__________遮住了考官的面孔，我背完三个疗愈灵字后，对方放出了一枚有条件通过的令牌。
screen:2.hook: Two shadows behind one screen meant a second presence no one had announced.
screen:2.line: 'Stand behind the *screen* and let only your words speak — the examiner must judge the voice, not the face.'

sentences.en: A bamboo *screen* divided the examination chamber, hiding the examiner's face.
I recited the three healing words from memory, then waited.
sentences.cn: 我从记忆中背诵了三个治疗词，然后等待。

sentences.en: Nothing came back for a long time.
sentences.cn: 很长一段时间都没有反应。

sentences.en: At last a hand appeared around the edge of the screen and set a small token on the floor — a carved cloud, the mark of conditional passage.
sentences.cn: 最后，一只手从屏风边缘伸出来，在地板上放了一个小令牌——一朵雕刻的云，这是有条件通过的标记。

sentences.en: The candle behind the screen cast two shadows, not one.
sentences.cn: 屏风后的烛光投出了两个影子，而不是一个。

chair:2.en: Master Qingwu's *chair* at the head of the teaching hall stood empty on the morning of the third day. No message, no replacement teacher, no note on the board. Xiaoxing whispered that an empty chair in the Cloud Sea Sect meant the master had accepted a trial that could not be watched. By noon, clouds had risen high enough to swallow the peak above us.
chair:2.cnHint: 教堂上首师尊的__________空着，师妹说这意味着师尊已接受了一场无人可以旁观的试炼。
chair:2.hook: The clouds kept rising, and the peak above us disappeared without a sound.
chair:2.line: 'When the master's *chair* stands empty, every disciple must become their own teacher until she returns.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu's *chair* at the head of the teaching hall stood empty on the morning of the third day.
No message, no replacement teacher, no note on the board.
sentences.cn: 没有信息，没有替代老师，黑板上没有留言。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing whispered that an empty chair in the Cloud Sea Sect meant the master had accepted a trial that could not be watched.
sentences.cn: 小杏低声说，云海宗的空椅子意味着师尊接受了一个无法旁观的试炼。

sentences.en: By noon, clouds had risen high enough to swallow the peak above us.
sentences.cn: 到了中午，云已经升得够高，吞没了我们上方的山峰。

court:2.en: The high elders had gathered in the open-air *court* at the mountain's crown to review the season's word-harvest. I was sent to deliver a sealed scroll and told not to linger. But as I set the scroll down, one elder read aloud a word I did not recognise — and every lamp in the court went dark at once.
court:2.cnHint: 长老们在山顶的露天__________审阅这一季的灵字收成，一位长老朗读了一个陌生的字，所有灯火瞬间熄灭。
court:2.hook: In the sudden dark, something answered from the clouds below.
court:2.line: 'Bring your findings before the *court* of elders — they alone can judge whether this word is a gift or a warning.'

sentences.en: The high elders had gathered in the open-air *court* at the mountain's crown to review the season's word-harvest.
I was sent to deliver a sealed scroll and told not to linger.
sentences.cn: 我被派去送一份密封的卷轴，并被告知不要逗留。

sentences.en: But as I set the scroll down, one elder read aloud a word I did not recognise — and every lamp in the court went dark at once.
sentences.cn: 但当我放下卷轴时，一位长老大声读出了一个我不认识的词——整个庭院的灯一下子全灭了。

mile:2.en: The scroll unrolled across the stone floor, its ink trail marking each *mile* of sky-road between our mountain and the Outer Peak. I traced the path with one finger, feeling the characters hum under my skin. Shen Wujiu had walked every step of it. Now the route was mine to memorize.
mile:2.cnHint: 卷轴展开，显示了通往外峰的____路程，我必须将这条路记在心中。
mile:2.hook: At the final mark, the ink had smeared — as if something had stopped Shen Wujiu mid-step.
mile:2.line: 'Every *mile* of sky-road holds a word that can slow the wind,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The scroll unrolled across the stone floor, its ink trail marking each *mile* of sky-road between our mountain and the Outer Peak.
I traced the path with one finger, feeling the characters hum under my skin.
sentences.cn: 我用一根手指追踪了路径，感到字符在我的皮肤下嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu had walked every step of it.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎走过了每一步。

sentences.en: Now the route was mine to memorize.
sentences.cn: 现在这条路线是我要记住的。

movement:2.en: The message was written in water-script, visible only when held above cloud mist. Each stroke described a *movement* of the hands — a gesture that would open the sealed archive on the eastern ledge. I copied it slowly, breath held. The archive had been shut for three years.
movement:2.cnHint: 水迹信件描述了一个手部____，据说能打开封印已久的档案室。
movement:2.hook: When I tried the gesture, the archive door did not open — it shook.
movement:2.line: 'That *movement* of the wrist is the key,' Xiaoxing whispered, guiding my hand steady.

sentences.en: The message was written in water-script, visible only when held above cloud mist.
sentences.cn: 那条讯息是用水笔写的，只有在云雾上方才能看见。

sentences.en: Each stroke described a *movement* of the hands — a gesture that would open the sealed archive on the eastern ledge.
I copied it slowly, breath held.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢地抄了下来，屏住呼吸。

sentences.en: The archive had been shut for three years.
sentences.cn: 那个档案库已经关了三年。

party:2.en: A torn notice clung to the gate post. It named a *party* of five disciples sent to the lower cloud shelf to collect rare word-herbs. Only two had returned. No names were crossed out — whoever recorded this had left in a hurry, the brush strokes thin with haste.
party:2.cnHint: 布告显示，一____弟子下山采药，但只有两人归来，记录者似乎匆忙离去。
party:2.hook: The date on the notice was yesterday — and I had seen five figures leave this very morning.
party:2.line: 'Our *party* set out together,' Master Qingwu said quietly, 'but the cloud shelf changes who it lets through.'

sentences.en: A torn notice clung to the gate post.
sentences.cn: 一张破损的通知贴在门柱上。

sentences.en: It named a *party* of five disciples sent to the lower cloud shelf to collect rare word-herbs.
Only two had returned.
sentences.cn: 只有两个回来了。

sentences.en: No names were crossed out — whoever recorded this had left in a hurry, the brush strokes thin with haste.
sentences.cn: 没有名字被划掉——记录这件事的人匆匆离开了，笔画因仓促而细弱。

rescue:2.en: Tucked inside the medicine jar was a folded slip of paper. It held two words in Xiaoxing's hand: *rescue* needed. Below them, a small diagram showed the cave behind the second waterfall — a place no new disciple was supposed to know about yet. My pulse quickened.
rescue:2.cnHint: 药罐里藏着小星的纸条，上面写着需要____，并画出了一个我本不该知道的洞穴位置。
rescue:2.hook: The ink on the slip was still faintly warm, as though written moments ago.
rescue:2.line: 'I drew the map because a *rescue* must be fast and cannot wait for permission,' the note ended.

sentences.en: Tucked inside the medicine jar was a folded slip of paper.
sentences.cn: 塞在药罐里的是一张折叠的纸条。

sentences.en: It held two words in Xiaoxing's hand: *rescue* needed.
Below them, a small diagram showed the cave behind the second waterfall — a place no new disciple was supposed to know about yet.
sentences.cn: 下面有一个小图，显示了第二个瀑布后面的洞穴——一个新弟子还不应该知道的地方。

sentences.en: My pulse quickened.
sentences.cn: 我的脉搏加快了。

writing:2.en: The old archive held walls of living text — *writing* that shifted when the mountain breathed, characters rearranging into new formulas at dawn. Master Qingwu had left a single candle and a blank strip of bark beside the entrance. The lesson, I understood, was to read before the light ran out.
writing:2.cnHint: 古老档案室的墙上布满会移动的____，师尊留下蜡烛，要我在烛光熄灭前读完。
writing:2.hook: By the time I reached the final wall, the candle had already begun to lean.
writing:2.line: 'The *writing* on this wall rewrites itself if you look away too long,' Master Qingwu warned.

sentences.en: The old archive held walls of living text — *writing* that shifted when the mountain breathed, characters rearranging into new formulas at dawn.
Master Qingwu had left a single candle and a blank strip of bark beside the entrance.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在入口旁边放了一根单独的蜡烛和一条空白的树皮。

sentences.en: The lesson, I understood, was to read before the light ran out.
sentences.cn: 我明白了，这堂课是在光线耗尽前读书。

bite:2.en: The word-fruit hung low on the inner branch, pale gold and pulsing faintly. Shen Wujiu's note said one *bite* would let me hear the mountain's oldest formula. I lifted it, hesitated, then placed it on my tongue. The taste was cold and sharp — like wind given a name.
bite:2.cnHint: 文字果实挂在枝头，沈无咎的字条说咬上一____就能听见山中最古老的咒语。
bite:2.hook: The formula I heard was not one written in any scroll I had ever seen.
bite:2.line: 'One *bite* is enough — more and the word will speak through you, not to you,' Shen Wujiu had warned.

sentences.en: The word-fruit hung low on the inner branch, pale gold and pulsing faintly.
sentences.cn: 词果在内侧树枝上低垂，苍白金色，微微脉动。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu's note said one *bite* would let me hear the mountain's oldest formula.
I lifted it, hesitated, then placed it on my tongue.
sentences.cn: 我举起它，犹豫了一下，然后把它放在舌头上。

sentences.en: The taste was cold and sharp — like wind given a name.
sentences.cn: 味道冷而尖锐——就像被赋予名字的风。

capture:2.en: The spirit-lantern at the peak was designed to *capture* stray word-fragments drifting up from the cloud sea below. I found it dark and cold, its catch-glass shattered. Scattered on the stone were syllables of light — pieces of a formula no one had reassembled in living memory.
capture:2.cnHint: 山顶的灵灯本是用来____从云海中飘来的文字碎片的，但我发现它已经破碎，碎片散落一地。
capture:2.hook: One syllable of light blinked, then rolled off the ledge into the clouds below.
capture:2.line: 'We built it to *capture* only what rises freely,' Master Qingwu said, 'never to take what clings to a living soul.'

sentences.en: The spirit-lantern at the peak was designed to *capture* stray word-fragments drifting up from the cloud sea below.
I found it dark and cold, its catch-glass shattered.
sentences.cn: 我发现它又冷又暗，捕捉玻璃碎了。

sentences.en: Scattered on the stone were syllables of light — pieces of a formula no one had reassembled in living memory.
sentences.cn: 散落在石头上的是光的音节——一个活着的记忆中没有人重新组合过的公式碎片。

cope:2.en: The instruction stone listed forty root-words to learn before the first trial. I sat with the list until the sky turned deep blue, unsure how to *cope* with so many forms at once. Then I found a note in Xiaoxing's writing tucked beneath the stone: learn one word fully, and the others will follow like shadows.
cope:2.cnHint: 试炼前需记四十个根词，我不知如何____这庞大的任务，直到在石板下发现了小星留下的字条。
cope:2.hook: The note was signed — but the name below Xiaoxing's had been carefully scraped away.
cope:2.line: 'The only way to *cope* with the whole mountain,' Xiaoxing had written, 'is to stand on one stone at a time.'

sentences.en: The instruction stone listed forty root-words to learn before the first trial.
sentences.cn: 教学石上列着四十个根字，要在第一次考验前学会。

sentences.en: I sat with the list until the sky turned deep blue, unsure how to *cope* with so many forms at once.
Then I found a note in Xiaoxing's writing tucked beneath the stone: learn one word fully, and the others will follow like shadows.
sentences.cn: 后来我在石头下面发现了小杏写的一张纸条：学透一个字，其他的就会像影子一样跟上。

salary:2.en: Deep in the Archive Cavern, I found a scroll listing every disciple's monthly spirit-stone allowance. The sum beside my name was small — a first-year *salary* barely enough to buy a single healing leaf. Shen Wujiu had warned me the Sect paid little at the start. Yet the scroll beneath mine showed a figure ten times larger, and that name had been crossed out in red ink.
salary:2.cnHint: 我在档案洞窟中发现了一份记录弟子每月所得灵石的卷轴，我的____少得可怜，而被红墨划去的那个名字却领取着十倍之数。
salary:2.hook: Below the crossed name, a single word was brushed: 'Vanished.'
salary:2.line: 'A first-year *salary* buys little, but it buys loyalty,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: Deep in the Archive Cavern, I found a scroll listing every disciple's monthly spirit-stone allowance.
sentences.cn: 我在藏经洞深处找到一卷羊皮纸，上面列着每个弟子的月度灵石补贴。

sentences.en: The sum beside my name was small — a first-year *salary* barely enough to buy a single healing leaf.
Shen Wujiu had warned me the Sect paid little at the start.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎曾警告过我，宗门初期的薪俸微薄。

sentences.en: Yet the scroll beneath mine showed a figure ten times larger, and that name had been crossed out in red ink.
sentences.cn: 可我下面那卷纸上的数字足足大了十倍，那个名字还被红墨笔划掉了。

shopping:2.en: At the Cloud Market — a row of wooden stalls lashed to the mountain's edge — I went *shopping* for my first spirit-herb satchel. Each vendor called their wares in words I could not yet speak, and every word I failed to pronounce made the price rise. Xiaoxing laughed softly and spoke one clean syllable; the vendor bowed and handed the satchel to me for free.
shopping:2.cnHint: 我在云端市集____时，不会念灵草的名字，价格步步上涨，直到师妹开口，摊主便分文未收。
shopping:2.hook: As we turned to leave, every market lantern went dark at once.
shopping:2.line: '*Shopping* here means knowing the words before you reach for your purse,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: At the Cloud Market — a row of wooden stalls lashed to the mountain's edge — I went *shopping* for my first spirit-herb satchel.
Each vendor called their wares in words I could not yet speak, and every word I failed to pronounce made the price rise.
sentences.cn: 每个摊主都用我还听不懂的话叫卖，我每念错一个字，价格就往上翻。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing laughed softly and spoke one clean syllable; the vendor bowed and handed the satchel to me for free.
sentences.cn: 小杏轻轻笑了一声，清清楚楚说了一个音节，摊主就鞠躬把布袋递给了我，分文不取。

tendency:2.en: Master Qingwu set a candle flame before me and told me to speak the word for 'still.' I tried three times; each time the flame bent toward me instead of calming. She noted this in her ledger without expression. 'You have a *tendency* to pull energy inward,' she said, 'like a valley that drinks rivers but never lets them go.' I did not know if that was praise or warning.
tendency:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊观察到我有将灵力向内汇聚的____，她将此记入册中，神色平静。
tendency:2.hook: That night the candle on my desk lit itself.
tendency:2.line: 'A *tendency* to draw things inward can save a life or end one,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set a candle flame before me and told me to speak the word for 'still.'
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我面前点了根蜡烛，让我念"静"这个字。

sentences.en: I tried three times; each time the flame bent toward me instead of calming.
sentences.cn: 我试了三次，每次火焰都朝我这边弯，就是平不下来。

sentences.en: She noted this in her ledger without expression.
sentences.cn: 她在账簿上记了笔，脸上没什么表情。

sentences.en: 'You have a *tendency* to pull energy inward,' she said, 'like a valley that drinks rivers but never lets them go.'
I did not know if that was praise or warning.
sentences.cn: 我不知道这是夸还是警告。

tough:2.en: The Ridge of Fading Breath was *tough* to cross — the wind carried words that erased other words, and every formula I whispered came apart before it could hold. I lost three healing leaves to the gust and nearly lost my footing on the narrow stone path. Shen Wujiu reached back without looking and steadied my wrist. At the far end, a sealed iron door bore no handle, only a lock shaped like an open mouth.
tough:2.cnHint: 穿越消息岭十分____，风会吞噬言语，师兄伸手稳住了我，而前方铁门只有一个形如张口的锁。
tough:2.hook: The mouth-shaped lock moved, as if about to speak.
tough:2.line: 'The path is *tough*, but the door only opens for those who arrive,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: The Ridge of Fading Breath was *tough* to cross — the wind carried words that erased other words, and every formula I whispered came apart before it could hold.
I lost three healing leaves to the gust and nearly lost my footing on the narrow stone path.
sentences.cn: 我丢了三片疗伤叶子，差点在窄石板路上摔下去。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu reached back without looking and steadied my wrist.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎回过身都没看，就扶住了我的手腕。

sentences.en: At the far end, a sealed iron door bore no handle, only a lock shaped like an open mouth.
sentences.cn: 走到那一头，是道密封的铁门，没有把手，只有一把锁，形状像张开的嘴。

tour:2.en: Master Qingwu led the new disciples on a *tour* of the Sect's five peaks, naming each one with a word that hummed in the chest long after she finished speaking. The fifth peak had no name she would share. 'You will name it yourself,' she said, 'when you are ready.' I looked at its bare summit and felt the air above it press down like a held breath, heavy with something unspoken.
tour:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊带新弟子____了五座山峰，每座峰名念来都在胸腔回响，但第五座峰她没有说出名字。
tour:2.hook: A single white feather drifted up from the nameless peak, against the wind.
tour:2.line: 'Every *tour* of these peaks is also a test,' Master Qingwu said, not looking back.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led the new disciples on a *tour* of the Sect's five peaks, naming each one with a word that hummed in the chest long after she finished speaking.
The fifth peak had no name she would share.
sentences.cn: 第五座峰她没说名字。

sentences.en: 'You will name it yourself,' she said, 'when you are ready.'
sentences.cn: "你准备好了，就会自己给它命名，"她说。

sentences.en: I looked at its bare summit and felt the air above it press down like a held breath, heavy with something unspoken.
sentences.cn: 我看着光秃秃的山顶，感觉上面的空气像憋着的呼吸一样往下压，沉甸甸装着什么说不出来的东西。

wake:2.en: In the *wake* of the great storm that had split the eastern bridge, the Sect held a night vigil for the lost words — formulas that had been spoken into the wind and never returned. We stood in silence around an empty stone bowl. Xiaoxing placed one luminous leaf inside it, and the leaf burned without smoke, as if remembering something it could not say aloud. I felt the shape of each lost word pass through me like cold water.
wake:2.cnHint: 在摧毁东桥的风暴____，门派为失散的法诀举行了守夜仪式，师妹放入一片发光的叶子，它无烟燃烧。
wake:2.hook: The stone bowl cracked cleanly down the middle as the last leaf turned to light.
wake:2.line: 'In the *wake* of loss, we speak the names so they are not forgotten,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: In the *wake* of the great storm that had split the eastern bridge, the Sect held a night vigil for the lost words — formulas that had been spoken into the wind and never returned.
We stood in silence around an empty stone bowl.
sentences.cn: 我们在一只空石碗周围无声地站着。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing placed one luminous leaf inside it, and the leaf burned without smoke, as if remembering something it could not say aloud.
sentences.cn: 小杏放进去一片发光的叶子，叶子无烟地燃烧着，好像在记起什么它说不出口的事。

sentences.en: I felt the shape of each lost word pass through me like cold water.
sentences.cn: 我感觉每一个丢失的字都像冷水一样从我身体里流过。

annual:2.en: The *annual* Naming Day came once each year, when disciples who had mastered ten new words were permitted to carve one of them into the mountain face. I had mastered only seven. I watched Shen Wujiu lift the iron brush and press a word deep into the stone; the whole cliff face shivered and released a scent like rain on dry earth. My seven words felt light and small inside my chest.
annual:2.cnHint: 一年一度的____刻名日，掌握十个词的弟子可将其中一字刻入山壁，师兄刻下时崖面颤抖，我只有七个词。
annual:2.hook: Where Shen Wujiu's word was carved, a thin crack spread upward toward the summit.
annual:2.line: 'The *annual* Naming Day is generous — it asks for only ten,' Shen Wujiu said, though his eyes were serious.

sentences.en: The *annual* Naming Day came once each year, when disciples who had mastered ten new words were permitted to carve one of them into the mountain face.
I had mastered only seven.
sentences.cn: 我只掌握了七个。

sentences.en: I watched Shen Wujiu lift the iron brush and press a word deep into the stone; the whole cliff face shivered and released a scent like rain on dry earth.
sentences.cn: 我看着沈无咎举起铁笔，在石头上深深刻下一个字，整面崖壁都颤了一下，散发出干土遇雨的味道。

sentences.en: My seven words felt light and small inside my chest.
sentences.cn: 我那七个字在胸腔里显得轻飘飘的。

charity:2.en: A wandering elder arrived at the Sect gate carrying nothing but a worn satchel and a request: she asked for *charity* — not spirit stones, but one word, freely given, that she could carry to a dying village below the clouds where all language had gone silent. Master Qingwu turned to us disciples and waited. None of us spoke. Then Xiaoxing stepped forward and whispered a single syllable into the elder's open hand, and the old woman closed her fingers around it carefully.
charity:2.cnHint: 一位游历的长者来到宗门，请求____——不是灵石，而是一个字，师妹上前将一个音节轻轻送入她手中。
charity:2.hook: As the elder descended, the clouds below the gate began, slowly, to glow.
charity:2.line: '*Charity* with words is the oldest medicine we have,' the elder said, and bowed.

sentences.en: A wandering elder arrived at the Sect gate carrying nothing but a worn satchel and a request: she asked for *charity* — not spirit stones, but one word, freely given, that she could carry to a dying village below the clouds where all language had gone silent.
Master Qingwu turned to us disciples and waited.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊转向我们弟子，等着。

sentences.en: None of us spoke.
sentences.cn: 没人开口。

sentences.en: Then Xiaoxing stepped forward and whispered a single syllable into the elder's open hand, and the old woman closed her fingers around it carefully.
sentences.cn: 然后小杏走上前，在那老妇人张开的手心里轻声吹出一个音节，老女人小心翼翼地把手指合上。

couple:2.en: Deep in the archive cave, I found a stone shelf holding only a *couple* of old jade scrolls. Dust covered everything else. Master Qingwu had said the rarest formulas were never stored in great number. I took both scrolls and felt the cave grow suddenly, strangely cold.
couple:2.cnHint: 我在藏经洞里发现了仅有的两卷玉简，洞中随即变得异常寒冷。
couple:2.hook: The cold had no natural source — something else was present.
couple:2.line: 'A *couple* of scrolls remain, yet one should be enough to change everything.'

sentences.en: Deep in the archive cave, I found a stone shelf holding only a *couple* of old jade scrolls.
Dust covered everything else.
sentences.cn: 其他地方都是灰。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had said the rarest formulas were never stored in great number.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说过，最珍稀的功诀从来不会存很多份。

sentences.en: I took both scrolls and felt the cave grow suddenly, strangely cold.
sentences.cn: 我拿起两卷，感觉山洞突然冷得古怪。

definition:2.en: Scratched into the stone arch above the sect gate was a single line of old script. Shen Wujiu told me it was the *definition* of a disciple: one who carries a word until it becomes breath. The characters were so sharp and clear that they seemed freshly cut, though the arch was ancient.
definition:2.cnHint: 宗门石拱上刻着弟子的____，字迹清晰如新，令人心生敬畏。
definition:2.hook: Someone had recut those letters — last night.
definition:2.line: 'The *definition* carved there is older than the sect itself, they say.'

sentences.en: Scratched into the stone arch above the sect gate was a single line of old script.
sentences.cn: 宗门大门上面的石拱里刻着一行古篆。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me it was the *definition* of a disciple: one who carries a word until it becomes breath.
The characters were so sharp and clear that they seemed freshly cut, though the arch was ancient.
sentences.cn: 那些字笔笔清晰，仿佛才刚刻上去，但这拱顶却古得不行。

imagination:2.en: Master Qingwu spread a blank scroll before me and said nothing. I stared until shapes began to form in the white space — clouds, a path, a door. 'Your *imagination* is a compass,' she said softly. 'It points before the mind knows where it is going.' Outside, the peak mist thickened.
imagination:2.cnHint: 师尊展开一张白卷，说我的____是指路的罗盘，窗外山雾随之骤然加深。
imagination:2.hook: The door I had imagined on the scroll was now glowing faintly.
imagination:2.line: 'Without *imagination*, a disciple sees only the herb, never the cure.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu spread a blank scroll before me and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我面前铺开一卷白纸，什么都没说。

sentences.en: I stared until shapes began to form in the white space — clouds, a path, a door.
sentences.cn: 我盯着看，直到白色里面开始浮出形状——云，一条路，一扇门。

sentences.en: 'Your *imagination* is a compass,' she said softly.
'It points before the mind knows where it is going.'
sentences.cn: "它指向心还没反应过来的地方，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: Outside, the peak mist thickened.
sentences.cn: 外面的山峰雾气又浓了。

journey:2.en: I discovered a folded letter tucked inside my practice robe — no seal, no name. It read: 'Your *journey* does not begin at the gate. It began the morning you first named a cloud.' I read it twice under the lantern light. Xiaoxing appeared at the doorway, eyes wide, holding an identical letter.
journey:2.cnHint: 我在练功服中发现一封无名信，说我的____早在为云朵命名时就已开始，小星也拿着一封一模一样的信。
journey:2.hook: Neither of us had ever told the other about naming clouds.
journey:2.line: 'Every *journey* worth taking starts before the traveler is ready.'

sentences.en: I discovered a folded letter tucked inside my practice robe — no seal, no name.
sentences.cn: 我在练功服里翻出一封折叠的信——没有印章，也没有署名。

sentences.en: It read: 'Your *journey* does not begin at the gate.
It began the morning you first named a cloud.'
sentences.cn: 信上说你的旅程始于你第一次给云朵命名的那个早晨。

sentences.en: I read it twice under the lantern light.
sentences.cn: 我在灯下读了两遍。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing appeared at the doorway, eyes wide, holding an identical letter.
sentences.cn: 小杏出现在门口，眼睛睁得很圆，手里拿着一封一样的信。

nearby:2.en: A faint hum drew me off the stone path to a *nearby* hollow in the cliff face. Inside sat a small jade dish, still warm, as though someone had just set it down. It held a single dried herb I had never seen in any lesson. The hum was coming from the herb itself.
nearby:2.cnHint: 一阵嗡嗡声引我走向石路____的崖壁凹处，里面放着一株从未见过的草药，声音正是从它发出的。
nearby:2.hook: The herb's glow matched the color of a scar on my palm.
nearby:2.line: 'There is a *nearby* hollow the older disciples avoid — now you know why.'

sentences.en: A faint hum drew me off the stone path to a *nearby* hollow in the cliff face.
Inside sat a small jade dish, still warm, as though someone had just set it down.
sentences.cn: 里面放着一个小玉碟，还温热着，像是刚才才被放下去的。

sentences.en: It held a single dried herb I had never seen in any lesson.
sentences.cn: 碟子里躺着一根干草药，我在任何课程里都没见过。

sentences.en: The hum was coming from the herb itself.
sentences.cn: 那声音是从草药本身发出来的。

perspective:2.en: From the highest terrace, Shen Wujiu handed me a thin crystal lens and told me to look down. Through it, the sea of clouds below became a map of glowing lines. 'Change your *perspective*,' he said, 'and the same world becomes a different lesson.' One of the glowing lines was moving toward us.
perspective:2.cnHint: 师兄递给我一块水晶透镜，改变____后，云海化为发光的线条图，其中一条正朝我们移动。
perspective:2.hook: The moving line had the shape of a hand.
perspective:2.line: 'Shift your *perspective* and the mountain becomes a message written for you.'

sentences.en: From the highest terrace, Shen Wujiu handed me a thin crystal lens and told me to look down.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从最高的露台递给我一块薄薄的水晶镜片，让我往下看。

sentences.en: Through it, the sea of clouds below became a map of glowing lines.
sentences.cn: 透过它，下面的云海变成了一幅发光的线路图。

sentences.en: 'Change your *perspective*,' he said, 'and the same world becomes a different lesson.'
One of the glowing lines was moving toward us.
sentences.cn: 其中一条发光的线正朝我们移动。

requirement:2.en: Master Qingwu pinned a new list to the hall pillar at dawn. I read it carefully: only one *requirement* stood apart from the rest, circled in red — 'Before ascension, return one word to the wind.' No one could explain what it meant. By evening, the red circle had spread across the whole page.
requirement:2.cnHint: 师尊在柱上贴出新规，唯独一条____被红圈标出——飞升前需将一个字还给风——到傍晚红圈已蔓延全页。
requirement:2.hook: The spreading red ink smelled faintly of lightning.
requirement:2.line: 'The single *requirement* no elder will explain is the one that matters most.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu pinned a new list to the hall pillar at dawn.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在天亮时把一份新单子钉到了大厅的柱子上。

sentences.en: I read it carefully: only one *requirement* stood apart from the rest, circled in red — 'Before ascension, return one word to the wind.'
No one could explain what it meant.
sentences.cn: 没有人能解释那是什么意思。

sentences.en: By evening, the red circle had spread across the whole page.
sentences.cn: 到了傍晚，那个红圈已经蔓延到了整个页面。

signal:2.en: A blue flame appeared above the outer peak, burning without smoke or wood. Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve. 'That is how the mountain *signals* that a disciple is ready,' she whispered. We had both studied the signs, but neither of us expected to see one so soon. The flame bent slowly toward our window.
signal:2.cnHint: 外峰上突然出现蓝色火焰，小星说这是山向弟子发出____的方式，火焰随后缓缓朝我们的窗口倾斜。
signal:2.hook: It was bending toward one window — mine alone.
signal:2.line: 'When the mountain *signals*, you do not wait for permission to answer.'

sentences.en: A blue flame appeared above the outer peak, burning without smoke or wood.
sentences.cn: 外峰上出现了一团蓝色的火焰，烧得无烟无木。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 小杏抓住了我的衣袖。

sentences.en: 'That is how the mountain *signals* that a disciple is ready,' she whispered.
We had both studied the signs, but neither of us expected to see one so soon.
sentences.cn: 我们都学过这些信号，但谁也没想到会这么快看到一个。

sentences.en: The flame bent slowly toward our window.
sentences.cn: 火焰缓缓地朝我们的窗户弯去。

frame:2.en: Inside the archive tower, I found an old *frame* hanging on the stone wall — a wooden border holding nothing but empty air. Yet traced along its inner edge were faint spirit-words, each one a forgotten flying formula. Shen Wujiu pressed a finger to the wood and whispered that the scroll it once held had been taken the night a disciple vanished.
frame:2.cnHint: 我在藏经塔发现一个空____，边框上刻着失传的飞升咒文。
frame:2.hook: The nail that held the missing scroll was still warm.
frame:2.line: 'This *frame* once held the only map to the upper peaks,' said Shen Wujiu softly.

sentences.en: Inside the archive tower, I found an old *frame* hanging on the stone wall — a wooden border holding nothing but empty air.
Yet traced along its inner edge were faint spirit-words, each one a forgotten flying formula.
sentences.cn: 但沿着它的内边缘还留着淡淡的灵文，每一个都是一个被遗忘的飞行咒。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a finger to the wood and whispered that the scroll it once held had been taken the night a disciple vanished.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎用手指按在木头上，低声说那个被卷轴曾经被一个弟子消失的那晚被拿走了。

friday:2.en: Master Qingwu marked every *Friday* on the sect calendar with a red herb-stroke, calling it the Day of Open Wind. On those mornings the clouds parted and words spoken aloud carried twice their usual power. I found this written on a paper tucked beneath my practice stone, signed by a hand I did not recognise.
friday:2.cnHint: 我发现一张纸条，说明为何每个____是修炼飞升咒的最佳时机。
friday:2.hook: The paper dissolved before I could read the name at the bottom.
friday:2.line: 'Every *Friday* the sky listens more closely than usual,' the note read.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu marked every *Friday* on the sect calendar with a red herb-stroke, calling it the Day of Open Wind.
On those mornings the clouds parted and words spoken aloud carried twice their usual power.
sentences.cn: 在那些早晨，云会分开，大声说出的话会有两倍的力量。

sentences.en: I found this written on a paper tucked beneath my practice stone, signed by a hand I did not recognise.
sentences.cn: 我发现这些字被写在了我练功石下面的一张纸上，签名是我不认识的笔迹。

grain:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me a small jar on the shelf of the medicine hall. Inside lay a single dark *grain*, no larger than a apple seed, that hummed with a low and steady sound. She said it was a compressed word — an entire ascension formula pressed into one seed — and that no one in the sect knew how to open it.
grain:2.cnHint: 小星向我展示一粒神秘的____，里面封存着一套完整的飞升咒文。
grain:2.hook: The jar was cold, though the hall was warm.
grain:2.line: 'One *grain* like this holds more power than a whole page of formulas,' Xiaoxing murmured.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me a small jar on the shelf of the medicine hall.
sentences.cn: 小杏给我看了医疗室架子上的一个小罐子。

sentences.en: Inside lay a single dark *grain*, no larger than a apple seed, that hummed with a low and steady sound.
She said it was a compressed word — an entire ascension formula pressed into one seed — and that no one in the sect knew how to open it.
sentences.cn: 她说那是一个压缩的字——整个飞升咒被压进了一粒种子里——而且没有人知道怎么打开它。

implication:2.en: Master Qingwu handed me a letter sealed with cloud-blue wax. The words inside seemed plain at first — a list of herbs to gather before dawn. But Shen Wujiu read it over my shoulder and grew pale, saying the real *implication* was a warning: something was already moving through the lower peaks toward our gate.
implication:2.cnHint: 师兄看了那封信后脸色发白，因为他读出了其中隐藏的____。
implication:2.hook: The wax seal bore a crack that had not been there a moment before.
implication:2.line: 'The *implication* of these words is that we have very little time,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed me a letter sealed with cloud-blue wax.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊递给我一封用云蓝色蜡封起来的信。

sentences.en: The words inside seemed plain at first — a list of herbs to gather before dawn.
sentences.cn: 里面的字起初看起来很平常——一份在天亮前要收集的草药清单。

sentences.en: But Shen Wujiu read it over my shoulder and grew pale, saying the real *implication* was a warning: something was already moving through the lower peaks toward our gate.

incredible:2.en: Pinned to the door of the word-garden was a rubbing of an ancient stone inscription. The characters were *incredible* in their size and detail, each stroke as wide as my arm, carved by someone who must have stood twenty feet tall — or who had learned to write with the wind itself as a brush.
incredible:2.cnHint: 我在字园门口发现一幅拓印，上面那些____的巨大字迹令人无法想象是人力所为。
incredible:2.hook: One character at the edge of the rubbing was still wet.
incredible:2.line: 'It is *incredible* that any hand could carve words this deep into living stone,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Pinned to the door of the word-garden was a rubbing of an ancient stone inscription.
sentences.cn: 钉在字园门上的是一份古代石刻铭文的拓片。

sentences.en: The characters were *incredible* in their size and detail, each stroke as wide as my arm, carved by someone who must have stood twenty feet tall — or who had learned to write with the wind itself as a brush.

net:2.en: Spread across the floor of the observation deck was a *net* woven from dried cloud-fiber, its knots tied at the crossing points of a dozen flight-paths the sect had charted over centuries. Xiaoxing told me that whoever fell through it during ascension practice would lose their spoken words for one full day — a punishment and a lesson at once.
net:2.cnHint: 我在观云台发现一张用云丝织成的____，据说能让失控飞升的弟子哑口无言。
net:2.hook: Three of the knots had been cut clean through since yesterday.
net:2.line: 'Step carefully — the *net* below is the only thing between you and the sea of clouds,' Xiaoxing warned.

sentences.en: Spread across the floor of the observation deck was a *net* woven from dried cloud-fiber, its knots tied at the crossing points of a dozen flight-paths the sect had charted over centuries.
Xiaoxing told me that whoever fell through it during ascension practice would lose their spoken words for one full day — a punishment and a lesson at once.
sentences.cn: 小杏告诉我，在飞升练习中谁要是从网子里掉下去，就会失去整整一天的说话能力——既是惩罚，也是教训。

obtain:2.en: Tucked inside a hollow bamboo tube near the peak library, I found a note in Shen Wujiu's handwriting. It said that to *obtain* the highest flying word, a disciple must first spend one night alone on the outer ledge with no lamp and no company — not as a test of courage, but as proof that silence was already part of them.
obtain:2.cnHint: 师兄的字条说明，若想____那个最高阶的飞升咒字，弟子必须先独自在悬崖过一夜。
obtain:2.hook: The bamboo tube had been placed there that very morning.
obtain:2.line: 'You cannot *obtain* a word that the wind has not already heard in you,' Shen Wujiu had written.

sentences.en: Tucked inside a hollow bamboo tube near the peak library, I found a note in Shen Wujiu's handwriting.
sentences.cn: 我在山峰图书馆附近的一根竹筒里面发现了一张沈无咎的笔迹的纸条。

sentences.en: It said that to *obtain* the highest flying word, a disciple must first spend one night alone on the outer ledge with no lamp and no company — not as a test of courage, but as proof that silence was already part of them.

pair:2.en: On the altar of the word-hall lay a *pair* of jade tablets, one carved with the word for rising and one with the word for returning. Master Qingwu said they were always kept together because neither formula worked alone — ascension without return was not flying, she told me quietly, it was simply falling in a hopeful direction.
pair:2.cnHint: 祭坛上摆着____玉简，分别刻有飞升与归返的咒字，缺一不可。
pair:2.hook: When I reached out, the returning tablet felt heavier than the rising one.
pair:2.line: 'This *pair* of words must be learned as one breath, not two,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: On the altar of the word-hall lay a *pair* of jade tablets, one carved with the word for rising and one with the word for returning.
Master Qingwu said they were always kept together because neither formula worked alone — ascension without return was not flying, she told me quietly, it was simply falling in a hopeful direction.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说它们总是放在一起，因为这两个咒单独用都不行——她静静地告诉我，没有回程的飞升不是飞行，那只是在抱着希望的同时往下掉。

persuade:2.en: Master Qingwu set the sealed scroll on the stone table between us. 'This formula is not meant for a first-year disciple,' she said. I had studied it for seven nights without sleep, and I tried to *persuade* her that I was ready — laying out each step of the breathing method, calm and clear. She listened without a word. At last she nodded, once.
persuade:2.cnHint: 弟子努力____师尊，希望获准修炼那卷封印卷轴。
persuade:2.hook: But her eyes drifted to the sky, where a cloud had turned the colour of ash.
persuade:2.line: 'I must *persuade* you with proof, not with words alone.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set the sealed scroll on the stone table between us.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把封好的卷轴放在我们之间的石桌上。

sentences.en: 'This formula is not meant for a first-year disciple,' she said.
sentences.cn: "这个秘诀不是给一年级弟子学的，"她说。

sentences.en: I had studied it for seven nights without sleep, and I tried to *persuade* her that I was ready — laying out each step of the breathing method, calm and clear.
She listened without a word.
sentences.cn: 她一言不发地听着。

sentences.en: At last she nodded, once.
sentences.cn: 最后她点了一次头。

preference:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread three herb-scrolls across the floor of the archive cave and told me to choose. Each scroll held a different path: one for speed, one for strength, one for healing. 'Your *preference* will shape every lesson that follows,' he said quietly. I reached for the healing scroll without hesitation. It felt warm, like a held breath.
preference:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，我对修炼方向的____将决定未来所有的课程。
preference:2.hook: The moment my fingers closed around it, the candle flame bent toward me.
preference:2.line: 'What is your *preference* — the path of force or the path of mending?'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread three herb-scrolls across the floor of the archive cave and told me to choose.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在档案洞的地板上铺开三卷草药卷，让我选择。

sentences.en: Each scroll held a different path: one for speed, one for strength, one for healing.
sentences.cn: 每卷代表不同的路：一条为了速度，一条为了力量，一条为了治愈。

sentences.en: 'Your *preference* will shape every lesson that follows,' he said quietly.
I reached for the healing scroll without hesitation.
sentences.cn: 我毫不犹豫地伸手去拿治愈卷。

sentences.en: It felt warm, like a held breath.
sentences.cn: 它摸起来很温暖，像被握住的一口气。

reliable:2.en: Xiaoxing slipped a small jade tablet into my hand before dawn. 'I copied this star-path chart myself,' she whispered. 'Every marking is *reliable* — I checked it three times against the sect library.' The chart showed a narrow bridge of air current that could carry a disciple from our peak to the forbidden archive in under an hour. I tucked it inside my robe.
reliable:2.cnHint: 师妹把一块亲手抄录的玉简交给我，说上面每个标记都是____的。
reliable:2.hook: By the time I looked up, she was already gone, and the morning bell had not yet rung.
reliable:2.line: 'Trust this chart — every line on it is *reliable*.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing slipped a small jade tablet into my hand before dawn.
sentences.cn: 小杏在天亮前把一块小玉牌塞进我的手里。

sentences.en: 'I copied this star-path chart myself,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "这是我自己抄的星路图，"她小声说。

sentences.en: 'Every marking is *reliable* — I checked it three times against the sect library.'
The chart showed a narrow bridge of air current that could carry a disciple from our peak to the forbidden archive in under an hour.
sentences.cn: 图上标出了一条狭窄的气流桥，可以在一小时内把弟子从我们的山峰送到禁地档案室。

sentences.en: I tucked it inside my robe.
sentences.cn: 我把它塞进衣服里。

suspect:2.en: I found the herb-pouch lying open on the practice ledge, its rarest leaf missing. No wind could have taken it — the air that morning was perfectly still. I began to *suspect* that someone had entered the hall before sunrise, moving without sound, leaving no footprint on the stone dust except one faint smudge near the eastern pillar. I did not speak of it to anyone.
suspect:2.cnHint: 药囊中最珍贵的叶片不见了，我开始____有人在黎明前悄悄进入了修炼堂。
suspect:2.hook: That evening, the eastern pillar glowed faintly for three long breaths.
suspect:2.line: 'I *suspect* the missing leaf did not simply fall.'

sentences.en: I found the herb-pouch lying open on the practice ledge, its rarest leaf missing.
sentences.cn: 我在练习台上发现草药袋敞开着，最珍贵的那片叶子不见了。

sentences.en: No wind could have taken it — the air that morning was perfectly still.
sentences.cn: 没有风能吹走它——那天早上的空气完全静止。

sentences.en: I began to *suspect* that someone had entered the hall before sunrise, moving without sound, leaving no footprint on the stone dust except one faint smudge near the eastern pillar.
I did not speak of it to anyone.
sentences.cn: 我没有把这事告诉任何人。

yield:2.en: The climbing trial required each disciple to carry a stone word-tablet up the ice steps of Mirror Peak. Halfway up, my legs shook and the weight dragged at my shoulders. Every part of me wanted to *yield* and set the tablet down. I thought of Master Qingwu's voice: 'the word does not bend.' I straightened, took one more step, then another, until the summit stone was beneath my feet.
yield:2.cnHint: 登顶试炼途中，我几乎想____放弃，但师尊的话让我坚持了下来。
yield:2.hook: At the top, I found a second tablet waiting — one nobody had placed there.
yield:2.line: 'Do not *yield* to the weight; let the weight teach your legs.'

sentences.en: The climbing trial required each disciple to carry a stone word-tablet up the ice steps of Mirror Peak.
sentences.cn: 攀登试验要求每个弟子背着一块石刻字牌爬上镜峰的冰阶。

sentences.en: Halfway up, my legs shook and the weight dragged at my shoulders.
sentences.cn: 爬到一半时，我的腿开始发抖，重量在压着我的肩膀。

sentences.en: Every part of me wanted to *yield* and set the tablet down.
I thought of Master Qingwu's voice: 'the word does not bend.'
sentences.cn: 我想起青梧师尊的声音："字不会弯。"

sentences.en: I straightened, took one more step, then another, until the summit stone was beneath my feet.
sentences.cn: 我挺直身体，迈出一步，又一步，直到山顶的石头在我脚下。

abandon:2.en: Shen Wujiu found me at the cliff edge, staring down at the sea of clouds where I had dropped my first practice scroll. 'Do not *abandon* the form just because one scroll is lost,' he said, handing me a blank one. 'The words live in the hand that wrote them, not in the paper.' I held the new scroll and breathed slowly. Somewhere below, the clouds parted for a moment, and I saw light.
abandon:2.cnHint: 师兄劝我不要因为丢失了第一卷练习卷轴就____整套功法。
abandon:2.hook: The clouds closed again instantly, as though they had shown me something by mistake.
abandon:2.line: 'Never *abandon* a path simply because the first step cost you something.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu found me at the cliff edge, staring down at the sea of clouds where I had dropped my first practice scroll.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在悬崖边找到我，我在盯着云海——那是我掉下的第一卷练习卷所在的地方。

sentences.en: 'Do not *abandon* the form just because one scroll is lost,' he said, handing me a blank one.
'The words live in the hand that wrote them, not in the paper.'
sentences.cn: "文字活在写它的手里，不在纸上。"

sentences.en: I held the new scroll and breathed slowly.
sentences.cn: 我握着新卷轴，慢慢地呼吸。

sentences.en: Somewhere below, the clouds parted for a moment, and I saw light.
sentences.cn: 云下面某处，云散开了一瞬，我看到了光。

anxious:2.en: The night before the sect's open trial, I lay awake on the narrow sleeping mat, too *anxious* to close my eyes. Each formula I had learned seemed to slip away the moment I reached for it in the dark. Xiaoxing slid a folded note under my door: three words in her careful brushwork — 'you already know.' I pressed the note flat and finally let my breathing slow.
anxious:2.cnHint: 大考前夜，我____得无法入睡，直到师妹送来的一张纸条让我平静下来。
anxious:2.hook: At midnight the sect bell rang once, though it was not yet time.
anxious:2.line: 'Being *anxious* is proof you care — now let that care become focus.'

sentences.en: The night before the sect's open trial, I lay awake on the narrow sleeping mat, too *anxious* to close my eyes.
Each formula I had learned seemed to slip away the moment I reached for it in the dark.
sentences.cn: 我学过的每个秘诀似乎都在我在黑暗中去抓它的那一刻溜走。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing slid a folded note under my door: three words in her careful brushwork — 'you already know.'
sentences.cn: 小杏从我的门下塞进一张折好的纸条：她笔下三个字——"你已经会了"。

sentences.en: I pressed the note flat and finally let my breathing slow.
