sentences.cn: 我把纸条压平，终于让我的呼吸平缓下来。

assess:2.en: Master Qingwu walked the length of the practice hall, watching each disciple hold their chosen formula in silence. When she reached me she paused the longest. 'I need to *assess* not only what you have memorised,' she said, 'but what you understand.' She asked me to explain a single word from memory — its root, its use, its risk. I spoke for ten minutes without stopping.
assess:2.cnHint: 师尊在修炼堂中巡视，停在我面前说，她需要____的不只是我的记忆，更是我的理解。
assess:2.hook: When I finished, the ink on the wall behind her had rearranged itself into a new character.
assess:2.line: 'I will *assess* your understanding, not your memory of the page.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu walked the length of the practice hall, watching each disciple hold their chosen formula in silence.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊走过练习厅的长度，看着每个弟子在沉默中保持自己选定的秘诀。

sentences.en: When she reached me she paused the longest.
sentences.cn: 她走到我这里停留最久。

sentences.en: 'I need to *assess* not only what you have memorised,' she said, 'but what you understand.'
She asked me to explain a single word from memory — its root, its use, its risk.
sentences.cn: 她让我从记忆中解释一个单字——它的根源、它的用法、它的风险。

sentences.en: I spoke for ten minutes without stopping.
sentences.cn: 我不停地讲了十分钟。

behave:2.en: The sealed scroll room on the third peak held one rule carved above the door. 'A word spoken carelessly can shatter stone,' Master Qingwu had warned. I pressed my palm to the cold wood and entered. Every herb-word on the shelves seemed to watch me, waiting to see how I would *behave* before offering its power.
behave:2.cnHint: 在封印卷轴室里，弟子明白自己的____将决定草药之言是否愿意显现力量。
behave:2.hook: One scroll trembled on its shelf, though no wind had entered.
behave:2.line: 'Show the words how you *behave*, and they will decide whether to answer you.'

sentences.en: The sealed scroll room on the third peak held one rule carved above the door.
sentences.cn: 第三座山峰的封闭卷轴室门上刻着一条规则。

sentences.en: 'A word spoken carelessly can shatter stone,' Master Qingwu had warned.
sentences.cn: "随意说出的一个字就能击碎石头，"青梧师尊曾经警告。

sentences.en: I pressed my palm to the cold wood and entered.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌贴在冷冰冰的木门上，进去了。

sentences.en: Every herb-word on the shelves seemed to watch me, waiting to see how I would *behave* before offering its power.

cent:2.en: Xiaoxing spread the cloud-market ledger across the moss-covered stone. Each spiritual herb-word had a price, marked in sky-copper coins. 'We have spent every last *cent* of our sect allowance,' she said softly. Without coin, the healing word for frostbite could not be borrowed before the cold season came.
cent:2.cnHint: 小星发现弟子们已花光了每一____，无法从云市购买治愈霜伤的草药之言。
cent:2.hook: Somewhere below the clouds, a coin rang against hollow stone — once, then silence.
cent:2.line: 'Not one *cent* remains, and the frost word costs more than I thought.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread the cloud-market ledger across the moss-covered stone.
sentences.cn: 小杏把云市账本铺在长满苔藓的石头上。

sentences.en: Each spiritual herb-word had a price, marked in sky-copper coins.
sentences.cn: 每个灵性草药字都有一个价格，用天铜币标记。

sentences.en: 'We have spent every last *cent* of our sect allowance,' she said softly.
Without coin, the healing word for frostbite could not be borrowed before the cold season came.
sentences.cn: 没有币，冻伤的治愈字在寒季来临前就借不到。

commercial:2.en: A sealed notice was nailed to the sect gate, written in the heavy ink of the Cloud Sea trading hall. It announced that the *commercial* exchange of rare herb-words was now restricted to licensed masters only. I read it twice, my borrowed word for wind still unregistered. The gate bell rang, unasked.
commercial:2.cnHint: 布告栏上张贴了一份关于____交易的新规，弟子手中未登记的草药之言面临风险。
commercial:2.hook: My sleeve, where the wind-word rested, grew suddenly warm.
commercial:2.line: 'The *commercial* trade of unbound words has been closed since last night's bell.'

sentences.en: A sealed notice was nailed to the sect gate, written in the heavy ink of the Cloud Sea trading hall.
sentences.cn: 一张封闭的告示被钉在宗门的门上，用云海贸易厅沉重的墨水写的。

sentences.en: It announced that the *commercial* exchange of rare herb-words was now restricted to licensed masters only.
I read it twice, my borrowed word for wind still unregistered.
sentences.cn: 我读了两遍，我借来的风字还没注册。

sentences.en: The gate bell rang, unasked.
sentences.cn: 门钟自己响了。

death:2.en: Shen Wujiu found the old record buried beneath the archive floor, its pages the color of ash. It described a disciple who had spoken a storm-word without grounding it first. The single line about the outcome read only: '*death* came before the echo faded.' I closed the record and did not open it again.
death:2.cnHint: 旧档案中记载着一位弟子因未稳固风暴之言而遭遇的____，令人心寒。
death:2.hook: The candle above the archive shelf bent its flame toward the closed record, then went still.
death:2.line: '*Death* left only one line in the record — that should be lesson enough.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu found the old record buried beneath the archive floor, its pages the color of ash.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在档案室地板下找到了那份旧记录，页面的颜色像灰烬。

sentences.en: It described a disciple who had spoken a storm-word without grounding it first.
sentences.cn: 它讲述了一个弟子说了一个风暴字但没有先稳住它。

sentences.en: The single line about the outcome read only: '*death* came before the echo faded.'
I closed the record and did not open it again.
sentences.cn: 我关上了记录，再没打开过。

escape:2.en: The mist maze on the lower peak was designed to hold wandering herb-words that had lost their masters. I followed a thread of pale light, turning left, then right. There seemed to be no *escape* from the circling fog until I spoke the grounding word softly and the path opened like a held breath released.
escape:2.cnHint: 在迷雾迷宫中，弟子找不到____的出路，直到一个定根之言打开了通道。
escape:2.hook: Behind me, something in the fog repeated my grounding word back, note for note.
escape:2.line: 'There is no *escape* from this maze unless the maze itself decides to let you go.'

sentences.en: The mist maze on the lower peak was designed to hold wandering herb-words that had lost their masters.
sentences.cn: 下峰的迷雾阵是用来困住那些失去了主人的流浪词语的。

sentences.en: I followed a thread of pale light, turning left, then right.
sentences.cn: 我跟着一缕苍白的光线，左转，右转。

sentences.en: There seemed to be no *escape* from the circling fog until I spoke the grounding word softly and the path opened like a held breath released.

expose:2.en: Shen Wujiu lifted the stone panel near the waterfall root and gestured for me to look. Beneath it, carved channels held faint, glowing script — the sect's oldest foundation words, laid down before any building stood. 'We *expose* these only to those who have passed the second seal,' he said. The glow brightened as I leaned closer.
expose:2.cnHint: 师兄掀开石板，向弟子____了宗门最古老的根基之言，隐藏在瀑布脚下的暗渠中。
expose:2.hook: One carved word I did not recognise pulsed once, as though it recognised me.
expose:2.line: 'We only *expose* these root words when the disciple is ready to carry their weight.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu lifted the stone panel near the waterfall root and gestured for me to look.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎撑起瀑布根部的石板，示意我看下去。

sentences.en: Beneath it, carved channels held faint, glowing script — the sect's oldest foundation words, laid down before any building stood.
sentences.cn: 底下刻着导管，里面闪烁着微弱的发光文字——宗门最古老的基础词，是在任何建筑竖起前就镌刻下来的。

sentences.en: 'We *expose* these only to those who have passed the second seal,' he said.
The glow brightened as I leaned closer.
sentences.cn: 我凑近时，那光亮更闪耀了。

floor:2.en: The message was not written on paper. It was pressed into the stone *floor* of the empty meditation hall, one character at a time, each letter faintly warm to the touch. Xiaoxing knelt beside me as I read it: a warning that the word for rising wind had been taken without record. Above us, the hall roof creaked.
floor:2.cnHint: 弟子在禅室____上发现了一条刻字警告，说明有人秘密取走了升风之言。
floor:2.hook: The last letter faded as we finished reading, leaving the stone cold and smooth.
floor:2.line: 'Read the *floor* carefully — whoever left this did not want it to last long.'

sentences.en: The message was not written on paper.
sentences.cn: 信息不是写在纸上的。

sentences.en: It was pressed into the stone *floor* of the empty meditation hall, one character at a time, each letter faintly warm to the touch.
Xiaoxing knelt beside me as I read it: a warning that the word for rising wind had been taken without record.
sentences.cn: 小杏跪在我身边，看我读着：一个警告，说上升风的词被偷走了，没有任何记录。

sentences.en: Above us, the hall roof creaked.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶，大厅的屋顶吱呀吱呀地响。

foundation:2.en: Master Qingwu led me to the deepest chamber of the sect archive. She placed her hand on a plain gray block at the center of the room. 'Every word you will learn rests on this,' she said. 'Understand it or nothing else will hold.' The block was carved with a single common word — the *foundation* of all cultivation. My hands shook as I copied it down.
foundation:2.cnHint: 师尊带弟子来到档案室最深处，指出所有修炼之言的____都刻于一块朴素的石台之上。
foundation:2.hook: When I lifted my brush, the ink moved on its own, drawing a second word beneath the first.
foundation:2.line: 'Without this *foundation*, every word you master will collapse in a strong wind.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led me to the deepest chamber of the sect archive.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊领我进了宗门藏经阁最深的密室。

sentences.en: She placed her hand on a plain gray block at the center of the room.
sentences.cn: 她把手放在房间中央一块朴素的灰色石块上。

sentences.en: 'Every word you will learn rests on this,' she said.
sentences.cn: "你将要学的每一个词都基于这个，"她说。

sentences.en: 'Understand it or nothing else will hold.'
sentences.cn: "理解它，否则其他什么都站不住。"

sentences.en: The block was carved with a single common word — the *foundation* of all cultivation.
My hands shook as I copied it down.
sentences.cn: 我的手颤抖着把它抄了下来。

strength:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled the old scroll on the stone table. 'Every sect needs a word that holds it together,' she said. 'Ours is this one.' The word glowed like a root reaching deep into mountain rock, and I felt its *strength* fill my arms like warm water rising. Outside, the wind went still.
strength:2.cnHint: 师尊展示了一个古老字符，它象征着云海宗的____，令我全身充满力量。
strength:2.hook: Then the scroll's edges began, slowly, to burn.
strength:2.line: 'Feel its *strength* enter your bones — that is how the mountain stands.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled the old scroll on the stone table.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石桌上展开了老卷轴。

sentences.en: 'Every sect needs a word that holds it together,' she said.
sentences.cn: "每个宗门都需要一个词来把它们聚在一起，"她说。

sentences.en: 'Ours is this one.'
sentences.cn: "我们的就是这一个。"

sentences.en: The word glowed like a root reaching deep into mountain rock, and I felt its *strength* fill my arms like warm water rising.
Outside, the wind went still.
sentences.cn: 外面，风停了。

survive:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade tablet carved with a single word. 'Disciples who crossed the Pale Bridge carried this,' he said quietly. 'Most did not return. The ones who did say the word let them *survive* when the clouds turned against them.' I held the cold jade and said nothing.
survive:2.cnHint: 师兄交给我一块玉牌，据说它帮助过去的弟子____了渡桥之险。
survive:2.hook: A crack, thin as a hair, now split the jade from edge to edge.
survive:2.line: 'Only those who truly knew the word could *survive* the crossing.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade tablet carved with a single word.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一块刻着单个字的小玉牌。

sentences.en: 'Disciples who crossed the Pale Bridge carried this,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "过了苍白桥的弟子都带着这个，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: 'Most did not return.
sentences.cn: "大多数人没有回来。

sentences.en: The ones who did say the word let them *survive* when the clouds turned against them.'
I held the cold jade and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 我握着冰冷的玉牌，什么也没说。

touch:2.en: On the eastern ledge I found a message stone, the kind used only for urgent words. Someone had pressed a single character into its surface with great care. The *touch* of my fingers on the carved lines sent a soft pulse up my arm, and for a moment I heard Master Qingwu's voice, though she was nowhere near.
touch:2.cnHint: 我在崖边发现了一块传信石，手指____它时，隐约听见了师尊的声音。
touch:2.hook: The character on the stone was one I had never been taught.
touch:2.line: 'One *touch* of that stone and the word will know your heart.'

sentences.en: On the eastern ledge I found a message stone, the kind used only for urgent words.
sentences.cn: 在东崖我找到了一块信息石，这种石头只用来传递紧急的词。

sentences.en: Someone had pressed a single character into its surface with great care.
sentences.cn: 有人用很大的耐心把一个字压进了它的表面。

sentences.en: The *touch* of my fingers on the carved lines sent a soft pulse up my arm, and for a moment I heard Master Qingwu's voice, though she was nowhere near.

trap:2.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the ring of white herbs growing in a perfect circle near the cliff's edge. 'Do not step inside,' she warned. 'It looks like a gift, but it is a *trap* — the herbs release a word that fogs the mind and pulls a disciple over the ledge.' I stepped back, grateful she had found me in time.
trap:2.cnHint: 师妹警告我，那圈草药看似礼物，实为____，会让人神志不清而坠崖。
trap:2.hook: Inside the circle, someone had already left a single footprint.
trap:2.line: 'That ring is a *trap* set for disciples who are too eager to collect rare herbs.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the ring of white herbs growing in a perfect circle near the cliff's edge.
sentences.cn: 小杏指着崖边长出来的那圈完美的白色草药。

sentences.en: 'Do not step inside,' she warned.
sentences.cn: "不要踏进去，"她警告说。

sentences.en: 'It looks like a gift, but it is a *trap* — the herbs release a word that fogs the mind and pulls a disciple over the ledge.'
I stepped back, grateful she had found me in time.
sentences.cn: 我向后退去，感激她及时找到了我。

tv:2.en: The elder's hall held many wonders, but nothing stopped me like the mirror on the north wall. Shen Wujiu saw my face and smiled. 'The sect calls it the sky-glass. Outsiders from the low lands call it a *tv*. To us it is simply a window — it shows what the clouds wish us to see.' Today the clouds showed nothing but grey.
tv:2.cnHint: 师兄解释说，长老堂里的天镜就是外面世界所说的____，用于观察云端异象。
tv:2.hook: Then a single image appeared: the Cloud Sea Sect's own gate, standing open and unguarded.
tv:2.line: 'Call it a *tv* if you like — the clouds decide what it chooses to reveal.'

sentences.en: The elder's hall held many wonders, but nothing stopped me like the mirror on the north wall.
sentences.cn: 长老殿里有很多奇迹，但没有什么能像北墙上那面镜子一样让我驻足。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu saw my face and smiled.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎看到我的脸，笑了。

sentences.en: 'The sect calls it the sky-glass.
sentences.cn: "宗门叫它天玻璃。

sentences.en: Outsiders from the low lands call it a *tv*.
To us it is simply a window — it shows what the clouds wish us to see.'
sentences.cn: 对我们来说，它就是个窗户——它展示云想让我们看到的东西。"

sentences.en: Today the clouds showed nothing but grey.
sentences.cn: 今天云只展示了灰色。

victim:2.en: A folded note lay under my meditation mat. It named a disciple from three years past, someone I had never met, and beneath the name were two words: 'first *victim*.' Master Qingwu arrived before I could call out, read the note without blinking, and placed it carefully inside her robe. She said only, 'Study harder tonight.'
victim:2.cnHint: 我在蒲团下发现一张字条，上面写着一位昔日弟子是某件事的第一个____。
victim:2.hook: That night every lamp in the hall went out at exactly the same moment.
victim:2.line: 'That disciple was the first *victim* of a word none of us had learned to contain.'

sentences.en: A folded note lay under my meditation mat.
sentences.cn: 一张折叠的纸条躺在我的打坐垫下。

sentences.en: It named a disciple from three years past, someone I had never met, and beneath the name were two words: 'first *victim*.'
Master Qingwu arrived before I could call out, read the note without blinking, and placed it carefully inside her robe.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我还没来得及呼救前就到了，读了纸条，眼睛没眨一下，然后小心地把它装进了她的衣袍里。

sentences.en: She said only, 'Study harder tonight.'
sentences.cn: 她只说，"今晚要用功读书。"

zone:2.en: Master Qingwu drew a line across the map with her finger. 'Beyond this ridge is the silent *zone*,' she said. 'Words spoken there carry no power and return no echo. If you lose your footing, no formula will save you.' She folded the map and handed it to me without another word.
zone:2.cnHint: 师尊在地图上划出一片____，在那里所有字诀都会失效，极度危险。
zone:2.hook: My name was already written, in someone else's hand, on the far side of that line.
zone:2.line: 'Enter that *zone* and every word you know becomes silent and useless.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a line across the map with her finger.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用手指在地图上划了一条线。

sentences.en: 'Beyond this ridge is the silent *zone*,' she said.
'Words spoken there carry no power and return no echo.
sentences.cn: "那里说出的词没有任何力量，也没有任何回响。

sentences.en: If you lose your footing, no formula will save you.'
sentences.cn: 如果你失去了立足点，没有任何公式能救你。"

sentences.en: She folded the map and handed it to me without another word.
sentences.cn: 她叠起地图，没有再说一个字就递给了我。

afraid:2.en: Xiaoxing found me sitting alone at the edge of the floating platform, staring down at the sea of clouds far below. 'You are *afraid* of the height,' she said, and it was not a question. She sat beside me and placed a small word-stone in my palm. 'So was I, on my first day. Say the word on the stone out loud.' I did, and the clouds below seemed, just slightly, less far away.
afraid:2.cnHint: 师妹发现我独坐高台边缘，她看出我____那无尽的云海深渊，便给了我一块字石。
afraid:2.hook: Yet when I looked up, the sky above had turned the colour of old ash.
afraid:2.line: 'I was *afraid* too — until I learned which word to speak at the edge.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found me sitting alone at the edge of the floating platform, staring down at the sea of clouds far below.
sentences.cn: 小杏找到我时，我独自坐在浮空平台的边缘，盯着下面远远的云海。

sentences.en: 'You are *afraid* of the height,' she said, and it was not a question.
She sat beside me and placed a small word-stone in my palm.
sentences.cn: 她在我身边坐下，把一块小字石放在我的手心里。

sentences.en: 'So was I, on my first day.
sentences.cn: "我第一天时也是，

sentences.en: Say the word on the stone out loud.'
sentences.cn: 大声说出石头上的词。"

sentences.en: I did, and the clouds below seemed, just slightly, less far away.
sentences.cn: 我照做了，下面的云似乎，只是稍稍，没有那么遥远了。

beautiful:2.en: The scroll arrived at dawn, carried by a wind that smelled of pine and cold stone. I unrolled it carefully. Inside, a single word glowed in silver ink — a word so *beautiful* that my eyes filled with tears before I could even read it aloud. Shen Wujiu stood beside me, silent, his breath held.
beautiful:2.cnHint: 一个字写在银色墨水里，美得让叙述者还未开口就已热泪盈眶。
beautiful:2.hook: But the silver ink began to bleed, as if the word were weeping.
beautiful:2.line: 'That word is *beautiful*, but beauty this sharp always carries a cost.'

sentences.en: The scroll arrived at dawn, carried by a wind that smelled of pine and cold stone.
sentences.cn: 卷轴在黎明时分到了，被一阵闻起来有松木和冷石头味道的风吹来。

sentences.en: I unrolled it carefully.
sentences.cn: 我小心地展开了它。

sentences.en: Inside, a single word glowed in silver ink — a word so *beautiful* that my eyes filled with tears before I could even read it aloud.
Shen Wujiu stood beside me, silent, his breath held.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在我身边，沉默着，屏住了呼吸。

combine:2.en: Xiaoxing spread three word-tablets on the stone floor of the archive cave. 'Watch,' she said. She pressed two together and the air hummed. To *combine* the right words was a rare skill — one that could lift a whole mountain or silence a storm. The third tablet began to shake on its own.
combine:2.cnHint: 小星在档案洞中将三块字碑____在一起，演示了一种罕见的技艺。
combine:2.hook: The third tablet had not been touched, yet it rose slowly into the air.
combine:2.line: 'If you *combine* these two words wrongly, the cave will seal itself forever.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread three word-tablets on the stone floor of the archive cave.
sentences.cn: 小杏在档案洞的石地板上摊开了三块字板。

sentences.en: 'Watch,' she said.
sentences.cn: "看着，"她说。

sentences.en: She pressed two together and the air hummed.
sentences.cn: 她把其中两块按在一起，空气嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: To *combine* the right words was a rare skill — one that could lift a whole mountain or silence a storm.
The third tablet began to shake on its own.
sentences.cn: 第三块字板开始自己颤抖起来。

complicated:2.en: Master Qingwu handed me a folded letter sealed with cloud-wax. The message inside was short, but its meaning was *complicated* — each line seemed to say two things at once, and the words shifted slightly each time I read them. I sat with it for an hour before I understood even half.
complicated:2.cnHint: 师尊交给叙述者一封短信，其含义却____，每次重读都有不同之意。
complicated:2.hook: When I folded the letter again, a line I had never seen before appeared.
complicated:2.line: 'The path ahead is *complicated*, but the first step is simply to read with a still heart.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed me a folded letter sealed with cloud-wax.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊递给我一封折起来的信，用云蜡封着。

sentences.en: The message inside was short, but its meaning was *complicated* — each line seemed to say two things at once, and the words shifted slightly each time I read them.
I sat with it for an hour before I understood even half.
sentences.cn: 我坐了一个小时才理解了其中一半。

crash:2.en: I heard it before I saw it — a *crash* like a mountain splitting, rolling up from the sea of clouds far below. A stone platform the size of a courtyard broke free from the cliff and fell without sound into the white mist. Shen Wujiu caught my sleeve before I could step closer to the edge.
crash:2.cnHint: 叙述者听到一声巨响，一块巨大的石台从悬崖边脱落，沉入云海。
crash:2.hook: In the mist below, something large and dark rose slowly toward us.
crash:2.line: 'That *crash* was not an accident — someone spoke a breaking word down there.'

sentences.en: I heard it before I saw it — a *crash* like a mountain splitting, rolling up from the sea of clouds far below.
A stone platform the size of a courtyard broke free from the cliff and fell without sound into the white mist.
sentences.cn: 一块有庭院那么大的石台从悬崖上裂开掉了下去，无声地坠入下方白茫茫的云海里。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu caught my sleeve before I could step closer to the edge.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在我靠近悬崖边之前抓住了我的袖子。

creature:2.en: Tucked inside an old word-chest in the upper library, I found a small drawing on silk. It showed a *creature* with the body of a fish and the wings of a cloud-hawk, hovering between two peaks. No one I asked had ever seen such a thing. The drawing was warm to the touch.
creature:2.cnHint: 叙述者在旧字箱里发现了一幅丝绸画，上面绘有一种从未见过的____。
creature:2.hook: That night, something circled the peak three times and left no shadow.
creature:2.line: 'A *creature* that appears in a sect drawing is never merely a legend — look again.'

sentences.en: Tucked inside an old word-chest in the upper library, I found a small drawing on silk.
sentences.cn: 在上面的藏书阁里一口老字箱的深处，我找到了一幅画在丝绸上的小画。

sentences.en: It showed a *creature* with the body of a fish and the wings of a cloud-hawk, hovering between two peaks.
No one I asked had ever seen such a thing.
sentences.cn: 我问过的人都没见过这样的东西。

sentences.en: The drawing was warm to the touch.
sentences.cn: 画摸起来是温热的。

crime:2.en: The sealed room in the east tower held a single document under glass: a record of the great *crime* of the Third Elder — the theft of the Ascension Word a hundred years ago. I pressed my palm to the glass and felt a cold shock run up my arm, as if the word itself still remembered the theft.
crime:2.cnHint: 东塔密室中存有一份百年前记录____的文件，叙述者触碰时感到一阵寒意。
crime:2.hook: The document's last line named a punishment that had never been carried out.
crime:2.line: 'Stealing a sacred word is a *crime* that echoes forward — it changes every disciple who comes after.'

sentences.en: The sealed room in the east tower held a single document under glass: a record of the great *crime* of the Third Elder — the theft of the Ascension Word a hundred years ago.
I pressed my palm to the glass and felt a cold shock run up my arm, as if the word itself still remembered the theft.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌贴在玻璃上，感到一阵冷冽的震颤从手臂窜上来，仿佛那个字本身还记得这场盗窃。

deeply:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed the small jade token into my hand without a word. I turned it over and found my name carved on the back — carved *deeply*, as if whoever had cut it had wanted the name to last beyond stone. I did not know when he had made it. The token was still warm.
deeply:2.cnHint: 师兄将一块刻有叙述者名字的玉牌交给对方，名字____地刻在背面。
deeply:2.hook: Below my name, almost too small to read, was a second name I did not recognise.
deeply:2.line: 'I carved it *deeply* because a name given lightly is a name easily forgotten.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed the small jade token into my hand without a word.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎没有说一句话，就把那块小玉牌按进了我的手心。

sentences.en: I turned it over and found my name carved on the back — carved *deeply*, as if whoever had cut it had wanted the name to last beyond stone.
I did not know when he had made it.
sentences.cn: 我不知道他什么时候做的。

sentences.en: The token was still warm.
sentences.cn: 玉牌还是温的。

demonstrate:2.en: Master Qingwu set the ancient jar on the altar and stepped back. 'I will *demonstrate* once,' she said. She breathed a single word onto the opening and the jar filled with soft light, then rose, then opened a passage in the stone wall behind it. The passage had not been there a moment before.
demonstrate:2.cnHint: 师尊在祭坛上____了一次古老的字咒，石墙后出现了一条从未见过的通道。
demonstrate:2.hook: The passage led downward, and from its depths came the faint sound of a name being called.
demonstrate:2.line: 'I will *demonstrate* once only — after that, your hands must remember without my help.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set the ancient jar on the altar and stepped back.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把古老的罐子放在祭坛上，退了一步。

sentences.en: 'I will *demonstrate* once,' she said.
She breathed a single word onto the opening and the jar filled with soft light, then rose, then opened a passage in the stone wall behind it.
sentences.cn: 她在开口处吹了一个字，罐子就充满了柔和的光，然后升起，打开了身后石墙上的一道通道。

sentences.en: The passage had not been there a moment before.
sentences.cn: 那通道一时间前还不存在。

preserve:2.en: Deep within the Archive Grotto, I found a jade scroll sealed in amber light. Master Qingwu had placed it there long ago to *preserve* the sect's oldest breathing formula from the slow decay that claimed even stone. Dust covered every shelf, yet the scroll glowed as if newly written.
preserve:2.cnHint: 在典藏石窟中，我发现师尊将一卷古老功法____在琥珀光中，使其免于腐朽。
preserve:2.hook: But the seal had already been broken from inside.
preserve:2.line: 'We *preserve* these words so the wind cannot steal them,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Deep within the Archive Grotto, I found a jade scroll sealed in amber light.
sentences.cn: 在档案洞的深处，我找到了一支被琥珀色的光封住的玉简。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had placed it there long ago to *preserve* the sect's oldest breathing formula from the slow decay that claimed even stone.
Dust covered every shelf, yet the scroll glowed as if newly written.
sentences.cn: 尘埃覆盖了每一层架子，可这支简却闪闪发光，仿佛才写好没多久。

procedure:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the Trial Altar at the peak's eastern edge. Each step of the ascension test followed a strict *procedure*: light the blue flame, speak the formula aloud, then step onto the wind disc without hesitation. I had memorised every stage, yet my hands still trembled.
procedure:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到试炼坛，升天考验有严格的____，每一步都不能出错。
procedure:2.hook: The blue flame turned white before I even touched it.
procedure:2.line: 'Follow the *procedure* exactly,' Shen Wujiu warned, 'or the disc will not rise.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the Trial Altar at the peak's eastern edge.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我来到了山峰东边缘的试炼台。

sentences.en: Each step of the ascension test followed a strict *procedure*: light the blue flame, speak the formula aloud, then step onto the wind disc without hesitation.
I had memorised every stage, yet my hands still trembled.
sentences.cn: 我把每个阶段都背得滚瓜烂熟，可我的手还是在发抖。

reasonable:2.en: Xiaoxing spread a map of the floating peaks across a flat stone and marked three possible routes to the upper clouds. 'The middle path is the most *reasonable* choice,' she said softly. It was shorter and sheltered from the gale winds that had turned back older disciples for a full season.
reasonable:2.cnHint: 小星在石桌上摊开地图，指出通往上层云界最____的路线。
reasonable:2.hook: Yet the middle path ended at a bridge no one had crossed in years.
reasonable:2.line: 'A *reasonable* path saves strength for what waits above,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread a map of the floating peaks across a flat stone and marked three possible routes to the upper clouds.
sentences.cn: 小杏在一块平石上铺开了浮峰的地图，标记了通往上层云雾的三条可能路线。

sentences.en: 'The middle path is the most *reasonable* choice,' she said softly.
It was shorter and sheltered from the gale winds that had turned back older disciples for a full season.
sentences.cn: 那条路更短，还能躲开那些把年长弟子挡了整整一季的大风。

reduction:2.en: At the Weighing Stone near the Cloud Gate, I placed my spirit satchel on the ancient scale. Master Qingwu studied the reading and announced a *reduction* in the number of herbs I could carry through the gate — too much weight would pull a rising disciple back into the lower winds.
reduction:2.cnHint: 在云门的称量石旁，师尊宣布了我可携带草药数量的____。
reduction:2.hook: The scale then tipped the wrong way with nothing on it at all.
reduction:2.line: 'A *reduction* of five bundles,' said Master Qingwu, 'is the only safe allowance.'

sentences.en: At the Weighing Stone near the Cloud Gate, I placed my spirit satchel on the ancient scale.
sentences.cn: 在云门附近的权衡石处，我把我的灵囊放在了古老的天平上。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu studied the reading and announced a *reduction* in the number of herbs I could carry through the gate — too much weight would pull a rising disciple back into the lower winds.

season:2.en: Shen Wujiu sat beside the observation pool and told me that the ascension window was not a single day but a *season* — a brief period each year when the cloud currents aligned and a prepared disciple could rise without being scattered by the upper winds. That season had already begun.
season:2.cnHint: 师兄在观测水池旁告诉我，飞升的时机是一段特定的____，如今已经开启。
season:2.hook: He did not say how many days remained in it.
season:2.line: 'This *season* will not wait,' said Shen Wujiu, eyes fixed on the clouds.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu sat beside the observation pool and told me that the ascension window was not a single day but a *season* — a brief period each year when the cloud currents aligned and a prepared disciple could rise without being scattered by the upper winds.
That season had already begun.
sentences.cn: 那个季节已经开始了。

sector:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a chart of the sky above our mountain and divided it into named regions. She pointed to the northern *sector*, a wedge of pale sky where the wind ran cold and straight. 'That is where the gate opens,' she said. 'Anywhere else and you will simply fall.'
sector:2.cnHint: 师尊展开天图，指着北方的____，说那里才是天门真正开启的地方。
sector:2.hook: A dark line was already moving across that pale northern wedge.
sector:2.line: 'Enter through the northern *sector*,' said Master Qingwu, 'and nowhere else.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a chart of the sky above our mountain and divided it into named regions.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊展开了我们山上的天空图，把它分成了几个命名的区域。

sentences.en: She pointed to the northern *sector*, a wedge of pale sky where the wind ran cold and straight.
'That is where the gate opens,' she said.
sentences.cn: "那就是大门打开的地方，"她说。

sentences.en: 'Anywhere else and you will simply fall.'
sentences.cn: 别的地方你只会坠下来。

setting:2.en: I climbed alone to the Drifting Pavilion to review the ascension formula one last time. The *setting* suited the work: silence above the clouds, pale light from no clear source, and the faint scent of frost herbs rising through the floor stones. Every word of the formula felt sharper here.
setting:2.cnHint: 我独自登上漂浮亭，这里的____让古老功法的每个字都变得格外清晰。
setting:2.hook: Then a second shadow appeared on the wall beside mine.
setting:2.line: 'The *setting* of a place shapes the words you speak within it,' Xiaoxing once said.

sentences.en: I climbed alone to the Drifting Pavilion to review the ascension formula one last time.
sentences.cn: 我独自爬上飘渡楼，想最后再过一遍飞升的法诀。

sentences.en: The *setting* suited the work: silence above the clouds, pale light from no clear source, and the faint scent of frost herbs rising through the floor stones.
Every word of the formula felt sharper here.
sentences.cn: 法诀的每一个字在这里都显得格外清晰。

shrink:2.en: I stepped onto the wind disc and spoke the final word of the formula. The cloud sea below began to *shrink* as I rose, the familiar peaks becoming small as seeds, the sect's red rooftops fading to a single bright point. Above, the sky deepened to a blue I had no name for.
shrink:2.cnHint: 我踏上风盘，脚下的云海渐渐____，宗门的红屋顶缩成了一个光点。
shrink:2.hook: Then that bright point below me simply went dark.
shrink:2.line: 'Watch the mountains *shrink*,' said Shen Wujiu, 'and you will know you are truly rising.'

sentences.en: I stepped onto the wind disc and spoke the final word of the formula.
sentences.cn: 我踩上风盘，念出了法诀的最后一个字。

sentences.en: The cloud sea below began to *shrink* as I rose, the familiar peaks becoming small as seeds, the sect's red rooftops fading to a single bright point.
Above, the sky deepened to a blue I had no name for.
sentences.cn: 上面天空渐渐变成了一种没有名字的蓝。

strike:2.en: Deep within the Archive Cavern, I found an ancient scroll warning of a spiritual *strike* that had once silenced every herb garden on the mountain. The text said miners of rare sky-root had stopped their work, and the whole sect had trembled without medicine or light. Their protest had shaken even the clouds.
strike:2.cnHint: 我在档案洞窟中发现了一卷古老卷轴，记载着一次让全山草药园沉寂的____。
strike:2.hook: At the scroll's edge, a single fresh fingerprint glowed faint green.
strike:2.line: 'That *strike* left the mountain without medicine for seven days,' said Shen Wujiu softly.

sentences.en: Deep within the Archive Cavern, I found an ancient scroll warning of a spiritual *strike* that had once silenced every herb garden on the mountain.
The text said miners of rare sky-root had stopped their work, and the whole sect had trembled without medicine or light.
sentences.cn: 文献说那些开采罕见天根的矿工停止了工作，整个宗门都陷入了无药可医、无光可依的震颤中。

sentences.en: Their protest had shaken even the clouds.
sentences.cn: 他们的抗争甚至震撼了云层。

television:2.en: In the outer hall, a flat spirit-mirror hummed on the stone wall, showing moving images like a *television* of another world. Master Qingwu had captured distant light and folded it into the glass so disciples could study the lower cities far below the clouds without ever descending.
television:2.cnHint: 外堂石壁上挂着一面灵镜，像另一个世界的____一样播放着远方城市的影像。
television:2.hook: Then the mirror flickered, and a face none of us recognised stared back.
television:2.line: 'This *television* of spirit-light shows only what the mountain allows us to see,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: In the outer hall, a flat spirit-mirror hummed on the stone wall, showing moving images like a *television* of another world.
Master Qingwu had captured distant light and folded it into the glass so disciples could study the lower cities far below the clouds without ever descending.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊捕捉了远处的光，把它折叠进玻璃里，这样弟子们就能研究云下面的远方城市，根本不用下山。

youth:2.en: Beside the Cloud Gate, a carved inscription read: 'In *youth* the root is soft and open; only then can the sky-word enter the bone.' I pressed my palm to the stone and felt a gentle warmth move up my arm, as if the mountain itself was testing whether my time had not yet passed.
youth:2.cnHint: 云门旁的石刻提醒我，只有____时期根基柔软，天道之言才能真正入骨。
youth:2.hook: The warmth stopped at my shoulder, and the stone let out one low note.
youth:2.line: 'Your *youth* is your greatest herb,' Xiaoxing whispered, eyes bright with certainty.

sentences.en: Beside the Cloud Gate, a carved inscription read: 'In *youth* the root is soft and open; only then can the sky-word enter the bone.'
I pressed my palm to the stone and felt a gentle warmth move up my arm, as if the mountain itself was testing whether my time had not yet passed.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌贴在石头上，感到一股温柔的热力沿着手臂向上流动，仿佛山本身在试探我的时间是否还没有过去。

alter:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me a seed that could *alter* the colour of any spiritual herb it touched, turning silver roots gold and gold roots a deep, warning red. She had found it wrapped in silk inside a hollow bamboo near the east bridge, left by no one anyone could name.
alter:2.cnHint: 小星向我展示了一粒能____灵草颜色的种子，没有人知道是谁留下了它。
alter:2.hook: She dropped it once, and the stone floor bloomed a sudden, silent crimson.
alter:2.line: 'One touch can *alter* the herb's whole nature,' Xiaoxing said, her hand trembling slightly.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me a seed that could *alter* the colour of any spiritual herb it touched, turning silver roots gold and gold roots a deep, warning red.
She had found it wrapped in silk inside a hollow bamboo near the east bridge, left by no one anyone could name.
sentences.cn: 她在东桥边的一根空心竹子里找到的，用丝绸包着，不知道谁留在那儿的。

approximately:2.en: The sealed jar on the offering shelf held *approximately* forty sky-petals, each worth a month of training. Shen Wujiu counted them twice under his breath, then set the jar down with great care. Someone had added petals since the last count, and no visitor had been logged at the shelf.
approximately:2.cnHint: 供台上的密封罐里装有____四十片天空花瓣，而上次清点之后没有人来过。
approximately:2.hook: The jar's seal bore a mark that belonged to a disciple long thought gone.
approximately:2.line: 'There are *approximately* forty petals here, but yesterday there were thirty,' Shen Wujiu murmured.

sentences.en: The sealed jar on the offering shelf held *approximately* forty sky-petals, each worth a month of training.
Shen Wujiu counted them twice under his breath, then set the jar down with great care.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎低声数了两遍，然后非常小心地放下了罐子。

sentences.en: Someone had added petals since the last count, and no visitor had been logged at the shelf.
sentences.cn: 自从上次清点以来，有人加进去了花瓣，可没有任何访客记录显示有人来过这个架子。

attractive:2.en: The new formula on the board was *attractive* in a dangerous way: its curves pulled the eye like a whirlpool pulls a leaf. Master Qingwu warned us that beautiful formulas often hide a flaw deep inside their grace, a trap set by the mountain for disciples who love form more than truth.
attractive:2.cnHint: 黑板上的新法诀外形____，但师尊警告我们，越美丽的法诀往往隐藏着越深的陷阱。
attractive:2.hook: One disciple had already copied it down before the warning left her lips.
attractive:2.line: 'An *attractive* formula is the mountain's kindest trick,' Master Qingwu said, erasing it slowly.

sentences.en: The new formula on the board was *attractive* in a dangerous way: its curves pulled the eye like a whirlpool pulls a leaf.
Master Qingwu warned us that beautiful formulas often hide a flaw deep inside their grace, a trap set by the mountain for disciples who love form more than truth.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊告诉我们，漂亮的法诀往往在它优雅的深处藏着一个缺陷，那是山为那些更看重形式而不看重真理的弟子设下的陷阱。

bag:2.en: Hanging from the old pine at the trail's fork was a small cloth *bag*, stitched with the sect's cloud symbol. Inside lay three dried night-herbs and a folded note whose words shifted each time I tilted it toward the light, spelling a different name with every angle.
bag:2.cnHint: 山路分叉处的老松树上挂着一个绣有门派标记的____，里面的纸条每次倾斜角度不同，显示的名字也不同。
bag:2.hook: The third name it showed was mine, written in tomorrow's date.
bag:2.line: 'Whoever left this *bag* knew exactly which path you would choose,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Hanging from the old pine at the trail's fork was a small cloth *bag*, stitched with the sect's cloud symbol.
Inside lay three dried night-herbs and a folded note whose words shifted each time I tilted it toward the light, spelling a different name with every angle.
sentences.cn: 里面放着三根晒干的夜草和一张折好的纸条，上面的字每次我向光线倾斜时都会变化，每个角度都拼出不同的名字。

beat:2.en: I stood at the summit and listened. The mountain had a *beat*, slow and deep, like a great heart counting years instead of seconds. Master Qingwu said disciples who could feel that pulse had crossed the first threshold of true ascent. I pressed my ear to the cold rock and waited.
beat:2.cnHint: 在山顶，师尊告诉我，能感受到山脉____的弟子，才算踏上了真正飞升的起点。
beat:2.hook: On the third pulse, a crack of golden light split the stone beneath my feet.
beat:2.line: 'Follow the *beat* of the mountain, and it will carry you upward,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: I stood at the summit and listened.
sentences.cn: 我站在山顶，静静地听。

sentences.en: The mountain had a *beat*, slow and deep, like a great heart counting years instead of seconds.
Master Qingwu said disciples who could feel that pulse had crossed the first threshold of true ascent.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说能感受到那个脉搏的弟子已经跨过了真正飞升的第一道门槛。

sentences.en: I pressed my ear to the cold rock and waited.
sentences.cn: 我把耳朵贴在冰冷的石头上，等待着。

distinguish:2.en: The archive room held a hundred jade slips, each carved with a different healing word. Master Qingwu set one before me. 'A true disciple must *distinguish* the word for mist from the word for cloud,' she said. I studied the two carvings until one shimmered faintly — and then the other went dark.
distinguish:2.cnHint: 在藏经阁中，师尊要我____两块玉简上的字，其中一块突然变暗。
distinguish:2.hook: The darkened slip cracked down the middle without anyone touching it.
distinguish:2.line: 'You must *distinguish* the mist word from the cloud word before dawn.'

sentences.en: The archive room held a hundred jade slips, each carved with a different healing word.
sentences.cn: 档案室里放着一百块玉简，每块上都刻着不同的疗愈之字。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set one before me.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我面前放下了其中一块。

sentences.en: 'A true disciple must *distinguish* the word for mist from the word for cloud,' she said.
I studied the two carvings until one shimmered faintly — and then the other went dark.
sentences.cn: 我盯着两块雕刻看，直到其中一块微微闪烁——然后另一块黯了下去。

document:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a folded paper into my hand at the gate of the inner hall. 'This is your entry *document*,' he said. 'Without it, the hall will not open for you.' I unfolded it and found a single word written in silver ink — a word I had never been taught. Behind me, the gate began to close.
document:2.cnHint: 师兄交给我一份入门____，上面写着一个我从未学过的字，身后的门开始关闭。
document:2.hook: The silver word on the paper slowly faded before my eyes.
document:2.line: 'Guard this *document* carefully — the hall reads it, not your face.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a folded paper into my hand at the gate of the inner hall.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在内殿的门口把一张折叠的纸塞进我的手心。

sentences.en: 'This is your entry *document*,' he said.
'Without it, the hall will not open for you.'
sentences.cn: 没有它，殿门就不会为你打开。

sentences.en: I unfolded it and found a single word written in silver ink — a word I had never been taught.
sentences.cn: 我展开纸条，发现上面用银色墨水写着一个字——一个我从未被教过的字。

sentences.en: Behind me, the gate began to close.
sentences.cn: 身后，大门开始关闭。

dozen:2.en: Xiaoxing laid a *dozen* small stones on the low table, each one holding a spoken word like a sealed breath. 'Listen to all twelve before the incense burns out,' she said with a small smile. I pressed my ear to the first stone. Somewhere far below, the sea of clouds gave a long, low sound, as if answering.
dozen:2.cnHint: 师妹把一____块储存着语言的石头摆在桌上，让我在香燃尽前听完。
dozen:2.hook: The twelfth stone was warm — far warmer than the others.
dozen:2.line: 'A *dozen* word-stones is the minimum for the trial ahead.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing laid a *dozen* small stones on the low table, each one holding a spoken word like a sealed breath.
'Listen to all twelve before the incense burns out,' she said with a small smile.
sentences.cn: 她带着淡淡的笑容说，香烧完之前要听完全部十二块。

sentences.en: I pressed my ear to the first stone.
sentences.cn: 我把耳朵贴在第一块石头上。

sentences.en: Somewhere far below, the sea of clouds gave a long, low sound, as if answering.
sentences.cn: 远处下方，云海发出一声长长的低鸣，仿佛在回应。

dull:2.en: The copying brush felt *dull* in my hand; the ink spread wrong and the characters lost their edges. Shen Wujiu watched without speaking. A blurred word, he had warned me, carries only half its power — enough to lift a feather, not a person. I pressed harder, and the tip of the brush began to glow.
dull:2.cnHint: 我手中的笔感觉____，写出的字模糊无力，师兄默默注视着我。
dull:2.hook: When the brush began to glow, a cold wind rose inside the closed room.
dull:2.line: 'A *dull* brush is as dangerous as a broken bridge — trust neither.'

sentences.en: The copying brush felt *dull* in my hand; the ink spread wrong and the characters lost their edges.
Shen Wujiu watched without speaking.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎无言地看着。

sentences.en: A blurred word, he had warned me, carries only half its power — enough to lift a feather, not a person.
sentences.cn: 他曾警告过我，模糊的字只能发挥一半的力量——足以抬起羽毛，却抬不起人。

sentences.en: I pressed harder, and the tip of the brush began to glow.
sentences.cn: 我加重了力度，笔尖开始发光。

fortune:2.en: At the base of the highest peak, Xiaoxing found a cracked stone tablet half buried in cloud-moss. The old characters on it read: 'Your *fortune* rises with the word you carry longest.' She traced each stroke carefully. Neither of us spoke. High above, a single lamp in Master Qingwu's tower went out.
fortune:2.cnHint: 师妹在山脚发现了一块石碑，上面写着____与所持之字相关的预言。
fortune:2.hook: Master Qingwu's lamp went out the moment Xiaoxing finished reading.
fortune:2.line: 'Our *fortune* as disciples depends on the words we refuse to forget.'

sentences.en: At the base of the highest peak, Xiaoxing found a cracked stone tablet half buried in cloud-moss.
sentences.cn: 在最高的山峰脚下，小杏发现了一块裂开的石碑，半埋在云苔里。

sentences.en: The old characters on it read: 'Your *fortune* rises with the word you carry longest.'
She traced each stroke carefully.
sentences.cn: 她仔细地描过每一笔。

sentences.en: Neither of us spoke.
sentences.cn: 我们都没有说话。

sentences.en: High above, a single lamp in Master Qingwu's tower went out.
sentences.cn: 高处，青梧师尊塔楼里的一盏灯熄灭了。

fulfil:2.en: The mission scroll asked me to carry the healing word 'dawn' to the sick pine at the cliff's edge and speak it once at sunrise. Shen Wujiu said only those who *fulfil* small tasks earn the right to attempt great ones. I climbed through the dark. The pine's bark was cold under my palm.
fulfil:2.cnHint: 卷轴要求我在日出时对悬崖边的松树念出治愈之字，师兄说____小任务才能尝试更大的。
fulfil:2.hook: When I reached the cliff, a second pine stood there that no one had ever mentioned.
fulfil:2.line: '*Fulfil* this errand faithfully — the mountain is always watching.'

sentences.en: The mission scroll asked me to carry the healing word 'dawn' to the sick pine at the cliff's edge and speak it once at sunrise.
sentences.cn: 任务卷轴让我把疗愈之字"晨曦"送到悬崖边的病松那里，在日出时念诵一次。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said only those who *fulfil* small tasks earn the right to attempt great ones.
I climbed through the dark.
sentences.cn: 我在黑暗中攀爬。

sentences.en: The pine's bark was cold under my palm.
sentences.cn: 松树的树皮在我的掌心冰冷。

gradually:2.en: I held the flying word on my tongue and waited as Master Qingwu had told me. My feet *gradually* left the cold stone floor — first one heel, then the other, then both — until I hovered at the height of my own shoulders. Below me, my shadow stayed where it was, as if it had chosen not to follow.
gradually:2.cnHint: 我含着飞升之字，双脚____离开了地面，但我的影子却留在了原处。
gradually:2.hook: My shadow on the floor turned its head slowly to look up at me.
gradually:2.line: 'Rise *gradually* — a sudden word spoken too fast will scatter like smoke.'

sentences.en: I held the flying word on my tongue and waited as Master Qingwu had told me.
sentences.cn: 我把飞行之字含在舌头上，如青梧师尊所教的那样等待。

sentences.en: My feet *gradually* left the cold stone floor — first one heel, then the other, then both — until I hovered at the height of my own shoulders.
Below me, my shadow stayed where it was, as if it had chosen not to follow.
sentences.cn: 我下面的影子留在了原地，仿佛它选择了不跟随。

incentive:2.en: The sect board listed one reward at the top: a word of pure light, able to part any cloud. Shen Wujiu read it aloud and said that *incentive* alone would drive half the outer disciples to attempt the autumn trial. I copied the notice onto my sleeve with a fingertip. That night, the clouds below our mountain glowed without any moon.
incentive:2.cnHint: 门派告示板上的奖励是一个能拨开云雾的字，师兄说这个____会让许多弟子参加秋季考验。
incentive:2.hook: The clouds below glowed all night, though the sky held no moon.
incentive:2.line: 'The light-word is *incentive* enough — no disciple will need a second reason.'

sentences.en: The sect board listed one reward at the top: a word of pure light, able to part any cloud.
sentences.cn: 宗门布告栏顶部列了一条奖赏：一个纯光之字，能分开任何云层。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu read it aloud and said that *incentive* alone would drive half the outer disciples to attempt the autumn trial.
I copied the notice onto my sleeve with a fingertip.
sentences.cn: 我用指尖把通知抄到了袖子上。

sentences.en: That night, the clouds below our mountain glowed without any moon.
sentences.cn: 那晚，我们山下的云层在没有月光的情况下闪闪发光。

bottom:2.en: The old library shelf leaned against the inner cave wall, its highest boards thick with dust. Xiaoxing handed me a rolled scroll she had found at the very *bottom* of the stack, where no one had reached in years. The paper was cold and faintly bright, as though a word inside still breathed. Master Qingwu had not catalogued it.
bottom:2.cnHint: 小星在书架____找到一卷从未被记录的神秘卷轴。
bottom:2.hook: The scroll unrolled on its own, one inch at a time.
bottom:2.line: 'I found this at the *bottom* of the pile — it was never listed anywhere.'

sentences.en: The old library shelf leaned against the inner cave wall, its highest boards thick with dust.
sentences.cn: 古老的图书馆架子靠在内洞的墙上，最高的架板上积满了灰尘。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me a rolled scroll she had found at the very *bottom* of the stack, where no one had reached in years.
The paper was cold and faintly bright, as though a word inside still breathed.
sentences.cn: 纸张冰冷而微微闪亮，仿佛里面的字还在呼吸。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had not catalogued it.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊没有给它编目。

breed:2.en: Master Qingwu kept a small garden on the eastern ledge, where she worked to *breed* a new strain of the silver-leaf herb, crossing calm with clarity until one plant could carry both gifts. I watched her press two stems together under morning cloud-light. She did not look up. A single leaf turned gold and then, very quietly, turned to ash.
breed:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊尝试____出一种同时具有双重功效的新草药。
breed:2.hook: The ash rose upward instead of falling.
breed:2.line: 'I am trying to *breed* a herb that holds two powers in one root.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu kept a small garden on the eastern ledge, where she worked to *breed* a new strain of the silver-leaf herb, crossing calm with clarity until one plant could carry both gifts.
I watched her press two stems together under morning cloud-light.
sentences.cn: 我看着她在晨曦的云光下把两根茎按在一起。

sentences.en: She did not look up.
sentences.cn: 她没有抬头。

sentences.en: A single leaf turned gold and then, very quietly, turned to ash.
sentences.cn: 一片叶子变成了金色，然后，很轻地，化成了灰烬。

classify:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread thirty word-seals across the stone floor and asked me to *classify* them before sunset. Some healed, some shielded, some called wind. I sorted by feeling, not by form. When I placed the last seal, the groups began to glow in three distinct colors I had never seen on this mountain before.
classify:2.cnHint: 师兄要求我在日落前把三十枚字印按功能____。
classify:2.hook: A fourth seal sat alone, refusing every group.
classify:2.line: 'Can you *classify* these seals before the evening bell?'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread thirty word-seals across the stone floor and asked me to *classify* them before sunset.
Some healed, some shielded, some called wind.
sentences.cn: 有些疗愈，有些防护，有些召唤风。

sentences.en: I sorted by feeling, not by form.
sentences.cn: 我按感觉而不是形状分类。

sentences.en: When I placed the last seal, the groups began to glow in three distinct colors I had never seen on this mountain before.
sentences.cn: 当我放下最后一个字印，各组开始用三种我在这座山上从未见过的独特颜色发光。

comment:2.en: After my first recitation, the hall was silent. Then Master Qingwu offered one short *comment*: the word for wind had been spoken too tightly, as if afraid of itself. I bowed and repeated the word, and this time a thin current moved through the stone room. She added nothing more, but her brush moved once across a record page.
comment:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊对我的背诵只给出了一句____，却让气流真实地流动了。
comment:2.hook: The brush left a mark that was not a character I recognized.
comment:2.line: 'My only *comment* is that the word must not be afraid of the air.'

sentences.en: After my first recitation, the hall was silent.
sentences.cn: 我的第一次诵读后，大厅陷入了沉默。

sentences.en: Then Master Qingwu offered one short *comment*: the word for wind had been spoken too tightly, as if afraid of itself.
I bowed and repeated the word, and this time a thin current moved through the stone room.
sentences.cn: 我鞠躬，重新念诵了这个字，这次一股细微的气流在石室里流动。

sentences.en: She added nothing more, but her brush moved once across a record page.
sentences.cn: 她没有再说什么，但她的笔在记录页上划过一次。

component:2.en: The healing formula had five parts, and Shen Wujiu taught me to feel each *component* separately before blending them. The third part — stillness — was the hardest; it wanted to dissolve the moment I held it. I managed to keep all five distinct for the length of one breath. The formula hummed and a faint warmth moved through my palm.
component:2.cnHint: 治愈咒法的每个____都需要单独感受，最难的是第三个。
component:2.hook: Then the warmth moved up my arm and would not stop.
component:2.line: 'Feel each *component* alone first, or the blend will collapse.'

sentences.en: The healing formula had five parts, and Shen Wujiu taught me to feel each *component* separately before blending them.
The third part — stillness — was the hardest; it wanted to dissolve the moment I held it.
sentences.cn: 第三部分——静止——最难把握；我一抓住它就想溶散。

sentences.en: I managed to keep all five distinct for the length of one breath.
sentences.cn: 我勉强在一个呼吸的长度里保持了全部五种的分离。

sentences.en: The formula hummed and a faint warmth moved through my palm.
sentences.cn: 秘方嗡鸣了，一阵微弱的温热在我的掌心里流动。

contrary:2.en: Every disciple was taught that silence strengthens a word-seal. I tried the *contrary* approach one afternoon, speaking the seal aloud while wind crossed the ledge, certain the noise would scatter it. Instead the seal flared twice as bright. I looked around; no one had seen. A thin crack appeared in the ledge-stone where the light had touched.
contrary:2.cnHint: 我尝试了与教导____的做法，字印却意外地闪耀得更亮。
contrary:2.hook: The crack slowly traced the shape of an eye.
contrary:2.line: 'What if the *contrary* of silence is not failure but a different path?'

sentences.en: Every disciple was taught that silence strengthens a word-seal.
sentences.cn: 每个弟子都被教导，沉默会强化言印。

sentences.en: I tried the *contrary* approach one afternoon, speaking the seal aloud while wind crossed the ledge, certain the noise would scatter it.
Instead the seal flared twice as bright.
sentences.cn: 反而言印闪亮了两倍。

sentences.en: I looked around; no one had seen.
sentences.cn: 我看了看周围；没人看到。

sentences.en: A thin crack appeared in the ledge-stone where the light had touched.
sentences.cn: 光线触过的地方，石台上出现了一道细细的裂纹。

deny:2.en: A sealed message arrived for me, carried by a cloud-sparrow. The letter asked whether I had opened the uncatalogued scroll in the lower library. I could not *deny* it — my name-mark was still pressed into the wax at its edge. I wrote back one honest word. By nightfall the sparrow had not returned, and the library door stood open when it had always been shut.
deny:2.cnHint: 一封信询问我是否打开过那本书，我无法____。
deny:2.hook: The library door swung open in a wind that was not blowing.
deny:2.line: 'I cannot *deny* it — my mark is right there on the edge of the wax.'

sentences.en: A sealed message arrived for me, carried by a cloud-sparrow.
sentences.cn: 一封密信由云雀送来了。

sentences.en: The letter asked whether I had opened the uncatalogued scroll in the lower library.
sentences.cn: 信上问我是否打开过下层库里那份未著录的卷轴。

sentences.en: I could not *deny* it — my name-mark was still pressed into the wax at its edge.
I wrote back one honest word.
sentences.cn: 我回了一个诚实的字。

sentences.en: By nightfall the sparrow had not returned, and the library door stood open when it had always been shut.
sentences.cn: 到了夜晚，云雀还没回来，库门敞开了——它从来都是关的。

depth:2.en: Shen Wujiu lowered a thread of pale light down through a split in the mountain rock to measure its *depth*. The thread ran out before it touched bottom. He pulled it back, coiled it on his palm, and said nothing for a long time. That evening he wrote a single word on paper, folded it small, and dropped it through the same split without watching it fall.
depth:2.cnHint: 师兄用光线测量山岩裂缝的____，绳子用完也没探到底。
depth:2.hook: From far below, something answered with a faint, steady hum.
depth:2.line: 'The *depth* of this crack is beyond anything I can measure with light.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu lowered a thread of pale light down through a split in the mountain rock to measure its *depth*.
The thread ran out before it touched bottom.
sentences.cn: 光线尽头了，还没有触到底部。

sentences.en: He pulled it back, coiled it on his palm, and said nothing for a long time.
sentences.cn: 他把它卷回掌心，良久无言。

sentences.en: That evening he wrote a single word on paper, folded it small, and dropped it through the same split without watching it fall.
sentences.cn: 那天晚上他在纸上写了一个字，折得很小，从同样的裂隙里扔下去，没有看它落下。

employment:2.en: Deep within the sect library, I found an old scroll listing the *employment* of rare spirit herbs in forgotten healing formulas. Each herb had a role — none wasted, none repeated. Master Qingwu had placed the scroll here deliberately, I was certain. Someone wanted me to read it before the trial.
employment:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现一卷古籍，记载着灵草的____，感觉是师尊特意留下的。
employment:2.hook: The scroll crumbled at the edges, as if recently burned.
employment:2.line: 'The *employment* of each herb must be exact,' said Master Qingwu, 'or the formula fails.'

sentences.en: Deep within the sect library, I found an old scroll listing the *employment* of rare spirit herbs in forgotten healing formulas.
Each herb had a role — none wasted, none repeated.
sentences.cn: 每一株药草都有一个角色——没有浪费，没有重复。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had placed the scroll here deliberately, I was certain.
sentences.cn: 我确信，青梧师尊是故意把卷轴放在这里的。

sentences.en: Someone wanted me to read it before the trial.
sentences.cn: 有人想让我在考验前读到它。

entire:2.en: I carried the water pail up the stone steps at dawn, but stopped when I saw it — the *entire* surface of the training courtyard was covered in frost-drawn characters. No wind could have written them. Shen Wujiu stood at the far edge, silent, his breath rising in pale clouds.
entire:2.cnHint: 清晨，我发现修炼场____地面都覆盖着神秘的冰纹字符。
entire:2.hook: One character, larger than the rest, spelled my name.
entire:2.line: 'The *entire* courtyard speaks,' Shen Wujiu said quietly, 'and I did not write it.'

sentences.en: I carried the water pail up the stone steps at dawn, but stopped when I saw it — the *entire* surface of the training courtyard was covered in frost-drawn characters.
No wind could have written them.
sentences.cn: 没有风能写出这些字。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the far edge, silent, his breath rising in pale clouds.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在远端，无言，他的呼吸升起淡淡的白雾。

gift:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small clay jar into my hands without a word. Inside was a golden paste that smelled of pine and morning rain — a *gift* from the mountain itself, she said, drawn from the cracks where clouds are born. I did not know what it could do. Yet.
gift:2.cnHint: 小星将一个盛着金色膏药的陶罐送给我，说这是山灵的____。
gift:2.hook: The paste moved on its own when I closed the lid.
gift:2.line: 'A true *gift*,' Xiaoxing whispered, 'chooses who receives it.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small clay jar into my hands without a word.
sentences.cn: 小杏没有一句话，把一个小陶罐塞进我的手里。

sentences.en: Inside was a golden paste that smelled of pine and morning rain — a *gift* from the mountain itself, she said, drawn from the cracks where clouds are born.
I did not know what it could do.
sentences.cn: 我不知道它能做什么。

sentences.en: Yet.
sentences.cn: 还没。

kitchen:2.en: The sect *kitchen* was empty at midnight, but the iron stove burned bright. On the chopping block lay three spirit herbs arranged in a triangle, each one rare enough to trade for a month of lessons. No cook would leave these out by accident. Someone had prepared this for me.
kitchen:2.cnHint: 午夜，我在门派____里发现三株珍贵灵草被整齐地摆在案板上。
kitchen:2.hook: A single wet footprint led from the stove to the open window.
kitchen:2.line: 'Meet me in the *kitchen* at midnight,' the note said, signed with no name.

sentences.en: The sect *kitchen* was empty at midnight, but the iron stove burned bright.
On the chopping block lay three spirit herbs arranged in a triangle, each one rare enough to trade for a month of lessons.
sentences.cn: 在砧板上，三株灵草排成一个三角形，每一株都稀有到足以换一个月的课程。

sentences.en: No cook would leave these out by accident.
sentences.cn: 没有厨子会意外地留下这些。

sentences.en: Someone had prepared this for me.
sentences.cn: 有人为我准备了这个。

mystery:2.en: The summit cloud never moved — not in wind, not in storm. Shen Wujiu called it the great *mystery* of Cloud Sea Sect, older than the founders, older than the mountain name. I touched the lowest edge of it on my first climb and felt something touch back, soft and aware.
mystery:2.cnHint: 云海宗山顶那片永不散去的云雾是千古____，据说比门派历史还要古老。
mystery:2.hook: Tonight, for the first time, the cloud descended three steps lower.
mystery:2.line: 'The *mystery* is not what hides inside,' said Master Qingwu, 'but what it is waiting for.'

sentences.en: The summit cloud never moved — not in wind, not in storm.
sentences.cn: 山顶的云从不移动——无论刮风还是暴风雨。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu called it the great *mystery* of Cloud Sea Sect, older than the founders, older than the mountain name.
I touched the lowest edge of it on my first climb and felt something touch back, soft and aware.
sentences.cn: 我第一次登山时摸到了它的最低边缘，感觉有什么东西摸回了我，柔软而有意识。

opposite:2.en: Master Qingwu drew two formulas on the stone wall and told me to feel their difference. One was warm, rising, like breath before speech. The other was its *opposite* — cold, falling, like the silence after a bell. Both were needed to open the sealed gate at the mountain's heart.
opposite:2.cnHint: 师尊让我感受两道法诀的截然____之气，说只有二者合一才能开启山门。
opposite:2.hook: The sealed gate pulsed once, as if it had heard us.
opposite:2.line: 'Light and its *opposite*,' Master Qingwu said, 'are the same breath, held differently.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew two formulas on the stone wall and told me to feel their difference.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石墙上画了两道秘方，让我感受它们的不同。

sentences.en: One was warm, rising, like breath before speech.
sentences.cn: 一道温暖、上升，像言语前的呼吸。

sentences.en: The other was its *opposite* — cold, falling, like the silence after a bell.
Both were needed to open the sealed gate at the mountain's heart.
sentences.cn: 两道都需要打开山心处那扇密封的门。

permanent:2.en: Shen Wujiu showed me the mark on his wrist — a faint silver line that would not fade. He had earned it at his first trial. '*Permanent*,' he said simply, as a man describes a scar. Each sect disciple who passed carried one. I looked at my own bare wrist and said nothing.
permanent:2.cnHint: 师兄给我看他手腕上那道____的银色印记，那是通过考验的证明。
permanent:2.hook: By morning, a faint silver line had appeared on my wrist too.
permanent:2.line: 'It is *permanent*,' Shen Wujiu said, 'whether you passed by skill or by fate.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu showed me the mark on his wrist — a faint silver line that would not fade.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎给我看他腕上的标记——一条淡银色的线，不会褪去。

sentences.en: He had earned it at his first trial. '*Permanent*,' he said simply, as a man describes a scar.
Each sect disciple who passed carried one.
sentences.cn: 每一个通过考验的宗派弟子都带着一个。

sentences.en: I looked at my own bare wrist and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 我看了看自己光秃秃的腕，什么也没说。

plenty:2.en: The spirit spring behind the east pavilion offered *plenty* — water clear as silence, full of soft light. Disciples came here to recover, to think, to listen. I came because the map I had found in the old scroll ended here, at this exact stone, with a single arrow pointing down.
plenty:2.cnHint: 东亭后的灵泉有____的灵气，而我找到的古图恰好以这里为终点。
plenty:2.hook: Beneath the marked stone, the ground rang hollow when I knocked.
plenty:2.line: 'There is *plenty* of water,' Xiaoxing said, 'but only one place where it sings.'

sentences.en: The spirit spring behind the east pavilion offered *plenty* — water clear as silence, full of soft light.
Disciples came here to recover, to think, to listen.
sentences.cn: 弟子们来这里恢复、思考、倾听。

sentences.en: I came because the map I had found in the old scroll ended here, at this exact stone, with a single arrow pointing down.
sentences.cn: 我来是因为我在古卷里找到的地图在这里结束了，在这块石头处，只有一个箭头指向下方。

lower:2.en: The archive room sat on a *lower* shelf of the mountain, cut into the stone where the mist was thickest. I found an old scroll wedged behind a cracked jar. Its words glowed faintly — a formula no one had copied in a century. My hands trembled as I unrolled it to the final line.
lower:2.cnHint: 我在山腰较低处的藏书室里发现了一卷无人抄录已久、散发微光的古老秘籍。
lower:2.hook: The last character on the scroll had been deliberately scratched out.
lower:2.line: 'The *lower* rooms hold the oldest words — and the ones someone tried to bury.'

sentences.en: The archive room sat on a *lower* shelf of the mountain, cut into the stone where the mist was thickest.
I found an old scroll wedged behind a cracked jar.
sentences.cn: 我在一个破裂的罐子后面找到了一卷泛黄的古卷。

sentences.en: Its words glowed faintly — a formula no one had copied in a century.
sentences.cn: 卷上的字迹微微发光——一个百年来无人誊抄过的秘方。

sentences.en: My hands trembled as I unrolled it to the final line.
sentences.cn: 我的手颤抖着，将它展开到最后一行。

naturally:2.en: The seed-word Xiaoxing pressed into my palm felt warm, as though it *naturally* belonged there. She said a true formula finds its disciple the way water finds stone — not by force, but by quiet, patient wearing. I closed my fingers around it and felt the cloud beneath the mountain shiver.
naturally:2.cnHint: 小星将一枚种子词交到我手中，说真正的咒文会____地找到与之相合的弟子。
naturally:2.hook: Below us, the sea of clouds parted in a perfect, silent circle.
naturally:2.line: 'A word that fits you will *naturally* hum before you even speak it.'

sentences.en: The seed-word Xiaoxing pressed into my palm felt warm, as though it *naturally* belonged there.
She said a true formula finds its disciple the way water finds stone — not by force, but by quiet, patient wearing.
sentences.cn: 她说真正的秘方会像水找到石头一样找到它的弟子——不是靠蛮力，而是靠无声的、耐心的消磨。

sentences.en: I closed my fingers around it and felt the cloud beneath the mountain shiver.
sentences.cn: 我合起手指，感到山下的云层微微颤动。

passionate:2.en: Shen Wujiu was *passionate* about the healing arts in a way that filled every corner of the study hall. He copied remedies long after the lamps dimmed, voice low, eyes bright. Tonight he stopped mid-sentence and stared at the window, where a single herb-word floated in, glowing red — the colour of warning.
passionate:2.cnHint: 沈无咎对医术极为____，但今夜一枚红光闪烁的药字飘入窗来，令他骤然停笔。
passionate:2.hook: The red glow pulsed once, then went dark.
passionate:2.line: 'You must be *passionate* about the words, or they will never answer you.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu was *passionate* about the healing arts in a way that filled every corner of the study hall.
He copied remedies long after the lamps dimmed, voice low, eyes bright.
sentences.cn: 他在灯灭后很久还在誊抄药方，声音很低，眼睛闪闪发亮。

sentences.en: Tonight he stopped mid-sentence and stared at the window, where a single herb-word floated in, glowing red — the colour of warning.
sentences.cn: 今晚他突然停顿，盯着窗户，一个闪烁着红光的草字飘了进来——那是警告的颜色。

pop:2.en: I pressed the sealed jade tube and felt something *pop* inside — a small burst of pressure, then a rush of warm light. A letter from Master Qingwu spilled out, written in words that rearranged themselves as I read, as if still deciding what to say. The last line fixed itself into a single, clear command.
pop:2.cnHint: 我按下封口的玉管，感到内部____地崩开，师尊的信从中涌出，文字竟在眼前自动排列。
pop:2.hook: The command read: 'Leave before the second bell. Tell no one.'
pop:2.line: 'When the seal starts to *pop*, the message inside has been waiting too long.'

sentences.en: I pressed the sealed jade tube and felt something *pop* inside — a small burst of pressure, then a rush of warm light.
A letter from Master Qingwu spilled out, written in words that rearranged themselves as I read, as if still deciding what to say.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊的信从密封的玉管里倒了出来，字迹在我读的时候不断重新排列，仿佛还在决定要说什么。

sentences.en: The last line fixed itself into a single, clear command.
sentences.cn: 最后一行固定成了一条清晰的命令。

possibly:2.en: I studied the faded map on the cavern wall, tracing routes that could *possibly* lead to the upper peak before the seasonal winds sealed the path. Three lines ended in blank stone. Only one reached a mark shaped like an open eye. I pressed my finger to it and the wall grew warm.
possibly:2.cnHint: 我研究洞壁上的旧地图，试图找出____能在季风封路前通往山顶的路线，最终一条路指向一个睁眼的记号。
possibly:2.line: 'This is the only route that could *possibly* still be open — choose carefully.'

sentences.en: I studied the faded map on the cavern wall, tracing routes that could *possibly* lead to the upper peak before the seasonal winds sealed the path.
Three lines ended in blank stone.
sentences.cn: 我研究着洞穴墙上褪色的地图，描摹着可能通往上峰的路线，要赶在季风封闭通道前。

sentences.en: Only one reached a mark shaped like an open eye.
sentences.cn: 三条线在空白的石头前终止。

sentences.en: I pressed my finger to it and the wall grew warm.
sentences.cn: 只有一条到达了一个睁眼形的标记。

previously:2.en: The storage chest had *previously* held nothing but dust, Xiaoxing told me — she had checked it herself three days ago. Now it contained a folded robe stitched with sky-root patterns and a name tag bearing my own name, written in ink that was still damp. Neither of us had put it there.
previously:2.cnHint: 这口箱子三天前明明还是空的，但如今里面竟放着一件绣有我名字的长袍，墨迹未干。
previously:2.hook: The ink on the name tag smelled of cloud-pine — the scent of Master Qingwu's study.
previously:2.line: 'I *previously* sealed this chest myself — nothing should be inside it.'

sentences.en: The storage chest had *previously* held nothing but dust, Xiaoxing told me — she had checked it herself three days ago.
Now it contained a folded robe stitched with sky-root patterns and a name tag bearing my own name, written in ink that was still damp.
sentences.cn: 现在它装着一件用云根纹样缝制的折叠长袍，还有一张标签，写着我自己的名字，用的还是湿漉漉的墨水。

sentences.en: Neither of us had put it there.
sentences.cn: 我们都没把它放在那里。

profession:2.en: Master Qingwu said that in the Cloud Sea Sect, a disciple's *profession* is not chosen — it is revealed, the way a hidden vein of ore shows itself only when rain washes the hillside bare. She handed me a blank record scroll and told me to press my palm to it. A single word rose through the paper like smoke.
profession:2.cnHint: 师尊说弟子的____不是自己选的，而是由天赋显现——她让我将手掌压在空白册卷上，一个字从纸中升起。
profession:2.hook: The word that appeared was one no disciple had ever been assigned before.
profession:2.line: 'Your *profession* is not what you study — it is what the words decide for you.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said that in the Cloud Sea Sect, a disciple's *profession* is not chosen — it is revealed, the way a hidden vein of ore shows itself only when rain washes the hillside bare.
She handed me a blank record scroll and told me to press my palm to it.
sentences.cn: 她递给我一张空白的记录卷轴，让我把手掌按在上面。

sentences.en: A single word rose through the paper like smoke.
sentences.cn: 一个字像烟一样从纸上升了起来。

readily:2.en: Shen Wujiu *readily* shared his notes on wind-step formulas, spreading scrolls across the stone table without hesitation. He said knowledge kept to oneself grows stale, like still water. I copied three pages by lantern light, grateful. Then I noticed the fourth page was missing — torn away, the edge still jagged and fresh.
readily:2.cnHint: 沈无咎____地将风步咒文的笔记摊开与我共享，毫不犹豫，但第四页已被人撕去，边缘仍新。
readily:2.hook: The torn edge was still warm to the touch.
readily:2.line: 'I *readily* share what I know — someone else, it seems, would rather steal it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu *readily* shared his notes on wind-step formulas, spreading scrolls across the stone table without hesitation.
He said knowledge kept to oneself grows stale, like still water.
sentences.cn: 他毫不迟疑地在石桌上摊开了卷轴，说知识藏在心里就会陈腐，像死水一样。

sentences.en: I copied three pages by lantern light, grateful.
sentences.cn: 我在灯下誊抄了三页，心存感激。

sentences.en: Then I noticed the fourth page was missing — torn away, the edge still jagged and fresh.
sentences.cn: 然后我注意到第四页不见了——被撕掉了，边缘还是崭新的锯齿状。

somewhat:2.en: Deep inside the archive tower, I unrolled a scroll older than the Sect itself. The ink had faded, yet the formula for cloud-walking was *somewhat* legible — enough to trace seven of the nine vital strokes. I copied them by lamplight, hand trembling with the weight of what I had found.
somewhat:2.cnHint: 我在藏经塔深处发现一卷古老秘籍，其中飞升口诀____可以辨认。
somewhat:2.hook: The eighth stroke, however, had been deliberately torn away.
somewhat:2.line: 'The path is *somewhat* clear, but the final gate remains hidden.'

sentences.en: Deep inside the archive tower, I unrolled a scroll older than the Sect itself.
sentences.cn: 深在档案塔内，我展开了一卷比宗派本身还要古老的书卷。

sentences.en: The ink had faded, yet the formula for cloud-walking was *somewhat* legible — enough to trace seven of the nine vital strokes.
I copied them by lamplight, hand trembling with the weight of what I had found.
sentences.cn: 我在灯下誊抄了这七笔，手因为发现之物的分量而颤抖。

stable:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a low stone building at the mountain's root, where spiritual beasts rested between long flights. The air inside was warm and heavy with herb-smoke. 'This is the cloud-crane *stable*,' he said quietly. Pinned to the nearest post was a folded note addressed in Master Qingwu's hand — to me.
stable:2.cnHint: 师兄带我来到云鹤____，我发现了师尊亲笔留下的一张字条。
stable:2.hook: The note bore only three words, and all three were warnings.
stable:2.line: 'Welcome to the *stable* — and read that note before you touch anything.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a low stone building at the mountain's root, where spiritual beasts rested between long flights.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我去了山根处的一座低矮石建筑，那里是灵兽在长途飞行间的歇脚处。

sentences.en: The air inside was warm and heavy with herb-smoke.
sentences.cn: 里面的空气温暖而沉重，弥漫着草药烟雾。

sentences.en: 'This is the cloud-crane *stable*,' he said quietly.
Pinned to the nearest post was a folded note addressed in Master Qingwu's hand — to me.
sentences.cn: 钉在最近的柱子上是一张折起的纸条，用青梧师尊的笔迹写着——收件人是我。

relax:2.en: The message from Master Qingwu arrived folded inside a white crane of paper, left on my stone desk before dawn. It held only four words: 'Come to the Peak.' My fingers were tight around the paper. I told myself to *relax*, to breathe the cool cloud-scented air, but the crane had left a faint burn mark on the desk.
relax:2.cnHint: 师尊留下纸鹤传信，我努力____，却发现纸上留下了焦痕。
relax:2.hook: The burn mark smelled of lightning, not of candles.
relax:2.line: '*Relax* your grip on the scroll — tension breaks the seal,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The message from Master Qingwu arrived folded inside a white crane of paper, left on my stone desk before dawn.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊的信件折在一只白色纸鹤里，天亮前留在了我的石桌上。

sentences.en: It held only four words: 'Come to the Peak.'
sentences.cn: 它只有四个字："来登峰。"

sentences.en: My fingers were tight around the paper.
sentences.cn: 我的手指紧紧握着纸张。

sentences.en: I told myself to *relax*, to breathe the cool cloud-scented air, but the crane had left a faint burn mark on the desk.

release:2.en: Deep in the Herb Vault, Xiaoxing found a sealed jar older than the sect's stone walls. The label said 'voice of the first wind.' She worked the stopper free and chose to *release* its contents into the open air. A sound like distant bells filled the vault, and every dried herb on the shelves turned briefly, perfectly green.
release:2.cnHint: 小星在药库中打开了一个古老密封罐，____了其中之物，架上的草药瞬间恢复了生机。
release:2.hook: Then the bells became a voice, and it spoke her name.
release:2.line: 'I will *release* the seal only once — listen well,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: Deep in the Herb Vault, Xiaoxing found a sealed jar older than the sect's stone walls.
sentences.cn: 在深处的草药库里，小杏找到了一个密封的罐子，比宗派的石墙还要古老。

sentences.en: The label said 'voice of the first wind.'
sentences.cn: 标签上写着"第一阵风的声音"。

sentences.en: She worked the stopper free and chose to *release* its contents into the open air.
A sound like distant bells filled the vault, and every dried herb on the shelves turned briefly, perfectly green.
sentences.cn: 一声像远处钟声的声音充满了库房，架子上的每一株干草都短暂地、完美地转青了。

route:2.en: The old map Shen Wujiu unrolled showed three *routes* from Cloud Sea Sect to the Forbidden Ridge. Two were marked with red ink — danger, collapsed bridges, hungry mist. The third had no ink at all, only a faint crease where someone had pressed a fingernail long ago, as if to say: here, and only here.
route:2.cnHint: 师兄展开古地图，三条前往禁岭的____中，只有一条没有标注危险。
route:2.hook: The unmarked crease was still warm to the touch.
route:2.line: 'This *route* through the high mist is the one Master Qingwu forbids,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The old map Shen Wujiu unrolled showed three *routes* from Cloud Sea Sect to the Forbidden Ridge.
Two were marked with red ink — danger, collapsed bridges, hungry mist.
sentences.cn: 两条用红墨标记——危险、坍塌的桥、饥饿的雾。

sentences.en: The third had no ink at all, only a faint crease where someone had pressed a fingernail long ago, as if to say: here, and only here.
sentences.cn: 第三条没有墨迹，只有一道淡淡的褶子，像是有人用指甲按过很久很久，仿佛在说：这里，只有这里。

sight:2.en: When I entered the Pavilion of Lost Words, the first *sight* that met me was a wall of glass holding a single herb suspended in golden light. The herb had no name on its jar. Shen Wujiu said some words are so powerful they cannot be labeled without waking them. I pressed my palm to the glass and felt my own heartbeat answer.
sight:2.cnHint: 进入失语阁，映入眼帘的____令我震惊——一株悬浮在金光中的无名草药。
sight:2.hook: The herb turned slowly, as though watching me back.
sight:2.line: 'The *sight* of that herb means you have been chosen,' said Shen Wujiu quietly.

sentences.en: When I entered the Pavilion of Lost Words, the first *sight* that met me was a wall of glass holding a single herb suspended in golden light.
The herb had no name on its jar.
sentences.cn: 那株草的罐子上没有名字。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said some words are so powerful they cannot be labeled without waking them.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说有些词太强大了，不能标记，否则就会把它们唤醒。

sentences.en: I pressed my palm to the glass and felt my own heartbeat answer.
sentences.cn: 我把掌心贴在玻璃上，感到自己的心跳回应了。

speaker:2.en: At the monthly gathering on Wind-Thorn Terrace, only one disciple may stand as *speaker* to recite a word-formula aloud. This time the lot fell to me. My voice shook on the first syllable. Master Qingwu did not move. But Xiaoxing, sitting at the edge of the circle, gave one small nod, and I found the second syllable without fear.
speaker:2.cnHint: 在月度集会上，我被选为____，当众诵读咒语，小星的一个点头给了我勇气。
speaker:2.hook: As the last syllable faded, a cloud rose against the wind.
speaker:2.line: 'A good *speaker* does not perform — they simply mean every word,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: At the monthly gathering on Wind-Thorn Terrace, only one disciple may stand as *speaker* to recite a word-formula aloud.
This time the lot fell to me.
sentences.cn: 这次抽签抽到了我。

sentences.en: My voice shook on the first syllable.
sentences.cn: 我在第一个音节上声音发抖。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu did not move.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊没有动。

sentences.en: But Xiaoxing, sitting at the edge of the circle, gave one small nod, and I found the second syllable without fear.
sentences.cn: 但坐在圆圈边缘的小杏轻轻点了一下头，我就不害怕地找到了第二个音节。

species:2.en: In the back room of the Herb Vault, I discovered a row of jars each holding a different *species* of luminous moss. The chart beside them said each one could cure a different kind of forgetting — forgetting a name, a road, a face, a promise. I stood there a long time, wondering which kind of forgetting I feared most.
species:2.cnHint: 药库深处陈列着多种____的发光苔藓，每一种都能治愈不同类型的遗忘。
species:2.hook: One jar had already been opened, and the promise-moss was gone.
species:2.line: 'Each *species* on this shelf answers a different wound of the mind,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: In the back room of the Herb Vault, I discovered a row of jars each holding a different *species* of luminous moss.
The chart beside them said each one could cure a different kind of forgetting — forgetting a name, a road, a face, a promise.
sentences.cn: 旁边的图表说每一种都能治愈一种不同的遗忘——遗忘一个名字、一条路、一张脸、一个承诺。

sentences.en: I stood there a long time, wondering which kind of forgetting I feared most.
sentences.cn: 我站在那里很久，想知道我最害怕遗忘哪一种。
