specifically:2.en: The letter left at my door gave clear instructions — I was to go to the archive at midnight and find the seventh shelf. It did not say why. But it *specifically* named me, using a title I had never told anyone: Keeper of the Unspoken Word. I held the letter until the ink faded, leaving only my name, glowing faintly on blank paper.
specifically:2.cnHint: 那封信____点名让我去藏档室，还用了一个我从未对人提起的称谓。
specifically:2.hook: By morning, even my name had disappeared from the page.
specifically:2.line: 'I am *specifically* asking you, not the others — do you understand why?' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The letter left at my door gave clear instructions — I was to go to the archive at midnight and find the seventh shelf.
sentences.cn: 留在我门口的信写着清楚的指示——我要在午夜去档案馆找第七个书架。

sentences.en: It did not say why.
sentences.cn: 信上没有说为什么。

sentences.en: But it *specifically* named me, using a title I had never told anyone: Keeper of the Unspoken Word.
I held the letter until the ink faded, leaving only my name, glowing faintly on blank paper.
sentences.cn: 我拿着信，直到墨迹褪去，纸上只剩我的名字，幽幽地发着光。

unfortunately:2.en: Xiaoxing had spent three days copying the flight-formula onto a strip of cedar bark. At dawn she climbed to the Launch Stone, spoke the words aloud, and leapt. *Unfortunately*, she rose only one breath's height before drifting back down like a leaf. She landed softly, looked at her hands, and said nothing. Above her, a single feather fell from a cloudless sky.
unfortunately:2.cnHint: 小星苦练飞升咒语，____，她只飘起了一瞬便落回地面，但一根羽毛随后从晴空落下。
unfortunately:2.hook: The feather was not from any bird anyone could name.
unfortunately:2.line: '*Unfortunately*, the formula is only half of flying — the other half is belief,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had spent three days copying the flight-formula onto a strip of cedar bark.
sentences.cn: 小杏花了三天时间把飞行咒语抄在一根雪松皮上。

sentences.en: At dawn she climbed to the Launch Stone, spoke the words aloud, and leapt.
sentences.cn: 天亮时她爬上了发射石，大声念出了那些词，然后跳了下去。

sentences.en: *Unfortunately*, she rose only one breath's height before drifting back down like a leaf.
She landed softly, looked at her hands, and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 她轻轻落地，看了看自己的手，什么也没说。

sentences.en: Above her, a single feather fell from a cloudless sky.
sentences.cn: 她上方，一根羽毛从无云的天空飘落下来。

vigorous:2.en: A scroll arrived at dawn, tied with green thread. Inside, a single line read: 'The *vigorous* disciple who planted the word-seed of wind shall rise to the Trial Peak before the next bell.' My hands did not shake. My breath did not rush. Yet something in my chest grew loud, like a drum struck once in an empty hall.
vigorous:2.cnHint: 清晨，一卷书信送达，说明____的弟子将被召至试炼峰。
vigorous:2.hook: Below the seal, a second line had been added in fresher ink.
vigorous:2.line: 'Only the *vigorous* disciple who tends the word-seeds daily may climb Trial Peak.'

sentences.en: A scroll arrived at dawn, tied with green thread.
sentences.cn: 一卷公文在黎明时分送到，用绿线捆着。

sentences.en: Inside, a single line read: 'The *vigorous* disciple who planted the word-seed of wind shall rise to the Trial Peak before the next bell.'
My hands did not shake.
sentences.cn: 我的手没有抖。

sentences.en: My breath did not rush.
sentences.cn: 我的呼吸没有急促。

sentences.en: Yet something in my chest grew loud, like a drum struck once in an empty hall.
sentences.cn: 但我胸口里有什么变得响亮，像一声鼓被敲响在空荡荡的大厅里。

wide:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an old map across the stone table. The Cloud Sea Sect sat at its centre, but the lands beyond stretched in every direction — a *wide* world of floating islands, hidden valleys, and unmarked peaks where word-herbs no one had named still grew in silence. I counted twelve routes I had never heard of.
wide:2.cnHint: 师尊展开地图，弟子第一次意识到外面的世界有多么____。
wide:2.hook: One island on the far edge bore a name crossed out in red.
wide:2.line: 'The world is *wide*, and most of its word-herbs have never been touched by human hands.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an old map across the stone table.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石桌上铺开了一张旧地图。

sentences.en: The Cloud Sea Sect sat at its centre, but the lands beyond stretched in every direction — a *wide* world of floating islands, hidden valleys, and unmarked peaks where word-herbs no one had named still grew in silence.
I counted twelve routes I had never heard of.
sentences.cn: 我数了数十二条我从未听说过的路线。

agriculture:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin book, its cover worn soft with use. 'Cloud Sea *agriculture*,' he said quietly, 'is not about soil or rain. It is about placing the right word in the right silence and waiting.' Inside, every page described a different word-herb, its season, its need, its danger. The last page was blank.
agriculture:2.cnHint: 师兄交给弟子一本关于云海____的薄书，最后一页是空白的。
agriculture:2.hook: Written in faint pencil on that blank page was a single question mark.
agriculture:2.line: '*Agriculture* here means growing words the way a farmer grows grain — with patience and respect.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin book, its cover worn soft with use.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一本薄薄的书，书皮被摩得柔软光滑。

sentences.en: 'Cloud Sea *agriculture*,' he said quietly, 'is not about soil or rain.
It is about placing the right word in the right silence and waiting.'
sentences.cn: 把正确的词放在正确的寂静里，然后等待。

sentences.en: Inside, every page described a different word-herb, its season, its need, its danger.
sentences.cn: 里面每一页都描写一种不同的词草，它的季节、它的需求、它的危险。

sentences.en: The last page was blank.
sentences.cn: 最后一页是空白的。

assign:2.en: Before the morning mist had lifted, Master Qingwu gathered us at the Gate of First Words. She looked at each disciple in turn, then spoke. 'I will *assign* one word to each of you. Lose it, and it is gone. Master it, and it becomes part of your spirit.' She pressed a folded paper into my palm without meeting my eyes.
assign:2.cnHint: 师尊在晨雾中将特定的词____给每位弟子，弟子收到一张折叠的纸。
assign:2.hook: The paper was warm, as if someone had held it for a long time before me.
assign:2.line: 'I *assign* this word to you alone — no other disciple will carry it.'

sentences.en: Before the morning mist had lifted, Master Qingwu gathered us at the Gate of First Words.
sentences.cn: 晨雾还没有散去，青梧师尊就把我们召集到第一言之门。

sentences.en: She looked at each disciple in turn, then spoke.
sentences.cn: 她逐一看着每个弟子，然后开口说话。

sentences.en: 'I will *assign* one word to each of you.
Lose it, and it is gone.
sentences.cn: 失去它，它就永远消失了。

sentences.en: Master it, and it becomes part of your spirit.'
sentences.cn: 掌握它，它就成为你灵魂的一部分。

sentences.en: She pressed a folded paper into my palm without meeting my eyes.
sentences.cn: 她把一张折叠的纸塞进我的手心，没有看我的眼睛。

broad:2.en: The message stone glowed faintly on my shelf. When I pressed it, Xiaoxing's voice rose from it, calm and clear. 'Come to the *broad* terrace above the herb garden. I found something in the morning dew.' I climbed the stone steps and found her kneeling at the edge, looking down into the clouds below as if reading a text written in mist.
broad:2.cnHint: 小星传来消息，让弟子去草药园上方那片____的露台。
broad:2.hook: In the dew at her feet, three words had formed on their own.
broad:2.line: 'Stand here on the *broad* terrace and you can feel every word-herb below breathing.'

sentences.en: The message stone glowed faintly on my shelf.
sentences.cn: 讯息石在我的架子上微微泛起光芒。

sentences.en: When I pressed it, Xiaoxing's voice rose from it, calm and clear.
sentences.cn: 我按下它时，小杏的声音从里面升起，平静而清晰。

sentences.en: 'Come to the *broad* terrace above the herb garden.
I found something in the morning dew.'
sentences.cn: 我在晨露中发现了什么。

sentences.en: I climbed the stone steps and found her kneeling at the edge, looking down into the clouds below as if reading a text written in mist.
sentences.cn: 我爬上石阶，发现她跪在边缘处，低头凝视着下方的云海，仿佛在读一篇用雾气写成的文字。

careful:2.en: Xiaoxing left a note folded under my ink stone. It said only: 'Be *careful* with the word you were given. I heard it hum last night through the wall between our rooms. Words that hum before they are learned are already trying to leave.' I read it three times. Outside, the clouds had turned the colour of old copper.
careful:2.cnHint: 小星留下纸条，提醒弟子对被赋予的词要____，因为它已经开始振鸣。
careful:2.hook: When I reached for my assigned word, the paper that held it was cold.
careful:2.line: 'Be *careful* — a word that hums before it is mastered is looking for a stronger keeper.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing left a note folded under my ink stone.
sentences.cn: 小杏在我的砚台下留了一张纸条。

sentences.en: It said only: 'Be *careful* with the word you were given.
I heard it hum last night through the wall between our rooms.
sentences.cn: 我昨晚听到它在我们房间之间的墙里嗡嗡叫。

sentences.en: Words that hum before they are learned are already trying to leave.'
sentences.cn: 在被学会之前就嗡嗡叫的词已经在试图离开了。

sentences.en: I read it three times.
sentences.cn: 我读了三遍。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds had turned the colour of old copper.
sentences.cn: 外面，云层已经变成了老铜的颜色。

combination:2.en: Shen Wujiu found me at the archive shelf and pointed to a passage in a cracked book. 'Look,' he said. 'A *combination* of two weak word-herbs can open a sealed gate that neither could open alone.' The passage was old, the ink nearly gone, but the diagram beneath it showed two familiar symbols I had already been assigned. My throat went dry.
combination:2.cnHint: 师兄在古籍中发现，两种弱字草的____可以开启封印之门。
combination:2.hook: The gate in the diagram matched the locked door at the base of our mountain.
combination:2.line: 'This *combination* of words is older than the sect itself — and no one knows who sealed it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu found me at the archive shelf and pointed to a passage in a cracked book.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在档案架旁找到我，指向一本破旧书籍中的一段文字。

sentences.en: 'Look,' he said.
sentences.cn: "看，"他说。

sentences.en: 'A *combination* of two weak word-herbs can open a sealed gate that neither could open alone.'
The passage was old, the ink nearly gone, but the diagram beneath it showed two familiar symbols I had already been assigned.
sentences.cn: 文字很古老，墨迹几近褪去，但下面的图示显示了两个我已经被分配的熟悉符号。

sentences.en: My throat went dry.
sentences.cn: 我的喉咙发干。

constant:2.en: A letter came, rolled inside a hollow reed, addressed in Master Qingwu's own hand. It read: 'The Cloud Sea makes *constant* demands on those who would rise above it. Let your practice be equally constant.' Below those words she had pressed her seal — and beside the seal, a single white feather that had never come from any bird I knew.
constant:2.cnHint: 师尊亲笔来信，说明云海对修行者有____的要求，信旁有一根陌生的白羽。
constant:2.hook: The feather dissolved into mist the moment I touched it.
constant:2.line: 'Let your study be *constant* — the cloud sea never rests, and neither should your practice.'

sentences.en: A letter came, rolled inside a hollow reed, addressed in Master Qingwu's own hand.
sentences.cn: 一封信来了，卷在一根空心芦苇里，用青梧师尊自己的笔迹写着地址。

sentences.en: It read: 'The Cloud Sea makes *constant* demands on those who would rise above it.
Let your practice be equally constant.'
sentences.cn: 让你的修行同样持恒。

sentences.en: Below those words she had pressed her seal — and beside the seal, a single white feather that had never come from any bird I knew.
sentences.cn: 在那些字下面，她按下了自己的印章——在印章旁边，一根从我认识的任何鸟儿身上都没有掉落过的白羽毛。

himself:2.en: Master Qingwu did not send a messenger. He wrote the warning *himself*, pressing each word into the bark with his own finger so the spiritual ink would carry his full intent. The scroll arrived warm, almost alive. I unrolled it and felt the mountain shift beneath my feet.
himself:2.cnHint: 师尊____亲笔写下警示卷轴，我展开它时，脚下的山峰突然震动。
himself:2.hook: The mountain had never moved before.
himself:2.line: 'He sealed this *himself* — no other hand could carry such weight.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu did not send a messenger.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊没有派信使。

sentences.en: He wrote the warning *himself*, pressing each word into the bark with his own finger so the spiritual ink would carry his full intent.
The scroll arrived warm, almost alive.
sentences.cn: 卷轴到达时还是温热的，几乎像活着一样。

sentences.en: I unrolled it and felt the mountain shift beneath my feet.
sentences.cn: 我展开它，感觉到山在我脚下移动了。

landscape:2.en: From the upper terrace I finally saw the full *landscape* of the Cloud Sea Sect: seven peaks rising like ink-brushed needles above a silver ocean of mist. Each peak held a word of power. I had only begun to read the first. Below, something dark passed through the clouds.
landscape:2.cnHint: 站在高台上，我第一次看清云海宗的全部____，七座山峰如画，然而云层之下似有黑影掠过。
landscape:2.hook: The shadow did not belong to any bird I knew.
landscape:2.line: 'This *landscape* holds seven words — and you have earned only one.'

sentences.en: From the upper terrace I finally saw the full *landscape* of the Cloud Sea Sect: seven peaks rising like ink-brushed needles above a silver ocean of mist.
Each peak held a word of power.
sentences.cn: 每座峰都持有一个力量之语。

sentences.en: I had only begun to read the first.
sentences.cn: 我才刚开始读第一个。

sentences.en: Below, something dark passed through the clouds.
sentences.cn: 下方，什么黑暗的东西穿过了云雾。

mentally:2.en: Shen Wujiu told me to rest before the trial, but I could not stop rehearsing the formula. I traced it *mentally*, word by word, as if my mind were a finger drawing in sand. By dawn I had worn a groove in my own thoughts. Then a cold wind arrived without warning.
mentally:2.cnHint: 师兄叮嘱我休息，但我仍在____默练咒文，黎明前一阵冷风毫无预兆地袭来。
mentally:2.hook: Cold wind on a still morning means the trial has already begun.
mentally:2.line: 'Practice it *mentally* first — the mouth speaks what the mind already knows.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me to rest before the trial, but I could not stop rehearsing the formula.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎让我在试炼前休息，但我无法停止演练那个公式。

sentences.en: I traced it *mentally*, word by word, as if my mind were a finger drawing in sand.
By dawn I had worn a groove in my own thoughts.
sentences.cn: 到天亮时，我已经在自己的思想里磨出了一道沟槽。

sentences.en: Then a cold wind arrived without warning.
sentences.cn: 然后一阵冷风无声地来临了。

neither:2.en: The ancient scroll offered two paths up the peak: the stone steps carved by old disciples, or the wind current used only by those who could speak the flight word. I could do *neither* yet. I stood at the base, breath steady, and waited for a third answer to arrive.
neither:2.cnHint: 古卷提供了两条登顶之路，而我两者____能走，我静静站在山脚，等待第三条路出现。
neither:2.hook: A third path appeared — but it cost more than climbing.
neither:2.line: '*Neither* road is closed to you — only one is closed to you today.'

sentences.en: The ancient scroll offered two paths up the peak: the stone steps carved by old disciples, or the wind current used only by those who could speak the flight word.
sentences.cn: 古老的卷轴提供了两条上山峰的路：老弟子刻凿的石阶，或只有能说出飞行之语的人才能用的风流。

sentences.en: I could do *neither* yet.
I stood at the base, breath steady, and waited for a third answer to arrive.
sentences.cn: 我站在山脚，呼吸平稳，等待第三个答案到来。

onto:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed the seed-word *onto* the blank page with two careful fingers, and the ink bloomed outward like a flower opening in fast motion. The character meant 'carry.' She said a word without heart behind it leaves no mark. The page began to glow, then went dark.
onto:2.cnHint: 师妹将种字____空白页上，墨迹如花绽放，但页面发光片刻后骤然变暗。
onto:2.hook: A word that goes dark has been heard by something else.
onto:2.line: 'Press it *onto* the page slowly — the word must feel the surface before it holds.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed the seed-word *onto* the blank page with two careful fingers, and the ink bloomed outward like a flower opening in fast motion.
The character meant 'carry.'
sentences.cn: 这个字的意思是"承载"。

sentences.en: She said a word without heart behind it leaves no mark.
sentences.cn: 她说一个没有心的字无法留下印迹。

sentences.en: The page began to glow, then went dark.
sentences.cn: 页面开始发光，然后陷入了黑暗。

plus:2.en: The healing formula required three root-words *plus* one word of breath. I had gathered the three. The fourth lived only in Master Qingwu's silence — the pause between his sentences where the real teaching hid. I listened harder than I had ever listened. A single white feather drifted down.
plus:2.cnHint: 疗愈咒需要三个根字____一个气字，第四个字藏在师尊的沉默里，一根白羽随后飘落。
plus:2.hook: White feathers mean a spirit bird above — watching.
plus:2.line: 'Three known words *plus* one silence — that is every formula worth learning.'

sentences.en: The healing formula required three root-words *plus* one word of breath.
I had gathered the three.
sentences.cn: 我已经集齐了三个。

sentences.en: The fourth lived only in Master Qingwu's silence — the pause between his sentences where the real teaching hid.
sentences.cn: 第四个只存在于青梧师尊的沉默中——她句子间的停顿，真正的教诲隐藏的地方。

sentences.en: I listened harder than I had ever listened.
sentences.cn: 我比以往任何时候都更用心地听着。

sentences.en: A single white feather drifted down.
sentences.cn: 一根白羽毛飘落了下来。

root:2.en: Shen Wujiu knelt by the old pine at the cliff's edge and pressed his ear to the bark. 'Every word has a *root*,' he said, 'and every root reaches toward the same dark water below the mountain.' He stood, brushed moss from his sleeve, and pointed at a crack in the stone.
root:2.cnHint: 师兄俯身贴近老松，说每个字都有____，而每条根都伸向山下同一片黑暗之水，随后他指向石缝。
root:2.hook: The crack had not been there at dawn.
root:2.line: 'Find the *root* of the word before you speak it — or the word will find its own root in you.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu knelt by the old pine at the cliff's edge and pressed his ear to the bark.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎跪在悬崖边的老松树旁，把耳朵贴在树皮上。

sentences.en: 'Every word has a *root*,' he said, 'and every root reaches toward the same dark water below the mountain.'
He stood, brushed moss from his sleeve, and pointed at a crack in the stone.
sentences.cn: 他站起身，拍掉袖子上的苔藓，指向石头上的一条裂缝。

satisfy:2.en: The trial demanded that I write one word to *satisfy* the mountain's hunger — one true word, not borrowed, not copied, grown from my own breath and need. I stood for a long time with an empty brush. When the word finally came, the clouds below the peak parted in a circle.
satisfy:2.cnHint: 试炼要求我写出一个能____山峰之渴的字，我持笔久久沉默，字出时，山下云海裂开一个圆。
satisfy:2.hook: The circle of open sky held the shape of an eye.
satisfy:2.line: 'One honest word will *satisfy* what a hundred borrowed ones never can.'

sentences.en: The trial demanded that I write one word to *satisfy* the mountain's hunger — one true word, not borrowed, not copied, grown from my own breath and need.
I stood for a long time with an empty brush.
sentences.cn: 我站了很久，拿着一支空荡荡的笔。

sentences.en: When the word finally came, the clouds below the peak parted in a circle.
sentences.cn: 当那个字终于出现时，山峰下的云在一个圆形内散开了。

consultant:2.en: A sealed bamboo scroll arrived at my door before dawn, bearing the mark of an elder I had never met. Inside, a single line read: 'Seek the *consultant* of the Archive Hall — she alone knows which word-herbs grow on the forbidden peak.' I did not know such a role existed within the Sect. The morning mist swallowed the messenger's footprints before I could look up.
consultant:2.cnHint: 黎明前一封竹简送到我门前，指引我去寻找档案堂的____，她知道禁峰上的字草秘密。
consultant:2.hook: The scroll's ink had not yet dried when it crumbled to ash.
consultant:2.line: 'Go to the *consultant* of the Archive Hall before the second bell rings.'

sentences.en: A sealed bamboo scroll arrived at my door before dawn, bearing the mark of an elder I had never met.
sentences.cn: 一个密封的竹简在天亮前送到了我的门前，上面印着一个我从未见过的长老的标记。

sentences.en: Inside, a single line read: 'Seek the *consultant* of the Archive Hall — she alone knows which word-herbs grow on the forbidden peak.'
I did not know such a role existed within the Sect.
sentences.cn: 我不知道宗门里存在这样一个角色。

sentences.en: The morning mist swallowed the messenger's footprints before I could look up.
sentences.cn: 晨雾吞没了信使的足迹，在我抬头看之前。

direct:2.en: The stone tablet near the eastern bridge held a map carved in silver light. Most paths twisted around fog-covered cliffs, but one line cut straight through — *direct*, bold, unapologetic. Shen Wujiu placed his hand beside the line and said nothing for a long moment. A single cloud, shaped like an open eye, drifted across the sun overhead.
direct:2.cnHint: 石碑上的地图显示，有一条____路径穿越迷雾峭壁，师兄凝视良久，沉默不语。
direct:2.hook: The carved line slowly began to glow red at its center.
direct:2.line: 'This is the only *direct* route — but no disciple has returned from it.'

sentences.en: The stone tablet near the eastern bridge held a map carved in silver light.
sentences.cn: 东桥附近的石碑上刻着用银色光芒显现的地图。

sentences.en: Most paths twisted around fog-covered cliffs, but one line cut straight through — *direct*, bold, unapologetic.
Shen Wujiu placed his hand beside the line and said nothing for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把他的手放在那条线旁边，沉默了很长一段时间。

sentences.en: A single cloud, shaped like an open eye, drifted across the sun overhead.
sentences.cn: 一朵形状像睁开的眼睛的单独云朵飘过了头顶的太阳。

discourage:2.en: Xiaoxing found the note tucked beneath her practice stone: 'Do not attempt the Wind-Word before the third month.' She understood it was meant to *discourage* her from rushing, yet the characters on the note shimmered with a light she had never seen before. She folded it carefully and looked toward the peak. Thunder answered from a clear sky.
discourage:2.cnHint: 小星在练功石下发现一张纸条，意在____她不要贸然修炼风字诀，但纸上字迹散发着异光。
discourage:2.hook: The folded note trembled in her hand as if breathing.
discourage:2.line: 'I wrote it to *discourage* you, not to stop your courage entirely.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found the note tucked beneath her practice stone: 'Do not attempt the Wind-Word before the third month.'
sentences.cn: 小杏在练功石下发现了那张纸条："第三个月前不要尝试风言术。"

sentences.en: She understood it was meant to *discourage* her from rushing, yet the characters on the note shimmered with a light she had never seen before.
She folded it carefully and looked toward the peak.
sentences.cn: 她小心地叠好纸条，朝山峰望去。

sentences.en: Thunder answered from a clear sky.
sentences.cn: 晴空中传来了雷鸣。

essentially:2.en: In the old storage room beneath the Hall of Words, I found a jar sealed with red clay. The label, written in Master Qingwu's hand, read: 'This formula is *essentially* a key — feed it the right sound and it will open what no hand can.' Dust floated in the pale light. At the bottom of the jar, something knocked twice.
essentially:2.cnHint: 在字堂地下室里，我找到一个封存的罐子，标签写着这道符文____是一把钥匙。
essentially:2.hook: The knocking from inside the jar stopped, then began again — three times now.
essentially:2.line: 'It is *essentially* a key, but what it opens, I dare not name.'

sentences.en: In the old storage room beneath the Hall of Words, I found a jar sealed with red clay.
sentences.cn: 在言语殿下的旧库房里，我发现了一个用红泥封住的罐子。

sentences.en: The label, written in Master Qingwu's hand, read: 'This formula is *essentially* a key — feed it the right sound and it will open what no hand can.'
Dust floated in the pale light.
sentences.cn: 尘埃在苍白的光线中飘浮。

sentences.en: At the bottom of the jar, something knocked twice.
sentences.cn: 罐子底部传来了两下敲击声。

extent:2.en: The messenger bird delivered a wrapped cloth, inside which lay a measuring cord of pale silk. A note from Shen Wujiu explained: 'Use this to find the *extent* of the broken seal around the east cliff — mark where the spiritual air ends and the dead air begins.' I walked to the cliff edge and held the cord out. The silk pulled taut on its own, pointing downward.
extent:2.cnHint: 师兄寄来一根丝绳，让我测量东崖破损封印的____，标出灵气与死气的边界所在。
extent:2.hook: The cord pulled downward with a force no wind could explain.
extent:2.line: 'We must know the full *extent* of the damage before Master Qingwu returns.'

sentences.en: The messenger bird delivered a wrapped cloth, inside which lay a measuring cord of pale silk.
sentences.cn: 传讯鸟送来了一卷布料，里面躺着一根淡蓝色的丝绳。

sentences.en: A note from Shen Wujiu explained: 'Use this to find the *extent* of the broken seal around the east cliff — mark where the spiritual air ends and the dead air begins.'
I walked to the cliff edge and held the cord out.
sentences.cn: 我走到悬崖边，把绳子伸了出去。

sentences.en: The silk pulled taut on its own, pointing downward.
sentences.cn: 丝绳自己绷紧了，指向下方。

finance:2.en: Tucked inside the Sect's old supply ledger, between records of ink and candles, I found a page unlike the rest. It listed not goods but word-herbs, with a column marked '*finance* of the hidden garden' — someone had been quietly funding a secret collection of rare formulas for years. The handwriting matched no name on any register I could find.
finance:2.cnHint: 在宗门旧账簿中，我发现一页记录着隐秘花园的____，有人多年来暗中为珍稀字草提供资金。
finance:2.hook: The page was dated three years before the Sect was officially founded.
finance:2.line: 'The *finance* for this garden came from somewhere far above us.'

sentences.en: Tucked inside the Sect's old supply ledger, between records of ink and candles, I found a page unlike the rest.
sentences.cn: 在宗门的旧账簿里，夹在墨水和蜡烛的记录之间，我发现了一页与众不同的纸张。

sentences.en: It listed not goods but word-herbs, with a column marked '*finance* of the hidden garden' — someone had been quietly funding a secret collection of rare formulas for years.
The handwriting matched no name on any register I could find.
sentences.cn: 笔迹与我查到的任何登记簿上的名字都不相符。

freedom:2.en: Pinned to the bark of the old cedar near the training ground, a square of paper read: 'Master Qingwu grants full *freedom* of the Archive Hall to the new disciple — all shelves, all hours.' I read it twice. No such permission had ever been given to a first-year student. A single white feather drifted down and landed on the word 'freedom,' covering it completely.
freedom:2.cnHint: 老杉树上贴着一张纸，写着清雾师尊授予新弟子使用档案堂的完全____，这在往届弟子中从未有过。
freedom:2.hook: The feather was still warm, as if it had just left a living wing.
freedom:2.line: 'With this *freedom* comes a weight you have not yet felt.'

sentences.en: Pinned to the bark of the old cedar near the training ground, a square of paper read: 'Master Qingwu grants full *freedom* of the Archive Hall to the new disciple — all shelves, all hours.'
I read it twice.
sentences.cn: 我读了两遍。

sentences.en: No such permission had ever been given to a first-year student.
sentences.cn: 从来没有过一年级学生获得这样的许可。

sentences.en: A single white feather drifted down and landed on the word 'freedom,' covering it completely.
sentences.cn: 一根洁白的羽毛飘然而下，落在"自由"二字上，完全遮住了它。

highlight:2.en: Among the scrolls Xiaoxing left on my desk, one was marked with a thin stroke of red oil. The stroke served to *highlight* a single line buried deep in an old record: 'The word for ascent only works at the boundary between night and morning.' She had left no other message. Outside my window, the sky was already shifting from black to deep blue.
highlight:2.cnHint: 小星在卷轴上用红油____了一句关键记录：飞升之字只在夜与晨的交界处方才奏效。
highlight:2.hook: The red mark on the scroll had not been made with any brush I recognized.
highlight:2.line: 'I used red oil to *highlight* it because I knew you would almost miss it.'

sentences.en: Among the scrolls Xiaoxing left on my desk, one was marked with a thin stroke of red oil.
sentences.cn: 在小杏留在我桌子上的卷轴中，有一卷用红油画了细长一笔。

sentences.en: The stroke served to *highlight* a single line buried deep in an old record: 'The word for ascent only works at the boundary between night and morning.'
She had left no other message.
sentences.cn: 她没有留下其他信息。

sentences.en: Outside my window, the sky was already shifting from black to deep blue.
sentences.cn: 我窗外的天色已经从黑色变成了深蓝。

artificial:0.en: Inside the Hall of Records, rows of spirit-lamps burned with a cold blue light. Master Qingwu warned us that every flame here was *artificial*, fed by carved stones rather than true spiritual fire. 'A disciple who cannot tell the difference,' she said quietly, 'will never ascend.'
artificial:0.cnHint: 在典籍殿中，师尊指出殿内的灵灯并非真正的灵火，而是____的，告诫弟子要能辨别真伪。
artificial:0.hook: Then one lamp flickered — and no stone nearby glowed at all.
artificial:0.line: 'Every *artificial* flame here hides what true fire should reveal.'

sentences.en: Inside the Hall of Records, rows of spirit-lamps burned with a cold blue light.
sentences.cn: 在记录厅里，一排排灵灯闪烁着冷蓝色的光。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu warned us that every flame here was *artificial*, fed by carved stones rather than true spiritual fire.
'A disciple who cannot tell the difference,' she said quietly, 'will never ascend.'
sentences.cn: "一个分不清楚的弟子，"她静静地说，"永远成不了仙。"

oil:0.en: Shen Wujiu knelt beside the old cultivation furnace, carefully pouring a dark *oil* pressed from cloud-lotus seeds into its base. He explained that without this offering, the furnace would refuse to ignite and the night's refining would be lost. The smell was deep and sweet.
oil:0.cnHint: 师兄在修炼炉旁，将云莲种子榨成的____注入炉底，准备当晚的炼制。
oil:0.hook: A single drop fell outside the circle, and the floor cracked open.
oil:0.line: 'This *oil* carries the memory of every cloud the lotus ever touched.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu knelt beside the old cultivation furnace, carefully pouring a dark *oil* pressed from cloud-lotus seeds into its base.
He explained that without this offering, the furnace would refuse to ignite and the night's refining would be lost.
sentences.cn: 他解释说不用这个供奉，炉子就会拒绝点火，今晚的炼制就会泡汤。

sentences.en: The smell was deep and sweet.
sentences.cn: 气味很深沉，很甜。

pretty:1.en: At the mountain gate, Xiaoxing pressed a small jade piece into my hand. 'Every new disciple receives one,' she said softly. The other disciples wore theirs as pendants, bright against their grey robes — each a *pretty* that marked belonging. I turned mine over, feeling the warmth of the sect's first welcome settle into my bones.
pretty:1.cnHint: 小星将一块玉饰送给我，那是新弟子身份的象征，我感受到了门派的温暖。
pretty:1.hook: But the jade in my palm had begun, very faintly, to crack.
pretty:1.line: 'A *pretty* like this one has not glowed for a hundred years.'

sentences.en: At the mountain gate, Xiaoxing pressed a small jade piece into my hand.
sentences.cn: 在山门口，小杏把一块小玉佩塞进了我的手里。

sentences.en: 'Every new disciple receives one,' she said softly.
sentences.cn: "每个新弟子都会得到一块，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: The other disciples wore theirs as pendants, bright against their grey robes — each a *pretty* that marked belonging.
I turned mine over, feeling the warmth of the sect's first welcome settle into my bones.
sentences.cn: 我翻转着我的玉佩，感受着宗门首次欢迎的温暖沉进了我的骨子里。

vital:2.en: The sealed scroll arrived at dawn, carried by a crane with silver wings. Inside, a single line read: 'The word *vital* to your ascent rests on the northern peak — find it before the third bell.' Master Qingwu stood at the gate, eyes fixed on the horizon, her silence heavier than any warning.
vital:2.cnHint: 一封密封的卷轴在黎明时分送达，提示弟子有一个对飞升____的字词藏于北峰。
vital:2.hook: The third bell was already beginning to ring.
vital:2.line: 'Guard it well — this word is *vital* to everything that follows.'

sentences.en: The sealed scroll arrived at dawn, carried by a crane with silver wings.
sentences.cn: 天亮的时候一张封好的卷轴来了，由一只银翅的仙鹤送来。

sentences.en: Inside, a single line read: 'The word *vital* to your ascent rests on the northern peak — find it before the third bell.'
Master Qingwu stood at the gate, eyes fixed on the horizon, her silence heavier than any warning.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在山门口，眼睛盯着地平线，她的沉默比任何警告都沉甸甸。

toward:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a folded note into my hand without a word and walked away. I opened it: a small map, a dotted path leading *toward* the edge of the outer cliff, where a hollow stone was said to hold the sect's oldest unspoken formula. The clouds below had turned the colour of iron.
toward:2.cnHint: 师兄悄悄递来一张纸条，上面画着一条通往悬崖边缘____某处的路。
toward:2.hook: Something beneath the cliff edge exhaled a low, steady breath.
toward:2.line: 'Walk *toward* the hollow stone — the formula is waiting inside it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a folded note into my hand without a word and walked away.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎不声不响地把一张折叠的纸条塞进我手里，然后走开了。

sentences.en: I opened it: a small map, a dotted path leading *toward* the edge of the outer cliff, where a hollow stone was said to hold the sect's oldest unspoken formula.
The clouds below had turned the colour of iron.
sentences.cn: 下面的云变成了铁的颜色。

multiple:2.en: Xiaoxing spread the recovered pages across the stone table. 'There are *multiple* versions of the ascent formula,' she said softly, tracing each line with one careful finger. 'Only one is true. The rest will send you into the clouds and no further.' She did not say how to tell them apart.
multiple:2.cnHint: 师妹发现飞升咒文竟有____个版本，只有一个是真正有效的。
multiple:2.hook: One page was still warm, as though someone had just set it down.
multiple:2.line: '*Multiple* copies exist, and most of them are traps.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread the recovered pages across the stone table.
sentences.cn: 小杏把找到的页面摊开在石桌上。

sentences.en: 'There are *multiple* versions of the ascent formula,' she said softly, tracing each line with one careful finger.
'Only one is true.
sentences.cn: "只有一个是真的。

sentences.en: The rest will send you into the clouds and no further.'
sentences.cn: 其他的会把你送进云里，没别的。"

sentences.en: She did not say how to tell them apart.
sentences.cn: 她没说怎么分辨。

progress:2.en: Each dawn I copied the flying formula onto fresh bark and burned it in the courtyard flame. Master Qingwu watched for seven days without comment. On the eighth morning she left a stone marker at my door — the sect's sign that a disciple had begun to *progress* past the outer gate of understanding. The marker was cracked down the middle.
progress:2.cnHint: 经过七天的练习，弟子终于开始在领悟飞升咒文上有所____，师尊留下了印记。
progress:2.hook: A cracked marker, the older disciples said, meant the path ahead would split.
progress:2.line: 'You finally *progress* — but the hardest step is still ahead of you.'

sentences.en: Each dawn I copied the flying formula onto fresh bark and burned it in the courtyard flame.
sentences.cn: 每个天亮我都在新鲜的树皮上抄飞升咒，在院子的火焰里烧掉。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched for seven days without comment.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊看了七天，一句话都没说。

sentences.en: On the eighth morning she left a stone marker at my door — the sect's sign that a disciple had begun to *progress* past the outer gate of understanding.
The marker was cracked down the middle.
sentences.cn: 那块标记从中间裂开了。

north:2.en: The message was burned into a leaf and left on my sleeping mat: 'The word that lifts a soul from stone is buried *north* of the Bell Tower, beneath the white root.' Shen Wujiu had drawn a small arrow in the corner. I looked up; through the paper window, the Bell Tower flag was already pointing the wrong way.
north:2.cnHint: 一片叶子上的焦字告诉弟子，关键字词埋藏在钟楼____方的白根之下。
north:2.hook: The flag had never pointed that way before — not in living memory.
north:2.line: 'Go *north* of the Bell Tower before the root dries out completely.'

sentences.en: The message was burned into a leaf and left on my sleeping mat: 'The word that lifts a soul from stone is buried *north* of the Bell Tower, beneath the white root.'
Shen Wujiu had drawn a small arrow in the corner.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在角落里画了一个小箭头。

sentences.en: I looked up; through the paper window, the Bell Tower flag was already pointing the wrong way.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头，透过纸窗，钟楼的旗子已经指向了反方向。

identity:1.en: At the base of the Ascension Pillar, every disciple carved their name into living stone. When my turn came, the chisel slipped from my hand. Master Qingwu caught it before it struck the ground and studied my face with calm, searching eyes. 'Your *identity* as a disciple of Cloud Sea Sect is not yet sealed,' she said softly.
identity:1.cnHint: 在飞升柱前，弟子们刻下姓名以确认自己的____，而叙述者的凿子却意外滑落。
identity:1.hook: The stone where my name should be had already begun to glow.
identity:1.line: 'Your *identity* as a disciple of Cloud Sea Sect is not yet sealed.'

sentences.en: At the base of the Ascension Pillar, every disciple carved their name into living stone.
sentences.cn: 在飞升柱的底部，每个弟子都要把自己的名字刻进活石里。

sentences.en: When my turn came, the chisel slipped from my hand.
sentences.cn: 轮到我的时候，凿子从我手里滑落了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu caught it before it struck the ground and studied my face with calm, searching eyes.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在它砸到地上之前接住了，用平静而探寻的眼神打量着我的脸。

sentences.en: 'Your *identity* as a disciple of Cloud Sea Sect is not yet sealed,' she said softly.
